threads.title: [BUG] dsh subagent 在 GUI 冷恢复后默认切回 dsv4p 模型导致扣费路由错误
threads.bodyText:
问题
Subagent 继承的是 agent.options 而非父 agent 的实际模型路由 —— GUI 切换模型或冷恢复后子代理静默跨 provider 计费

概述
dsh-subagent 解析子代理的 provider/model 时读取的是 parent.options（父 agent 创建时的 AgentOptions），而父 agent 的实际服务路由可以被模型选择瀑布（installModelSelection，@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent）按请求覆盖。两者一旦分叉，subagent 就会静默地把账单记到 agent.options 里写的 provider 上——而不是父 agent 真正在用的那个 provider。
本次事故中，分叉由 GUI 冷恢复路径引入：它用部署默认模型播种 agentOptions，同时把服务路由钉在会话持久化的 request/header 上。父 agent 自己一直在钉定路由上跑，但它派生的全部 61 个子/孙会话都按部署默认模型创建，账单全部记到了官方平台账号。
严重度
Critical —— 静默跨 provider 计费 / 成本泄漏，附带错误模型执行。财务影响只有去 provider 账单页才看得到。
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6；涉及包均为 0.1.0-rc.6：
dsh-subagent、dsh-host-apiproxy、dsh-api-remotes、dsh-agent-loop、dsh-agent-default-model、dsh-agent、dsh-session。
Node.js v22.22.2，macOS 26.6.1 (arm64)。
服务：launchd com.deepseek.dsh.web 运行 dsh web，监听 127.0.0.1:3080。

真实事故
时间线（UTC+8）：



时间
事件




20:48
session 启动。第 1 轮。request/header（reason=initial）：custom1/custom1。


21:18
DSH 宿主停止（重启）。run 记录被 recoverInterruptedRuns() 标为 failed / host_interrupted。


21:24
会话经 Web GUI API proxy 冷恢复。request/header（reason=resume）：仍是 custom1/custom1。


21:37 / 21:50 / 22:01
恢复后的父 agent 分三批派发 44 个直接子代理 + 17 个孙代理。


22:10
最后一个子代理活动结束。期间 DeepSeek 平台账号持续扣费。



观测到的父/子分叉：

父会话日志（每一条 request/header）：config.provider=custom1，config.model=custom1。
每个子会话日志（subagent/descriptor）："agentProvider":"deepseek-official"，"agentModel":"deepseek-v4-pro"；子会话自己的 request/header 证实它确实由 deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro 服务。
deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro 正是 settings.yaml → agent-default-model——即部署默认模型。

成本：树内 61 个子会话，token 字段合计 ≈ input 471 万 / output 190 万 / reasoning 109 万（≈ 770 万），全部记到错误的provider，而父 agent 的流量一直走原路由。
根因
1. subagent 继承读的是 options，不是实际路由
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/index.js（0.1.0-rc.6），resolveChildAgentOptions（501–512 行）：
function resolveChildAgentOptions(parent, requested, childDepth) {
	const parentProvider = parent.options.provider;
	const parentModel = parent.options.model;
	const parentMaxTokens = parent.options.maxTokens;
	return {
		...parentProvider !== void 0 ? { provider: parentProvider } : {},
		...parentModel !== void 0 ? { model: parentModel } : {},
		...parentMaxTokens !== void 0 ? { maxTokens: parentMaxTokens } : {},
		...requested,
		subagentDepth: childDepth
	};
}
parent.options 是父 agent 创建/恢复时传入的 AgentOptions。任何改变父 agent 实际服务路由的机制都不会更新它。
2a. 冷恢复用部署默认模型播种 options，同时把路由钉在会话日志上
@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js（0.1.0-rc.6），createApiProxy：
/** The seed model each create/resume declares; re-read so it never goes stale. */
const agentOptions = () => {
	const { provider, model } = defaults.defaultModelSelection();
	return { provider, model };
};
这个闭包同时用于全新创建和冷恢复（经 createApiRemoteAgentResolver → ctx.agents.resume({ resumeSessionId, agentOptions: options.agentOptions() })，@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes/lib/index.js 124–126 行）。
而 selectionFor()（host-apiproxy 1750–1774 行）按此优先级安装请求级选择：进程内 picker 选择 → 会话持久化的 request/header 配置 → 部署默认。于是恢复后的 agent 处于：

agent.options = 部署默认（deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro）
每次请求的实际路由 = 持久化 header（custom1/custom1）

父 agent 自己的 LLM 调用因此继续走持久化路由（正确），但 resolveChildAgentOptions 把 agent.options——部署默认——复制进每个子代理（错误，产生扣费）。
2b. GUI 模型选择器在活跃会话上有同样的分叉
模型选择 RPC（host-apiproxy 2701 行）：
selectionFor(found.agent).current = selected;
它只写请求级 selection，从不写 agent.options。因此任何用户在 GUI 里选了不同于 agent-default-model 的模型的会话，立即出现 options ≠ 实际路由，它派生的每个 subagent 都会静默记到默认 provider 的账上。无需重启——这就是下面的最小复现。
最小复现
复现 A —— GUI 模型选择器（无需重启）：

settings.yaml 的 agent-default-model = provider A / model a。
新建会话。用模型选择器切到 provider B / model b（B ≠ A）。
发送：「Delegate one subagent (run_in_background: false) to reply with a single word.」
观察：父会话 request/header = B/b；子会话的 subagent/descriptor 与 request/header = A/a。扣费的是 provider A。

复现 B —— 冷恢复：

会话被钉到 B/b（picker）。至少发一次请求，让 request/header 存在。
重启 dsh web。
在 GUI 恢复该会话并派发一个 subagent。观察结果同上。

threads.title: Windows: dsh plugin add splits paths with spaces, and hook bridges fail open silently
threads.bodyText:
Two Windows issues found while evaluating dsh on Windows 11, both reproduced on 47f94385 with Node 24.19.0. Posting here since CONTRIBUTING.md asks for Discussions rather than PRs.
1. dsh plugin add splits a package path that contains a space
apps/cli/src/plugin.ts calls spawnSync('pnpm', args, { shell: process.platform === 'win32' }). With shell: true and CMD, Node sets windowsVerbatimArguments, so the argv is concatenated into one unquoted command line and cmd re-tokenizes it.
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\Repo Clones\lhh010\dsh-minigames"

installs two dependencies, Repo and a broken link:Clones\lhh010\dsh-minigames, then prints the misleading Repo declares no dsh.bundle warning. Staging the package at a space-free path works around it. Relative specifiers also resolve against the caller's cwd rather than the profile directory, which surprised me separately.
One fix that passes here removes shell: true and spawns the command processor directly, so Node applies its own quoting:
export function buildPnpmSpawn(
  anchored: readonly string[],
  platform: NodeJS.Platform,
  comspec: string | undefined,
): { command: string; args: readonly string[] } {
  if (platform !== 'win32') return { command: 'pnpm', args: anchored }
  return { command: comspec ?? 'cmd.exe', args: ['/d', '/s', '/c', 'pnpm', ...anchored] }
}
with runPlugin calling spawnSync(command, pnpmArgs, { cwd: dir, stdio: 'inherit' }) and no shell option. A four-case regression test on that builder passes locally; happy to paste it if useful.
2. Hook bridges fail open on Windows, silently, for any hook that invokes an interpreter
packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code runs a hook's command through the host shell. On Windows that is PowerShell, which does not adopt a native child's exit code as its own process exit code:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "py -3 hook.py"                     # exits 1 when hook.py exits 2
powershell -NoProfile -Command "py -3 hook.py; exit $LASTEXITCODE" # exits 2

Since a non-2 exit is classified as a non-blocking error, a PreToolUse deny hook is skipped and nothing reports it. Verified by canary in the headless profile: the identical hook blocks with the suffix and does not block without it, so a user can have a hook config that loads, runs, and enforces nothing.
A bash-idiom hook fails harder, because PowerShell parses the whole command before running any of it. With echo MARKER > file; echo x >&2; exit 2, the marker file was never written: >&2 is not valid PowerShell, so the leading write never executed either.
Suggestion: either run hook commands through a shell that propagates child exit codes, or document the trailing ; exit $LASTEXITCODE requirement in both bridge READMEs. The Codex bridge README already lists commandWindows as ignored, which is a related trap for anyone bringing an existing config over.
Happy to provide full patches or the canary scripts if that would help.

threads.title: [Bug] 调用文件/搜索工具时触发 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')' 并导致会话污染 (tool_calls 悬空)

threads.title: Windows 下将用户主目录设为工作区会触发沙箱崩溃（ACL temp root 断言），导致 harness 停摆
threads.bodyText:
问题描述：
DSH (v0.1.0-rc.6, Windows) 中，当工作区指向用户主目录（如 C:\Users\<user>）时，workspace-write 模式下运行任何沙箱工具或切换权限都会崩溃，报错：
Windows ACL temp root must be outside the workspace: workspace=C:\Users\qw114; temp=C:\Users\qw114\AppData\Local\Temp

该配置本身是 Web UI 允许的（目录选择器可选中主目录），但会导致整个 harness 停摆：所有沙箱工具不可用、权限切换失效、旧对话无法发送消息。
根因（已定位到具体代码行）：

dsh-sandbox-policy/lib/index.js:142 — resolve() 的 workspaceRoot 取自 session.header.cwd（会话 cwd 为主目录）。
dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:387 — materializeAclGrant 调用 assertTempRootOutsideWorkspace(workspaceRoot, tmpdir()) 抛错。
断言定义：dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-CNjZgO4h.js:760-762 — temp 目录位于 workspace 内即 throw。
Windows 的 %TEMP% 默认位于用户主目录内（C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp），因此只要工作区 = 主目录，该断言必然触发。

即使把 TMP/TEMP 外移避开此断言，下一步 dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:392 的 grant.add(workspaceRoot) → setNamedSecurityInfoW（types-CNjZgO4h.js:655）仍会对整个主目录应用 DACL 授权，同样存在失败/卡顿风险。
安全/健壮性结论：

底层断言是 fail-closed 的安全设计（temp 与 workspace 重叠会形成沙箱逃逸），本身不是 bug。
但集成层存在缺陷：dsh-workspace/lib/index.js:341 的 create() 只校验目录存在，从不拒绝主目录当工作区；创建时零警告，崩溃后报错晦涩、无补救提示，且单点配置错误带崩整个 harness。

复现步骤：

Windows 上 dsh web，在 Web UI 新建工作区指向 C:\Users\<user>（主目录）。
会话 cwd 落在主目录，切到 workspace-write（或运行 shell/fs 工具）。
触发上述断言崩溃。

建议：

在创建工作区时拒绝/警告「工作区 = 用户主目录」；
或让 assertTempRootOutsideWorkspace 的报错包含可操作提示（如设置 TMP 到主目录之外、或使用 danger-full-access 逃生开关 DSH_PERMISSION_MODE）。

此问题反馈由 AI 生成。

threads.title: DeepSeek usage mapping may misclassify cache hit/miss tokens
threads.bodyText:
I noticed a possible usage-mapping mismatch in the DeepSeek adapter (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek) that may affect cache hit / cache miss accounting.
The current adapter normalizes usage in packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts (mapUsage, lines 53–62):
export function mapUsage(usage: WireUsage): TokenUsage {
  const cacheRead = usage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens ?? usage.prompt_cache_hit_tokens
  const reasoning = usage.completion_tokens_details?.reasoning_tokens
  return {
    inputTokens: usage.prompt_tokens - (cacheRead ?? 0),
    outputTokens: usage.completion_tokens,
    ...cacheRead !== undefined ? { cacheReadTokens: cacheRead } : {},
    ...reasoning !== undefined ? { reasoningTokens: reasoning } : {},
  }
}
This means:

prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens takes precedence over prompt_cache_hit_tokens
prompt_cache_miss_tokens is not used directly
cache miss usage is reconstructed as prompt_tokens - cacheRead

While reviewing a DeepSeek usage dashboard built from DSH session events, I observed a noticeable difference compared with the DeepSeek console for the same day.
DeepSeek console:
cache hit input:  59,261,184
cache miss input:  1,033,483
output:              325,656

DSH-derived dashboard around the same time:
cache hit input:  ~59,969,792
cache miss input:    ~395,874
output:               ~319,306

The snapshots were not taken at exactly the same second, so a small total-token difference is expected, but the hit/miss redistribution is much larger than the timing difference.
The pricing calculation itself appears consistent with DeepSeek's published rates. The discrepancy seems to occur before pricing, in the usage buckets.
For reference, the DeepSeek wire schema (packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/types.ts, WireUsage) exposes both native cache fields and the OpenAI-compat spelling:
prompt_tokens: number
completion_tokens: number
prompt_cache_hit_tokens?: number
prompt_cache_miss_tokens?: number
prompt_tokens_details?: { cached_tokens?: number }
completion_tokens_details?: { reasoning_tokens?: number }
Would it be more accurate for the adapter to prefer the native DeepSeek billing fields when available, for example:
const cacheHit = usage.prompt_cache_hit_tokens ?? usage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens
const cacheMiss = usage.prompt_cache_miss_tokens ?? Math.max(0, usage.prompt_tokens - (cacheHit ?? 0))
I am not claiming this is definitely a bug yet, because I have not captured a raw response where both cache spellings are present and demonstrably different.
Could you confirm the intended semantics of prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens vs prompt_cache_hit_tokens, and whether prompt_cache_miss_tokens should be preferred when available?
Thanks.

threads.title: V4-Flash-0731 在正确诊断后仍持续探索，而不进入代码编辑
threads.bodyText:
大家好，我最近在使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 + DeepSeek Harness 跑一些 SWE 类型的真实编码任务时，反复观察到一个比较明显的现象。
模型往往已经：

找到正确的文件 / 函数
判断出正确根因
甚至已经说出了最小修改方案

但它并不会马上进入 edit（编辑），而是继续执行：

read
grep
bash
Git 历史查询
CHANGELOG 查询
额外推理和验证

最后有时会一直调查到请求次数或 Token 预算耗尽，仍然没有真正修改代码。
我暂时把这个现象叫做：
Post-Diagnosis Exploration Loop（诊断后探索循环）**
或者：
Diagnosis-to-Action Gap（诊断到行动间隙）**
这里说的不是文本重复，也不是 Tool Call（工具调用）格式出错。
工具调用本身都是正常的，问题主要是：
模型已经知道答案了，但似乎很难从“继续调查”切换到“开始修改”。
一个受控实验
任务：pytest-pr-10356
我使用了相同的：

任务 Prompt
DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
Reasoning Level（推理等级）
代码起点
standard-offline Agent Preset（智能体预设）

只改变提供给 Agent 的额外上下文。
结果：



条件
首次出现正确诊断
最终是否编辑




无额外 Memory
第 10 个响应
否


Full Memory Context
第 7 个响应
否


Progressive Memory Context
第 5 个响应
否



三组最后的 Patch（补丁）全部为空。
工具调用情况：

无 Memory：read×7 / grep×6 / bash×3
Full Memory：read×5 / grep×3 / bash×2 / glob×1
Progressive Memory：read×8 / grep×4 / bash×1

三组都是：
edit = 0**
这里比较有意思的一点是：
额外上下文确实让模型更早找到了正确答案：
第 10 步 → 第 7 步 → 第 5 步
但是节省下来的步骤并没有转化成更早的代码修改，反而继续被用于额外调查。
我在其他任务里也观察到类似情况：
模型已经明确说出了正确根因和合理的最小修改方向，但之后仍继续查询 Git 历史、CHANGELOG、源码和其他信息，最终没有进入编辑。
想请教几个问题


这是目前 standard-offline Agent Loop（智能体循环）的预期行为吗？


DSH 目前是否存在类似：
探索 → 诊断 → 编辑 → 测试
这样的显式 Progress State（进度状态），还是完全由模型自己判断什么时候应该进入下一阶段？


官方 Benchmark 中使用的 minimal mode（最小模式），在这方面是否会和 standard-offline 有明显不同？


对于 V4-Flash-0731，目前是否有推荐的 DSH Preset（预设）或配置，可以减少“已经诊断正确但仍继续调查”的情况？


其他人有没有观察到类似现象？


我个人感觉直接规定：

“调用 N 次工具以后必须开始编辑”

可能不是一个很好的方案。
因为不同任务得到正确诊断所需的步骤差别很大。
我更想了解的是：
DSH 是否已经注意到这种 Diagnosis → Action（诊断到行动）之间的转换问题，以及是否有更通用的 Stop / Progress Policy（停止 / 进度策略）设计。
感谢！

threads.title: DSH-BUG-REPORT-seq-gap-overlap
threads.bodyText:
[Bug Report] 会话中断恢复后合成收尾事件与续写事件 seq 重叠，导致日志损坏、历史无法加载

提交渠道：deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness GitHub Discussions（Bug Report 分类）
提交链接：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/new
本报告由实际日志分析 + 源码定位得出，证据如下。

环境

版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 全局安装，桌面应用内嵌 dsh web 子进程）
Node：v24.19.0
平台：Windows（Electron 桌面应用）
会话日志物理格式：session.jsonl.zstd（拼接 zstd 帧：头帧 + 每批事件一帧，packChunks 打包分片行）

现象
加载某个会话历史时失败，错误信息：
history unavailable for session "session-37374e34-...": Error: corrupt session log:
seq gap in committed region at line 9551 (expected 165985, got 165983)

读端校验器（dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 的 SessionLogScanner.consumeEventLine，lib/index.js:275-300）要求每个事件的 seq 从 0 严格连续递增；发现重叠即判定日志损坏并拒绝加载。该会话因此永久无法加载历史（无自动修复路径，只能手动改日志文件）。
日志证据：两个"边界事件"是崩溃恢复合成的，不是正常写入
损坏点前后（原始 JSONL 行号）：



行
事件
seq
time




9549
reasoning-chunks（turn 6 step 1，最后一段分片）
seq0=165958，含 25 个 chunk
time0=1786886027781


9550
step/end（turn 6 step 1）

1786886027971

165984

9552
reasoning-chunks（同一 turn 6 step 1，同一段推理文本续写）
seq0=165983（重叠！）
time0=1786886028008


…
恢复后一直续写，seq 165983→183873，内部连续

turn/end（turn 6, reason:{kind:"completed"}）

1786886243823



三点吻合 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session 的 interruptedTurnClosers()（lib/types/repair.js:21-125）：

事件形状：该函数正是"先补 step/end（若 step 未关闭），再补 turn/end { reason: { kind: 'interrupted' } }"（repair.js:120-123）；
时间戳：注释明确"合成事件复用最后一个真实事件的时间戳"（repair.js:76-80）。验证：raw 9549 最后 chunk 的 time = time0(1786886027781) + Σdt(190) = 1786886027971，与两个合成事件 time 完全一致；
seq：let seq = last.seq + 1（repair.js:79），即 165983。

即：turn 6 的流被中断后，durable 日志尾部留下一个未关闭的 turn（最后真实事件 seq 165982）；某次恢复/冷加载路径（dsh-session-persistence 的 prepareCore → interruptedTurnClosers → commitRepair）检测到未关闭 turn，向文件追加了这两个合成收尾事件（seq 165983/165984）。随后同一 turn 在 37ms 后恢复续写（同一段推理文本无 user/message 隔断，最终 turn 6 completed），但续写事件的 seq 从 165983 重新开始——与文件中已有的两个事件重叠。
根因：写端两条路径的 seq 状态不同步

崩溃恢复路径只写文件、不推进内存游标：commitPrepared（dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:1019-1028）在 tornMarker/closers 非空时调用 backend.commitRepair(...) 后直接 return，没有 this.states.set / cursor 推进；commitRepair（dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1031-1035）也只做 truncate + appendLines，纯文件操作。
实时写入路径只校验内存游标：appendCore（dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:829-835）检查 event.seq !== state.cursor + i，但 state.cursor 是内存值，落后于文件已提交长度（165985），所以续写事件 165983 通过了校验。
读端校验严格、写端不严格：读端 SessionLogScanner 要求 seq 全局连续，重叠即抛错；写端只与内存游标比对，检测不到与文件的重叠。
正常情况下有防护：adoptLivePrefix（lib/index.js:1285-1302）的 seedCoversPrefix 会拒绝"live 种子不覆盖已持久化前缀"的情况——但本次流程中恢复续写未走该防护（很可能是同一进程内 live Session 未释放、写路径直接续写），故未被拦截。

影响

触发条件：会话运行中 turn 被瞬时中断（流错误/超时/内嵌 harness 重启等），随后同一 turn 恢复续写。日志尾部出现 seq 重叠 → 该会话历史永久不可加载，且无自动修复。
已损坏会话只能手动修复：删除两个合成收尾事件（step/end、turn/end interrupted）后，恢复段恰好从 seq 165983 无缝衔接，日志即恢复连续（本次修复后 183874 事件、seq 0..183873 连续、turn/step 边界平衡，内容零丢失）。

建议修复

提交修复（commitRepair）后同步推进 coordinator 的 durable cursor / 清掉陈旧 state，使后续 append 的校验基准与文件已提交长度一致；或
写端校验改为与文件已提交长度对齐（append 前读取 committed 前缀长度，或对落后事件重新编号为 committedLength + i），而不是只对内存游标做弱校验；或
拒绝续写：当 live 写路径的 next-seq 与 durable 尾部不一致时抛错（把 seedCoversPrefix 的防护扩展到 seq 对齐），而不是静默写出重叠事件。

threads.title: DeepseekV4-Pro-max 思考链异常，出现重复片段（多为WAIT-HOLDON-HMM等）
[Windows] 调用 Pwsh/Glob 工具崩溃：Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
threads.bodyText:
环境 / Environment

OS: Windows 10/11
dsh: v0.1.0-preview (deepseek-harness)
Node 22.x / pnpm 11.21.0
界面: dsh web (http://127.0.0.1:3080)，模型 DeepSeek-V4-Pro

复现步骤 / Steps to reproduce

运行 dsh web
浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:3080，Ctrl+F5 硬刷新
新建会话 (New session)
提问 "这个文件下有东西吗"（任何会触发 Pwsh/Glob 文件工具的问题）

期望 / Expected
AI 列出当前工作目录的文件。
实际 / Actual
工具调用被中断，然后报错：
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

Glob · *  → OUT Interrupted: interrupted
Pwsh · List files in current working directory → 同样崩溃

补充说明 / Notes

纯聊天完全正常，只有调用【任何】文件/命令行工具时才崩。
已尝试：批准 pnpm 构建脚本 (pnpm approve-builds / opencli)、重装并卸载 modlens 插件 —— 仍然崩溃。
所以这不是 modlens 插件的问题，而是 dsh 内置工具的 prepare 层在 Windows 下的 bug。
似乎与置顶那条 "Windows: host process crashes with ENOENT in OutputCollector.spillAll" 是同一类 Windows 子进程/工具层问题。

threads.title: Config channel & module sharing for DSH client plugins — a front-door plugin's open questions
threads.bodyText:
We are building client plugins on DSH (brand theme + capability launcher + settings showcase) in our repo linkhealth-dsh-platform and hit a few platform questions. Would appreciate pointers from maintainers/community:
Config channel to client plugins. A patch entry's config never reaches the browser — the client graph passes only id/url/inject. What is the recommended way to configure a client plugin (settings RPC? env? manifest)? Currently we hard-code defaults in the plugin (BUILTIN_CONFIG) because nothing else reaches it.
Sharing modules into a client bundle. Client bundles are self-contained (require() reaches only platform modules), so we duplicate the config/launch logic: inlined in client.js and again in a standalone module covered by unit tests. Is there a sanctioned way to share code into a client bundle (build step, import map, ...)?
Automated testing of client plugins. Our 22 unit tests cover the pure logic only; browser integration is manual. Is there a DSH-native way to test client plugins (headless browser harness, fixture-based, ...)?
Branding the default welcome/hero. Locale dictionaries can't be overridden cross-package (same namespace+locale key throws), so the default hero copy/logo can't be branded. Any intended slot for a branded welcome (or is that out of scope)?
Full context (status table + detailed notes) is in our repo's discussion #1. Happy to turn whatever we learn into a write-up for other client-plugin authors.

threads.title: 请确认 dsh preset add URL / 预设一键安装协议契约
threads.bodyText:
背景
我们在做 DeepSeek Harness Desktop（社区桌面打包版，内置 Node 与官方 @deepseek-ai/dsh）与 cordis.run 插件市场。桌面版已按上游 dsh plugin --profile web add <package> 契约实现插件一键安装，并已和 cordis.run 定稿浏览器深链协议：
dsharness://plugin/install?v=1&name=<npm-package>&source=<cordis.run 插件页>

现在我们想为 preset（.dshpreset / .agent-presets/<id>） 做同样的「cordis.run 一键安装」，需要先和上游把契约逐字节对齐。以下问题请帮忙答复；能附上源码文件/分支/commit 或协议文档最好。
最优先确认


预设一键安装现在是否存在？如果存在，走哪种：

(A) 纯 CLI：dsh preset add <url>（终端复制命令）
(B) 浏览器深链：dsharness://preset/install?... 之类的协议，CLI 只是底层执行路径
如果尚不存在，也请明确说明，我们好决定是否只做「复制命令」或自行提案协议。



<url> 应该指向什么：

(甲) 直接 .dshpreset 文件 URL（dsh 自己下载并导入）
(乙) manifest/元数据 JSON URL（name/version/downloadUrl/sha256），dsh 先读 JSON 再下载
请给一个完整示例 URL，以及 dsh 侧是否跟随 302 重定向。



请提供 dsh 侧处理远程 preset add 的源码或协议文档：

解析 URL/参数/深链的函数（等价于我们桌面的 deep_link.rs 与 is_valid_package_name）
远程下载/导入分支的校验与限额（路径穿越 / 符号链接 / zip 炸弹 / 文件数与大小）
或一份 ADR/README（参数表 + 示例 URL + 安全模型）



如果走 (B) 浏览器深链

完整 scheme 形态是什么？例如 dsharness://preset/install?v=1&...？请给 host/path。
参数契约：

v 是否固定 1
预设标识用 id / url / source？键名与取值
是否需要 sha256 强校验
重复参数是否拒绝、未知参数是否忽略、非法 v 是否直接拒绝、总长是否 ≤ 2048


预设 id 校验规则是否就是 [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*（成为目录名，../escape、a/b、绝对路径都拒绝）？

安全与信任（preset 等同 shell 权限）

远程 add 路径上游会自己做压缩包校验吗（路径穿越/符号链接/zip 炸弹/解压大小/文件数），还是信任 URL 来源？
是否有 origin/host 白名单（类似 source host 必须等于 cordis.run）？怎么传？
安装前是否有确认弹窗（名称/来源/版本/SHA-256/「等同 shell 权限」警告），以及 busy 门控、单实例排队？

版本与覆盖语义

dsh preset add 能否指定版本，还是永远拉「最新 approved 版本」？
落盘目录是否为 <dshHome>/.agent-presets/<id>/？同名 id 已存在时是覆盖、询问、还是拒绝？

错误与反馈

CLI 成功/失败输出与退出码是什么？我们好写「复制命令」兜底文案。
深链非法输入时是否像 plugin 版那样只写日志不弹 UI？

我们已有的相关实现参考

插件深链：dsharness://plugin/install?v=1&name=...&source=...
桌面 preset id 校验：^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$
预设根：<dshHome>/.agent-presets/<id>/

感谢！收到答复后我们照旧做逐字节交叉核对。

threads.title: Bug：`pnpm dsh web` 启动失败，报错 "--expose-internals is required for HMR service"
threads.bodyText:
环境

操作系统：Windows 11
Node.js：v22.22.2（通过 pnpm）/ 同样在 v24.15.0 上复现
dsh 版本：0.1.0-rc.5（commit 47f9438）
说明：此问题与仓库路径是否含中文无关，纯为启动参数缺失

复现步骤

pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web

预期结果
Web UI 在 http://127.0.0.1:3080 正常启动
实际结果
进程立即退出，报错：
Error: failed to apply loader entry ... (@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr):
--expose-internals is required for HMR service
[cause]: Error: --expose-internals is required for HMR service
at runProfile (apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts:283)
at new Hmr (vendor/hmr/src/index.ts:121)
根因分析
web 配置（profile）启用了 @deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr 热更新插件。
该插件构造函数会检查 this.ctx.loader.internal，若 Node 启动时未带
--expose-internals 就直接抛错（vendor/hmr/src/index.ts:121），
而 loader.internal 仅在 process.execArgv 含该标志时才有效
（vendor/loader/src/internal.ts:110）。
根目录 package.json（第 136 行）的 dsh 脚本为：
"dsh": "node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts"
它漏掉了 --expose-internals，导致官方文档写的 pnpm dsh web 起不来。
（tsx 源码模式本身没问题，缺的只是这一个启动参数。）
建议修复
将第 136 行改为：
"dsh": "node --expose-internals --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts"
改完 pnpm dsh web 即可正常启动（已本地验证）。
（根据 CONTRIBUTING 说明，目前暂不接受外部 PR，故以 Discussion 形式反馈。）

threads.title: Remote web UI: ask_user_question card vanishes after mux reconnect (SSH / reverse-proxy)
threads.bodyText:
Symptom
When DeepSeek Harness web is reached over a remote hop (SSH local-forward, Tailscale Serve, or any reverse proxy that is not loopback), ask_user_question can leave the turn blocked on the host while the browser composer never shows the question card.
Locally (http://127.0.0.1:3080) the same session usually works. Remotely the session still looks “running”, tool-call / assistant events keep arriving, but the input bar is never replaced by the question UI. The only recovery is to cancel the turn. After cancel, the tool result is:
Error: ask_user_question was aborted before the user answered

This is not “the tool is missing from the preset”. The model-facing tool ran. The human never got a card to answer.
Environment that reproduces it

DSH web (npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web) listening on 127.0.0.1:3080
Browser not on the same machine; access via:

ssh -L 3080:127.0.0.1:3080 …, or
Tailscale Serve (https://<magicdns> → 127.0.0.1:3080)


--trusted-host is set so /api is not 403 (page loads, history loads, live events flow)
A preset that actually composes @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user (official Standard / creative-style presets do)
Trigger: any turn that calls ask_user_question and then sits waiting for a human

Idle time on the hop (tens of seconds is enough on some SSH / Serve paths) makes it much more likely.
Expected

Model calls ask_user_question.
Host registers a pending wait and pushes question/requested on the mux downlink.
The web composer chain elects the question plugin and renders the card (options / custom / skip).
Answering posts /api/respond with the same rpcId; host settles the tool call; the loop continues.

A later mux reconnect while the question is still pending should re-show the same card, because the wait is still live on the host.
Actual (remote)
Steps 1–2 happen. Step 3 often does not. The host stays in userQuestions.ask() until the user cancels. Refreshing the page does not recover the card if the client later wipes the wait (see below). Cancelling the turn is the only way out.
Why this is a remote-only footgun
ask_user_question is not a session-log event. It is a generation-scoped mux frame:

Host (dsh-host-apiproxy) registerProvider.ask() mints an rpcId, stores the wait in an in-memory table, and pushes { type: "question/requested", sessionId, questions } to every connected mux consumer.
On mux subscribe, still-pending waits are replayed into the new stream (same rpcId).
question/resolved is also mux-only.
None of this is written to session.jsonl. History backfill cannot restore a card.

So the card’s entire lifetime is: mux frame → client Session.pending → conversation.composer chain.
The browser downlink is a WebSocket (GET /api/events.mux upgrade), not SSE. Unary RPCs stay on HTTP. A hop that drops idle WebSockets (SSH -L, Tailscale Serve, many reverse proxies) will tear the mux even while HTTP history/prompt still work. That is why the chat can look healthy and the card still disappears.
Race (this is the bug)
Official client reconnect order:

Mux socket opens. Host immediately replays every still-pending question/requested / approval/requested.
Readiness handshake (host.describe + both streams open) succeeds → onConnected.
Session.resync() rebuilds the history window.

In current dsh-client-runtime, resync() does:
this.pending.clear()
then re-open history

History does not contain the question. The frames from step 1 were already applied to pending. Step 3 deletes them. The composer’s selectQuestion then sees an empty interactions list and keeps the normal input bar.
The comments around disconnect already know the right model:

On disconnect, drop generation-scoped waits (they may have been answered while the socket was dead; there is no frame for that).
On mux-open, replay re-adds every still-pending host request with its live rpcId.

Clearing pending in resync() (which runs after that replay) inverts the contract. On a stable loopback socket you rarely reconnect mid-wait, so the bug stays hidden. On SSH / Serve you reconnect often, so the card is gone and the tool is still blocked.
There is a second aggravating factor: the host WebSocket downlink does not ping. An idle remote hop can close the socket, which forces the reconnect path above while a question is outstanding.
Suggested direction (not a patch request, just the invariant)
Two independent, demoable slices:


Pending-wait lifetime vs reconnect
Treat question/requested / approval/requested as mux-generation state:

Clear them on disconnect (old generation is dead).
Do not clear them in resync() / onConnected (replay already ran).
After reconnect, a still-pending host wait must produce a visible composer card without the user cancelling.



Keep the downlink alive on a hop
Server-side WebSocket ping (e.g. every 15s) on /api/events.mux and /api/events.host, so an idle SSH / Serve path does not force a reconnect in the first place.


Slice 1 is sufficient to make a pending question survive reconnect. Slice 2 reduces how often you hit the path.
Acceptance

 Call ask_user_question from a session opened through SSH -L or Tailscale Serve; the question card appears in the composer without cancelling the turn.
 While the card is up, drop and restore the mux (disable the hop for a few seconds, or wait for an idle timeout). After the client reconnects, the same pending question is visible again (same rpcId / same options).
 Answering the restored card settles the host wait and the agent continues.
 Loopback http://127.0.0.1:3080 behaviour is unchanged.
 A cancelled / already-answered wait does not resurrect a stale card after reconnect.

Notes

Preset composition is fine: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user is per-agent; @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions is the host UI and is already in the web-app overlay. This is not “the tool was not unlocked”.
--trusted-host 403s are a different class of failure (nothing in /api works). Here unary /api works; only the wait UI is missing.
Issues are disabled on this repo, so this is filed as a Discussion.

threads.title: Q&A: isLoopbackHostname rejects IPv4-mapped loopback (`[::ffff:7f00:1]`), so dual-stack Host/Origin 403s
threads.bodyText:
isLoopbackHostname rejects the WHATWG form of IPv4-mapped loopback, so a Host/Origin that a dual-stack stack writes as [::ffff:127.0.0.1] fails the /api Host fence with 403 even though it is 127.0.0.1.
Evidence (master 47f9438)
packages/client/connection/src/loopback-hostname.ts only accepts localhost, [::1], and IPv4 127/8:
export function isLoopbackHostname(hostname: string): boolean {
  if (hostname === 'localhost' || hostname === '[::1]') return true
  const parts = hostname.split('.')
  return parts.length === 4
    && parts[0] === '127'
    && parts.every(part => /^\d{1,3}$/.test(part) && Number(part) <= 255)
}
WHATWG parsing of the mapped spelling (Node new URL):



input authority
url.hostname
isLoopbackHostname




127.0.0.1
127.0.0.1
true


localhost
localhost
true


[::1]
[::1]
true


[::ffff:127.0.0.1]
[::ffff:7f00:1]
false


[::ffff:7f00:1]
[::ffff:7f00:1]
false



The Host fence (packages/client/connection/src/api-request-trust.ts:108) and the browser ctx.connection.isLoopback flag (packages/client/connection/src/client/index.ts:106) both use this predicate. The unit test (packages/client/connection/tests/loopback-hostname.client.spec.ts) only covers the three accepted forms plus a few refusals; it never mentions ::ffff:.
This is a 403 / "not loopback" classification bug, not an auth bypass. I have not yet captured a live Windows Host header in this form against dsh web — posting because the predicate + WHATWG normalization are deterministic. If anyone has a 403 on http://127.0.0.1:3080 whose DevTools Network Host/Origin is the mapped spelling, that is the missing live repro.
Related but different: #900 (Origin rewritten by the environment layer) and #894 (port-less loopback Origin). Those assume the hostname already classified as loopback.
Suggested fix
Treat [::ffff:7f00:1] / [::ffff:127.0.0.1] (and the rest of ::ffff:127.0.0.0/104) as loopback, using the already-parsed WHATWG hostname so the dotted and hex-mapped spellings collapse to one check. Keep refusing unbracketed ::1 (the existing test).

threads.title: [BUG] 插件自定义会话事件导致整个会话日志下次加载时被拒读——Session.append 无法写 ignorable 标记，插件事件注册口为 deferred
threads.bodyText:
我在开发一个小的简单的插件，因为不支持工作空间多文件夹，所以想根据Session来添加多个只读的参考库，使用dsh + flash开发。
开发时遇到了一个问题，以下是AI总结的内容，麻烦开发过的朋友帮忙解答下如何解决，多谢
目前自己的插件 @dsh-plugins/ref-lib 的实现方式与架构约束

本文档记录我们（第三方插件开发者）在 rc.6 上从零实现一个真实插件（只读参考库，
per-session 隔离）的完整路径：遇到了哪些架构约束、每个约束怎么绕行、最终方案是什么、
以及我们因此需要官方提供哪些扩展点。供 DSH 维护者参考——特别是理解为什么
"settings 配置白名单插件化"、"插件事件注册口"、"客户端自定义 RPC" 这些 deferred 项
对插件生态是刚需，而非锦上添花。


1. 插件简介
@dsh-plugins/ref-lib：在任意会话上维护多个只读参考库（如 core 源码仓库），
agent 通过 systemPrompt 注入自动感知库的路径与只读约束。需求要点：

per-session 隔离：每个会话自己的参考库列表，互不可见；
UI 交互：会话头部「参考库」按钮 → 系统原生"选择文件夹"对话框添加 → 列表/删除；
数据持久化、跨重启存活。

2. 遇到的架构约束（按踩坑顺序）
约束 1：settings 配置客户端白名单（UI 无法读写插件自己的 namespace）
想用 settings RPC 让浏览器端读写插件自己的配置 namespace ref-lib，得到
settings-not-exposed。根因：packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts 的
exposedNamespaces() 只放行硬编码白名单（WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES /
PRODUCT_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES）与动态模型提供商 namespace；第三方插件 namespace
默认不可被浏览器端读写，且无插件扩展点。官方注释明确：

"a future registration does not become remotely readable or writable by default"
"plugin can expose its own configuration without a change in this package, is deferred work"

约束 2：无插件自定义 RPC、client→node 事件为单向
浏览器端可调的 RPC 集合固定（rpc-map.ts：session/workspace/host/settings/credentials/
goal/llm/skill/subagent/questions…），插件无法注册自己的 RPC 方法；
ctx.remote 是 host→client 单向事件订阅，client 无法向 node 端发自定义事件。
→ 插件 UI 与 node 端之间没有任何官方自定义数据通道。
约束 3：credentials 只写不读回
credentials.set 是唯一允许 client 写任意字符串的 RPC，但 credentials.describe
只返回 { configured, source, writable }（凭据值永不回流）——不能当通用 KV 用。
约束 4（事故）：session 自定义事件写入成功、整条日志被拒读
v1 曾用 session.append('ref-lib/set', …) 做 per-session 存储（写入成功、内存里功能
正常），但：

该事件类型不在 harness 构建时生成的 KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES 白名单内
（packages/core/session/src/known-event-types.ts，注释自认 "out-of-repo plugin
events are outside this list by construction; a registration surface for them is
deferred"）；
读取路径对白名单外事件整体拒读（除非信封带 ignorable: true）；
Session.append(type, data, opts) 的 opts 只接受 surface 元数据
（surfaceOp/sourceEventSeqs，且仅消息类事件），没有任何写 ignorable 的途径。

结果：任何含 ref-lib/set 的会话日志在下次加载时被整体拒绝
（SessionFormatUnsupportedError），连写它的 harness 自己也读不回——该会话永久不可恢复。
这是设计笔记明确的 deferred 项（.agents/notes/…/2026-08-10-session-log-version-mechanism.md：
"until a registration surface exists, an out-of-repo plugin's events refuse resume"）。
约束 5：命令执行必然渲染卡片（污染会话 UI）
ctx.remote.commands.execute / session.prompt 是当前版本唯一能从 client 触发
node 端执行的通道，但会写入 command/run+command/done 并渲染为对话流里的命令结果
卡片——无任何"静默"选项。
约束 6：投影纯事件驱动（v3 后读不到）
sessionProjections 只从会话事件折叠（SessionProjectionRegistry.snapshot/restore），
状态一旦不在日志里（v3 sidecar），投影基线里就没有它——UI 无法经投影读插件状态。
3. 最终实现（v3）
在约束 1–6 下，唯一自洽的组合是：



能力
方案
代价




存储
sidecar JSON：<dshHome>/plugin-data/ref-lib/<sessionId>.json（dshHomePath('plugin-data', 'ref-lib')），node 端原子读写（writeFileSync+renameSync）；冷读时：sidecar → 旧日志 ref-lib/set 迁移 → 父会话继承 → 空
无（插件 node half 有完整 fs 权限；天然 per-session、随 dsh home 持久化）


UI 读（打开面板/刷新）
ctx.remote.commands.execute('/ref-lib list') → node 端读 sidecar → 返回文本 → client 解析
每次打开面板渲染一张命令结果卡片


UI 写（添加/移除）
ctx.remote.commands.execute('/ref-lib add <path>' / remove <id>) → node 端更新 sidecar
渲染一张命令结果卡片


目录选择
ctx.workspaces.pickDirectory()（host 原生 OS 选择器，与"选择工作区"同源）
无


上下文注入
ctx.systemPrompt.context({ name: 'reference-libs', order: 150, text })，按 context.agent?.session 从 sidecar 读列表渲染
无


UI 挂载
conversation.session.header.utilities（list 型 slot，per-session scope）
无


命令入口
/ref-lib add/list/remove（对话可用，也是 UI 的中转载体）
无



工程形态：标准 bundle（dsh.bundle + dsh.client 双面插件），node half 用
Service 类（default export，loader 按 static inject 注入），client half 构建为
window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory }) 闭包工厂（平台模块 external），
UI 走 settings.section/conversation.session.header.* 等 list 型 slot。
4. 给官方的扩展点建议（按解除阻塞的优先级）

插件事件注册口 / Session.append 的 ignorable 写入面（对应随附 issue）：
让插件能安全持久化 per-session 事件。设计笔记自己写明"gains that surface with its
first user / deferred until such a consumer exists"——我们就是那个 consumer。
settings 配置客户端白名单插件化（如 ctx.settings.expose(ns) 或注册时声明
configClient: true）：插件 UI 可直接读写自己的配置，摆脱命令卡片污染。
插件自定义 RPC（或 client→node 事件通道）：插件注册自己的方法进 rpc-map，
让 UI 与 node 端有官方数据通道；这将同时解决读与写的污染与绕行。
（可选）投影支持非事件数据源：让插件把 sidecar 状态接入投影，UI 一次读取。

5. 一句话总结
rc.6 对第三方插件开发者而言，"浏览器端可见 + 可持久化 + 不污染会话"三者无法兼得：
settings 白名单拒绝 UI 直读直写，session 自定义事件会让日志整条拒读，命令分发是唯一
执行通道但必然渲染卡片。最终方案被迫采用 sidecar 文件存储 + 命令中转——能用，
但每一步都在绕行官方缺失的扩展点。
问题概述
第三方插件可以通过 Session.append 写入自定义会话事件（用 declare module 扩展 SessionEventMap 后，例如 session.append('ref-lib/set', { libs: [...] })），写入时没有任何报错——append 不做事件类型的词汇表校验。但持久化读取路径会拒绝加载任何包含"仓库内置白名单（KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES）之外事件类型"的日志，除非该事件在信封上带 ignorable: true 标记——而 Session.append 根本不提供设置 ignorable 的途径（其 opts 只接受 surface 元数据 surfaceOp/sourceEventSeqs，且仅对消息类事件可用）。
对插件作者的实际后果：写入成功，会话在下次加载/重启时变得永久不可读（harness 明确"拒绝重建会话"）。harness 自己也无法读回它当初接受的日志。
复现步骤

插件扩展会话事件词汇表：
declare module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types' {
  interface SessionEventMap { 'my-plugin/state': { /* json */ } }
}

在命令处理器（或任何持有 Session 的地方）：
session.append('my-plugin/state', { any: 'payload' }) // 成功，已持久化

重启 harness 并尝试加载/恢复该会话。
→ 加载被拒绝：日志含 my-plugin/state，它不在 KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES 内，且没有 ignorable: true。

期望行为
既然插件能写会话事件，就应该能（a）把它标记为 ignorable（信息性事件，让 first-party 读取器安全跳过），或（b）注册自己的事件类型让读取器能解释日志。目前两个途径都不存在。
实际行为

写入路径：成功（append 不做词汇表校验，只做旧版形状校验）。
读取路径：loud refusal（显式拒绝） 整条日志——会话无法恢复，插件侧没有任何 API 可以规避。

证据（来自 master 源码）


packages/core/session/src/known-event-types.ts（生成文件）头部注释：

"The persistence read path refuses to interpret a log containing a type outside this set unless the event carries the envelope's ignorable marker … such a log was likely written by a newer harness, and silently skipping a required event would reconstruct a wrong session. Downstream (out-of-repo) plugin events are outside this list by construction; a registration surface for them is deferred until such a consumer exists."
（持久化读取路径拒绝解释任何包含白名单外事件类型的日志，除非事件带 ignorable 标记……这类日志很可能是更新的 harness 写的，静默跳过必需事件会重建出错误的会话。仓库外插件事件按构造天然不在该列表内；给它们提供注册口被延后，直到出现这样的消费者。）



packages/core/session/src/types.ts — SessionEvent.ignorable 字段：

"A writer sets true only on purely informational records whose loss cannot affect reconstruction; defaulting to required means a forgotten marker over-refuses (an inconvenience) rather than silently resuming a gutted session."
（写入者只在"丢失不影响重建的信息性记录"上设 true；默认是"必需"，忘记标记只会过度拒绝（不便），而不会静默恢复一个被掏空的会话。）



packages/core/session/src/index.ts — Session.append 签名：
append<T extends SessionEventType>(type: T, data: SessionEventMap[T],
  ...opts: T extends SurfaceEventType ? [opts: SurfaceIntent] : []
): SessionEvent<T>
SurfaceIntent 只携带 surfaceOp/sourceEventSeqs；没有 ignorable 参数（非消息类事件甚至没有 opts）。


设计笔记 .agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-10-session-log-version-mechanism.md：

"Until a registration surface exists, an out-of-repo plugin's events refuse resume under first-party readers — the pre-release stance accepts that, and the refusal is loud rather than silent."
（在注册口存在之前，仓库外插件的事件在 first-party 读取器下拒绝恢复——预发布阶段接受这一点，拒绝是显式而非静默的。）
"writers do not yet set ignorable (no producer needs it), so Session.append gains that surface with its first user."
（写入者目前都不设 ignorable（没有生产者需要它），所以 Session.append 会在第一个用户出现时获得该写入面。）
"Per-plugin runtime registration of known event types … a registration surface for them is deferred until such a consumer exists."
（按插件运行时注册已知事件类型……它们的注册口被延后，直到出现这样的消费者。）



影响
第三方插件作者（即被延后的注释所等待的"消费者"）无法在不破坏会话日志的前提下持久化自己的 per-session 状态。笔记和代码都明确把这件事延后到"出现消费者"——本 issue 就是那个消费者回来报告。
补充约束：这也与 settings 配置客户端白名单（packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts 的 exposedNamespaces()，同为 deferred）相互作用——插件作者目前没有任何官方认可的浏览器可见状态通道。
建议修复（任一即可解除插件作者的阻塞）

Session.append 增加可选 ignorable 参数（或信封接受它）：插件可以写入信息性事件，让 first-party 读取器安全跳过。改动最小，也符合笔记自身的计划（"会在第一个用户出现时获得该写入面"）。写入者必须显式选择（默认保持 required）。
按插件运行时注册已知事件类型（即被延后的"注册口"）：读取器解释日志时，查询"仓库白名单 ∪ 已注册插件事件类型"。
两者结合：注册用于 required 插件事件，ignorable 显式选择用于信息性事件。

如维护者认可方向，我愿意协助实现或测试。

threads.title: bug(llm-pi-ai): openai-responses 路由无法关闭 session_id 请求头
threads.bodyText:
openai-responses 路由必发 session_id，拒绝下划线 header 名的网关返回 400，导致部分第三方中转/路由不可用。


复现步骤：

配置一条 api: openai-responses 的自定义路由，baseURL 指向拒绝含下划线 header 名的第三方 OpenAI 兼容网关。
配置一个该网关确认支持 Responses API 的模型。
经 Harness 发送一条最小消息。

llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    third-party-responses:
      apiKeyEnv: THIRD_PARTY_API_KEY
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: https://gateway.example/v1
      models:
        - id: example-model


实际结果：
请求在到达鉴权与模型之前返回 400 Bad Request。
对真实第三方 Responses endpoint 做过单变量对照：两次请求的 URL、模型、鉴权、请求正文字段完全一致，仅改变是否携带 session_id header。
不带 session_id（仍带 x-client-request-id、正文 prompt_cache_key、stream: true）：HTTP 200，text/event-stream，收到 response.created / response.output_text.delta / response.completed，获得 Response ID，模型返回预期文本。
带 session_id：HTTP 400，text/plain，正文 Bad Request，无 Response ID，无 SSE 事件。
失败由该 header 触发，与 API key、endpoint、模型 id、请求正文、流式协议无关。endpoint、凭据、provider 名和模型 id 不在此披露。
成因：packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts:317 将 Agent 请求的 sessionId 透传给 pi-ai。pi-ai 0.82.1 dist/api/openai-responses.js:166-175 按 compat.sessionAffinityFormat 分派 header；detectSessionAffinityFormat（同文件 :34-36）仅在 provider 为 openrouter 或 baseURL 含 openrouter.ai 时返回 openrouter，其余一律返回 openai，即发送 session_id。自定义网关必然落入该分支。
pi-ai 已定义 SessionAffinityFormat = "openai" | "openai-nosession" | "openrouter"（dist/types.d.ts:41），并在 OpenAICompletionsCompat（:463）与 OpenAIResponsesCompat（:472）上都接受 sessionAffinityFormat。Harness 侧的 PiAiCompatProfile（src/catalog.ts）与配置 schema compatProfile（src/config.ts:188）只暴露 thinkingFormat 和 supportsReasoningEffort，该字段无从配置。
两个协议在此处不对称：Completions 侧的 affinity header 受 sendSessionAffinityHeaders 开关控制且检测默认为 false（dist/api/openai-completions.js:489、:1174）；Responses 侧没有这个开关，只要有 sessionId 就发。
无可用 workaround：profile 的 headers 只能新增或覆盖 header 的值，无法移除 header 名。把 session_id 置空仍会发出含下划线的 header 名，网关同样拒绝；pi-ai 将 options headers 最后合并（openai-responses.js:178-180），覆盖顺序也不改变这一点。


预期结果：
compat 可在 provider 级和模型级配置 sessionAffinityFormat。
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    third-party-responses:
      apiKeyEnv: THIRD_PARTY_API_KEY
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: https://gateway.example/v1
      compat:
        sessionAffinityFormat: openai-nosession
      models:
        - id: example-model
openai-nosession 省略 session_id，保留 x-client-request-id。正文 prompt_cache_key 由 cacheRetention 决定（openai-responses.js:204），不受此字段影响。未配置时维持 pi-ai 的自动检测。
解析优先级：模型级 compat → provider 级 compat → 已安装 catalog 条目 → pi-ai 自动检测。


环境：

deepseek-harness master（47f943859b）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai 0.1.0-rc.5
@earendil-works/pi-ai 0.82.1
macOS Tahoe 26.5.2，故障位于 HTTP header 处理阶段，与操作系统无关



参考

pi-ai SessionAffinityFormat / OpenAIResponsesCompat
pi-ai 同类问题：earendil-works/pi#3579
OpenAI Responses API 迁移指南：https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/migrate-to-responses

threads.title: fs 工具（write/read/edit）无超时预算，工具调用可无限挂起：实测 2.5h + 100% CPU 忙循环 + 会话永久卡死
threads.bodyText:
背景
timeout-policy（@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-call-timeout-policy）已随 dsh-base bundle 装配并在 web profile 中激活。但按该插件 README 的说明，它只对声明了 ToolDefinition.timeoutMs 的工具生效，而交付的 write/read/edit（dsh-tool-fs、dsh-tool-str-replace-editor）有意不声明；bash/pwsh 仅有命令级超时参数，同样不挂 ToolDefinition.timeoutMs。也就是说，超时强制执行恰好对最可能长时间挂起的本地 fs 工具是盲区。
现象（真实事故）

会话中 agent 执行 write，目标为 OneDrive Files-On-Demand 占位符目录下的新文件（父目录不存在，OS 层实际拒绝新建）。
tool/call 事件落日志后再无 tool/result：会话文件 mtime 冻结；此后 2.5 小时无任何新事件。
服务器进程 100% CPU 忙循环：两次采样 8 秒窗口内分别烧掉 7.95s / 4.98s CPU（前一次为 5s 窗口 4.98s），持续整个挂起期间。
GUI 该会话永久显示「运行中」；只能重启进程恢复。重启后会话由持久化层自动收尾（合成缺失 tool 结果），数据无损（JSONL 追加式）。

根因

超时强制层存在但只覆盖声明预算的工具 → fs 工具无任何 deadline；
且机制为协作式（仅通过 exec.signal 通知）：即使声明了预算，忽略/不转发 signal 的工具（忙循环）也无法被中止；本次正是 100% CPU 忙循环，协作式超时即使启用也拦不住；
无回合级步数/时长上限，一个挂死调用即可让 GUI 永久显示「运行中」。

期望行为

内置 fs 工具（至少 write/read/edit）有默认超时预算（如 60s），并把 exec.signal 转发到文件 IO；
tools/execute 派发层提供硬看门狗：为每个 in-flight 调用登记 deadline（如 5 分钟），超时强制结算为 TOOL_TIMEOUT/aborted 并中断对应 fiber——即使工具忽略 signal；
回合增加步数/时长双上限（如 30 步 / 30 分钟），超限以 interrupted 收尾。

建议修复位置

dsh-tool-fs / dsh-tool-str-replace-editor：声明 timeoutMs、转发 exec.signal（移除「有意不声明」的例外）；
dsh-tools / dsh-agent-loop：派发级硬 deadline 兜底；
dsh-agent-loop：回合步数/时长上限。

threads.title: headless: a turn that ends max-tokens exits 1 silently (+ launcher swallows boot errors)
threads.bodyText:
Two small diagnostics found while building a plugin against 0.1.0-rc.6, both about a headless turn failing quietly. Repros included; happy to open PRs if useful.
1. Headless exits 1 silently when the first turn ends max-tokens
dsh --profile headless "<task>" exits code 1 and prints nothing when the opening turn ends with reason max-tokens. Traced via the session log: the harness system prompt plus runtime context measured 7,797 input tokens; against an 8,192-token model window the model produced zero output tokens, the turn closed {kind:"max-tokens"}, and the process exited 1 with nothing on stdout or stderr. The only evidence lives in $DSH_HOME/sessions/**/session.jsonl.zstd.

Repro: any model with an ~8k context window on the default headless profile.
Fix that unblocked it locally: raise the model context window to ~16k, leaving room for the harness prompt.
Suggestion: a one-line stderr notice on a max-tokens turn end (input N ≥ window M) would turn a silent exit into a self-diagnosing one.

2. The launcher swallows boot errors
lib/bin.js wraps argument resolution in catch (error) { return process.exit(error instanceof CommanderError ? error.exitCode : 1) }. A non-Commander error at parse/boot time exits 1 with no output. Combined with case 1, several distinct failures all present identically as a silent exit 1. A single console.error(error) in the non-Commander branch would surface the actual cause.
Both are minor, but together they cost a while to diagnose because nothing prints. Thanks for the harness — the plugin model is a pleasure to build against.

threads.title: A --patch-inserted plugin validates its config but never activates, and ctx.logger has no sink in any shipped profile
threads.bodyText:
Found while wiring an external governance tool to the Claude Code hook bridge. Posting here rather than as an issue per CONTRIBUTING.md.
Short version: a plugin inserted through a --patch overlay is resolved, applied and config-validated, and then appears never to activate — no handler ever runs. I could not find the reason from the outside because ctx.logger has no sink in either shipped profile, so the warning that would explain it is unobservable.
This is not the PowerShell exit-code fail-open in #2485. There the hook runs and its exit code is mangled; here the hook command never executes at all — a marker command that only appends to a file leaves no file.
Environment

dsh 0.1.0-rc.7 (npm next), @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code 0.1.0-rc.6
Node v25.2.1, pnpm 11.21.0, Windows 11
Profiles headless and web, both freshly materialised

Reproduce
dsh plugin --profile headless add \
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code@next \
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-hook-protocol@next \
  @deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants@next
hooks.json — the command deliberately involves no third-party tool, so nothing but the bridge is on trial:
{ "hooks": { "PreToolUse": [ { "matcher": ".*", "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "timeout": 60,
  "command": "node -e \"require('fs').appendFileSync('C:/tmp/proj/marker.txt','fired\\n')\"" } ] } ] } }
patch.yml:
- insert:
    - id: cavesson-hooks
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code'
      config:
        configPath: 'C:/tmp/proj/hooks.json'
        projectDir: 'C:/tmp/proj'
dsh --profile headless --patch patch.yml "create a file named hello.txt containing hi"
Observed: the agent creates hello.txt and exits normally. marker.txt is never created. No warning, no error, on stdout or stderr.
Expected: either the hook runs, or something says why it did not.
The mount is fine — that part is verifiable
Both ways an entry can be wrong fail loudly, so a valid entry really is resolved, applied and validated:
# unresolvable plugin name
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: ... Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-this-package-does-not-exist'

# omitting the bridge's required key
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry cavesson-hooks
  (@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code): invalid config: configPath required

Ruled out along the way: package not installed; version skew (rc.5 → rc.6 against runtime rc.7); the patch not composing (--dump-config shows the entry); absolute vs relative configPath; spaces in the path (the 8.3 short form behaves identically); and the config file shape — parseClaudeCodeConfig accepts a bare hooks event map of command hooks, which is what is being fed.
No diagnostic channel in either shipped profile
packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code catches a config-load failure, calls ctx.logger.warn(... — no hooks registered) and returns, and the examples/acp-agent/cordis.yml comment notes warnings "use ctx.logger, never stdout". That is reasonable, but neither shipped profile appears to mount a sink:

dsh --profile headless --dump-config and --profile web --dump-config contain no logger entry.
Booting web with a configPath pointing at a file that does not exist produced no warning at all.
Inserting your own @deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-logger-console (as in examples/headless-agent/tests/fixtures/session-telemetry-otel.cordis.yml) through the same --patch produced zero output, including from the logger itself — which may be the same activation problem, one level down.

So a mount that silently does nothing is also a mount that cannot be debugged from a released install.
Guess, offered only as a starting point
lib/index.js declares inject = ["shell"]. If activation is gated on service availability while config validation happens earlier at apply, that would explain the whole pattern at once: a config error is visible, an unsatisfied injection is not, and an inactive plugin registers nothing. I could not confirm whether headless provides a shell service — it composes dsh-bash-sandbox, dsh-shell-env, dsh-subprocess-local and dsh-tool-bash.
Questions

Is --patch insert expected to activate plugins the same way a bundle layer does, or is there an additional step for out-of-tree packages that declare no dsh.bundle?
Does headless satisfy inject: ["shell"]? If not, is that the intended reason the bridge is inert there, and is there a supported profile for running it?
Would you consider surfacing unsatisfied injections at boot? A plugin that validates its config and then silently never activates is indistinguishable from one that is working, which for a hook bridge means a session that looks governed and is not.

Happy to test a patch or supply fuller logs.

threads.title: Failed/interrupted assistant turn corrupts session — persistent INVALID_REPLAY_STATE on continue (llm-pi-ai)
threads.bodyText:
This has been written by AI.
Summary
When an assistant turn fails or is interrupted mid-stream, the session appears to persist a partial assistant message. Afterwards, every attempt to continue the conversation fails with:
invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content
INVALID_REPLAY_STATE

The conversation becomes permanently unrecoverable — retrying "continue" reproduces the same error every time. Starting a new session is the only workaround.
Steps to reproduce (observed)

Cause an assistant turn to fail mid-generation (e.g. the upstream provider returns a 429/rate-limit, or the stream is interrupted before the assistant message is finalized).
Attempt to continue the same conversation.
It fails with INVALID_REPLAY_STATE; repeating step 2 keeps failing identically.

Expected: A failed/interrupted turn should not commit an incomplete assistant message; the partial turn should be rolled back so the session stays replayable and the user can retry.
Actual: The partial assistant content is retained, so the stored block count no longer matches the assistant content, and the llm-pi-ai adapter rejects every subsequent replay.
Possible direction: Commit the assistant turn atomically only on successful completion (or discard partial content during error handling), so replay-state validation never sees a mismatch.
Environment: adapter @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai, dsh 0.1.0-rc.5. Observed on a downstream build — happy to help narrow it down if it doesn't reproduce on a clean checkout.

threads.title: 反馈bug：workspace create 失败
threads.bodyText:
点击添加工作区，会出现这错误。原本目录为小新远程开机，但是harness读取目录的时候，截断了，仅显示小新远程。
DSH 在 Windows 上用一个子进程弹出系统目录选择框（），选中后通过一段叫 的代码把结果路径读出来。 问题就出在这里：
IFileOpenDialogreadUtf16
function readUtf16(koffi, address) {
const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768));
let end = 0;
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2;   // ← bug 在这里
return bytes.toString("utf16le", 0, end);
}
Windows 的路径是 UTF-16 小端编码，每个汉字占 2 个字节（低字节在前、高字节在后）。 判断「字符串结束」应该看整个 16 位编码单元是否为零，但这段代码只检查了 ，也就是只看了低字节。bytes[end]
关键点：汉字「开」的 Unicode 码位是 ，小端序低字节恰好是 ：U+5F000x00
小 U+5C0F  低字节 0F  高字节 5C
新 U+65B0  低字节 B0  高字节 65
远 U+8FDC  低字节 DC  高字节 8F
程 U+7A0B  低字节 0B  高字节 7A
开 U+5F00  低字节 00  高字节 5F   ← 低字节是 0，被误判成"字符串结束"
机 U+673A  低字节 3A  高字节 67   ← 后面全被丢掉
所以读到「开」时，代码以为字符串到头了，结果就成了 ，「开机」两个字被截掉。 凡是名字里含「码位低字节为 0x00」的汉字（比如 =U+4E00、=U+5F00 等）都会触发这个 bug。
上述为harness自己检测到的问题，望修复。

threads.title: Moving or renaming a project folder makes its session history disappear, with no recovery path移动或重命名项目文件夹会导致其会话历史记录消失，无法恢复这些数据
threads.bodyText:
正文（Body）
## Summary / 摘要

Moving (or renaming) a project folder makes that workspace's session history silently disappear from the Web GUI sidebar. The data is NOT lost — session logs still exist on disk under `~/.dsh/sessions/`, and `session.list` still returns them — but the workspace shows an empty `sessionIds` list and there is no built-in way to re-link the sessions to the new path. The only workaround is hand-editing `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json` (risky) or moving the folder back.

Also observed: path strings stored in `workspace.json` appear to be mojibake (GBK bytes inside a UTF-8 file, e.g. `V:\涓偂鐩戞帶鎻愮ずdemo1` instead of `V:\个股监控提示demo1`), while session-header `cwd` values are proper UTF-8. This string mismatch may also break the membership check. Needs maintainer confirmation.

## Environment / 环境

- dsh: 0.1.0-rc.6 (`dsh --version`)
- Node: v24.13.0
- OS: Windows 11 (build 26200), 简体中文系统

## Steps to reproduce / 复现步骤

1. Start `dsh web` in a project folder, e.g. `V:\ProjectA`, and have a conversation (creates real history).
2. Stop the server, then **move/rename** the folder, e.g. to `V:\Other\ProjectA`.
3. Restart `dsh web` and open the Web GUI.
4. Observed: the `ProjectA` workspace still exists in the sidebar, but shows **zero sessions**. The conversations are gone from the UI.

Additional detail: `session.list` API still returns those sessions (with `cwd` pointing to the old path), and the JSONL logs are intact under `~/.dsh/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/`.

## Root cause / 根因分析（代码层面）

- The workspace entity's `sessionIds` getter filters by a path index: `record.sessionIds.filter(id => host.sessionPath(id) === record.path)` (`dsh-workspace/lib/index.js`).
- That index is built at startup by validating each session header's `cwd` via `realpath` + `isDirectory`; sessions whose folder no longer exists are excluded (and end up in `invalidSessionPaths`).
- The full disk rescan (`bootstrap`) runs **only once**, when the workspace domain is first initialized (`if (!this.state.initialized)`). It never re-runs afterwards.
- `attachSession` is only invoked when a **new** session is created; there is no API/UI to attach an existing (cold) session back to a workspace, nor to re-point a workspace/session to a new path.
- Net effect: a moved folder = permanently orphaned history, until someone hand-edits `workspace.json`.

## Suggested fix / 建议方案

- **A (recommended, moderate scope):** add a "rescan disk sessions" entry point (re-runnable version of the bootstrap logic, fixing sessions that exist on disk with a valid `cwd` but were never registered — e.g. they currently show up under "ungrouped"), plus a "re-link / repair workspace path" API + UI where the user picks the new folder location, and the stored session-header `cwd` (and workspace `path`) are rewritten accordingly.
- **B (bigger change):** make session→workspace identity relocatable instead of binding to an absolute path.
- Please also verify the encoding inconsistency in `workspace.json` path fields mentioned above.

## Workaround I used / 临时自救

- Backed up `~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`, then hand-added the orphaned session id to its workspace's `sessionIds` array (validated with `JSON.parse`). Takes effect on next boot.
- Moving the folder back to the original path also restores visibility.

Thanks for this great tool — happy to provide more details, logs, or test a patch.

threads.title: Bug report: changing the default agent preset does not apply when a workspace reuses an existing blank session
threads.bodyText:
Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, web profile (dsh web)

Steps to reproduce

In Settings → Agent presets, set the default preset to a custom preset (e.g. router-standard, then later minimal).
The current workspace already contains a blank session that was created earlier under a different preset (e.g. standard).
Click "New conversation".

Expected
The new conversation should run under the current default preset (agent-presets.default).
Actual
The workspace reuses the existing blank session, which keeps the preset it was originally created with. The session header shows the old preset (e.g. 标准模式), so the settings change appears to have no effect. This is reproducible with both custom and built-in presets.
Root cause (from reading the installed client source)

workspaces.connectWorkspace (client runtime) first looks for any existing blank session in the workspace and returns it without switching its preset.
agentPresets.default is only consulted when a session is truly newly created.
The new-session hero chip also shows currentSession()?.agentPreset before falling back to the deployment default, so it can display the old blank session's preset too.

Suggested fix
When reusing a blank session, switch it to the current agentPresets.default first (the host already supports this for blank sessions via agentPreset.select / AgentPresets.recompose). Alternatively, the hero chip should prefer the deployment default over the current session's preset, and stage that default when a blank session becomes current.
Current local workaround
A small injected host plugin listens to agent/created and settings/document-updated, and recomposes any blank session whose preset differs from agentPresets.default. Non-blank sessions are left untouched.
This seems like a product gap rather than a configuration issue — reporting it here because Issues are disabled on this repository.

threads.title: [Ideas] edit 工具是否应该明确提示：同一文件的多个编辑不能并行执行？
threads.bodyText:
问题概述
edit 工具面向模型的说明中，是否应该明确写出下面这条约束？

针对同一个文件的多个 edit 调用必须串行执行；只有目标文件不同的编辑才适合并行。如果遇到 FS_STALE_VERSION，应重新读取文件后再重试。

目前底层文件系统的行为是安全且合理的：写操作会按照 targetKey 加锁，带保护的编辑会校验会话最近观察到的文件版本。原生工具调度器也会把修改类工具按排他方式执行。
不过，如果模型通过更高层的编排工具或并行调用包装器同时发起多个 edit，这些调用仍可能在第一个编辑记录新版本之前取得相同的旧版本。第一个编辑成功后，文件版本发生变化，后续调用就会因为版本过期而返回 FS_STALE_VERSION。
这里不是建议削弱版本保护。版本检查正在正确地防止更新丢失。想讨论的是：这种安全使用约束是否也应该明确展示给模型。
当前模型能看到的说明
当前 master 分支中的 tool:edit 提示说明了字面匹配、replace_all 和编辑前读取文件的要求，但没有提到同一文件不能并行编辑：

Use the edit tool for targeted changes to existing UTF-8 text files. It replaces literal old_string with new_string; by default old_string must appear exactly once. If old_string appears multiple times, provide a more specific old_string or set replace_all to true. Read the file first (the default fs-observation-policy requires it), unless you just created or edited it in this session.

工具描述本身也比较简短：

Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

通用复现方式
以 /tmp/edit-probe.txt 为例：

先读取文件一次。
通过能够并行分发工具调用的编排层，同时发起多个 edit，分别修改该文件中不同且唯一的区域。
多个调用可能在进入后端的目标级修改锁之前取得相同的已观察版本。
第一个编辑推进文件版本后，后续受版本保护的调用返回 FS_STALE_VERSION。
重新读取文件，并按顺序执行这些编辑，则可以成功。

这与当前实现一致：

fs-observation-policy 将会话观察到的版本作为编辑意图传递；
fs-local 按 targetKey 串行化修改，并拒绝旧的预期版本；
tool-fs 在编辑成功后记录新版本；
原生调度器会排他执行修改类工具，但外部或更高层的并行编排不一定保留这一调度约束。

建议的最小改动
建议给 tool:edit 的系统提示补充一句：

Never invoke multiple edit calls targeting the same file in parallel. Execute edits to the same file sequentially; edits to different files may run in parallel. If an edit fails with FS_STALE_VERSION, re-read the file and retry.

也可以在工具 description 中加入更短的版本，确保没有加载工具专属 prompt section 的场景也能看到这一约束。
为什么原生调度已经排他，仍值得写进说明？

模型可能使用具有独立并发语义的编排工具或包装器；
“并行处理相互独立的工作”是常见的 Agent 策略，而同一文件的不同代码区域表面上看起来互不相关；
失败虽然符合预期，但本来可以避免，并且恢复需要额外一次读取和工具调用；
明确写成“同文件串行、不同文件可并行”，不会不必要地阻止跨文件并行。

其他可能方案

保持现状，完全依赖原生排他调度器；
让并行编排层识别相同的规范化目标并自动串行化；
在分发前检测同目标调用，并返回更明确的诊断信息。

不建议在 FS_STALE_VERSION 后直接自动盲重试。其他编辑改变文件后，原始字面替换可能已经不再表达相同意图；重新读取后由模型重新判断更安全。
想请教维护者

“同一文件串行编辑”是否应该成为模型可见的 edit 使用约定，而不仅是内部调度属性？
工具自身的提示是否应该说明常见高层编排方式引入的约束？
更推荐只补充提示，还是进一步在编排层实现目标感知的自动串行化？

这是英文 Ideas 讨论 #3017 的中文问答版本，方便中文社区参与讨论。

threads.title: Plugin-bundled duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools breaks all tool calls (ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] undefined)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
After installing a third-party plugin (dsh-computer-use) into the web profile, every tool call in the web UI crashes with:
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

After the crash, the session is left with a dangling tool/call (no tool/result), so every subsequent turn in that session — and in any session forked/seeded from it — fails with:
An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)  INVALID_REQUEST

Environment

dsh: 0.1.0-rc.7 (global npm install)
Node.js: v24.15.0
macOS (Apple Silicon)
Profile: web, with third-party plugins installed via dsh plugin / dshmarket

Root cause
TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER is a module-level Symbol created in @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools:
const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER = Symbol("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler");
Installing a plugin that depends on @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools (e.g. dsh-computer-use@0.1.0, which bundles @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.1.0-rc.6 as a real dependency under its own node_modules, and other plugins with ^0.1.0-rc.6 peer ranges hoisting an rc.6 copy to $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools) results in two physical copies of the dsh-tools module in one process:

the core copy (rc.7) used by dsh-agent-loop
the profile/plugin copy (rc.6) loaded through the profile's node_modules

Each module instance creates its own unique Symbol, so ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] in dsh-agent-loop resolves to undefined and the first .prepare() call throws:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
    at startCall (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:193:60)
    at fillPool (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:233:10)
    at runGroup (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:242:9)
    at executeToolCalls (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:135:25)
    at ReactLoopAgent.step (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:662:32)
    at ReactLoopAgent.turn (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:555:22)

Timeline confirms it: tool calls worked until the plugin was installed; removing the plugin and all stray dsh-tools copies from the profile restored normal operation.
Reproduction

dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-computer-use (or any plugin that pulls @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools into the profile's node_modules)
Start dsh web, open a new session, send any prompt that triggers a tool call (e.g. "list files in the current directory")
The turn fails at the first tool call with the prepare TypeError; continuing the session then fails with INVALID_REQUEST

Note: --profile headless is unaffected (no third-party plugin bundles loaded).
Secondary issue: unrecoverable session corruption
When a turn crashes between tool/call and tool/result, the session log keeps a dangling tool call. Because sessions are seeded/forked with their full history (parentSession / seedLength), the corruption propagates to every descendant session and the API rejects every subsequent request. There is no built-in recovery: the user has to abandon the whole session chain (or hand-repair the log). Suggestion: on resume, detect a trailing unanswered tool_calls block and either synthesize an error tool-result or truncate it.
Suggestions

Dedupe / externalize core packages for plugins: document that plugins must treat @deepseek-ai/* packages as peer-only, and/or make the plugin loader resolve @deepseek-ai/* imports from the core installation so only one module instance ever exists.
Replace the symbol-key lookup with a string key or a service interface that survives duplicate module instances.
Installer guard: dsh plugin add could warn/block when a plugin bundles a different version of a core @deepseek-ai/* package than the running harness.

Workaround (for anyone hitting this)
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-computer-use   # or the offending plugin
# remove any stray copies:
rm -rf "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools"
then restart dsh web.

threads.title: demo:cordis fails: duplicate loader entry id cordis-host-runner
threads.bodyText:
Summary / 摘要
pnpm run demo:cordis (Web surface) fails to boot with:
duplicate loader entry id: cordis-host-runner

dsh-web-app already mounts cordis-host-runner, while examples/web-cordis/cordis.yml still inserts the same id. The demo overlay looks stale after the runner was moved into the shipped web-app bundle.
pnpm run demo:cordis（Web）启动失败，报 duplicate loader entry id: cordis-host-runner。dsh-web-app 已挂载该 entry，demo patch 又 insert 了一次。
Environment

Commit: 99f6f02fecdb7dff40c3fbc9470f5907c29f74ca (dsh-0.1.0-rc.7)
Node: v24.12.0
OS: macOS (darwin)

Repro
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm run demo:cordis
Error (trimmed)
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include): duplicate loader entry id: cordis-host-runner
TypeError: duplicate loader entry id: cordis-host-runner

Root cause
Already present in packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml:
- id: cordis-host-runner
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-host-runner'
Demo overlay examples/web-cordis/cordis.yml also does:

    - id: cordis-host-runner

    - id: tool-cordis

Suggested fix
Keep the port pin and only insert tool-cordis (the runner is already in dsh-web-app):

  config:
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: 3081

- insert:
    - id: tool-cordis

After that change, dsh web --patch examples/web-cordis/cordis.yml --dump-config shows each id once and the demo boots.

threads.title: dsh --profile tui --resume <id> 无法启动
pnpm peer-dependency warnings on dsh plugin add: which are safe to ignore and how to fix the rest
threads.bodyText:
Symptom
Running dsh plugin --profile web add <plugin> makes pnpm print a long list of ✕ missing peer warnings (@deepseek-ai/cordis, @deepseek-ai/dsh-*, react-dom, etc.), plus an Ignored build scripts notice at the end. It looks like a broken install, but most of these warnings are by design — only a couple of items actually need fixing. Posting my findings for anyone who runs into the same output.
Finding 1: most missing-peer warnings are by design and safe to ignore
The profile directory (e.g. ~/.dsh/profiles/web) deliberately sets autoInstallPeers: false in its pnpm-workspace.yaml. These peers are provided by the dsh host one level up, in ~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules — verified versions there:

@deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.1 (satisfies ^4.0.1)
react / react-dom 18.3.1 (satisfies ^18.2.0)
dsh-llm / dsh-tools / dsh-agent / dsh-client-* etc., all at 0.1.0-rc.6

At runtime, plugins resolve them through Node's upward node_modules lookup and share the host's singletons. Do not install these packages into the profile just to silence the warnings — that creates duplicate cordis / dsh-tools instances, which is exactly the root cause of the tool-scheduling crashes in #1849 and #2731. pnpm only looks inside the profile workspace and can't see the host's packages one level up, so the warnings will always appear.
Finding 2: the only real conflict is @xterm/addon-web-links — fixable with an override
dsh-plugin-terminal@0.1.13 pins @xterm/addon-web-links to 0.11.0, which declares a peer on @xterm/xterm@^5.0.0, while the plugin itself bundles @xterm/xterm@^6.0.0 (hence the unmet peer warning). @xterm/addon-web-links@0.12.0 is the release built for xterm 6 and no longer declares that peer. Add to the profile's pnpm-workspace.yaml:
overrides:
  '@xterm/addon-web-links': '0.12.0'
Then run pnpm install in that directory — the conflict warning is gone.
Finding 3: authorize the ignored build scripts via onlyBuiltDependencies
The build scripts of node-pty, ssh2, cpu-features, and cloudflared are blocked by pnpm's default policy, but the terminal/ssh plugins need them. Also in pnpm-workspace.yaml:
onlyBuiltDependencies:
  - cloudflared
  - cpu-features
  - node-pty
  - ssh2
After reinstalling, ssh2's crypto binding compiles successfully, and node-pty (via prebuilds) was verified working with a real spawned process.
Remaining issue (not fixable from the profile side)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@0.1.0-rc.7 (a dependency of dsh-sight@0.3.1) expects dsh-brand / dsh-invariants@^0.1.0-rc.7, while the host currently ships rc.6, which doesn't satisfy that range. Runtime injection by the host generally still works, but if dsh-sight misbehaves, the likely cause is the host lagging behind — we can only wait for a host upgrade.
Two suggestions

The docs (or the output of dsh plugin add) could note that missing-peer warnings for host-provided packages are normal, or offer a way to suppress them, to avoid confusion.
Be aware that dsh plugin add/remove may rewrite pnpm-workspace.yaml and drop the manually added overrides / onlyBuiltDependencies sections. It would be more robust if the CLI preserved unknown fields or offered a profile-level pnpm config entry point.

Environment: pnpm 10.33.0, Node 22, macOS arm64.

threads.title: [Bug] 版本 token 包含 ctime 导致元数据未变、内容未变时误报 FS_STALE_VERSION
threads.bodyText:
问题概述
fs-local 用于判断文件是否"陈旧"的版本 token，目前由以下字段拼接而成：
function versionOf(info) {
  return FsVersion(`${info.dev}:${info.ino}:${info.size}:${info.mtimeNs}:${info.ctimeNs}`)
}
其中 ctimeNs（inode 元数据最后修改时间）会被任何元数据变化刷新，例如 chmod、chown、修改扩展属性、硬链接计数变化等，即使文件的实际文本内容一个字节都没有变化。
这会导致一个和"文件内容是否真的变了"完全无关的假阳性：如果在模型 read 之后、下一次 write/edit 之前，有任何进程（包括常见的编辑器保存行为、格式化工具、权限修复脚本等）touch 了这个文件的元数据但没有改内容，editText/writeText 就会把它当成"文件已变化"，返回 FS_STALE_VERSION，即便重新读取后看到的内容和之前完全一致。
可复现步骤
用一个通用的临时文件即可稳定复现，不需要任何并发：
cat > /tmp/edit-probe.txt <<'TXT'
line01
line02
line03
TXT


模型 read 该文件一次。


在下一次 edit 之前，执行一次只影响元数据、不改内容的操作，例如：
chmod 640 /tmp/edit-probe.txt
chmod 644 /tmp/edit-probe.txt
可以验证：mtime 不变，ctime 发生了变化，文件字节内容完全没变。


紧接着对该文件发起一次 edit（替换一个明确存在的字面量）。


该次 edit 会返回：
cannot edit "...": file changed since it was read — re-read the file, then retry

即使重新 read 后可以看到内容与之前一致。


我在本地按上述步骤复现了两次，均 100% 触发；作为对照，只执行 touch -a（仅修改 atime）不会触发，符合 versionOf 不包含 atime 的实现。
和另外两个既有讨论的关系
这个问题和我此前提交的两个讨论都相关，但根因不同，希望单独讨论：

#3017（英文 Ideas）和 #3029（中文 Q&A）讨论的是同一文件被并行编辑时的 FS_STALE_VERSION，那是版本保护在正确工作，只是需要在模型提示里说清楚。
本讨论讨论的是单一调用方、完全串行、文件内容未变的场景下出现的 FS_STALE_VERSION 误报，属于版本 token 本身对元数据噪声过于敏感，和并发无关。

关于修复方向：为什么建议排除 ctimeNs，而不是改成内容哈希
一个直观的想法是把陈旧检测换成内容哈希，但我认为这会带来不必要的性能代价。下面按推荐程度列出几个具体方向，供讨论：
方案 1（推荐）：版本 token 去掉 ctimeNs，只保留 dev:ino:size:mtimeNs
function versionOf(info) {
  return FsVersion(`${info.dev}:${info.ino}:${info.size}:${info.mtimeNs}`)
}

成本：零。仍然是纯 stat，不增加任何 I/O。
收益：直接消除 chmod/chown/xattr 等元数据噪声导致的误报，覆盖本讨论描述的这类场景。
风险：小。和 Git 的 stat 缓存、rsync、make 等主流工具的增量判断依据一致——它们普遍以 mtime/size 判断文件是否变化，通常不依赖 ctime。
残留代价：理论上如果某工具"只改 mtime、不改内容"（例如某些格式化工具会重设时间戳），依然可能误报，但概率远低于 ctime 场景。

方案 2：editText 增加"内容兜底校验"，仅在 stat 版本不一致时触发
即 stat 版本一致时直接放行（保留现有快速路径）；stat 版本不一致时不要立刻报错，而是读一次当前内容，与 read 时留存的内容或哈希做比较，只有内容确实不同才报 FS_STALE_VERSION。

成本：只在版本不一致、原本就要报错的分支里多做一次读取，不影响正常路径的性能。因为 editText 本来就要把整个文件读进内存做字面量替换（README 已注明这一点），这次额外读取的边际成本不大。
收益：既保留对元数据变化的敏感监测（不会漏掉真正的并发修改），又能过滤纯元数据噪声。
代价：需要在观察状态里额外保留一份内容快照或哈希，是对 fs-observation-policy 的一次接口扩展（目前只存版本 token，不存内容）。
适用范围：更适合只用于 edit，不建议套用到 write——因为 write 当前的陈旧检测只是一次 stat（"0 stat" 的性能特征），如果也叠加内容读取，会让每次覆盖写入前都多一次完整读取，对大文件、连续多次覆盖同一大文件的场景会有实打实的性能回退。

方案 3：保留 ctimeNs 校验，但仅作为诊断信息而非拒绝依据
即正式校验只用 dev:ino:size:mtimeNs（等同方案 1），但当 ctimeNs 不一致、其余字段一致时，在错误信息或调试日志里追加提示，例如"检测到文件元数据变化（如权限/属主），但内容判定未过期"，帮助排查问题来源，同时不影响放行判断。

这更像是方案 1 的可选增强，而不是独立方案，适合在方案 1 落地后再考虑。

方案 4（不推荐，仅作对比）：全面切换为内容哈希
即把 write/edit 的陈旧检测统一换成读取内容并计算哈希。

对 editText 而言代价不大（原因同方案 2）。
但对 writeText 而言，会把当前"仅 stat、不读内容"的路径变成"每次覆盖写入前都要完整读一次文件"，在大文件或高频覆盖写场景下有明显的性能回退，性价比低于方案 1。

建议的落地顺序
优先落地方案 1，这是收益成本比最高的改动，几乎没有下行风险。如果维护者认为"绝对不能漏掉任何并发修改"（哪怕只是元数据层面的），可以在方案 1 基础上，为 editText 单独叠加方案 2 作为加强校验（因为 edit 反正要整读文件，兜底成本低），但不建议把这一加强校验同时套用到 writeText 上，以免引入方案 4 描述的性能回退。方案 3 可以作为方案 1 的诊断信息补充。
想请教维护者

版本 token 目前把 ctimeNs 纳入陈旧检测，是刻意的安全选择（宁可误报也不漏报），还是尚未考虑到这种元数据噪声场景？
是否可以考虑把版本 token 收窄为 dev:ino:size:mtimeNs（方案 1），作为对 write/edit 都零额外成本的修复？
如果仍然希望保留基于内容的强校验，是否更适合作为 editText 的可选兜底路径（方案 2），而不改变 writeText 当前"仅 stat、不读内容"的性能特征？

threads.title: [Bug][Fix available] pnpm add -g 后 native binding 解析失败，dsh web 找不到已安装插件
threads.bodyText:
Affected scenario
这个问题发生在发布版 DSH CLI 通过 pnpm 安装到用户级全局目录时，而不是在源码仓库中运行 pnpm dsh web：
pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
dsh web
触发条件是全局安装采用隔离的 content-addressed / global virtual-store 布局：node-addon-require-builtin、共享的 node-addon-native-custom-loader 和当前平台包位于不同的物理包根目录，没有依赖 pnpm hoist。Node 22+ 正常启动，不额外传入 --expose-internals。
What the user sees
dsh web 在挂载 profile 中的 bare plugin specifier 时失败，错误形态是：
failed to import loader entry ...:
Cannot find module '@deepseek-ai/...' imported from ...

报错中的插件包实际上已经安装。用户通常看不到真正更早的错误，因为 Loader 会把 native bridge 当作可选能力并吞掉它：
No usable native binding found

随后 ModuleLoader.fromInternal() 返回 undefined，bare plugin import 改走普通动态导入，并从 vendored Loader 包而不是 profile / 已安装应用解析，于是产生误导性的二次 Cannot find module。
Root cause
node-addon-require-builtin 持有当前平台包作为自己的 optional dependency，并委托 node-addon-native-custom-loader 选择和加载平台包。共享 custom loader 却从自己的物理模块位置执行平台包 require()。
在 pnpm global virtual-store 中，平台包仍然存在并且能从 entry package 的依赖目录解析，但不在共享 custom loader 的祖先搜索路径中，因此 native entry 加载失败。
最小回归测试使用 rc.7 锁文件中的三个真实 0.1.4 包构造该布局，并证明：

entry package 持有 custom loader 与当前平台包的依赖链接；
平台包已安装且能从 entry package 的依赖目录解析；
未修改的 native entry 仍稳定抛出 No usable native binding；
修复后的 ModuleLoader.fromInternal() 能得到 Node internal loader。

Fix
正常 native entry 加载失败后，Loader 按依赖所有权从 entry package 自己的依赖目录解析 custom loader 与平台包，再调用 platform bridge。NARB_DISABLE_OPTIONAL_PACKAGE=1 仍会明确禁用该路径，普通动态导入行为保持不变。
完整修复（基于 rc.7 的 99f6f02，共 2 commits）：

完整差异
主修复 ee3c84c
保留显式 opt-out 语义 6c54acf

Validation

隔离布局回归测试：2/2（正常加载 + 显式 opt-out）；
Loader typecheck；
完整 lint/build；
doc-sync：28/28；
pre-push typecheck。

Scope
这项改动只修复 pnpm 用户级全局安装中的 native platform-package 解析路径。它不是 #2699 中“源码启动 + watch-only HMR 依赖契约”问题的修复，也不表示所有 dsh web 启动错误都有相同根因。
请维护者 review 这项依赖所有权解析修复是否符合 Loader 的预期语义；完整两提交已经可以供内部移植或 squash。

threads.title: pnpm dsh web fails on Linux ARM64 when Cordis internal ESM loader falls back
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Running pnpm dsh web from the repository checkout fails to resolve @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse on Linux ARM64.
The package exists and pnpm workspace links are present. The failure occurs after Cordis cannot obtain Node's internal ESM loader and falls back to a bareimport(name) from vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts. The corresponding client package is also missing from tsconfig.base.json paths.
Environment

DeepSeek Harness: 0.1.0-rc.7
Node.js: v24.18.1
pnpm: 11.21.0 (repository pins 11.7.0)
OS: NixOS 26.05 under WSL2
Kernel: 6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2
Platform: linux
Architecture: arm64

Steps to reproduce

Run pnpm install.
Run pnpm run build (this succeeds).
Run:

  pnpm dsh web
Expected behavior
The Web profile starts and prints its local URL.
Actual behavior
Startup fails while directory-picker-auto dynamically mounts the browse client surface.
$ node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web

  Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader
  entry
  directory-picker (@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-auto):
  failed to
  import loader entry e0033e60
  (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse): Cannot find
  package
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse' imported from
  /home/nixos/deepseek-harness/vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts

  Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse' imported from  /home/nixos/deepseek-harness/vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts
      at Object.getPackageJSONURL
        (node:internal/modules/package_json_reader:301:9)
      at packageResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:768:81)
      at moduleResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:859:18)
      at defaultResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:992:11)
      at resolveTsPathsSync
        (.../node_modules/.pnpm/tsx@4.22.4/node_modules/tsx/dist/
        register-CqMfTiWi.mjs:2:11190)
      at boot (packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts:800:11)
      at async runProfile (apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts:248:15)

  Node.js v24.18.1
  [ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.
ARM64 loader diagnostic
Directly invoking node-addon-require-builtin produces:
Error: node-addon-require-builtin unsupported: Unsupported/no-getter
  (arm64 getter is not optional-bti-ldr-x0-this-imm-ret)
code: Unsupported/no-getter
node: 24.18.1
napi_version: 10
platform: linux
arch: arm64
target: internal/modules/esm/loader
getter_symbol: not-found
getter_pattern: none

Consequently, ModuleLoader.fromInternal() returns no loader:

{"node":"v24.18.1","platform":"linux","arch":"arm64","loaderAvailable":false}

Using Node's diagnostic --expose-internals flag makes the same probe succeed:

{"node":"v24.18.1","platform":"linux","arch":"arm64","loaderAvailable":true,"loaderVersion":"v2"}
This confirms that the ARM64 addon failure causes Cordis to take the fallback branch at vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts:154-160.
Additional resolution evidence
A source-mode import test using tsx/esm gives:
@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-browse       OK
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse FAIL ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND

tsconfig.base.json contains mappings for the host directory-picker packages, but not for:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-native
Both packages are declared by packages/bundle/web-app/package.json, exist under packages/client/, and have pnpm workspace links. Reinstalling dependencies does not address the failure.
pnpm run verify-cordis-config currently passes, so dynamic package references from SURFACE_PACKAGES are not covered by its source-plane resolution check.
Suggested resolution

Add source mappings for both client directory-picker packages.
Extend verify-cordis-config to validate dynamically selected package names.
Add a regression test for operation when ModuleLoader.fromInternal() is unavailable.
Either update node-addon-require-builtin for Node 24 ARM64 or make the fallback preserve the Loader profile baseUrl for bare package specifiers.
