threads.title: [Bug] CORDIS_SHARED 非法 JSON 会在 Loader 构造时打崩所有 dsh --profile 启动（.env 也能灌进来）
threads.bodyText:
在 rc.7（99f6f02）对过源码，Discussions / Issues 里搜 CORDIS_SHARED、envData、JSON.parse(process.env 都是空的。
怎么炸
dsh --profile web（以及所有走 runProfile 的 surface）会先跑 loadLayeredEnv，再 ctx.plugin(Loader)。Loader 构造函数里有一句：
// vendor/loader/src/index.ts:68-70
public envData = process.env.CORDIS_SHARED
  ? JSON.parse(process.env.CORDIS_SHARED)
  : { startTime: Date.now() }
变量是真值就会 JSON.parse，没有 try/catch。空字符串没事（假值走默认），空格、not-json、{ 这种都会在 host 准备阶段直接 SyntaxError，插件树还没挂上。
为什么 .env 也能打进来
loadLayeredEnv（packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts）会把调用目录和 $DSH_HOME 的 .env 写进 process.env。bootstrap 黑名单只有 PATH / NODE_OPTIONS / DSH_* 这类，没有 CORDIS_SHARED。所以项目 .env 里随手写一行 CORDIS_SHARED=debug，下一次 dsh web 就起不来。
浏览器侧其实已经躲过了：apps/web/vite.config.ts 把 process.env.CORDIS_SHARED 钉成 undefined，注释写明是为了让 envData 走默认分支。Node 启动路径没有同等保护。
最小复现
· 在仓库根或 ~/.dsh 放 .env，内容一行：CORDIS_SHARED=not-json
· pnpm dsh web（或任意 dsh --profile …）
· 预期：忽略或告警
· 实际：dsh: host preparation failed: Unexpected token …，进程退出
JSON.parse('null') 能过，但 envData 会变成 null，后面要是读 startTime 会再炸一次；这次只把「非法 JSON 直接打崩启动」记下来。

threads.title: [CLI] headless / TUI can't use agent presets (persona) — mount() is coupled to the web frontend
threads.bodyText:
Summary
The non-web surfaces (headless profile, and community TUI plugins that compose over dsh-base) cannot use agent presets — an agent always comes up as the default "coding agent" persona, even when dsh-agent-presets is mounted and settings.yaml sets agent-presets.default.
This blocks a Codex/Claude-Code-style CLI experience: tools load, but the persona (the agent's identity / system-prompt) does not.
Environment

dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (all @deepseek-ai/dsh-* packages at 0.1.0-rc.6)
Reproduced with both the built-in headless profile and the community @dsh-tui/dsh-tui (0.1.2), each patched to insert @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets with config.default set.

Repro

Create a headless (or TUI) profile that inserts @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets (with a valid config.default) plus an MCP client.
Run one task: dsh --profile  "who are you"

Observed: the reply is the deployment's default "coding agent" persona. The preset's persona (defined in an agent.cordis.yml under .agent-presets) is never applied.
Root cause (from reading the source)

Per dsh-agent-presets README, ctx.agentPresets.mount(agentCtx, id) is the one supported call site, meant to run in the agent factory's setup(agentCtx) hook.
Grepping every .js under @deepseek-ai/dsh-* finds no call to agentPresets.mount() / recompose() outside the agent-presets package itself — i.e. no core-layer component performs the mount.
The mount only happens through the web conversation frontend (dsh-client-ui-conversation), which is why the web UI gets personas but headless and dsh-tui do not. dsh-headless run() calls agents.create(...) with a setup hook that only installs the model selection — it never mounts a preset.

So persona support is coupled to the web frontend instead of living in the core agent-composition path.
Expected
Agent-preset mounting should be a core-layer concern, so any surface (web / headless / TUI / third-party frontends) gets the same persona behavior. Concretely:

Move the preset mount into the core agent factory (or provide a core hook), so headless and TUI can compose an agent from a preset; and/or
Add a launcher flag (e.g. --preset ) so: dsh --profile headless --preset stock "task" works.

Related (minor, community TUI)
The community @dsh-tui/dsh-tui also does not integrate dsh-workspace, so sessions it creates show up in the web UI under "ungrouped" rather than under their workspace. This is a separate gap, but it compounds the "CLI is not first-class" impression. Mentioning it here for context; it can be tracked separately.
Suggestion
A core-layer agentPresets mount + a --preset flag would unblock the whole CLI ecosystem (headless, dsh-tui, and future terminal clients) without each frontend re-implementing preset composition.

threads.title: Safe pattern for wrapping CLI coding agents (agy / Codex / Claude Code) as pure-LLM providers in DSH — anti-autonomy flags & fallback routing
threads.bodyText:
We run DSH 24/7 on a small VPS and wrap several CLIs as LLM providers via custom cordis plugins. Sharing what we learned and asking for the blessed pattern.
Context. When a CLI coding agent (agy, codex, claude) is spawned headlessly as a provider, its internal agent loop can start doing its own tool calls behind the harness's back — we observed agy auto-approving its own ViewFile/edit steps because our first adapter passed --dangerously-skip-permissions. That surfaced as empty assistant turns (the CLI burned thousands of tokens internally and returned nothing).
What we verified locally (agy 1.1.14):

--mode plan + --sandbox + --disable-slash-commands = pure-LLM posture (no edit/apply tools, no slash expansion). Text answers work normally.
--dangerously-skip-permissions = full autonomy — never for a provider adapter.
--json-schema gives structured final results; --input-format stream-json allows multi-turn NDJSON.
Codex: codex exec --sandbox read-only --json. Claude Code: -p --permission-mode dontAsk --disallowedTools "*" --output-format stream-json.

Our adapter hardening (open to review): process-group kill (SIGTERM→SIGKILL), stderr ring drain, TTFT/idle/wall timers, exit-vs-close handling incl. grandchildren holding pipes, error taxonomy mapped to RATE_LIMIT(+providerRetryAfterMs)/AUTH/INVALID_REQUEST/TIMEOUT/SERVER, never fabricating content on empty results, and a fake-CLI test harness (17 integration scenarios + unit tests, all hermetic).
Questions for maintainers/community:

Is there a blessed hook for cross-provider fallback in dsh-llm? We found providerRetryPolicy (same-provider retry) but no route chain — is the intended pattern a custom plugin on agent/request-error, or something like LiteLLM-style fallbacks on the roadmap?
Does dsh-fs-sandbox compose with CLI-provider adapters (i.e., constrain what a CLI child can touch beyond its own flags), or is bubblewrap the expected OS layer?
Any plans for a first-party "CLI agent adapter" package in the harness (shared spawn/parse/safety layer)?

Happy to share our adapter + test suite as a plugin if useful. Thanks for the great harness!

threads.title: 两个 harness 进程共享同一 sessions root 会损坏"回合进行中"的会话日志 —— 一方合成崩溃修复写入 + 另一方盲目追加，且整个持久化栈没有跨进程锁
threads.bodyText:
history unavailable for session "session-599650e1-…": Error: corrupt session log:
seq gap in committed region at line 17972 (expected 217964, got 217961)

直接原因：写者 A 的回合正在进行中、磁盘尾端是已刷盘的 step/start 时，写者 B 的会话 prepare 路径将其判定为"中断的回合"，并向磁盘追加了合成收尾事件（step/end、turn/end {reason: interrupted}、session/end-seed），占用了 seq N+1..N+3。写者 A 毫不知情，继续从自己内存中的 seq N+1 追加。日志中从此出现两段各自连续、但相互不兼容的编号区域。
而在这之下的才是真正的缺陷：持久化栈完全没有跨进程互斥——所有防护都是进程内内存状态。
环境









dsh
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6


操作系统
Windows 10


Node
v26.1.0


日志编码
zstd 帧（session.jsonl.zstd），会话格式版本 0


部署形态
两个 dsh web 实例，同一 cwd（D:\Codes\…），共享默认 sessions root ~/.dsh/sessions



事件经过（时间线全部取自日志本身）



本地时间
事件
写入者




13:38:34
A 的 agent 在同一 cwd 以后台任务启动 dsh web --port 3081（完整命令记录在日志 seq 217874）
A


~13:40:10
B（3081 实例）启动完成，创建了自己的空白会话
B


13:40:18.373
A 刷盘 step/start seq 217960（turn 9 / step 21），随后进入约 10 秒的首 token 等待间隙
A


13:40:19.694
B prepare 同项目另一个长期休眠的会话 → 追加了一个孤立的 session/end-seed（该日志本身平衡，无害；但注意：一次"读"跨进程写了磁盘）
B


13:40:26.248
B prepare A 正在写的会话。磁盘尾端 = 开着的 turn/step → interruptedTurnClosers() 触发 → B 追加合成 step/end 217961、turn/end (interrupted) 217962，随后 session/end-seed 217963
B


13:40:28.661
A 的 step 21 首 chunk 到达，追加 assistant/chunk seq 217961 —— 编号倒回
A


13:42:28.555
A 正常完成回合：turn/end 220204（completed）
A



形成的磁盘布局（每事件一行；每个追加批次是独立的 zstd 帧，因此 3 个合成事件恰好独占两个帧）：
frame 14228: tool/result 217958, step/end 217959              ← A
frame 14229: step/start 217960  (turn 9 / step 21)            ← A（流式间隙开始）
frame 14230: step/end 217961, turn/end(interrupted) 217962    ← B，合成崩溃修复
frame 14231: session/end-seed 217963                          ← B，re-seed 标记
frame 14232: assistant/chunk seq 217961 "…"                   ← A 从内存 seq 恢复追加
   …
frame 14356: turn/end 220204 (completed)                      ← A

锁定来源的取证指纹： 合成收尾事件的毫秒时间戳与最后一个真实事件完全相同（1787118018373，即 step/start 217960 的时间）。自然产生的事件不可能如此——这是 interruptedTurnClosers() 文档化的确定性设计（"timestamps reuse the last real event"）。三个事件共享同一毫秒、且独占一个追加帧，就是崩溃修复的签名。
根因走查

PersistenceCoordinator.prepareCore()（@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence）读取存储前缀并调用 interruptedTurnClosers(storedEvents)（@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types/repair.js）。尾端有未闭合的 step 时，合成收尾事件。
commitPrepared()：closers.length > 0 → backend.commitRepair()，将它们持久化写入共享日志。jsonl 后端的 repair() 在认为尾端撕裂时甚至会先 truncate——另一个写者的字节可能被直接砍掉，而不只是被遮蔽。
恢复出的 Session 构造器发现种子不以 end-seed 结尾时追加 session/end-seed；attachPrepared() 同样把这个后缀写入磁盘。
写者 A 的 appendLiveBatch() 按 e.seq >= cursor 过滤后盲目追加；后端以 "a" 模式 open，从不重读文件尾。A 与 B 在任何环节都察觉不到对方的存在。

为什么现有防护拦不住



防护
作用域
为何无效




states.get(id).owner 活跃属主检查（commitPrepared 抛 "already has a live persistence owner"）
进程内 Map
B 的进程从未见过 A 的会话对象


preparations 预约缓存
进程内
同上


serialize(id, op) 按 id 串行化操作
进程内 Promise 链
只在单进程内串行


loadLiveSnapshot 拒绝为开回合的活跃会话取快照
进程内
B 没有 A 会话的活跃快照


isPreparedSourceCurrent（fileRevision 比对）
跨进程，但一次性
只保护 B 自己的 读→提交 窗口（亚秒级）。A 的下一帧 2.4 秒后才到


materialize 原子发布（link() / MoveFileExW 不带替换）
跨进程 ✅
只保护文件创建——追加与崩溃修复不受保护



结论：创建是竞态安全的，创建之后的一切都不是。我在两个包里全文检索过任何 flock / lockfile / O_EXCL / lease / heartbeat / PID 形态的原语——一个都没有。
最小复现步骤

终端 1，项目目录：dsh web → 打开/继续一个会话（A）。
让 A 做一件流式输出较久的事（带工具调用的回合会形成很好的"已刷盘 step/start 然后间隙"窗口）。
终端 2，同一目录：dsh web --port 3081（B）。在 B 的 UI 里打开会话列表 / 历史也会走同一条 prepare 路径。
若 B 在 A 回合进行中、刷盘尾端恰为 step/start 时 prepare 该会话，B 就会写入合成收尾。A 的下一次 write-behind 刷盘随即倒回 seq 空间。
两个实例此后加载该会话都会报 seq gap in committed region。

时间窗口依赖流式间隙，但我们第一次无意尝试就命中了——这个窗口就是每个 step 的首 token 延迟，每个 step 都会出现一次。
影响

任何两个共享 sessions root + 项目 cwd 的 harness 进程（dsh web + dsh web，或据推测 dsh web + 同项目的 headless/CLI 运行）都可能损坏回合进行中的会话日志。
损坏在写入时静默无声，事后以整个会话无法加载的形式爆发。
即便是良性情形也会写盘：prepare 一个平衡的日志也会跨进程追加一个多余的 session/end-seed（我们在损坏发生前 6 秒恰好捕获到它落在另一个休眠会话上）。
比实际观察更糟的变体：如果尾端恰好是撕裂帧，B 的 commitRepair truncate 会直接丢弃 A 的字节。

建议方向（任一方向都乐意展开为 PR 讨论）

按会话做跨进程互斥 —— 例如会话目录内 O_EXCL 锁文件（含 PID + 心跳），或写者进程独占持有句柄；prepare/resume/repair 必须拿到锁，否则拒绝。
让读路径在竞争下无副作用 —— 拿不到锁时合成收尾只留在内存；绝不 repair-on-read 一个属主还活着的日志。
追加前检测外部增长 —— 每批追加时复核 fileRevision；发现外部写入就大声中止（"multiple writers"），而不是盲目追加。
为进行中的回合加活性标记 —— 回合开着时写轻量心跳行，让恢复启发式能区分"崩溃了"和"另一个进程正在流式输出"。
工具化：dsh sessions verify|repair，实现最长有效前缀/后缀手术；下面是我们被迫手工做的等价操作。

给已踩坑者的恢复说明
合成事件可以被识别（同毫秒时间戳、自成一体的追加帧）。我们的修复方式是剔除独占持有这 3 个合成事件的两个帧——其余所有帧保持逐字节一致、头帧不动——然后用 Session.fromRestore() 校验结果（220,205 个事件，seq 0…220204 连续，以干净的 turn/end {completed} 收尾；原文件可预测地未通过同一校验）。替换文件后 GUI 成功加载该会话并追加了它自己规范的 end-seed。完整取证报告可按需提供。

TL;DR： 会话日志以 seq = index 连续性为硬不变量，创建走原子发布，但追加与崩溃修复没有跨进程锁——于是第二个 harness 进程可以"修复"一个在另一进程中活着的会话并倒回其 seq 空间。建议对 repair 施加 锁或拒绝 语义，并在追加时检测外部增长。

threads.title: Our servers are currently overloaded. Please try again later.
会话运行时长远高于实际运行时间，疑似时间戳 Bug
threads.bodyText:
问题描述：
我新下载了 DeepSeek Harness，第一次运行了一个任务（检测电脑配置并优化游戏帧数），实际总共只用了十几分钟。但界面上显示的"运行时间"却长达 7 个多小时，与实际不符。
我导出了会话日志 session.jsonl 分析后发现，日志中的事件时间戳存在一次约 7 小时的异常跳变：
断裂点前后事件 seq 序号是连续的（32175 → 32180），说明事件是连续生成的，中间并没有真实等待 7 小时。
但 time 字段从 1787024624581（11:43:44）直接跳变到 1787049816975（18:43:36），凭空多了约 7 小时。
同一位置的 time0 字段（text-chunks / reasoning-chunks 事件使用）却保持一致，仍在 11:xx 范围内。
具体证据（session.jsonl 第 2713-2714 行）：
JSON
{"type":"text-chunks","seq0":32175,"time0":1787024624581,...}   // 11:43:44{"type":"assistant/chunk","seq":32180,"time":1787049816975,...} // 18:43:36，突然跳变
统计结果：
会话创建到结束的墙上时钟跨度：约 7.5 小时
事件间隔 < 30 秒的"活跃时间"：仅约 844 秒（14 分钟）
全会话只有 1 条用户消息（我最初发的那条），AI 在单个 turn 内完成
怀疑点： assistant/chunk 事件的 time 字段在 seq 32180 处发生了约 7 小时的无故跳变，与 time0 字段和 seq 连续性矛盾，推测是时间戳生成逻辑存在 Bug，导致界面的"运行时间"计时错误。
环境信息：
操作系统：Windows
会话工作目录：C:\Users\JINJU\OneDrive\Desktop\新建文件夹
模型：deepseek-v4-pro
会话 ID：session-7bc11645-ccbb-4b21-b753-0b00d8a50ee2

threads.title: [Bug] 重启后侧栏所有会话标题显示为工作区文件夹名，点开会话后才恢复
threads.bodyText:
标题建议
[Bug] 重启后侧栏所有会话标题显示为工作区文件夹名，点开会话后才恢复
正文
环境

DSH 版本：0.1.0-rc.6（dsh web 启动；全局 npm 安装）
平台：Linux x86_64
补充：已对比 0.1.0-rc.7（2026-08-17 发布）源码，dsh-session-projection-cache 与 rc.6 完全一致，rc.7 未修复此问题

复现步骤

在若干工作区中创建并使用多个会话（会话有自动生成或手动改名的标题）
完全退出并重启 dsh web
侧栏会话列表：所有未打开的冷会话，标题显示为该会话所属工作区的文件夹名（如 DSHGUANLI）
点击打开任意会话后，该会话标题恢复为正确的会话标题

根因分析（已定位到代码）
侧栏会话行标题的链路：

客户端渲染用 displayTitleOf(title, cwd, id)（dsh-client-runtime）：优先持久 title → 退回 cwd 文件夹名 → 退回 session id；
session.list 的行 schema sessionSummarySchema（dsh-host-apiproxy）没有 title 字段，title 只能通过行内 projections 块中的 "title" 投影提供；
冷会话（未打开）的 projections 只来自持久化投影缓存 sessionProjectionCache.cachedSnapshot()（~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache.json），零日志读取；
本机该缓存仅有 3 条记录（2026-08-14/15），而 ~/.dsh/sessions/ 下有 60 个持久化会话；缓存自 2026-08-15 起不再写入（当前活跃会话也不会触发更新，说明写入路径失效）；
因此重启后几乎所有冷会话行没有 title → 侧栏显示工作区文件夹名；
点开会话走 session.history，detached 路径用 detachedProjectionsFor() 从完整日志重新折叠 projections（含 title）并返回，客户端 installWindow 将其 seed 进投影 store，标题随即恢复。

期望行为
重启后侧栏会话列表应直接显示持久化标题（session/title 事件），无需先打开会话。
建议修复方向

session.list 对冷会话行折叠 title（dsh-session-query 已具备 readTitleSnapshots() / foldSessionTitle），或
修复 dsh-session-projection-cache 写入路径（当前环境下完全不落盘；写入是 fail-soft 的，错误只记 warning，建议先检查宿主日志中的 session projection cache: ... write ... failed）。

threads.title: 子 agent 使用的是父 agent 创建时快照的模型,不跟随 Web UI 里切换后的当前模型
threads.bodyText:
现象
在 Web UI 中切换模型后,父 agent 派生的 in-process 子 agent 并没有使用当前选中的模型,而是使用父 agent 创建时记录的模型。我这次 7 个子 agent 全部因此启动失败,报 UNKNOWN_MODEL,并且它们用的 provider/model 甚至是我 settings 里从未配置过的 kimi-k3。
复现
一次 Web 会话,期间在 UI 里切换过 3 次模型。session 日志中父 agent 的 request/header:
seq=12   provider=packyai            model=grok-4.6
seq=136  provider=packyai            model=glm-5.3
seq=689  provider=deepseek-official  model=deepseek-v4-flash    ← 该 turn 成功完成

在最后这个 turn 里,父 agent 通过 tool-subagent(provider: spawn)派生了 7 个子 agent。每个子 agent 的 subagent/descriptor 都记录:
agentProvider: "packyai"
agentModel:    "kimi-k3"

所有 7 个子 agent 的 turn/end 均为:
{ kind: "error", error: { code: "UNKNOWN_MODEL",
  message: "pi-ai provider \"packyai\" has no configured model \"kimi-k3\"" } }

两点异常:

父 agent 早已切到 deepseek-official,子 agent 仍走 packyai。
kimi-k3 在本部署的 settings 里从未配置过,像是某处残留的 stale default。

根因(源码定位)


packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:1081 — 顶层 agent 创建时的 agentOptions() 读 defaults.defaultModelSelection(),该值成为 parent.options 的创建期快照。


packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:2247-2261 — UI 切模型只更新会话级 ModelSelectionRef 并尝试持久化 default;持久化失败被 logger.warn 吞掉,不 throw,parent.options 也不更新。


packages/subagent/subagent/src/continuation.ts:413-414 — 子 agent descriptor 构造:
const agentProvider = request.agentOptions?.provider ?? parent.options.provider
const agentModel    = request.agentOptions?.model    ?? parent.options.model
当 tool-subagent row 未显式配 agentOptions 时,回退到 parent.options —— 即那份创建期快照,不跟随 UI 切换。


若中途 saveDefaultModelSelection 失败,后续 agents.create 拿到的 default 甚至可能是当前 settings 里根本不存在的值(如本例 kimi-k3),现象就是"stamped 了一个 settings 从未出现过的模型"。
影响

子 agent 静默走错 provider/model,忽视 UI 里的当前选择。
常见后果:子 agent 首次请求即因 provider/model 不匹配失败,父 agent 只好自己接管子任务,并行子 agent 完全失效。
UI 层不可见:子 agent 只是"快速夭折",只有翻 session.jsonl 才能看到 descriptor 里错位的 provider/model。

修复

continuation.ts 构造 descriptor 时,先读父 agent 的当前 selection(通过 ctx.agentDefaultModel.currentSelection() 或安装在 parent.ctx 上的 ModelSelectionRef),再回退到 parent.options。
或在 UI 切模型时同步更新 parent.options(或改成 live ref),消除"创建期快照"这个概念。
saveDefaultModelSelection 失败不宜仅作 warn 吞掉 —— 它是后续 agents.create 拿 default 的唯一来源,失败会直接产生"stamped 了 settings 里没有的模型"这种诡异状态。

threads.title: pi-ai adapter: third-party "server_error"/overload responses are not classified as SERVER and never retried
threads.bodyText:
Environment / 环境
DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.5 (commit 47f9438, 2026-08-13)
Surface: Web GUI (dsh web), agent run / model request
Provider path: third-party OpenAI-compatible API via pi-ai adapter (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai)
Retry plugin: llm-retry present in base bundle (packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml)
Describe the bug / 问题描述
第三方 provider 过载时返回标准错误体：
Error Code server_error: Our servers are currently overloaded. Please try again later.
DSH 直接显示“本轮运行失败”，一次重试都不发生；默认重试策略本应覆盖这类瞬时故障（SERVER/RATE_LIMIT/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT），每次重试都立刻再次失败。
Steps to reproduce / 复现步骤
配置一个会返回 server_error/overload 文案（文本中无 5xx 数字）的第三方 OpenAI 兼容 provider
发送消息触发上游过载错误
观察：本轮立即失败，会话日志无 llm/retry 事件——完全没有退避重试
Expected / Actual
期望：归类为可重试 SERVER，按默认退避重试 2 次（500ms→10s，10% 抖动）后才失败
实际：首次请求即失败，直接把上游原文展示给用户
Root cause / 根因分析
pi-ai 将捕获异常扁平化为 error.message，丢失原始 Error/cause（stream.ts 已有注释），只能文本分类
classifyPiAiError 只把含 5xx 数字的文案（如 HTTP 500）归为 SERVER；server_error: ... 无数字 → 落入兜底 PI_AI_ERROR
PI_AI_ERROR 不在默认重试码白名单（packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts）→ llm-retry 直接放行 → 本轮以错误终结
Relevant code / 相关位置
packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts（修复点）· packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts · packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts · packages/llm/llm-retry/src/index.ts · packages/extensions/ui-cordis/src/client/locales.ts

threads.title: 在群晖 NAS（Linux x64）上运行 DeepSeek Harness 的安装与启动问题及解决方案
threads.bodyText:
大家好，
我最近尝试在 群晖 Synology NAS（Linux x64） 上从源码部署 DeepSeek Harness，目前已经成功运行。
在整个安装和启动过程中遇到了一些比较典型的问题，最终都已经解决。这里整理出来，希望可以帮助官方改进安装文档、CLI 启动方式以及 Linux/NAS 环境的兼容性。

一、运行环境
我的环境：

设备：Synology 群晖 NAS
CPU 架构：Linux x64
Node.js：v22.19.0
pnpm：v11.7.0
部署方式：源码部署
项目目录：

/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness


二、最开始误用了 pnpm.mjs
最初尝试：
node pnpm.mjs install
结果：
Error: Cannot find module '/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness/pnpm.mjs'

随后检查：
which pnpm
pnpm -v
得到：
/bin/pnpm
11.7.0

因此改为直接使用：
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
安装成功。

三、Workspace 安装
安装过程中出现了以下警告：
Unsupported platform:
wanted: {"cpu":["arm64"],"os":["linux"],"libc":["any"]}
current: {"os":"linux","cpu":"x64","libc":"glibc"}

对应：
native/landlock-run/packages/linux-arm64

此外还有一些 workspace cyclic dependency 警告。
不过 lockfile 校验正常，依赖安装最终成功。
之后手动重新构建了几个 native dependency：
pnpm rebuild node-pty
pnpm rebuild koffi
pnpm rebuild esbuild
然后：
pnpm install
显示：
Already up to date


四、dsh CLI 本身可以正常运行
在项目目录中：
pnpm dsh --help
能够正常得到：
Usage: dsh [options] [command] [args...]

dsh: boot a DeepSeek Harness profile...

Commands:
  web [options] [args...]     boot the web profile
  plugin [options] [args...]  manage a profile's plugins

因此可以确认：
源码、TypeScript、tsx、CLI 入口以及基础 workspace 环境都是正常的。

五、尝试将 dsh 安装成系统命令
我的目标是希望以后无论当前在哪个目录，都可以直接：
dsh
而不需要：
cd /volume1/docker/deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh
于是创建：
/usr/local/bin/dsh

最开始遇到了权限问题：
Permission denied

原因是文件权限为：
-rwx------ 1 root root

修改为：
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/dsh
之后权限问题解决。

六、tsx 的解析问题
最开始尝试让 /usr/local/bin/dsh 直接执行：
node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts
从项目目录运行没问题，但是从用户 Home 目录执行时：
cd ~
dsh web
出现：
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package 'tsx'

后来发现，关键在于：
tsx 是通过 pnpm workspace 环境解析的，不应该假设它一定存在于：
/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness/node_modules/tsx/esm.mjs

实际上 pnpm 的依赖结构位于 .pnpm 中。
因此直接硬编码：
/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness/node_modules/tsx/esm.mjs

并不是可靠的方式。
最终发现最稳定的方法是直接调用项目自身已经定义好的：
pnpm dsh

七、dsh web 最初出现 workspace package 找不到
执行：
dsh web
最开始出现：
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]:

Cannot find package
'@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse'

但是这个 package 实际上是存在的：
packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse

检查：
cat packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse/package.json
其中：
"name": "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse"
而且：
packages/host/directory-picker-auto/package.json

中也正确声明了：
"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse": "workspace:^"
通过：
pnpm list -r --depth -1 | grep -E "directory-picker|ui-directory"
也可以看到：
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse@0.1.0-rc.7

并且：
packages/host/directory-picker-auto/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/

中存在对应 symlink。
我进一步直接测试：
node -e "import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse').then(()=>console.log('PACKAGE OK')).catch(e=>console.error(e))"
结果：
PACKAGE OK

说明 package 本身没有问题，主要是当时 root/workspace 的依赖链接状态存在问题。

八、重新创建 workspace links
之后重新执行：
pnpm install --force --offline --shamefully-hoist
这次 root node_modules 中出现了正确的 workspace links，例如：
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse
    -> ../../packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse

再次验证：
node -e "import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse').then(()=>console.log('ROOT PACKAGE OK')).catch(e=>console.error(e))"
得到：
ROOT PACKAGE OK

于是这个问题解决。
不过需要特别说明：
这次 pnpm install --force --offline --shamefully-hoist 在安装 native packages 时最终出现了：
Segmentation fault (core dumped)

所以我不建议把这个命令作为官方推荐的安装方法。
它只是碰巧恢复了当前环境下的 workspace links。

九、之后发现 HMR 需要 --expose-internals
workspace package 问题解决后，再运行：
dsh web
已经能够进入 Web 启动阶段，并输出：
dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080

这说明 Web profile 已经开始启动。
但是随后报错：
Error: --expose-internals is required for HMR service

完整错误来自：
@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr

也就是说当前 Web/HMR 服务要求 Node.js 使用：
--expose-internals


十、最终解决方式
最终我将系统级 /usr/local/bin/dsh 设置为：
#!/bin/sh

DSH_ROOT="/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness"

cd "$DSH_ROOT" || exit 1

export NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:+$NODE_OPTIONS }--expose-internals"

exec pnpm dsh "$@"
然后：
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/dsh
这样无论当前在哪个目录：
cd ~
都可以直接：
dsh web
最终成功启动。

十一、当前运行状态
现在已经可以正常运行：
dsh web
并得到：
dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080

也就是说，目前：

Node.js 正常
pnpm 正常
workspace 正常
TypeScript/tsx 正常
CLI 正常
workspace package resolution 正常
HMR 正常
Web profile 正常启动

DeepSeek Harness 已经成功运行在我的群晖 NAS 上。

十二、对官方文档/项目的几点建议
1. 建议增加 Linux/NAS 源码部署文档
目前如果是在普通 Linux 开发机上可能比较容易，但 Synology NAS 这种环境会涉及：

pnpm workspace
native dependencies
CPU architecture
Node.js
HMR
文件权限
后台运行

建议增加一个 Linux/NAS 部署章节。

2. 建议明确说明 tsx 的解析方式
项目目前：
"dsh": "node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts"
在 workspace 环境中是可以工作的。
但用户不应该假设：
node_modules/tsx/esm.mjs

一定存在。
特别是 pnpm 环境下，直接硬编码：
node_modules/tsx/esm.mjs

容易导致：
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND


3. 建议考虑 CLI 自动处理 --expose-internals
当前：
dsh web
实际需要：
--expose-internals

才能启动 HMR。
如果这是 Web profile 的固定要求，我认为可以考虑：

在 CLI 内部自动设置；
或者在 dsh web 的启动逻辑中自动加入；
或者在文档中明确说明。

这样用户不需要自行设置：
NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-internals

4. 建议改善 workspace package resolution 的错误提示
例如：
Cannot find package
'@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse'

但实际上：
packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse

存在，并且：
workspace:^

也正确配置。
对于这种情况，如果 CLI 能够提示：
Workspace package exists but is not linked/resolvable.
Try `pnpm install`.

会比单纯的 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND 更容易排查。

5. 建议增加 NAS 网络访问说明
目前默认：
http://127.0.0.1:3080

只能从 NAS 本机访问。
如果希望：
Windows PC
Android
iPhone
局域网其他设备

访问 NAS 上运行的 DeepSeek Harness，需要配置监听：
0.0.0.0:3080

建议官方文档增加：
“如何在服务器/NAS 上开放 Web 服务供局域网访问” 的说明。

十三、最终结论
经过排查，我最终采用的方式是：
Synology NAS
      │
      ▼
Node.js 22.19.0
      │
      ▼
pnpm 11.7.0
      │
      ▼
DeepSeek Harness workspace
      │
      ▼
/usr/local/bin/dsh
      │
      ├── cd /volume1/docker/deepseek-harness
      │
      ├── NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-internals
      │
      └── pnpm dsh "$@"
                │
                ▼
        apps/cli/src/bin.ts
                │
                ▼
             dsh web
                │
                ▼
       http://127.0.0.1:3080

目前已经可以稳定启动。
希望这些信息能够帮助官方进一步完善 Linux / Synology NAS / pnpm workspace 场景下的安装和部署体验。
感谢团队维护这个项目！

threads.title: # Bug report: `pnpm run build` fails with `SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token` when pnpm is installed via mise
threads.bodyText:
Bug report: pnpm run build fails with SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token when pnpm is installed via mise
Summary
scripts/build.ts assumes process.env.npm_execpath is a Node.js script path and feeds it to node (spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script])). When pnpm is installed via mise (or any native installer), npm_execpath points to a native Windows executable (pnpm.exe), so node tries to parse the PE binary as JavaScript and fails with SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token.
Environment

OS: Windows 10/11 (zh-CN)
Node: v24.19.0
pnpm: 11.7.0 (installed via mise)
dsh: 0.1.0-rc.8
Package manager install method: mise (mise installs\pnpm\11.7.0\pnpm.exe, a ~98 MB native executable - no .cjs/.js variant present)

Repro
cd D:\data\code\deepseek-harness
pnpm run build
Observed output (abridged):
$ tsx scripts/build.ts
C:\Users\root\AppData\Local\mise\installs\pnpm\11.7.0\pnpm.exe:1
MZx@x...This program cannot be run in DOS mode.$PEd...
SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token

The direct equivalent of what build.ts does:
node "C:\Users\root\AppData\Local\mise\installs\pnpm\11.7.0\pnpm.exe" run build:lib
fails identically, confirming the root cause.
Root cause
scripts/build.ts (runScript):
const packageManager = process.env.npm_execpath
// ...
const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], { ... })

process.execPath -> node.exe
process.env.npm_execpath -> ...\pnpm\11.7.0\pnpm.exe (a native PE executable)

So the actual command executed is node "pnpm.exe" run build:lib, and node parses the PE header as source -> SyntaxError.
This works only when npm_execpath points to a JS/CJS launcher (e.g. npm's own npm-cli.js, or pnpm installed as .cjs via npm i -g pnpm). It breaks for package managers installed as native executables (mise, volta, scoop, etc.).
Suggested fix
In scripts/build.ts, detect whether npm_execpath is a native executable and spawn it directly instead of via node:
const result = /\.exe$/i.test(packageManager)
  ? spawnSync(packageManager, ['run', script], { cwd, env: environment, stdio: 'inherit' })
  : spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], { cwd, env: environment, stdio: 'inherit' })
This preserves the existing behavior for JS launchers and fixes native binaries (Windows .exe; also consider /.(exe|cmd|bat)$/i or a more portable check). Alternatively, resolve the underlying JS entry of the package manager (e.g. via require.resolve), but the extension check is the minimal, robust fix.
Notes (possibly related)

pnpm --version in the repo root also warns: "The 'workspaces' field in package.json is not supported by pnpm. Create a 'pnpm-workspace.yaml' file instead." - the repo does have pnpm-workspace.yaml (confirmed present), so this warning may be a separate pnpm/mise quirk worth a look.

threads.title: 2026/8/20 从远程分支同步了代码 之后启动一直卡在加载插件页面怎么解决
Configuring Bailian Token Plan via custom provider silently breaks: schema rejection, missing `developer` compat, and unintuitive `models` replacement semantics
threads.bodyText:
Environment

DSH Desktop: 2.0.1
Harness: 0.1.0-rc.7
pi-ai: bundled with desktop
Provider endpoint: https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 (Bailian Token Plan CN)
OS: Windows

Summary
When a user manually configures the Bailian Token Plan endpoint as a custom provider (instead of using the built-in qwen-token-plan-cn catalog route), they encounter three cascading failures that are extremely difficult to diagnose:

Reasoning effort selector does not appear for any model
developer role 400 error from the Bailian API
"API key is invalid" after attempting to fix #2 by adding compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false at the route level

All three stem from configuration-layer UX issues in dsh-llm-pi-ai, not from the Bailian API itself. The built-in qwen-token-plan-cn catalog route handles all of these correctly, but there is no GUI guidance to use it.
Detailed Reproduction
Step 1: User adds Bailian as a custom provider
This is the natural first approach — the GUI offers "Add Custom Provider" but does not surface the built-in qwen-token-plan-cn catalog route:
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    aibaba:
      displayName: Bailian
      apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://token-plan.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
      models:
        - id: qwen3.7-max
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
        # ... more models
Result: No reasoning effort selector appears for any model. The models work for basic chat, but reasoning capability is invisible.
Root cause: Hand-declared models have no reasoning metadata. The settings-models UI deliberately does not expose reasoningEfforts editing (source comment: "There is deliberately no reasoning-effort control, here or on the editor"). Without reasoningEfforts, resolveModelReasoning returns {reasoning: false} → reasoningInfo() returns {} → UI hides the selector.
Step 2: User encounters developer role 400 error
After extended multi-turn usage, requests fail with:
400 {"error":{"code":"invalid_parameter_error","message":"developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']"}}

Root cause: detectCompat() in openai-completions.js defaults supportsDeveloperRole: true for the Bailian URL (it's not in the isNonStandard list). The built-in catalog explicitly sets supportsDeveloperRole: false for every Bailian model, but hand-declared routes lose this metadata. When model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole evaluates to true, DSH sends role: "developer" which Bailian rejects.
Step 3: User tries to fix it and makes things worse
Attempting to add compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false at the route level:
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  displayName: Bailian
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
  compat:
    supportsDeveloperRole: false   # ← NOT in compatProfile schema
  models:
    - id: wan2.7-image
    # ...
Result: The entire llm-pi-ai provider section fails schema validation silently. The route is never registered. Subsequent requests fail with "API key is invalid" or "no adapter registered for provider qwen-token-plan-cn" — neither of which points to the actual cause (schema rejection).
Root cause: compatProfile only accepts thinkingFormat and supportsReasoningEffort. Writing any other field causes assertServiceable → resolveProfiles to throw. The onChange handler catches this and logs "keeping the previously registered routes after a refused update", but the user sees only the downstream symptom ("API key is invalid"), not the validation failure.
What Works (But Is Undiscoverable)
The built-in qwen-token-plan-cn catalog route handles everything correctly with just:
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  displayName: Bailian
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
No api, baseURL, models, or compat needed. All ~15 text models inherit correct reasoning metadata, supportsDeveloperRole: false, and DeepSeek's requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages: true.
But there is no way for a user to discover this without reading source code.
Structural Limitation: models Replacement Semantics
Writing a models list on a catalog route completely replaces the built-in catalog (line 1139 of dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js):
const entries = configured.length > 0 ? configured : [...defaults.values()].map(...)
This means users cannot supplement the built-in catalog with additional models (e.g., image/audio models not in the catalog). They must choose between:

Full built-in catalog (correct compat, but no custom models)
Custom model list (loses all built-in metadata including critical compat flags)

There is no merge mode.
Suggested Improvements
1. Surface built-in catalog providers in the GUI
Add a "Use Built-in Provider" option in the Models settings page that lists available catalog routes (qwen-token-plan-cn, deepseek, etc.) alongside the manual "Add Custom Provider" flow. This would prevent users from ever needing to hand-configure endpoints that already have full catalog support.
2. Provide explicit errors on schema validation failure
When assertServiceable / resolveProfiles throws during onChange, the error should be surfaced to the user (toast notification, settings page banner, or at minimum a prominent log entry) rather than silently falling back to previous routes. The current behavior — logging "keeping the previously registered routes after a refused update" to the error log while the user sees an unrelated "API key is invalid" — makes diagnosis nearly impossible.
Specifically, when compatProfile rejects an unknown field like supportsDeveloperRole, the error message should name the invalid field and suggest valid alternatives.
3. Consider a models merge mode for catalog routes
Allow catalog routes to declare additional models without replacing the entire catalog. For example:
qwen-token-plan-cn:
  apiKeyEnv: AIBABA_API_KEY
  extraModels:           # merge instead of replace
    - id: wan2.7-image
    - id: qwen-audio-3.0-tts-plus
Or alternatively, allow per-model compat overrides on catalog routes so users can fix individual fields without losing the rest of the catalog metadata.
4. Document the compatProfile schema boundary
The fact that only thinkingFormat and supportsReasoningEffort are user-configurable compat fields is not documented anywhere visible to users. The other dozen+ compat fields (supportsDeveloperRole, requiresReasoningContentOnAssistantMessages, supportsStore, etc.) are internal-only but look like reasonable configuration options. A docs page or inline schema description listing allowed fields would prevent silent misconfiguration.
Impact
These issues affect any user who configures a provider endpoint that happens to have built-in catalog support but doesn't know to use the catalog route name. The Bailian Token Plan case is particularly painful because:

The endpoint is widely used in China
The developer role error only manifests after multi-turn usage (not on first request)
The attempted fix (adding supportsDeveloperRole) triggers a completely different failure mode
The error messages at each stage point in wrong directions

I've written a detailed troubleshooting guide based on my debugging experience that I'd be happy to contribute as documentation if helpful.

threads.title: pnpm run build fails with "SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token" when pnpm is installed via get.pnpm.io/install.sh
threads.bodyText:
Summary
pnpm run build fails immediately at build:lib with SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token when pnpm is installed via the official standalone installer (curl -fsSL https://get.pnpm.io/install.sh | sh -).
Environment

OS: Linux (aarch64)
Node.js: v24.16.0
pnpm: 11.7.0 (installed via get.pnpm.io/install.sh, standalone @pnpm/exe binary)
deepseek-harness: v0.1.0-rc.8

Steps to reproduce

Install pnpm via the official script: curl -fsSL https://get.pnpm.io/install.sh | sh -
pnpm install
pnpm run build

Actual result
$ pnpm run build
> tsx scripts/build.ts
file:///data/.pnpm-store/v11/links/@pnpm/exe/11.7.0/.../node_modules/@pnpm/exe/pnpm:1
ELF...
SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token
...
Error: build: build:lib exited with 1

Root cause
scripts/build.ts re-invokes the package manager like this:
const packageManager = process.env.npm_execpath
spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], ...)
i.e. it runs node <npm_execpath> run build:lib. This assumes npm_execpath points to a Node-runnable JS entrypoint (npm-cli.js / pnpm.cjs). The official get.pnpm.io/install.sh installs pnpm as a standalone native executable (@pnpm/exe), so npm_execpath points to an ELF binary and node fails to parse it.
The same node <npm_execpath> pattern also appears in scripts/run-gates.ts, scripts/run-web-snapshots.ts, and scripts/run-coverage-partitions.ts, so pnpm run check:* is likely affected too.
It does not reproduce in CI because pnpm/action-setup@v4 installs pnpm via npm by default (standalone: false), which yields the pnpm.cjs JS entrypoint.
Suggested fix
In these scripts, spawn npm_execpath directly when it is a native executable, and only use node <npm_execpath> for JS entrypoints (.js / .cjs / .mjs).

threads.title: 疑似：prepare 抛错后不写 tool/result，会话历史残留未配对的 tool_calls，之后每轮都被上游 400 拒绝
threads.bodyText:
现象：某个会话在某一轮工具调用时报错，之后每次发消息都失败。底层错误是 DeepSeek API 返回的 400：
An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)

环境：Windows 10，dsh 0.1.0-rc.7，deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash。
出问题的那一轮事件序列：
assistant/message   # tool-call：pwsh Get-Content 读日志
tool/call
step/end
turn/end             # reason:{kind:"error", error:{message:"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')", code:"UNKNOWN"}}

tool/call 写了，没有 tool/result。全会话这是唯一一次缺配对的（session.history 拉全量统计）。这轮之后每次发消息都 400。
怀疑在 dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js 的 startCall：
callSeqs[index] = appendToolCall(session, turn, step, call.block);   // 先写 tool/call
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec);  // 这里抛错
TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER 是 Symbol。ctx.tools[Symbol] 为 undefined 时 .prepare 抛的 TypeError，和 turn/end 的错误逐字一致。appendToolResult 是唯一写 tool/result 的地方，抛错路径没有兜底，残缺序列留在历史里，之后每轮都原样发给上游被 400。
我环境里触发原因是 dsh-tools 双副本（Symbol 不匹配，推断）。profile 里 dsh-tools 的 junction 建于 8/19 22:49，出事在 22:46，junction 建好后新会话正常。这条是环境问题，干净环境不一定会出现；但不管触发原因是什么，prepare 抛错不写 result 都会把会话弄坏，这个跟环境无关。
复现：curl 构造同样残缺的序列打 DeepSeek API 返回逐字相同的 400，佐证 400 是上游校验。dsh 侧未稳定复现，也没抓实际请求体。
建议：

startCall 里 appendToolCall 之后用 try/catch 兜住，抛错时补一条 tool_call_id 对应、content 为错误描述的 tool/result；若回滚 tool/call，必须连带去掉 assistant 消息里的 tool_calls 声明。
构造请求时发现未配对的 tool_calls，丢弃整条 assistant 消息并连带后面配对的 tool 消息，用于恢复已污染的旧会话。

如需更多信息（完整事件流、会话文件）：2632530353@qq.com

threads.title: 长 SVG/HTML 输出后 Web UI 输入框消失并持续“深潜”
threads.bodyText:
长 SVG/HTML 内容与连续文件写入后，当前会话底部输入框消失，任务长时间停在“深潜”状态，用户无法继续输入或明显地停止生成。

复现、预期与验收

复现步骤：

在 macOS 上运行 pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8 web。
在 Web UI 新建会话，使用代码/PTC 类 Agent 预设，让 Agent 生成一张复杂的 SVG/HTML 图片。
Agent 在聊天正文中输出很长的内联 SVG/HTML 源码。
用户继续追问“图片在哪”。
Agent 调用写文件工具，写入 dragon-restaurant.svg 和 dragon-restaurant.html。
页面停留在“深潜…… 1分01秒”状态；长 SVG/HTML 把消息区域撑得很长，底部 composer 输入框及明显的停止按钮在当前视口中消失。


实际结果：

会话在“深潜”状态持续很久，输入框不可见，用户无法继续输入。
超长 SVG/HTML 以原始文本铺满消息区域，没有折叠或独立滚动，导致布局被撑开。
刷新或新建会话后输入框恢复；模型后端本身可正常回答，因此更像 Web UI 会话状态/布局问题。


预期结果：

composer 应固定在会话底部并始终可见。
运行期间应始终显示可见的“停止生成”按钮。
超长代码块应折叠、限制高度或在内部滚动，不能把输入区挤出视口。
工具调用完成或失败后，会话应可靠地结束运行状态。


环境：

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.8（npm next；当前 latest 为 0.1.0-rc.7）
macOS 26.5.2，Apple Silicon
Google Chrome 151.0.7922.169
Node.js v22.23.1
pnpm 10.33.2
本地 Web UI：http://127.0.0.1:3080
模型路由：Google Vertex / Gemini 3.7 Flash（后端已单独验证可正常响应）


验收条件：

使用同样的长 SVG/HTML 输出与文件写入流程时，输入框保持可见。
运行中可随时停止；运行结束后 composer 自动恢复。
长代码不会破坏聊天区布局。

threads.title: 【构建兼容性问题】pnpm 11 下执行 build 失败，npm_execpath 被错误地作为 Node 脚本执行
threads.bodyText:
问题描述
在使用 pnpm 11.7.0 和 Node.js 24.19.0 从源码构建 deepseek-harness 时，执行：
pnpm install
pnpm run build
构建失败。
环境：

操作系统：WSL2 Ubuntu Linux
Node.js：v24.19.0
pnpm：v11.7.0
架构：linux x64

错误信息：
SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token

file:///home/.../.local/share/pnpm/store/v11/links/@pnpm/exe/11.7.0/.../node_modules/@pnpm/exe/pnpm:1

ELF>


问题原因分析
问题应该出现在：
scripts/build.ts
中的代码：
const packageManager = process.env.npm_execpath

const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], {
这里假设 npm_execpath 指向的是一个 JavaScript 文件。
但是在 pnpm 11 中：
npm_execpath

可能指向：
.../node_modules/@pnpm/exe/pnpm

这个文件是 Linux ELF 可执行文件，而不是 JavaScript 文件。
当前代码实际执行：
node /path/to/pnpm run build:lib
于是 Node.js 会尝试解析 pnpm 二进制文件：
ELF>

最终导致：
SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token


补充说明
这个问题在旧版本 npm/pnpm 布局下可能不会出现，因为：

某些版本的 npm_execpath 指向 .js 文件；
旧版本 pnpm 可能使用 JavaScript launcher。

但是 pnpm 11 使用了 @pnpm/exe 二进制入口，因此不能再假设 npm_execpath 可以通过 Node 执行。
建议后续避免依赖 npm_execpath 是 Node 脚本这一假设，直接执行 package manager 可提高兼容性。

threads.title: "Add workspace" does nothing when dsh web runs as a service reached only via SSH tunnel — the directory-picker resolver mounts an OS chooser on the unreachable server display
threads.bodyText:
Scenario
dsh web running as a systemctl --user service on a remote Linux desktop, reached exclusively through ssh -L 3080:localhost:3080 (never an interactive SSH login shell into that box — just a local port-forward to the already-running service). The remote desktop session is real and has a live DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY, but nobody is sitting at it; every operator interacts through the tunneled browser only.
Clicking Add Workspace in the web GUI did nothing at all: no dialog, no error, no network activity visible in the browser. It looked like a dead button.
Root cause
packages/host/directory-picker-auto's resolveDirectoryPickerBackend infers whether the operator is "local" from boot-time process facts: bind host, SSH_CONNECTION/SSH_TTY, and (on Linux) DISPLAY/WAYLAND_DISPLAY plus a chooser binary on PATH.
For our systemd unit:

Bind host is loopback (127.0.0.1) ✓ eligible for native
SSH_CONNECTION/SSH_TTY are absent — these only exist in an interactive SSH login shell's environment. A systemctl --user service is spawned by the systemd user manager itself, never through an SSH shell, regardless of how an operator actually reaches it later via a tunnel.
DISPLAY=:0 / WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-0 are present — carried from the desktop session the unit inherited at registration.
zenity is on PATH ✓

So the resolver reads "loopback + no SSH markers + live DISPLAY + chooser available" as "attended local desktop" and mounts the native backend. In reality, every real operator reaches this service exclusively through the SSH tunnel and never sees the server's own display. Clicking "Add workspace" spawned zenity --file-selection --directory as a child of the systemd unit, popped a picker window on the server's own :0 display — completely invisible over the tunnel — and the browser just sat there waiting for an RPC response that would never come until the dialog was dismissed (by nobody).
This is a real, fully reproducible bug for a fairly common deployment pattern: any dsh web instance run as a systemd/supervisor-managed service and accessed only through a tunnel, VPN, or reverse proxy that never touches the server process's own environment.
Compounding it: on a stale/dead display (a DISPLAY baked into a unit from a since-closed session), the Linux native picker's exit-code handling made things worse — zenity/kdialog exiting 1 because they can't reach any display was indistinguishable from the user clicking Cancel, so even a broken display session produced silent, feedback-free failure instead of a diagnosable error.
Fix (already written, tested, and merged to our fork)
We wrote and merged two fixes to SmartAI/deepseek-harness master (a fork tracking deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness at parity as of this writing) — commits b3e1412b and d32e5526:

DSH_DIRECTORY_PICKER_BACKEND=native|browse — a new environment variable resolveDirectoryPickerBackend checks before any inferred signal. Set once on the unit/supervisor definition, it lets an operator who knows their own topology (service-managed, tunnel-only access) force browse (the in-app, protocol-served picker) without touching the app's plugin composition. Unset/blank/unrecognized falls through to the existing inference unchanged — deliberately not auto-detected via e.g. INVOCATION_ID, because systemctl --user services are equally common for genuinely attended desktop autostart, so treating "under systemd" as proof of "unattended" would regress that legitimate case.
Linux native-picker display-failure detection — pickNativeDirectory's Linux branch now inspects stderr for known GTK/Qt display-connection markers before mapping exit code 1 to a cancelled pick. A real display failure now rethrows and reaches the client's error surface instead of masquerading as Cancel; a genuine Cancel click (empty stderr) is unaffected.

Both are covered by new unit tests (resolver: 12 new cases including the exact systemd+SSH-tunnel scenario; native picker: stderr-marker detection for zenity/kdialog, single- and multi-line, no-fallback-on-display-failure), full repo typecheck, and lint, all green before merge.
Applied to our own deployment: setting DSH_DIRECTORY_PICKER_BACKEND=browse on the systemd unit's Environment= immediately fixed it — "Add workspace" now opens the in-app directory browser, driven entirely over the web protocol, working correctly through the SSH tunnel.
Happy to open a PR against this branch if that's useful, understanding external PRs aren't being accepted right now — otherwise, hopefully this saves someone else the same debugging session, and a maintainer is welcome to cherry-pick.
Minor secondary finding (documentation gap, not a functional bug)
While chasing the above, we found that packages/host/directory-picker-auto's own README suggestion — "Mount -native or -browse directly in an overlay to pin the interaction" — reads naturally as a same-id cordis.patch.yml override ({ id: directory-picker, name: '...-browse' }), but that silently no-ops: applyEntryPatches in vendor/include/src/index.ts skips any patch whose name differs from the target row's current name, with only a warn() — no thrown error, no failed boot. The working form is disabled: true on the old row plus a fresh insert: under a new id. This cost real debugging time on our side (patch parsed fine, profile installed fine, service restarted fine — the only trace was a warn buried in journal output). Worth a doc fix in that README (and anywhere else the same "pin via overlay" pattern is suggested) showing the correct disable+insert shape; a hard-error-on-name-mismatch is a possible but higher-risk alternative given applyEntryPatches' own "a typo must never fail the boot" design goal.

通过环境变量 NODE_OPTIONS 提高 Node.js 的内存上限：
NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web

确保系统可用物理内存大于设定的内存值
可全局安装 npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh 后直接运行 dsh web，避免 npx 的额外开销

Problem Description
When executing npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web to start the DeepSeek local tool, a fatal JavaScript heap out of memory error occurs. The tool's memory usage exceeds Node.js's default heap memory limit (~2GB) during startup, causing the process to crash with an IOT instruction (core dumped) error.
Root Cause
The @deepseek-ai/dsh tool requires substantial memory resources when loading dependencies and initializing the web service, exceeding Node.js's default --max-old-space-size limit (typically 2048 MB).
Solution
Increase Node.js's memory limit using the NODE_OPTIONS environment variable:
NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=4096" npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
This command extends the heap memory limit to 4GB, which is sufficient for the tool's startup and runtime requirements. If more memory is needed, change 4096 to 8192 (8GB).
Notes

Ensure your system has available physical memory greater than the set limit
Consider global installation npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh and run dsh web directly to avoid npx overhead
If memory is still insufficient, close other memory-intensive applications and retry

threads.title: BUG: 超出工作区（Windows·SMB映射驱动器）File operations judged as "out of workspace"
threads.bodyText:
DSH 问题报告（Windows · SMB 映射驱动器）：对当前工作区路径操作被判定为“超出工作区”
一、问题概述
在 Windows 上以网络共享（映射驱动器）路径创建 DSH 项目工作区后，在对当前工作区内的路径执行文件操作（读写/编辑等）时，被判定为“超出工作区”（out of workspace / 越界），导致操作被拒。
用户提供的是映射驱动器路径（如 Z:\...），DSH 内部将工作区解析为 UNC 路径（\\<server>\<share>\...），随后沙箱在对工作区边界进行判断时，对这两种路径形态的判断结果不一致，从而误判当前路径越界。
二、环境

操作系统：Windows（process.platform === 'win32'）
文件服务：NAS 网络共享（SMB），映射盘 Z: → \\<server>\<share>
DSH 版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.7（npm 安装）

三、根因分析
对本地安装的 DSH 源码（node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-*）排查，问题与工作区路径的规范化方式有关。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local/lib/index.js 的 resolveLocalTarget() 使用 node:fs/promises 的 realpath() 解析路径：
// dsh-fs-local/lib/index.js
async function resolveLocalTarget(cwd, path) {
  const displayPath = resolve(cwd, path);
  // ...
  targetKey: FsTargetKey(await realpath(displayPath))
}
在 Windows 上，对映射盘（Z:\...）执行 realpath() 会得到其底层 UNC 规范路径（\\<server>\<share>\...）。当工作区根被规范化为 UNC，而某些操作/路径仍以盘符（Z:\...）形态出现时，沙箱的“工作区包含/边界”判断（如 dsh-fs-local 的 contains() 等）在两种形态之间比较可能出现不一致，从而把工作区内的路径误判为越界（超出工作区）。
说明：以上为基于本地源码的初步定位，最终以上报后维护团队确认的根因为准。
四、影响与一连串后果
该问题会引发一连串连锁后果，具体如下：

核心问题：对当前工作区内的路径执行文件操作（读写/编辑等）被判定为“超出工作区”而被拒绝，正常作业无法进行。
路径形态不一致导致误判：同样的路径，以盘符（Z:\...）和以 UNC（\\<server>\<share>\...）两种形态出现时，工作区边界判断结果不一致，造成“明明在工作区内却报越界”的困惑。
交互/界面受影响：工作区根被规范化为 UNC 后，依赖该路径的界面展示与操作出现异常，文件夹/路径显示不稳定。
第三方插件连锁表现：部分第三方文件浏览插件（如 Better Sidebar）因其自身的绝对路径判断规则（POSIX 语义，只认 / 开头的路径）不识别 UNC，会把工作区路径报为“not an absolute path”。此为上述问题的连锁表现，属第三方插件行为，并非官方 DSH 的功能缺陷，仅用于说明问题影响范围。

五、建议修复方向（供参考）

统一 Windows 工作区路径的形态：将工作区根与操作路径统一规范化为同一形态（盘符或 UNC）后再做“包含/边界”比较，避免盘符与 UNC 混用导致误判。
在 Windows 上使工作区根与 realpath 结果保持一致，使边界判断与用户所提供路径形态一致。

六、复现步骤（供维护者复现）

在 Windows 上把网络共享映射为盘符（例如 net use Z: \\<server>\<share>）。
用该盘符路径（Z:\<项目>\<子目录>）创建/打开一个 DSH 项目工作区。
对当前工作区内的路径执行文件操作。
观察：操作被判定为“超出工作区”（out of workspace）而被拒绝；并观察由此引发的上述一连串后果。


DSH Issue Report (Windows · SMB mapped drive): File operations on paths inside the current workspace are judged as "out of workspace"
1. Problem Summary
On Windows, after creating a DSH project workspace using a network-share (mapped drive) path, file operations (read/write/edit, etc.) on paths inside the current workspace are judged as "out of workspace" and rejected.
The user provides a mapped-drive path (e.g. Z:\...); DSH internally resolves the workspace to a UNC path (\\<server>\<share>\...). When the sandbox later checks the workspace boundary, it evaluates the two path forms (drive letter vs UNC) inconsistently, so a path inside the workspace is misjudged as out of bounds.
2. Environment

OS: Windows (process.platform === 'win32')
Storage: NAS network share (SMB), mapped drive Z: → \\<server>\<share>
DSH version: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.7 (installed via npm)

3. Root Cause Analysis
After inspecting the locally installed DSH source (node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-*), the issue relates to how the workspace path is canonicalized.
resolveLocalTarget() in @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local/lib/index.js resolves paths with realpath() from node:fs/promises:
// dsh-fs-local/lib/index.js
async function resolveLocalTarget(cwd, path) {
  const displayPath = resolve(cwd, path);
  // ...
  targetKey: FsTargetKey(await realpath(displayPath))
}
On Windows, calling realpath() on a mapped drive (Z:\...) returns its underlying canonical UNC path (\\<server>\<share>\...). When the workspace root is canonicalized to UNC but some operations/paths still appear in drive-letter form (Z:\...), the sandbox's "workspace containment/boundary" checks (e.g. contains() in dsh-fs-local) may compare the two forms inconsistently, misjudging an in-workspace path as out of bounds.
Note: the above is a preliminary localization based on local source; the root cause confirmed by the maintainers after escalation takes precedence.
4. Impact and Chain of Consequences
This issue triggers a chain of consequences, as follows:

Core issue: File operations (read/write/edit, etc.) on paths inside the current workspace are judged as "out of workspace" and rejected, blocking normal work.
Inconsistent path-form checks cause misjudgment: The same path, when appearing in drive-letter form (Z:\...) versus UNC form (\\<server>\<share>\...), yields inconsistent workspace-boundary results, causing confusion ("why is an in-workspace path reported as out of bounds").
UI/interaction affected: Once the workspace root is canonicalized to UNC, interface display and operations that depend on that path behave abnormally; folder/path display becomes unstable.
Third-party plugin knock-on: Some third-party file-browsing plugins (e.g. Better Sidebar) use their own absolute-path rules (POSIX semantics, only accepting paths starting with /) and therefore do not recognize UNC, reporting the workspace path as "not an absolute path". This is a knock-on effect of the above issue and is third-party plugin behavior — it is not an official DSH functionality defect, and is mentioned only to illustrate the extent of the impact.

5. Suggested Fix (for reference)

Unify the Windows workspace path form: normalize both the workspace root and the operation path to the same form (drive letter or UNC) before performing "containment/boundary" comparisons, to avoid mismatches caused by mixing drive-letter and UNC forms.
Keep the workspace root and the realpath result consistent on Windows, so the boundary check matches the path form the user provided.

6. Reproduction Steps (for maintainers)

On Windows, map a network share to a drive letter (e.g. net use Z: \\<server>\<share>).
Create/open a DSH project workspace using that drive-letter path (Z:\<project>\<subdir>).
Perform a file operation on a path inside the current workspace.
Observe: the operation is judged as "out of workspace" and rejected; and observe the chain of consequences triggered as described above.

threads.title: Web UI: Show in Folder button opens workspace root instead of produced files directory
Build fails when using standalone pnpm binary (`@pnpm/exe`) due to `npm_execpath` being executed with Node
threads.bodyText:
Describe the bug
When building the project using a standalone pnpm binary (the @pnpm/exe distribution, installed as a native executable), the build script fails with a SyntaxError. The error originates from scripts/build.ts where runScript() assumes that process.env.npm_execpath points to a JavaScript file and executes it with Node.
To Reproduce

Install pnpm using the standalone binary distribution (@pnpm/exe), e.g. via pnpm add -g @pnpm/exe or by downloading the native executable.
Run pnpm run build (or the equivalent script that triggers scripts/build.ts).
Observe the build fails with an error similar to:
SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token
    at compileSourceTextModule (node:internal/modules/esm/utils:318:16)


The exit code is 1, and the build reports build: build:lib exited with 1 (or similar).

Expected behavior
The build should succeed regardless of whether pnpm was installed as a JavaScript entry point (e.g. via npm/Corepack) or as a standalone native binary.
Actual behavior
The build fails because scripts/build.ts runs:
spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], ...)
This is equivalent to node /path/to/pnpm run build:lib. When npm_execpath points to a native executable (ELF on Linux, Mach-O on macOS, PE on Windows), Node attempts to parse the binary file as JavaScript and throws a SyntaxError.
Environment

OS: [e.g. Linux x86_64]
Node.js version: [e.g. v20.11.0]
pnpm version: 11.7.0 (standalone binary @pnpm/exe)
Installation method: standalone binary placed in ~/.local/share/pnpm/bin/pnpm
file output of the pnpm binary: ELF 64-bit LSB executable, x86-64, ...
dsh-v0.1.0-rc.8

Root cause
The runScript() function in scripts/build.ts hardcodes the assumption that npm_execpath is a JavaScript file. This is true for pnpm installed via npm (which provides pnpm.cjs) or via Corepack (which may use a JS shim), but not for the standalone @pnpm/exe binary, which is a native executable.
Additional context
This issue is not a bug in pnpm itself—the standalone binary is a valid distribution. The build script should be flexible enough to handle both JS-based and native-executable package manager entries.

threads.title: [Upstream Issue] dsh-mcp-client 不发送 MCP roots / rootUri，codegraph MCP 默认项目指向宿主启动目录而非当前工作区
threads.bodyText:
环境

DSH（@deepseek-ai/dsh v0.1.0-rc.7），dsh-mcp-client 插件（@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js）
CodeGraph MCP server v1.5.0（stdio transport，codegraph serve --mcp）
macOS，单 DSH 实例 + 多工作区（workspace）工作流

现象
在一个 DSH 实例内切换工作区时，codegraph_explore 等工具的默认项目始终指向 DSH 宿主进程的启动目录，而不是当前会话的工作区。
实测：DSH 宿主从 ~/Documents/code/DataNex/scripts 启动（工作区为 ~/Documents/code/private-aiagentos），codegraph MCP 默认项目解析到 DataNex（Rust 项目），本项目的 .codegraph/ 索引只有显式传 projectPath 时才会被打开。
根因（源码证据）
1. dsh-mcp-client 建立连接时不声明任何 MCP capabilities，也不发送 workspace 信息：
const generation = new Client({
  name: "dsh-mcp-client",
  version: "0.0.1"
}, { capabilities: {} });   // ← 空 capabilities，不声明 roots

不发送 rootUri / workspaceFolders（initialize 参数）
不声明 capabilities.roots，因此 codegraph 不会发起 roots/list
唯一传给子进程的路径是 transport 的 cwd（config.cwd），即 DSH 宿主进程启动目录，与当前会话 workspace 无关

2. codegraph v1.5.0 的默认项目解析顺序（mcp/session.js handleInitialize + resolveRoot）：

客户端 initialize 带 rootUri → 用 fileUriToPath(rootUri)
客户端 initialize 带 workspaceFolders[0].uri → 用之
服务器启动参数 --path
客户端声明 capabilities.roots → 启动后 roots/list 拉取第一个 root
以上全部缺失 → 兜底 process.cwd() 向上找最近的 .codegraph/（findNearestCodeGraphRoot）

DSH 对 1/2/4 全部不提供（3 也由配置决定），于是永远走到第 5 条 = 宿主启动目录。
影响

多工作区单实例是 DSH 的正常用法，但 codegraph 默认项目被"钉死"在启动目录，无法跟随当前工作区；
依赖默认项目的 agent 规则（如本项目 AGENTS.md 的 codegraph-first 约定）在 DSH 下会静默查错项目；
只能靠每次调用显式传 projectPath 绕开，agent 工作流容易漏传。

期望行为
codegraph 默认项目应跟随 DSH 的当前会话 workspace：

方案 A（推荐）：dsh-mcp-client 声明 capabilities: { roots: { listChanged: false } }，并实现 roots/list 处理器返回当前 workspace root（file:// URI）；codegraph 侧已原生支持（clientSupportsRoots → roots/list 优先于 cwd）。
方案 B：连接时把当前 workspace 作为 rootUri 发送（LSP 风格，codegraph 最高优先级）。
方案 C：至少支持按会话/连接粒度注入 --path。

复现步骤

在项目 A 目录启动 DSH（cd A && dsh web），工作区切换到项目 B；
调用 codegraph_explore（不传 projectPath）；
观察返回的源码来自项目 A 而非项目 B；
lsof -p <codegraph-mcp-pid> | grep cwd 确认其 cwd = 项目 A。

建议
在 dsh-mcp-client 中补充 MCP workspace 集成：声明 roots capability 并响应 roots/list（返回当前 ctx.sessions workspace 根），使 DSH 的 workspace 概念贯通到 MCP 层。codegraph 端无需改动。
相关文件

DSH：@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js（new Client(..., { capabilities: {} })、StdioClientTransport({ cwd })）
CodeGraph v1.5.0：lib/dist/mcp/session.js（handleInitialize rootUri/workspaceFolders/--path 分支、roots/list、cwd 兜底）、lib/dist/mcp/directory.js（findNearestCodeGraphRoot）

threads.title: [BUG] git 源插件安装后 bundle 组合异常，工具层空结果致会话循环且恢复后无响应
threads.bodyText:
Summary
macOS + DSH rc.8（web profile，PM2 托管）通过 dsh plugin --profile web add 安装一个 git 源第三方插件（dsh-api-relay-audit，bundle=github:toby-bridges/api-relay-audit#00ce802）后，出现以下级联现象：

pnpm git 源安装过程出现死锁；
安装后 dsh --profile web --dump-config 的输出行数从正常值（约 658 行）骤降到 17 行，疑似 bundle 组合层异常；
会话内工具结果全部为空（tool/result 307 条均为 ok=None，无一条 ok=True）；
agent 对空结果持续重试，形成 24 轮循环（末段 11 分钟内 8 轮）；
pm2 restart 后会话恢复，但此后对每条用户消息仅返回空的 assistant/message（无内容、无工具调用），该会话无法再正常使用，只有新建会话才恢复。

Environment



Item
Value




DSH
@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8（web profile，npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web，PM2 托管）


Node.js
v26.3.1


OS
macOS (darwin-arm64)


Provider
volcengine (ark, https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3)


Model
deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731


触发插件
dsh-api-relay-audit@2.4.0（bundle=github:toby-bridges/api-relay-audit#00ce802，git 源）


会话
session-9186ec1a-d8b6-4079-a7ac-56695befaa0e（会话日志约 3.1MB）



复现链 / 证据



阶段
观察




安装
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-api-relay-audit（git 源）→ pnpm 安装死锁


bundle 组合
安装后 --dump-config 输出 17 行；卸载插件后恢复 658 行


工具结果
会话日志 tool/result 307/307 ok=None（0 条 ok=True）


循环
会话共 24 轮，末段 11 分钟内 8 轮；期间反复执行 pm2 restart、job_output 轮询、清理残留进程


恢复后
重启后对每条用户消息返回空 assistant/message，无内容、无工具调用



可能的根因（推测，请确认）

git 源插件的 bundle 注册可能影响 cordis 组合层，使 dump-config 组合树不完整，工具执行层返回空结果而非错误；
agent loop 对连续空结果缺少熔断/健康检查，持续重试形成循环；
大量空事件累积到会话上下文后，恢复时模型产出空回复，会话无法继续。

建议（供参考）

工具层：连续 N 次工具结果为空时停止重试并明确报错，而非继续循环；
会话层：恢复会话时若检测到大量异常/空事件，可自动触发已有的 compaction，或明确提示用户新建会话；
插件层：dsh plugin add（尤其 git 源）安装后校验 dump-config 组合完整性；git 源安装提供避免死锁的路径（如 tarball）。

相关讨论

#3802（第三方插件写入 session event 导致会话无法打开）
#3808（prepare 崩溃后会话永久卡死 400）
#3819（Agent 陷入 infinite bash loop）
#3797（大会话打开时 UI 看起来无回复）

threads.title: [Bug Report] 会话中断恢复后合成收尾事件与续写事件 seq 重叠，导致日志损坏、历史无法加载
threads.bodyText:
[Bug Report] 会话中断恢复后合成收尾事件与续写事件 seq 重叠，导致日志损坏、历史无法加载

提交渠道：deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness GitHub Discussions（Bug Report 分类）
提交链接：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/new
本报告由实际日志分析 + 源码定位得出，证据如下。

环境

版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 全局安装，桌面应用内嵌 dsh web 子进程）
Node：v24.19.0
平台：Windows（Electron 桌面应用）
会话日志物理格式：session.jsonl.zstd（拼接 zstd 帧：头帧 + 每批事件一帧，packChunks 打包分片行）

现象
加载某个会话历史时失败，错误信息：
history unavailable for session "session-37374e34-...": Error: corrupt session log:
seq gap in committed region at line 9551 (expected 165985, got 165983)

读端校验器（dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 的 SessionLogScanner.consumeEventLine，lib/index.js:275-300）要求每个事件的 seq 从 0 严格连续递增；发现重叠即判定日志损坏并拒绝加载。该会话因此永久无法加载历史（无自动修复路径，只能手动改日志文件）。
日志证据：两个"边界事件"是崩溃恢复合成的，不是正常写入
损坏点前后（原始 JSONL 行号）：



行
事件
seq
time




9549
reasoning-chunks（turn 6 step 1，最后一段分片）
seq0=165958，含 25 个 chunk
time0=1786886027781


9550
step/end（turn 6 step 1）
165983
1786886027971


9551
turn/end（turn 6, reason:{kind:"interrupted"}）
165984
1786886027971


9552
reasoning-chunks（同一 turn 6 step 1，同一段推理文本续写）
seq0=165983（重叠！）
time0=1786886028008


…
恢复后一直续写，seq 165983→183873，内部连续




10477
turn/end（turn 6, reason:{kind:"completed"}）
183873
1786886243823



三点吻合 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session 的 interruptedTurnClosers()（lib/types/repair.js:21-125）：

事件形状：该函数正是"先补 step/end（若 step 未关闭），再补 turn/end { reason: { kind: 'interrupted' } }"（repair.js:120-123）；
时间戳：注释明确"合成事件复用最后一个真实事件的时间戳"（repair.js:76-80）。验证：raw 9549 最后 chunk 的 time = time0(1786886027781) + Σdt(190) = 1786886027971，与两个合成事件 time 完全一致；
seq：let seq = last.seq + 1（repair.js:79），即 165983。

即：turn 6 的流被中断后，durable 日志尾部留下一个未关闭的 turn（最后真实事件 seq 165982）；某次恢复/冷加载路径（dsh-session-persistence 的 prepareCore → interruptedTurnClosers → commitRepair）检测到未关闭 turn，向文件追加了这两个合成收尾事件（seq 165983/165984）。随后同一 turn 在 37ms 后恢复续写（同一段推理文本无 user/message 隔断，最终 turn 6 completed），但续写事件的 seq 从 165983 重新开始——与文件中已有的两个事件重叠。
根因：写端两条路径的 seq 状态不同步

崩溃恢复路径只写文件、不推进内存游标：commitPrepared（dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:1019-1028）在 tornMarker/closers 非空时调用 backend.commitRepair(...) 后直接 return，没有 this.states.set / cursor 推进；commitRepair（dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1031-1035）也只做 truncate + appendLines，纯文件操作。
实时写入路径只校验内存游标：appendCore（dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:829-835）检查 event.seq !== state.cursor + i，但 state.cursor 是内存值，落后于文件已提交长度（165985），所以续写事件 165983 通过了校验。
读端校验严格、写端不严格：读端 SessionLogScanner 要求 seq 全局连续，重叠即抛错；写端只与内存游标比对，检测不到与文件的重叠。
正常情况下有防护：adoptLivePrefix（lib/index.js:1285-1302）的 seedCoversPrefix 会拒绝"live 种子不覆盖已持久化前缀"的情况——但本次流程中恢复续写未走该防护（很可能是同一进程内 live Session 未释放、写路径直接续写），故未被拦截。

影响

触发条件：会话运行中 turn 被瞬时中断（流错误/超时/内嵌 harness 重启等），随后同一 turn 恢复续写。日志尾部出现 seq 重叠 → 该会话历史永久不可加载，且无自动修复。
已损坏会话只能手动修复：删除两个合成收尾事件（step/end、turn/end interrupted）后，恢复段恰好从 seq 165983 无缝衔接，日志即恢复连续（本次修复后 183874 事件、seq 0..183873 连续、turn/step 边界平衡，内容零丢失）。

建议修复

提交修复（commitRepair）后同步推进 coordinator 的 durable cursor / 清掉陈旧 state，使后续 append 的校验基准与文件已提交长度一致；或
写端校验改为与文件已提交长度对齐（append 前读取 committed 前缀长度，或对落后事件重新编号为 committedLength + i），而不是只对内存游标做弱校验；或
拒绝续写：当 live 写路径的 next-seq 与 durable 尾部不一致时抛错（把 seedCoversPrefix 的防护扩展到 seq 对齐），而不是静默写出重叠事件。

threads.title: `pnpm run rescope-vendor:check` fails on a clean checkout of master
threads.bodyText:
pnpm run hygiene fails on a fresh clone of master because two of the EXACT_EDITS in scripts/rescope-vendor.ts anchor to text that no longer exists in the repository. Both anchors were removed by unrelated commits that did not update the edit list, and no CI mode runs this gate, so nothing caught it.
Reproduction
Fresh worktree at master (b150a551b8), fresh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, Node 24, pnpm 11.7.0:
$ pnpm run rescope-vendor:check
rescope-vendor: exact edit knip-logger-console: knip.json is neither pending nor cleanly applied (duplicated, partial, or moved)
rescope-vendor: exact edit vendoring-cookbook-name-invariant-zh: docs/cookbook/adding-a-vendored-package.zh.md is neither pending nor cleanly applied (duplicated, partial, or moved)
rescope-vendor: 2 problem(s); nothing was written.

pnpm run hygiene fails on the same gate (FAILED vendor rescope). Nothing else in the gate is wrong — pnpm run check:ci:static is 37/37 green on the same tree, which is consistent with this gate being outside CI.
Cause
knip-logger-console anchors to an ignoreDependencies block immediately followed by the "packages/util/home" key:
      "ignoreDependencies": [
        "@cordisjs/plugin-logger-console",
        "@deepseek-ai/.+"
      ]
    },
    "packages/util/home": {
50c22ee472 ("chore(knip): drop stale and glob-duplicate workspace entries") removed the packages/util/home entry from knip.json. @cordisjs/plugin-logger-console no longer appears anywhere in knip.json either, so the edit has nothing left to do — the vendored package is already rescoped to @deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-logger-console and is covered by the @deepseek-ai/.+ pattern beside it. That commit did not touch scripts/rescope-vendor.ts.
vendoring-cookbook-name-invariant-zh expects its replacement text to link ../rescope.md:
replace: '改写 `name` 的 scope（[映射](../rescope.md)），保留上游的 `version`/`exports`/`type`',
8d3674695b ("docs(i18n): localize Chinese internal links") changed the applied text in docs/cookbook/adding-a-vendored-package.zh.md to link ../rescope.zh.md, which is what the pairing contract's link-locale rule requires. The edit is substantively applied; only its replace string is stale. That commit also did not touch scripts/rescope-vendor.ts.
In both cases exactEditState sees neither find nor replace, so it reports invalid rather than pending or applied.
Why it went unnoticed
rescope-vendor:check is reachable only through hygieneLeafGates() in scripts/run-gates.ts, which is included by the hygiene and check-all modes. Neither is a CI mode — ci-static, ci-primary, and the rest never call it. So the gate runs only when a contributor invokes pnpm run hygiene locally, and both anchors could rot without any signal.
That orchestration gap may be the more interesting half of this report: a gate that no CI mode executes will drift silently, and this one is load-bearing for the vendoring workflow.
Fix
Retiring the obsolete knip-logger-console edit and pointing the zh cookbook edit at ../rescope.zh.md restores the gate:
rescope-vendor: check over 4671 tracked files
rescope-vendor: post-state verified — no residue, every exact edit landed, idempotent.

Happy to share the diff if it's useful, though I understand from CONTRIBUTING.md that external pull requests aren't being accepted right now — so this is a report rather than a patch offer. Either way, adding the gate to a CI mode would stop the next anchor from rotting.
Environment: macOS 15 (arm64), Node 24.18.0, pnpm 11.7.0, master at b150a551b8.

threads.title: [BUG] dsh-llm-pi-ai: tool_call arguments O(n²) reparse in long sessions causes 500 Upstream gateway error
threads.bodyText:
Summary
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai's OpenAI Chat Completions adapter accumulates
streaming tool_calls[].function.arguments deltas into a single string,
then re-parses the entire accumulated string on every chunk using
partial-json. This is O(n²) in the length of arguments per tool call.
In long-running sessions (e.g., agent sessions that last hours and
accumulate large assistant message histories), this combines with the
session's growing messages payload to produce requests whose bodies
exceed provider gateway limits, causing 500/503 Upstream gateway error
responses from relay hosts such as relay.framefly.com.cn.
Environment

DSH: 0.1.0-rc.6 (@deepseek-ai/dsh v0.1.0-rc.6)
Bundle: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app
Adapter: @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai
Provider: a custom route registered via llm-pi-ai.providers.<route> using
api: openai-completions against a relay that fronts OpenAI's
chat/completions (e.g., relay.framefly.com.cn)
Tested model: gpt-5.5 (and gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.6-sol, etc.)
Provider confirms the LLM is healthy: 8/8 standalone curl calls succeed
with sub-second TTFT and no 500 responses
Provider: dsh-llm-deepseek against the same provider has no such failures

Symptoms

Sessions running 1+ hours on openai-relay/gpt-5.5 see occasional
turn/end kind=error events with reason
{"code":"SERVER","message":"500: {\"message\":\"Upstream gateway error\",\"type\":\"api_error\"}"}
or 503: {"message":"Service temporarily unavailable"}
Frequency is low (we observed ~2 errors in 19,589 events on one session,
≈0.01%), but accumulates the longer the session runs
Errors appear after many assistant turns, typically when the
accumulated history plus tool_calls makes the request body large
The companion adapter dsh-llm-deepseek on the same provider path
shows no such errors in equivalent workloads

Reproduction
Direct LLM access (relay.framefly.com.cn) succeeds in 8/8 cases.
$ curl -s -X POST "https://relay.framefly.com.cn/v1/chat/completions" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer …" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-5.5","messages":[…],"max_tokens":50}' | jq
# → 200 OK, "42"

The same call initiated through DSH via the llm-pi-ai provider eventually
returns a 500. The session's request.context event shows the same provider
and model are in use, and the body of the failing request is significantly
larger than a fresh session's (long history + many tool_calls).
Root cause
In @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai's OpenAI Chat Completions stream handler
(dist/api/openai-completions.js), tool_call argument deltas are concatenated
into a single string and re-parsed on every chunk:
for (const toolCall of choice.delta.tool_calls) {
    const block = ensureToolCallBlock(toolCall);
    …
    let delta = "";
    if (toolCall.function?.arguments) {
        delta = toolCall.function.arguments;
        block.partialArgs = (block.partialArgs ?? "") + toolCall.function.arguments;
        block.arguments = parseStreamingJson(block.partialArgs);   // ← O(n²) per chunk
    }
    …
}
parseStreamingJson invokes partial-json's parse() on the full
accumulated string, so the cost of streaming one tool_call with n
delta characters is O(n²) in n. Across hundreds of tool calls in a long
session, this is both slow and (more importantly) the streaming handler
holds on to ever-growing partialArgs strings per call, and the assembled
history sent to the provider is bloated by stringified reparses.
The harness Blockassembler already provides incremental block assembly
that tolerates delta-only protocols. The adapter does not need to
accumulate partialArgs at all — it could yield raw tool-call-delta
chunks and let the harness's assembler manage concatenation (this is
exactly what dsh-llm-deepseek does).
Workaround
Two practical mitigations until this is fixed upstream:

Use dsh-llm-deepseek for long sessions (it does not have this issue).
Add an explicit retryPolicy to the affected provider in
~/.dsh/settings.yaml so the harness's dsh-llm-retry recovers from
the 500/503 instead of failing the turn:
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    <route>:
      retryPolicy:
        mode: normal
        maxRetries: 5
        retryableCodes: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504]
        backoff:
          initialDelayMs: 1000
          maxDelayMs: 60000
          jitterRatio: 0.2
Note: dsh-llm-pi-ai forces the inner pi-ai SDK's maxRetries to 0,
so the retry must be configured at the harness layer.

Suggested fix
Replace the per-chunk partialArgs accumulator + parseStreamingJson
with raw tool-call-delta yields and let the harness Blockassembler
handle the concatenation. The adapter should yield one
tool-call-delta chunk per incoming tool_calls[i].function.arguments
delta, with index, id, name, arguments fields populated, and rely
on the harness to assemble the final arguments string for each
tool-call block (this is what dsh-llm-deepseek already does).
The same fix applies to the tool-call-delta accumulation that
pi-messages.js performs downstream of the adapter — once the adapter
stops accumulating, the entire pi-ai pipeline becomes delta-only and the
Blockassembler's deltas arriving for an index already closed by block-end are ignored (malformed stream) invariant holds.
Reference

DSH harness: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
Affected file: packages/llm-pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js
Reference implementation that does NOT have this issue:
packages/llm-deepseek/lib/index.js (see async *stream + translatePayload)
DSH Blockassembler (correct incremental assembly):
packages/llm/lib/types/assembler.ts


Filed by: 老六 (AvatarV5)
Date: 2026-08-19
Affected version: @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai shipped with
@deepseek-ai/dsh v0.1.0-rc.6

threads.title: Session log unloadable after interrupted turn: re-emitted seqs misreported as torn record
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Loading a session history fails with:
history unavailable for session "<id>": Error: corrupt Zstandard session log: complete frame contains a torn JSONL record (internal)

The file itself is fine: every zstd frame is complete, every line is well-formed, and there is no byte-level truncation. The real problem is a logical seq gap: the writer re-emitted seq numbers that are already committed, and the reader reports this as "torn record", which hides what actually went wrong.
What the reader sees
The read-side scanner (SessionLogScanner) checks that event seqs stay globally continuous (event.seq === events.length). On the first mismatch it records the problem and stops advancing committedBytes; every later row is decoded but not committed. At the end, readZstdPrefix sees committedBytes !== inputBytes and throws the misleading "complete frame contains a torn JSONL record" error.
Root cause (writer side)
The event sequence around the failure point looks like this:
seq=N     step/end            (turn T, step S)
seq=N+1   turn/end            (turn T, reason=interrupted)
seq=N     assistant/chunk     (turn T, step S)   <-- seq restarts at N (duplicate of committed seqs)
seq=N+1   assistant/chunk     (turn T, step S)
seq0=N+2  reasoning-chunks    (turn T, step S)
...37 more replayed rows...

When a turn is interrupted (turn/end with reason=interrupted is durably written), the writer resumes appending for the same turn but restarts the seq from its stale in-memory counter (N, N+1), instead of continuing from the persisted max seq (+1) or opening a fresh turn. The results are rows that duplicate already-committed seqs, and the whole log becomes unloadable.
Evidence

scanner: inputBytes=8,791,095, committedBytes=8,784,541 (Δ=6,554 bytes = everything after the duplicate-seq point; 47,260 events committed, 37 rows rejected).
scanZstdFrames: 22,628 complete frames, tornStart === undefined — no byte-level truncation anywhere in the file.
The first offending row: assistant/chunk whose seq equals an already-committed seq, appearing immediately after turn/end(interrupted).

Suggested fix (writer side)

When resuming an interrupted turn, continue the event seq from persistedMaxSeq + 1, or emit a fresh turn/start for the resumed work; never re-emit seqs that are already durably committed.
If "resume inside a closed turn" is not a supported semantic, drop the resumes or warn instead of appending them.

Implemented fix (available in the fork)
A fix implementing the write-side guard is ready for review: huangxinV587#3 (draft)

Write-side guard. The JSONL backend records each session file's identity after its last successful write. When a stat before an append shows the file changed, the batch is re-validated against the durable event count: a batch whose first seq is below the committed count is refused, with an error naming the session, the batch start seq, the committed count, and the remedy (close and reopen the session). Batches that continue from the committed count pass normally.
Reader-side diagnosis. The scanner's first recorded issue is now surfaced: a byte-complete frame with a duplicate or missing seq reports seq gap in committed region instead of the misleading "torn JSONL record" wording.
Coverage. 4 new regression tests (genuine before-red) plus the existing package suites (663 tests green), typecheck, lint, and repo doc gates.

Optional reader hardening

Treat rows after turn/end(interrupted) for the same turn as a boundary: truncate at the last committed record and adopt the rest, mirroring the existing torn-final-frame recovery. At minimum, the error message should say "seq gap" instead of "torn JSONL record".

Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 0.1.0-rc.8
Node 24, Windows (reproduced locally; the reader code is platform-agnostic)

threads.title: Streaming tool calls fail when later deltas send an empty name
threads.bodyText:
Summary
A local Web session on dsh web fails every model tool call with:
Error: unknown tool ""

The browser connection and tool catalog are healthy: /api/host.describe returns 200 and the request header contains the expected tool names (bash, read, grep, etc.). The persisted tool/call events, however, contain name: "" for the failed calls.
Reproduction
The upstream DeepSeek-compatible streaming response can emit tool-call deltas like:
{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"function":{"name":"bash","arguments":""}}]}
{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"function":{"name":"","arguments":"{\\"command\\":\\"pwd\\"}"}}]}
The first delta supplies the valid name; a later delta repeats an empty name.
In packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts, the translator currently does:
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
The empty later value overwrites bash, so the executor receives an empty tool name and reports unknown tool "".
Suggested fix
Only update the accumulated name for a non-empty value:
if (call.function?.name) block.name = call.function.name
A regression test should cover a bash name followed by an empty-name delta.
Is this empty repeated name expected behavior from the compatible gateway, and should the adapter tolerate it as above?

threads.title: Seeking Help: Two Interconnected Risk Assessment Projects for the New Phosphate Port in Annaba, Algeria
threads.bodyText:
Hello Harness Community,
I'm reaching out to invite collaboration on two interconnected risk assessment projects in Annaba, Algeria. Both projects revolve around the same critical question: What is the real threat to the new Phosphate Port and the surrounding region from the Bouhamdane Dam?

🌊 Project 1: The Catastrophic Scenario (Dam Failure)
The Problem: The Bouhamdane Dam, located 25 km west of Guelma, is a large earthen dam (capacity: 220 million m³) situated in an active seismic zone. In the event of a major earthquake or structural failure, a catastrophic release of water and silt would surge down the Wadi Seybous valley.
The Potential Impact:
· The flood would be channeled towards the new Phosphate Port in Annaba.
· The "Life Base" (the Chinese workers' camp for the port project) is built on a low-lying swamp, barely 1 meter above sea level. It was raised using landfill (approx. 5-6 meters), but this material is not compacted natural soil and would be highly vulnerable to erosion and collapse in a flood.
· The entire coastal area of Annaba and El Tarf could be inundated.
Project 1 Goal: To verify the hypothesis of catastrophic damage to the Phosphate Port and its "Life Base" from a Bouhamdane Dam failure.
Tasks:

Simulate the flood path from the dam to the sea.
Assess the potential structural damage to the port and the "Life Base".
Determine the margin of error in these estimations.


🌧️ Project 2: The Seasonal Flood Scenario (Similar to 2003)
The Problem: In 2003, authorities were forced to release a large volume of water from the Bouhamdane Dam to prevent a catastrophic failure, causing significant flooding. This scenario is more likely to recur than a full dam collapse.
The Potential Impact:
· Even a controlled release would inundate the "Life Base" area (which is built on a natural swamp).
· The remaining swamp area (not yet landfilled) would become stagnant water, creating a major health hazard (malaria, waterborne diseases) for both the workers and the local population.
· The port construction itself could be disrupted.
Project 2 Goal: To model the impact of a major seasonal flood (like 2003) on the region, focusing on the flooding of the "Life Base" and the resulting environmental and health risks.
Tasks:

Model the flood inundation of the "Life Base" area.
Identify the remaining swamp areas and their potential to become stagnant water pools.
Assess the public health risks (diseases, epidemics) arising from stagnant water.


🛠️ What I Have & What I Need
I have:
· A comprehensive file (in Markdown) containing all coordinates, analysis, and historical context for both projects.
· The file is ready to be fed into Harness (as a single, structured prompt).
I need:
· Someone with the skills and resources to run this file through Harness.
· Generate a Digital Terrain Model (MNT) of the area.
· Produce a 20-second timelapse video (2003-2026) showing the area's evolution.
· Generate a final PDF report for each project.
If you can help, or know someone who can, please reply here or reach out. I'm happy to share the complete file with anyone interested.
Thank you,
