threads.title: Flaky on CI: process-exit.spec.ts managed-tree tests intermittently hit the 30s timeout (different case each run)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
In our downstream fork's CI (GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest, Node 24), the tests in packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/tests/process-exit.spec.ts intermittently fail with a ~30s timeout. The failing case varies between runs — different runs of the same suite timed out on different cases while their siblings passed in under 500 ms — and rerunning the exact same commit passes green. This points to shared-state / timing sensitivity in the spec rather than a deterministic regression.
Evidence
All four cases are variations of "removes an ordinary managed tree after <exit reason>":



Run
Failing case
Duration
Siblings




A
after 'unhandled-rejection'
30,015 ms (timeout)
all pass (<500 ms)


B
after 'direct'
30,470 ms (timeout)
all pass (after 'unhandled-rejection' passes at 372 ms)



Rerunning failed jobs (same commits, no source changes) went green both times:

Failed: https://github.com/shine-233/deepseek-harness-study/actions/runs/32549629393 (attempt 1 fail -> attempt 2 pass)
An earlier run on a different commit failed the same way and also passed on rerun

Environment

GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner
Node 24 (actions/setup-node)
Observed from our study-fork's CI which runs the upstream test suite unchanged

Guess at direction (may be wrong)
Each case spawns a real child process tree and waits for managed-tree removal; a slow runner can plausibly push one wait past the 30s test timeout, with whichever case happens to be slowest that day losing the race. Possible mitigations: a larger per-test timeout for this spec, or polling with a deadline instead of a fixed wait.

threads.title: DSH 过重的依赖解析 | npm dependency resolution takes minutes for DSH
threads.bodyText:
省流 | TL;DR

最推荐：直接换 pnpm dlx | Most Recommdate: Use Pnpm

pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest web

继续用 npm，但禁用严格 peer 依赖解析 | Use Parameters to avoid peer resource

npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh --legacy-peer-deps
概述
嗨！今天我尝试用npm更新dsh，发现npm直接崩溃。在 #176 #3786 #3710 #3845 提到的 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 首次启动长时间无输出问题基础上，我进一步做了一些排查。问题似乎和网络慢没啥关系，主要是 npm 的 peer dependency 解析阶段。
一个比较直观的量化结果来自我的CNB“云原生开发”：使用 npm 时，DSH单次构建持续 8 分 19 秒被 SIGKILL；切换到 pnpm 后，同一套构建可以正常完成，pnpm install 约 45–50 秒。


使用npm构建v0.1.1-rc.2直接OOS



使用npm 构建v0.1.0-rc.6 耗时长但成功



使用 pnpm 构建v0.1.1-rc.2仅消耗1.7min

进一步分析
本地进一步用 --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts 排除构建脚本和实际解包影响后：



测试
耗时




npm 默认，0.1.0-rc.7
~4 min


npm 默认，0.1.1-rc.1/rc.2
长时间无响应


npm --legacy-peer-deps，0.1.0-rc.7
30.59 s


npm --legacy-peer-deps，0.1.1-rc.1
28–32 s


pnpm（CNB）
~45–50 s



这说明单纯的依赖数量或网络速度很难解释 npm 的分钟级耗时：同一依赖图在禁用 npm peer dependency resolution 后，解析时间可以稳定下降到约 30 秒。
我也做了CPU profile。在 npm 长时间无输出的阶段，进程实际上仍在持续占用 CPU；采样中约59% self time 位于 Node URL 解析、28% 位于semver.SemVer，调用栈主要来自 Arborist 的 peer placement / dependency validation
因此目前更倾向于：DSH 较重的 peer dependency graph 触发了 npm Arborist 异常昂贵的重复 peer-placement validation
改为 pnpm 和采用--legacy-peer-deps都能显著缓解这一现象。
For English
Hi there, I did some further investigation into the very long first-run installation time reported in #176.
This does not appear to be just a lack of progress output or slow network access. In my tests, npm spends most of the silent period doing CPU-bound peer dependency resolution.
Reproduction
Environment:

Windows 11
Node.js v24.12.0
npm 11.8.0
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.1 / rc.2
fresh temporary directories / no existing lockfile

A normal npm install can remain silent for several minutes around dependency placement/resolution.
After this point there may be no new npm log output for minutes.
This is also reproducible in our CNB packaging workflow. With npm, one build spent 8m19s in this phase before the npm process was eventually killed with SIGKILL(OOS)
I tested dependency resolution separately using:
npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh@<version> `
  --package-lock-only `
  --ignore-scripts
The interesting result is what happens when npm peer dependency resolution is disabled:



Test
Time




npm default, 0.1.0-rc.7
~4 min


npm default, 0.1.1-rc.1/rc.2
stuck


npm --legacy-peer-deps, 0.1.0-rc.7
30.59 s


npm --legacy-peer-deps, 0.1.1-rc.1
28–32 s


pnpm install in CNB
~45–50 s



The pnpm build resolves roughly 500 packages and completes normally, so dependency count alone does not seem to explain the multi-minute npm behavior.
The --legacy-peer-deps result seems particularly significant: with the same npm, registry and DSH release, resolution drops from minutes to about 30 seconds when peer dependency processing is disabled.
CPU profile
I then captured a CPU profile while npm was in the silent resolution phase.
In a ~20.5 second sample, the largest self-time hotspots were approximately:

Node internal URL constructor    ~59%
semver.SemVer                    ~28%

Following the caller stacks, this work originates predominantly from Arborist dependency validation underneath peer-placement checks, roughly along this path:
CanPlaceDep
  -> canPlacePeers / checkCanPlace
    -> Edge.satisfiedBy
      -> depValid
        -> npm-package-arg
          -> URL / SemVer parsing

There are nested/repeated CanPlaceDep -> canPlacePeers -> ... -> CanPlaceDep checks in the sampled stacks.
So although CanPlaceDep itself has little self CPU time, the work triggered underneath peer placement repeatedly performs dependency-spec / semver validation and dominates the profile.
This also explains why the process looks completely hung: it is not necessarily blocked on network or I/O; npm is still actively doing resolution work without producing user-visible progress.
Current hypothesis
My current hypothesis is that DSH's unusually peer-heavy package graph triggers pathological/redundant peer-placement validation in npm Arborist.
This seems consistent with all three observations:
normal npm resolution takes minutes;
--legacy-peer-deps reduces it to ~30 seconds;
pnpm resolves and installs the same large graph much faster.
I don't know yet whether this should ultimately be considered an npm/Arborist performance bug, or whether the published DSH package graph can be structured differently to avoid triggering it.
It may still be worth adding first-run progress feedback as suggested in #176, but that would only address the UX symptom rather than the underlying installation cost.
Happy to provide the .cpuprofile, graph-diff script/results, or run additional targeted tests if useful.

threads.title: [Bug] Same-mode sandbox_permissions hard-errors instead of running — loops GPT-family models
threads.bodyText:
On a workspace-write (or danger-full-access) session, a tool call whose sandbox_permissions requests a mode the session already has (same or narrower) fails instead of just running. GPT-family models (e.g. gpt-5.6-sol) speculatively attach this field on ordinary calls and then loop on the two errors below for the whole turn — on danger-full-access they never recover.
Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode
Error: invalid justification: expected a non-empty sentence   (when the reason is emptied)

No argument set passes both. The operation needed no escalation — writing in the workspace is already permitted.
Expected: same-mode → run normally; narrower → reject as a downgrade (not "missing justification"); wider → approval unchanged.
Env: DSH 0.1.1-rc.2, gpt-5.6-sol via azure-openai-responses.

threads.title: [Bug] Windows: dsh-subprocess-local 的 spawn()/taskkill 未设置 windowsHide，重启 Harness 时弹出空白 CMD 窗口
threads.bodyText:
环境

平台：Windows（win32 x64）
复现载体：DSH Desktop（Electron 壳，@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.7，dsh-subprocess-local 0.1.0-rc.7）

现象
Electron 主进程以 windowsHide: true 隐藏启动 harness 的 node 进程（进程本身没有可见控制台）。随后 harness 内通过 ctx.subprocess.spawn() / spawnSync("taskkill", ...) 生成的控制台程序（pwsh、bash、taskkill、node 等）如果没带 windowsHide，Windows 会给它们新建一个可见的控制台窗口。表现最明显的是：每次重启/停止 Harness 时，清理进程树的 taskkill /T /F（spawnSync，同步执行）会弹出一个短暂停留的空白 CMD 窗口；工具子进程调用也会闪窗。
定位
packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/lib/spawn.ts（打包产物 lib/index.js）：

spawnSubprocess() 中：

const child = spawn(program, args, {
  cwd: spec.cwd,
  env,
  stdio: [ ... ],
  detached: platform !== "win32"
});
缺少 windowsHide: true（detached 仅对 POSIX 生效，Windows 分支没有任何隐藏控制台的设置）。

taskkillProcessTree() 中：

spawnSync("taskkill", ["/PID", String(pid), "/T", "/F"], { stdio: "ignore" });
缺少 windowsHide: true —— 这是重启/停止时弹空白窗口的直接来源。

仓库内其他位置（桌面壳 main、dsh-native-command、dsh-host-directory-picker-native）都正确设置了 windowsHide: true，说明这是本包遗漏，非有意为之。

修复建议
两处 spawn 选项各加一行 windowsHide: true（POSIX 上该选项被 Node 忽略，无副作用）：
const child = spawn(program, args, {
  cwd: spec.cwd,
  env,
  stdio: [ ... ],
  detached: platform !== "win32",
  windowsHide: true
});
spawnSync("taskkill", ["/PID", String(pid), "/T", "/F"], { stdio: "ignore", windowsHide: true });
影响面
所有走 ctx.subprocess.spawn() 的执行器：dsh-bash-local、dsh-pwsh-local、dsh-tool-fs-search（ripgrep）等；以及任何进程树清理（taskkill）路径。
备注
已在本机安装副本上验证修复有效（重启后不再弹窗）。本反馈仅为上游跟踪，补丁会被应用更新覆盖。

threads.title: [Bug] Windows: dsh CLI 插件管理 spawnSync("pnpm", ..., { shell: true }) 未设置 windowsHide，安装插件时弹出 CMD 窗口
threads.bodyText:
环境

平台：Windows（win32 x64）
版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.7

现象
在 Windows 上执行 dsh plugin 相关命令（或经由 DSH Desktop 安装插件）时，runPlugin() 通过 spawnSync("pnpm", args, { shell: true }) 调用 pnpm。shell: true 在 Windows 上会走 cmd.exe /d /s /c ...，而 spawn 选项没有 windowsHide: true —— 当父进程（隐藏启动的 harness node）没有可见控制台时，会弹出可见的 CMD 窗口。
定位
apps/cli（打包产物 lib/plugin-9h8shc4d.js）中 runPlugin()：
const result = spawnSync("pnpm", args.map(...), {
  cwd: dir,
  stdio: "inherit",
  shell: process.platform === "win32"
});
修复建议
const result = spawnSync("pnpm", args.map(...), {
  cwd: dir,
  stdio: "inherit",
  shell: process.platform === "win32",
  windowsHide: true
});
POSIX 上该选项被忽略，无副作用。
备注
与 packages/subprocess/subprocess-local 中 spawn() / taskkill 缺 windowsHide 是同一类问题（见同仓库另一条反馈 #4023），建议一并修复。

threads.title: Plugin-registered commands execute but render nothing on the launcher screen
threads.bodyText:
Posting here since Issues are disabled on this repo. I'm not sure whether this is intended behaviour for plugin commands or a gap worth fixing — details and a minimal reproduction below.
Summary
On the launcher screen (the "Into the Unknown" / 探索未至之境 new-session screen),
a command registered by a plugin executes but produces no visible output, and
the view does not advance into a session. The same command, in the same process,
renders normally once a session exists.
Built-in commands (/goal etc.) do not have this problem on the same screen:
they render and switch into the session view.
The failure is silent — the input clears, so the command was accepted and ran
(server-side side effects do happen), but the screen shows nothing at all. From a
user's point of view the plugin is simply broken.
Reproduction
A 13-line plugin is enough. It registers one command that returns one line of
text: no UI slot, no service, no network, no storage.
index.js
export const name = 'dsh-probe-repro';
export const inject = ['commands'];

export function apply(ctx) {
  ctx.commands.register({
    name: 'probe',
    description: 'Minimal probe: returns one line of text',
    handler: () => ({ kind: 'success', text: 'probe ok — if you can read this, rendering worked' }),
  });
}
package.json
{
  "name": "dsh-probe-repro",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "type": "module",
  "main": "index.js",
  "dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "probe.cordis.yml" } },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "^4.0.1",
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands": "0.1.0-rc.6"
  }
}
probe.cordis.yml
- insert:
    - id: probe-repro
      name: dsh-probe-repro
Steps
dsh plugin --profile probe-test add -w "$PWD"     # $PWD = the plugin dir above
Then add "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app" to bundles in
~/.dsh/profiles/probe-test/package.json — dsh plugin add creates the profile
with @deepseek-ai/dsh-base and the plugin only, so without this there is no web
UI and nothing binds the port. (Possibly a separate bug; noting it because the
repro needs it.)
dsh --profile probe-test --port 8911

Open http://127.0.0.1:8911/ — you land on the launcher screen.
Type /probe, press Enter.
→ The input clears. Nothing renders. The view stays on the launcher screen.
Open any existing conversation from the sidebar (or send any message to start one).
Type /probe, press Enter.
→ probe · probe ok — if you can read this, rendering worked

Expected
Step 2 behaves like step 4 — and like a built-in command does on that screen:
the output renders, and the view moves into a session.
Actual
The handler runs, its CommandResult is discarded, and the view does not change.
What we ruled out

Not plugin-specific content. The repro above touches no slot and no
service; it is one command returning one string.
Not a client-slot conflict. Commands with no registered UI slot at all
behave identically.
Not the registration shape. The descriptor matches what built-in commands
use.
Not the command failing. The input clears and side effects land; only the
rendering and the view transition are missing.

Impact
Every dsh plugin that ships a command hits this on a user's very first
interaction, which is exactly when they have the least context to diagnose it.
Because the failure is silent rather than an error, the natural conclusion is
that the plugin is broken, and clicking "New session" returns the user to the
same screen.
Plugin authors cannot work around it in-product: on that screen the only slots
that render are conversation.hero.workspace and conversation.hero.agentPreset,
both kind: 'single' — registering into either replaces the host's own workspace
picker rather than adding beside it. conversation.composer.dock /
conversation.input.dock are kind: 'list' but do not render on the launcher
screen (the shipped stats line that lives in the dock is absent there). The only
channel left is the command's own description string, shown in the command
autocomplete — which is where we ended up putting a warning.
Environment

dsh 0.1.0-rc.6
macOS (Darwin 25.5.0), Node v26.3.0
Reproduced 2026-08-22 in a dedicated profile containing only
@deepseek-ai/dsh-base, @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app, and the probe plugin above.


Is this the intended behaviour for plugin-registered commands on the launcher screen? If it is, is there a supported way for a plugin to render something on that screen that I've missed? If it isn't, I'm happy to add anything else that would help — the reproduction above is a self-contained 13-line plugin.

threads.title: [Bug] Deleted/modified agent preset ("Mode") strands recorded sessions after host restart: preset "X" not found
threads.bodyText:
中文
删除或修改模式（Agent Preset，agent 预设）后，使用该模式的会话在宿主重启后无法恢复
摘要
会话创建时记录所用模式，每次恢复都按记录重新挂载。当该模式后来从名册消失——$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets 下对应目录被删除、改名，或模式被修改后不再以原 id 出现在名册——宿主一旦重启，所有记录了该 id 的会话都以笼统的 internal 错误恢复失败，且没有任何受支持的手段让这些对话继续。
同一进程内其实已经容忍删除：AgentPresets.remove() 会为已挂载会话保留 standing mount（见 packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts 中 remove() 上方注释）。缺口只在冷恢复路径：宿主重启后，磁盘上已不存在的模式无法再被挂载。
环境

dsh 0.1.1-rc.2（npm 全局安装），profile web
Node v24.19.0，Windows 11（10.0.26100）

复现步骤

新建一个用户模式：~/.dsh/.agent-presets/router-standard/agent.cordis.yml（拷贝任意内置预设即可）；
在该模式下建会话并跑至少一轮，然后停止会话；
删除、改名该目录，或修改该模式使其 id 从名册消失；
重启宿主，打开该会话（或点模式选择器触发懒恢复）。

实际结果（本次复现，完整错误信息）：
模型操作失败：internal: resume failed for session "session-2c50143f-cf3e-4236-a0ee-d462bb2e605e": Error: agent-presets: preset "router-standard" not found (available: standard, code, minimal, cordis, liangshen)

（liangshen 是该宿主上既有的用户模式，其余四个为内置预设。）同一消息也出现在 RPC 的 error.message 里：
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "internal",
    "message": "resume failed for session \"session-2c50143f-cf3e-4236-a0ee-d462bb2e605e\": Error: agent-presets: preset \"router-standard\" not found (available: standard, code, minimal, cordis, liangshen)",
    "details": {}
  }
}
UI 仅弹出这个“模型操作失败”开头的笼统提示，该 id 下所有会话永久卡死。实测一个真实环境里 78 个持久会话中有 20 个因单个被删 id 而搁浅。
期望结果：要么会话仍可恢复（有文档化的降级），要么给出结构化、可行动的错误与恢复路径，而不是笼统 internal。
根因
恢复链路：api-proxy.ts 的 composeAgent(presetId) -> presets.resolve(id) 抛 UnknownPresetError（preset.ts）-> 被 packages/api/remotes/src/agent-lookup.ts 的兜底捕获包装成 { code: 'internal' }，丢弃了线协议已定义的 agent-preset-not-found 结构化细节（{ agentPreset, available }）。
对比之下冷读历史已经优雅降级（standingKeyFor 失败被吞掉、历史仍可查看），唯独恢复硬失败，行为不一致且难排查。另外持久层已具备显式改绑的全部机制（agent-preset/selected 事件、最新者胜），只是没有暴露给搁浅场景。
修复方向建议

最小改动：让恢复路径透传 agent-preset-not-found（而非 internal），客户端即可提供恢复入口；
恢复流：报错时允许客户端为会话追加一条 agent-preset/selected 事件以改绑到现有模式——与空白期 agentPreset.select 同一持久化机制，扩展到搁浅场景；
文档化回退：缺失 id 解析为部署默认组合（ghost id 下），并输出告警。下方插件证明该方案端到端可行。

已验证的进程内 workaround
通过 home patch 层挂载的小插件包裹服务实例的 resolve：未知 id 返回默认模式行（保留 ghost id 作隔离键），全部消费路径随之降级，20 个搁浅会话无需重建任何目录即恢复。核心代码见英文节。
已检索的既有报告
Discussions/Issues 中检索 preset not found、resume failed、“删除预设 会话”均无重复；最接近的是 #3018（改默认预设对复用空白会话不生效），同属预设生命周期领域但症状不同。

English
Summary
A session records the agent preset it was composed under — the same thing the UI calls a "Mode" — and re-mounts that preset on every resume. When the preset later disappears from the roster (its user-authored directory deleted or renamed under $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets, or the preset itself modified), every session recorded under that id fails to resume with a generic internal error after a host restart, and there is no supported way to keep those conversations alive.
In-process behavior already tolerates deletion - AgentPresets.remove() keeps standing mounts for joined sessions (packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts, comment above remove()). The gap is only the cold-resume path: once the host restarts, nothing can re-mount a preset that no longer exists on disk.
Environment

dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 (npm global install), profile web
Node v24.19.0, Windows 11 (10.0.26100)

Minimal reproduction

Author a user preset: ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/router-standard/agent.cordis.yml (a copy of any shipped preset works).
Create a session under it, run at least one turn, close/stop the session.
Delete or rename ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/router-standard/, or modify it so that id leaves the roster.
Restart the host; open the session (or click the Mode selector, which lazily resumes).

Actual (verbatim from the affected host):
模型操作失败：internal: resume failed for session "session-2c50143f-cf3e-4236-a0ee-d462bb2e605e": Error: agent-presets: preset "router-standard" not found (available: standard, code, minimal, cordis, liangshen)

(liangshen is an unrelated user preset already on that host; the other four are the shipped built-ins.) The same message arrives in the RPC error.message:
{
  "ok": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "internal",
    "message": "resume failed for session \"session-2c50143f-cf3e-4236-a0ee-d462bb2e605e\": Error: agent-presets: preset \"router-standard\" not found (available: standard, code, minimal, cordis, liangshen)",
    "details": {}
  }
}
The UI surfaces only that generic 模型操作失败 toast, and every session recorded under the missing id strands permanently. In one real deployment here, 20 of 78 persisted sessions stranded behind a single deleted id.
Expected: either the session still resumes (documented fallback), or the failure is a structured, actionable error with a recovery path - not an opaque internal.
Root cause
Resume funnels through the recorded effective preset (newest agent-preset/selected event, else the header - packages/preset/agent-presets/src/session.ts, resolveSessionPreset) into:

packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts -> composeAgent(presetId) -> presets.resolve(id) -> throws UnknownPresetError (packages/preset/agent-presets/src/preset.ts),
which the generic resolver catch wraps into { code: 'internal' } (packages/api/remotes/src/agent-lookup.ts, resume failed for session ...), discarding the structured agent-preset-not-found details ({ agentPreset, available }) that the wire protocol already defines.

Notably, the cold transcript read already degrades gracefully: standingKeyFor failures are swallowed so history stays viewable without the preset. Resume is the only path left failing hard, which makes the inconsistency easy to hit and confusing to diagnose.
A session's preset is deliberately fixed at creation (assertPresetUnchanged), and blank-session switches are recorded as agent-preset/selected log events where the newest wins - i.e. the persistence layer already has everything needed to re-point a session at another composition explicitly.
Suggested directions (pick per taste)

Minimal: let the resume path surface agent-preset-not-found instead of internal (the RPC details map already carries { agentPreset, available }). Clients could then offer recovery.
Recovery flow: on that error, let the client adopt the session under an existing preset by appending an agent-preset/selected event - same durability mechanism agentPreset.select uses while blank, extended to the stranded case.
Documented fallback: resolve missing ids to the deployment default composition under the ghost id, with a warning. A tiny process-level shim proves this is viable end-to-end (below).

Verified workaround (process-level plugin)
A home-patch plugin wrapping the live service instance keeps all 20 stranded sessions resumable with no directories recreated:
export const inject = ['agentPresets']
export function apply(ctx) {
  const presets = ctx.agentPresets
  const original = presets.resolve.bind(presets)
  presets.resolve = async (id) => {
    try { return await original(id) }
    catch (error) {
      if (!(error instanceof Error) || typeof error.presetId !== 'string') throw error
      const standIn = await original(undefined) // deployment default
      return { ...standIn, id }                 // ghost id keeps scope isolation
    }
  }
}
All consumers (create/resume/fork/cold read via resolveMountable/standingKeyFor) degrade together because they funnel through resolve() / this.resolve().
Prior art checked
Searched Discussions & Issues for preset not found, resume failed; no duplicate found. Closest: #3018 (default-preset change not applying to a reused blank session), same lifecycle area, different symptom.

threads.title: headless run with an openai-codex OAuth route lingers 5 minutes after completion (pi-ai session WebSocket cache is never cleaned up)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
A headless dsh --profile headless "<prompt>" run whose turn uses an openai-codex OAuth route does not exit when the turn completes. The final answer and the completed log are durable immediately, but the process stays alive for exactly five more minutes, then exits normally.
Root cause (verified on stock npm packages)
@earendil-works/pi-ai (0.82.1, as resolved by @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai@0.1.1-rc.2) keeps the Codex session WebSocket cached for reuse when a sessionId is supplied:

dist/api/openai-codex-responses.js — after a completed request, processWebSocketStream → release({ keep: true }) → scheduleSessionWebSocketExpiry(sessionId, entry).
The idle timer is SESSION_WEBSOCKET_CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000, created with plain setTimeout (not unrefed), and the cached WebSocket itself is also a referenced handle — so the Node event loop cannot drain.
dsh-llm-pi-ai forwards the DSH sessionId into pi-ai (enabling this cache), but nothing calls pi-ai's provided cleanup — cleanupSessionResources(sessionId?) from dist/session-resources.js — when the headless session/agent finishes. We found no caller of cleanupSessionResources anywhere in the @deepseek-ai/* tree.

Isolation evidence



Scenario
Exit




headless turn on a DeepSeek route
~3 s


same + an installed plugin that creates a child agent (DeepSeek)
~6 s


any headless turn using the openai-codex OAuth route
~5 min (exits when the idle TTL closes the socket)



The 5-minute wait reproduces with unrelated plugin sets, and disappears whenever the Codex OAuth route is not used — it tracks the provider, not any plugin.
Suggested fix
Have dsh-llm-pi-ai call cleanupSessionResources(sessionId) when a session/agent is disposed (or at least when a headless run finishes its last turn). unrefing the timer alone would not be enough — the cached WebSocket is a referenced handle too.
Happy to provide the full reproduction runs if useful.

threads.title: [Bug] Subagent 工具未暴露 model/provider 参数，子代理强制继承父代理模型导致无法按需切换模型
threads.bodyText:
问题描述
subagent 和 subagent_fork 工具在调用时只接受 description、prompt 和 run_in_background 三个参数，不提供 model 或 provider 参数供模型或用户在运行时指定子代理使用的模型。
当预设配置（agent.cordis.yml）中未显式设置 agentOptions 时，resolveChildAgentOptions 函数会静默地将父代理的 provider、model 和 maxTokens 复制给子代理（见 @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/child-agent.js 第 51-62 行）。这意味着用户无法在不修改配置文件的情况下，让子代理使用与父代理不同的模型。
复现步骤
在 settings.yaml 中将默认模型配置为一个较贵的模型（例如 mimo-v2.5-pro）
同时在 llm-pi-ai.providers 中配置一个免费或低成本模型（例如 ox-alpha-free）
创建一个会话，调用 subagent 工具委托一个任务
观察子代理实际使用的模型——始终为父代理的 mimo-v2.5-pro，无法通过任何工具调用参数切换为 ox-alpha-free
期望行为
subagent 工具应暴露可选的 model 和 provider 参数，允许模型在调用时指定子代理使用的模型。例如：
json
复制
{
"description": "小说优化",
"prompt": "请使用 ox-alpha-free 模型优化以下文本...",
"model": "ox-alpha-free",
"provider": "opencode-go-glm-2"
}
当这些参数未提供时，继承父代理模型是合理的默认行为；但应当允许覆盖。
实际行为
subagent 工具的参数定义中没有 model 或 provider 字段
agentOptions 仅存在于工具的配置层（预设文件），不在运行时调用参数中
子代理无条件继承父代理的模型，没有任何提示或警告
用户在不知情的情况下，所有子代理任务的 token 消耗都计入父代理模型
影响
成本问题：用户以为子代理在使用免费/低成本模型，实际所有 token 消耗都走父代理的高价模型。在本次案例中，一天内因小说优化任务消耗了 43,777,176 token，全部计入 mimo-v2.5-pro，而用户预期使用的是免费的 ox-alpha-free
工作流灵活性受限：无法在同一会话中混合使用不同模型（例如用便宜模型做批量处理、用贵模型做精细推理）
缺乏透明度：子代理继承模型的行为是静默的，工具描述中没有任何提示告知用户"子代理将使用与当前会话相同的模型"
与 workflow 工具不一致：workflow 工具的 phases 支持 per-phase 的 provider/model 覆盖，但 subagent 工具不支持，设计不统一

threads.title: [web] UI fails to load over plain HTTP on a non-loopback host — mintRpcId() calls crypto.randomUUID(), which is undefined in insecure contexts
threads.bodyText:
Summary
When the DSH web UI is served over plain HTTP on a non-loopback host (e.g. http://<LAN-IP>:3080 or http://<tailscale-IP>:3080), the browser treats the origin as a non-secure context (window.isSecureContext === false). In that environment crypto.randomUUID is undefined.
dsh-client-connection's AbstractApiClient.mintRpcId() calls crypto.randomUUID() directly, so minting the very first RPC id (host.describe) throws TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function. That throw is swallowed by the connection loop's catch, which aborts the current generation — closing both events.mux and events.host WebSockets while they are still CONNECTING.
Result: the browser logs WebSocket connection to 'ws://…/api/events.mux' failed: WebSocket is closed before the connection is established., the host.describe request is never actually sent, and the whole UI (sidebar etc.) stays blank, stuck in an infinite reconnect loop.
The same UI works perfectly when the same server is reached over HTTPS or over loopback (http://127.0.0.1:3080), because those are secure contexts where crypto.randomUUID exists.
Environment

dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (all @deepseek-ai/dsh-* packages at 0.1.0-rc.6)
Reproduced in Chrome (headless, DevTools Protocol) — any browser behaves the same
Access path: browser → http://100.68.55.117:3080 (Tailscale IP of the host, plain HTTP) → tailscale serve --tcp 3080 3080 → 127.0.0.1:3080
Confirmed via CDP: window.isSecureContext === false, typeof crypto.randomUUID === "undefined", typeof crypto.getRandomValues === "function"

Steps to reproduce

Boot dsh --profile <web-profile> --port 3080 bound to loopback (the only supported --host today).
Expose it over plain HTTP on a non-loopback address — e.g. a TCP reverse proxy (tailscale serve --tcp 3080 3080) or a plain-HTTP reverse proxy — so the browser origin is http://<non-loopback-host>:3080.
Open http://<non-loopback-host>:3080 in a browser.

Observed: the sidebar is completely blank; DevTools shows the events.mux / events.host WebSockets failing with "closed before the connection is established", and [web-runtime] connection lost, retry #N repeats forever. The POST /api/host.describe request is never issued.
Expected vs actual

Expected: the UI loads over any reachable HTTP host (the harness already has a --trusted-host mechanism for exactly this), minting RPC ids through the browser-safe randomUuid() helper.
Actual: mintRpcId() uses crypto.randomUUID() (secure-context-only), so the first RPC id mint throws, the handshake aborts, and the UI never loads on non-secure contexts.

Root cause (from reading the source)
In @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection (lib/client.js):
mintRpcId() {
    return RpcId(crypto.randomUUID());   // throws on non-secure contexts
}
The same package already ships a browser-safe helper a few lines away:
// lib/types/client/random-uuid.js
/** Browser-safe UUID generation for client-side wire correlation. */
/**
 * Generate an RFC 4122 version 4 UUID without requiring a secure context.
 * @returns a UUID backed by crypto.getRandomValues(), which browsers expose on insecure origins.
 */
function randomUuid() {
    const bytes = globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
    // ... sets v4 variant/version bits, hex-encodes, formats with dashes
}
…but mintRpcId() doesn't use it. The host.describe() unary call (callUnary) reaches mintRpcId() before it issues the HTTP request, so the failure happens before any /api traffic is sent — which is why the symptom is "WebSocket closed before established" (the abort closes the WebSockets) rather than an HTTP error.
There is at least one more direct crypto.randomUUID() usage in the same bundle (MessageId(crypto.randomUUID()) for session messages), which hits the same wall on non-secure contexts.
Suggestion

Make mintRpcId() (and any other client-side id minting) use randomUuid() instead of crypto.randomUUID(), since randomUuid() already exists and is documented as the insecure-origin-safe path; and/or
Add a randomUuid()-backed polyfill for crypto.randomUUID on the client, so no call site can accidentally depend on the secure-context-only API.

This is the same class of "works over loopback/HTTPS, breaks over plain HTTP on a non-loopback host" issue that's easy to miss in dev (where 127.0.0.1 is always a secure context).

threads.title: [Bug] dsh web crashes on Windows when a tool call / sub-agent is triggered
threads.bodyText:
Environment


OS: Windows 11 (also reproduces on Windows 10)


dsh: official @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 (repo deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, apps/cli). I launch it through the node runtime bundled in my desktop setup (...\node\dsh.cmd), but the failing component is dsh's own standard web profile at ~/.dsh/profiles/web — i.e. the same one npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web creates. So this is a dsh-on-Windows issue, independent of how dsh is launched.


Version: reproduced on 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.1-rc.2 (latest dist-tag at time of writing)


Symptom: Chatting works fine. The moment a task that triggers a tool call / sub-agent is assigned, the run fails with:
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

(Stack points into @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop → ctx.tools[schedulerSymbol].prepare(...))


Root cause
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools registers its tool scheduler under a private, module-level
Symbol("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler"). The agent loop later looks it up via
ctx.tools[thatSymbol] and calls .prepare().
In a single dsh web process there end up being two physical copies of
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools:

The copy nested inside the dsh CLI install:
<dsh-install>\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-tools


A separate copy materialized inside the web profile:
~\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-tools



Because they are two distinct module instances, the Symbol("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler")
created by copy #1 is not === to the same-named Symbol from copy #2. So the agent loop
looks up the scheduler with Symbol A, but ToolRuntime registered it under Symbol B →
ctx.tools[schedulerSymbol] is undefined → .prepare() throws.
Why Windows, and not macOS
The web profile installs plugins that depend on @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools
(e.g. dsh-better-sidebar, @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all, agent-teams, ssh, …).
On Windows, pnpm materializes a separate physical copy of the core package instead of
deduping to the CLI's copy. On macOS/Linux, pnpm tends to hardlink/dedupe to a single
instance, so the Symbol identity stays consistent and the crash does not occur.
This matches the community analysis already published (several Chinese tech write-ups have
independently reproduced the exact same Symbol-identity mechanism).
A second, independent defect
Some web profiles also ship without @deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime /
dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread, so ctx.codeRuntime is undefined. That is a separate
failure (mode:code skills fail to load) and is fixed the same way — junction the missing
packages in.
Workaround (user-side, tested)
Make the web profile reuse the CLI's single copy via directory junctions, so the whole
process has exactly one dsh-tools instance.
1. Detect duplicate copies (PowerShell):
Get-ChildItem -Path $env:USERPROFILE\.dsh -Recurse -Directory -Filter dsh-tools | Select-Object FullName
If you see more than one real directory, that is the problem.
2. Point the web copy at the CLI copy (cmd, same user; back up first). Replace <dsh-install>
with your dsh install directory — the npm global root where @deepseek-ai/dsh lives:
set "CLI=<dsh-install>\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-tools"
set "WEB=%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-tools"
ren "%WEB%" "%WEB%.bak"
mklink /J "%WEB%" "%CLI%"
3. If ctx.codeRuntime is undefined, repeat step 2 for:

...web\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-code-runtime → CLI ...\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-code-runtime
...web\node_modules\dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread → CLI ...\dsh\node_modules\dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread

4. Restart dsh web. The running process already loaded the broken modules; the junction
only affects new launches.
Important

dsh auto-updates can re-extract the web profile and overwrite the junction, re-breaking it.
Re-run the junction after each update. (I keep an idempotent PowerShell script for exactly this.)
This is a user-side mitigation, not an upstream fix. The real fix is for the web profile to
dedupe / pin @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools to the CLI's single copy.

Ask to maintainers
Please make the web profile reuse the CLI-bundled @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools (single instance /
pinned version) on Windows, and ensure dsh-code-runtime is present in the web profile. Happy to
provide a full repro (process, module paths, Symbol-identity diff) if useful.

threads.title: deepseek harness本地web UI 对话输入框不出现以对话输入框输入内容隐藏看不见情况
@ 菜单的会话候选每次击键耗时约 4.8 秒:listCandidates 解压会话日志取标题,而这些标题在投影缓存里已经有了
threads.bodyText:
在 Web GUI 输入框里输入 @,触发菜单显示 "Loading…" 持续 4–5 秒才出现候选,而且每次击键都重新来一遍。文件搜索这半边很快,会话搜索这半边很慢。
环境

dsh 0.1.1-rc.2(dsh web,默认 web-app 组合,Windows)
磁盘上约 250 个会话(zstd 日志共约 124 MB;单个最大 6.4 MB)

实测数据(对运行中的宿主直接探测 POST /api/<endpoint>):



RPC
延迟
说明




fileReferences/list
11–54 ms
有工作区索引缓存,正常


sessionReferenceResolver/candidates
每次 4500–4850 ms
无缓存;每次击键都重跑


session.list(侧边栏,同一宿主)
约 190–420 ms
已经能为全部会话返回标题



根因
SessionReferenceResolver.listCandidates(位于 packages/context/session-reference/src/index.ts)通过 ctx.sessionQuery.readTitleSnapshots(...) 解析候选标签,该调用会解压每个候选会话的完整 zstd 日志来提取标题——每次调用最多解压 candidateLimit(默认 50)个,既没有缓存也没有防抖。而侧边栏的 session.list 从投影缓存(dsh-session-projection-cache 维护的 session_projcache.json)以极低成本拿到同样的标题。也就是说,这条昂贵的路径在重算宿主早已算好的数据。
客户端还有两个加重因素:

ui-reference 的 candidates() 用一个 Promise.all 同时等文件 RPC 和会话 RPC,快的文件结果被慢的会话结果拖住一起出不来;
输入触发管道每次击键都查询、无防抖,所以每敲一个字符就是一整轮解压。

影响
@ 菜单实际上连文件引用也没法用了——整个菜单要保持 pending 状态直到两个来源都返回(每次击键 4–5 秒)。此外这条链路上没有任何客户端超时,请求一旦丢失,菜单会永远停在 "Loading…"(在宿主重启竞态后实际观察到;另外 dsh web 重启时旧进程占着 3080 端口会报 EADDRINUSE,也和这个现象相关)。
建议的修复方案(按影响排序)

标题改从投影缓存读取,不要再解压日志。 listCandidates 的标签来源应换成侧边栏同款的投影缓存/session-list 路径(session.list 证明全部会话带标题约 200 ms 可达)。仅这一项就应把端点从约 4.8 秒降到 500 ms 以内。
缓存 + 失效: 按 session id 缓存标题快照(TTL 分钟级即可——标题很少变),监听 session/title 事件失效,重复击键就是零成本。
客户端防抖: ui-reference(或 input-trigger 控制器)对候选查询加约 150–200 ms 防抖,让一连串击键只触发一轮 RPC 而不是 N 轮。
渐进渲染: 拆开 ui-reference candidates() 里的 Promise.all,让文件组独立返回——菜单框架本来就支持分组各自的 ready 状态,文件结果立即显示,会话组自己慢慢解析。
加客户端超时(比如 AbortSignal.timeout(3000)),请求丢失时该组按失败处理(菜单自动关闭),而不是永远挂在 "Loading…" 上。

第 1–2 项治延迟,第 3–4 项治体感,第 5 项治挂死。
目前的临时规避
禁用该插件(~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 里 - id: session-reference / disabled: true)后 @ 菜单毫秒级响应,代价是失去 @session 功能。若必须保留功能,把 candidateLimit 调小(比如 10)可按比例缩短延迟。

草稿里的所有数字都来自今天在你机器上的真实探测。需要我再补一版英文对照(或纯英文)的,随时说。

threads.title: feat: Missing ACP/Multica daemon long-running protocol support (blocking integration)
threads.bodyText:
Body:
Describe the bug/blocker
This is not a bug, but a missing protocol feature that prevents DSH from being discovered and managed by external daemons like Multica (v0.4.32).
Current state:
DSH installed: v0.1.1-rc.2 (global)
Available modes: headless (one-shot) and web (browser UI).
Missing: ACP (Agent Communication Protocol) server mode or a persistent JSON-RPC/WebSocket interface similar to Hermes (acp) or Opencode (run --json).
Impact:
Multica daemon has supported DSH since v0.4.26, but it cannot discover or maintain a session with DSH because DSH lacks a long-lived service endpoint. The client side is ready, but the server-side handshake is missing.
Request:
Please add an acp subcommand (or a --daemon flag) that exposes a standard protocol interface, allowing process supervisors like Multica to spawn and communicate with DSH persistently.
Workaround (temporary):
Currently only dsh --headless "cmd" is viable, which loses context and state.

threads.title: dsh-host-directory-picker-native: fixed 32KB koffi.view() read of a small heap pointer segfaults the host on Windows
threads.bodyText:
Summary
@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native's Win32 folder-dialog backend reads a fixed
32768-byte view from a small heap pointer to extract the result path. On a real Windows
machine this reliably segfaults the whole dsh host process (not just the picker) every
time a user completes (or cancels-then-reopens) the native folder dialog.
Reproduced 6 times back-to-back in a real user's dsh-host.log (two separate host restarts,
identical stack both times):
FATAL ERROR: Error::New napi_get_last_error_info
...
1: readUtf16 (...\dsh-host-directory-picker-native\lib\worker.cjs:22:34)
2: resultPath (...\lib\worker.cjs:132:20)
3: runFolderDialog (...\lib\worker.cjs:181:26)
4: ...\lib\worker.cjs:219:10
5: processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:104:5)

Root cause
worker.cjs (compiled from packages/host/directory-picker-native, win32-dialog-bindings.ts):
function readUtf16(koffi, address) {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768));
  let end = 0;
  while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2;
  return bytes.toString("utf16le", 0, end);
}
address comes from IShellItem::GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH), a CoTaskMemAlloc
block sized only for the path + NUL terminator — typically tens to a few hundred bytes, never
32KB. koffi.view(address, 32768) followed by Buffer.from() immediately materializes all
32768 bytes, walking well past the actual allocation. Whenever that small block happens to sit
near the end of a committed memory page (which is common — it depends on nothing the caller
controls), the read crosses into unmapped memory and the process takes an access violation.
Node surfaces this as the confusing FATAL ERROR: Error::New napi_get_last_error_info message
because the N-API environment is already corrupted by the time it tries to construct the error.
The neighboring comment explains this 32KB-view approach was chosen specifically to avoid a
different crash from calling koffi.decode(addr, 'str16') directly (that one apparently
double-dereferences the _Out_ void ** out-param). It looks like that fix traded one crash for
another — the new one is more reliably reproducible than the one it replaced, since virtually
every real folder-picker interaction produces a small allocation that's a strong candidate for
page-boundary proximity.
Not fixed in the latest published version
Confirmed the current version and the newest one (npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native versions
→ latest is 0.1.1-rc.2) have byte-identical readUtf16. This isn't something we can route
around by bumping the pinned dependency version.
Suggested direction
Read in small growing chunks (e.g. start at 520 bytes ≈ MAX_PATH UTF-16, double up to the
32768 cap only if no NUL terminator is found) instead of materializing the full 32768-byte view
in one shot. That keeps the overwhelmingly common case (paths under MAX_PATH) to a single
small read, which is far less likely to cross into an unmapped page. It doesn't eliminate the
theoretical risk entirely (no bound is provably safe without knowing the real allocation size),
but it should turn "crashes basically every time" into "crashes basically never."
Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native@0.1.0-rc.7 (pinned by our app; also checked
0.1.1-rc.2, same code)
Windows 10/11 x64 (exact build not captured in the log)
Reported via a downstream app built on DSH; happy to share the full dsh-host.log if useful.

Per CONTRIBUTING.md, posting here as a Discussion rather than an Issue since Issues are
disabled on this repo — let me know if there's a better place for this.

threads.title: 在使用dsh-better-sidebar插件的引用功能时，发现dsh会自动将文件识别为绝对路径，从而导致找不到文件报错。
threads.bodyText:
问题根源：
在 Windows 上，node:path.isAbsolute('/udp-web/apps/screen') 返回 true。因为 POSIX 风格的 / 开头的路径在 Windows 上的 node:path 中被视为"绝对路径"（它被当作当前磁盘驱动器的根路径）。
所以：
用户在侧边栏点击 "@文件" → 插入 @udp-web/apps/screen 到输入框
AI 理解用户引用的是文件 udp-web/apps/screen
AI 调用 str_replace_editor 工具，传入 path: "/udp-web/apps/screen"
str_replace_editor 的 resolveTarget 检查 isAbsolute('/udp-web/apps/screen') → true，通过检查
调用 ctx.fs.resolve('/udp-web/apps/screen')
fs-local 的 resolve 调用 resolve(cwd, path) → 因为 path 以 / 开头被视为绝对路径 → 结果变成了 C:\udp-web\apps\screen（而不是拼接到实际的工作目录 D:\workspace\UDP\dataAnalysis 后面）
完整的调用链：
复制
Sidebar.tsx line 995: appendToDraft(ctx, sessionId, @${relativeTo(cwd ?? '', path)})
→ 插入 "@udp-web/apps/screen"
→ 用户发送消息，AI 看到 "@udp-web/apps/screen"
→ AI 调用 str_replace_editor view path="/udp-web/apps/screen"
→ dsh-tool-str-replace-editor resolveTarget:
第68行: isAbsolute('/udp-web/apps/screen') → true (Windows上/path被视为绝对路径!)
第69行: ctx.fs.resolve('/udp-web/apps/screen')
→ dsh-fs-local resolve:
第706行: resolveLocalTarget(opts?.cwd ?? this.config.cwd, path)
→ resolveLocalTarget:
第155行: displayPath = resolve(cwd, '/udp-web/apps/screen')
→ 在Windows上，resolve('D:\workspace\UDP\dataAnalysis', '/udp-web/apps/screen')
→ 结果是 'C:\udp-web\apps\screen' (因为'/'开头被当作C盘的根目录!)
解决方案（建议）：
这个问题出在 str_replace_editor 工具（dsh-tool-str-replace-editor）的 resolveTarget 函数第 68 行。在 Windows 上，isAbsolute('/path') 返回 true，但用户实际期望的是一个相对于工作目录的路径。
有两种修复思路：
方案 A（推荐，在 dsh-tool-str-replace-editor 层面修复）： 修改 resolveTarget 函数，对以 / 开头但在 Windows 上不是有效盘符绝对路径（即不是 C:\、D:\等）的情况，将其视为相对路径，用 path.resolve(cwd, path) 来解析。或者更简单：检测平台为 Windows 且路径以 / 开头但不含盘符时，移除开头的 / 再 resolve。
方案 B（在 dsh-fs-local 层面修复）： 修改 resolveLocalTarget 函数，对以 / 开头但不含盘符的路径，在 Windows 上视为相对路径，拼接到 cwd 后面。
方案 C（在客户端 Sidebar.tsx 层面修复）： @文件 按钮插入时，直接插入绝对路径而不是相对路径。但这会失去相对路径的简洁性。
方案 D（在 dsh-tool-str-replace-editor 的 resolveTarget 中修改）： 将第 68 行的检查改为：在 Windows 上，路径必须以盘符开头（如 C:\）才视为绝对路径；否则视为相对路径。
最合适的修复位置是 方案 A，在 dsh-tool-str-replace-editor 的 resolveTarget 中。但请注意这属于 DSH 核心库（@deepseek-ai 包），修改后需要重新构建。或者考虑在 dsh-better-sidebar 层面，让 "@文件" 插入时使用更清晰的方式表明路径来源。

threads.title: 非 localhost HTTP 访问 web GUI 时 RPC 全部失败：crypto.randomUUID is not a function
threads.bodyText:
通过局域网 IP 或 NAT 映射地址（如 http://192.168.x.x:3080）访问 dsh web GUI 时，浏览器端任何 RPC 都抛出 TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function，设置工作区等操作无法完成。

复现、预期与验收

复现步骤：

以 0.0.0.0 绑定启动 web 服务（pnpm dsh --profile web --patch <overlay> --no-open）；
浏览器通过 http://<非 localhost 地址>:3080 打开页面；
打开「设置工作区」，或执行任何触发 RPC 的操作。


实际结果：操作失败，浏览器抛 TypeError: crypto.randomUUID is not a function。
预期结果：非安全来源（insecure origin）下 RPC 正常完成。
环境：dsh 0.1.1-rc.2（master b150a551），Node v24.15.0，Linux，现代 Chrome/Edge。
验收条件：http://<LAN-IP>:3080 下 workspace.list / host.listDirectory 等 unary RPC 成功；新增模拟无 crypto.randomUUID 环境的回归测试。



根因分析

crypto.randomUUID() 仅在安全上下文（HTTPS 或 localhost）可用；普通 HTTP 的局域网地址不是安全上下文，此时 crypto.randomUUID 为 undefined。
packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/client.ts 的 AbstractApiClient.mintRpcId() 直接调用 crypto.randomUUID()；浏览器端 WebApiClient（packages/client/connection/src/client/web-api-client.ts）未覆写它，unary RPC 在铸造 rpcId 时即抛错。
连接包已有基于 crypto.getRandomValues()（非安全来源可用）的 randomUuid()（packages/client/connection/src/client/random-uuid.ts），rpc.call 路径已使用并配有测试（client-apply.client.spec.ts 的 secure-context 用例），但 unary 路径遗漏。
同类隐患还有一处：packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/service.ts:66 添加附件草稿时同样直接调用 crypto.randomUUID()。



已验证的修复方案
WebApiClient 覆写 mintRpcId() 复用 randomUuid()：
protected override mintRpcId(): RpcId {
  return RpcId(randomUuid())
}
并在 client-apply.client.spec.ts 增加回归用例（vi.stubGlobal('crypto', { getRandomValues }) 下断言 unary 调用的 rpcId 为合法 v4 UUID）。连接包 112 个测试全绿，重建后实际通过局域网 HTTP 访问验证通过。如需要，我可以整理成 PR。

另附一个部署侧观察（非 bug，供文档参考）：修复后通过 NAT 映射地址访问会命中 /api 的 DNS-rebinding 信任栅栏（全部 403），需在 patch overlay 中给 web-runtime 声明 trustedHosts: ['<映射后的 host:port>']（overlay 只接受字面值，!!js 不可用）。建议部署文档补充这一说明。

threads.title: [Bug] Loader cannot resolve ESM plugin with zero import statements (could not be resolved)
threads.bodyText:
H 加载器无法解析"零 import 的 ESM 插件"：报 "could not be resolved"，导致启动崩溃
摘要
DSH（DeepSeek Harness，@deepseek-ai/dsh，0.1.0-rc.7）的插件加载器（loader.internal，见 cordis-plugin-loader 的 import() 分支）对没有任何 import 语句的 ESM 插件文件解析失败，报 plugin(s) could not be resolved，导致整个插件树加载失败、进程退出（闪退）。给该文件添加任意一行无害 import（如 import 'node:process'）后立即恢复正常。
环境

DSH 版本：0.1.0-rc.7（@deepseek-ai/dsh）
平台：Windows 10/11（10.0.26200），Node v24.16.0
插件：cleverer-dsh（github:Classicoke/cleverer-dsh，v1.2.0）的 plugins/dsh-discipline.mjs；
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export、@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables（均为 0.1.1-rc.2）
触发条件：profile 的 node_modules 经 pnpm 重装后（此前 8/23 前正常，重装后开始出现）

现象
启动 dsh web 时崩溃，退出码 1：
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: dsh: plugin(s) failed to load: cleverer-dsh/plugins/dsh-discipline.mjs
Cordis startup failed because these plugin(s) could not be resolved (see the error(s) logged above)

（@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export、@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables 同样报 could not be resolved。）
复现步骤

在 profile（dsh_data/profiles/web）里让插件补丁（cordis.patch.yml 的 - insert:）引用一个零 import 的 ESM 文件，例如：
- insert:
    - id: dsh-discipline
      name: 'cleverer-dsh/plugins/dsh-discipline.mjs'
其中 dsh-discipline.mjs 内容为：export const name = 'dsh-discipline'、export const inject = ['systemPrompt']、export function apply(ctx){...}，没有任何 import 语句。
node bin.js web（或 dsh web）→ 启动崩溃，报 could not be resolved。

根因分析（关键）

该文件存在、语法正确：node -e "import('.../dsh-discipline.mjs')" 直接加载完全正常（name/inject/apply 均正确导出）。
同包其余 11 个插件文件（均有 1~5 条 import）全部正常加载；唯独这个 0 import 的文件失败。
尝试过的所有"引用方式"均无效：包名（cleverer-dsh/plugins/xxx.mjs）、相对路径（./node_modules/...）、绝对路径（file:///...）、patch 覆盖 name、彻底重装插件——全部报 could not be resolved。
逐文件对比 import 数量：正常文件 1~5 条 import；失败文件 0 条。
给失败文件加一行 import 'node:process'（无副作用）后，立即加载成功。

结论：loader.internal（DSH 的模块加载器）对零 import 的 ESM 模块处理存在缺陷——似乎把"没有 import"的模块判定为不可加载/解析失败。这属于 DSH 加载器 bug，与插件本身代码无关。
证据



文件
import 语句数
加载结果




cleverer-dsh/plugins/dsh-discipline.mjs
0
❌ could not be resolved


cleverer-dsh/plugins/anti-stuck.mjs
2
✅


cleverer-dsh/plugins/dsh-cordis-discipline.mjs
2
✅


cleverer-dsh/plugins/dsh-skill-provider.mjs
3
✅


@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-export/lib/index.js
0
❌ could not be resolved


@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables/lib/index.js
0
❌ could not be resolved


修复后（加 import 'node:process'）
1
✅ 全部加载成功



影响

任何零 import 的 ESM 插件/模块在 pnpm 重装依赖后可能无法加载，导致 DSH 启动崩溃（闪退）。
用户侧表现为"装插件/更新后突然闪退"，难以排查（DSH 只输出 could not be resolved (see the error(s) logged above)，但详细错误并未打印到 stdout/stderr）。

临时绕过（给其他用户）
给出问题的插件入口文件添加一行无害 import，例如：
import 'node:process'
放在文件顶部即可恢复正常（注意：插件包更新后会覆盖此改动，需重新添加；建议在插件作者或 DSH 修复前，用 pnpm patch 或脚本固化）。
建议修复

排查 loader.internal（cordis-plugin-loader 的 import() 分支 / DSH 内部加载器）对"无 import 的 ESM 模块"的解析逻辑，消除对零 import 模块的错误判定。

threads.title: Bug: compactor rejects valid short summaries with “summary is not smaller”
threads.bodyText:
Summary
The session compactor aborts when the generated summary is longer than the shadowed content, even for a very short turn. The whole agent turn is terminated instead of retaining the original content or skipping compaction.
Reproduction

DeepSeek Harness: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2
OS: Windows 11 x64
Profile: headless
Provider: OpenAI-compatible Ollama adapter
Model: Qwen3.8-9B uncensored GGUF (local)
Workspace: Windows path

Run a short tool-using task that triggers compaction, for example:
Create a small file, execute it, and report the result. Use tools explicitly.

After the tool calls, compaction ends with:
summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (254 estimated framed tokens >= 67)

A second occurrence in the same test session was:
summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (554 estimated framed tokens >= 67)

The JSONL event is:
{"type":"compaction/end","data":{"error":"summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (254 estimated framed tokens >= 67)"}}
Expected behavior
If the summary is not smaller, compaction should be skipped and the shadowed content retained, or the summary should be replaced with a minimal marker. It should not abort the agent turn.
Actual behavior
The compaction step reports an error and the session terminates prematurely after otherwise successful tool calls.
Notes
This is especially likely with short Windows tool-call turns, where framing overhead makes a summary larger than the content being replaced. A simple fallback such as if summary_tokens >= shadowed_tokens: return no_compaction appears sufficient.

threads.title: [Windows] Console window flashes on every shell tool call when dsh runs without a host console (Web UI / Electron)
threads.bodyText:
中文摘要：Windows 上以 Electron 壳 / 无控制台方式运行 dsh web 时，agent 每次调用 shell 工具都会闪出一个可见控制台窗口（标题为 Git\usr\bin\bash.exe 或 cmd.exe）。根因：Windows ACL 沙箱在受限令牌下无法使用 CREATE_NO_WINDOW（子进程会以 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED / 0xC0000142 死亡），因此设计为“子进程共享宿主控制台”；但 Web/Electron 宿主本身没有控制台可共享，Windows 就为每个子进程分配一个全新的可见控制台。0.1.0-rc.6 与 0.1.1-rc.2 行为一致。详细分析与修复建议见下方英文部分。
Environment

Windows 11 Pro build 26200
dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 (identical behavior on 0.1.0-rc.6)
Launch mode: GUI wrapper without a console → node ...\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js web --port 3080
Executors involved: winbash (Git Bash) and pwsh tool calls from any session

Steps to reproduce

Start dsh web from any process that has no attached console (GUI launcher / Electron wrapper / detached service).
In the Web UI, trigger any shell tool call (winbash or pwsh).
Watch the screen/taskbar: a new console window flashes open and closes for every spawn — titled with e.g. C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\bash.exe or cmd.exe.

Expected
Background tool executions should not create visible console windows.
Actual
One visible console window per spawned child, on every tool call, in every active session. Very disruptive when agents run multiple commands.
Root cause analysis
sandbox-windows-acl's own README states:

Console isolation is unavailable. Under the restricted token, children created with CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE die during DLL initialization with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142). ... Children therefore share the host console; stdio redirection is pipe-based, unaffected.

“Children share the host console” only holds when the host has a console (CLI usage). When the host is a GUI/detached process — i.e. the graphical Web UI launch path this project ships — there is no console to share, so Windows allocates a new visible console for every child.
Verified against the installed artifacts:

No windowsHide is set anywhere in the executor spawn paths (it is correctly set in dsh-native-command, dsh-host-directory-picker-native, and the MCP SDK stdio client).
No difference between 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.1-rc.2.

Possible directions to fix

If the server process has no console, allocate one hidden console at startup (e.g. AllocConsole kept hidden, or launch via a hidden conhost), so sandboxed children can share it instead of each allocating a fresh visible one.
Alternatively, allocate a hidden pseudoconsole (ConPTY) for restricted children instead of relying on console inheritance.
At minimum, set windowsHide: true on all non-restricted spawn paths, as some native helpers already do.

Happy to provide additional logs or a minimal repro script if useful. Thanks!

threads.title: # `dsh web` 在流式会话运行约 30–40 分钟后崩溃：“JavaScript heap out of memory”
threads.bodyText:
dsh web 在流式会话运行约 30–40 分钟后崩溃：“JavaScript heap out of memory”
摘要
dsh web 在运行约 30–40 分钟后内存耗尽并退出。进程堆内存单调增长，直到达到 V8 默认约 4GB 上限，报错 FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit。内存增长与流式 assistant/chunk 事件数量成正比——这些事件被永久保留在内存中的 append-only 会话日志里。
环境

操作系统：Windows（PowerShell）
Node.js：24.x（在 v24.18.0 上复现）
pnpm：11.7.0
dsh：0.1.1-rc.2（源码检出，pnpm dsh web）
模型：DeepSeek V4 Flash，推理模式（按 token 粒度流式输出）

实际行为
进程存活约 38.8 分钟（2327053 ms）后崩溃：
<--- Last few GCs --->

[27132:00000282380B7000]  2326151 ms: Scavenge (interleaved) 4083.4 (4088.3) -> 4082.2 (4092.8) MB, pooled: 0 MB, 5.74 / 0.00 ms  (average mu = 0.342, current mu = 0.316) allocation failure;
[27132:00000282380B7000]  2327053 ms: Mark-Compact (reduce) 4092.8 (4099.7) -> 4084.0 (4088.7) MB, pooled: 0 MB, 588.90 / 0.01 ms  (+ 160.6 ms in 32 steps since start of marking, biggest step 5.2 ms, walltime since start of marking 769 ms) (average mu = 0
FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory

预期行为
服务器应能长时间运行 agentic 会话而不出现无界内存增长，或者至少限制活动会话日志的内存占用（例如内存中只保留派生消息 + 尾部窗口，更早的历史从磁盘冷读；或者像磁盘格式那样在内存中也对 chunk 事件做打包折叠）。
复现步骤

执行 pnpm dsh web 并打开 http://127.0.0.1:3080。
发起对话，让 agent 流式输出长回复（长推理回合和/或大量工具调用）。
观察进程内存随每个 token-delta 事件不断增长。
约 30–40 分钟后（事件总量达到数十万到百万量级）进程以上述堆 OOM 崩溃退出。

可控复现（无需 API key）
我使用仓库自带的 mock LLM（packages/test-support/llm-mock-server）和临时 DSH_HOME，通过真实的 /api 通道驱动 prompt 复现：

空闲服务器（无浏览器连接）：约 157MB，10 分钟以上保持平稳。
打开两条 WebSocket 事件流（/api/events.mux、/api/events.host）但没有事件：依然平稳。
一条流式输出 100,000 个单字符 delta 的 prompt：157MB → 385MB，且不再回落。
第二条同样的 prompt：流式期间涨到约 540MB。
第三条 prompt 在浏览器/WebSocket 完全断开的情况下：仍然增长（峰值约 740MB）——说明内存保留在服务端，不是 websocket 缓冲问题。

证据
每个事件的成本
针对 packages/core/session 的微基准：向一个 Session 追加 500,000 个 assistant/chunk 事件，append-only 日志中每个事件约保留 305 字节（即使是 1 个字符的负载——深度冻结的对象外壳占大头）。
真实会话数据
报告人机器上的一次真实会话（约 39 分钟、28 个回合）包含 744,271 个事件，其中 740,508 个是 assistant/chunk（流式文本 + 推理 delta）。其持久化日志只有 9.65MB（zstd、打包行；原始 23.5MB）。而同样的这些事件在内存中约占 1.5–2.5KB/事件（计入持久化克隆、投影 checkpoint、已连接浏览器的 mux 帧）——与约 39 分钟耗尽 4GB 堆的量级吻合。
根因分析

packages/core/session/src/index.ts 中的 Session.log 是 append-only 内存日志；事件被深度冻结且会话存活期间永不淘汰。Web 会话在整个服务器生命周期内一直存活（工作区会持续列出它们），因此内存在整个运行期间持续累积。
packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts（约 350 行）对每个流式 delta 追加一条 assistant/chunk 会话事件。DeepSeek 推理流按 token 粒度输出（文本 + reasoning_content），一个长回合就会产生数万条事件。
持久化 JSONL 格式已经会对连续 chunk 做折叠打包（chunk-rows.ts、packChunkRuns——真实会话实测约 60 倍压缩），但活动内存日志仍把每个 chunk 保留为独立冻结对象。打包只发生在持久化边界。
放大因素：

每个事件都会被 structuredClone 进持久化 write-behind 队列（packages/session/session-persistence/src/write-behind.ts）；
每个事件都会作为 JSON 帧推送给每个已连接的浏览器 mux 流（packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts 的 events.mux）；
投影缓存每 200 个事件 / 5 秒对整个会话做一次 checkpoint（packages/session/session-projection-cache/src/index.ts）。



补充：Web UI 删除/归档会话不会释放内存
当前 API 层没有任何真正销毁内存中会话的入口（rpc-map 中只有 workspace.archiveSession 和 workspace.delete，没有 session.dispose/session.delete）：

UI 的“归档会话”只调用 workspace.archiveSession，把 sessionId 写入归档集合（纯元数据），SessionStore 中的 Session 对象及其全部事件原样保留在内存中。
“删除工作区”只移除工作区登记，文件夹与会话日志保留，会话移到“未分组”，内存同样不受影响。
实测浏览器断开后内存仍继续增长，说明增长完全绑定在存活 Session 对象上；因此用户在当前版本中没有任何可行的临时手段释放内存，只能重启进程。

修复建议

内存侧镜像 chunk 打包：把连续、同 block 的 assistant/chunk 事件在活动日志中折叠为 run 对象（复用磁盘已有的 ChunkRow 词汇），可大幅降低常驻内存。
限制活动会话日志：内存中只保留派生消息 + 尾部窗口，更早历史通过 sessionPersistence.readFrom 从磁盘冷读。
为每个会话增加事件数/字节上限，并自动压缩原始 chunk 事件。
可选：让 mux 帧推送具备背压感知（目前若浏览器缓慢/挂起，ws 会无上限缓冲帧）。
可选：提供真正的 session.dispose RPC / UI 删除入口，让用户能主动释放旧会话内存。

临时缓解
NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" pnpm dsh web 可以推迟崩溃，但无法解决无界增长问题。定期重启服务器也有帮助。

threads.title: --profile headless crashes on any tool call: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')" (0.1.1-rc.2)
threads.bodyText:
Issues are disabled on the repo, so posting here as the README suggests.
Symptom
With --profile headless, every turn where the model calls a tool dies with:
dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

The same setup, same command, same session — but a task phrased so the model answers without any tool ("reply with exactly PONG, do not use tools") — completes normally and exits 0. So the model/provider path is healthy; the failure is on the tool path.
Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 (current latest at time of writing)
Node 25.5.0, Windows 11
Launched via npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2 --profile headless --patch <overlay> "<task>"
Model reached through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint via DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL

What I ruled out
Not caused by a third-party plugin. I first hit this with a hooks bridge plugin mounted, so I re-ran the identical tool-using task with a patch overlay that mounts no third-party plugin at all — same crash, byte-identical message. That control run is why I'm reporting it here rather than debugging my own plugin.
Not dsh-session-query-sqlite being mounted with openAt: never. That was my first hypothesis, since the docs say a search under that setting should fail with a typed SESSION_QUERY_SEARCH_DISABLED rather than crash. I overrode it to openAt: first-search with a real database path — no change, same crash. Recording this so nobody re-tests the same dead end.
Where I think it comes from
Grepping the installed bundle for .prepare( call sites, the candidates are:

scheduler.prepare( in dsh-tools — best fit, since the failure is specific to the tool path
persistence.prepare() / ctx.sessions.prepare() in dsh-agent-loop

Reading undefined.prepare suggests an optional dependency that the tool path assumes is present. dsh-session-persistence is declared optional (peerDependenciesMeta), so one plausible shape is: the headless profile does not mount it, and something on the tool path dereferences it unguarded instead of degrading.
Question for maintainers: is --profile headless expected to run tool calls out of the box, or does it require mounting an additional plugin (session persistence or similar)? If the latter, a typed error naming the missing capability would save a lot of guessing — right now it surfaces as an UNKNOWN TypeError.
Secondary: headless has no way to self-diagnose this
dsh-headless prints error.message only. No stack trace, and --help exposes no log/debug/verbose flag I could find. With an UNKNOWN TypeError and no frame, there is nothing for a user to act on — I had to grep the shipped bundle to form even a guess.
Two small things that would have turned this into a five-minute fix on my side:

Print the stack (or gate it behind --verbose / a DSH_LOG_LEVEL env var) when the error is not a typed harness error.
When a turn aborts hard, the session log persists only the event header — the event flush does not appear to complete, so post-mortem inspection of the session file shows almost nothing. Flushing pending events on abort would make crashes debuggable after the fact.

Happy to run any additional repro or provide the patch overlay if useful.

threads.title: dsh web 在 Chrome 下用 127.0.0.1 访问时特权 API 全部 403(pickDirectory/设置/凭据),localhost 正常
threads.bodyText:
环境

macOS (Intel), Google Chrome 150
dsh 0.1.1-rc.2(@deepseek-ai/dsh,npm 安装),通过 dsh web 启动 Web UI

现象
dsh web 自动打开浏览器访问 http://127.0.0.1:3080 后:

点击 "添加工作区" 报错:transport failure for /api/host.pickDirectory: HTTP 403
实际不止 pickDirectory —— 所有特权 API 全部 403:host.pickDirectory、host.describe、settings.*、credentials.*、agentPreset.*(PRIVILEGED_METHODS 里的方法)
页面加载后特权请求持续重试失败,服务器端每失败一次打一条 403

关键线索:换 http://localhost:3080 访问,一切正常。
根因分析(已定位)
两层原因叠加:
1. Chrome 对 127.0.0.1 的 Origin 头剥掉了非默认端口
在 http://127.0.0.1:3080 页面上,Chrome 发出的同源 fetch 请求头是:
Host: 127.0.0.1:3080
Origin: http://127.0.0.1        ← 端口 3080 被剥掉了!
Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin
Referer: http://127.0.0.1:3080/

(服务器端抓包确认。开源 Chromium headless 不发这种 Origin,所以自动化测试复现不了,必须用真实 Chrome。localhost 域名形式的页面不受影响。)
2. dsh 信任围栏做严格的 Origin.host === Host 字符串比较
packages/client/connection/src/api-request-trust.ts 的 isTrustedApiRequest:
const origin = header(request.headers, 'origin')
if (origin === undefined) return true
try {
  return new URL(origin).host === hostUrl.host
} catch {
  return false
}

new URL("http://127.0.0.1").host → "127.0.0.1"
hostUrl.host → "127.0.0.1:3080"
不相等 → 403

服务器端实测矩阵(POST /api/host.pickDirectory):



请求
结果




Host: 127.0.0.1:3080 + Origin: http://127.0.0.1:3080
通过(415,进入 RPC)


Host: 127.0.0.1:3080 + Origin: http://127.0.0.1(Chrome 实际发的)
403


Host: localhost:3080 + Origin: http://localhost:3080
通过


无 Origin
通过



Workaround
浏览器地址栏用 http://localhost:3080(不要用 127.0.0.1:3080)。
修复建议

治本:信任围栏对 loopback 主机名的 Origin 比较应忽略端口差异(比较 hostname 而不是带端口的 host),或对 loopback + 相同 hostname 的情况放行;
降低触发概率:dsh web 启动自动打开浏览器时默认用 localhost 而非 127.0.0.1。

提问
有没有其他人遇到同样的 403?尤其 Windows 上是否也有(Chrome 是否对 127.0.0.1 有同样行为)?如果确认是 Chrome 通用行为,建议尽快修信任围栏 —— 目前 127.0.0.1 这个自动打开默认地址对 Chrome 用户是必现故障。

threads.title: Two preset-mounting bugs in 0.1.1-rc.2 (symlinked preset dirs skipped in discovery; duplicate inspect provider registration) — with patches
threads.bodyText:
Two independent bugs in agent-preset mounting, both reproduced in a live two-device fleet deployment of dsh 0.1.1-rc.2. Both are small, self-contained fixes; patches and a tested branch are linked below.
1. Preset discovery silently skips preset directories that are symlinks (@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets)
Symptom. A user preset materialized as a symlink (~/.dsh/.agent-presets/<id> → a directory in a synced shared tree) is absent from the roster with no broken: marker. Defaulting the preset to it fails with agent-preset-not-found, and the web GUI's New Session flow cannot commit a workspace (initial workspace selection failed: … agent-preset-not-found).
Root cause. scanRoot (packages/preset/agent-presets/src/discovery.ts) iterates readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true }) and filters on child.isDirectory(). For a symlink Dirent, isDirectory() is false — so a linked preset directory is skipped entirely.
Fix. Follow symlink children with stat (which resolves links) before the directory test; a broken link skips exactly like a non-directory. Roster paths remain rooted at the scanned root (the link), which is the path a user edits.
2. tool-cordis re-registration fails the second preset mount (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis)
Symptom. With two presets that both compose the Cordis toolset mounted in one process (e.g. the shipped cordis preset plus a user preset including dsh-tool-cordis), the second preset mount fails:
agent-preset-invalid: preset "…" failed to mount: failed to apply loader entry tool-cordis (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis):
Host Cordis inspect provider "Service" is already registered

In the web GUI this surfaces as Model operation failed: internal: resume failed for session … — the session becomes unusable and its preset is not selectable in the composer.
Root cause. The Host inspect registry is process-global and rejects duplicate provider ids. apply() in packages/extensions/tool-cordis/src/index.ts unconditionally registers all four first-party Host inspect providers on every preset mount, so the second mount throws.
Fix + scoping note. The first-party Host providers are safe to register once per process: Service/Event/Builtin answer from static catalogs, and the Tool provider resolves the requesting agent at query time (ctx.tools.schemas(context.agent)). apply() now skips providers already registered by an earlier mount and registers the rest as before. If per-mount providers are ever added, they belong in a different registration path (a refcount was considered and rejected: the registrations carry no per-mount state).
Verification

packages/preset/agent-presets: two regression tests added to tests/discovery.spec.ts (symlink to a preset outside the root is discovered healthy with the link path; broken symlink skipped). Full file passes 23/23 under vitest.
packages/extensions/tool-cordis: tests/cordis-lifecycle.spec.ts passes 11/11; tsc --noEmit clean for both packages against the built workspace (tsc -b tsconfig.host.json).
Both commits pass the repo's lefthook pre-commit checks (lint 0 warnings / 0 errors, whitespace, vendor manifest guard).
Field verification on two devices: symlinked preset discovered and mounted; cordis + a fleet preset coexisting in one process, second mount applies cleanly, session resumes, preset picker round-trips.

Patches
Branch: https://github.com/boeykokchin1969/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/preset-symlink-discovery-and-inspect-reregister (2 commits on b150a55)

0001-agent-presets-discover-preset-directories-that-are-symlinks.patch
0002-tool-cordis-reuse-existing-first-party-inspect-registrations.patch

Happy to rework the second fix as a refcounting variant if the team prefers symmetric register/unregister semantics, or to split the changes differently for review.

Follow-up (2026-08-26): a third silent-failure mode found while fleet-testing — one invalid YAML key kills the entire llm-pi-ai namespace
While debugging "custom providers disappear from the Models UI" on one of two machines (identical dsh 0.1.1-rc.2, identical composed configs, byte-identical provider blocks — except one), I instrumented dsh-settings + dsh-llm-pi-ai and traced it to a single model entry in settings.yaml:
reasoningEfforts:
  false: low   # <- the poison
The schema expects the enum keys off | minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh | max (plus a boolean-false literal, which is unreachable from a parsed file, since JS object keys are strings). The failure mode is what I'd like to flag:

SettingsProvider.register() resolves the stored section synchronously; a schema failure throws, which kills the owning plugin's ctx.inject(["settings"]) fiber before setSource/onChange/watch are wired. The adapter then stays at zero routes forever.
The throw surfaces nowhere I could find — no journal line, no UI error, no toast on the web face. Observable symptoms only: Models page lists built-ins only, "Add a custom provider" disabled, "This model is unavailable — select one to continue" in the composer, and NO_ADAPTER at session start for any route that provider owns.
Compounding: publish() keeps the last good value for a namespace whose stored section fails, so a process that registered before the bad data landed keeps working. My second machine (valid key) ran fine the whole time — which made the failure look machine-dependent.

Suggested improvements:

Surface register-time validation failures: at minimum a logged error, ideally a visible note on the Models settings page naming the offending provider/model.
The seam already refuses invalid WRITES (settings.mutate -> settings-rejected); a read that fails registration could arguably keep a last-good/empty resolution instead of killing the namespace's consumer.
The Models UI add-provider flow is where the false: key came from (the "no effort" case); emitting off: (the enum string) would have been valid.

Repro: put any llm-pi-ai provider model entry with a reasoningEfforts key outside the enum (e.g. false) in settings.yaml, start dsh web -> Models page shows built-ins only; dsh --profile headless with that provider as default -> NO_ADAPTER.
Local fix: change the key to off: (or remove the entry). Happy to share the instrumented patches if useful.

threads.title: Plugin-origin tool calls hang indefinitely while built-in tools work
threads.bodyText:
Environment

DSH: @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7 (installed via npx), Node v24.19.0
OS: Windows
Plugin: dsh-secure-audit (reproduced on v0.1.0 and v0.2.2)

Steps to reproduce
From a run_code program, call any plugin-registered tool, e.g.:
await tools.security_scan_text({ text: "hello", maskText: true });
await tools.security_redact_text({ text: "hello" });
await tools.security_redact_json({ json: "{\"a\":1}" });

Expected
The call settles within the tool declared timeoutMs (8000 ms) - either a result or a timeout error, like every built-in tool.
Actual
The call never settles. The run_code execution is interrupted with no result recorded. This happens for every plugin-origin tool, on both plugin versions, while all built-in tools (pwsh, read, write, edit, glob, grep, web_search, skill) work normally in the same session.
Observations

The plugin defineTool declares timeoutMs 8000, and its execute is fast by design (rule-scan budget 100 ms; 96/96 local tests pass; execution returns in milliseconds when run directly against the plugin modules).
The harness never surfaces a timeout error either - so the timeout does not appear to be enforced on the plugin-tool bridge.
Related contract issue (now fixed in the plugin): a runtime skill registered as { name, description, content } made the skill loader throw "loaded skill security-review source must be a string" because the loader requires a source field. Adding source fixed skill loading, but plugin tool execution still hangs - suggesting the plugin to host bridge itself, not the plugin logic.

Additional check
Diffed the published npm tarballs: dsh-tools, dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread, dsh-skill, dsh-session, dsh-web-app lib code is unchanged or only unrelated changes between 0.1.0-rc.7 and 0.1.1-rc.2, so this is still present in the latest published version. Happy to provide more detail or run diagnostics.

threads.title: 目前DSH当历史任务过多的情况下，点击SubAgent经常会timeout
threads.bodyText:
打开一个子代理的对话历史时，服务端依次发生：
先做一次全库扫描来“验证关系”：subagents.history 第一步是 catalogChild（api-proxy.ts:2640），它调用 ctx.subagents.listChildren(parentSessionId)；而 listChildren 每次都调 prepareListing → persistence.list() 全量扫盘（subagent/subagent/src/list-children.ts:217）——readdir 533 个项目目录、4311 个会话每个做 2 次存在性检查 + 打开 + 解压首个 zstd 帧。这一步只是为了确认“这个 child 确实是这个 parent 的”。
冷子代理走 inspect 时再扫一次全库：已完成的子代理不在内存里（attached 才走内存快路径，api-proxy.ts:2650-2656）。冷路径 inspectServable → inspectApiRemoteSession（api/remotes/src/agent-lookup.ts:102）第一行就是 (await persistence.list()).find(...)——为了查一个“会话存在不存在”，又把 4311 个会话全扫一遍。
然后整文件解压子代理日志：persistence.inspect(id) → loadStored → findLog（不知道 cwd，第三次遍历所有项目目录找文件）→ 从头读完并解压整个 session.jsonl.zstd（jsonl 后端无 seek）。更糟的是 prepared 缓存默认只有 5 个会话（DEFAULT_PREPARED_SESSION_CACHE_SIZE = 5，coordinator.ts:27）——你连续点开几个不同的子代理，每个都重新解压一遍。
以上全部发生在同一个 Node 进程里，扫描和解压的 I/O 回调 + 大 JSON 序列化会挤占事件循环，正在跑的任务的实时输出推送也被拖慢——所以加载子代理历史时整个页面都顿。
比侧边栏更糟的一点：侧边栏只在连接/刷新时拉一次 session.list，而 listChildren 在每次打开子代理历史之前、每次目录刷新、每次重连（对选中的会话和每个打开的目录都会 refreshSubagents）都要重付全量扫描。

threads.title: directory-picker-browse: New-folder errors show `invalid payload for host.createDirectory` because the UI drops rpcError.details.issues
threads.bodyText:
Summary
In the browse directory picker, typing/pasting an absolute path into the New folder name field surfaces invalid payload for host.createDirectory to the end user. The actionable text the schema already produces (host.createDirectory requires a single non-blank path segment name) is transported correctly but dropped by the picker UI.
Reported by a non-technical Windows user of a product built on dsh; the message told them nothing about what was wrong or what to do.
All three packages at 0.1.0-rc.7. Electron host on Windows 10/11 x64.
Reproduction

Open the browse directory picker (@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-browse).
Click New folder.
Enter an absolute path instead of a single name, e.g. D:\Projects\demo.
Click Create.

Observed: red inline text invalid payload for host.createDirectory.
Expected: something like "Enter a folder name only — to create it somewhere else, use Edit path."
Where it is lost
The payload is correctly rejected, with a specific reason:
dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/types/api/host.schema.js:44-45
}).refine(payload => payload.name.trim() !== '' && payload.name !== '.' && payload.name !== '..'
    && !/[/\\]/.test(payload.name),
    { message: 'host.createDirectory requires a single non-blank path segment name' });
dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:4857-4862 — the generic message, with the zod issues preserved under details:
const payload = route.schema.safeParse(message.payload);
if (!payload.success) return errorResponse(message.rpcId, {
    code: "bad-request",
    message: `invalid payload for ${method}`,
    details: { issues: payload.error.issues }
});
So the proxy does the right thing: details.issues[0].message carries the readable sentence.
dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse/lib/client.js:113-116 — the picker's failure-text helper reads only message:
/** Failure text: the Host business message when typed, else the throw's text. */
if (error instanceof DirectoryBrowseError) return error.rpcError.message;
return error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
details.issues is never consulted, so the specific reason is discarded at the very last step before display.
Suggested fixes
1. Use the detail that is already there. When rpcError.code === 'bad-request' and rpcError.details?.issues?.length, prefer the first issue's message over the generic one. That alone turns the above into host.createDirectory requires a single non-blank path segment name — still developer-flavoured, but at least it names the actual constraint.
2. Validate in the field, before the round trip. The New-folder input knows it wants one segment (browser.folderName). Rejecting / and \ inline, with a hint pointing at the existing Edit path affordance (browser.editPath), fixes the real user problem: they were not trying to name a folder oddly, they were trying to go somewhere else. Pasting a full path into the only text field on screen is a very natural mistake when the target is on another drive.
3. Optional — say so in the label. browser.untitledFolder as placeholder reads as "type a name here"; an explicit hint ("name only") would cost nothing.
Note on a related constraint
dsh-host-directory-picker-browse/lib/index.js:225 uses non-recursive mkdir, so multi-level creation is not possible even with a corrected message. That is a reasonable default, but it means a user targeting D:\A\B must create A, enter it, then create B. Worth mentioning in the same hint.

Filed from the same downstream product as
#4330 (the Windows native-picker segfault). That one is confirmed fixed for us by switching the win32 backend to browse; this report is about the browse backend's own UX.

threads.title: [Bug] Typing or dragging text selection in composer scrolls chat transcript to bottom when scrolled up
threads.bodyText:
Description
In a conversation with enough history to scroll, when the user scrolls up to view older messages and then types or drags to select text inside the composer textarea, the chat transcript automatically scrolls down incrementally with every typed or selected character until it reaches the very bottom.
Steps to Reproduce

Open any session with enough messages to enable scrolling.
Scroll up to inspect older messages (so the scrollport is not at the bottom).
Click into the composer textarea and:

Type some characters, OR
Click and drag the mouse to select text inside the textarea.


Observation: With every single character typed or selected, the parent conversation scroll container (data-conversation-scroll) scrolls down step-by-step, eventually jumping all the way to the bottom.

Environment

DSH Version: 0.1.1-rc.2
OS: Windows
Browser: Chromium (Chrome / Edge) / WebKit

Preliminary Analysis (Hypothesis only, for maintainer reference)
Note: This is a preliminary deduction based on inspecting the frontend layout and has not been verified with a full code patch.

The composer seat (.wSkVaW_composerSeat) is nested inside the conversation scrolling container (.wSkVaW_scrollBody with data-conversation-scroll) using CSS position: sticky; bottom: 0.
When typing or dragging to select text within the absolute-positioned <textarea> (.uV2eYG_input), the browser text/selection engine native selection tracking (ScrollRectToVisible / autoscroll) appears to evaluate the selection coordinates against the ancestor scroll container normal layout flow, propagating unintended downward scroll increments to the parent scrollBody.

Expected Behavior
Typing or selecting text in the composer should not affect the scroll position of the conversation transcript when inspecting history.

threads.title: [BUG] Python SDK当 session ID 存在时无法 resume 对话
threads.bodyText:
Python SDK 当session ID 存在时无法resume对话：
import json

from pathlib import Path
from deepseek_harness import DeepSeekHarness, DeepSeekHarnessConfig

cwd = Path(".").resolve()
config = Path("./cordis.yml").resolve()
session = Path(".sessions").resolve()

while True:
    with DeepSeekHarness(
        config=DeepSeekHarnessConfig(
            provider="openai",
            model="Qwen3.8",
            max_tokens=15200,
            cordis=str(config),
            cwd=str(cwd),
            session_root=str(session),
            base_url="http://***",
            api_key="sk-***",
        )
    ) as harness:
        query = input("user->")
        result = harness.run(query, session_id="id-123")

        print(result.session_root, result.session_id)
        print(result.final_response)
结论：不是 Python SDK 不持久化，而是 SDK server 从不“恢复”已存在的会话
1. 架构上：Python SDK 本身不做任何持久化
DeepSeekHarness 是一个很薄的客户端——它只是用 subprocess 拉起一个 Node 运行时进程（deepseek_harness_runtime → @deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-jsonrpc-server），通过 stdio JSON-RPC 发 session/prompt。真正写 JSONL 的是那个子进程里的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 插件，根目录由 DSH_SESSION_ROOT 决定（python/sdk/src/deepseek_harness/api.py:64-65）。
2. 你脚本里的关键问题：with DeepSeekHarness(...) 在 while True 里
你的循环每转一圈就新建一个运行时子进程。于是第二次起，session_id="id-123" 面对的是一个全新的进程。
而 SDK server 的 createSession（packages/sdk/server/src/server.ts:218-231）对每个 sessionId 无条件走“新建会话”路径：
const handle = await this.ctx.agents.create({ sessionId, meta: { cwd }, ... })
agents.create（packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts:589）调的是 ctx.sessions.prepare(id, { meta })——内存里从零新建一个空会话，不会去读磁盘。agent-loop 里其实有 resume()（index.ts:653，会通过 sessionPersistence.prepare(id) 把历史加载进来），但 SDK server 从来没调用它。
3. 于是发生“id 冲突”，后续全部不落盘
新进程里这个空会话被 announce 后，持久化协调器 onCreated（packages/session/session-persistence/src/coordinator.ts:1237）发现磁盘上已有 id-123 的日志，走 adoptLivePrefix：因为新会话的 seed 是空的，无法覆盖已持久化的前缀，直接抛：
session "id-123" already has a persisted log on disk that does not match this live session (id collision)
这个错误被吸收进 write-behind 的初始化 promise（coordinator.ts:1181 的 .catch），所以对话还能正常跑、还能返回回答；但之后每个写入都会 await 这个已 reject 的 init 而失败 → JSONL 一个字都不更新，模型也看不到之前的上下文。进程退出时 flush 再抛一次，又被 disposeAndExit 里的 Promise.allSettled 和 Python 客户端 close() 的 except 吞掉，所以你根本看不到报错。
相关讨论：
#167
#712
