threads.title: pnpm run build fails with misleading MISSING_EXPORT when deleted packages leave manifest-less directories behind
threads.bodyText:
Summary
After a refactor that deletes or moves packages, any working copy that has been built before accumulates manifest-less directories containing only ignored build output (lib/, node_modules/, *.tsbuildinfo). git clean -fd does not remove them (they are gitignored), and the tsdown workspace glob (packages/*/*, vendor/*, apps/cli) still matches them. The stale lib trees then get bundled, and the build fails with confusing MISSING_EXPORT errors that reference paths from before the refactor.
Environment

master @ cd5ef814 (merge of #3248, dsh-0.1.2-alpha.1)
macOS 15 arm64, node v24.19.0, pnpm 11.7.0
Observed from a desktop client that runs git reset --hard + git clean -fd + pnpm install + pnpm run build on every update

What happened in the wild
After updating to cd5ef814, the build failed with Build failed with 7 errors repeated across ~134 tsdown projects (a 300 MB log), all pointing at exports that no longer exist:
[MISSING_EXPORT] "apiRemoteSubagentOwnershipError" is not exported by "../../api/remotes/src/index.ts".
[MISSING_EXPORT] "ApiRemoteSubagentSessionOwnership" is not exported by "../../api/remotes/src/index.ts".
ERROR  Error: Build failed with 7 errors:   ← ×134

Note ../../api/remotes/src/index.ts: the package had already moved to packages/api/remotes. The path comes from stale build output of a deleted package (packages/host/apiproxy), not from anything in the current tree.
Root cause

The refactor deleted packages (e.g. packages/host/apiproxy, packages/client/runtime, packages/examples/*). git reset --hard removes their tracked files, but the gitignored lib/ and node_modules/ survive git clean -fd, leaving manifest-less directories.
tsdown's workspace enumeration matches directories by glob and does not require package.json. For a directory without its own tsdown.config.ts, config loading walks up to the root config, whose host-face entry is lib/types/{index,invariant,startup}.js.
The stale lib/types/*.js resolves as the entry and rolldown bundles it; its imports reference symbols the refactor removed → MISSING_EXPORT. The misleading relative path is resolved from the stale artifact's own location.

Minimal reproduction (30 seconds, on a built tree)
mkdir -p packages/host/apiproxy/lib/types
cat > packages/host/apiproxy/lib/types/index.js <<'REPRO'
import { apiRemoteSubagentOwnershipError } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes';
export { apiRemoteSubagentOwnershipError };
REPRO
pnpm exec tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host   # → MISSING_EXPORT, exits 1
rm -rf packages/host/apiproxy                 # → build works again
scripts/clean.ts already handles exactly this case (manifest-less directories whose content is only known residue are removed; unknown content aborts the clean), and pnpm run clean unblocked us — a full pnpm install && pnpm run build afterwards succeeds (393 tsdown builds, 218 client artifacts recorded). But nothing runs or even points to the clean script when the build fails, so the failure looks like a broken tree at the new commit.
Suggestions

Run the orphan/residue planning from scripts/clean.ts (plan-only) at the start of scripts/build.ts and fail with an actionable message, e.g. "stale manifest-less package directories found — run pnpm run clean".
If feasible in the tsdown workspace config, skip directories without package.json during workspace enumeration.
Document pnpm run clean as the recovery step after refactors that delete or move packages.

threads.title: 会话日志在回合中断后因已提交 seq 回退而整条不可加载
threads.bodyText:
中断-恢复后，turn/end 先提交了 seq，同一回合的流式输出仍按旧 seq 继续写入，读取器 fail-closed 拒载——一次错误的中间关闭帧让整条会话历史不可用。

复现、预期与验收


复现步骤：

长会话（数十万事件）运行中经历中断-恢复（服务重启、浏览器断连、或上下文压缩 checkpoint）
之后打开该会话的历史



实际结果：
历史加载失败：history unavailable ... Error: corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 51854 (expected 587030, got 587028)。
本机两次独立会话的同类损坏（脱敏后相邻事件序列，seq+type）：
会话 A：
... assistant/chunk#215756 , step/end#215757 , turn/end#215758 , assistant/chunk#215757 , assistant/chunk#215758 , ...
会话 B：
... turn/end#587029 , assistant/chunk#587028 , ...（读取时报 expected 587030, got 587028）

形态：终止逻辑先写 step/end+turn/end（把 seq 提交推高），同一回合的流式 chunk 随后仍从被提交过的 seq 继续写——「中间错误关闭帧」。读取器只容忍末尾 torn frame，无法恢复中间的已提交回退，于是整条历史不可用（fail-closed）。删除该错误帧后，用 DSH 自身解码逻辑全量重扫验证 681858 条事件 seq 完全连续（本机已验证，原始文件已备份）。


预期结果：

写入/终止串行化：turn/end 的提交与流式输出互斥，任何中断-恢复都不能产生已提交 seq 回退；或
读取器把「已结束回合之后又出现的同回合后续事件」视为可恢复的无效记录（丢弃该错误帧、只损失当前回合），而不是让整条会话失效。



环境：
DSH 0.1.1-rc.2，Windows 11，web profile（多插件）；损坏发生在长会话的中断-恢复窗口（无 host 崩溃，重启/断连/压缩即可触发）。


验收条件：
任意中断-恢复后历史仍可加载（或最多只损失损坏回合，不损失整条历史）。

threads.title: Plugin list (Web Settings) conflates host composition with per-session preset enablement
threads.bodyText:
What's misleading
The Web GUI's Settings → Plugins → Plugin list tab shows model-facing tool rows (e.g. tool-pwsh, tool-fs, tool-goal, plan-mode, compaction-basic) as Disabled even when the active session's agent preset has them enabled and they are working. A user on the standard preset running on Windows sees tool-pwsh marked Disabled and reasonably concludes the tool is off — but the session is actually using it.
Not a duplicate. I searched the Discussions (English and 中文) before posting. The closest neighbors are #4980 (profile patch targeting a disabled row is a silent no-op — same root cause, different angle: the patch no-op rather than the badge confusion), #2107 / #2367 (web ships the compaction stack disabled — the functional consequence of the same design), #1393 (host + preset double-mount of tool-skill silently drops the catalog), #4810 (add enablement filters to the Plugin list — treats the badge as correct), #4609 (add enable/disable toggles to the Plugin list — a working on/off button), and #2574 / #2066 (minimal preset has no command channel on Windows). None reports the angle here: the badge conflates host composition with per-session preset enablement, so it reads as a global on/off that isn't. This is part of a family of host-vs-preset layering gaps; cross-links below.
Why the badge is wrong
The inventory is a host-composition snapshot only:

dsh-base declares tool-pwsh enabled on Windows (disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32').
dsh-web-app overrides it to disabled: true unconditionally in the web bundle, because the web surface moved the agent plane behind agent presets — the host row is deliberately off so a preset can grant the tool per session.
The Plugin list (@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-plugin-inventory, RPC pluginInventory/list) reads ctx.loader.entries() from the host Loader tree. It does not reflect per-agent mounts that a preset applies into a session's private realm.

So the badge reports the host row (off) while the session is running the tool (on via preset). The two are different layers, and the UI conflates them into one "Enabled/Disabled" state. The package's own README already names this as a deferred limitation ("Read-only Loader view … no plugin mutation controls").
Steps to reproduce

Boot dsh --profile web (default standard preset).
Start a session; confirm the session preset chip reads standard.
Open Settings → Plugins → Plugin list.
Observe tool-pwsh (and other model-facing tool rows) show Disabled while the same session can invoke pwsh normally.

Suggested resolution
Any of, so the badge stops reading as a global on/off:

annotate per-agent tool rows (e.g. "off at host — granted by the active preset");
link from the Plugin list to the Agent presets tab ("these tools are preset-scoped — manage them here");
or make the inventory project the effective per-session enablement for a selected session, not just the host tree.

This composes cleanly with #4810 (enablement filters) and #4609 (enable/disable toggles): once the badge is honest about which layer it reports, those controls become trustworthy.
Affected surface

packages/host/plugin-inventory/ (pluginInventory/list, ctx.loader.entries())
packages/client/ui-settings-plugin-inventory/ (read-only Plugin list tab)
packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml (the disabled: true overrides that move the agent plane behind presets)

Related

#4980 — profile patch targeting a disabled row is a silent no-op (same root cause, patch-override angle)
#2107, #2367 — web profile ships compaction stack disabled (functional consequence)
#1393 — host + preset double-mount of tool-skill silently drops the skill catalog
#4810 — add enablement filters to the plugin inventory (same surface, complementary)
#4609 — add enable/disable toggle in the Web plugin list (same surface, complementary)
#2574, #2066 — minimal preset has no command channel on Windows (same Windows+tool theme, different preset)
#1782, #1697 — host-plane registrations invisible to agents (similar vocabulary, different root cause: pnpm hoisting / dual-instance dsh-tools)

Environment

Windows host, PowerShell 7, dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 (local checkout master)
Web GUI at http://127.0.0.1:3080, profile web, preset standard (标准模式)

threads.title: Bug: pre-existing TS errors block pnpm run build on master (5 errors in test files, @types/react bigint/ReactNode)
threads.bodyText:
Bug report — pre-existing TypeScript errors block pnpm run build / build:lib:client on master (5 errors in test files)
Summary
pnpm run build (and build:lib:client → tsc -b tsconfig.client.json) fails on current master (cd5ef814) with 5 TypeScript errors in 3 test files that are unrelated to any recent change — all ReactNode-vs-bigint incompatibilities from @types/react under exactOptionalPropertyTypes. This blocks the canonical build for any contributor (including CI on Windows).
Reproduction

Fresh shallow clone of master at cd5ef814, Node v24.9.0, pnpm install (lockfile).
pnpm exec tsc -b tsconfig.client.json → exit 1.

Errors (path:line)
packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/input-bar.client.spec.tsx(150,9): error TS2375
  Type '{ rightItems?: ... bigint ... }' is not assignable to type 'ComposerBarProps' with
  'exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true'. Types of property 'accessory' are incompatible.
  Type 'bigint' is not assignable to type 'ReactNode'.
packages/client/ui-renderer/tests/session-provider.client.spec.tsx(161,26): error TS2322
  Type 'React.ReactNode' is not assignable to type 'ReactNode'. Type 'bigint' is not assignable to type 'ReactNode'.
packages/client/ui-renderer/tests/session-provider.client.spec.tsx(184,26): error TS2322 (same)
packages/client/ui-renderer/tests/session-provider.client.spec.tsx(211,26): error TS2322 (same)
packages/test-support/client-runtime/tests/runtime.client.spec.tsx(326,34): error TS2322 (same)

The failing files are byte-identical to the original HEAD (git diff cd5ef814 -- <file> is empty), so the errors are pre-existing on master, not introduced by local work.
Likely cause
@types/react@18.3.31 widened ReactNode handling (or a bigint-typed value/new React type resolution under "types"/skipLibCheck settings in tsconfig.client.json) interacting with exactOptionalPropertyTypes: true in tsconfig.base.client.json. Worth checking whether a @types/react pin or a tsconfig.base.client.json skipLibCheck/ReactNode adjustment is intended.
Impact

pnpm run build (used by CI and by the web dev loop pre-requisite) fails on the client phase.
Contributors who only need the web dist must bypass the test-including typecheck (e.g. a src-only aggregate), which is not the documented path.

Suggested fix (for maintainers)
Either pin @types/react to a version whose ReactNode accepts bigint, or add skipLibCheck: true to the client typecheck aggregate, or adjust the three test files' fixtures. Happy to open a PR with the fix once external PRs are accepted (CONTRIBUTING.md currently declines external PRs).

threads.title: ## 🐛 发送消息时「排队发送」面板短暂闪现
threads.bodyText:
@discussion
🐛 发送消息时「排队发送」面板短暂闪现
描述
在 AI 空闲状态下发送消息时，「排队发送」面板（包含编辑/删除/插话按钮）会短暂闪现一下后消失。该面板仅应在 AI 正在回复时出现（用于排队管理），空闲时不应触发。
复现步骤

确保 AI 处于空闲状态（没有正在回复的消息）
输入一条消息并点击发送
观察消息发送瞬间

期望行为
AI 空闲时发送消息，消息直接变成对话气泡，不出现排队面板。
实际行为
发送消息时，_7yHdaG_panel（排队发送面板）短暂闪现约 1-2 帧后消失，然后消息正常显示为气泡。

threads.title: 使用cpa反代codex gpt 5.6 luna时 提示权限升级错误
threads.bodyText:
标题：[Bug] Same-level sandbox_permissions causes invalid escalation error
问题描述：
在 DSH 中，当当前沙箱权限已经是 workspace-write 或 danger-full-access 时，如果工具调用再次传入相同的 sandbox_permissions，工具调用会失败并报告权限升级错误。
该问题可在以下环境中复现：

DSH portable
CPA reverse proxy
gpt-5.6-luna
Responses protocol

环境信息：

DSH portable：0.1.1-rc.2
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app：0.1.1-rc.2
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox：0.1.1-rc.2
OS：Windows
Reverse proxy：CPA
Model：gpt-5.6-luna
API protocol：Responses
Approval policy：ask 和 never 下均观察到同类问题

复现步骤：

启动 DSH，并将当前有效沙箱权限设置为 danger-full-access。
调用一个支持沙箱权限的工具，例如 pwsh。
在工具调用中传入与当前权限相同的参数：

{
"sandbox_permissions": "danger-full-access",
"justification": "run the command"
}
以下组合也可以复现：
当前权限：workspace-write
请求权限：workspace-write
实际结果：
工具调用在命令执行前失败，并返回：
sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode
或者：
sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode
即使当前已经是 danger-full-access，仍然会被当作一次非法权限升级请求。
预期结果：
当请求的 sandbox_permissions 与当前有效权限相同时，应将其视为幂等请求，不应触发审批，也不应报错，而是直接使用当前有效权限执行。
只有在请求权限严格高于当前权限时，才应该进入权限升级和审批流程。
预期的权限关系：
read-only → workspace-write / danger-full-access
workspace-write → danger-full-access
danger-full-access → 无需升级
具体来说：
当前：workspace-write
请求：workspace-write
结果：按当前权限执行，不报错
当前：danger-full-access
请求：danger-full-access
结果：按当前权限执行，不报错
根因分析：
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox 中的 approveEscalation() 只检查请求权限是否存在于严格更高权限列表中。
当前逻辑类似于：
if (!(WIDER_MODES[effectiveMode] ?? []).includes(mode)) {
throw new Error(
sandbox escalation to "${mode}" is not strictly wider than this call's current "${effectiveMode}" mode
);
}
当 mode === effectiveMode 时，该请求实际上不需要升级，但当前实现仍然会进入严格权限检查并抛出错误。
对于 danger-full-access，由于它已经是最高权限，WIDER_MODES["danger-full-access"] 没有更高权限，因此同级请求必然失败。
建议修复：
建议在严格权限检查之前增加同级权限短路：
if (mode === effectiveMode) return effectiveMode;
if (!(WIDER_MODES[effectiveMode] ?? []).includes(mode)) {
throw new Error(
sandbox escalation to "${mode}" is not strictly wider than this call's current "${effectiveMode}" mode
);
}
这样可以：

允许同级权限请求正常执行；
不会额外授予任何权限；
不会触发不必要的审批；
继续拒绝低于当前权限或非法的权限请求；
保持真正的权限升级流程不变。

相关代码位置：
源码包：packages/sandbox/sandbox
已安装运行文件：@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox/lib/index.js
相关函数：approveEscalation()
关于 Responses protocol 和反代：
当前使用的是 Responses protocol，模型通过 CPA reverse proxy 接入 gpt-5.6-luna。
Responses 风格的结构化工具调用可能会保留或重复传递可选的 sandbox_permissions 字段，但这不应导致 DSH 在同级权限请求上报错。
反代层当然可以避免在普通工具调用中注入 sandbox_permissions，但 DSH 运行时仍应安全处理同级权限请求，因为该请求不会带来任何权限提升。
因此，这个问题的核心应属于 DSH 沙箱升级逻辑的边界处理问题，而不是 Responses protocol 不受支持，也不是用户的权限配置错误。

threads.title: loader 静默丢弃函数式插件的 inject 声明，首次访问依赖才报错
threads.bodyText:
unwrapExports 解包默认导出时静默丢弃同级的 inject 等命名导出，插件照常加载但依赖声明丢失，首次访问服务才报错。

复现、预期与验收

复现步骤：



写一个函数式插件（ESM，最常见的书写方式——默认导出函数、元数据具名导出）：
// my-plugin/index.js
export const inject = ["llm"];

export default function apply(ctx) {
  ctx.on("llm/stream", (payload, next) => {
    ctx.llm; // 首次访问注入服务
    return next();
  });
}


经 loader 加载：
# cordis.yml
- name: ./my-plugin/index.js
  id: my-plugin


触发任意一次 llm/stream（例如手动 /compact 或任意模型调用）。



实际结果：


插件在加载时正常 apply（loader 只记录一条 "apply plugin"），无任何警告。
首次访问注入服务时抛出：Error: cannot get property "llm" without inject（本例发生在 compaction/start 后 1ms）。
机制（已对照源码逐行确认）：

Loader.unwrapExports（vendor/loader/src/index.ts，当前 master 原样保留；npm 构建 @deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader@1.0.2 lib/index.js:736）：
exports = exports.default ?? exports —— 只要存在默认导出，就返回裸 apply 函数，模块命名空间上的同级 inject / name / Config 全部被丢弃；
ctx.registry.plugin（@deepseek-ai/cordis lib/index.js:1634）以 Inject.resolve(plugin.inject) 构建 fiber —— plugin.inject 为 undefined，依赖图为空；
上下文代理 get handler（lib/index.js:675）发现属性既不在任何 fiber store、也不在 fiber.inject，抛错。


对照：类式插件（export default class P { static inject = [...] }）与命名空间式（无默认导出，export const inject + export function apply）都正常；只有"默认导出函数 + 具名元数据"这一形态静默失败。
与 postmortem 0001（docs/postmortem/0001-acp-default-export-drops-inject.md）的关系：该 postmortem 已记录同一 bug 类（ACP 桥的 export default apply 事故，PR #41 修复）。但 0001 的修复是删掉那一个插件里的多余默认导出 + 补 e2e 测试，loader 的静默丢弃行为本身未变（今日已核对 master 上 unwrapExports 原样保留）；其"不要加 export default"的教训只存在于仓库 README/postmortem 内部，外部插件作者从发布物、loader 报错或文档中都无法发现。
实际影响（本次会话）：用户自写插件 dsh-compaction-fallback（llm/stream 拦截、摘要路由到备用模型）因该形态静默丢失 llm 注入，手动 /compact 在 compaction/start 后 1ms 失败；自动压缩的摘要级同样被卡，数日内实际只有剪枝级在运行，排查耗时数小时。



预期结果（两层，其一即可）：


最小（诊断）：当 unwrapExports 解包到 .default、且被丢弃的命名空间带有 cordis 元数据键（至少 inject，含 name / Config）而解包值自身未定义时，在加载时经 ctx.logger 输出警告，指明模块与被丢弃的键，并指向 postmortem 0001 / 插件编写文档。把"数小时后在首个 LLM 调用处炸"变成"加载时立刻可见"。


完整（健壮）：保留元数据——解包出的默认值自身没有 inject / name / Config 时，从被丢弃的命名空间继承（双方都定义时以默认值自身为准或告警），使自然 ESM 形态直接可用。


环境：


dsh 0.1.1-rc.2；@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader 1.0.2；@deepseek-ai/cordis（随 dsh 安装）；Node 22+；任意 profile（web/headless 均可复现）。


验收条件：



按 postmortem 0001 的"测试真实入口路径"规则，补一个无 key 的 e2e：经真实 Loader 加载 export default apply + export const inject 形态的插件，断言声明的 inject 被生效（或加载时出现指明被丢弃键的告警）。
该形态要么正常工作（依赖声明生效），要么在加载时产生明确的诊断输出；两者不得同时缺失。
命名空间式（无默认导出）与类式插件行为不变。

threads.bodyText:

而这个任务，一共有533次模型调用，单次的工具定义占用tokens是9.1K，整体这部分占用为533x9.1K约等于4850K tokens。

threads.title: deepseek-harness 默认附加 dsh_plugin_packages 导致第三方 OpenAI 兼容网关全部报错
threads.bodyText:
版本
dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.3 (dd6322d6)
问题描述
从 v0.1.2-alpha.1 引入的 [#2916](https://github.com/)（`feat(deepseek): upload plugin package metadata，commit ea6f61f）开始，llm-deepseek` 适配器默认会在每一条请求中附加以下最外层字段：
{
  "dsh_plugin_packages": []
}
该字段包含当前活跃插件包的 name 和 version 清单。
当 baseURL 不是 DeepSeek 官方端点时，例如：

OpenCode Zen Go：https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
kimi-k3 等第三方上游或兼容网关

这些服务通常会对请求参数进行严格校验。遇到不认识的最外层字段时，请求会被直接拒绝：
Upstream request failed: Unsupported request parameter(s): dsh_plugin_packages.

因此，从 v0.1.2-alpha.2 开始，所有通过 deepseek-official 路由访问第三方网关的请求，默认都可能失败。
如果用户显式开启了 dsh_session_log，也可能出现相同问题。
复现步骤
在 ~/.dsh/settings.yaml 中配置一个使用第三方网关的 DeepSeek provider：
llm-deepseek:
  baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
  models:
    - id: kimi-k3
随后发起任意一个通过 deepseek-official 路由的请求。
请求会立即失败，并返回：
Upstream request failed: Unsupported request parameter(s): dsh_plugin_packages.

期望行为
当 baseURL 指向非 DeepSeek 官方端点时，不应默认向请求中添加 DeepSeek 官方专属的诊断字段。
可以考虑以下任一方案：

仅在 baseURL 为 DeepSeek 官方端点时添加 dsh_plugin_packages；
为该字段提供显式配置开关，例如：

dsh_plugin_packages: false

将 plugin-package-inventory-deepseek 插件的默认状态改为禁用，由用户主动开启。

当前 plugin-package-inventory-deepseek 的 enabled 默认值为 true，会导致所有第三方兼容网关默认收到额外字段，影响范围较大。
临时解决方案
可以在 profile 的补丁层中禁用该扩展插件：
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml

- id: plugin-package-inventory-deepseek
  disabled: true
也可以通过 settings.yaml 禁用：
plugin-package-inventory-deepseek:
  enabled: false
影响
该问题会导致所有使用 llm-deepseek 适配器、通过 deepseek-official 路由访问严格校验请求参数的第三方网关时，请求默认失败。
第三方网关兼容性不应依赖用户手动发现并禁用诊断插件。默认配置应保证基础请求可以正常发送。

threads.title: danger-full-access 权限下 bash/edit/write 工具无法执行的问题
threads.bodyText: Harness 当前存在权限校验问题：在会话已经处于 danger-full-access、且 Approval prompts 为 Disabled 的情况下，调用 bash、edit 或 write 工具仍会重复触发 sandbox escalation。传入 danger-full-access 会报 sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode，传入 workspace-write 也会报 sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode。因此读取文件正常，但无法修改或创建文件，也无法运行 lint、测试和构建。预期是在当前权限已经满足请求时直接执行工具，或跳过重复的权限升级校验。初步判断是 Harness Runtime 的会话权限状态与 bash/edit/write 工具的 sandbox 权限校验逻辑不一致。

threads.title: Model list served/fetched by the harness is stale and incomplete — never refreshed from provider endpoints
threads.bodyText: Model list is stale/incomplete: the harness never refreshes provider model listings from the endpoints. In DSH 0.1.1-rc.2, the model selector only serves models hand-written in settings.yaml — a configured models list fully replaces the route catalog (resolveRouteModels in dsh-llm-pi-ai) — and the "fetch available models" action short-circuits to pi-ai's static built-in catalog for catalog-known providers instead of interrogating GET {baseURL}/models (discoverModels), while the official DeepSeek route ships a hardcoded 3-model catalog with no registerModelDiscovery at all. Live probe: opencode-go endpoint serves 33 models but the harness shows 3; zai-coding-cn serves 10 but shows 7; even the fetch action returns 16 entries, missing 17 models the endpoint actually serves. Please make discovery always query the live endpoint (falling back to the catalog on failure, merging catalog capacities onto endpoint ids) and register discovery for llm-deepseek.

threads.title: [Bug] dsh-browser: browser_open/browser_act crashes the dsh web process (CDP WebSocket has no error fallback); session resumes with "tool outcome unknown"
threads.bodyText:
Package: @deepseek-ai/dsh-browser@0.1.0-rc.1 (lib/index.js)
Environment: dsh web profile, Node v24.16.0, Windows (Edge/Chrome)
Symptom

Calling browser_open / browser_act (autonomous-browser tools) crashes the whole dsh web process: the cmd window returns to the prompt (process exits).
On the next launch, the resumed session shows:

"The tool call was interrupted after it was recorded, but no result was durably recorded. Its outcome is unknown."


Sometimes, instead of crashing, the turn hangs forever at "Deep diving..." and the Stop button does nothing (the tool call stays "running").

Root cause (in connectCdp)

ws.onmessage calls JSON.parse(ev.data) with no try/catch — a malformed/no-JSON CDP frame throws an uncaught exception and kills the process.
After the socket is open there is no onclose/onerror handler, so when Chrome dies or the connection drops, every pending send() promise never settles (infinite hang).
send() has no timeout, so even a live-but-unresponsive Chrome hangs the command forever.
spawn(chromePath, ...) has no error listener, so a spawn failure emits an unhandled error event that crashes the process.

Expected behavior
The CDP client should reject pending commands (surfacing a normal tool error to the model) on socket close/error, parse frames defensively, and time out stalled commands — instead of crashing the process or hanging the turn. A tool error should be recorded as tool/result (isError) so the conversation continues.
Suggested fix (I patched this locally and it works)

Wrap JSON.parse in try/catch.
Add onclose/onerror → reject all pending sends.
Add a timeout to send().
Add an error listener on the spawned Chrome process.

threads.title: 【BUG反馈】任务执行了快15小时了，现在一直卡在最后一步
threads.bodyText:
昨天晚上我使用deepseekharness开发，过去24小时了，现在任务一直在执行最后一步，但是api_无任何变化，

提示词如下
【角色设定】
你现在是一位资深的 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发专家，精通 Cordis 框架、defineTool 工具注册机制、Schemastery Schema 校验和 Windows 文件系统操作。请帮我编写一个名为 dsh-smart-disk-cleaner 的 Harness 原生工具插件，目标是发布为可上架的正式 Bundle。
【设计哲学——安全第一，清理第二，清理可还原】
本插件的核心原则是：任何破坏性操作都不可自动执行，必须经过用户确认；所有已执行的操作都必须可回滚。
参考项目 https://github.com/vudsen/ai-disk-cleaner 的三阶段架构：
扫描阶段：快速遍历目录，将文件树加载到内存
分析阶段：将扫描结果暴露为工具供 Agent（大模型）调用，由 LLM 智能识别垃圾文件并标记
执行阶段：结合 LLM 分析结果，由用户确认后执行清理或迁移操作
【插件类型判断】
本插件属于 Tool 类型（纯 Host 端后台能力），不需要 Client 端 UI。Agent 在对话中调用工具完成扫描、分析、清理、迁移等操作，结果以文本/表格形式返回对话界面。
【项目结构规范】
请严格按照以下目录结构生成代码：
文本
编辑
dsh-smart-disk-cleaner/
├── src/
│   ├── index.ts            # 插件入口，导出 name / inject / Config / apply
│   ├── scanner.ts          # 目录扫描与空间分析模块
│   ├── quarantine.ts       # 隔离区管理模块（移入/恢复/列表）
│   ├── migrator.ts         # 符号链接迁移模块
│   ├── safety.ts           # 安全校验模块（黑名单/权限检查）
│   ├── logger.ts           # 审计日志模块（基于 ctx.logger 封装）
│   └── types.ts            # 所有 TypeScript 类型/接口定义
├── tests/
│   ├── scanner.test.ts
│   ├── safety.test.ts
│   └── quarantine.test.ts
├── package.json
├── tsconfig.json
├── tsdown.config.ts
├── cordis.patch.yml        # Bundle 配置层文件（发布用）
├── cordis.yml              # 本地开发调试用（--patch 加载）
├── .gitignore
├── LICENSE
├── README.md
└── CHANGELOG.md
【package.json 规范】
必须包含以下关键字段：
json
编辑
{
"name": "dsh-smart-disk-cleaner",
"version": "0.1.0",
"type": "module",
"main": "lib/index.js",
"files": ["lib", "cordis.patch.yml"],
"scripts": {
"build": "tsdown",
"prepare": "tsdown",
"test": "vitest run",
"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"
},
"dependencies": {
"proper-lockfile": "^4.1.2"
},
"devDependencies": {
"@deepseek-ai/cordis": "workspace:^",
"@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": "workspace:^",
"@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "workspace:^",
"typescript": "^5.0.0",
"tsdown": "latest",
"vitest": "latest"
},
"dsh": {
"bundle": {
"patch": "./cordis.patch.yml"
}
}
}
【tsconfig.json 规范】
json
编辑
{
"compilerOptions": {
"target": "ES2022",
"module": "ESNext",
"moduleResolution": "bundler",
"declaration": true,
"declarationMap": true,
"sourceMap": true,
"outDir": "lib",
"rootDir": "src",
"strict": true,
"esModuleInterop": true,
"skipLibCheck": true,
"forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
"resolveJsonModule": true,
"isolatedModules": true
},
"include": ["src"],
"exclude": ["node_modules", "lib", "tests"]
}
【tsdown.config.ts 规范】
typescript
编辑
import { defineConfig } from 'tsdown'
export default defineConfig({
entry: ['src/index.ts'],
format: 'esm',
dts: true,
sourcemap: true,
clean: true,
external: [
'@deepseek-ai/cordis',
'@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools',
'@deepseek-ai/schemastery',
],
})
【.gitignore 规范】
文本
编辑
node_modules/
lib/
*.tsbuildinfo
.dsh/
.DS_Store
*.log
【Config 配置规范（Schemastery Schema）】
在 src/index.ts 中，使用 @deepseek-ai/schemastery 定义插件配置：
typescript
编辑
import Schema from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
export interface Config {
blacklist: string[]
excludeDirs: string[]
quarantineRetentionHours: number
maxScanResults: number
migrateSpaceBuffer: number
}
export const Config = Schema.object({
blacklist: Schema.array(Schema.string()).default([
'C:\Windows',
'C:\Program Files',
'C:\Program Files (x86)',
'C:\ProgramData',
'C:\$Recycle.Bin',
'C:\System Volume Information'
]),
excludeDirs: Schema.array(Schema.string()).default([
'node_modules', '.git', 'pycache', '.venv'
]),
quarantineRetentionHours: Schema.number().default(72),
maxScanResults: Schema.number().default(50),
migrateSpaceBuffer: Schema.number().default(1.1),
})
用户可在 cordis.patch.yml 的 config: 字段覆盖任意默认值。
【插件入口规范】
src/index.ts 必须严格遵循以下结构：
typescript
编辑
import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'
import Schema from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
export const name = 'dsh-smart-disk-cleaner'
export const inject = ['tools']
// Config 接口 + Schema 定义（如上）
export function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config) {
// 1. 注册工具
ctx.tools.register(defineTool({ /* ... */ }))
// 2. 用 ctx.effect() 管理生命周期资源
ctx.effect(() => {
// 启动隔离区过期清理定时器等
const timer = setInterval(() => { /* 清理过期隔离文件 */ }, 3600000)
return () => {
clearInterval(timer)
ctx.logger.info('[smart-disk-cleaner] 定时器已清理')
}
})
}
【核心工作流程——对齐 AIDiskCleaner 的三阶段架构】
阶段一：扫描（Scan）
插件提供 scan 动作，递归遍历指定目录，返回占用空间最大的前 N 个文件/文件夹（N 从 config.maxScanResults 读取，默认 50）。
内存保护：扫描过程中设置内存上限（如最多缓存 10 万个文件条目），超出时停止遍历并返回已扫描结果 + 警告信息，防止 OOM。
扫描结果以 JSON 格式返回，每个结果包含：
absolutePath：文件的绝对路径
size：文件大小（字节）
lastModified：最后修改时间（ISO 8601 格式）
isDirectory：是否为目录
depth：相对于扫描根目录的深度
阶段二：AI 智能风险分级（由 Agent 完成，非插件代码）
插件的 scan 动作只负责返回扫描结果。风险分级由 Harness Agent（大模型）根据扫描到的文件路径、文件名、扩展名等信息，在对话中自动分析并分为三类：
🟢 安全清理（如：.tmp、.log、.cache、旧安装包、浏览器缓存）
🟡 建议迁移（如：Docker 镜像、WSL 虚拟磁盘、本地大模型文件、开发工具缓存）
🔴 高危保留（如：.exe、.dll、.sys、注册表文件、当前运行程序的配置文件）
Agent 将分析结果以 Markdown 表格形式返回给用户，等待用户确认。
阶段三：执行操作（用户确认后）
根据 Agent 的分类结果和用户确认，插件执行以下操作：
功能一：安全删除（带隔离区机制）
delete 动作：不直接删除文件，而是移动到隔离区目录（路径使用 path.join(os.homedir(), '.dsh', 'quarantine') 解析，确保 Windows 兼容性），生成 QuarantineRecord 写入 quarantine-manifest.json
隔离区文件保留 config.quarantineRetentionHours 小时，过期后标记为可清理
restore 动作：根据 QuarantineRecord 将文件移回原始路径
quarantine-list 动作：返回当前隔离区所有记录，包含原始路径、移入时间、剩余保留时长
幂等性：对已存在于隔离区的文件重复执行 delete，应跳过并返回提示，不报错
功能二：无感迁移（符号链接技术）
migrate 动作：针对用户确认"建议迁移"的文件/目录
校验目标磁盘可用空间 ≥ 源文件总大小 × config.migrateSpaceBuffer
完整复制文件/目录到目标路径
校验完整性：对比源和目标的文件数量与总大小
删除原位置文件
在原位置创建符号链接（fs.symlink）指向新位置。必须根据 isDirectory 字段设置 type 参数：目录用 'dir'，文件用 'file'
写入 MigrationRecord 到 migration-manifest.json
Windows 符号链接权限处理：
优先尝试创建符号链接（fs.symlink）
如果因权限不足（EPERM）失败，自动降级为创建 Junction（fs.symlink(target, path, 'junction')），Junction 不需要管理员权限
如果 Junction 也失败（如跨盘符文件场景），则放弃迁移并返回错误 ERR_SYMLINK_FAILED，提示用户以管理员身份运行或开启开发者模式
undo-migrate 动作：根据 MigrationRecord 反向操作——删除符号链接/Junction、将文件复制回原位、删除目标位置副本
并发安全：执行迁移前获取文件锁（使用 proper-lockfile），防止并发操作冲突
任一步骤失败则中止并回滚已执行步骤，确保不会出现"原文件已删、新文件未到位"的中间状态
功能三：操作审计日志
基于 DSH 内置的 ctx.logger 输出到控制台
同时写入持久化日志文件（路径：path.join(os.homedir(), '.dsh', 'logs', 'smart-disk-cleaner.log')）
格式：[ISO8601时间戳] [级别] [模块名] 消息内容
级别：INFO、WARN、ERROR、ROLLBACK
日志文件按天轮转，保留最近 30 天
【工具注册规范】
使用 defineTool 注册一个名为 smart_disk_cleaner 的工具，参数如下：
表格
参数	必填条件	JSON Schema	说明
action	始终必填	{ type: 'string', enum: ['scan', 'delete', 'migrate', 'restore', 'quarantine-list', 'undo-migrate'] }	执行的操作类型
targetPath	scan/delete/migrate	{ type: 'string' }	目标路径
destPath	migrate/restore	{ type: 'string' }	迁移/恢复目标路径
fileList	delete/migrate	{ type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }	用户确认要操作的文件路径列表
output 必须包含 render 函数：
typescript
编辑
output: {
schema: { type: 'string' },
render: (_args, value) => [{ type: 'text', text: value }],
}
【安全校验模块（safety.ts）】
黑名单从 config.blacklist 读取，每次执行 delete 或 migrate 前，对 fileList 中的每个路径逐一校验
路径比较使用 path.resolve() 标准化后再做前缀匹配，防止 C:\Windows.. 等绕过
命中黑名单则拒绝该条并返回结构化错误
校验用户当前进程是否有目标路径的读写权限，无权限则返回结构化错误
扫描时跳过黑名单路径，遇到无权限目录记录警告日志并跳过，不中断扫描
【错误码规范】
所有错误必须返回结构化对象 { error: true, code: string, message: string }，错误码定义如下：
表格
错误码	含义
ERR_BLACKLIST_HIT	路径命中安全黑名单
ERR_PERMISSION_DENIED	无权限操作目标路径
ERR_PATH_NOT_FOUND	目标路径不存在
ERR_INSUFFICIENT_SPACE	目标磁盘空间不足
ERR_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH	迁移后文件完整性校验失败
ERR_SYMLINK_FAILED	符号链接创建失败（含权限不足）
ERR_LOCK_CONFLICT	文件锁冲突，操作被拒绝
ERR_ALREADY_QUARANTINED	文件已在隔离区中（幂等跳过）
ERR_QUARANTINE_EXPIRED	隔离区文件已过期
ERR_RESTORE_PATH_EXISTS	恢复时原路径已有同名文件
ERR_SCAN_MEMORY_LIMIT	扫描文件数超过内存保护上限
【类型系统规范】
在 src/types.ts 中必须定义以下接口，所有模块共享：
ScannedFile：{ absolutePath: string; size: number; lastModified: string; isDirectory: boolean; depth: number }
RiskLevel：'safe' | 'suggest-migrate' | 'dangerous'
QuarantineRecord：{ originalPath: string; quarantinedPath: string; movedAt: string; expiresAt: string; fileSize: number }
MigrationRecord：{ sourcePath: string; destPath: string; symlinkPath: string; symlinkType: 'file' | 'dir' | 'junction'; migratedAt: string; fileSize: number }
OperationLog：{ timestamp: string; action: string; targetPath: string; status: 'success' | 'failed' | 'rolled-back'; detail?: string }
【cordis.patch.yml 规范（发布用）】
yaml
编辑

name: dsh-smart-disk-cleaner
config:
quarantineRetentionHours: 72
maxScanResults: 50

threads.title: Bug report: Session containing deleted/corrupted plugin cause dsh unable to load the session log
Alpha.3 Web profile cannot load rc.8-era plugins
threads.bodyText:
Compatibility issue: alpha.3 core cannot load rc.8-era @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all@0.2.5
Environment

DSH core/runtime: @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.3
Node.js: v24.19.0
Host package: FreeCodeCampXYG/starline-dsh-desktop
Reproduction package/release: Starline DSH Desktop v0.6.17
Windows portable offline runtime, launched with the Web profile

Reproduction

Keep an existing Web profile that enables @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all@0.2.5.
Start the profile with the alpha.3 offline runtime.
The loader reports repeated plugin import failures and the Web profile does not start successfully.

Representative errors:
The requested module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings' does not provide an export named 'installSettingsSection'
The requested module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings' does not provide an export named 'settingsNamespace'
Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy'

The failing imports originate from the installed @linxin666/* plugin packages under the user's Web profile. The current alpha.3 runtime provides @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@0.1.2-alpha.3; the plugin package metadata still declares the older ^0.1.0-rc.8 API line.
Expected behavior
Could alpha.3 either provide a compatibility path/error classification for older Web plugins, or document the required plugin version boundary? A clear startup diagnostic would also help users distinguish an incompatible persisted profile from a broken offline runtime.
Workaround
Disabling/removing the old @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all bundle from the Web profile allows testing the base profile separately. I have not deleted sessions, credentials, or the packaged runtime.
Thanks for confirming whether an alpha.3-compatible release of the plugin family is planned, or whether the profile should be migrated/reinstalled against a new plugin contract.

threads.title: Message-box context indicator shows the previous model's window after switching models in the picker
threads.bodyText:
Message-box context indicator stays on the previous model's window after switching models in the picker
Summary
The context-window number rendered inside the message input box (token-meter) keeps showing the previous model's window after the user switches models in the picker. It only updates when the next outgoing request fires a request/context event.
The picker change itself does not refresh the indicator, even though the selected model's contextWindow is already resolved at that point.
Environment

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.2-alpha.3 (commit dd6322d604)
Web UI at http://127.0.0.1:3080
Provider: OpenRouter (via the llm-pi-ai adapter)
Two affected models: <MODEL_A_ID> (advertised <WINDOW_A>) and <MODEL_B_ID> (advertised <WINDOW_B>) — I left the real IDs out of this template, see the note at the bottom

Reproduction

Start a fresh session.
Select <MODEL_A_ID> in the model picker. Send a message. The indicator in the message box shows <WINDOW_A>. ✅
Without sending another message, switch the picker to <MODEL_B_ID>. The indicator still shows <WINDOW_A>. ❌
Send a message. The outgoing request resolves <MODEL_B_ID>, the agent loop appends a new request/context, and only now does the indicator jump to <WINDOW_B>.

Expected
The indicator should reflect the currently selected model's window, not the window of the most recent completed request. Either of these is fine:

Update the indicator (and any other consumer of the contextPressure projection) when the picker changes, using the already-resolved model.contextWindow from the catalog, or
Emit a request/context event at resolve-time so the projection's "last-wins" rule picks it up before the next outgoing request.

Where in the code
The projection only updates contextWindow on request/context events:

packages/llm/token-meter/src/usage-projection.ts:188 — the contextPressure projection's apply only changes state.contextWindow when event.type === 'request/context'.

request/context is only appended per outgoing request, not on model change:

packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:531 — the agent loop appends a request/context event just before issuing a request, and only when the resolved provider / model / contextWindow differs from the previous one. The picker change never reaches this path because no request has been issued yet.

The picker change does have the data it needs but does not push it to the session's token-meter projection:

packages/llm/llm/src/index.ts:774 — LlmResolvedModelInfo.context is computed and validated at resolve time, but the resolved value is not written back to the session until the agent loop runs.

Suggested fix (sketch)
A small, low-risk change would be to append a request/context event from the model-picker's onChange handler (or from the resolve path itself) using the already-known model.contextWindow. Because the projection is "last-wins" and dedupes on equality (agent.ts:528-532), a duplicate that matches the last request is a no-op, so over-emit on the picker side is safe.
Tests
packages/llm/token-meter/tests/token-usage-projection.spec.ts:313 covers the "stays correct across successive requests" case. There is no equivalent test for "picker changed, no new request yet" — adding one would lock the desired behavior in.
Workaround
None on the client. The "stale until next request" behavior is by design but is not documented in the message-box UI.
Note
This report is filed from a DSH checkout where I have redacted the exact model IDs. The two models are both surfaced through OpenRouter, with advertised context windows that differ by a factor of ~4. The bug is the same regardless of which pair of models is used: the indicator follows the last request/context event, not the picker's current value.

threads.title: [Resolved / transient] DSH rc.2 openai-codex / gpt-5.6-sol returned overloaded; same session now succeeds
threads.bodyText:
NoteResolution update (2026-09-03): this no longer reproduces and is being closed as a transient incident. The same DSH session was continued without any User-Agent or request-body shim and completed further gpt-5.6-sol tool steps successfully. DSH is still 0.1.1-rc.2, dsh-llm-pi-ai is still 0.1.1-rc.2, and pi-ai is still 0.82.1; the installed LLM package files match their npm tarballs byte-for-byte, and the OAuth grant did not rotate between failure and success. The failed turn had already completed two tool steps (create_goal, then todo_write) before a later model step returned overloaded; the resumed turn completed get_goal and update_goal. This falsifies the deterministic “legacy tools are rejected” interpretation. The Responses Lite wire difference below is real but was not the established cause. Most likely this was transient provider capacity/routing behavior. The original hypothesis is retained below only as investigation history.

ImportantCorrection after follow-up: Pi Coding Agent 0.84.4, with its embedded @earendil-works/pi-ai@0.84.4, is currently working normally with openai-codex / gpt-5.6-sol, including multi-step tool calls. Therefore this is not evidence that Pi or pi-ai 0.84.4 is generally broken for Sol. This report is now scoped to the DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 integration path. The Responses Lite source difference is real, but its causal connection to the DSH failure is unproven; a capability gate would be premature without reproducing on stock DSH alpha.4 / pi-ai 0.84.4.

Summary
openai-codex / gpt-5.6-sol agent turns on DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 can terminate with:
Codex error: Our servers are currently overloaded. Please try again later.
failure.code = PI_AI_ERROR

In the observed DSH session, the model first produced a normal response and a create_goal tool call. After the tool result was recorded, the next model request failed before generation with input/output usage both zero. The same account and model complete tool calls in the official Codex CLI 0.146.1.
This has the same visible symptom as #3306 and #3407, but those discussions focus on error classification and retries. There is also a separate request-dialect mismatch: official Codex marks gpt-5.6-sol as a Responses Lite model, while the pi-ai version resolved by this DSH release still emits the legacy top-level instructions and tools request shape.
I am not proposing a User-Agent/header workaround. Local compatibility experiments were removed. After verifying current Pi Coding Agent behavior, Responses Lite should be treated as a diagnostic difference to investigate—not as an established fix or a reason by itself to withhold Sol.
Versions

DSH: 0.1.1-rc.2
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai: 0.1.1-rc.2
resolved @earendil-works/pi-ai: 0.82.1
provider/model: openai-codex / gpt-5.6-sol
reasoning effort: high
transport: SSE
comparison client: official Codex CLI 0.146.1

Request-format difference
DSH maps assembled tools to pi-ai Context.tools. pi-ai 0.82.1 then sends top-level instructions and top-level tools, with parallel_tool_calls: true.
Official Codex CLI 0.146.1 marks gpt-5.6-sol with use_responses_lite: true. Its Responses Lite branch instead:

moves tools to an input item with type: "additional_tools" and role: "developer";
moves base instructions to a developer message in input;
omits top-level instructions and tools;
disables parallel tool calls;
uses reasoning.context: "all_turns".

A loopback capture of the official CLI request, sent only to a local HTTP server, confirmed this structure without recording credentials, prompt content, tool descriptions, schemas, IDs, or full payloads.
Source references

DSH pi-ai dependency: 
  
    
      deepseek-harness/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/package.json
    
    
        Lines 45 to 47
      in
      b150a55
    
  
  
    

        
          
           "dependencies": { 
        

        
          
             "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "^0.82.1", 
        

        
          
             "@deepseek-ai/schemastery": "workspace:^" 
        
    
  


DSH lock resolving pi-ai 0.82.1: 
  
    
      deepseek-harness/pnpm-lock.yaml
    
    
        Lines 5540 to 5542
      in
      b150a55
    
  
  
    

        
          
           '@earendil-works/pi-ai': 
        

        
          
             specifier: ^0.82.1 
        

        
          
             version: 0.82.1(@modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.29.0(zod@4.4.3))(ws@8.21.0)(zod@4.4.3) 
        
    
  


DSH tool-to-context mapping: 
  
    
      deepseek-harness/packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/context.ts
    
    
        Lines 116 to 133

related upstream request: earendil-works/pi#6516

Reproduction

Start DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 with an existing valid openai-codex OAuth grant.
Select openai-codex / gpt-5.6-sol, reasoning effort high.
In a fresh session, send a task that causes a normal DSH tool to be called.
Observe the request after its tool result, or use a harmless no-op function in an isolated adapter probe.
The request can terminate before generation with the overload sentence, PI_AI_ERROR, and zero token usage.
Run an equivalent tool task with official Codex CLI on the same account/model; it completes.

Please do not include authorization headers, OAuth grants, request IDs, full system prompts, message content, or complete payloads when reproducing.
Expected behavior
DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 should complete the same Sol tool loop that current Pi Coding Agent 0.84.4 completes. Before proposing a wire change or model gate, the request and behavior should be re-captured on stock DSH alpha.4, which resolves pi-ai 0.84.4.
Questions / suggested direction

What differs between current working Pi Coding Agent 0.84.4 and the failing DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 integration path (adapter headers, transport options, context/replay conversion, or resolved pi-ai behavior)?
Can the issue be reproduced on stock DSH alpha.4 / pi-ai 0.84.4 before changing the wire format or adding a capability gate?
Could the original structured provider error be retained? Classifying the sentence as retryable SERVER (#3407) helps real transient overloads, but retries alone cannot correct an incompatible request shape.

The source comparison proves the dialect difference. It strongly matches the tool-dependent failure, but I cannot claim knowledge of the provider's internal routing; a maintainer-owned wire fixture or integration test would make the causal link conclusive.

threads.title: [Bug] cannot get property "remote.session" without inject：model-selection directoryFor 在启动期崩溃（host/web-app 0.1.2-alpha.4）
threads.bodyText:
环境 Environment



组件
版本




@deepseek-ai/dsh（host）
0.1.2-alpha.4（npm 全局安装，systemd 守护）


@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app
0.1.2-alpha.4


@linxin666/dsh-web-all
0.3.12


Node.js
v26.8.0


OS
Linux（Omarchy），自托管 http://127.0.0.1:3080



复现步骤 Repro
无头浏览器直接打开即可复现，无需任何交互（web-all 0.3.12 的「官方 new-session 行为」会自动建会话并触发）：
chromium --headless=new --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --enable-logging=stderr --v=0 --virtual-time-budget=20000 --dump-dom "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=<YOUR_TOKEN>"

报错出现在 stderr 控制台日志中。每次加载必现（实测 3/3），抛出时机在 mcp-connector client apply() completed 后约 554ms。
现象 Observed
控制台输出顺序：
[dsh-perf] list gate: installed on sessions.list (coalesce projection-only publishes)
[git-graph] auto-isolation disabled: the workspaces service shape changed; using the official new-session behavior
[mcp-connector] client apply() called
[mcp-connector] registering shell.overlay slot
[mcp-connector] registering sidebar.footer.action slot
[mcp-connector] client apply() completed
Uncaught Error: cannot get property "remote.session" without inject
    at Object.get (index-Df-65__b.js:2:8044)
    at Proxy.directoryFor (client.js:304:1)
    at Object.apply (index-Df-65__b.js:2:7746)

影响：主界面正常渲染，但 conversation.input.model 座（输入框旁的模型选择器）不可用。两条 web-all 日志为优雅降级（服务形状探测），与本次崩溃无关。
初步定位 Analysis
崩溃点在 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection（web-app 自带）ModelDirectoryResolver.directoryFor()，bundle 第 304 行：
const directory = new ModelDirectory(this.ctx.remote.session, sessionId, () => sessions.subagentAddress(sessionId) === void 0, this.catalog, binding.session.projections.faceOf("modelSelection"));
关键事实：

remote.session 没有任何静态 provide。整个 application 批次检索不到它的 provide 注册。
它是动态 namespace：@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller 贡献 30+ 个 namespace: "session" 的 Typert 描述符，经 api-gateway 的 mountContribution（异步 enqueue → createNamespace + installMethods）安装。
同函数第 299-302 行 this.ctx.sessions.scope/binding 解析成功，唯独第 304 行 this.ctx.remote.session 失败 → 访问时 namespace 尚未安装。
boot manifest 中 model-selection 的 inject 只有 4 个插件级依赖（dsh-api-session-controller、dsh-client-locale、dsh-client-ui-commands、dsh-api-remotes），不含 remote.session；而 bundle 的 exports.inject 声明了 ["commandUi","locale","sessions","slots","remote","remote.session"] —— 依赖链存在但运行时装配断裂。

疑似根因：boot 期插件 apply 同步访问 remote.session，与 api-gateway 异步 mountContribution 存在时序/装配竞态；也可能与 alpha.4 的服务形状变化有关（web-all 0.3.12 已检测到 workspaces 形状变化并降级）。
期望 Expected
directoryFor 在 boot apply 期访问 remote.session 不应抛错；remote.session namespace 应在插件 apply 前安装完成。
附注：此前该报错曾被归因于第三方插件 agent-teams 调用 directoryFor；卸载后 model-selection 自身在 boot 期同样触发，确认与第三方插件无关。

threads.title: DeepSeek Harness 关于 API Key 自动读取和计费提示的问题
threads.bodyText:
我想反馈一个 DeepSeek Harness 关于 API Key 自动读取和计费提示的问题。
我首次通过 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 使用 DSH，没有登录 DeepSeek 账号，也没有在 DSH 中填写或授权任何 API Key。但启动后 DeepSeek Provider 已自动可用，并默认使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。直到出现 Insufficient Balance / QUOTA，我才发现 DSH 一直在消耗我的 DeepSeek API 余额。
排查后发现，DSH 自动读取了我此前为其他开发工具配置的系统环境变量 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。
我理解开发者工具自动读取环境变量是常见机制，但问题在于：DSH 在使用一个用户从未在 DSH 内主动配置过的付费 API Key 时，没有明确告知凭据来源，也没有提示调用将产生费用。 这很容易让用户误以为当前模型是 Harness 默认提供的能力或免费额度，尤其 Agent / Subagent 可能产生大量调用，存在非预期计费风险。
建议在首次检测到环境变量 API Key 时给予明确提示或确认，并在模型页面标注凭据来源及计费状态。
我认为核心问题是：“检测到 API Key”不应自动等同于“用户已明确授权 Harness 使用该 Key 产生费用”。

Bug: stale broken symlink in profile module-fallback makes every DeepSeek request fail with "request extension preparation failed"
Summary
After upgrading deepseek-harness to 0.1.2-alpha.3, every DeepSeek model request fails with:
dsh: REQUEST_EXTENSION: DeepSeek request extension preparation failed

Root cause: plugin-package-inventory-deepseek (enabled by default) fails to resolve the
package identity of one active plugin entry — @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json — because
its symlink under the shared profile module-fallback ($DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules) is a
stale broken symlink left over from the pre-upgrade dependency graph. healProfilesModuleFallback
never repairs or removes it, and the inventory plugin treats the lookup failure as fatal for the
whole request.
Environment

DSH version: 0.1.2-alpha.3 (upgraded in place from an older checkout)
OS: Windows 11
Node: v22.22.0
Layout: profile module fallback — $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules (shared) mirrors the
installation dependency closure; profiles load their plugin tree through healProfilesModuleFallback.

Reproduction
node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts --profile headless "reply ok"
# → dsh: REQUEST_EXTENSION: DeepSeek request extension preparation failed
(The same failure occurs in the web profile, which is how it was first observed.)
Precise failure point
Instrumenting the real headless loader and running plugin-package-inventory-deepseek's
per-entry PackageIdentityResolver.resolve() over all 85 active non-group entries yields
exactly one failure:
FAIL @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json: cannot resolve active package "@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json"
     (treeBase=file:///C:/Users/ASUS/.dsh/profiles/headless/)

The failing lookup is barePackageManifest() →
createRequire(anchor).resolve.paths(packageName) → existsSync(join(searchPath, packageName, 'package.json')).
The shared fallback symlink is broken:
$HOME/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json
  -> /…/deepseek-harness/apps/cli/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json
  (mtime 2026-08-14 15:03  — created BEFORE the upgrade; target no longer exists)

A healthy neighbour for contrast (re-created after the upgrade at 2026-09-02 20:31):
$HOME/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage
  -> /…/deepseek-harness/apps/cli/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage

Why the symlink is stale
resolveModuleFallbackEntries() (packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts) builds the fallback
entry set by BFS over the dependency graph from apps/cli/package.json (the install anchor).
@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json is declared as a dependency of dsh-base (and
session-controller, message-feedback, session-projection-cache, subagent) — i.e. it is
reached through the profile bundle layer, not through the apps/cli dependency closure.
After the upgrade it is no longer reachable from the install anchor's BFS, so it is absent
from resolveModuleFallbackEntries()'s result.
healProfilesModuleFallbackLocked() only iterates the current entries (creating/repairing
those symlinks) and never removes symlinks that are no longer in the entry set. The
pre-upgrade symlink therefore survives, still pointing at the old (now non-existent) path.
The entry still activates in the loader (Node resolves @deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json via the
workspace source package packages/storage/storage-json), so the plugin is present and ACTIVE —
but plugin-package-inventory-deepseek's independent existsSync-based lookup walks the
profile fallback directory and hits the broken link.
Why this takes down every request
plugin-package-inventory-deepseek/src/index.ts — resolve() throws on the failed lookup:
manifest = barePackageManifest(packageName, anchors)
if (manifest === undefined) {
  throw new Error(`plugin-package-inventory-deepseek: cannot resolve active package ${JSON.stringify(packageName)}`)
}
DeepSeekLlmApiExtensionRegistry.prepare() runs Promise.all over all registered providers,
so the throw propagates. llm-deepseek's adapter wraps it as
LlmError('DeepSeek request extension preparation failed', 'REQUEST_EXTENSION') — a hard
failure of every chat/completions request, before any HTTP dispatch.
Two distinct defects


healProfilesModuleFallback leaks stale symlinks. It has no sweep for entries that
dropped out of the resolved dependency closure, and moduleFallbackEntryCurrent() compares
only readlinkSync(link) === entry.packageDir (a path-string equality) without checking that
the target actually exists. After a dependency-graph change, stale broken links accumulate
and are never repaired or removed.


plugin-package-inventory-deepseek is fail-closed on a diagnostic field. A single
unresolvable package identity aborts the entire request. Since this field (dsh_plugin_packages)
is optional/observability-only, a failed lookup for one entry should degrade gracefully
(skip that entry, or omit the field) rather than fail the model request.


Suggested fixes

In healProfilesModuleFallbackLocked (or its caller), remove any symlink under the shared
fallback node_modules that is not present in the current entry set (or at least any that is
broken — lstat is a symlink but stat/existsSync fails).
In moduleFallbackEntryCurrent, for kind === 'symlink', also verify the target exists
(existsSync(join(entry.packageDir, 'package.json'))), so a broken link is treated as stale
and healed.
In plugin-package-inventory-deepseek, treat an unresolvable individual entry as a skip (or
log-and-continue) rather than throwing, so an observability field can never take down the
whole request path.

Workaround (applied locally)
Disable the plugin in each profile's cordis.patch.yml:
- id: plugin-package-inventory-deepseek
  disabled: true
This restores all DeepSeek requests. It sacrifices the dsh_plugin_packages diagnostic field,
not any functional behaviour.

threads.title: 长会话触发 Content Exists Risk / INVALID_REQUEST，整个会话被 400 拒绝，能否恢复？(dsh + DeepSeek API)
threads.bodyText:
我在用 dsh (DeepSeek Harness) + DeepSeek API 跑一个约 765 轮的长会话时遇到一个问题，想请教一下（也想确认这是不是已知 bug）：
现象
某个 turn 里一条 tool/result 的记录在会话日志里损坏了（内容未闭合、sourceEventSeqs 缺失/错位），从那之后整个会话的所有请求（包括仅发一句 "hi?"）都返回：

Content Exists Risk
INVALID_REQUEST (HTTP 400)

整个会话等于报废，发什么都 400。
已排查

会话日志文件 session.jsonl.zstd 里有一段 tool/result 的字节损坏（内容未闭合、被拆成非 JSON 行）。我手动清掉了坏行、补齐了缺失的 result，现在文件能完整解析、无语法错误，callId 引用也一致；
但修复后仍持续返回 Content Exists Risk / INVALID_REQUEST (400)。

想请教

这种"会话某处 tool/result / sourceEventSeqs 写盘损坏 → 之后整个会话被 400 拒绝"，是不是 dsh 的已知问题？我看到相关讨论：#5160（sourceEventSeqs 写盘导致 SessionPersistenceCorruptionError）和 #5439（损坏导致每个 DeepSeek 请求都被破坏）。是不是同一个根因？
有没有办法救回/恢复这种会话（比如导出上下文、剔除损坏记录后重新使用）？还是只能放弃？
Content Exists Risk 到底是上游 DeepSeek 的内容审查，还是 dsh 侧在校验上下文时抛的错误？客户端有没有规避/豁免的办法（比如重发时精简上下文、跳过坏记录）？

如果有朋友遇到过同样问题，麻烦分享一下处理方式，谢谢！

threads.title: [Bug/提案] 纯推理轮到 content or tool_calls must be set，毒死整会话：(serialize) 层缺少对 reasoning-only 空 content 的兜底
threads.bodyText:
症状 一个会话里某个 turn 之后，该会话之后每一轮都立即失败：
This turn failed: Invalid assistant message: content or tool_calls must be set   [code: INVALID_REQUEST, status: 400]
即使只回 "hi?" 也一样，整会话报废、无法续用。
复现
配置：llm-deepseek 指向平台代理（多厂商网关，Anthropic 兼容），model: deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp，reasoningEffort: high。
触发：模型某一轮只返回了 reasoning（思维链），没有正文、也没有工具调用（实验版模型 + 高推理时容易出现）。该纯推理轮被当作普通 assistant 消息持久化。
下一轮重放历史时，网关报 content or tool_calls must be set，此后每轮都失败。
根因 packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/serialize.ts 的 serializeAssistant()（~203 行）：
const text = flattenText(message.content)   // 只取 type==='text' 的块
const reasoning = message.content.filter(b => b.type === 'reasoning').map(b => b.text).join('')
const toolCalls = message.content.filter(b => b.type === 'tool-call').map(b => ({...}))
return {
  role: 'assistant',
  content: text,                            // ← 纯推理轮时 = ""（空串）
  ...reasoning ? { reasoning_content: reasoning } : {},
  ...toolCalls.length ? { tool_calls: toolCalls } : {},   // ← 无 tool-call 时省略
}
纯推理轮 → content: ""、无 tool_calls，仅带 reasoning_content。把空串当作"未设置 content"的网关（也不把 reasoning_content 映射为可接受内容）→ 直接 400。
对比 同文件多模态路径有兜底：
content: flattenText(result.content) || '(no output)'
唯独 serializeAssistant 这条没有——这是明显的不一致。
家族关系（跨引用） 这属于"一条坏消息就永久毒死整会话"的同一失败家族：#967、#3315（未配对 UTF-16 代理对）、#5160（sourceEventSeqs 写盘）、#5439（dsh-storage-json 符号链接）、#5445（tool/result 损坏 + 上游 Content Exists Risk）。 但以上都未覆盖本触发点（reasoning-only 空 content），代理对的 sanitize 修复（hungnnvidia 的 fork PR）也治不到这里。
提案
在序列化层做系统性加固，补上最后一个洞：
serializeAssistant 遇到"无 text 且无 tool-call 的 assistant 轮"（即为纯推理轮）时：从 wire 消息中剔除该轮（它对用户无可见内容，且思维回传规则仅对 tool-call 轮生效），或采用非空兜底。
配套回归测试：tests/serialize.spec.ts 增加 reasoning-only 用例（现有 reasoning 用例都带 text/tool，唯独缺 reasoning-only）。
与代理对 sanitize（sanitizeSurrogates）合并为"序列化层双洞加固"。
请教
这是不是已知且在修？"剔除纯推理轮"这个方案维护者是否接受，还是更倾向给个非空兜底？
从维护者角度，serializeAssistant 这条为啥没像多模态那条加 || '(no output)' 兜底（是否有保真/签名方面的刻意考量）？

threads.title: can not choose workspace and create ner session
dsh plugin exec cannot resolve installation peers before the first profile launch
threads.bodyText:
Update — September 18, 2026: DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2 switches ordinary profile launches from disk links to process-local runtime resolution, so the original launch-first workaround no longer repairs a fresh plugin subprocess. See the verified alpha.2 follow-up for the exact upstream patch, complete keyless regression, fresh repaired-host acceptance, and validation limits. The old report and historical patch below are retained for context. The official alpha.2 release has not been fixed by this local candidate.


DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 can leave a freshly installed plugin command unable to resolve peer packages supplied by the DSH installation.
Reproduction

Start with a fresh DSH home and DSH 0.1.2-rc.1.
Install an out-of-tree plugin that exposes a bin and declares @deepseek-ai/schemastery as a peer.
Before launching the profile, run the plugin bin through dsh plugin --profile <profile> exec <bin>.

The command fails with:
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package @deepseek-ai/schemastery imported from <profile>/node_modules/<plugin>/lib/...

A profile launch first makes the same command succeed.
Cause
Profile launch prepares $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules, the shared fallback containing installation-provided packages. The dsh plugin pnpm forwarder did not prepare that fallback, so a plugin executable invoked before the first launch could not resolve its DSH-provided peers.
Proposed fix
Prepare the installation module fallback after profile initialization and before forwarding every dsh plugin command. A self-contained built-bin regression installs a fixture with a Schemastery peer and executes it immediately.
Reference implementation: franksong2702@c90ea79
Verification
pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts apps/cli/tests/built-bin.e2e.ts -t "anchors a relative add spec|makes installation peers available|activates a dependency that gained"
# 3 passed

pnpm run doc-sync
# 32 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped

pnpm run build
# exit 0

threads.title: MCP client rejects content-only tool results (missing structuredContent) - breaks interop with servers declaring structured_output=false (e.g. OpenViking 0.4.17.1)
threads.bodyText:
Summary (EN)
dsh 0.1.2-rc.1's MCP client rejects tool results that contain only content blocks without structuredContent, even when the server explicitly declared structured_output=false for that tool (i.e. no outputSchema). This breaks interop with MCP servers whose tools legitimately return unstructured text/media output — allowed by the MCP spec, where structuredContent is optional.
环境 / Environment

dsh: 0.1.2-rc.1（npm 全通道最新，next tag；Windows 11）
对端 / peer: OpenViking 0.4.17.1（PyPI 最新正式版；Volcengine 开源的 MCP 上下文数据库服务器，监听 127.0.0.1:1933，streamable HTTP）

症状 / Symptom
调用 OpenViking 提供的 MCP 工具 read 时，dsh 侧直接拒收结果：
Error: tool "mcp__openviking__read" returned invalid output: missing required property "value.structuredContent"

同一服务器的 search / list / write 等工具（返回结构化结果）校验通过，只有 read 失败。
服务端证据 / Server-side evidence
OpenViking 0.4.17.1 的 openviking/server/mcp_endpoint.py 第 501 行起：
@mcp.tool(structured_output=False)
async def read(uris: str | list[str]) -> str | list[ContentBlock]:
0.4.17 起 OpenViking 的 read 工具改为返回纯文本 / 媒体 content block（配合 MCP 原生媒体返回特性），并显式声明 structured_output=False——即不声明 outputSchema、按 MCP 规范合法地只返回 content。已核对上游 main 分支（1,480 行版本）该处一致，即官方尚未调整。
分析 / Analysis

按 MCP 规范，CallToolResult 的 structuredContent 是可选字段；工具未声明 outputSchema 时，客户端不应要求它。
dsh 的 MCP 客户端在结果校验时似乎无条件要求 structuredContent（报错路径 value.structuredContent），导致任何合法返回 content-only 的服务器工具都会被拒。
双方均已处于各自最新发布版本（dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 为全通道最新；OpenViking 0.4.17.1 为最新稳定版），升级无法绕过，属于两侧互操作适配问题。

复现 / Repro

Windows 上 uv tool install "openviking[bot]==0.4.17.1"，启动 openviking-server --with-bot（127.0.0.1:1933）
dsh 挂接该 OpenViking MCP 端点
调用工具 read，参数如 {"uris": "viking://user/<uid>/memories/profile.md"}
dsh 报上方错误；同一读取走 HTTP API / CLI（ov read）正常；search/list/write 正常

期望行为 / Expected behavior
工具未声明 outputSchema 时，客户端应接受仅含 content 的结果，不强制要求 structuredContent（MCP 规范行为）。
建议修复 / Suggested fix
放宽 dsh MCP 结果校验：仅当工具声明了 outputSchema 时才要求 structuredContent；否则接受 content-only 结果。
本地临时绕过 / Local workaround
改用 ov read CLI 或 MCP search（自带 read_content 全文返回）；OpenViking 的自动记忆召回/会话捕获走 HTTP API 直连，不受影响。

threads.title: `danger-full-access` mode: tool schema still advertises `sandbox_permissions`, escalating to "the user rejected ..." when approval policy is forced to `never`
threads.bodyText:
TL;DR
When DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access is set:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml line 191 forces the approval service to policy: "never" (the JS expression (DSH_PERMISSION_MODE ?? 'workspace-write') === 'danger-full-access' ? 'never' : 'ask').
ctx.fs.sandboxMode is "danger-full-access" (not undefined), so FsSandboxController in @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs/lib/index.js:1111 still treats the backend as confining and advertises the escalation fields sandbox_permissions and justification on the write / edit (and on bash / pwsh for the shell families).
Whenever a model emits one of these tools with sandbox_permissions set, @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox/lib/index.js:106 (approveEscalation) hands the request to @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-approval/lib/index.js:175-179, which short-circuits on effectivePolicy === "never" and returns "rejected".
The error string returned to the model is "the user rejected escalating this <command|operation> to \"<mode>\"" — verbatim, hard-coded. The model interprets this as a real user refusal and on the next turn retries the same call, looping indefinitely.
The model-facing escalation hint (escalationHintMarker in @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox/lib/index.js:75-77) tells the model "the approval prompt asks the user", which reinforces the loop.

This is a structural contradiction: the file policy says "no confinement, anything goes", but the tool schema + approval pipeline still pretend the model is in a narrower mode and need to ask the user to widen it — except the user has explicitly forbidden being asked.
Reproduction


Set DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access (or set permission: { sandbox: danger-full-access, approval: never }).


Start a session and ask the model to perform a write or a shell command.


If the model happens to emit sandbox_permissions / justification on the call (the schema still lists them as valid values; the model frequently does so in non-trivial contexts, including when the prior turn emitted a sandbox-denial marker from another session), the call fails with:
Error: the user rejected escalating this operation to "danger-full-access"



The model retries with the same sandbox_permissions parameter; the rejection repeats.


The same loop happens for bash / pwsh (Windows) calls.
Why this is a bug, not a UX nit

The "user" never actually saw an approval prompt — the refusal is synthesized by effectivePolicy === "never". The wording is misleading to both the model and the human reading the transcript.
Under danger-full-access, the whole point of the mode is "no confinement, no questions asked". Yet the schema still advertises the escalation enum, and the runtime still attempts to escalate, just to fail in a misleading way.
escalationHintMarker is returned after every sandbox denial — including denials produced under danger-full-access (where the only reason a denial could fire would be a bug in fs-sandbox.checkedTarget or bash-sandbox returning an EPERM that didn't actually require widening). Telling the model to "retry with sandbox_permissions" in policy=never contexts is a self-referential dead end.
The preset-level mitigation (adding "do not set sandbox_permissions" to the persona prompt) is unreliable: the schema still lists the field, and the tool description for bash / pwsh (in @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash/lib/index.js:129 and @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh/lib/index.js:144) actively tells the model to do exactly that on a denial.

Affected versions
Reproducible on the current deepseek-harness distribution as shipped; line numbers above are from node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml and @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs, @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash, @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh, @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox, @deepseek-ai/dsh-user-approval in a fresh install.
Suggested fixes (any one would resolve it)
I think the cleanest fix is at the schema/advertisement boundary, not at the approval outcome:


Suppress escalation advertisement when the effective mode is already at the top of the WIDER_MODES ladder. In FsSandboxController (and the bash/pwsh equivalents), do not inject sandbox_permissions / justification into the tool schema when defaultMode === "danger-full-access" — there is nothing wider to escalate to. ESCALATION_TARGETS is intentionally a fixed closed list at @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox/lib/index.js:41, but the escalationModes slice in each tool plugin currently still advertises all of them under any confining backend.


Make escalationHintMarker policy-aware. When effectivePolicy === "never", return a neutral marker like [sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode — approval prompts are disabled; no escalation available] instead of instructing the model to retry with sandbox_permissions.


Make the never outcome wording honest. Replace "the user rejected escalating this <X> to "<mode>" (in approveEscalation, @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox/lib/index.js:106) with something like "approval prompts are disabled in this session; sandbox_permissions cannot widen to "<mode>" — retry without it". This stops the model from thinking a human actively refused.


(Optional) Allow dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml to be configured so that policy: never is paired with sandbox: danger-full-access (which already is — see line 203-205), but skip advertising escalation fields under that combination. The shipping default already pairs them; the missing piece is the advertisement-side filter.


Any single one of (1), (2), (3) is enough to break the loop. (1) is the most user-facing; (3) is the lowest-risk.
Workaround we currently use
A small dynamic Cordis plugin that registers a tools/pre-execute listener and denies any write / edit / bash / pwsh call that carries sandbox_permissions or justification. It works, but it's per-session and per-deployment; the structural fix belongs upstream. I can share the plugin source if useful.
Happy to open a PR for any of (1)-(3) — just let me know which direction the maintainers prefer.
References (paths in a fresh install)

node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml lines 169-205 — sandbox / approval wiring, and the never policy hard-coded for danger-full-access.
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-sandbox/lib/index.js lines 107-170 — SandboxedFileSystem, checkedTarget, the source of ctx.fs.sandboxMode.
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs/lib/index.js lines 1102-1188 — FsSandboxController, resolvePolicy, mapError.
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs/lib/index.js lines 617, 771 — sandbox_permissions injection into write / edit schema when escalationModes.length > 0.
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash/lib/index.js line 129 — tool description string instructing the model to escalate.
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh/lib/index.js line 144 — same for PowerShell.
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox/lib/index.js lines 41, 75-77, 92-110 — ESCALATION_TARGETS, escalationHintMarker, approveEscalation.
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-approval/lib/index.js lines 38-39, 155-179 — NEVER_SENTENCE, effectivePolicy, the hard-coded "rejected" short-circuit.

threads.title: 单流（single-stream）速度下降：170–180 Tok/s → 约 130 Tok/s，大家有遇到吗？
threads.bodyText:
单流（single-stream）速度下降：170–180 Tok/s → 约 130 Tok/s，大家有遇到吗？

一句话：这几天 DSH 里模型单流输出速度从几天前的 170–180 Tokens/s 掉到了 约 130 Tokens/s，想问问是不是只有我这样，还是大家都一样？作为对比，火山引擎的 DeepSeek 单流能做到 200+ Tokens/s。

现象 / The issue
我使用的是 DeepSeek 官方通道（DSH 默认接入）。同样的模型、同样的参数、同样的网络环境，最近几天单流生成速度明显下降：



时间
单流速度




前几天
170–180 Tokens/s


现在
约 130 Tokens/s



（注：这里指单流 / single-stream——即不开启多路并发推理时的单条流式输出速度；开启多流后总吞吐更高，但单流本身能反映单条链路的性能。）
想问大家 / Questions

有没有人和我一样，最近几天单流速度也下降了？（从 ~170–180 掉到 ~130 左右）
你们现在测到的单流速度大概是多少？在哪个区域 / 网络环境下？
是官方服务端近期有波动/调整，还是我这边（节点/网络）的问题？

如果只是我这边的问题，也欢迎指出来，我好排查。
对比：火山引擎 DeepSeek 能做到 200+ 单流 / FYI: Volcano Engine DeepSeek
作为参考，火山引擎（Volcano Engine）托管的 DeepSeek 单流速度可以达到 200+ Tokens/s，明显高于我目前从官方通道拿到的 ~130 Tok/s。
如果官方通道近期确有波动，火山这类第三方托管在单流吞吐上确实有明显优势，也值得大家对比参考。

欢迎大家贴自己的实测数据（模型、通道、区域、单流速度），一起确认是不是普遍现象。

threads.title: [BUG]Upgrade from rc.6 to 0.1.2-rc.1: models page dead until restart + lazy client bundle race
threads.bodyText: Feedback: DeepSeek Harness 0.1.2-rc.1 — upgrade & plugin ecosystem issues 环境：macOS · dsh 由 0.1.0-rc.6 升级到 0.1.2-rc.1（npx 缓存整体替换）· profile: web 时间：2026-08-17 ~ 2026-09-04 · 反馈人希望帮助改善 rc 阶段的升级体验 摘要 / TL;DR rc 阶段升级 + 第三方插件 = 连续两次"装完/升完才炸、还要外部工具救场"。以下 3 个问题若能解决，能大幅减少这类事故。 1.【高】升级后「模型设置页」僵死：provider 全空、点不动、无报错；重启才恢复 现象：从 0.1.0-rc.6 升级到 0.1.2-rc.1（期间 profile 被重装、多个插件升级）后： 聊天模型选择器只剩 deepseek； Settings → Models 页：之前配置过的 provider（zai/zhipu/kimi 等，settings.yaml 中仍在）全部不显示； 在 Models 页新增/编辑 provider 点了没反应，且没有任何报错； 完整重启 dsh 后一切恢复（provider 回来了、也能新增保存了）。 诊断线索： settings.yaml 中 llm-pi-ai.providers 内容完整、分区名未变（新版仍是 llm-pi-ai），pi-ai 内置目录（@earendil-works/pi-ai）也包含这些 provider id； 因此更像是运行实例在热更新/升级迁移后处于坏状态：设置注册静默失败、UI 保存静默 no-op，无任何日志/报错可查。 建议：a) 设置热更新失败时给出可见错误并自动回退/提示重启；b) 升级迁移后主动校验 llm 目录注册状态并上报；c) Models 页保存失败不要静默。 2.【中】重启后首个页面加载的竞态：懒加载 client 插件报 failed to load，且不重试 现象（0.1.0-rc.6 时也出现过）： failed to import loader entry 89315beb (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-input-trigger): client-modules: bundle script /plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-input-trigger/client.js?rev=0bd00b04060f failed to load 发生时机：dsh 重启后、服务器尚未完全就绪时，浏览器（旧页面自动重连/手动刷新）去拉非 immediately 的懒加载 client 条目，请求落空 →

threads.title: 运行 dsh web 时因从 node:zlib 错误导入 Zstd 函数而失败
threads.bodyText:
问题描述
在执行 dsh web 命令时（无论是通过 npx 还是全局安装），进程因 SyntaxError 而失败，错误信息显示 node:zlib 模块未导出 createZstdDecompress、zstdCompress、zstdDecompressSync 等函数。这表明 @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 包试图使用 Node.js 内置 zlib 模块中并不存在的 Zstandard（Zstd）压缩函数。
环境信息

操作系统：macOS（Darwin）
Node.js 版本：尝试过 v20.16.0、v22.14.0 和 v22.19.0（所有版本均出现相同错误）
包管理器：npm 10.8.1 / 11.4.1，pnpm 11.7.0
dsh 版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2（截至反馈时发布的最新版本）

复现步骤

执行 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web（或全局安装后运行 dsh web）。
出现如下错误：
SyntaxError: The requested module 'node:zlib' does not provide an export named 'createZstdDecompress'

（类似错误还会出现在 zstdCompress、zstdDecompressSync 和 PublicZstdFrameDecoder 上。）

完整错误片段：
file:///path/to/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:10
import { constants, createZstdDecompress, zstdCompress, zstdDecompress, zstdDecompressSync } from "node:zlib";
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
SyntaxError: The requested module 'node:zlib' does not provide an export named 'createZstdDecompress'

已尝试的临时解决方法

升级 Node.js 至 v22.14.0 和 v22.19.0 – 错误依然存在。
清除 npm/npx 缓存并重新全局安装 – 问题依旧。
从源码仓库（deepseek-harness）克隆并尝试本地构建：

修改了 zstd-private-decoder.ts、zstd-public-decoder.ts 和 zstd.ts，将 node:zlib 导入替换为虚拟实现，以在运行时绕过该错误。
但完整的工作空间构建因缺少内部依赖（如 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-webworker）和构建文档不完整而失败。


移除或模拟 dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 插件后，CLI 可以启动，但随后其他插件（如 typert-loader）因缺少编译后的包（lib/typert.host.js）而失败。

预期行为
dsh web 应正常启动本地 Web 界面，而不抛出模块导入错误。
问题分析
node:zlib 模块不支持 Zstandard（Zstd）压缩——它仅提供 gzip、deflate、brotli 等。@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 中的代码错误地假设 Zstd 函数可从 node:zlib 获取，这是一个明显的 Bug，影响所有用户，与 Node.js 版本无关。
此外，源码仓库的构建流程复杂，且缺乏清晰的构建与运行指南，使得用户难以在本地绕过该问题。
建议

移除对 node:zlib 中 Zstd 压缩/解压功能的依赖。
若确实需要 Zstd，请使用正确的第三方库（如 zstd 或 zstd-codec），并确保已安装。
或者，如果会话持久化功能尚不稳定，建议在当前发布版本中暂时禁用它，以保证 dsh web 基本功能可用。

感谢您维护此工具，期待修复。
