threads.title: [BUG] selectCompactableRange compares a real-window token budget against heuristic node prices
threads.bodyText:
selectCompactableRange compares a real-window token budget against heuristic node prices
Version: 0.1.5-rc.2
Packages: @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic, @deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter
Summary
selectCompactableRange spends retainTokens by summing
pricedNodes[i].tokens — the token meter's fixed char/4 estimate — while
retainTokens itself is derived from the routed model's real context window
(resolveCompactSpec: Math.floor(contextWindow * retainRatio)).
Those are two different units, and the meter is explicit about it:
TokenMeasurement.totalTokens is anchored on the provider's reported usage,
whereas nodes[].tokens is the fixed estimator, which projection.ts
documents as systematically underpricing CJK text and JSON schemas.
So retention holds back more of the surface than its budget names. When the two
scales are far enough apart, retention consumes the whole surface, the head
degenerates to tens of tokens, and summarizeCompaction then correctly refuses
every checkpoint offered to it:
summary is not smaller than the shadowed content (3480 estimated framed tokens >= 65)

A retry cannot help, since no summary is smaller than 65 tokens, so the pass
fails permanently at that pressure point while totalTokens stays over the
threshold.
Where
packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts:133-140
let accumulated = 0
let keepFromIdx = pricedNodes.length
for (let index = pricedNodes.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
  accumulated += pricedNodes[index]!.tokens   // fixed char/4 estimate
  keepFromIdx = index
  if (accumulated >= retainTokens) break      // fraction of the REAL window
}
against config.ts:
const retainTokens = policy.retainTokens === undefined
  ? Math.floor(contextWindow * policy.retainRatio)   // real-window scale
  : policy.retainTokens
The shrink comparison at region.ts:403 is not affected — it compares
estimateMessage(checkpoint) against shadowedRouteTokenCount, both on the
estimator's scale, and its comment says as much. As far as I can tell the
mismatch is confined to retention.
Reproducing
The two scales have to be far apart, which happens when surface content is
dense for the estimator — tabular JSON/TSV tool results, CJK text. With English
prose the ratio stays near 1.2x and retention behaves about as documented.
Arithmetic only, no model required: construct a surface whose node prices sum to
less than contextWindow * retainRatio, while a usage-anchored totalTokens
exceeds contextWindow * thresholdRatio. Call selectCompactableRange. It
returns null or a near-empty span, and the walk shows why — keepFromIdx
reaches firstIdx before accumulated reaches its budget.
End to end:

Mount token-meter + compaction-basic plus a tool returning tabular
JSON/TSV, contextWindow 32768, thresholdRatio 0.7 (threshold 22,937),
default retainRatio 0.16 (retainTokens 5,242).
Drive a session with dense tabular results until totalTokens crosses the
threshold.
At the crossing, compare measurement.totalTokens against
measurement.nodes.reduce((t, n) => t + n.tokens, 0).

Observed at the crossings in such a session: the node sum is a fraction of
totalTokens, differing by a median of 2.4x and up to 4.4x. Four passes,
each with retainTokens 5,242:
totalTokens=23398  nodeSum=5369  nodeSum-retainTokens=127   -> refused (3480 >= 65)
totalTokens=23470  nodeSum=5661  nodeSum-retainTokens=419   -> refused (901 >= 192)
totalTokens=22982  nodeSum=6264  nodeSum-retainTokens=1022  -> refused (3149 >= 985)
totalTokens=25796  nodeSum=6611  nodeSum-retainTokens=1369  -> refused (1843 >= 1142)

totalTokens is over the threshold so compaction must happen, but the surface
it is measured against prices at a fifth of that, so nothing is left to fold
once 5,242 is held back. Setting retainTokens: 0 removes the negative head
budgets entirely, which is consistent with retention being the only place the
units cross.
Suggested direction
You will know the intended invariant; these are just the readings I considered.

Spend retention in the unit it is measured in. Compare accumulated
against surfaceTokens * retainRatio instead of contextWindow * retainRatio — measurement.surfaceTokens is already the sum of the same
tokens the walk accumulates, so both sides become the estimator's.
Convert at use. Scale retainTokens by surfaceTokens / totalTokens
before the walk. Keeps the config's "fraction of the real window" meaning, but
the factor is per-call (1.2x-6.1x observed) while the spec resolves once.
Retain by position. A node count sidesteps the unit question altogether.
Or the estimator is the bug. If retention is meant to be a real-window
budget and node prices are meant to be comparable to it, then the 2.4x
disagreement is what needs fixing, not the comparison.

Independent of the direction: a guard would help. If the selected head prices
below some floor, skipping the pass seems strictly better than spending a model
request on a checkpoint summarizeCompaction is guaranteed to refuse — each
refusal costs a full request and frees nothing.

threads.title: hooks-claude-code: a matcher written as "Bash" selects nothing, because the adapter matches the DSH tool name "bash"
threads.bodyText:
Environment: dsh 0.1.5-rc.1, node v22.22.0, Linux.
A project-level .dsh/hooks.json in the Claude Code format, activated through a carrier bundle that inserts @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code with an absolute configPath:
{
  "PreToolUse": [
    { "matcher": "Bash",
      "hooks": [ { "type": "command", "command": "python3 .dsh/hooks/gate.py", "timeout": 10 } ] }
  ]
}
Expected: the command runs before every shell tool call.
Actual: it never runs. No error, no warning, nothing in the log, and dsh --profile web --dump-config shows the row composed correctly.
Root cause, three verifiable facts:

The shell tool registers itself as bash, not Bash: dsh-tool-bash has name: "bash".
The adapter hands the matcher the DSH tool name with no translation: dsh-hooks-claude-code builds the matcher query as tool_name: exec.name.
A pure-word matcher takes the dialect's LITERAL path, which compares strings exactly: matchesMatcher does pattern.split("|").includes(query) when CLAUDE_LITERAL (/^[A-Za-z0-9_|]+$/) matches.

So "Bash" is compared against "bash" and the whole group is skipped.
Minimal reproduction:
import { matchesMatcher } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hook-protocol';

matchesMatcher('Bash',      'bash', 'claude-code');  // false — expected true
matchesMatcher('bash',      'bash', 'claude-code');  // true
matchesMatcher('bash|Bash', 'bash', 'claude-code');  // true
matchesMatcher('[Bb]ash',   'bash', 'claude-code');  // true
Impact, and why "silent" is the defect. Claude Code's documented matcher for the shell tool is Bash, so a hooks file written from the documentation selects nothing on this adapter. The failure is invisible at every layer: the config parses, the plugin composes, the group never matches, and a [ -f "$h" ]-guarded command exits 1, which the protocol reads as "no decision".
Measured cost on our side: two pre-tool gates (one refusing a whole pytest tests/, one refusing an unlocked pytest tests/contracts/, 4,042 tests) were silently absent for as long as they existed. A five-minute suite ran unlocked beside another agent's suite and both doubled (9:13 against 4:48 isolated, and 13:20 for the suite beside it against a 7:05 baseline) before we noticed.
Suggested fixes, any one of which closes it:

Translate the tool name before matching (bash → Bash, and the same for the rest of the Claude Code vocabulary this dialect documents), so matchers written per those docs keep working.
Or make the literal comparison case-insensitive.
And in either case, warn when a PreToolUse group selected nothing in a session: a matcher that names a known Claude Code tool and matched no call is a wiring bug, and today it looks exactly like a gate with nothing to refuse.

Workaround we ship: "matcher": "bash|Bash", which stays on the literal path and matches either spelling.
Secondary observation, same family: @deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code declares no dsh.bundle, so listing it as a dependency composes its row in --dump-config while the hook process never starts; activation required a carrier bundle in the project. If that is intended, one line in the package README would save the next person the evening it cost us.

threads.title: [缺陷] 会话面板内的插件模态无法逃离所在 pane 的层叠上下文（z-index 99999 输给兄弟 pane 的 z-index 8）
threads.bodyText:
摘要
插件渲染在会话区里的弹窗，无法盖住兄弟 pane 的内容。它写的 z-index: 99999 完全失效，于是另一个 pane 里一个 40px 宽、看不见的拖拽手柄（z-index: 8）会吃掉本该属于弹窗的点击。同一个元素在触屏上还会留下一条常亮的悬停指示条。
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.2（DSHA 安卓 App 内置，App 版本 0.1.5-rc2 / code 129）
安卓 16 平板，WebView 视口 1238×787 CSS px，devicePixelRatio 2.5
pointer: coarse、hover: none（纯触屏）
涉及包：dsh-client-ui-conversation

复现步骤

插件把一个 position: fixed 的对话框 + 遮罩渲染进 conversation.composer.dock 插槽（对话框 z-index: 99999，遮罩 99998）；
打开这个对话框；
点击落在 CSS x 366–406 区间内的任意控件 —— 那里正是 div.wSkVaW_widthHandle 的位置。

实际结果
点击被 div.wSkVaW_widthHandle 吃掉（40px 宽、position: absolute; z-index: 8），尽管对话框是 position: fixed; z-index: 99999 且在视觉上位于最上层。用户能感知到的现象是：「点那几个标签不灵敏，得点好几下」。
在该手柄中心用 document.elementsFromPoint 实测的绘制顺序（从最上层到最下层）：
div.dshadb_scrim      z:99998  fixed     <- 插件对话框的遮罩
div.EvIC1a_scroll     z:auto   static
div.EvIC1a_root       z:auto   relative
div.wSkVaW_viewArea   z:auto   static
div.wSkVaW_scrollBody z:auto   static
div.wSkVaW_body       z:auto   relative
div.wSkVaW_root       z:auto   relative
从两个元素各自向上找到最近的「自成层叠上下文的祖先」：
模态的上下文根 = div.dshadb_scrim（它自己的遮罩）
手柄的上下文根 = div.wSkVaW_body
=> 两者不在同一个层叠上下文
期望结果
一个 position: fixed 且 z-index: 99999 的对话框，应当绘制并命中测试于 z-index: 8 的 absolute 元素之上，并且不应被兄弟 pane 的内容遮挡。
推测的根因
dsh-client-ui-conversation 中有这样一条规则：
.pXSMma_body>*{ z-index:1; position:relative }
它让会话正文的每一个直接子元素都各自成为一个层叠上下文。于是渲染在 pane A 内部的 fixed 元素永远无法逃出 pane A，而 pane B（装着 .wSkVaW_widthHandle 的聊天 pane）整体绘制在 pane A 之上。对话框自己写多大的 z-index 都失去意义，只有各个 pane 的相对顺序在起作用。
建议的修法

方案 a：去掉 .pXSMma_body>* 上的 z-index:1（如需定位可保留 position:relative）。堆叠顺序由 DOM 顺序本来就能稳定保证。
方案 b：或者让「对话框类插槽」走 portal / 宿主自己的 overlay 层渲染（div.pI_x6G_overlayLayer 已经是这个角色），使插件不再继承 pane 的层叠限制。
方案 c（针对手柄本身，建议顺带做）：@media (hover: none){ [class*="widthHandle"]{ pointer-events: none } } —— 触屏上这个手柄本来就无从发现（没有 hover 提示、没有任何视觉），留着唯一可观测的效果就是吃掉点击；接了鼠标的平板（hover: hover）不受影响，官方拖拽照旧。

同一元素的第二个症状
.wSkVaW_widthHandle::after 是拖拽指示条（默认 opacity: 0，:hover / [data-dragging] 时为 1）。在 hover: none 设备上，触摸会留下 sticky hover，指示条被永久点亮，表现为一条来路不明的灰色竖条画在无关界面上。应当用指针能力查询把它关掉。
本地临时规避
本地一个纯 CSS 插件对 @media (hover: none) 施加了：
[class*="widthHandle"]::after { display: none !important; }
[class*="widthHandle"] { pointer-events: none !important; }
这能止住这一个手柄的症状，但结构性问题依旧存在 —— 任何在会话 pane 内渲染模态的插件都会中招。

threads.title: agent.steer() from a plugin breaks the tool layer (reading 'kind') on 0.1.5-rc.1
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Calling agent.steer(...) from a plugin on an agent reference obtained from the
agent/created event makes the tool layer fail for the rest of the run:
dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')

The steered message is delivered and consumed (a second turn/end appears
in the session log), but tool calls in that turn break. Plugin-driven steering
therefore looks like it works and then poisons the run.
A second, distinct error appears when steering synchronously from inside a
session/event handler:
Error: session append cannot reenter while another append is being published

Environment









dsh
0.1.5-rc.1 (latest dist-tag)


OS
Windows 11


node
v24.19.0


Profile
headless bundle (dsh-base + dsh-headless) + a few third-party plugins


Provider
DeepSeek official API (https://api.deepseek.com/v1)



What works (verified, in case it narrows things down)

agent/created fires under a headless run and its payload carries a usable agent:
payloadKeys: ["agent"], and steer/followup/inject/whenIdle are all functions.
ctx.on("session/event", (session, event) => …) subscribes fine and turn/end is observable.
turn/start / turn/end are session events (session.append(...)), so subscribing via bare
ctx.on("turn/start") never fires. (Not a bug — just easy to get wrong; may deserve a doc note.)

Reproduction
Attach this plugin to a headless profile, then run any task that uses a tool:
const name = "steer-repro";
const Config = z.object({ logPath: z.string().default("repro.jsonl") });

function apply(ctx, config) {
  let agent = null;
  ctx.on("agent/created", (p) => { agent = p?.agent ?? null; });

  // Variant A: steer inside the handler  -> "cannot reenter" error
  ctx.on("session/event", (session, event) => {
    if (event?.type !== "turn/end") return;
    agent?.steer({ role: "user", content: [{ type: "text", text: "Also reply with exactly: STEERED_OK" }] });
  });

  // Variant B: defer out of the publish frame -> steer consumed, tools break
  // setImmediate(() => agent?.steer({ ... }));

  // Variant C: poll session.ownEvents()/eventAt() with no subscription at all
  // setInterval(() => { /* on turn/end, then agent.steer(...) */ }, 400);
}

export { Config, apply, name };
Result for all three variants:
$ dsh --profile <bee> "Reply with exactly: BASE"
BASE
dsh: UNKNOWN: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')

Isolation



Variant
Result




subscription present, but never steer
baseline completes normally


steer synchronously inside session/event
session append cannot reenter while another append is being published


steer via setImmediate (out of publish frame)
steer delivered (second turn/end), tools then break


steer via pure polling, no event subscription
tools break


plugin detached (control)
normal



So the crash tracks the steer() call itself, not the subscription and not the
deferral mechanism. --dump-config and boot are clean in every case, i.e. this
is not a plugin-loading problem.
Hypothesis
steer() re-enters the agent step loop while the tool scheduler's state is
mid-publish, so the scheduler resolves a tool record that is undefined
(reading 'kind' is the signature of a failed scheduler-record lookup). This
resembles the earlier tool-layer failures where a second copy of
@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools splits the module-local Symbol used as the scheduler
key (the #1337 / #4640 / #4667 family) — as if the injected step resolves the
scheduler against a different instance than the one the running turn publishes to.
Impact
Any plugin-driven steering is unusable, which is the natural way to correct a
long-running headless task without running a resident Host. Users are left with
only cancellation/timeout, losing the ability to redirect a task mid-flight.
Requests

Make steer() safe to call from a plugin callback, or document the required
call context (which frame/lifecycle it must run in).
If re-entrancy is inherently unsafe from inside session/event, raise a clear
error at the steer() call site instead of corrupting the tool layer for
the remainder of the run.
If this is the known Symbol-split family, does the Symbol.for fix cover the
steer path?

Deterministic locally (5/5 runs). Minimal repro plugins and the JSONL logs showing
the steered message being consumed immediately before the tool failure are
available if useful.

threads.title: [Bug] 重启后子代理列表全部显示"不可用"：v0 日志的 `header.system` 无法迁移到 v3，且错误被降级为可重试的 `unavailable`
threads.bodyText:
环境



项
值




DSH 版本
0.1.5-rc.2（在 0.1.5-rc.1 上复现，升级后仍存在）


profile
web


平台
Windows 11，Node v24.18.0


相关包
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent、@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query、@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3




症状
Web GUI「任务管理」面板中，某父会话派生的全部子代理不再显示标题／模式／活动状态，只显示各自 UUID + 灰色「不可用」。

重启 DSH 前：正常显示 Analyze docs and experiments 等标题
重启 DSH 后：全部退化为 UUID + 「不可用」
子代理日志完好无损：标签、事件、完整历史都能用官方 API 读出来


最小复现

会话中派生若干子代理。
让某个子代理再派生子代理（delegationDepth: 2）。
完全重启 DSH，使这些子代理成为冷会话。
打开该父会话的「任务管理」面板。

期望：显示子代理标题／模式／状态。
实际：UUID + 「不可用」。

根因
链路如下：
① 冷读取
dsh-subagent/lib/index.js 的 resolveColdIdentity()（2240-2248 行）：
try {
  observation = await query.observeSession(childId, ...)
} catch (error) {
  return {
    kind: "diagnostic",
    id: childId,
    reason: sessionQueryCode(error) === "SESSION_QUERY_CORRUPT_SESSION"
         || sessionQueryCode(error) === "SESSION_QUERY_SOURCE_CONFLICT"
      ? "corrupt" : "unavailable"        // ← 落在这里
  }
}
② 冷读触发 v3 迁移
observeSession → SessionObservationReader.read() → 冷读 → 迁移到当前格式。
③ 迁移器直接拒绝
dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3/lib/index.js:236：
if (Object.hasOwn(record(data["header"], "request header"), "system"))
  throw new SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError(
    "format v3 request/header rejects retired header.system")
④ 错误被错误分类
SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError 既不是 SESSION_QUERY_CORRUPT_SESSION 也不是 SESSION_QUERY_SOURCE_CONFLICT，于是被归为 unavailable（语义是"暂时失败、下次重试"），而不是"此日志格式需要升级 harness"。
因为每次重列都必然失败，该占位文案永久留存。

证据
涉及的子代理日志均为 version: 0，其中各有一条违规的 request/header：
4e88f0bd-…  events=1118  request/header 带 header.system（6910 字符）
5460df61-…  events=1131  request/header 带 header.system（6910 字符）
65dd6b63-…  events=582   request/header 带 header.system（6910 字符）
f7076563-…  events=628   request/header 带 header.system（6910 字符）

用 0.1.5-rc.2 自带的格式目录验证：
const { sessionFormatCatalog } = await import(
  '<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-catalog/lib/index.js')

sessionFormatCatalog.encodeCurrentEvent(v0RequestHeaderEvent)
// throws: format v3 request/header rejects retired header.system
同一批数据经 createRestore(...) 与 decodeEvent(...) 零失败 ——
说明日志可读、内容完整，失败点纯粹是 v3 迁移策略拒绝了已废弃字段。
为什么只有子代理受影响
父会话重启后仍是活会话（sessions.get(id) !== undefined），走 projections.snapshot(live) 快路径，不读盘、不迁移。子代理是冷会话，必须回读磁盘，于是撞上迁移拒绝。

两个可独立修复的缺陷
缺陷 1：迁移器拒绝而非转换
header.system 已被 system/message 取代，而迁移器自己就认识这个类型 ——
dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3/lib/index.js 第 9 行的 SURFACE_TYPES 明确列有 "system/message"。
因此理论上可自动转换（把 header.system 抽成一条 system/message 事件），不必让整份日志不可用。若确实不做自动转换，也应明确指引"请升级 harness"，而不是让用户看到一个像是临时故障的状态。
值得注意的是：dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:960（refuseForeignFormatVersion 的注释）已经声明了正确意图 ——

must see "upgrade the harness", never "corrupt session log".

但该路径只覆盖"外来格式版本"，没有覆盖 v0 → v3 的 header.system 这一情形，也没有贯彻到 subagent 的 catalog 路径。
缺陷 2：错误分类吞掉了不可重试的失败
dsh-subagent/lib/index.js:2245-2248 只把两种错误码映射为 corrupt，其余一律 unavailable，导致"格式不受支持、重试无用"被错误地划入"可重试"。
已验证：dsh-subagent 全文中 reason: 只出现 "corrupt"（2160、2255、2261 行）与 "unavailable"（2247 行），从不产生 "unsupported"。
因此浏览器端已有的 subagentDiagUnsupported（「子代理记录版本不受支持」）在该路径上永远不可达 —— 而它恰恰是本 bug 最该显示的文案。

建议修复

dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3：把 header.system 自动转换为 system/message（推荐），或至少将该失败标记为不可重试。
dsh-subagent：在 resolveColdIdentity 的错误分类中识别 SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError，映射为 unsupported，使 UI 显示「子代理记录版本不受支持」。
可选：subagents.list 的载荷保留诊断原因字符串，便于用户与开发者定位。


影响

数据无损：日志完整，仅列表渲染退化。
用户无法从 UI 进入这些子代理的历史，也看不到标题 —— 已完成任务的成果实际被"藏起来"。
任何经历过 v0 → v3 格式演进、且派生过子代理的用户，重启后都可能命中。


附：如何自行验证（无需 GUI）
const { sessionFormatCatalog } = await import(
  '<dsh>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-catalog/lib/index.js')

// 取任一带 header.system 的 v0 request/header 事件：
sessionFormatCatalog.encodeCurrentEvent(event)
// → throws "format v3 request/header rejects retired header.system"

threads.title: [Bug] Todo list does not update incrementally during long-running tasks
threads.bodyText:
Description
When running a long-running, multi-step task in DeepSeek Harness, the Todo list does not update incrementally during execution.
The agent may generate a complete Todo list at the beginning, but completed items remain in_progress or pending in the UI while the task is still running. After the task finishes, the Todo list suddenly updates and multiple items are marked as completed at once.
This makes the task progress shown in the UI inaccurate and difficult to follow.
Environment

OS: Windows 11
DeepSeek Harness: 0.1.2-alpha.5
Mode: Web UI
Task type: Long-running, multi-step tasks

Steps to Reproduce

Start a long-running task involving multiple sequential steps.
Let the agent generate a Todo list with several items.
Observe the Todo list while the agent is executing the task.
Wait for several individual steps to finish.
Observe the Todo list again.

Actual Behavior

Todo items are not marked as completed immediately after the corresponding step finishes.
The UI may remain unchanged for a long period while the agent continues working.
After the task finishes, multiple Todo items may suddenly be marked as completed at once.
The displayed Todo progress therefore does not reflect the actual execution progress.

Screenshot 1 — Todo list during execution

The task is still running, but the Todo list does not reflect the completed steps.
Screenshot 2 — Todo list after task completion

After the task finishes, multiple Todo items are updated at once immediately.
Expected Behavior
The Todo list should update incrementally during task execution:

Each Todo item should be marked as completed shortly after the corresponding step is actually completed.
The UI should reflect the agent's current progress in near real time.
Todo completion should not be batched until the entire task finishes.

Impact
For long-running tasks, the current behavior makes it difficult to determine:

Which steps have actually been completed.
Which step the agent is currently working on.
Whether the agent is making progress or is stuck.

Suggested Fix
Consider updating/pushing the Todo state whenever an individual step changes status, rather than only updating the UI after the task or Todo write operation finishes.

threads.title: Bug report: Windows windows-acl sandbox dies permanently for a session when its cached private temp dir disappears
threads.bodyText:
Product: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 (npm next; latest at the time of writing is 0.1.5-rc.1)
Host: Windows 10, Node v24.19.0, x64
Backend: windows-acl (restricted-token runner) — the chain's sole win32 candidate
Severity: high for Windows users — a session loses all confined execution until the DSH process restarts

1. Symptom
Every confined workspace-write command in an affected session fails with:
Error: sandbox mode "workspace-write" is requested but no sandbox backend is usable on this host;
refusing to run the command unconfined. Install bubblewrap or run a Landlock-enforcing kernel (Linux),
ensure sandbox-exec is usable (macOS), or ensure the ACL restricted-token runner can start (Windows)
— otherwise switch the consumer to danger-full-access.
Runner failure: windows-acl-run: --temp is not an existing directory: C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-am0JWF

(Structured error: name: "SandboxUnavailableError", code: "SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE".)
Two things make this worse than it looks:

The backend is not missing. On the same host and the same DSH process, confined commands work
normally — the ACL runner rewrites TMP/TEMP to a capability-granted private dir and enforces the
workspace boundary. The error text is therefore misleading, and it invites the model to escalate to
danger-full-access (which is exactly what happened in practice — see §4).
It never recovers for that session. Within one session, every failure names the same
private temp dir, across 25 minutes. The session is confined-execution-dead until the DSH process
restarts.

2. Root cause
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local caches one private temp directory per (sessionId, workspaceRoot) for
the provider's lifetime and hands that path to the runner on every confined call — without ever
re-validating that the directory still exists:
// node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js (0.1.5-rc.2, lines ~400-403)
const key = JSON.stringify([String(sessionId), workspaceRoot]);
const existing = this.tempCapabilities.get(key);
if (existing !== void 0) return existing;            // <-- cached dead path is returned forever
const tempDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "dsh-"));
The runner then fails closed on its very first pre-flight check
(dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js, requireDirectory → existsSync), prints
windows-acl-run: --temp is not an existing directory: … and exits 127, which
RUNNER_FAILURE_RULES["windows-acl"] maps to SandboxUnavailableError.
The deletion itself comes from DSH's own cleanup: in the whole installed tree the only code that removes
these directories is sandbox-local's removeTempDir(), called from

revokeAclGrants() (provider dispose / cordis effect teardown), and
the partial-grant-failure cleanup inside materializeAclGrant().

Once such a removal happens while the provider instance (and therefore its tempCapabilities map)
survives, the session is stuck. We could not pin down from the artifacts which of those two paths
fires first — that is the one open question; the "cache is never re-validated" half is proven by the
identical stale path being reused for 25 minutes.
3. Evidence
3.1 The backend works on this host (same process, minutes apart)
Current session, confined pwsh command:
$env:TEMP  ->  C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-OCWs63

> icacls C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-OCWs63
C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-OCWs63 S-1-4-679122723-976859111-1:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)   <- tempWriteSid()
                                             DESKTOP-SCIEJPJ\Admin:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
                                             ...

S-1-4-x-y-1 is exactly tempWriteSid(privateTempDir) from
dsh-sandbox-windows-acl (tempWriteSid = S-1-4-<a>-<b>-1). Enforcement is live too:
Set-Content C:\Users\Admin\dsh-sandbox-probe.txt     -> Access to the path ... is denied.   (correct)
Set-Content C:\Users\Admin\.dsh\.sandbox-probe.txt   -> ok                                   (correct)

Roughly 40 confined commands in that session succeeded with zero runner failures.
3.2 Two affected sessions, months apart (so not a 0.1.5 regression)
Logs live at $DSH_HOME/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<session>/session.v3.jsonl.zstd. Note: they are
multi-frame zstd — zlib.zstdDecompressSync() (and the streaming API) decode only the first
frame, so a naive search finds nothing. Decoding all frames:



session
when (local, +08:00)
workspace
failures
distinct --temp in failures




session-ed1b02bb-c416-4967-97ef-a903b1c371c2
2026-09-13 09:46:49 → 10:12:01
D:\renpy-projects
6
1 — …\Temp\dsh-am0JWF


session-031541e1-92d1-411b-989c-97ca0f3a9ea2
2026-08-19 19:56:48 → 20:18:05
D:\GL2
4
1 — …\Temp\dsh-Xk3Q7D



In session-ed1b02bb, the last healthy confined command is at 09:42:05; from 09:46:49 on, no
confined workspace-write command ever succeeds again, and all 6 failures carry the same path.
3.3 The "it works again afterwards" is escalation, not recovery
The successful commands interleaved with the failures are unconfined — the model escalated, with the
user approving each time:
{"type":"approval/asked","seq":1249,"toolName":"pwsh",
 "reason":"escalate sandbox to danger-full-access: The workspace-write sandbox runner is unusable
           (its temp directory no longer exists), so this Ren'Py lint check cannot run any other way; …"}
(approval/asked with that reason appears repeatedly: seq 1249, 1405, 1441, 1501, 1508, 1515.)
So an affected session silently degrades to danger-full-access — the opposite of the intended
fail-closed outcome, and it makes agents report "the sandbox is broken" to the user.
3.4 Ruled out

OS/cleanup-tool deletion of %TEMP%: Storage Sense is disabled
(HKCU\…\StorageSense\Parameters\StoragePolicy\01 = 0, no policy keys), and unrelated temp files from
08:45 are still present while the sandbox dirs vanished.
Non-deterministic mkdtemp: fs.mkdtempSync() returns distinct random suffixes here
(4/4 distinct); crypto.randomBytes is fine. So a constant stale path cannot be re-creation.
ACL module deleting directories: no rmSync/rmdir anywhere in dsh-sandbox-windows-acl;
dsh-acl-locks holds lock files only.

4. Suggested fix
Re-validate the cached capability before returning it (this is the local hotfix we are running, marked
[dsh-hotfix sandbox-local]):
const existing = this.tempCapabilities.get(key);
if (existing !== void 0) {
    if (existsSync(existing.dir)) return existing;
    try { existing.grant.dispose(); } catch {}
    this.tempCapabilities.delete(key);
}
const tempDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "dsh-"));
(existsSync is already imported in that module.) A missing directory is then simply re-materialized
with a fresh path/SID instead of poisoning the session.
Two secondary suggestions that would have shortened this diagnosis a lot:

Distinguish the two failure classes in the message. A runner-side pre-flight failure is not
"no sandbox backend is usable on this host"; the current text tells the model to switch to
danger-full-access, and models comply. Something like
SANDBOX_RUNNER_FAILED (state: the backend exists but this invocation's confinement could not be
established; retry/rebuild, do not escalate) would prevent both the misleading escalation and the
"sandbox is broken" reports.
Say why existsSync failed. requireDirectory collapses ENOENT and EACCES/EPERM into one
message (Node's existsSync returns false for any stat error). Reporting the actual statSync
error code would separate "deleted" from "present but unreadable" in the field.

5. Environment / repro notes

Reproduced twice on this host, in long-lived sessions that crossed several turn boundaries; the first
failing command in a turn is the one that surfaces it.
We could not construct a minimal deterministic reproducer: forcing it needs the private temp dir to
disappear between materializeAclGrant() and the runner's existsSync (or the cached entry to
outlive the directory). Deleting the session's private temp dir out-of-band and then issuing a
confined command reproduces the identical error text, which is how the hotfix above was validated.

threads.title: 子代理能否运行在与父代理不同的 agent preset 上？
threads.bodyText:
I've been reading packages/preset and the subagent drivers, and I can't find any supported way to make a delegated child run on a preset other than its parent's. Before treating that as a gap, I'd like to check whether it's deliberate and whether I'm missing a seam.
All line references are against master @ c291e79 (2026-09-10); I also verified the behaviour against the published @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets@0.1.5-rc.2.
What I found
1. composeFrom has no preset id.
packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts (implementation in lib/types/index.js):
composeFrom(agentCtx, parentCtx) {
    const agentKey = scopeOf(agentCtx);
    const standing = standingMountFor(parentCtx);   // parent's standing mount, always
    if (standing === undefined) return undefined;
    this.bindings.set(agentKey, bindScopeParent(agentKey, standing.key));
    return standing.presetId;
}
The signature is (agentCtx, parentCtx) — there is no parameter through which a different preset id could arrive. mount(agentCtx, id) is the one that takes an id.
2. Children go through exactly that call.
packages/subagent/subagent/src/child-agent.ts:
childCtx.get('agentPresets')?.composeFrom(childCtx, parent.ctx)
and the preset is deliberately read from the parent's live scope chain rather than its durable header. The matching tests (packages/subagent/subagent-in-process-driver/tests/preset-inheritance.spec.ts) assert this inheritance directly, including a case where the parent was recomposed to a different preset while blank and the child follows it.
3. The delegate tool exposes no preset field.
packages/subagent/tool-subagent — no preset parameter. So there is no model-facing path either.
Two adjacent things that made me pause

packages/subagent/subagent-in-process-driver/tests/fixtures/presets/ contains coding and reviewing (with matching preset_only / reviewing_only tools) and tests/preset-inheritance.spec.ts. The fixture names suggest per-child preset assignment was at least considered or prototyped. The archived preset-tool-filter-DSL note points in the same direction, though I couldn't reach that file (404) so I may be reading too much into fixture names.
The child-local composition controls that do exist are persona, toolFilter, and maxDepth (2026-07-12-subagent-persona-tool-filter-and-depth.md). These customise a child but cannot switch its preset — they filter or overlay the inherited composition.

The constraint I keep running into
agentPresets/select exists as a remote method and select(agent, agentPreset) as a service method, but swap() refuses once the session has produced anything:
if (boundary !== undefined && (boundary.openTurnStartSeq !== null || boundary.lastTurn > 0)) {
    throw new RemoteError('agent-preset/locked', ...)
}
which is the documented blank-session contract. And the in-process drivers compose their children inside a synchronous setup, while mount() is async — so composing a child from a named preset does not obviously fit the window the drivers use.
CreateAgentOptions.agentPreset does exist (packages/core/agent/src/types.ts) and the child header records agentPreset, but that field is set by whoever calls ctx.agents.create — not by the tool caller.
The use case I'm trying to reach
I want a parent to delegate to specialist children that carry their own skill sets — e.g. a Unity-expert child and a Blender-expert child — without a human hand-orchestrating several top-level sessions. Today the workaround is manual: open a separate top-level session per preset from the GUI and pass interfaces between them.
Questions

Is preset inheritance for children a deliberate hard boundary, or simply the only path today?
If deliberate: is the reasoning the same "a child must not run a different generation of the composition than its parent's history was produced under" argument recorded in composeFrom's doc comment, or is there something stronger — trust, or composition semantics?
Is there a seam I've missed (provider config, SDK, an existing per-child composition row) that already permits this?
If this is worth supporting, which shape would upstream prefer?

an optional preset field on the subagent tool plus a new provider capability flag (alongside persona / toolFilter / depthLimit), or
composeOneChild mounting an explicitly requested preset instead of composeFrom
The second looks smaller, but it has to solve the sync-setup-vs-async-mount mismatch, which makes me suspect the first is the more honest shape.



I'm happy to prototype whichever direction you'd accept. I may well be missing repo context, so a pointer would be just as useful as an answer.

threads.title: [问题反馈][DS 4.1] 身份提示影响推理模式，疑似伴随严重能力下降
threads.bodyText:
问题概述
在使用 DSH + goat（Command Code Provider API）的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 时，我反复观察到一种让我感觉任务能力明显、甚至严重下降的推理状态：以 We need… / I need… 展开，随后连续叙述局部操作；相比之下，同渠道的 ZCode 有时会先判断任务性质、列出整体结构，再用 Let me… 进入设计，实际体验更好。
我怀疑系统提示中的身份描述会影响这种状态的出现，希望官方协助排查。我们随后进行了 1,044 次有记录的对照请求，观察到：只改变短系统提示中的身份名称，早期推理文本的分布也会显著变化。
需要明确区分：

实际使用观察：我认为某种 Need/连续叙述型状态伴随严重的能力下降，这是本帖最想解决的问题。
实验已验证的部分：身份提示条件与推理开头、分项列表、自我规划措辞的出现频率有关。
尚未验证的因果链：没有按最终答案正确率或完成质量评分，因此还不能把这些实验写成“Need 这个词导致能力下降”或“已确认路由到了更弱模型”。Need 起句和连续叙述型也不是同一指标。

环境与现场对比

DSH：@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.1，macOS。
接入：llm-pi-ai / openai-completions。
Provider base URL：https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1。
请求模型 ID：deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash。
对比客户端：DSH 与 ZCode，使用相同渠道、相同用户任务；对比的 High 会话记录已核对。
DSH 现场启用了自定义 Oh My DSH preset，不是干净的官方默认 preset。 两客户端完整系统提示、工具列表和上下文并不相同，尚未完成 stock DSH 的完整端到端归因。
现场 DSH 记录为 reasoningEffort: high，适配器检查也确认发送 reasoning_effort: high。ZCode 的 High 记录包含 reasoningEffort: high 和 thinking: enabled，但取得的是 SDK options，不是完整的最终 HTTP body。
现场输出上限也不同：DSH 配置为 384,000，ZCode SDK options 为 128,000；下面的受控测试统一使用较小上限，避免这个变量混入组间比较。

原始用户任务：

直接给我生成一个秦始皇骑自行车的动态svg

DSH 中让我觉得质量下降的片段：

We need to create an animated SVG showing Qin Shi Huang riding a bicycle…
So I'll set up a rotation animation with a nested group…
I'm also adding vertical motion…
Now I'm working out the layering…

ZCode 中我觉得更好的片段：

The user wants an animated SVG of Qin Shi Huang… This is a creative task — I should just generate it. No need for plans or questions.
Let me design it carefully:

A side-view bicycle with rotating wheels
A cartoon Qin Shi Huang figure…
Animation…
Let me think about the geometry.


这些是用户提供/本地记录中的风格示例，不是经过盲评的质量证据，也不能用模型自称判断后端身份。
对照实验设计
后续实验直接调用同一个 goat API，绕过两个客户端，用于隔离短提示条件；不能把它们等同为 1,044 次 DSH 客户端缺陷复现。
共四个预先定量的批次，没有“跑到显著才停止”，也没有过滤不利样本：



批次

共同条件：同一个 provider、模型 ID、API key；reasoning_effort: high；无工具、无历史；未额外设置 temperature；正式比较内保持相同输出上限。各区组包含全部条件并随机交错发送，批次内并发量固定。
请求使用短输出上限以降低成本，正式初轮/英文轮的输出均被上限截断。检查的是早期返回的推理文本，不是完整 SVG、最终答案或长程推理质量。不同批次的语言、输出上限和时间不同，不能直接把跨批次差值当成某个单变量的因果效果。
英文任务原文

Directly generate an animated SVG of Qin Shi Huang riding a bicycle.
Analyze possible reasons why asynchronous tasks occasionally execute more than once.
Design a minimal solution for two processes to safely update the same JSON file.

最后一轮：只改变一个身份名称
系统提示固定为：
You are an interactive {identity} agent that helps users with software engineering tasks.

identity 为 ZCode、DSH、coding、Claude、ChatGPT、DeepSeek、Codex、Gemini、Atlas、Aster。最后两个是虚构名称对照；没有要求模型以 Need 或 Let me 开头。
全部 600 次 HTTP 200，每格 20 次；Need 类起句次数如下，完整列出所有条件：

Need 类：推理起句以 We need / I need / Need to 开始（此前中文轮次也识别中文等价形式），不包括后文才出现的 need。
预定主要观察窗口为前 600 个 Unicode 字符，指标包括 Need 类起句、分项列表、自我规划措辞（如 Let me / I should）、特定连续叙述标记。按任务及随机区组置换身份标签 20,000 次，四项指标使用 Holm 多重比较校正：

Need 类起句、分项列表、自我规划措辞：校正后均 p < 0.001。
特定连续叙述标记：本轮没有命中，不能声称复现了原始连续叙述状态，更不能凭这个指标判断智能。

统计显著针对文本分布，不是任务能力。 某些 Need 起句的样本仍然有清晰列表；相同身份也会生成不同风格。
较早英文轮中的同条件切换
在完整 DSH 短角色句 + 同一英文 SVG 任务 + High + 384 输出上限下，20 次中出现：Need 类 10 次、先概括用户任务 6 次、Let me 起句 4 次。
其中捕获 1 条与最初连续叙述形式接近的样本：

I need to create an animated SVG… I'll work through the design process.
First, I'm planning the visual composition…
Now I'm drafting the SVG structure…
I'm defining the bike geometry precisely…

因此，身份提示不是决定单次输出风格的固定开关。
最小复现（Python 标准库）
以下是小规模检查方式，不是上述 600 次的全部统计脚本。默认每种身份 2 次；重跑最后一轮时使用 10 个身份、3 个任务、每格 20 次，并随机分区组发送。API key 仅从环境变量读取，不要贴进讨论。
import json
import os
import random
import re
import urllib.request

key = os.environ["CMD_API_KEY"]
url = "https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1/chat/completions"
identities = ["ZCode", "DSH", "coding"]
repeats = int(os.environ.get("REPEATS", "2"))
randomizer = random.Random(20260913)
prompt = "Design a minimal solution for two processes to safely update the same JSON file."

for block in range(repeats):
    order = identities.copy()
    randomizer.shuffle(order)
    for identity in order:
        body = {
            "model": "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
            "reasoning_effort": "high",
            "max_tokens": 256,
            "stream": False,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content":
                 f"You are an interactive {identity} agent that helps users with software engineering tasks."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
            ],
        }
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, data=json.dumps(body).encode(), method="POST",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
        message = result["choices"][0]["message"]
        reasoning = message.get("reasoning_content") or message.get("reasoning") or ""
        need = bool(re.match(r"(?:we\s+need\b|i\s+need\b|need\s+to\b)", reasoning.strip(), re.I))
        print(json.dumps({
            "block": block, "identity": identity, "need_opening": need,
            "opening": reasoning[:600], "model": result.get("model"),
            "request_id": result.get("id"),
        }, ensure_ascii=False))
希望官方帮助核查

对 DS 4.1，是否已知身份措辞会显著影响这种推理组织方式？有没有推荐的身份句或提示组装方式？
如何方便地导出并对比 最终发送的、脱敏后的系统提示、工具 schema、reasoning_effort、thinking 和输出上限，以排除 UI High 与实际协议参数不一致？
能否用官方 DeepSeek 路由或可确认后端的环境验证同样现象，再比较 stock DSH 与上述自定义 preset？这样才有可能分开模型行为、渠道行为和 harness 组装影响。
有没有适合检验“这种状态伴随严重质量下降”的小型、真实任务对照方法？我希望最终解决的是实际能力回退，而不是仅把开头改成 Let me。

我也怀疑渠道可能混用不同后端，但目前返回的模型 ID、每次不同的 fingerprint 和 reasoning_details.format: unknown 都不足以确认。本帖不指控已经证实的模型替换，也不声称问题一定在 DSH 核心。
原始请求 ID、返回文本、全部条件表和分析结果已在本地保留，后续可按需要提供脱敏样本；此处没有公开凭据、私人会话路径或完整私人提示配置。

threads.title: fix(client-connection): resolve webServer from Connection, not the RPC caller (PRs appear disabled — fix branch attached)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
A third-party plugin that registers an RPC endpoint through the public, carrier-neutral connection.rpc.handle() API silently fails to mount its route in a Web composition, because the Host implementation resolves webServer from the calling plugin's own context instead of from Connection's own context. I found the root cause, fixed it, and added regression coverage. Pull requests appear to be disabled on this repository, so I'm posting the fix here instead, with the full diff on a public branch for a maintainer to cherry-pick or pull directly.
Branch (fork): https://github.com/SergioMazariego/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/client-connection-external-rpc-web
Commit: 118e6c9be8bd4408fc965d7826864d0fb2dc0a0b
Compare view: master...SergioMazariego:deepseek-harness:fix/client-connection-external-rpc-web
Regression
DSH 0.1.5-rc.1
Windows

Settings -> Subscriptions

Failed to load proxy settings:
transport failure for /subscriptions-auth/proxyGet: HTTP 405

The endpoint belongs to a third-party plugin that authenticates providers via subscriptions/OAuth instead of API keys. It registers its RPC endpoints through Connection's public API (connection.rpc.handle(...)), declaring only inject: ['connection'] — the documented contract for that API, which is meant to be carrier-neutral.
Root cause
HostConnectionService.register() (the implementation behind connection.rpc.handle(), in packages/client/connection/src/rpc-host.ts) mounted the channel's route by calling owner.webServer.register(route) directly on owner, the calling plugin's own context (get rpc() captures owner = this.ctx, rebound per caller — see the class doc: "whose channel registrations belong to the caller fiber").
Cordis resolves a service reference by walking the accessing fiber's own ancestor chain; a fiber that never crosses a webServer-providing ancestor gets cannot get property "webServer" without inject. A plugin that only declares inject: ['connection'] — exactly what the public API asks for — has no such path to webServer whenever webServer is provided by its own separate plugin fiber rather than directly on the root context (the shape of a normal Web composition, and the shape the existing test suite happened not to exercise: its mounted() helper called ctx.provide('webServer', …) directly on the literal root, which masks the bug).
So the very first call to connection.rpc.handle() from such a plugin throws synchronously inside the registration effect. That failure is local to the registering plugin's own fiber, so the rest of the app keeps running — but the plugin's channel is never mounted. A later request to that channel's path finds no route, falls through to the webServer's fallback seat, and — under the shipped Web composition, where the fallback is frontend-static — receives HTTP 405, because frontend-static's fallback answers any non-GET/HEAD request with 405 outside its own named routes (packages/host/frontend-static/src/index.ts).
This is not a new dependency requirement working as intended: connection.rpc.intercept('/api', …) and connection.fetch.register(...) — the other two RPC/Fetch registration APIs on the same service — never touch webServer at all; they only touch Connection's own internal maps and piggyback on the one /api route Connection's own apply() already mounts through its existing optional ctx.inject(['webServer'], …). rpc.handle() was the one path that bypassed that abstraction and reached for the caller's own webServer access instead.
Fix
HostConnectionService now resolves webServer itself, through its own soft dependency declared in its constructor (ctx.inject(['webServer'], …), on Connection's own context — the same context that already optionally mounts /api), instead of requiring the calling plugin's context to reach it:

register() records the channel's WebRoute in an internal map (channelRoutes) and mounts it immediately if webServer is already active.
The constructor's ctx.inject(['webServer'], …) callback mounts every already-recorded channel whenever webServer (re)activates, and withdraws every mounted channel when webServer stops (a restart, or an isolated realm unloading).
The disposer returned to the caller (rpc.handle()'s return value) still belongs to the caller's own fiber — removing the channel's registration when that plugin unloads — preserving the class's existing "channel registrations belong to the caller fiber" contract. Only the route-mounting step moved off the caller's context.

This is the minimal change: no changes to registerInterceptor/registerFetchRoute (already carrier-neutral), no changes to the public HostConnectionRpc/HostConnectionFetch types, and client-connection's own top-level inject = ['credentials'] is untouched — webServer stays optional for the whole plugin, exactly as the existing doc comment describes ("Provides carrier-neutral RPC and Fetch registries. When webServer is present, the plugin also mounts the /api browser transport"), so Desktop, headless, and other webServer-less compositions are unaffected.
Tests

Added packages/client/connection/tests/external-rpc-web.host.spec.ts:

Mounts webServer as its own nested plugin fiber (not directly on the root context, which is what let the existing suite miss this) alongside client-connection, then a sibling plugin declaring only inject: ['connection'] that calls connection.rpc.handle(...). Asserts the route mounts, a real request reaches the handler (not a 405), and disposing the external plugin withdraws the route.
A second case registers the channel before webServer exists anywhere in the tree, asserts nothing is mounted yet, then activates webServer and asserts the channel mounts; disposing webServer withdraws the route without disturbing the external plugin's own registration.
Both cases fail against the pre-fix code with cannot get property "webServer" without inject, and pass with the fix.


Updated the one existing assertion whose expected error text changed (packages/client/connection/tests/node-half.host.spec.ts): the duplicate-channel error is now raised by HostConnectionService itself (already registered) rather than by (in that test) the fake webServer's own duplicate-route check.
Ran the full packages/client/connection suite (165 tests) and packages/host/webserver + packages/host/frontend-static (5 tests): all green.
tsc -b packages/client/connection/tsconfig.host.json and tsconfig.client.json: no errors.
oxlint over the changed files: 0 warnings, 0 errors.
Verified 100% statement/branch coverage on rpc-host.ts (this repo's per-file coverage gate) with the new test alone.

Manual verification
Before:
POST /subscriptions-auth/proxyGet -> HTTP 405

Temporary local workaround (evidence used to localize the regression,
not the fix landed here):
client-connection inject changed from:
['credentials']
to:
['webServer', 'credentials']

After restarting DSH:
subscription proxy settings loaded correctly and external RPC calls succeeded.

That workaround happened to work because it moved client-connection's own base fiber onto a Web composition where webServer was declared close enough in the tree for the caller's own context to resolve it in that particular installation's plugin layout — it does not hold in general (e.g. it cannot help a plugin mounted where no ancestor of its own fiber ever provides webServer), and it makes webServer mandatory for the whole client-connection plugin, which is not architecturally correct (see packages/client/connection/src/index.ts's doc comment). The fix on the branch above resolves webServer from Connection's own context unconditionally, so it works regardless of where a connection.rpc.handle() caller sits in the plugin tree, and keeps webServer optional for client-connection as a whole.
Note on delivery
I tried opening a pull request first (fix/client-connection-external-rpc-web on my fork, SergioMazariego/deepseek-harness, against master), but this repository has Pull Requests disabled at the repository-feature level (confirmed via the API: has_pull_requests: false — listing existing PRs also 404s), so posting here per the README's contribution guidance. Happy to adjust the change, split it, or answer questions — the branch above stays up to date if I need to push a revision.

threads.title: [Bug] edit rejects same-mode sandbox_permissions under danger-full-access
threads.bodyText:
What happened
On DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 for Fedora Linux, when a session is already using danger-full-access, the model can call the edit tool with:
{
  "sandbox_permissions": "danger-full-access",
  "justification": "..."
}
The edit then fails with:
sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode
This makes file editing fail even though the session already has full access.
Expected behavior
A request for the already-active mode should be treated as a no-op, or the escalation fields should be omitted from the tool schema when the active mode is already danger-full-access. Only a strictly wider mode should enter the approval/escalation path.
Reproduction

Start the local DSH web profile.
Set the permission preset to danger-full-access.
Ask the model to edit an existing UTF-8 text file.
If the model includes sandbox_permissions: "danger-full-access" in the edit call, the call is rejected.

How I solved it locally
I changed the escalation check so that when requestedMode === effectiveMode, it returns the existing mode without entering the approval path. This treats the repeated same-mode parameter as a no-op while preserving the safety check for real upgrades: requests from workspace-write to danger-full-access still require approval. After restarting DSH, file editing worked again.
Workaround
Omit sandbox_permissions and justification from the edit call.
Environment

DSH 0.1.5-rc.2
Fedora Linux
Local web profile
Responses API-compatible backend

threads.title: Session search fails entirely when any session contains a released subagent/descriptor v2 event (two v0→v1 migration gates + no per-session tolerance)
threads.bodyText:
Bug report — session search fails entirely when any session contains a released subagent/descriptor v2 event. (Issues are disabled on this repo, so filing here.)
Environment

dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 (checkout dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2-139-gc291e7961a), macOS
session-persistence-jsonl backend + persistent session-query-sqlite index (openAt: startup)

Symptom
session_search / session_event_search fail with the model-safe message session history storage is unavailable (code SESSION_QUERY_PERSISTENCE_FAILED), while session_trace / session_event_trace work on the same session. The Web sidebar search degrades to "content search unavailable, showing name matches" — same cause. persisted_sessions stays at 0 rows, because indexing requires a successful cold read.
Root cause — two independent gates

packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/validation.ts (L198):

if (event.type === 'subagent/descriptor' && data['version'] !== 3) {
  ...
  if (version === 0) throw new SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError(
    `${event.type} ${event.seq} uses unsupported descriptor version ${descriptorVersion}`)

packages/session/session-format-v0-to-v1/src/payload-validation.ts (L956, subagentDescriptorValue):

literalValue(data['version'], [3], `${label} version`)
Relaxing only gate 1 surfaces gate 2's error (version must be one of 3).
A real v2 event carries {version:2, mode:"continuable", provider:"spawn", label, agentProvider, agentModel} — required ['mode','version','provider'] plus optional keys all drawn from RELEASED_V0_EVENT_DISPOSITIONS['subagent/descriptor']. So the payload validates correctly once admitted; the remaining field checks are version-independent.
Amplifier (the more consequential defect)
packages/session-query/session-query/src/corpus.ts inspectPersisted (~L272-293) only special-cases SessionPersistenceCorruptionError and rethrows everything else as SESSION_QUERY_PERSISTENCE_FAILED. There is no per-session skip or partial-result path, and session-query-sqlite's _observeStable behaves the same way. Net effect: one unreadable artifact fails the whole search. In our workspace, 34 of 323 sessions (10.5%) were unreadable due to this single format issue, and that cost 100% of search.
Cold-read sweep evidence (323 sessions): 289 readable / 34 failing, all with signature SessionFormatUnsupportedError: subagent/descriptor {seq} uses unsupported descriptor version 2 (23x seq 6, 10x seq 0, 1x seq 50393).
Questions

Is descriptor v2 meant to be migratable? If yes, would you accept admitting released descriptor versions whose key set is a subset of the current released inventory (or an explicit version→inventory mapping), instead of hard-failing in the v0 path?
For the query layer: should an unreadable session degrade to "skipped/not searchable" rather than failing the entire search? That seems like the higher-value fix — partial data should still be searchable.

Local workaround we are running (for reference, not a patch submission)
Accepting v2 in both gates (2 files, +13/-2): the previously failing session cold-reads with all 157 events and header intact, descriptor data preserved verbatim (version: 2 intact — the source v0 artifact remains unchanged contract holds, originals are not rewritten); full sweep becomes 323/323 readable, 0 failures; session-format-v0-to-v1 + session-query suites pass 443/443. Happy to open a PR if a maintainer prefers that over a local downstream patch.

threads.title: [Bug] 安卓语音输入：输入法组字里带换行时，输入框只落地一部分文本（首段整段丢失）
threads.bodyText:
环境



项
值




DSH
0.1.5-rc.2（Web GUI）


设备
vivo iPA2475 / Android 16


承载
App 内置 Android WebView


输入法
微信输入法 3.5.0，语音输入 + 「AI 整理」



现象
用语音说一段话，等输入法「AI 整理」完成后，输入框里的文本会比整理版少一整段：

整理版是两行（例如「1. …」换行「2. …」）时，第一行整行消失，只剩第二行；
主观感受就是"整理完刚进框，立马又被删了一截"。

说明：输入法把口述重写、压缩是它自己的功能，不算 bug。这里只针对整理后的文本没有完整落地。
复现步骤

安卓 + 微信输入法，开着语音输入的「AI 整理」；
在 Web 输入框里用语音说一段有并列条理、能被整理成"带编号/换行"的长句（比如提两条要求）；
说完停顿，等它整理；
观察输入框：整理版的第一行可能整体消失。

关键证据（客户端埋点：composition / beforeinput / input + DOM 变更）
一次典型现场（t 是页面内相对毫秒）：
t=223457  comp-update   d=58  "1. 把那个长文按钮去掉吧，太别扭了。\n2. 把哨兵挂在后台监督着我。万一有这种…"
t=223457  beforeinput   insertCompositionText  d=58
t=223484  charData      -66   文本节点 105 → 39        ← 首段「1. …」整行没有落地
t=223486  node-/node+   SPAN、P、BR 增删（编辑器重建该处 DOM）
t=223498  input         insertCompositionText  d=58  ×3
t=223498  comp-end      d=41  "2. 把哨兵挂在后台监督着我。…\n"   ← 输入法最终声明的也只剩第二行

同一次口述里，输入法先后声明的组字文本是：d=105（未整理原文）→ d=58（整理版，两行）→ d=41（只剩第二行）。
输入法声明的组字文本里有换行，而落进编辑器的只剩换行之后那一段。
对照组：

组字不含换行时，编辑器里的文本和输入法声明的文本差值 ≤2 字（通常只是尾部空白），一切正常；
同一录制窗口里 9 次"输入框被清空"，逐条和会话记录比对，9 次全部对应用户按下发送——所以不是编辑器在乱清空。

定位

触发条件是"一次组字里带换行"（contenteditable 里换行 = 新 block 元素）：此时实际落地文本比输入法声明的少一整个首段，同时编辑器重建了该处 DOM；
推测是 Android WebView/Chromium 对 insertCompositionText 组字区跨段落的边界处理，与编辑器的 DOM 重建叠加导致的；
对比 npm 上 0.1.2-rc.1 / 0.1.3-alpha.2 / 0.1.5-alpha.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2 四个版本的输入框实现，都是同一个富文本编辑器。所以这不是新版回归，是一个一直存在的老问题，只是被输入法的新功能（会把口述整理成多行/带编号）第一次踩出来。

期望行为
compositionend 之后，这一段的实际文本不应该少于输入法在 compositionupdate / compositionend 里声明的文本。
建议的修复方向

compositionend 后做一次完整性校验：拿输入法声明过的文本与该段实际文本比对；如果声明文本更长、且实际文本是它的连续子串，就按声明文本用受控插入补全（不要重新进入组字）；
或者在 beforeinput（insertCompositionText）检测到 data 含 \n 时，别让组字区跨段落推进（例如先把整段落进单个 block，再由编辑器自行拆段）；
回归用例建议：Android WebView + 中文输入法语音输入，构造"一次组字带换行/编号"的输入，断言最终文本包含组字声明文本的首段。

附：我这边做的临时缓解（没有改宿主代码）
在客户端注入一段只读监听 + 静默修补脚本：组字期间记录输入法声明过的每一版文本；compositionend 之后如果框里该段文本是其中某一版的连续子串、而且更短，就按那一版补全（只补不删，措辞变化一律尊重输入法的整理结果）。这能消除现象，但它属于事后修补，根治还是要在编辑器层做。

threads.title: macOS Desktop: standard editing shortcuts (⌘V/⌘C/⌘X/⌘A) don't work
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Official Desktop on macOS: standard editing shortcuts do nothing anywhere in the
app. ⌘V cannot paste into the chat composer or the API-key field, and ⌘C/⌘X/⌘A
are equally dead. Affects every text input, so pasting code or credentials is
impossible.
Reproduction

Launch the Desktop app (pnpm run dev:desktop, and see Notes re: packaged).
Copy any text from another application.
Focus any text field — the chat composer, or the onboarding API-key field.
Press ⌘V.

Current behavior
Nothing is inserted. No error, no dialog — the shortcut is silently ignored.
The same applies to ⌘C, ⌘X, and ⌘A.
Expected behavior
Standard macOS editing shortcuts work in every text field.
Environment

macOS (Darwin 25.6.0), arm64
Electron 44.0.0
@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.1.5-rc.2

Notes
Likely cause: the application menu template in apps/desktop/src/main.ts:437
contains only { role: 'quit' }. On macOS, Electron dispatches the standard
editing accelerators through menu items; without role: 'editMenu' (or explicit
cut/copy/paste/selectAll roles), those accelerators are never registered, so ⌘V
is not delivered to the renderer. This block is unconditional — it is not gated
on development — so the packaged build is affected as well.
Minimal fix: add { role: 'editMenu' } to the template (viewMenu/windowMenu
would restore the other standard items).

threads.title: 【BUG】fork 出的子会话继承父会话未认领的收件箱消息并重复执行
threads.bodyText:
fork 子会话会继承父会话尚未认领的收件箱消息，在自己的首轮重新执行它，新输入被排在队尾。

复现、预期与验收
复现步骤

新建一个会话（任意目录即可）。
发送 A：查询截图广州天气，100字以内告诉我，等 turn 1 完成。
发送 B：是今日的广州天气，等父会话把 B 回答完（父会话 turn 2 完成）。
在父会话里对 turn 1 的回复执行 fork（较早的那个 turn，不是最后一个）。
在子会话里输入 C：不查了查深圳天气。
观察子会话的队列与其首个 turn。

补充：第 3-4 步之间不需要抢时机。host 的切点是「锚点 turn 的 turn/end 之后一直推进到下一个 turn/start 之前」，只要锚点 turn 的下一个 turn 已存在于日志中，该 turn 的 prompt 插入事件就必然落进 seed（实测 cut=32，被继承项在 seq 31）。
实际结果
子会话 session-6054df05-c33b-4e80-9e55-10706e596d9c：

seq 32 session/end-seed {inherited:true}，即 fork 边界，inheritedEventCount=32
seq 34：C 以 agent/inbox/spliced start=1 入队，排在继承来的 B 之后，即用户新输入变成排队内容
seq 35-63：turn/start turn=2 认领 start=0，seq 38 user/message id=5b6b79f4 正是 B，完整执行了一轮（含 web_search / web_fetch / pwsh 等真实工具调用），turn/end turn=2 completed
seq 64-75：turn/start turn=3 才执行 C（seq 67 user/message id=cd059ac1）

父会话 session-600371be-f8fb-4060-a696-9bdf75731a15 里 B 已经执行过：seq 32 turn/start turn=2、seq 35 user/message id=5b6b79f4、seq 53 turn/end turn=2 completed。即同一条消息在父、子两个会话里各执行了一次。
预期结果
fork 出的子会话不应把 seq 小于 inheritedEventCount 的 agent/inbox/spliced 插入重建为自己的待执行输入：打开子会话时队列应为空；输入 C 后由 C 开启首个 turn，不重复执行 B。
环境

dsh 0.1.5-rc.1
Node v24.19.0；Windows 10 Education 22H2 build 19045
父会话 isSeeded=false；子会话 isSeeded=true，parentSession=父
日志位置：~/.dsh/sessions///session.v3.jsonl.zstd

根因定位
fork 切点把未认领的收件箱插入卷进了 seed：
let cut = boundary.seq + 1
while (cut < source.events.length && source.events[cut]?.type !== 'turn/start') cut++
// seed: source.events.slice(0, cut), inheritedEventCount: cut, meta: { isSeeded: true }

投影重建时 registry 折叠的是全量内存日志，inheritedEventCount 只作为参数传给 init()。缺陷在收件箱投影的定义：init 不接收 inheritedEventCount，apply 也没有 event.seq 守卫，于是从 seq 0 起的全部 agent/inbox/spliced 都被折叠：
init: () => ({ 'next-turn': [], 'next-step': [] }),
apply(state, event) { if (event.type !== 'agent/inbox/spliced') return state; ... }

对照：同一版本里 schedule 与 subagentCatalog 两个投影都写了 if (event.seq < state.inheritedEventCount) return state；session/end-seed 的文档也写明边界之前的事件 this lifecycle produced none of them。因此这是收件箱投影漏掉边界守卫的回归，而不是设计意图。
验收条件

打开一个 fork 子会话时，其 agent.inbox.nextTurn / nextStep 为空（父会话待办只来自继承前缀时）。
在子会话输入新消息后，首个 turn 由该新消息开启，不执行任何继承来的消息。
若修复方式为给收件箱投影加边界守卫，需同时提升 stateVersion，否则投影缓存 session_projcache 里的旧行会在冷启动被原样恢复。

threads.title: session/list returns SESSION_QUERY_SOURCE_CONFLICT when a live session re-creates a stored id, leaving the Web sidebar empty
threads.bodyText:
Summary
A single SESSION_QUERY_SOURCE_CONFLICT rejected the entire session/list RPC, so the Web session list came back empty after a page refresh — the history looked erased even though every stored session was intact on disk. The trigger is a session id that is legitimately re-created in a later process: the live header gets a fresh createdAt, which can never equal the durable one, and SessionCorpus.listSessions() treated that one disagreement as fatal for the whole listing.
Reproduction

Have a stored session artifact whose id is later re-created live. A plugin that keeps its state in one fixed session id does this on every boot: ctx.sessions.create(SessionId('team-board')).
Start dsh web and call the session list RPC:
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/session/list \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H "cookie: dsh-auth-<authority-hash>=<signed session cookie>" \
  -d '{"type":"client-request","rpcId":"1","method":"session/list","payload":{"args":{"_request":{}}}}'

Observed response (HTTP 200, transport fine):
{"type":"server-response","rpcId":"1","result":{"ok":false,"error":{
  "code":"gateway/internal",
  "message":"session source headers conflict for session \"team-board\"","details":{}}}}


Current behavior

SessionCorpus.listSessions() compares each attached session's live header with the stored header sharing its id and lets assertSessionHeadersCompatible() throw out of the whole call (packages/session-query/session-query/src/corpus.ts).
A re-created id necessarily carries a new createdAt, so this is a permanent condition, not a race, for that id.
The Web client only flips its list state to error and keeps an empty summary set, so the sidebar renders no sessions at all. Reloading cannot recover, which reads as "my chat history disappeared".
Exact reads (load) are fine; only the listing was all-or-nothing. Measured headers in the report below:

live: {"version":3,"id":"team-board","createdAt":<current boot>,"isSeeded":false}
stored (legacy v0, sessions/_no-cwd/team-board/): {"version":0,"id":"team-board","createdAt":1787020788707,"delegationDepth":0}



Expected behavior
One stale stored source should not hide the rest of the corpus: listSessions() should stay live-preferred and exclude only the conflicting stored source, while exact reads of a non-live id may keep refusing with SESSION_QUERY_SOURCE_CONFLICT.
Suggested fix (verified locally)
SessionCorpus.listSessions() catches the conflict, logs a warning, serves the live session as persisted: false, and drops the stale stored row; everything else is untouched.
let durable = records.get(session.id)
if (durable !== undefined) {
  try {
    assertSessionHeadersCompatible(session.header, durable.header)
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    if (!isSourceConflict(error)) throw error
    this._ctx.logger.warn(`session-query: stored source for session "${session.id}" conflicts with the live header; ...`)
    records.delete(session.id)
    durable = undefined
  }
}
Evidence:

Reproduced the exact gateway/internal failure in an isolated DSH_HOME, then confirmed the listing returns ok:true with the original, unmodified artifact in place.
Added a regression case that re-creates a persisted id under a fresh createdAt; packages/session-query, packages/api/session-controller/tests, and packages/subagent/subagent pass (1742 tests), plus tsc -b, oxlint, markdown wrap, and the bilingual pairing gate.
Change set: src/corpus.ts, tests/session-query.spec.ts, README.md + README.zh.md (docs for the listing semantics). Commit 729c72d743 on fix/session-list-source-conflict, based on dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2.

Environment

DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2, macOS (darwin, arm64), Node v24.15.0
Web profile with @deepseek-ai/dsh-base + @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app and third-party plugins, including @dsh-suite/plugin-team-board
ctx.sessionQuery served by @deepseek-ai/dsh-session-query-sqlite with openAt: never (SQLite not opened; the JSONL corpus path above is what ran)


中文
摘要
一次 SESSION_QUERY_SOURCE_CONFLICT 让整个 session/list RPC 失败，Web 会话列表在刷新后变成空列表——看起来像历史记录被清空，实际磁盘上每条会话都完好。触发条件是某个 session id 在后续进程中被合法地重新创建：实时 header 会拿到新的 createdAt，永远不可能等于持久化那份，而 SessionCorpus.listSessions() 把这一个不一致当成了整个列表的致命错误。
复现

磁盘上已有一个会话归档，之后同 id 被实时重新创建。把状态存在固定 session id 里的插件每次启动都会这样：ctx.sessions.create(SessionId('team-board'))。
启动 dsh web，调用会话列表 RPC（上面的 curl 示例，需带上签名的浏览器会话 cookie）。
实际返回 HTTP 200 但结果失败：{"ok":false,"error":{"code":"gateway/internal","message":"session source headers conflict for session \"team-board\""}}。

当前行为

listSessions() 把每个实时会话的 header 与同 id 的持久化 header 比较，并让 assertSessionHeadersCompatible() 的异常直接抛出整个调用。
被重新创建的 id 必然带新的 createdAt，所以对该 id 来说这是常态而非竞态。
Web 客户端只把列表状态置为 error、summaries 保持为空，侧边栏因此不显示任何会话；刷新也无法恢复。
精确读取（load）不受影响，只有列表是"全有或全无"。

期望行为
一条陈旧的持久化来源不应遮蔽其余语料：listSessions() 应保持 live-preferred，仅排除冲突的那一条持久化来源；对非实时 id 的精确读取仍可用 SESSION_QUERY_SOURCE_CONFLICT 拒绝。
建议修复（已在本地验证）
SessionCorpus.listSessions() 捕获该冲突、打一条 warning、把该实时会话按 persisted: false 返回并剔除那条陈旧记录，其余行保持不变。已在隔离的 DSH_HOME 中复现出完全一致的报错，并在放回原始未修改归档文件后确认列表恢复为 ok:true；新增回归用例（固定 id 以新的 createdAt 重新创建）；packages/session-query、packages/api/session-controller/tests、packages/subagent/subagent 共 1742 个测试通过，tsc -b、oxlint、Markdown 换行与双语配对门禁均通过。
环境
DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2，macOS (arm64)，Node v24.15.0；web profile 挂载 dsh-base + dsh-web-app 及第三方插件（含 @dsh-suite/plugin-team-board）；ctx.sessionQuery 由 dsh-session-query-sqlite（openAt: never）提供。

threads.title: Headless session env: are DSH_-prefixed variables intentionally dropped before reaching the session?
threads.bodyText:
Hi — reporting two runtime observations from a real deployment (Linux container, DSH 0.1.1-rc.2, --profile headless), in case they are useful. Both are reproducible; I did not isolate the exact mechanism, so I am reporting behavior rather than claiming a bug.
1. DSH_-prefixed environment variables do not reach the spawned headless session.
We passed an attribution marker on the parent process environment when spawning dsh --profile headless <task>.
Inside the session, the tool that reads it saw nothing (recorded UNKNOWN). Renaming the variables to a non-DSH prefix made them visible immediately; same host, same profile, same invocation. We could not determine whether the filter is applied to the DSH process environment or only to the session it spawns, so this is a phenomenon report: if you need to pass provenance into a dispatched session, a non-DSH_ prefix works; DSH_-prefixed names appear to be dropped. If that is intended namespacing hygiene, it may be worth one line in the docs.
2. MCP client tool registration is not refreshed after a connection failure.
A streamable-HTTP MCP server was unreachable when the session started (every call returned fetch failed). After the server came back, calls in the same session returned unknown tool — the tool list was never re-fetched — and only a new session could use the server. If accurate, re-listing tools on reconnect/retry would make long-lived sessions recover without a restart.
3. Session logs can end with a partial zstd frame.
session.jsonl.zstd may end mid-frame while live. A tail decoder that walks frame boundaries can distinguish "torn at the tail (expected while writing)" from "torn in the middle (corruption)". Not a request — just noting the distinction we had to make.
Happy to provide minimal reproductions (sanitized: no private addresses or paths). Thanks for the harness.

threads.title: [Bug] Python code runtime child process becomes orphaned high-CPU zombie on macOS after host exits
threads.bodyText:
Environment

OS: macOS (Darwin arm64)
Component: packages/experimental/code-runtime-python (bootstrap.py)

Description
When the DSH host process is restarted, reloaded, or exited abnormally on macOS, the spawned Python runtime child process (bootstrap.py) is not cleaned up.
Because macOS does not support Linux-specific PR_SET_PDEATHSIG, the Python process is reparented to launchd (PID 1). After the IPC channel (fd 3) closes, the process enters an infinite busy-wait loop in the asynchronous event loop / reader, pinning a single CPU core at 100% indefinitely.
Expected Behavior

The Python child process should terminate immediately when the parent process exits or when EOF is encountered on the protocol pipe.
On macOS, a lightweight background watchdog thread inside bootstrap.py should monitor os.getppid() == 1 and call os._exit(0) when orphaned.
The host Node.js process should kill the child process group (process.kill(-pid, 'SIGKILL')) on teardown.

threads.title: compaction-basic: default thresholdRatio 0.8 can never trigger when the per-request output reserve is large (sessions die before first compaction)
threads.bodyText:
现象
长会话（消息量约 79 万 token）在完成任何自动压缩之前，就直接收到上游 max-context 报错而死；会话记录中从未出现任何 compaction/start / compaction/summary。
环境

dsh 0.1.5-rc.2（dsh --profile web；我们在此版本上运行长驻 agent 会话）
模型 deepseek-flash：context window 1,048,576；每次请求默认携带 maxTokens=256,000（输出预留）
实测报错样例（原文）：

This model's maximum context length is 1048576 tokens. However, you requested 1048596 tokens (792596 in the messages, 256000 in the completion)
...requested 1055000 tokens (799000 in the messages, 256000 in the completion)



数值分析

有效输入上限 = 1,048,576 − 256,000 = 792,576（≈ window 的 75.6%；按显示口径 1,000,000 ≈ 79.26%）
compaction-basic 默认 thresholdRatio: 0.8 ⇒ 触发点：

按 1,048,576 计 = 838,860 > 792,576（不可达）
按 1,000,000 计 = 800,000 > 792,576（仍不可达，差 7,424 tokens）


⇒ 在大输出预留（256K）下，默认阈值永远无法在死线前触发；先撞死线，压缩永远轮不到。

证据

两个长会话的完整会话记录（约 8.8MB / 8.1MB）：compaction 相关出现 0 次；终结均为上述硬溢出报错。
我们已在自家部署将 thresholdRatio 调整为 0.65 作为缓解（本 issue 供上游参考默认值行为）。

建议（供参考）

触发条件与输出预留挂钩，例如 min(thresholdRatio × window, window − maxOutputReserve − margin)；或
下调默认值（如 0.65–0.7）；或
在文档中明确：大输出预留模型需自行调低 thresholdRatio（Dev Note 亦提到默认比例 no corpus-backed guidance）。

附注（观察，供确认）
packages/bundle/web-app 的补丁将 compaction-basic / command-compact / tool-result-pruner 置为 disabled: true（注释称 moved to host plane）。在我们部署的最终组合树（dsh --profile web --dump-config）中三者仍为 disabled: true 且未见替代挂载——不确定是预期行为还是我们缺了某个环节，一并反馈。

threads.title: Overflow recovery produced no compaction attempt after CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED (no compaction/start recorded; session stays dead)
threads.bodyText:
现象
会话在收到 provider 确认的 CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED 后，未记录任何压缩尝试；后续每次唤醒/重试仍以同类报错结束（同一会话累计 8 次 CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED），直至 turn/end.reason.kind=error 终止，会话进入"每次唤醒都撞同一面墙"的状态。
环境 / 证据

dsh 0.1.5-rc.2、deepseek-flash、window 1,048,576、默认输出预留 256,000（与另一条 issue 同环境）
会话记录（约 8.8MB、3141 行）统计：

CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED ×8；maximum context ×8
compaction/start = 0；compaction/summary = 0；compacted-summary = 0


时间线样例：turn 41 首次报错（requested 1048596 = 792596 messages + 256000 completion）→ 至 turn 44 仍为同类报错后 terminated（另一样本会话序列一致）。

期望 vs 实测
compaction-basic README 描述：agent/request-error 监听器对 provider 确认的 CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED 会绕过常规阈值与保留策略、做一次最大平衡头部缩减，并在 surface replacement generation 前进后授权重试。
实测：未观察到任何压缩尝试落地（无 compaction/start），会话直接死亡。
疑问

恢复是否有前置条件（open turn / step boundary / generation advance）导致在"已 closed 的会话"或"重试回合"里无法启动？
恢复失败是否可在会话记录里留下痕迹（当前完全静默，诊断困难）——哪怕一条"恢复尝试失败"的持久化记录？
若压缩请求本身需要全量历史而在超限会话上不可行，是否应提供更轻的兜底（先裁剪/外置再压缩）？

影响
长会话一旦错过压缩窗口即进入死亡循环（每次唤醒都撞同一面墙），只能靠外部重建会话恢复；对长驻 agent 工作流影响大。

threads.title: [Web GUI] 开启微信输入法「跨设备复制粘贴」后,粘贴图片无法发送:"A requested file or directory could not be found at the time an operation was processed."

模型侧:OpenAI Codex 订阅模型(gpt-5.x / gpt-6-astra,经 dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 openai-codex 协议)与 GLM-5.3-flash(zai,原生多模态)

症状
粘贴图片后点发送,消息发不出去,composer 弹 toast:

A requested file or directory could not be found at the time an operation was processed.

表面上看和模型强相关:用 Codex 订阅模型基本必现,用 GLM-5.3-flash 一切正常——所以一开始完全查错了方向。
排查(这条文案到底是谁产生的)


怀疑是 Node fs.cp 的 ERR_FS_CP_ENOENT → 排除:Node 的 fs.cp 错误码表里没有这个码,实测缺源文件报的是普通 ENOENT ... lstat。


对 harness 仓库源码、已安装的全局 dsh bundle、已装载的 web client bundle、本地自定义插件源码、request-log、以及解压后的最近 session 日志做全文检索 → 这句话在本地任何地方都不存在。


检索该句原文 → 它是 Chromium 的固定文案,见 third_party/blink/renderer/core/fileapi/file_error.cc:
const char kNotFoundErrorMessage[] =
    "A requested file or directory could not be found at the time an "
    "operation was processed.";
即 blink 文件 API 的 kNotFoundError → DOMException [NotFoundError] 消息;OPFS、File System Access、FileReader 等失败时都会抛出。


根因链路(以当前 master 源码行号为准;已装 0.1.5-rc.1 的 client bundle 为同一模式)
粘贴
  → keymap.ts PASTE_COMMAND → item.getAsFile()
    (packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/editor/keymap.ts:137)
  → createDrafts → browserDraftAttachment(file)
    (service.ts:73) 只建了 URL.createObjectURL 预览,字节未读,
     浏览器 File 对象被原样存进 draftAttachments

发送(两条提交路径同样行为)
  → sendSession → serializeAttachments → encodeImage(attachment.file)
    (service.ts:260)
  → serializeDraftAttachments → encodeImage(attachment.file)
    (service.ts:454)
  → base64ImageOf(file) → FileReader.readAsDataURL(file)
    (service.ts:124-135,reader.onerror 直接 reject reader.error)
  → 粘贴与发送之间,剪贴板同步功能接管了剪贴板,
    File 背后的快照失效 → DOMException [NotFoundError]
  → submission.abandon() → facade notify('error', error.message)
    (facade.ts:378) → InputBar toast(InputBar.tsx:111)
     文案 = DOMException.message,一字不差

关键点:图片草稿被惰性持有,直到提交才第一次读字节。对比之下,非图片文件草稿在 intake 时就后台上传(beginFileUpload),不受影响——所以只有贴图踩坑。

threads.title: `dsh-skill-filesystem` 的目录监视在 Windows 上导致 bundle 插件无法在线更新（ERR_PNPM_EPERM: rename …_tmp_…）
threads.bodyText:
摘要@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem 在 watch: true（默认）下用 chokidar 以深度 1 监视每个注册的技能根，在 Windows 上会为该目录持有句柄。结果是：注册了技能根的 bundle 插件，在 DSH 运行期间永远无法在插件市场里更新 —— pnpm 落地新版本的最后一步 rename <pkg>_tmp_<n> -> <pkg> 被 Windows 拒绝。环境WindowsDSH Desktop 2.0.10 / @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.2@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem 0.1.5-rc.2Node v24.18.0 / pnpm 11.8.0profile desktop（nodeLinker: hoisted，autoInstallPeers: false）复现安装 @openviking/dsh-memory-plugin@0.3.0 并保持 DSH 运行。更新到 0.3.2：dsh plugin --profile desktop add @openviking/dsh-memory-plugin@latest实际结果ERR_PNPM_EPERM: [importPackage ...\node_modules\@openviking\dsh-memory-plugin]EPERM: operation not permitted, rename'...\node_modules\@openviking\dsh-memory-plugin_tmp_15548_10' -> '...\node_modules\'同一进程内改名探测（Rename-Item + 立刻改回）：
插件（同期在线更新均成功） | 子目录 | 包根
-- | -- | --
dsh-context | lib、node_modules 均 OK | ✅ OK
dshmarket | client/lib/src 全 OK | ✅ OK
@gausszhou/dsh-opencode-session-id | lib OK | ✅ OK
@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin | shared OK、servers OK、skills LOCKED | ❌ LOCKED
补充：包内新建/删除文件成功、改名 README.md 成功、skills/openviking-memory 内部改名成功 —— 即锁的粒度是目录句柄，不是「文件被占用」。根因@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin 的 skills.mjs 注册了包内技能根，且未传 watch：export const SKILLS_DIR = fileURLToPath(new URL("./skills", import.meta.url));export function buildSkillsConfig() {  return { providerName: SKILL_PROVIDER_NAME, includeDefaultRoots: false, customSkillDirs: [SKILLS_DIR] };}export function mountOpenVikingSkills(ctx) {  return ctx.plugin(skillFilesystem, buildSkillsConfig());}该插件由自己的 bundle patch 以默认配置挂载（其 cordis.patch.yml 只写 name:，无 config），用户的 profile patch 也未覆盖，因此走默认值：lib/index.js:37 → watch 默认 truelib/index.js:38 → watchUsePolling 默认 falselib/index.js:372-386 → openRootWatcher() 用 chokidar.watch(mode.anchor, { …, usePolling })，深度 1chokidar 底层 fs.watch() 在 Windows 上持有该目录句柄且不带 FILE_SHARE_DELETE，于是：skills/ 本身不可改名（watcher 钉住它）其子项可改名（深度 1）包里其他目录可改名（无 watcher）而 pnpm 更新一个包要 rename 的正是该目录的父包目录，故必然 EPERM。这也解释了为什么 dsh-context / dshmarket / dsh-opencode-session-id 同期都能在线更新：它们加载后不留任何持续句柄。影响面不限于 OpenViking：任何在 Windows 上注册文件系统监视根的 bundle 插件都无法在线更新，且用户得到的提示是「检查 profile」，与实际原因无关。期望Windows 上更新此类插件应成功，或至少一次性给出可执行指引（完全退出 DSH 后命令行更新 / 停用该插件并重启后再更新）。不应为了更新而要求用户「停用插件」——这属于平台实现细节泄漏。建议修复A（根治，推荐） Windows 上对注册根默认 usePolling: true。fs.watchFile 只周期性 stat 目标路径，不持有目录句柄，因此 rename 不再被拒。现有 watchPollIntervalMs（默认 100ms）与 watchUsePolling 开关使这只是一处策略切换。代价是轮询开销，可配合 watchMaxProjects 限流。B 改为监视技能根的父目录而非根自身，使技能根可被整体替换。C 若 A/B 有额外权衡，至少提供可显式 watch: false 的途径并写入文档：随发行版发布、运行时不会被磁盘编辑的技能目录（如本 bundle 的 skills/）并不需要 watcher。

threads.title: DeepSeek Harness 前端输入框对中文输入法 IME 兼容问题
threads.bodyText:
实际问题只是在harness对话框打字会出现同步跳字。
以下内容由deepseek生成
【Bug 反馈】DeepSeek Harness 输入框中文输入法同步跳字/候选词自动上屏
环境：

产品：DeepSeek Harness Web
模型：DeepSeek-V4.1-flash和V4-falsh
操作系统：Windows 11
浏览器：Edge 版本
输入法：微软拼音
Harness 版本：应该是最新吧）

复现步骤：

打开 DeepSeek Harness 使用过的聊天页。
在输入框用中文输入法键入 nihao，不按空格/数字选词。
候选条显示：1 你好 2 你号 3 拟好 4 倪浩 5 (@^0^@)/ 6 你哈哦 7 泥嚎。
输入框内容异常变成“尼哈尼赫尼”，出现跳字、重复上屏。

期望行为：

输入法组合输入期间，输入框只显示拼音或正常候选，不自动上屏候选词。
用户按空格/数字/回车选词后，才把对应汉字写入输入框。
流式响应、状态更新不应打断输入法 composition。

可能原因：

受控输入框在 IME composition 期间被强制重写 value。
流式响应/重渲染触发 onChange，导致 composition 被打断。
未正确处理 compositionstart / compositionupdate / compositionend。

建议修复：

在输入框组件增加 isComposing 标志：onCompositionStart 设 true，onCompositionEnd 设 false。
onChange 或状态同步时，如果 isComposing 为 true，跳过对输入框 value 的 setState/强制同步。
避免在 composition 期间用 props.value 覆盖输入框；可在 compositionend 后再同步。
将输入框组件与流式响应重渲染隔离（memo/独立 state），避免父组件更新导致输入框重置。
回归测试：Chrome/Edge + 微软拼音/搜狗，输入 nihao、zhongwen、woshi 等长拼音，连续快速输入。

临时规避：

无痕模式/禁用浏览器扩展。
Windows 开启微软拼音“使用以前版本的微软拼音输入法”。
先在别处输入后粘贴。

请求：请修复该 IME 兼容性问题，或提供临时补丁/版本。可提供截图和录屏。

threads.title: opencode-go provider returns stale model list — deepseek-flash (V4.1 Flash) missing & custom provider fails with MissingSessionID
threads.bodyText:
问题描述
DeepSeek Harness 内置的 opencode-go 提供商返回的模型列表不包含最新的 deepseek-flash（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）。手动在设置中添加自定义提供商后，所有请求均返回 400: MissingSessionID 错误，导致 OpenCode Go 路由完全不可用。

复现步骤

在 DSH 设置 → 模型 → 添加提供商中，选择内置的 opencode-go。
点击“获取可用模型”，返回的列表中不包含 deepseek-flash。
手动创建自定义提供商，Provider ID 填写 opencode-go，API 地址填写 https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1，协议选择 openai-completions。
添加模型 ID deepseek-flash 后尝试对话，收到报错：

400: {"type":"MissingSessionID","message":"Error from provider (Console Go): Request is missing x-opencode-session and cannot be routed efficiently. Please see https://opencode.ai/docs/go/#where-can-i-use-it"}


预期行为

opencode-go 的模型列表应包含 deepseek-flash（即 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）。
自定义或内置的 OpenCode Go 提供商应能正常发送请求，不出现 MissingSessionID 错误。

环境信息

DSH 版本： 0.1.5-rc.2
OpenCode Go 提供商配置：API 地址 https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1，协议 openai-completions
操作系统：windows 25H2 

已尝试的排查

确认 API Key 有效，且 GET https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models 返回的列表中包含 deepseek-flash。
手动添加模型 ID deepseek-flash 后仍无法正常调用，报错始终为 MissingSessionID。
了解到社区插件 dsh-opencode-models 可以拉取完整模型列表，但该插件只解决模型发现问题，不解决自定义提供商的 x-opencode-session 请求头缺失问题。

请求

为内置 opencode-go 路由实现实时模型发现，或在“获取可用模型”时调用真实端点 GET {baseURL}/models。
让内置 opencode-go 路由自动附加 x-opencode-session 请求头（可参考社区插件的实现）。
更新静态 catalog，补充 deepseek-flash（DeepSeek V4.1 Flash）等新模型。
如果以上为有意设计，请在文档中说明推荐的 OpenCode Go 接入方式。

threads.title: [Bug] dsh 在 Node 24 上静默退出(import.meta.main 已被移除)
threads.bodyText:
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1
Node v24.0.0(macOS arm64)
package.json 没有 engines 字段

现象
dsh web、dsh --profile web、dsh --version 全部静默退出(exit 0、零 stdout、零 stderr)。
3080 端口从未 listen,~/.dsh 也不会创建,看起来"什么也没发生"。
根因
lib/bin.js 末行用 if (import.meta.main) await runCli(); 判定是否入口。
import.meta.main 在 Node 24 上是 undefined(该 API 在 22.x 一直 experimental,24 已移除),
条件恒为 falsy,runCli() 永不执行。
实测:在 lib/bin.js 顶部加 console.error("main=" + import.meta.main),然后以该文件为入口:



Node
import.meta.main




v24.0.0
undefined ✗


v25.9.0
true ✓



(本机 Node 22 因 libsimdjson.30.dylib 缺失跑不起来,未直接验证 v22;但官方 v22 文档里有该 API。)
临时修法:把 bin.js 顶部 shebang 改成绝对路径指向能用的 Node(Node 25)。改完后
dsh --version 正常输出 0.1.5-rc.1,dsh web 起来,3080 监听正常。
复现
npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
node --version                    # v24.x
dsh web --no-open
echo "exit=$?"                    # 0
lsof -nP -iTCP:3080              # 空
ls ~/.dsh 2>/dev/null             # 不存在
期望
非 0 退出码 + 一行明确错误,例如:
Error: dsh requires Node 22 or earlier (or any version where import.meta.main exists);
detected Node v24.0.0.

哪怕只是一行 Error: failed to start; open an issue at ... 也比现在的静默退出强。
建议

package.json 加 engines("node": ">=20 <24" 或迁到可移植判断)
if (import.meta.main) 失败时给用户明确诊断(至少 console.error 一下)
CI 在 Node 24 上跑一次,避免静默回归

可移植替代(供参考)
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
const isMain = import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href;
if (isMain) await runCli();
