threads.title: Browser Use: mounting it makes session creation fail with a misleading 'initial connection or tool synchronization failed' — is this the #3984/#4025 serverName scope issue?
threads.bodyText:
Browser Use: multi-session serverName collision rejects session creation with a misleading error
Component: @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp (+ dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime, dsh-browser-use)
Version: 0.1.6-alpha.1
DSH: 0.1.6-alpha.1
Platform: macOS 26.6.2 (Darwin arm64), Node v24.18.0
Severity: blocks session creation entirely once triggered

Summary
After mounting Browser Use (Playwright MCP backend) and restarting dsh web, creating or resuming any session fails across all workspaces:
failed to create session "session-<id>": Error:
mcp-client(playwright-mcp): initial connection or tool synchronization failed

The error text points at connection, but the actual failure is a serverName uniqueness collision in dsh-mcp-client's process-wide reservation table. Because Browser Use mounts one MCP client per live Session (all under the fixed name playwright-mcp) with failOnStartupError: true, any overlap between two Sessions' registration windows tears down session creation.
Once Browser Use is disabled, session creation recovers immediately.

Environment / config that triggers it
- insert:
    - id: browser-use
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use'
    - id: browser-use-playwright-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp'
      config:
        mode: launch
        headless: true
        executablePath: /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome
Profile uses patchReload: live. Another, unrelated MCP server (serverName: dbx) is mounted in the same profile and never fails.

Observed symptoms

Sessions stop being created. Their persisted logs stop after the permission records — exactly 3 lines, ~320 bytes:

{"type":"session","version":3,"id":"session-...","cwd":"...","agentPreset":"standard"}
{"type":"permission/preset","seq":0,"data":{"preset":"workspace-write"}}
{"type":"sandbox/mode","seq":1,"data":{"mode":"workspace-write"}}
{"type":"approval/policy","seq":2,"data":{"policy":"ask"}}

Fails across every workspace (not workspace-specific) — 20+ such stub sessions accumulated in ~90 seconds across 6 different workspaces.
Intermittent: rapid successive "new session" clicks fail; retrying after a pause succeeds. One workspace produced FAIL at 16:20:11 and OK at 16:20:32.


Root-cause chain (traced in source)
1. dsh-mcp-client reserves serverName process-wide, with a ctx.root fallback
packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/index.ts (apply):
ctx.effect(() => {
  const owner = scopeOf(ctx) ?? ctx.root          // ← falls back to process root
  let names = activeServerNames.get(owner)
  if (!names) { names = new Set(); activeServerNames.set(owner, names) }
  if (names.has(config.serverName)) {
    throw new Error(`mcp-client: serverName "${config.serverName}" is already in use by another mcp-client instance — pick a unique serverName in cordis.yml`)
  }
  names.add(config.serverName)
  return () => void names.delete(config.serverName)
}, 'mcp-client.serverName')
2. Browser Use mounts one MCP client per live Session, all with the same fixed name
packages/experimental/browser-use-runtime/src/mcp.ts (mountSessionMcp), inside SessionResources.open(agent, signal):
await scope.ctx.plugin(McpClient, McpClient.Config({
  transport: 'stdio',
  serverName: options.name,        // fixed per provider — 'playwright-mcp' for every Session
  command: options.command,
  args: options.args,
  failOnStartupError: true,        // ← turns a contained conflict into a fatal one
  reconnect: { enabled: false },   // ← no retry
}))
and the provider passes the constant name (browser-use-playwright-mcp/src/index.ts):
mountSessionMcp(ctx, {
  name: 'playwright-mcp',
  exclusive: config.mode === 'attach',
  ...
})
3. failOnStartupError: true makes the collision fatal, then wraps it in a misleading message
dsh-mcp-client:
const opts = { registrationFailure: 'contain', serverName: config.serverName, ... }
const startupOpts = config.failOnStartupError
  ? { ...opts, registrationFailure: 'throw' }    // ← Browser Use path
  : opts                                          // ← ordinary MCP servers stay contained
...
const outcome = await connection.ready
if (outcome.error !== undefined && config.failOnStartupError) {
  throw new Error(`mcp-client(${config.serverName}): initial connection or tool synchronization failed`, { cause: outcome.error })
}
4. Browser Use mounts during the serial, blocking agent/created event
mountSessionMcp:
ctx.on('agent/created', async ({ agent, signal }) => {
  ...
  await resources.get(agent, signal)   // awaits the MCP client's connection + discovery
  clients.set(agent, state)
}, { prepend: true })
Because agent/created is serial and awaited, a throw here prevents session creation from ever completing — which is exactly the 3-line stub logs above.
Why only Browser Use breaks
serverName reservation is process-global while the tool registry it feeds is per-agent scoped. Two live Sessions legitimately wanting the same MCP server collide on the name check even when teardown is perfect and instantaneous. Ordinary MCP servers (dbx here) survive because they use the default failOnStartupError: false, which contains the failure instead of throwing.
This matches the analysis already on file in #3984 / #4025 (scope mismatch: activeServerNames keyed on ctx.root vs per-agent tool visibility), except the Browser Use path escalates the collision into a hard session-creation failure.

Evidence that the MCP server itself is healthy
The failure is not in the Playwright MCP process. All of the following succeeded while Browser Use was mounted and failing:

Same command DSH spawns, using DSH's own scrubbedParentEnv() + StdioClientTransport:
OK cwd=/Users/lee/LeeProject/space tools=24 148ms
10 concurrent instances across 4 different cwd values (including non-ASCII paths):
all OK, 24 tools each, ~380 ms
8 concurrent instances in the same second: all OK
Manual runs under the exact failing workspace cwd: all OK
initialize returns protocolVersion 2025-06-18; tool list = 24 tools

Ruled out as causes: executablePath value, working directory, non-ASCII paths, memory pressure (71 % free), git presence, Chrome singleton lock, concurrent MCP spawn count.

Suggested direction
Any one of these would prevent a recoverable condition from killing session creation:

Scope serverName uniqueness to the registering agent scope rather than ctx.root, matching where the tools actually live — or, if per-process uniqueness is intentional (double-spawn protection), make the error message say so and document the concurrent-Session restriction explicitly.
Do not let a per-Session provider mount be fatal to agent/created — a failed browser mount should leave that Session without browser tools (the documented blocked behavior in SessionResources) instead of rejecting creation.
Include cause in the surfaced error. The wrapper message names "connection or tool synchronization", which sends diagnosis down the wrong path; the actual cause was a registration collision.

Note: simply deleting the reservation before checking (as floated in #3984) would make two instances share one serverName silently; #4025 already argues that is worse than the deterministic error.

Workaround
Disabling the two Browser Use rows restores session creation immediately. Because --isolated is hard-coded in the launch branch, launch cannot persist a profile, so there is no config-level way to avoid the per-Session mount short of not using the provider.
Below is the machine-translated Chinese version. 以下为中文版。

Browser Use：多会话 serverName 冲突导致会话创建被拒，且报错信息误导
组件： @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp（含 dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime、dsh-browser-use）
版本： 0.1.6-alpha.1
DSH： 0.1.6-alpha.1
平台： macOS 26.6.2（Darwin arm64），Node v24.18.0
严重程度： 一旦触发，会话创建被完全阻断
概述
挂载 Browser Use（Playwright MCP 后端）并重启 dsh web 后，所有工作区的新建与恢复会话全部失败：
failed to create session "session-<id>": Error:
mcp-client(playwright-mcp): initial connection or tool synchronization failed

报错文字指向「连接」，但真实原因是 dsh-mcp-client 进程级 serverName 保留表中的唯一性冲突。由于 Browser Use 为每个活动会话挂载一个 MCP 客户端（名字固定为 playwright-mcp），并设置 failOnStartupError: true，任意两个会话的注册窗口重叠，就会让会话创建失败。
停用 Browser Use 后，会话创建立即恢复。
触发配置
- insert:
    - id: browser-use
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-browser-use'
    - id: browser-use-playwright-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp'
      config:
        mode: launch
        headless: true
        executablePath: /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome
Profile 使用 patchReload: live。同一 profile 内另一个无关的 MCP 服务器（serverName: dbx）从不失败。
观察到的现象

会话不再被创建，其持久化日志停在权限记录之后——正好 3 行、约 320 字节（见上方 JSON）。
跨所有工作区失败（与工作区无关）：约 90 秒内在 6 个不同工作区累积了 20 多个这样的空壳会话。
间歇性：快速连续点击「新会话」会失败，停顿后重试则成功。同一工作区在 16:20:11 失败、16:20:32 成功。

根因链条（源码追溯）

dsh-mcp-client 以进程级方式保留 serverName，并回退到 ctx.root：const owner = scopeOf(ctx) ?? ctx.root，随后若名字已存在即抛错。
Browser Use 为每个活动会话挂载一个 MCP 客户端，名字固定：serverName: options.name（提供方传常量 'playwright-mcp'），同时 failOnStartupError: true、reconnect: { enabled: false }。
failOnStartupError: true 把冲突升级为致命：mcp-client 默认 registrationFailure: 'contain'，Browser Use 路径改为 'throw'；最终包装成 mcp-client(...): initial connection or tool synchronization failed。
Browser Use 在串行阻塞的 agent/created 中挂载（{ prepend: true } 且 await resources.get(...)），因此抛错会让会话创建永远无法完成——这正是那 3 行空壳日志的成因。

为什么只有 Browser Use 会坏
serverName 保留是进程全局的，而它服务的工具注册表是按 agent 作用域的。两个活动会话合法地想挂载同一个 MCP 服务器时，即使 teardown 完美且即时，也会在名字检查上冲突。普通 MCP 服务器（此处的 dbx）因为使用默认的 failOnStartupError: false 而把失败包容掉，所以不受影响。
这与 #3984 / #4025 中已有的分析一致（activeServerNames 以 ctx.root 为 key 与 per-agent 工具可见性之间的作用域不匹配），差别在于 Browser Use 路径把这个冲突升级成了硬性的会话创建失败。
MCP 服务器本身健康的证据
故障不在 Playwright MCP 进程内。在 Browser Use 已挂载且正在失败期间，以下全部成功：

使用 DSH 自身的 scrubbedParentEnv() + StdioClientTransport 启动同一命令：OK ... tools=24 148ms
跨 4 个不同 cwd（含非 ASCII 路径）并发 10 个实例：全部 OK，各 24 工具，约 380 ms
同一秒内并发 8 个实例：全部 OK
在失败工作区的确切 cwd 下手动运行：全部 OK
initialize 返回 protocolVersion 2025-06-18；工具数 24

已排除：executablePath 取值、工作目录、非 ASCII 路径、内存压力（71% 空闲）、git 存在性、Chrome 单例锁、并发 MCP 启动数量。
建议方向

把 serverName 唯一性收窄到注册的 agent 作用域，与工具实际所在的作用域一致；若进程级唯一性是刻意设计（防重复拉起），请在报错与文档中明确说明该并发限制。
不要让 per-session 的提供方挂载对 agent/created 致命——浏览器挂载失败应让该会话没有浏览器工具（即 SessionResources 中已有的 blocked 行为），而不是拒绝会话创建。
在抛出的错误中带上 cause。当前包装信息说「连接或工具同步」，把排查引向错误方向；实际原因是注册冲突。

注：像 #3984 中设想的「先删再查」会让两个实例静默共用同一个 serverName；#4025 已论证这比确定性报错更糟。
规避方式
停用这两行 Browser Use 配置即可立即恢复会话创建。由于 launch 分支中 --isolated 是硬编码的，launch 无法持久化 profile，因此在配置层面除了不使用该提供方之外，没有其他办法避免 per-session 挂载。

threads.title: tsdown workspace mode resolves the suite root config as a build target and aborts the run (0.22.2)
threads.bodyText:
tsdown workspace mode resolves the suite root config as a build target and aborts the whole run
tsdown version: 0.22.2 (rolldown 1.1.1)
Node: v24.19.0 (also reproduced on v24.18.0)
OS: Linux (docker node:24-bookworm-slim) and Windows 11 — byte-identical failure on both
Package manager: pnpm 11.7.0
Summary
With a root tsdown.config.ts that declares workspace and entry, the workspace run aborts during config
resolution — before any package builds — with:
ERROR  Error: [@scope/root-package] Cannot find entry: ["lib/types/{index,invariant,startup}.js"]
    at resolveEntry (tsdown/dist/options-*.mjs:83:34)
    at async resolveUserConfig (…:740:40)
    at async Promise.all (index 25)
    at resolveConfig (tsdown/dist/build-*.mjs:95:19)

The label is the root package, and the entry is the root config's own entry template — i.e. the suite root
config itself is being resolved as if it were a build target. A repository root is a declaration, not a package with
lib/types/index.js, so this can never succeed.
Minimal reproduction
sh reproduce.sh        # creates ./tsdown-ws-repro, installs tsdown@0.22.2, runs three variants
The generated project is the smallest shape that carries the same structure:
package.json                 { "name": "@repro/root", "private": true, "type": "module" }
pnpm-workspace.yaml          packages/*/*  +  apps/*
tsdown.config.ts             workspace: ['packages/*/*', 'apps/*']
                             entry: ['lib/types/{index,invariant,startup}.js']
packages/util/thing/         @repro/thing — has src/index.ts, and lib/types/index.js is pre-created
apps/web/                    @repro/web-frontend — a Vite-style app with no lib/types entry

Observed



Variant
Result




A — every discovered package has lib/types/index.js
✅ ✔ Build complete for both packages


B — apps/web lacks that entry (the real-world case)
❌ Error: [@repro/web-frontend] Cannot find entry: ["lib/types/{index,invariant,startup}.js"]


C — workspace: { include: ['packages/*/*'] } (exclude the package that lacks entries)
❌ failure moves to the root: [@repro/root] Cannot find entry


D — root config returns [] for the host face
❌ Error: undefined No input files, try "tsdown <your-file>" or create src/index.ts


E — root config returns { entry: '' } (the SKIP_WORKSPACE_BUILD shape used by packages/client/tsdown.client.ts)
❌ No input files (the empty entry fails the filter below, so the default branch runs)



Root cause pointer
dist/build-*.mjs:
95: const configs = (await Promise.all(rootConfigs.map(async (rootConfig) => {
96:   const { configs: workspaceConfigs, deps: workspaceDeps } = await resolveWorkspace(rootConfig, inlineConfig, rootDeps);
98:   const configs = (await Promise.all(workspaceConfigs.filter((config) => !config.workspace || config.entry)
        .map((config) => resolveUserConfig(config, inlineConfig, workspaceDeps)))).flat()…
Line 98's filter keeps a config when !config.workspace || config.entry. The suite root config satisfies
config.entry (it is the template string), so it passes the filter and is handed to resolveUserConfig, which
resolves entry against the root cwd and throws at resolveEntry (line 83). Setting the root entry to an
empty string makes config.entry falsy, so the filter drops it — and the run then fails one branch later with
No input files, because resolveEntry falls back to <cwd>/src/index.ts, which a suite root does not have.
Expected
The suite root config should not be resolved as a build target. Either exclude it explicitly during workspace
expansion, or make the existing "skip this package" convention work for it (client-only packages are skipped today
via a config whose entry is empty — the docs in packages/client/tsdown.client.ts describe the intent as
"Workspace mode replaces an empty config array with the root defaults. A falsey entry instead removes this package
before entry resolution.").
Real-world impact
deepseek-harness (private fork) at tag dsh-v0.1.5-rc.2:

pnpm run build:lib:host = tsc -b tsconfig.host.json && tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host
tsc -b passes with 0 errors; tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host fails exactly as above, leaving 81 packages in
the bundle closure without lib/ artifacts, so the downstream pnpm deploy cannot materialize the runtime.

Workaround in the fork today: none that we could find from the config surface (seven variants tried, A–E above plus
patching the discovery list and moving the config out of the root). A patch to resolveConfig/line 98 that skips the
root suite config works around it.

threads.title: Notes from building a scroll-UX client plugin: root causes of "stiff" auto-scroll, and the fixes that work
threads.bodyText:
We built dsh-think-ux (https://github.com/el16z3c/dsh-think-ux) — a client plugin that makes think rows stream as a smooth capped preview and makes the main conversation view glide to the bottom instead of snapping. While chasing an intermittent "stiff scroll" report we instrumented the scroller and found three findings that may be useful for anyone working on Web-UI scroll behavior (and for the bundle itself):
1. Browser scroll anchoring fights smooth follow on large insertions. When a tool row / code block lands while the reader is bottom-pinned, the browser's overflow-anchor adjustment shifts scrollTop by the whole inserted chunk in a single frame (we measured 20–200 px downward shifts landing exactly at the floor — 295 of 333 uncaught scroller motions in one capture). A smooth chaser stepping ~16 px/frame cannot catch a whole-chunk snap, so the result is a visible hard jump. Fix: overflow-anchor: none on the scroller while following (restore the previous inline value on unload — an empty original must still clear the inline override).
2. Think-box settle unmounts ~490 px in one frame. When a think row settles, the body unmounts; a bottom-pinned reader is clamped down by the whole box in one frame (the turn-boundary "stiff snap"). Fix: play a short height animation (180 ms) before the unmounting commit so the clamp happens frame by frame. The animation should end via transitionend (a fixed timer racing the animation desyncs under hidden tabs / main-thread stalls), with the timer started at the animation's real start as a safety net; the finish should keep the inline height: 0 until the element unmounts (clearing it first flashes the natural full height for a frame under load).
3. Reader intent vs bundle re-pin is a structural problem, not a timing one. The bundle's follow re-pin is a plain JS el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight write; native reader scrolling never passes through the JS property setter. A defineProperty trap on the scroller's scrollTop therefore identifies re-pins by construction: writes landing at the floor while the reader sits above it are re-pins — allow them (so the bundle's own bookkeeping stays consistent) and restore the reader's position in the same tick. The real change fires a scroll event the bundle's handler reads as "reader moved", which flips its follow off — self-healing. Every reader return is native, passes through untouched, and re-engages follow. (One Chrome fact we verified: scroll events carry isTrusted=true even for JS scrollTop writes — trust the trap, not the flag.)
Happy to share the trace methodology (per-instance rAF echo ring + a local HTTP trace sink) if useful.

threads.title: Inline math: single-dollar spans always become math because the option is read from an empty object
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Any $…$ span in a chat message is rendered as inline math (KaTeX), so currency and shell text are destroyed: the dollar signs disappear, the words in between switch to math type, and every space inside the span is swallowed.
Input that a normal assistant answer produced:
tek tasarım için $1.64, diğer ikisi toplam $0.62.

Rendered as: tek tasarım için 1.64, diğerikisitoplam 0.62. — the two $ are gone and "diğer ikisi toplam" is set as one italic math run.
Environment

dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 (npm global install), web profile, browser surface, dark theme
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend, bundled dist/assets/vendor-*.js
Reproduced with plain assistant prose — no extensions, no plugins, no custom theme

Root cause
In the bundled frontend, the micromark math text construct reads its option from a fresh empty object:
function w4(e) {
  let n = {}.singleDollarTextMath;
  n == null && (n = !0);            // always true
  return { tokenize: r, resolve: x4, previous: k4, name: "mathText" };
  …
}
{}.singleDollarTextMath is always undefined, so the ?? true default always wins. The option can therefore never be disabled from outside: no matter what a caller passes, the bundled code inspects an empty literal. This looks like constant folding of an inlined options = {} argument at the call site — the construct parameter e is never read.
The same expression is present in the two newest published builds:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend 0.1.5-rc.2 → function w4(e){let n={}.singleDollarTextMath;return n==null&&(n=!0),…}
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend 0.1.6-alpha.1 → function t4(e){let n={}.singleDollarTextMath;return n==null&&(n=!0),…}

So this is not fixed by upgrading, and passing {singleDollarTextMath: false} cannot work in the current build.
Impact

Currency in normal prose: $1.64 … $0.62, $10 … $20.
Shell / environment text: $HOME, $PATH, $1 — any two of them in one paragraph pair up into a math span.
Inline code and code blocks are safe; ordinary prose, list items and table cells are not.
\(…\), \[…\] and $$…$$ behave correctly — only the single-dollar text form is the problem.

Suggested fix

Read the option from the real argument (options?.singleDollarTextMath ?? true) so a caller can turn it off, and
consider defaulting single-dollar text math to false — requiring \(…\) or $$…$$ for math, the way most Markdown renderers do it — since $ is far more common as a currency sign than as a math delimiter in chat.

A configuration setting for it would also be enough.
Workaround (verified)
Escaping works: \$1.64 renders as a literal $1.64, which confirms the construct honors character escapes and only the raw trigger is at fault.

threads.title: messages 协议：历史里一条 tool input 不是合法 JSON，会让整条会话永久无法恢复
threads.bodyText:
messages 协议：历史里一条 tool input 不是合法 JSON，会让整条会话永久无法恢复
Summary
b0641b83fc（"feat(llm): default DeepSeek to Messages with Files parity"）把默认协议从 chat-completions 切到 messages 之后，历史中只要存在一条 arguments 不是合法 JSON 的 tool call，该会话就永久无法再打开。
原因是 messages 适配器在序列化历史时会校验每条工具输入（protocols/messages/serialize.ts:16-22），一条不合法即拒绝整个请求；而恢复会话必须重放整份历史，于是每次都失败、无法自救。
同一份历史在 chat-completions 下可正常使用（该路径不做此校验），这也是升级前该会话一直可用的原因。模型偶发生成非法 JSON 是生成侧问题，但让它升级为"整条会话报废"的是适配器缺少容错。
一个容易踩偏的实现细节（本贴的核心）
同一份工具参数在会话日志里存了两份，两处都可以独立损坏，而只有其中一份会被校验：



副本
位置
是否被 serialize.ts 读取




tool/call 事件的 data.arguments
事件流
❌ 不读


assistant/message 的 tool-call 内容块 arguments
消息内容（message.content）
✅ 序列化器读的是这里



serialize.ts:24-36 的 assistant() 遍历的是 message.content，:33 对每个 tool-call 块调用 toolInput(block.arguments)。
这是结构性的，不是巧合：消息派生只接受"表面事件"，而 tool/call 不在其中——packages/core/session/src/index.ts:315-318：
function isMessageEventType(type: unknown): type is SurfaceEventType {
  return type === 'system/message' || type === 'user/message'
    || type === 'assistant/message' || type === 'tool/result'
}
tool/call（写入点 packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:264）永远不进入序列化器接收的 Message[]，因此被校验的只有 assistant/message 内容块里那一份。
实测后果：把 tool/call 事件那份修好后，会话仍然打不开——必须连内容块那份一起修。诊断时若只检查事件副本（或只看会话日志里的 type=tool/call 行），会得出"已修复"的错误结论。建议诊断工具同时检查两处。
Reproduction


在 messages 协议（即当前默认）下运行会话，期间某次工具调用的 arguments 由模型生成为非法 JSON。本例是模型在中文正文里使用了未转义的英文双引号：
{"description": "……最快，但"某个说法"就仍然没有仓库内证据。", "label": "……"}
                       ↑ 未转义，把 JSON 字符串提前闭合

正确写法应为 \"某个说法\"，或按中文排版改用全角引号。


该轮不会立即报错：工具照常执行、后续步骤照常进行，坏记录被原样写入会话日志。


之后任意一次恢复该会话 → 序列化整份历史 → 失败：
本轮运行失败  DeepSeek Messages historical tool input is invalid JSON



此后该会话每次恢复都失败，无法继续，也无法压缩自救。


Current behavior
protocols/messages/serialize.ts:16-22 直接抛错，整个请求被拒：
function toolInput(raw: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  let value: unknown
  try { value = JSON.parse(raw) } catch (_invalidToolHistoryJson) {
    throw new LlmError('DeepSeek Messages historical tool input is invalid JSON', 'INVALID_REQUEST')
  }
  return object(value, 'INVALID_REQUEST')
}
用户侧只得到这一行，不含 callId / 工具名 / 位置，无法定位是哪一条坏在哪里；该会话只能放弃。
本机实测（DSH 0.1.6-alpha.1，Windows 11，deepseek-official / deepseek-flash）：



项
值




规模
42 条会话、共 15,152 次 tool/call


命中
1 条


坏记录
工具 ask_user_question，seq=167，内容块索引 2，arguments 全长 911 字符


位置
该 far 文件第 103 个 zstd 帧 —— 第 1 行 assistant/message（含该 tool-call 块）；第 2 行是同一参数的 tool/call 事件副本


错误
Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 389


形态
arguments 内 82 个双引号全部未转义（含结构引号），解析器直到正文引号处才迷路；断点 389 正是紧跟 …最快，但 之后的那个裸引号



修复验证：将正文引号成对替换为全角引号、结构引号保持裸引号后，JSON.parse 通过，语义完整保留（"某个说法" → “某个说法”），会话恢复可用。注意两处副本都要改：只改 tool/call 事件那份时，会话依旧打不开（本机实测）。
Expected behavior
建议至少实现第 1 条：

序列化时容错：遇到不可解析的工具输入时降级而非抛错——丢弃该调用的输入（保留"这里发生过一次调用"这一事实）并记录诊断。仓库内已有同类先例：protocols/messages/replay.ts:39-46 的 readReplay() —— 捕获 INVALID_REPLAY_STATE 后调用 onDegrade 并返回 undefined，即"丢弃不可用元数据 + 记警告 + 保留内容"；
写入历史前校验：持久化 tool call 之前校验 arguments 是否可解析，不可解析则就地归一化，避免坏记录进入 durable log；
错误可诊断：报错时带上 callId / seq / 工具名，便于用户定位。

Environment

DSH 0.1.6-alpha.1（0d1f50007f），Windows 11
deepseek-official / deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V41-Flash），协议 messages（默认）
相关提交：b0641b83fc；相关代码：protocols/messages/serialize.ts:16-22、:33、protocols/messages/replay.ts:39-46、packages/core/session/src/index.ts:315-318
相邻现象：Discussion #2770（同属"长会话不可继续"，但成因不同）
如需会话样本（含坏记录，且两份副本中一份已修一份未修，可精确隔离缺陷）可在本贴回复索取

threads.title: 长会话被服务端以裸 413 拒绝且不可恢复；默认协议切到 messages 后集中出现
threads.bodyText:
长会话被服务端以裸 413 拒绝且不可恢复；默认协议切到 messages 后集中出现

背景：这是 Discussion #2770（"长对话卡住……触发 api 413 报错"）之后的补充证据。该讨论的采纳答案把成因归于"provider 侧上下文超限"，此结论正确但不完整——本贴补充两点新事实：① 默认协议已在 b0641b83fc 切换到 messages，触发面随之改变；② 实测证明 413 与请求体体积无关（见下文排除法）。同时指出一条可零成本确认的可观测性缺口。

Summary
b0641b83fc 把 DeepSeek 默认协议从 chat-completions 切到 messages 之后，原本可正常使用的长会话开始被服务端以 HTTP 413 拒绝，且此后每次恢复都失败、无法自救——恢复必须重放整份历史，于是每次重发都再次 413。实测窗口：升级到 0.1.6-alpha.1 后 39 分钟首次出现，升级前同一条会话一直可用。
本贴有两条可独立确认的问题线索：

可观测性缺口：服务端只返回裸 413（无 error.message），而 DSH 已把原始响应体读进内存（protocols/chat-completions/adapter.ts:348 的 rawResponse）、放进 Error.cause:364，却从不写入会话事件。结果是 UI 与日志里只剩一个状态码，用户和维护者都无法据此定位——这一条不依赖任何复现成本，读代码即可确认；
诱因待定：413 的触发条件尚无定论。下文给出了排除法实测，证明"请求体字节数超限"这一直觉解释不成立。

Reproduction
复现成本较高（需要一条长期积累的大会话），故分两部分给出。
现象部分：

在 messages 协议（当前默认）下积累长会话（本机实例：会话日志约 13 MB，含多张图片附件）；
发起下一轮 → 服务端 413；
此后每次恢复/继续都 413。注意：413 不被自动重试——它映射为 INVALID_REQUEST，不在默认重试集合内（packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts:18-24 的 DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES 只有 EMPTY_RESPONSE/RATE_LIMIT/SERVER/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT）。本机会话日志中该会话共有 5 次 413 尝试，位于 turn 76–80、每回合各 1 次、间隔 11 分钟至 22 小时，均为手动重发，期间无 llm/retry 事件；
对照：同一条会话在升级前（默认 chat-completions）一直正常工作。

可独立确认部分（无需大会话）：
在 protocols/chat-completions/adapter.ts:346-352 可以看到，报错文案仅在响应体可解析且含 error.message 时才被替换：
let message = `DeepSeek API error (HTTP ${response.status})`   // 默认：只有状态码
const rawResponse = await response.text()
try { const parsed = JSON.parse(rawResponse); if (providerError?.message) message = providerError.message } catch { }
UI 上看到默认文案，即证明服务端未提供 message；而该响应体不出现在会话日志里（本机逐类事件核查未发现承载它的记录），因此无从取证。protocols/messages/transport.ts:25 同理（缺省回退为 DeepSeek Messages request failed (${status})）。
Current behavior


报错文案不含原因：
本轮运行失败  DeepSeek Messages request failed (413)      # messages 适配器
本轮运行失败  DeepSeek API error (HTTP 413)               # chat-completions 适配器



不可恢复：恢复会话必须重放整份历史，每次尝试都重复触发同一个 413；


该会话历史中曾成功压缩过一次（compaction/start → compaction/summary，约 40 KB），但未能阻止 413。


413 出现在"恢复后的第一次请求"（本机实例，两次分别在不同协议下）：



时间
协议
事件序列（同一步内）




2026-09-15T12:42:38Z
messages
user/message(293 B) → request/header(28 KB) → assistant/attempt → 413 → turn/end


2026-09-15T13:06:24Z
chat-completions
同上 → 413 → turn/end



（另三次同型失败：turn 78/79 于 2026-09-15T13:17:49Z、13:28:59Z，turn 80 于 2026-09-16T11:30:19Z——均为手动重发。）
已排除"请求体字节数超限"（同机实测，Node v26，同一网络环境）：



端点
请求体
结果




/chat/completions
0.10 → 7.63 MB
全部 401（无效 key 的正常响应），无一 413


/anthropic/v1/messages
0.10 → 7.63 MB
全部 401，无一 413



即网关本身并不按该量级拒收 body；413 更可能来自认证之后的语义层判定。另注：protocols/chat-completions/adapter.spec.ts:1424 的既有预期为 httpErrorCode(413, { code: 'context_length_exceeded' })，倾向于同一方向。
升级时间线（本机 update-dsh.log）：
2026-09-14 22:35  升级 → c291e7961a          正常
2026-09-15 20:14  升级 → 0d1f50007f (0.1.6-alpha.1，含协议默认切换)
2026-09-15 20:59  首次 413

Expected behavior
按优先级建议：

把 provider 原始响应记入会话事件：rawResponse 已在 cause 里，仅差一步写入。当前缺口使这类问题只能靠外部复现，用户与维护者都无从定位；建议至少记录其分类结果，避免泄露敏感 body 时也可只记 status + provider 错误码/类型；
协议默认值变更时提示存量会话兼容性风险：设计笔记 .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-07-deepseek-messages-adapter.zh.md 写明"切换协议保留已有端点覆盖，部署者负责其兼容性"，但未覆盖"存量会话可能因此不可用"。建议在发布说明中提示，或提供迁移检查；
给出可操作的失败指引：当 413 在会话首步重复出现时，提示"该会话可能已超出该协议可接受的请求规模，建议新开会话"，而不是只显示状态码；
（长期）上下文压力估算偏低导致压缩不及时——社区 Discussion #2770 与跟踪帖 #2107 涉及同一现象。

Environment

DSH 0.1.6-alpha.1（0d1f50007f），Windows 11
deepseek-official / deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V41-Flash）；contextWindow = 默认 1_000_000，maxTokens = 默认 256_000
协议 messages（默认）；实测显式切 chat-completions 后同样 413，故非协议本身所致
相关代码：protocols/messages/transport.ts:25、protocols/chat-completions/adapter.ts:346-364、common/models.ts、common/request-pricing.ts
相关提交：b0641b83fc、7d3dab66a2、a7070008e7
相关讨论：Discussion #2770

threads.title: [Windows][Desktop] 双击启动的桌面端下所有 shell 工具以 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142) 失败，命令行 dsh web 宿主正常
threads.bodyText:
[Windows][Desktop] 双击启动的桌面端下所有 shell 工具以 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142) 失败，命令行 dsh web 宿主正常

English summary — On Windows, every shell tool call inside the double-click-launched desktop app fails immediately with exit code 3221225794 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED / 0xC0000142) and completely empty stdout/stderr, while the same build run as pnpm dsh web from a terminal executes shell commands normally with the ACL sandbox still enforcing its boundary. The observable difference between the two runs is the host process and how it was started: the double-clicked Electron host is started by Explorer and holds no console, whereas the terminal-started host inherits one.

环境



项
值




OS
Microsoft Windows NT 10.0.26100.0；注册表 DisplayVersion=24H2、CurrentBuild=26100.9168、EditionID=Professional、ProductName=Windows 10 Pro（24H2/26100 上该键值仍报 Windows 10，属已知表现）


架构
AMD64


DSH 版本
0.1.6-alpha.1


桌面端运行时
node 24.17.0，win32/x64（$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/desktop-runtime-state.json）


桌面端启动方式
双击启动（由 Explorer 拉起，非终端启动）


沙箱模式
workspace-write（实测于命令行宿主）


进程上下文
用户 Administrator，非提升（IsInRole(Administrator) = False）


可用 shell
仅 C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe（5.1.26100.9168，PSEdition=Desktop）；Get-Command pwsh -All 无结果，未安装 PowerShell 7



复现步骤
实验组（失败）：

双击启动桌面客户端（而非从终端启动），打开任意工作区。
让 agent 执行任意 pwsh 工具调用。最简命令 1 即可复现。
观察退出码与输出。

对照组（成功）：

关闭桌面端，在终端中运行 pnpm dsh web，在浏览器中打开 Web UI，使用同一工作区。
执行同样的 pwsh 调用。

实际结果



探测项
双击启动的桌面端宿主
终端启动的 dsh web 宿主




退出码
3221225794（0xC0000142）
0


stdout / stderr
全空
正常返回


复现率
6 / 6 次调用全部失败
连续多次成功


工作区外写入
无法探测（pwsh 无法启动）
DENIED :: UnauthorizedAccessException


工作区内写入
无法探测
ALLOWED


语言模式
无法探测
FullLanguage


whoami.exe
无法探测
Access is denied


存活 Electron 进程
未探测到（无可用执行通道）
无



关键点：命令行宿主下 ACL 沙箱仍在正常强制执行——工作区外写入被拒、工作区内写入通过、受限令牌在场（whoami.exe 被拒正是文档记录的受限令牌现象）。因此这不是"沙箱坏了"或"沙箱未生效"，而是宿主环境差异。

注：桌面端宿主下没有任何可用的执行通道，因此上表左列无法采集到与右列对称的证据。这正是该缺陷难以自诊断的原因。

预期结果
两种宿主下 shell 工具都应正常工作，且沙箱边界一致。
根因分析
代码事实（已核实）
1. 进程创建不携带任何控制台 flag
packages/subprocess/win32-process/src/process.ts:563：
abi.CREATE_SUSPENDED | abi.CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT
即没有 CREATE_NO_WINDOW、没有 CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE、也没有 DETACHED_PROCESS。对 packages/subprocess/win32-process 全目录 grep -i console 零命中。
2. 文档把"共享宿主控制台"当作对策，并记录了该错误码
packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.zh.md:117（"已验证边界"）：

控制台隔离不可用。 以 CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE 创建的子进程在 DLL 初始化期间以 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED（0xC0000142）死亡；子进程共享宿主控制台，基于管道的 stdio 重定向不受影响。

3. 同一错误码的另一条已知成因
packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.zh.md:94：保活组（登录 SID + Everyone）缺失时"早期 DLL 初始化会以 0xC0000142 死亡"。
4. shell 解析在本机落到最后一个候选
packages/shell/pwsh-local/src/resolve.ts:21-37 的解析顺序为 %ProgramFiles%\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe → PATH 中的 pwsh.exe → %SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe。本机上前两个候选均不存在（已逐路径核实：C:\Program Files\PowerShell、C:\Program Files (x86)\*PowerShell*、D:\Program Files\PowerShell、Store 别名 ...\WindowsApps\pwsh*、scoop、chocolatey 均不存在），因此实际执行的是 Windows PowerShell 5.1。
推断（环境前提已确认，宿主侧仍无法直接测得）
文档第 117 条把"子进程共享宿主控制台"作为既定对策，但该对策隐含要求宿主自身持有控制台。
本缺陷的宿主是双击启动的 Electron GUI 进程（由 Explorer 拉起），在 Windows 上不持有控制台。因此不带控制台 flag 的 CreateProcessW 会让 console 子进程转为分配一个新控制台，而这一步在 WRITE_RESTRICTED 受限令牌下失败，表现为子进程在 DLL 初始化阶段死亡——与观测到的空输出、0xC0000142、且没有 runner 侧 windows-acl-run: 诊断（该诊断会伴随退出码 127）完全一致。
两次运行可观测到的差异是宿主进程及其启动方式（双击 Electron GUI vs 终端 node CLI）。文件策略的差异不会影响这一阶段：read-only 下 pwsh 同样能够启动，只是语言模式降为 ConstrainedLanguage，不会产生进程初始化失败。
残留不确定性：桌面端宿主下没有任何可用执行通道可以探测控制台所有权，因此推断的最后一环（"新控制台分配失败"）未能直接测得。请维护者协助确认 ProcessCreation 路径在宿主无控制台时的预期行为，并考虑文档第 117 条是否需要补充"宿主必须持有控制台"这一前提。
已排除的假设



假设
排除依据




沙箱实现缺陷 / 保活组（登录 SID + Everyone）缺失
同机、同版本、同沙箱配置下，命令行宿主中沙箱边界工作完全正常（外写被拒 / 内写通过）


未安装 PowerShell 7 是根因
5.1 在有控制台的宿主下工作完全正常，PSVersion=5.1.26100.9168


runner 自身失败（fail-closed 路径）
未出现文档约定的 windows-acl-run: <detail> stderr 文本，退出码也不是 127


提权导致的令牌异常
进程为非提升状态


工作区 ACL 所有者问题
工作区位于 D:\Program Files\... 下曾被列为次要嫌疑，但命令行宿主下同一工作区写入正常，故排除



影响
双击启动的 Windows 桌面端下所有 shell 工具不可用（bash 走同一条沙箱路径）。这是阻断性缺陷：桌面端用户可以对话，但无法执行任何命令，因此桌面端在 Windows 上实际不可用。
建议的验证与修复方向

从带控制台的终端启动同一份桌面端产物——这是判定性实验（我们未能执行，因为它需要交互式 GUI 操作）。双击启动（无控制台）失败、终端启动（继承控制台）若成功，则宿主控制台即为唯一变量：
& "<桌面端安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe"

请确认宿主无控制台时的预期行为，并在 packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/README.zh.md 第 117 条的对策中补充"宿主必须持有控制台"这一前提；若桌面端确实无法保证，则该后端在桌面端宿主下需要一条显式的降级或探测路径（而非静默产生无法诊断的空输出失败）。
可诊断性：当前失败在 UI 层表现为完全空白（无退出码语义提示、无 stderr），建议把"子进程在命令执行前以 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED 死亡"识别为沙箱基础设施故障并上报，与普通命令失败区分开。
桌面端打包产物中已携带 node-pty 与 ConPTY 的 OpenConsole.exe（resources/app.asar.unpacked/dsh/node_modules/node-pty/...），是否可作为伪控制台来源值得评估——仅为方向，未验证。

附：诊断命令
在 DSH 之外的普通 PowerShell 窗口中执行，用于补充环境信息：
# 1. 可用 shell 与版本（确认是否只有 5.1）
Get-Command pwsh, powershell -All | Format-List Name, Source, Version

# 2. 保活组是否在令牌中（排查 0xC0000142 的另一条成因）
whoami /groups | Select-String -Pattern 'Everyone|S-1-1-0|S-1-5-5-'

# 3. 工作区 ACL 与所有者
icacls "D:\Program Files\DeepSeek\temp_workspace"
(Get-Acl "D:\Program Files\DeepSeek\temp_workspace").Owner

# 4. 崩溃记录（若存在，会给出出错模块名，对定位控制台/conhost 相关失败尤其有价值）
Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-3)} |
  Where-Object { $_.Message -match '0xc0000142|pwsh|powershell|conhost' } |
  Select-Object -First 20 TimeCreated, ProviderName, Message | Format-List

# 5. 系统信息
[Environment]::OSVersion.VersionString

取证说明：本报告的环境数据（含双击启动方式）、沙箱边界探测与命令行为均为实测；代码与文档引用来自仓库 0.1.6-alpha.1 的本地检出。根因部分中"宿主无控制台导致新控制台分配失败"为机制推断，其环境前提（双击启动、宿主为 Electron GUI）已确认，但最后一环未能在宿主侧直接测得，已在文中明确标注，未作为既定结论陈述。

threads.title: 会话无法加载："message must have tool source" —— 空 tool callId 能通过 append 写入，却在读取时被拒绝
threads.bodyText:
版本
0.1.5-alpha-2
症状
一个此前正常工作的会话无法加载（gateway/internal 报错）：
stored session "session-1ba6018d-9f77-4b92-a3ab-71f0dff63061" is corrupt:
stored session "session-1ba6018d-..." failed validation: Error: session event at seq 3071
message must have tool source

根因
我解码了存储日志（2134 个拼接的 zstd 帧、3740 个事件）。seq 3070/3071 是这样的：
{ "type": "tool/call",   "seq": 3070, "data": { "callId": "", "name": "", "arguments": "{}" } }
{ "type": "tool/result", "seq": 3071, "data": { "message": { "source": { "kind": "tool", "callId": "" } },
    "error": { "name": "ToolNotFoundError", "code": "UNKNOWN_TOOL" } } }
三层问题叠加，造就了一份 harness 自己都读不回来的日志：


Provider 翻译层容忍无 id 的 tool_call delta。 packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts 的 closeBlock() 在流式 tool_calls delta 从未携带 id/name 时回退为 block.callId ?? '' / block.name ?? ''（某些 OpenAI 兼容网关确实会这样返回）。甚至有一个测试用例把这个宽松行为固定了下来：translate.spec.ts —— "handles deltas that never carry id or name (empty-string fallbacks)"。


agent-loop 原样落盘。 packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts 的 appendToolCall / appendToolResult 把空 id 直接写进 tool/call，随后又写进 tool/result（执行失败的 unknown tool "" 成了结果本身）。


写入端验证弱于读取端验证。 Session.append()（packages/core/session/src/index.ts）只执行 validateSessionEventData + surfaceManager.validateNext。严格的消息不变量（assertMessageEventShape，它要求 tool/result 的 source.callId 非空）是在 b1af35145b（"fix: enforce message snapshot invariants"）中加到读取/seed/快照路径上的，却从未加到 append 路径。于是循环可以持久化一个 validateStoredEvents -> adoptSessionEvent 之后会拒绝的事件——一次畸形的模型 delta 就这样把整个会话变成不可加载：整份日志被拒绝，seq 3071 之后的一切都无法再访问。


这与 append 自己的 JSDoc 相矛盾："a bad event fails at the append site rather than later during a backend flush."
影响
任何一个首个 tool_calls delta 缺少 id 的 provider 响应都会悄然污染会话文件。该回合仍会正常完成（模型会收到 unknown-tool 错误），但这个会话从此再也无法加载。
修复方向建议

在 Session.append() 中强制执行 assertMessageEventShape，让坏事件在 append 处就失败。
在源头拒绝或修复无 id 的 tool call（合成一个 id，或让流失败），而不是回退为 ''。

遇到此问题的临时绕过方法：重写存储日志，把两个事件中的空 callId 替换掉，并删除 session_projcache 投影缓存让其重建。

threads.title: [Bug] 正文里的 @ 会弹出候选菜单，且没有转义或关闭方式
threads.bodyText:
摘要
在 Web GUI 输入框里，只要 @ 的前一个字符是空白（或 @ 位于草稿开头），
@ 就会被当作引用补全触发器，弹出「文件与文件夹 / 对话」候选菜单。
用户只是在写普通正文（例如"成本 @ 上周对比"）时也会触发，
而且既没有转义语法，也没有配置开关，只能等它自己收起来或按 Esc。
参考注释显示，@ token 语法本意是"不把邮箱地址里的 @ 当触发器"
（packages/context/file-reference/src/grammar.ts：

An @ inside another token, such as an email address, is not a completion trigger.

但"空白之后的 @"不在这个豁免范围内，于是正文里的 @ 全部命中。
环境

dsh：0.1.5-rc.1（npm 全局安装，...\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh）
界面：dsh web（Web GUI）
profile：web（bundles = dsh-base + dsh-web-app），未改动 cordis.patch.yml
OS：Windows 10.0.26200
Node：v24.14.0
preset：标准模式（standard）

复现步骤

打开 Web GUI 的任意会话输入框
输入 今天的成本 @ 上周对比（即 @ 前面有空格），或直接在空输入框里敲一个 @
观察候选菜单弹出

实际行为

菜单弹出，显示「文件与文件夹」和「对话」两组候选
继续输入普通文字时，菜单一直留在输入浮层上，直到：

键入一个空格（token 结束），或
按 Esc，或
点击菜单和 composer 卡片之外的区域


无法在正文中"写下一个字面量 @ 而不触发菜单"

期望行为
希望至少满足其中一项：

正文场景不触发：例如仅在行首/列表位置等更严格的位置触发，或需要显式手势才触发
支持字面量转义：例如 @@ 或 \@ 表示真正的 @，不打开菜单
可配置：能关闭 @ 引用源，或把它限制为只在草稿以 @ 开头时才启用

想请大家确认
这是设计如此、还是可以调整？如果其他人也遇到同样情况，欢迎在此回复——
确认是普遍问题后我再把它作为正式的功能请求提出。
（若维护者认为这属于预期行为，请告知推荐的正文 @ 输入方式。）
根因定位（master 源码）


packages/client/ui-input-trigger/src/core/detect.ts → detectTrigger()
@ 的分支对 position 不做任何区分，leading 和 inline 都会返回命中：
const at = activeAtToken(draft, caret)
if (at !== undefined) {
  const start = caret - at.prefix.length
  return {
    trigger: '@',
    query: at.query,
    quoted: at.quoted,
    position: draft.search(/\S/) === start ? 'leading' : 'inline',
    span: { start, end: caret, draftRev: 0 },
  }
}


packages/context/file-reference/src/grammar.ts → activeAtToken()
只豁免"紧跟非空白字符的相对位置"，不豁免"空格之后的 @"：
const plain = /(?:^|\s)(@([^\s]*))$/u.exec(beforeCursor)
if (plain?.[1] === undefined || plain[2] === undefined) return undefined
return { prefix: plain[1], query: plain[2], quoted: false }
即：触发条件是 @ 位于草稿开头或空白之后；token 内容为 @ 之后的连续非空白字符，
碰到空白即结束（这一点解释了"打空格菜单就消失"）。


packages/client/ui-input-trigger/src/core/menu.ts
菜单打开后只要还有分组处于 pending 就不关闭，只有"所有分组都 ready 且都为空"
才自动收起（allReadyEmpty）。而 @ 已注册了文件与对话两个全局源，
在工作区根目录下几乎总会有文件候选，因此菜单会稳定停留。


packages/client/ui-input-trigger/README.zh.md 的「已知限制」
没有提到"正文中的 @"这一场景。


影响
日常写中文/英文正文时，只要用到 @（提到某人、写"@某人"、写成本或版本对比等），
输入浮层就会被候选菜单遮挡，需要额外的 Esc 或空格操作，属于持续性的输入打断。

threads.title: [Bug] Live sessions have no retention policy: heap grows with opened-session count and OOMs at any heap cap (128 GB host, measured per-session costs)
threads.bodyText:
英文版（建议作为正文）
Environment



Item
Value




dsh
0.1.5-rc.1 (global npm install)


Node
v22.23.1


OS
Linux x64, 128 GB RAM (≈64 GB actually free at the time)


Launch
dsh web (web profile; 4 local profile plugins)


Heap cap
V8 default → 4144 MB; later runs with explicit --max-old-space-size



Summary
dsh web grows its heap in proportion to the number of sessions the process has opened, not merely to one large log, and nothing ever evicts those live sessions. Three separate runs died the same way at three different heap caps, and raising the cap only moved the wall:



run
heap cap
survived
crash signature




1
4144 MB (default)
19 h
Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit


2
4144 MB (default)
16 h
same


3
8240 MB (--max-old-space-size=8192)
44 h
Reached heap limit



In every crash the last mark-compacts reclaimed almost nothing (e.g. 4030.2 → 4014.1 MB, i.e. 0.4 %), so the heap was live retained data, not uncollected garbage.
Measured: resident cost is per open session
Fresh boot with 8 sessions open (each holding an OS file lock on its session.lock), measured at the HTTP API (heapUsed ≈ 2875 MB):



session

decompressed log
resident heap
resident RSS

Σ

1807.8 MB

The RSS sum (3376.6 MB) matches the process measurement (3354 MB) almost exactly; the heapUsed sum (1807.8 MB) accounts for ~63 % of the process's 2875 MB. Method: each transcript was streamed through the same path the host uses when it opens a session (line-wise JSON.parse → lossless clone → deepFreeze), one file per isolated process.
Measured: opening a session is one-way
I opened one not-yet-live session through the real wire protocol (/api/remote.mux, session/follow with maxMessages: 1), then closed the WebSocket. Evidence is the process's held session locks, which is not affected by background noise:



moment
sessions held by the process
heap




before
8
3044 MB


6 s after open
9
3015 MB


3 s after socket close
9
3015 MB


20 s after socket close
9
3029 MB



The count never returns. Repeating page loads/streams accumulates.
Measured: growth does not require activity
A /proc-based sampler watched one process for its whole life (3,861 samples): anonymous memory went 1.05 GB → 4.64 GB in 16.2 h, monotonic. During that window there were zero session-log writes and zero queue/storage writes — only a handful of attachment files. So the slope is not "work done"; there is an additional time/aggregate-proportional term.
Upstream source locations (checked against master, 0.1.6-alpha.1, pushed 2026-09-15 — all still present)
Verified by fetching the files and grepping the current master tree:


No live-session retention policy.
packages/api/session-controller/src/client/sessions/manager.ts

:96 private readonly sessions = new Map<SessionId, Session>()
:292 this.sessions.set(sessionId, session) (lazy build, never evicted)
:245 async drop(sessionId) exists; :247 this.sessions.delete(sessionId)
grep -nE "idleTimeout|maxSessions|evict|retention" over the package: no hits



A read handle pins the whole decoded log.
packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts

primed — 2 occurrences on master
COLD_LOG_MEMO — 2 occurrences (the decoded-log memo, count-bounded by entries, not bytes)
decodeStoredLog 3, freezeStoredEvents 3, memoizeStoredLog 4



The observation cache can exceed its own cap.
packages/session-query/session-query/src/index.ts:122-131

const preparedSessionCacheSize = config.preparedSessionCacheSize (default 5)
entries pinned by an active lease (refs > 0) are skipped by eviction, so a cache bounded by count is not a bound in bytes.



The raw log is append-only and compaction does not trim it. Session.log keeps every streaming chunk; surface replace removes shadowed entries from model input only.



Items 1–4 are source reading + sampling. I do not have a heap snapshot from the crashing process (it aborted with SIGABRT and no .heapsnapshot was written), so “which single holder dominates” is an analysis, not a measurement. Independent reports (#3275, #5995, #5696, #6511, #4722) reach the same conclusion with heap snapshots of their own.

Why "more RAM" is not the fix
The crash is not physical-memory exhaustion: a 64 GB host still died at ~4.1 GB (#5995), and one reporter measured that with --max-old-space-size=16384 the heap still climbs past 4 GB with no plateau (#3275). The resident term is opened sessions × per-session cost, so any fixed cap is eventually crossed.
Reproduction (minimal)
# 1. a session store with many/large sessions
ls -la "$DSH_HOME/sessions"/*/ | head

# 2. start with a known cap and no client
NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 dsh web --no-open

# 3. sample heap every 60 s (no client needed) — RSS/heap climbs monotonically
while :; do grep VmRSS /proc/$(pgrep -f 'dsh/lib/bin.js web')/status; sleep 60; done

# 4. connect one client and open a *stored* session; then close the socket.
#    The server keeps the session resident: watch the held session locks
ls -l /proc/$(pgrep -f 'dsh/lib/bin.js web')/fd | grep -c session.lock
What I ruled out on my host

Browser side: the server paginates the opening frame (DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES = 50), and the leak reproduces with no client at all (--no-open), so the renderer is not the cause of the host heap.
Legacy session format: bcahlit in #3275 showed hiding all v2 files and keeping only v3 still OOMs.
Projection cache: same reporter — moving session_projcache aside makes it OOM faster.
Third-party plugins: disabling a 21-row community bundle cut the slope ~4× (75 → 17 MB/s) but did not stop it.
Invalid agent preset (#6415's trigger): checked — my own preset has the required persona.prefix, so that path is not active here.
Not corruption: no SessionPersistenceCorruptionError / SessionFormatUnsupportedError in ~10 boots; only heap exhaustion. All sessions load.

Suggested fixes (ordered by leverage)

Give live Sessions/Agents a retention policy: idle timeout and/or a byte-aware cap with real eviction (manager.get() ↔ drop()), plus a public eviction entry point — today the only drop() caller is scope teardown.
Don't retain the decoded log in the handle state (primed) for read handles; stream the fold instead of materialising every event.
Make both memos byte-bounded (they are count-bounded today: 2 entries and 5 entries) and let leases expire.
Bound the resident reconstruction window separately from durable history (see the community handbook's four-budget model).

Related

#3275 — Web server OOMs within ~60s of a client connecting when a workspace contains a large session
#5696 — V8 heap OOM after ~8h: opened Conversations fully hydrated and never evicted
#5995 — 内存随会话事件数持续增长，约 8 小时后堆触顶（含 26.1 MB/会话 的官方基准引用）
#6511 — every session open / reconnect re-decodes the log and retains the decoded copy
#4722 — in-memory session log is unbounded (append-only), compaction never trims it
#5347 — 超长会话因流式增量碎片未清理导致 OOM


中文版（可放在英文之后，或作为主帖）
环境
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.1（全局 npm 安装）· Node v22.23.1 · Linux x64 · 物理内存 128 GB（实际可用约 64 GB）· web profile（含 4 个本地 profile 插件）· 启动方式 dsh web。
结论
dsh web 的堆占用与**「该进程打开过的会话数量」成正比（不只是单个大日志），而且没有任何驱逐机制**。三次运行在三个不同的堆上限上以同一方式崩溃，抬高上限只是把墙往后挪：



运行
堆上限
存活
崩溃签名




1
4144 MB（默认）
19 小时
Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit


2
4144 MB（默认）
16 小时
同上


3
8240 MB（--max-old-space-size=8192）
44 小时
Reached heap limit



每次崩溃前最后一次 mark-compact 几乎回收不到东西（例如 4030.2 → 4014.1 MB，即 0.4%），说明堆里是活着的保留数据，不是没回收的垃圾。
实测一：常驻成本按「每个已打开会话」计
全新启动、8 个会话处于打开状态（各自持有 session.lock 的 OS 文件锁），经 HTTP API 读到 heapUsed ≈ 2875 MB：



会话

解压日志

RSS 合计（3376.6 MB）与进程实测（3354 MB）几乎完全吻合；heap 合计占进程 2875 MB 的约 63%。测法：把每份日志分别喂给一个独立进程，走 host 打开会话时的同一条路径（逐行 JSON.parse → 无损克隆 → deepFreeze）。
实测二：打开会话是单向的
我用真实线协议（/api/remote.mux + session/follow，maxMessages: 1）打开一个当时尚未 live 的会话，然后关闭 WebSocket。判据用进程持有的会话锁数——它不受后台噪声影响：



时刻
进程持有会话数
heap




打开前
8
3044 MB


打开后 6 秒
9
3015 MB


关闭 socket 后 3 秒
9
3015 MB


关闭 socket 后 20 秒
9
3029 MB



计数不回落。 反复刷新页面/重连会持续累加。
实测三：增长不需要活动
用一个只读采样器盯住某次进程的完整生命周期（3,861 个样本）：匿名内存 16.2 小时内从 1.05 GB 单调涨到 4.64 GB。该时间窗内会话日志零写入、队列与 storages 零写入（只有几个附件文件）。所以斜率不是「做了多少活」，另有一项与时间/累计量成正比的增长。
上游源码位置（已对照 master / 0.1.6-alpha.1，最后推送 2026-09-15，四处都还在）

live 会话没有保留策略：packages/api/session-controller/src/client/sessions/manager.ts

:96 private readonly sessions = new Map<SessionId, Session>()
:292 this.sessions.set(sessionId, session)（懒建，永不淘汰）
:245 async drop(sessionId) 存在、:247 this.sessions.delete(sessionId)
对 idleTimeout|maxSessions|evict|retention 全包 grep：零命中


读句柄钉住整份解码日志：packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts —— primed 2 处、COLD_LOG_MEMO 2 处、decodeStoredLog 3 处、freezeStoredEvents 3 处
观察缓存可超出自身上限：packages/session-query/session-query/src/index.ts:122-131，preparedSessionCacheSize 默认 5，且 refs > 0（被租约钉住）的条目在淘汰时被跳过 —— 一个「按条数」的上限在字节维度上不构成上限
原始日志 append-only 且 compaction 不裁剪：Session.log 保留全部流式碎片；surface replace 只影响模型输入，不删原始事件


上述 1–4 是源码阅读 + 采样归因。我没有拿到崩溃进程的 heap snapshot（它以 SIGABRT 退出、未落盘 .heapsnapshot），所以「单一主导持有者」属分析判断而非定论。#3275 / #5995 / #5696 / #6511 / #4722 等报告各自带堆快照，得出相同结论。

为什么「加内存」不是解法
这不是物理内存耗尽：一台 64 GB 的机器同样死在 ~4.1 GB（#5995）；另有人实测 --max-old-space-size=16384 时堆仍越过 4 GB 且无平台期（#3275）。常驻项是 已打开会话数 × 单会话成本，因此任何固定上限终将被越过。
已排除项（避免后来者重复踩）

不是浏览器侧：开局帧被分页（DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES = 50），且完全没有客户端（--no-open）时同样复现。
不是旧格式：隐藏全部 v2、只留 v3 仍 OOM（#3275 评论）。
不是投影缓存：把 session_projcache 移开反而更快 OOM（同上）。
不是第三方插件：关掉 21 行社区 bundle 使斜率降约 4×（75 → 17 MB/s），但没有停止。
不是非法 preset（#6415 的触发点）：已自查，本机 preset 的 persona.prefix 存在，该路径未激活。
不是数据损坏：约 10 次启动中没有任何 SessionPersistenceCorruptionError / SessionFormatUnsupportedError，只有堆耗尽；全部会话可加载。

建议修法（按杠杆排序）

给 live Session/Agent 加保留策略：空闲超时和/或字节感知的上限 + 真正的驱逐（manager.get() ↔ drop()），并补一个公开驱逐入口——今天 drop() 的唯一调用者是 scope teardown。
读句柄不再保留解码日志（primed）；把 fold 改成流式，而不是物化每个事件。
两个 memo 改成按字节封顶（现在是按条数：2 条与 5 条），并让租约到期。
把「常驻重建窗口」与「持久历史」分开设界（参见社区手册的四预算模型）。

相关讨论
#3275 · #5696 · #5995 · #6511 · #4722 · #5347

threads.title: Goal模式空转，亟需优化
threads.bodyText:
deepseek-v4.1-flash 非常喜欢调用子代理和后台任务，导致没有并行主任务时，主Agent空转goal轮次，从而快速消耗goal模式轮次与用户Tokens。
这个问题非常严重，1小时能空转数十轮次，几小时就会达到goal轮次上限256。这个还是小事，重要的是用户的费用因为goal状态判断等消耗过快。

threads.title: Markdown 渲染器误把单波浪号 ~内容~ 解析为删除线（singleTilde 默认开启）
threads.bodyText:
问题
会话消息中的 Markdown 渲染器把 ~内容~（单波浪号对）解析为 <del>。两个相邻片段如 ~100~ ~200~ 会稳定渲染成删除线。GitHub.com 的 GFM 只认 ~~内容~~，同样的文本在 GitHub 上显示正常。
复现环境：DSH Desktop 2.0.9 与 dsh web 0.1.5-rc.1 均可复现。
复现步骤

在会话中发送 区间 ~100~ 到 ~200~ 之间
观察渲染结果：文本被加上删除线

根因
packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/parse.ts 的两条 mdast 管线以 gfm() 无参构造 micromark GFM 扩展，继承了库默认值 singleTilde: true：
extensions: [gfm(), cjkFriendlyStrong()],
建议修复
两条管线都传入 gfm({ singleTilde: false })。我们已在 fork 中实现并验证：

分支：https://github.com/GUODnuli/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/markdown-single-tilde
改动：parse.ts 两处 gfm() → gfm({ singleTilde: false })，含回归测试（33/33 通过）与 Agent Note（双语）

上游仓库关闭了 Issue/PR 通道，因此通过 Discussion 提交，供团队参考采纳。

threads.title: Deepseek Harness compaction missing thinking tokens
threads.bodyText: The fundamental issue I am having right now is when using Qwen3.8 27b, which is a model that tends to think a LOT, and in fact most of its useful output is done in thinking, Deepseek Harness only compacts the actual "output" tokens, which leads to it missing a lot of context, and ends up having it redo things it has already done in thinking. A good example is file generation, the model will build files through thinking and then add them to the directory but not necessarily comment on them in the output tokens. This leads to the compaction acting as if they never existed in the first place. If there is a general fix to this I would be happy to hear suggestions.

threads.title: [Windows] 托管子进程以 windowsHide: true 启动时失败 (0xC0000142) 并弹出模态错误对话框
ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION poisons the process until restart — forcing HTTP/1.1 (undici allowH2:false) restores recoverability (measured)
threads.bodyText:
TL;DR
After a single TLS-layer failure, every subsequent model request failed in 1–2 ms with
ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION ("The session has been destroyed") and never recovered — only restarting
dsh fixed it. Forcing the process to HTTP/1.1 (undici global dispatcher with allowH2: false)
restores recoverability: the underlying connection errors still happen, but each one is now an
ordinary retryable request failure that recovers within the same turn — no restart, and zero
ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION since.
Measured before/after (same machine, same route, same provider):




before
after (~1.1 h observation)




ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION
24 (continuous, 4 min)
0


failure shape
1–2 ms, no DNS/TCP egress (reusing a dead h2 session)
~0.9–1.2 s — connection is really established, then closed by the peer (UND_ERR_SOCKET: other side closed)


recoverable?
❌ no — retries hit the same poisoned session; restart required
✅ yes — retry #1/#2 recovers inside the same turn


turns
session paralyzed
4/4 completed, no restart



Symptom and evidence
Captured at the fetch layer (error.cause chains), DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.2, Node v26.8.2:
15:25:06  POST https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/chat/completions
          TypeError: fetch failed
            └─ ... SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:ssl/tls alert bad record mac
          code = ERR_SSL_SSL/TLS_ALERT_BAD_RECORD_MAC        <- trigger

15:25:07 → 15:29:30   (24 consecutive requests)
          TypeError: fetch failed
            └─ The session has been destroyed
          code = ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION   elapsed = 1–2 ms

While poisoned, the local tunnel logged no DNS query and no TCP connection for those requests —
i.e. the failures were entirely local, consistent with re-use of a destroyed HTTP/2 session rather
than a reconnect. Retries could not help, and raising retryPolicy.maxRetries only changed how long
each turn waited before dying.
Mechanism
undici enables HTTP/2 by default — allowH2 = allowH2 != null ? allowH2 : true
(undici/lib/core/connect.js), ALPN ['http/1.1','h2']. Against an h2-capable edge an HTTP/2 session
is negotiated; once that session is destroyed (here by a TLS record failure on the wire), the client
keeps re-using it instead of reconnecting, so every later request fails locally.
Note the installed undici is 8.10.2, which already contains nodejs/undici#5310 ("reset invalid
HTTP/2 sessions") and #5453 ("requeue request on GOAWAY'd session") — lib/dispatcher/client-h2.js
has the ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION → resetHttp2Session() + requeueUnsentRequest() path — yet the
session stayed poisoned for 4 minutes here. A standalone reproduction was not achieved: three
self-contained attempts (graceful h2 session destroy, socket destroy between requests, socket destroy
mid-stream) all reconnected correctly on the next request in undici 8.10.2. The production failure
needs the TLS-layer failure to occur on a live h2 connection.
Mitigation (verified)
Install a global dispatcher that never negotiates h2:
const { Agent, setGlobalDispatcher } = await import('undici')
setGlobalDispatcher(new Agent({ allowH2: false }))
Verification that it takes effect (the same process also uses Node's built-in fetch, whose
dispatcher is shared through the undici global symbol):



dispatcher
measured ALPN




default Agent
HTTP 200  ALPN=["h2"]


new Agent({ allowH2: false })
HTTP 200  ALPN=["http/1.1"]



HTTP/1.1 has no session-level state: a broken connection is an ordinary socket error and the next
request opens a fresh connection. We run this as a small local plugin that installs the dispatcher
after dsh-http-proxy does, with a guard that skips overriding when a proxy dispatcher is already
installed (so HTTPS_PROXY setups are not broken), and logs the before/after dispatcher on every
boot for verification.
What this does not claim

The underlying connection closures are not fixed. After the mitigation the same endpoint still
saw 18 UND_ERR_SOCKET: other side closed events in ~1.1 h (17 of them at ~1 s elapsed: connect +
TLS, then closed by the peer; one at 17.9 s). Who closes them — the gateway, an intermediary, or the
local tunnel — is not determined; no speculation here.
The observation window is short (~1.1 h of real use at the time of writing; continuing).
The claim is narrow and falsifiable: if a poisoned h2 session returns, ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION
will reappear here. So far it has not.
The original criterion for "fixed" was recoverability, not error-freeness: transient path errors
are expected on this route; what must never happen again is a session that can only be recovered by
restarting the process.

Suggestion for the harness
In @deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy's direct (no-proxy) path, install the agent as
new undici.Agent({ allowH2: false }), or reset the dispatcher/connection when a TRANSPORT failure
carries ERR_HTTP2_INVALID_SESSION. That converts a "process is dead until restart" failure into a
single retryable request error — which is what we measured after applying it locally.
Related

nodejs/undici#5310 (merged) and #5453 — HTTP/2 resilience fixes already present in 8.10.2.
github/copilot-cli#3304 — same symptom in another long-running CLI, still open.
openclaw/clawhub#245 (merged) — same class, fixed by removing allowH2.
earendil-works/pi#4682 — the same error surfacing in another transport; auto-closed.

threads.title: [移动端] 会话划到底时输入框上浮约 168px：能否让 composer 对"末尾外部流内元素"免疫？
threads.bodyText:
在 Android WebView 宿主上遇到一个 composer 贴底失效的问题：定位到根因后想请维护者确认，这层防护值不值得做在上游。下面是现象、代码级定位与真机采样数据。 English TL;DR — On an Android WebView host, a foreign in-flow spacer injected after [data-composer-seat] inside [data-conversation-scroll] makes the sticky-bottom composer float by exactly the spacer height when the conversation is scrolled to the end. position: sticky; bottom: 0 only ever shifts an element up; it can never push it down, so once the spacer becomes the content tail, the composer parks above the container bottom. 环境 项 值 DSH 0.1.5-rc.1（web profile） @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation 0.1.5-rc.1 宿主 Android 17 WebView（DSH Mobile，com.dshmobile.app） 视口 横屏，CSS 约 1090×728（屏幕 2506×1673，DPR ≈ 2.3） 桌面浏览器端我没能复现（那边没有这个垫片），触发条件看起来与 WebView 宿主注入的 DOM 有关。 复现步骤 打开任意一个已有若干轮历史的会话； 把消息列表划到最底部； 输入区（输入卡片 + 底部 N 轮 … tok/s 统计行）整体上浮，下方出现一片空白；往回滚一点又贴回底部。 实际：划到底时 composer 停在内容末端上方，浮起量 = 其后方流内内容的总高度（本机为 168px）。 期望：composer 始终贴在滚动容器底边，不因外部插入的元素而漂移。 定位与根因 输入区是滚动容器的最后一个子元素，用 sticky; bottom: 0 贴底 （packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/ConversationRoot.module.css）： .wSkVaW_root[data-phase=active] .wSkVaW_viewArea{flex:1 0 auto;min-height:auto} .wSkVaW_root[data-phase=active] .wSkVaW_composerSeat{z-index:7;position:sticky;bottom:0} ConversationRoot 往滚动容器里只渲染两个子节点：
{sessionId !== undefined ? renderSlot("conversation.session", {}) : null}
{composer}
但真机上的滚动容器有三个子节点，第三个是无 class 的 DIV，高 168px （= --dsh-composer-height 152 + 16），且是参与布局的流内元素： conversation.session ~ wSkVaW_composerSeat(h152) ~ DIV(h168) 它不在 DSH 的任何包中产生（我搜过 data-composer-seat / data-conversation-scroll / 所有 createPortal / 所有 index 注入点，都不符合），因此判断来自 WebView 宿主的注入 （大概率为键盘预留空间）。 position: sticky; bottom: 0 的约束是单向的： 自然位置在容器底边之下 → 被向上拉，贴在底边（正常滚动时的表现） 自然位置已在底边之上 → 不做任何事（sticky 永远不会往下推） 于是设 trailing = seat 之后流内内容总高度： scrollTop ≤ max - trailing → 贴底 max - trailing < scrollTop ≤ max → 上浮量 = scrollTop - (max - trailing)，划到底为 trailing 采样数据与该线性关系完全一致（修正量 17 → 34 → 53 → … → 168 递增）。 现场数据（真机采样，多次一致） 滚动容器 clientHeight = 628，底边 y = 728（= 视口底边，容器高度正常） scrollHeight - clientHeight = 5627（max scrollTop） 划到底：scrollTop ≈ 5628 seat 自然位置底边 y = 560 容器底边 y = 728 差值 = 168 ← 正好是那个垫片的高度 影响面 所有"输入区 sticky 贴底 + 滚动容器尾部被外部插入流内元素"的宿主都会触发，与 DSH 版本无关： 我对比过 0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2 / 0.1.6-alpha.1，composer 相关 CSS 内容逐字节相同， 0.1.6-alpha.1 的 JS diff 也未见定位相关改动 —— 也就是说升级 DSH 不会解决。 视觉后果：划到底时输入区脱离底边、下方留白；因为 seat 与统计行属于同一元素，两者会一起上浮。 建议（上游可选的两条改法） 让"贴底"不依赖"必须是最后一个流内盒子"：给 seat 加 margin-bottom: calc(-1 * var(--dsh-composer-trailing, 0px))， 由脚本测量 seat 之后的流内兄弟高度写入该变量（0 时无副作用）。这属于纯布局修正，滚动不经过 JS。 或把 seat 移出滚动容器：滚动容器只放消息，seat 作为兄弟节点常驻底部（此时"末尾多出元素"再也影响不到它）。 顺带一个请求：如果 DSH 有官方推荐的"宿主向页面注入元素"的约定/钩子，欢迎在文档里写明， 这样移动端宿主就不必往滚动容器里塞垫片了 —— DSH 的 composer 本身是流内 sticky，已经为消息列表预留了高度， 再叠一个 composer 高度 + 16 的垫片是重复预留。 附：无 DevTools 时的自查代码 const seat = document.querySelector('[data-composer-seat]'); const sc = seat.closest('[data-conversation-scroll]'); console.log([...sc.children].map(k => `${k.className || k.tagName}:${Math.round(k.getBoundingClientRect().height)}`)); sc.scrollTop = sc.scrollHeight; // 划到底 console.log('seat 高于容器底边', Math.round(sc.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - seat.getBoundingClientRect().bottom), 'px'); 附：我方的临时规避（仅作参考，不代表上游方案） 按上面建议 1 做了一个独立插件：测量 seat 之后的流内兄弟高度，写入 CSS 变量并负 margin 抵消； 不删、不改宿主注入的垫片，其键盘预留高度原样保留；垫片不存在时自动休眠。真机验证：划到底贴合、快速甩动不抖。

threads.title: [Bug] 过期的 dsh.workspace.view.v5 会让整个侧边栏浏览器留白（会话历史"消失"）
threads.bodyText:
[Bug] 过期的 dsh.workspace.view.v5 会让整个侧边栏浏览器留白（会话历史"消失"）
Environment

dsh 0.1.5-rc.1（dsh web，Windows 11，Chrome/Edge）
浏览器 localStorage 中存在旧版本写入的 dsh.workspace.view.v5
复现无需任何服务端改动；Host 数据完好（session/list 正常返回，workspace/follow 正常下发 baseline）

Summary
浏览器里若存着结构过期的 dsh.workspace.view.v5（缺少 groupExpansion / sessionOrderByAccount 等字段），sidebar.workspaces 的组件会在渲染时抛 TypeError，被插槽的错误边界吞掉，结果是整块侧边栏浏览器直接消失——只剩「新会话」按钮和「设置」，连「工作区」标题、搜索框都没有。用户会误以为对话历史丢失。
Reproduction


打开 dsh web 的 GUI，按 F12 打开 Console。


写入一个旧结构的状态：
localStorage.setItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5', JSON.stringify({ groupBy: 'workspace', orderBy: 'updated' }))


刷新页面。


Current behavior
侧边栏只剩 新会话 | 设置，sidebar.workspaces 区域整块留白。Console：
TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
    at Object.entries (<anonymous>)
    at SessionTree (.../dsh-client-ui-workspace/client.js...)
error: slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces': TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object

之后再刷新也无法恢复，必须显式清理该 localStorage 键。清理后立即恢复正常：
localStorage.removeItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5')
// 刷新后侧边栏恢复：新会话 | 工作区 | <工作区…> | 设置，Console 无报错
Expected behavior
持久化状态过期或字段缺失时，侧边栏应以默认值正常渲染（工作区分组、全部折叠），而不是整块消失；至少应给出可见的错误提示而不是留白。
Root cause


packages/client/store/src/index.ts:154（attachPersistence）恢复时是整体替换，不补默认值、不校验、无 schema 版本：
api.setState(devFreeze(JSON.parse(raw) as T), true)


packages/client/ui-workspace 假定这些字段一定存在：

src/client/rows/WorkspaceBrowser.tsx:239 Object.entries(groupExpansion)
src/client/stores.ts:83,86（retainAccountKeys）Object.entries(d.groupExpansion) / Object.entries(d.sessionOrderByAccount)



packages/client/ui-renderer/src/client/scoped-slots.tsx:334-338（SlotErrorBoundary）捕获后渲染空 div（data-slot-error="sidebar.workspaces"），所以表现为"整块消失"。


触发条件的现实性：同一个 dsh.workspace.view.v5 键下状态结构变过——retainAccountKeys 至今仍在删除一个历史字段 sessionUpdatedAtByAccount（stores.ts:89），说明该键在不同版本间承载过不同字段集；旧版本写入的状态被新版本读到就会缺字段。
Impact
升级后部分用户的侧边栏浏览器会永久不可用，直到手动清 localStorage；由于会话列表一起消失，很容易被判定为"对话历史丢失"。
Suggested fix

给 client store 的持久化恢复加 schema/version 与迁移，或至少与 init() 浅合并（{ ...init, ...parsed }）并校验 JSON；
状态结构变化时提升 persist key（v5 → v6）而不是沿用同键；
ui-workspace 侧对 groupExpansion / sessionOrderByAccount 兜底默认值。

Workaround
F12 → Console → localStorage.removeItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5') → 刷新。

threads.title: Web chat pinned on "Loading history…" forever when a live assistant baseline fails validation
threads.bodyText:
Summary
session.follow includes the host's in-memory copy of an in-flight assistant
attempt in its opening snapshot. The host folds those frames as trusted and never
validates chunk shape. The browser validates them strictly during the first
window install. When a chunk fails, expandAssistantStream throws a plain
TypeError, and every handler on the open path recognises only RemoteError.
The TypeError is rethrown before openState is ever assigned, so the chat
stays on "Loading history…" with no error surface, no timeout and no retry.
Users see a chat that never loads. Reloading does not help, because the same
baseline is served again. It clears only when the host drops the attempt.
Present in 0.1.5-rc.1 and unchanged in 0.1.6-alpha.1.
Reproduction
Against a running dsh web, intercept the gateway socket and attach an
activeAttempt whose stream carries one non-object chunk to the opening
snapshot frame:
frame.value.assistantStream = {
  revision: 1,
  activeAttempt: {
    attemptId: 'repro', startedAfterSeq: lastSeq, turn: 1, step: 1, nextIndex: 1,
    stream: [{ type: 'chunk', time: Date.now(), chunk: 'not-an-object' }],
  },
};
Result: the chat column shows chat.loadingHistory indefinitely, zero rows, no
openError, and the console carries an unhandled
TypeError: Assistant stream raw chunk must be a lossless JSON object.
Observed for 30 s, and in the wild for minutes across repeated hard refreshes.
Chain
All paths in @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller.


lib/index.js — SessionAssistantStreamAccumulator retains live frames for
reconnecting web followers, documented as folding "one trusted frame". No
chunk validation.


lib/index.js — follow() emits
assistantStream: this.assistantStreams.get(target)?.snapshot() ?? { revision: 0 }
in the opening snapshot.


lib/client.js — ClientAssistantStream.replace() calls
expandAssistantStream(opening.stream), which runs validateRecord and
throws TypeError for a chunk that is not a lossless plain JSON object.


That call sits under installWindow → acceptEventChange('replace') →
RemoteJournalStream.replaceFromOpening → publish, inside open()'s try
block, so it rejects events.open().


lib/client.js — doOpen:
} catch (error) {
  if (generation !== this.openGeneration || this.events !== events) return;
  if (!isRemoteFailure(error)) throw error;   // openState still "loading"
  this.events = void 0;
  this.openState = "error";
  this.openError = error;
}
isRemoteFailure requires isDSHRemoteError === true, so a TypeError
escapes. openState is never moved off "loading".


followCurrent() calls record.session.open() with no .catch(), so the
rejection is unhandled and nothing re-opens: followCurrent returns early
while current === this.watched.


failEventStream has the same shape, so a non-RemoteError raised by the
background consumer also throws out of a callback rather than settling state.
Why storage looks clean
Only the live copy is affected. Validating every stored assistant stream with
the shipped browser validator gave zero rejections over 13,502 streams in 567
sessions. A malformed durable event behaves correctly and renders
chat.loadError. The asymmetry is that durable events cross a validating
boundary and the live baseline does not.
Suggested fixes

Validate the accumulator's frames on the host, at the point they are folded,
so a bad chunk cannot reach the wire and fails where it can be attributed.
Make the browser's open path total. doOpen and failEventStream should
settle openState for every error class, not only RemoteError; rethrowing
inside a callback leaves the UI with no way back.
Treat an unreadable live baseline as recoverable in
ClientAssistantStream.replace(): drop the transient tail, keep the durable
window, let live frames resync. The in-flight text arrives again anyway.

Fix 2 alone converts a dead screen into a visible error. Fix 3 keeps the session
usable. We are running 3 locally as a patch.
Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.1, @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller 0.1.5-rc.2
Node 24.21.0, Linux, Chromium
Also checked @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller@0.1.6-alpha.1: the
doOpen and failEventStream handling is byte-identical.

threads.title: [Bug] 未思考直接输出文本时 Chat 出现空的思考块（0.1.6-alpha.2 / deepseek-flash + Messages 协议）
threads.bodyText:
TL;DR (English) — On 0.1.6-alpha.2, when the model answers with text and no thinking, Chat still shows an empty "思考 / Think" block. The Messages protocol emits a block-start(reasoning) for a signature-only empty thinking block, the harness persists {"type":"reasoning","text":""} into the assistant message, and the Chat renderer draws a Think row for every reasoning block.

Summary
模型没有产生思考内容、直接输出正文（且不是工具调用）时，Chat 里会出现一个标题为“思考”但内容为空的思考块；该空块同时被写进会话日志的 assistant 消息内容里。

版本：0.1.6-alpha.2（checkout ddefc45fbc），Windows
provider deepseek-official / model deepseek-flash（Messages 协议，thinking enabled）
关联代码：packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/protocols/messages/translate.ts、packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/AssistantMarkdown.tsx

Reproduction

用 deepseek-official / deepseek-flash（Messages 协议）发一条会直接作答、不需要推理的请求，例如“只回复两个字：收到”。
Chat 时间线里回答上方多出一个空的“思考”折叠行：收起态只有“思考”标题、没有摘要，展开后正文为空。
会话日志 session.v3.jsonl 中该条 assistant/message 的 content 以空 reasoning 块开头。

复现证据（本机真实会话，节选自 assistant/message 的 stream 记录）：
{ "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "block-start", "index": 0, "blockType": "reasoning" } },
{ "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "block-end", "index": 0, "block": { "type": "reasoning", "text": "" } } },
{ "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "block-start", "index": 1, "blockType": "text" } },
持久化结果：
{ "role": "assistant",
  "content": [ { "type": "reasoning", "text": "" }, { "type": "text", "text": "..." } ],
  "source": { "kind": "model", "provider": "deepseek-official", "model": "deepseek-flash",
              "replayState": { "response": { "kind": "deepseek-messages", "version": 1 },
                               "blocks": [ { "type": "reasoning", "signature": "…" }, { "type": "text" } ] } } }
本机已有会话统计：400 条 assistant/message 中 52 条带空 reasoning 块，形状均为 ["reasoning","text"] 或 ["reasoning","tool-call"]。
Current behavior

Messages 协议在 content_block_start（type: "thinking"）就发出 block-start(reasoning)；DeepSeek Messages 在没有思考内容时仍会返回带 signature 的空 thinking 块且没有任何 thinking_delta，于是 block-end 落下 { "type": "reasoning", "text": "" }，被 BlockAssembler 组装进 assistant 消息并持久化。
Chat 的 AssistantMarkdown 对每个 reasoning 块无条件渲染 ReasoningRow，空 reasoning 块因此渲染成空“思考”行（组件快照中 data-variant="think"，摘要 <span class="_summaryText_…"> 为空）。
同类判定在仓库里本已把空 reasoning 视为不可见（assistant.ts 的 blockIsVisible、turn-process.ts 的 visibleChunk、llm 的 isVisibleChunk），只有最终渲染循环漏掉了；chat-completions 协议也已有“空 reasoning 不建块”的等价保护，messages 协议没有。

Expected behavior
未产生思考内容时不应出现任何思考块：Chat 不渲染空 reasoning 行，assistant 消息也不应因这次“假思考”而多出内容块。
Fix (verified locally)
packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/AssistantMarkdown.tsx：新增 paintsContent，与 assistant.ts 的可见性判定对齐——text/reasoning 仅在去除空白后非空时算可见；渲染循环跳过空白 reasoning 块，hasVisible 也改用它，避免只剩空块时画出空壳。
新增测试 packages/client/ui-chat/tests/coverage-tails.client.spec.tsx：空 reasoning 不渲染 Think 行、流式下等首个思考 token 到达才出现 Think 行、仅空 reasoning 时不渲染根壳。移除修复后这 3 条测试全部失败（已本地验证）。
本地验证：test:gui 433 个测试文件 / 6183 用例通过，run-oxlint 无告警，pnpm run build 成功，运行中的 dsh web 实时 graph 已在提供含修复的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat bundle。
可选的上游修复（更彻底，未采用）：让 messages/translate.ts 推迟发出 thinking 块的 block-start，使空 thinking 块根本不进入持久化内容；需同时保持 replayState.blocks 与 message.content 的下标对齐。

threads.title: [Bug] Chat: "Load earlier" can succeed without adding any rows
threads.bodyText:
What happens
Clicking Load earlier in Chat can return a successful page while no new rows appear on screen. Clicking it repeatedly looks like the button is simply broken. A browser refresh that replays the same history window can expose the same symptom.
Where
packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/conversation-nodes/message.ts
Cause
The input-message Context id is derived from the producer id:
? { id: String(event.data.id), role: 'start' }
When two append-surface user/message events carry the same producer data.id, both match a single input-message Context as two separate starts. That violates the assembler's unique-start invariant, so the later occurrence is folded away and produces no visible row. Neither symptom requires missing persisted events or a server restart.
Observed evidence
With a long transcript, paging twice produced:



step
anchor elements
Chat text (characters)




initial
193
10,613


after 1 page
401
32,767


after 2 pages
597
41,633



Suggested fix
Use the event's own position for row identity, and keep the producer id for the things that genuinely need it:
? { id: String(event.seq), role: 'start' }
data.id is still required for Inbox correlation and steering classification, so it should stay in the payload — only the Context/row identity needs to change.
Why this cannot be a plugin
The conversation.chat.node slots render nodes, but they do not let a plugin change how node identity is computed, and there is no public seam for registering or overriding a ConversationNodeDefinition. So this appears to need a change inside ui-chat.
Process note
Issues are disabled on this repo and CONTRIBUTING.md states external pull requests are not accepted, so I am posting here as instructed. Sorry if this is the wrong category — happy to move it.
