Custom agent presets in $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/ are no longer registered after upgrading from 0.1.5-rc.1 to 0.1.7-alpha.2
threads.bodyText:
中文摘要（给中文读者）
从 0.1.5-rc.1 升级到 0.1.7-alpha.2 后，放在 $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/ 里的自定义 agent preset 不再被注册，
导致所有使用自定义 preset 的会话能看历史、但不能继续对话（RemoteError: Unknown agent preset: crew）。
已定位到源码层：上游把 preset 机制从「目录」改成了「组合条目」
（@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets 复数 → @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset 单数），
新版安装树里已经没有任何读取 .agent-presets 目录的代码路径。
我的会话数据未受影响（925/925 个日志字节完全一致，152 万条记录全部可解析）。
详见下方英文全文。


Custom agent presets in $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/ are no longer registered after upgrading from 0.1.5-rc.1 to 0.1.7-alpha.2

Channel: GitHub Discussions — this repository disables Issues and names Discussions
as its bug-report channel in CONTRIBUTING.md. Every claim below was measured on a real
machine; anything I did not establish is marked as such.

Summary
After upgrading @deepseek-ai/dsh from 0.1.5-rc.1 to 0.1.7-alpha.2, every
session whose creation header carries a user-defined agentPreset fails to resume:
resume failed for session "session-a7d197a6-9fd5-4f86-8233-2906d66e2ebd":
RemoteError: Unknown agent preset: crew   (gateway/internal)

The conversation history renders correctly, but the session cannot be continued —
sending a message fails and nothing is written.
Three user-defined presets live in $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/ (crew, qa, walnut).
They are byte-identical to their pre-upgrade state, yet none of them is registered
by 0.1.7-alpha.2.
This is not a data problem. All 925 existing session logs are byte-identical after
the upgrade; the failure is at preset discovery/registration.
Environment









OS
Windows (Windows 11, PowerShell 7.6.1)


Node.js
v24.15.0


package manager
pnpm 10.34.5


before
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.1 (working install, presets work)


after
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-alpha.2 (fresh, clean install)


install shape
isolated DSH_HOME containing a byte-for-byte copy of the real home; 267 @deepseek-ai/dsh* packages, all at 0.1.7-alpha.2 (verified uniform, so this is not a mixed-version install)



Expected
A user-defined agent preset placed in $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/<id>/
(the discovery root used by 0.1.5-rc.1, and the location dsh-crew writes to)
keeps working after the upgrade — or the release notes describe the new model and
a migration path exists.
Actual
The preset is not registered at all.
Evidence
1. The old mechanism was directory-based and shipped its own preset files
0.1.5-rc.1 installs @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets (plural), which contains:
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets/presets/
    cordis/agent.cordis.yml
    minimal/agent.cordis.yml
    ptc/agent.cordis.yml
    standard/agent.cordis.yml

On the npm registry, @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets has no 0.1.7-alpha.x version;
its last published version is 0.1.6-alpha.2:
$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets versions --json | tail
  "0.1.5-rc.1", "0.1.5-rc.2", "0.1.5-rc.3", "0.1.6-alpha.1", "0.1.6-alpha.2"

2. The new mechanism is a composition entry, not a directory
0.1.7-alpha.2 instead installs @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset (singular) plus
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry. The whole of
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset/lib/index.js is 29 lines:
/** Registers child plugin configuration without owning Agents using older revisions. */
var AgentPreset = class {
  ctx;
  config;
  static inject = ["agentPresets"];
  /** Preserve child expressions until their own plugins activate. */
  static [EntryGroup.key] = true;
  static Config = z.object({
    id: z.string().required(),
    name: z.string(),
    description: z.string(),
    order: z.number(),
    plugins: z.array(z.any()).required()
  });
  constructor(ctx, config) { this.ctx = ctx; this.config = config; }
  async *[Service.init]() {
    yield await this.ctx.agentPresets.register(this.config);
  }
};
A preset is now an entry in an ordinary Cordis composition whose plugins are declared
inline. There is no directory scan.
3. No filesystem path in the new build references an agent-presets directory
Searching the entire installed 0.1.7-alpha.2 tree (node_modules/.pnpm, all *.js):



pattern searched
matches




.agent-presets
none


agent-presets/
none


agent-presets
only "agent-presets-invariant" (registry plugin name) and id: "agent-presets" (a client UI section id) — no path



(The old install does contain @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets/presets/..., as shown above.)
So on 0.1.7-alpha.2 there is no code path that reads $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/.
4. The user data is intact — this is purely discovery



measurement
value




existing session logs before / after the upgrade
925 / 925


unchanged (byte-identical SHA-256)
925


modified / deleted
0 / 0


added
3 files, all new-generation session.v4.jsonl.zstd


zstd frames decoded across all logs
1,153,761 — 0 failures


JSONL records parsed
1,520,285 — 0 failures


distinct top-level record types
40 — all present in the shipped known-event list



A real pre-existing v3 session was successfully migrated and published as a v4 successor,
which is the behaviour the format design promises.
Minimal reproduction

On 0.1.5-rc.1, create a user preset in the old format:
$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/crew/ containing preset.yml and agent.cordis.yml
(this is exactly what dsh-crew@0.10.0 writes — see its host/crew.js,
PRESET_ID = "crew", join(home, ".agent-presets", PRESET_ID)).
Create a session that names it (its header records agentPreset: "crew").
Upgrade @deepseek-ai/dsh to 0.1.7-alpha.2 in a clean install.
Reopen the session.
Observe: history renders, then
RemoteError: Unknown agent preset: crew (gateway/internal); sending a message fails.

Impact

Every session recorded with a user-defined preset becomes read-only. History is
visible; the conversation cannot be continued.
dsh-crew (the plugin that ships the crew/PM workflow) is at 0.10.0, which is the
latest published version, and it still writes its preset into
$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/crew/. Its entire workflow therefore stops working on
0.1.7-alpha.x.
The same applies to any third-party preset that follows the documented
$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/ layout.

Things I ruled out (so they do not need re-testing)

Not a session-format regression. 925/925 logs unchanged; 1.5M records parse; a v3
session migrated to v4 successfully.
Not a mixed-version install. All 267 @deepseek-ai/dsh* packages are 0.1.7-alpha.2.
Not a cascade from another broken preset. Moving qa and walnut out of
.agent-presets (leaving only crew) and restarting still yields
Unknown agent preset: crew.
Not browser state. Reproduced in a fresh private/incognito window.
Not a missing dependency of the crew preset. All 19 @deepseek-ai/* packages
referenced by its agent.cordis.yml are present in the 0.1.7-alpha.2 install.

Separate, independent issue found at the same time
The same user presets reference @deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-worker-thread, whose last
published version is 0.1.5-rc.3; it does not exist at 0.1.7-alpha.1/0.1.7-alpha.2.
So even after the discovery problem is fixed, those two presets would fail to mount.
Worth an upgrade note for preset authors: a package referenced by a preset can disappear
between minor lines.
What I could not determine

Whether the removal of directory-based .agent-presets discovery is intended, and
if so, what the documented replacement for user-authored presets is.
I did not find upgrade/migration notes covering this change. If such notes exist, a
pointer would be welcome.

Request

Either keep the $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/<id>/ discovery working, or
Document the new model (a composition entry with inline plugins) and provide a
migration path/upgrade note, so preset authors can follow — and so existing sessions
can be resumed again.

Version data used in this report
@deepseek-ai/dsh                        0.1.5-rc.1  ->  0.1.7-alpha.2
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets          last version 0.1.6-alpha.2   (plural — removed)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset           0.1.7-alpha.2                 (singular — new)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset-registry  0.1.7-alpha.2
@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-worker-thread last version 0.1.5-rc.3       (removed)
dsh-crew                                0.10.0                        (latest published)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-catalog currentVersion: 4             (unchanged 0.1.7-alpha.1 -> 0.1.7-alpha.2)


Related
This appears to be part of a pattern in the 0.1.6/0.1.7 line, where third-party plugins and presets break in ways that surface far from the cause:

#7445 — 0.1.7-alpha.1: legacy client service settingsScope silently removed — third-party plugins hang on boot and the failure surfaces as a misleading client-half failed
#7147 — tool-cordis registers Host inspect providers globally → any second mount of a preset containing it fails (New Session appears to do nothing)
#6751 — [Bug] 空白新会话切换 Agent Preset 后，新 preset 的 modelSelectionSettings 型 delegation 工具完全未安装

A single upgrade note about what changed for third-party preset/plugin authors — and a migration path — would help all of them at once.

threads.title: Custom agent preset mounting `subagent` tool outside an `isolate` group fails to mount → agent loses subagent spawn capability
threads.bodyText:
Description
Environment

DeepSeek Harness (dsh), desktop app build
Custom agent preset produced by authoring a composition modeled on the shipped standard preset

Summary
When switching an agent session from the built-in standard preset to a custom preset, the subagent tool is not exposed in the session's tool list. The session only has list_agents, send_message, and interrupt_agent. As a result, the agent cannot spawn nested subagents (spawn-tool-unavailable), which breaks multi-agent orchestration flows that rely on nested delegation.
Root cause (tentative)
The custom preset mounts the subagent delegation tool at the top level of the composition, i.e. without the wrapping cordis:group that carries the isolate: { workflowEngine: true } realm.
The shipped standard preset (and the cordis preset) mount the subagent delegation toolset inside such a group:
- id: delegation
  name: cordis:group
  group: true
  isolate:
    workflowEngine: true
  config:
    - id: tool-subagent-control
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'

    - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'

    - id: tool-subagent
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
      config:
        provider: spawn
        toolName: subagent
        modelSelectionSettings: true
        backgroundMode: continuable
    # ... fork, codex, claude-code, workflow, ralph ...
The custom preset instead mounts it directly:
- id: tool-subagent
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  config:
    provider: spawn
    toolName: subagent
    modelSelectionSettings: true
    backgroundMode: continuable
- id: tool-subagent-control
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
- id: tool-subagent-list-agents
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
The standard/agent.cordis.yml header documents this constraint explicitly:

A service row here MUST sit inside a group carrying an isolate realm. Without one it publishes into the root realm, where it is process-global — another preset publishing the same name collides, and a host reader would resolve one preset's instance for every session; dsh-agent-presets rejects that at mount.

And in the delegation section:

The subagents registry and its spawn/fork backends live in the HOST composition: the registry is a process singleton ... workflows is different — nothing outside an agent reads it — so every row that reaches it shares one entry-local realm here.

So the hypothesis is: mounting tool-subagent at the root realm (without the isolate group) causes a mount-time collision that dsh-agent-presets rejects, leaving the session without the subagent tool. list_agents/send_message/interrupt_agent still appear because those control tools mounted fine, but the actual spawn tool is missing.
Expected behavior
A custom preset modeled on standard should be able to expose the subagent spawn tool when the delegation toolset is mounted with the same isolate: { workflowEngine: true } grouping as the shipped presets — or, failing that, the mount rejection should fail loudly at preset load time with a clear diagnostic (rather than silently omitting the tool from the session's tool list, which surfaces only later as an opaque "tool not available" at the point the agent tries to delegate).
Steps to reproduce

Copy the standard preset into a new preset directory and author a custom persona/instructions (keep the rest, including the delegation group, intact in this first step).
In the custom preset, move the tool-subagent row (and its siblings) out of the delegation cordis:group / isolate block so they sit at the composition top level.
Switch the session's agent preset to this custom preset (default preset mapping).
Start a session and ask the agent to delegate to a subagent.
Observe the agent's tool list contains only list_agents / send_message / interrupt_agent, not subagent.

Impact
Multi-agent orchestrator flows that delegate through nested subagent spawn fail with "tool subagent not exposed in session tool list", blocking the entire workflow. The failure only appears at delegation time, making it hard to trace back to the preset composition.
Possible improvements

Fail loudly at mount time — dsh-agent-presets should emit a noticeable error/warning when a subagent (or other registry-backed) tool row is mounted outside its required isolate realm, instead of silently leaving the tool absent.
Document the constraint — the standard/agent.cordis.yml header already states it; consider surfacing it in the public docs on authoring custom presets (a "delegation must live inside an isolate: workflowEngine group" note), since presets are the official customization path.

threads.title: 0.1.7 read-time migration refuses released subagent/descriptor v2 sessions (fix available)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-alpha.2 refuses to read sessions whose subagent/descriptor payload carries version: 2, so any session opened between 2026-07-27 (payload v2 shipped in #2663) and 2026-08-28 (v3) fails whole-artifact v0-to-v1 migration with SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError and becomes unreadable. Downstream aggregation (e.g. the usage-billing plugin) skips these artifacts, so users see silently missing cost statistics for sessions they still actively append to. The raw v0 log stays unchanged on disk — nothing is lost, but there is no self-healing path.
Reproduction
Open (or continue appending to) a session created in that window on 0.1.7-alpha.2. The reader refuses with:
SessionFormatUnsupportedMigrationError: subagent/descriptor <seq> uses unsupported descriptor version 2

Proposed fix
Descriptor v2 is a strict subset of what the v3 payload validator already accepts (required: mode/version/provider; optional: label and composition members), so the v0 edge can admit version 2 alongside 3 with the same released-key policy — no new validation branches beyond the version literal. Versions outside {2, 3} keep refusing.
A complete patch (with migration pass/refuse tests and a bilingual Agent Note) is on my fork, based on current master 00102833df:
https://github.com/kenz1117/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/descriptor-v2-migration
Since both issues and pull requests are disabled in this repository, I am posting it here; happy to move it wherever the maintainers prefer. session-format-v0-to-v1 passes 111/111 on that branch.

threads.bodyText:
Bug: Internal Peer Dependency Conflict in @deepseek-ai/dsh
Description
Installing @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest produces hundreds of npm warn ERESOLVE overriding peer dependency warnings due to an internal version mismatch between sub-packages within the same monorepo.
Conflicting Dependencies



Package
Required @deepseek-ai/cordis




@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr@1.0.19
~4.0.4

threads.title: Orphaned profile writer lock silently drops the legacy settings.yaml migration (settings lost, welcome notice cannot be acknowledged)
threads.bodyText:
Environment: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-alpha.2 (npm global), Node.js v25.1.0, macOS 15.4.1, profile: web
Summary
An orphaned writer lock (<profile>/package.json.lock left behind by a killed process) makes the one-shot legacy settings.yaml migration fail silently and permanently. The user's settings (theme, model defaults, welcome-notice acknowledgement) are dropped, the welcome notice reappears, and acknowledging it fails with a generic "please try again" that can never succeed.
I believe the migration behavior is a bug; the lock timeout reporting and the UI error copy are related rough edges that made this very hard to diagnose.
What happened

A dsh plugin --profile web add ... process was killed (timeout) while it held the profile writer lock. The lock file survived with the dead PID inside:
$ cat ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json.lock
20702
$ ps -p 20702   # dead


On the next dsh web boot, SettingsForms.importLegacyDocument() (in @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings) runs:
await rename(path, imported);            // settings.yaml → settings.yaml.imported  (succeeds)
for (const [section, values] of Object.entries(sections ?? {})) {
    try { await this.update(ns, values); }
    catch (error) { this.ownerContext.logger.warn(...); }   // every section throws
}
Each update() goes through withFileLock(.../package.json) → waits 2s → atomic-write: timed out waiting for the writer lock at .../package.json.lock → caught → logger.warn → next section. All five sections were dropped.
Because the file is renamed before the imports, the migration never runs again ("a partial import never repeats"). The settings are gone for good — I had to notice the missing theme, manually rename .imported back, delete the stale lock, and reboot to recover.
Symptoms in the UI:

The 内测声明 / welcome notice reappears even though welcomeNoticeVersion was already acknowledged in the old file.
Clicking the confirm button shows "暂时无法保存确认状态，请重试。" — retrying can never work, because every settings write hits the same orphaned lock.
Raw API response (found by driving the page headlessly) :
{"code":"settings/rejected","message":"atomic-write: timed out waiting for the writer lock at /Users/<u>/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json.lock","details":{"ns":"ui-settings-general"}}




Repro steps

Hold the profile writer lock from any process and kill it (e.g. interrupt dsh plugin add with a SIGKILL), leaving <profile>/package.json.lock behind with a dead PID.
Put a legacy ~/.dsh/settings.yaml in place (pre-0.1.6 layout) and start dsh web.
Observe: the file is renamed to settings.yaml.imported, no section is imported, nothing is printed to stdout, and the migration will never be retried.

Why I think this is a bug


Migration is not failure-atomic. Renaming the source file before knowing the imports succeed converts any transient write failure into permanent, silent data loss. Suggestion: import all sections first and rename only after full success — or rename back on failure — so a later boot can retry.


The failure is invisible. Neither logger.info("settings: imported ...") nor the logger.warn for a failed section appeared on stdout in my runs (the success line never appeared either, even when the import worked). A migration that can lose user settings should be loud — or logged to a file.


The lock timeout error is not actionable. withFileLock already writes the holder's PID into the lock file, but the timeout error doesn't include it. Not auto-deleting orphan locks is a defensible choice ("orphan recovery is an operator action"), but then please include the PID and whether it is still alive in the error:

timed out waiting for the writer lock at .../package.json.lock (held by pid 20702, not running); remove the lock file to recover

Without this, diagnosis took several steps that an ordinary user would not know to perform.


The UI swallows the real error. settings/rejected carries a precise message, but the welcome notice shows only a generic "请重试" for a condition that retries cannot fix. Passing the server message through (at least in a details/tooltip) would have made this a 10-second fix.


Current workaround (for anyone hitting this)
LOCK=~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json.lock
[ -f "$LOCK" ] && ps -p "$(cat "$LOCK")" >/dev/null 2>&1 || rm -f "$LOCK"   # only if the PID is dead
mv ~/.dsh/settings.yaml.imported ~/.dsh/settings.yaml                       # if migration half-ran
# restart dsh web — the migration re-runs and imports everything
Was the rename-before-import behavior intentional? Happy to open a PR for (1) and (3) if it helps.

threads.title: # [Bug] Sidebar history sessions and workspaces completely lost, and current session has no corresponding entry (Data loss risk)
threads.bodyText:
[Bug] Sidebar history sessions and workspaces completely lost, and current session has no corresponding entry (Data loss risk)
🐛 Description
While using DSH, a severe state loss issue occurred:

Sidebar completely empty: All historical session records disappeared, leaving only the "New Session" and "Settings" buttons.
No corresponding entry for the current session: Even if a conversation can be opened or re-entered, there is no corresponding highlighted entry for it in the left sidebar.
Workspaces lost: Original workspace configurations and environmental states have all disappeared.
Refreshing the page or restarting the application does not recover them. Suspected local data reset or migration failure.

🖥️ Environment

DSH Version: v0.1.7-rc.1 (Modify as needed, e.g., v0.1.5-rc.2 / v0.1.7-alpha.2)
Runtime: Web / DSH Desktop (Community desktop client, please specify the project) / Running from source
OS: macOS / Windows / Linux (Please specify version)
Browser: Chrome / Edge / Firefox (If Web, please specify version)
Installation Method: Global npm / npx / Built from source / Desktop client installer

🔁 Steps to Reproduce

Open DSH, normally create and save multiple sessions, and perform operations within their corresponding workspaces.
Normally exit, refresh the page, or update/restart the application.
Reopen DSH, and find that the sidebar history list is completely empty.
Try to create or resume a session, the sidebar still shows no corresponding entry.
Check workspaces, and find that original workspace configurations and context are all lost.

🎯 Expected Behavior

The sidebar should normally display all historical session records.
The currently opened session should have a corresponding highlighted entry in the left sidebar.
Workspace configurations and historical states should remain intact.

❌ Actual Behavior

The sidebar is completely empty, and all historical records are gone.
Opening any session shows no corresponding entry in the sidebar.
Original workspace configurations and states are lost, making it impossible to continue previous context.

🛠️ Troubleshooting Steps Taken

 Refresh page / Restart software (Ineffective)
 Check local ~/.dsh directory data files:

~/.dsh/sessions/ or ~/.dsh/profiles/ (Confirm whether session data files still physically exist)
~/.dsh/workspaces/ (Confirm whether workspace data is lost)
Please note the result here: Files still exist / Files are lost / Files exist but cannot be parsed


 Disable all third-party plugins (e.g., DSH-better-sidebar) and restart
 Check browser console (F12) or terminal for error messages (e.g., database connection failure, JSON parse error)
 Try creating a new Profile and logging in again

📝 Additional Context


Note: Recent DSH upstream has many breaking changes (e.g., profile format migration). This issue not only involves UI rendering but is also accompanied by severe loss of session records and workspace data. It is suspected that database migration failed during version upgrade, or old Profile parsing crashes caused the frontend to forcefully reset local state. Since this involves core data loss, we hope the official team can prioritize investigating data loading and persistence logic and provide a data recovery solution.

threads.title: Reveal-in-file-manager reports success while the Explorer window stays invisible
threads.bodyText:
Status: RESOLVED — fixed locally by the reporter on 2026-09-23; see "Resolution" at the
end. Root cause corrected on 2026-09-25: the invisible window is caused by
windowsHide: true on the spawned explorer.exe, not by the token-restricted sandbox.
The earlier attribution in this report was measured from inside a sandbox child and confused
the test environment with the cause; the A/B measurement under a plain user token is in
"Correction" below. The fix is unchanged, and the fix still matters (the bug reproduced on
0.1.7-rc.2).

Summary
With the Windows ACL sandbox active (workspace-write, the default), revealing a file in Explorer
from the GUI ("open" → "show in file manager") reports success and does nothing visible. The
folder window is created, the target file is even correctly selected inside it, but the window is
never shown, and the process exits with code 1 — which the caller accepts as a successful handoff.
The user sees a success toast ("已请求在文件管理器中显示" / "requested to show in file manager") and
no window.
Environment

Windows 11 (Chinese locale), Windows PowerShell 5.1
Originally reported on @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.5-rc.3; re-verified on 0.1.7-rc.2 (2026-09-25),
where the reveal is still broken and the same fix is still required
dsh web GUI, profile web, file policy workspace-write

Reproduction

Start dsh web with the default workspace-write policy.
Ask the agent to create any file in the session workspace.
In the GUI, use the file card's menu → show in file manager.
Observe: the toast reports success; no Explorer window appears (check the taskbar — nothing was
added there either).

What was measured (2026-09-23)
EnumWindows + Shell.Application were used to inspect the windows after the reveal. Three windows
for the same folder existed:



Window
Created by
Visible
SelectedItems()




HWND=3148338
COM Shell.Application.Explore
True
the target file


HWND=197996
explorer.exe /select, (the DSH path)
False
the target file


HWND=329818
explorer.exe /select, (the DSH path)
False
the target file



So the reveal is doing its job — the folder is open and the file is selected — it just leaves the
window hidden.
Correction (2026-09-25): the cause is windowsHide, not the restricted token
The 2026-09-23 investigation ran its probes from a sandbox child and attributed the invisible
window to that child's restricted token. A controlled A/B under the same token the host actually
uses (a plain, unrestricted user token) shows that attribution was wrong: upstream's code produces
the invisible window there too.
Method: two separate scratch folders, two probe files, and revealNativePath imported from the
unpatched lib/index.js.orig versus the patched lib/index.js, in one process, same token.
Window state read back through Shell.Application:



Stage
node exit
Window
Visible
Selected
Foreground window




baseline
—
—
—
—
Chrome


upstream index.js.orig
0 ("success")
hwnd=655550 for _reveal_a
False
probe.txt
still Chrome


patched index.js
0
new hwnd=460902 for _reveal_b
True
probe.txt
_reveal_b - 文件资源管理器



The mechanism is in the shared runner, runNativeCommand
(@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command/lib/index.js):
execFile(command, [...args], { encoding: "utf8", signal, windowsHide: true }, …)
windowsHide: true is correct for a helper that should never flash a console — but
explorer.exe /select, is not such a helper: the folder window it hands to the shell is created as
part of a process launched hidden, and it stays hidden. Explorer then exits 1, and runExplorer
deliberately accepts exit 1 as a delegated handoff, so nothing surfaces.
That single flag explains both halves of the bug: the window is never shown, and the caller is told
the handoff succeeded.
Why the COM route is immune
Shell.Application is hosted by the already-running explorer.exe, so the window is created by
that process and our hidden-child launch flag never applies to it. That is why routing the reveal
through COM displays the window, and why the sandbox token was never the deciding variable.
(Side note, measured on 0.1.7: from inside the sandbox the COM route cannot be used — the child
runs at Low integrity, New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application fails with "拒绝访问", and piped
stdio to a child fails with spawn EPERM. This does not affect the real path: the reveal is served
by the host process — HTTP route → dsh-client-ui-deliverables →
ctx.sessionController.openWorkspacePath → revealNativePath, see
dsh-api-session-controller/lib/index.js.)
Root cause
@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command, revealNativePath(). On 0.1.7-rc.2 (unchanged in substance from
0.1.5-rc.3, the encoding helper around it was refined):
if (manager === "explorer") {
    let windowsPath = path;
    if (platform === "linux") { /* wslpath … */ }
    await runExplorer(["/select,", explorerTarget(windowsPath)], signal, run);
    return;
}
Two problems compound here:

The window is never shown — because runNativeCommand starts the child with
windowsHide: true (corrected attribution; see above).
The failure is swallowed — explorer.exe exits 1, and runExplorer deliberately treats exit
code 1 as a delegated handoff. So a reveal that displayed nothing is indistinguishable from a
successful one, and the UI reports success.

Secondary observation (unrelated to the invisibility): on 0.1.5-rc.3 the /select, target was a
file:// URI rather than the native path the switch documents. 0.1.7 encodes that target more
carefully (explorerTarget() decodes non-ASCII escapes and escapes both , and =), so this is
mostly addressed upstream.
Resolution (applied locally by the reporter, 2026-09-23; re-applied to 0.1.7-rc.2 on 2026-09-25)
Route the reveal through the running shell's COM object instead of spawning explorer.exe.
Shell.Application is hosted by the already-running explorer.exe, so the window it creates is
displayed:
await run("powershell.exe", [
    "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass",
    "-File", REVEAL_COM_SCRIPT,   // lib/reveal-com.ps1
    windowsPath
], signal);
The helper (abridged):
$shell = New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application
# reuse an existing window for the folder; Explore() only when none exists
$shell.Explore($parent)
$window = <first shell window for $parent>
$window.Document.SelectItem($window.Document.Folder.ParseName($leaf), 1 + 4 + 8)
$window.Visible = $true
# Document.Focus() does not exist on this shell object; raise the window instead:
# SetForegroundWindow is refused by the Windows foreground lock, so attach to the
# foreground thread first, then BringWindowToTop + SetActiveWindow + SetForegroundWindow,
# falling back to FlashWindowEx so the taskbar button blinks.
Measured after the change (2026-09-25 run, host-equivalent token):

upstream: window created, Visible = False, foreground stays on the browser
patched: window created, Visible = True, SelectedItems() = [target file], foreground switches
to the Explorer window
re-applied to a clean 0.1.7-rc.2 install via a version-checked, idempotent patch script; the user
confirmed in the GUI that the window now pops up and shows the file

Three behaviours worth keeping if upstream rewrites the helper:

Reuse an already-open window for the folder. Calling Explore() every time piles up duplicate
windows; during this investigation three appeared.
Never let a cosmetic step fail the reveal. Document.Focus() throws
does not contain a method named 'Focus' on this shell object while the window is visible and the
file is selected; making that fatal would report a working reveal as failed — the same class of bug
as the swallowed exit code 1.
Let it fail loudly, not silently. Even with the fix, the helper returns a distinct exit code
when no window can be raised, so a future regression is visible instead of being reported as
success.

A minimal upstream alternative, if spawning PowerShell is unwanted: keep the explorer.exe hand-off
but stop hiding it (windowsHide: false, or a per-call override for the reveal), and keep the
"distinguish a real failure from exit 1" handling.
I am happy to open a PR with the helper and the small call-site change if the approach is acceptable.

threads.title: [Bug] 0.1.7-rc.1 待审计划卡片丢失「查看全文」且不再自动打开（slot 条目被永久退役）
threads.bodyText:
DSH 0.1.7-rc.1：待审计划卡片丢失「查看全文」按钮且不再自动打开（slot 条目被永久退役）

拟提交渠道：GitHub Discussions（该仓库 Issues 已关闭：has_issues: false，README 亦指向 Discussions）
提交入口：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/new/choose


一、环境



项
值




dsh 版本
0.1.7-rc.1（撰写时 npm 上已发布的最新版本，无更新版本可升）


启动方式
dsh web（Web UI），全局 npm 安装


浏览器
Chromium 内核（Windows 11）


触发功能
plan 模式（/plan）→ agent 调用 exit_plan_mode → 待审计划卡片


本地改动
无核心补丁；profile 装有若干本地客户端插件，但 conversation.plan-review.actions 在整个安装树中只有 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plan 一个贡献者（已核对），故与这些插件无关



二、现象
计划提交进入待审后，卡片本身正常渲染（「计划待审」条、标题、两行摘要、要求修改 / 同意执行 都在），但：

条带右侧的 「查看全文 / View full plan」链接消失；
计划不会自动在右侧栏打开；
整页刷新后一切恢复正常；
崩溃发生前，浏览器 Console 报：

slot entry crashed in 'conversation.plan-review.actions':
Error: sidebarRight: no session surface is mounted
    at SidebarRightController.require
    at SidebarRightController.openResource
    at Object.openPlan
    at openReview

第 1、2 条同时出现不是两个 bug：「查看全文」按钮和「自动打开」由同一个 slot 条目组件提供，该组件崩溃一次后条目即被退役（见第五节）。
三、复现（间歇性，竞态）
不是稳定复现，需要撞上界面重排的时间窗。提高命中率的操作：

让 agent 在 plan 模式下提交计划（卡片出现，先不要点任何按钮）；
切到另一个会话，或打开「设置 / 插件」等占据主区域的面板，再切回该会话；
重复 3~5 次。

命中后的确认（Console 执行）：
document.querySelector('[data-slot-error="conversation.plan-review.actions"]')  // 非 null = 已崩溃并被退役
命中即永久生效：即使右侧栏已经重新就绪，按钮也不会回来，只有刷新页面恢复。
四、根因（按已发布构建的行号给出，均为 node_modules 内构建产物）
崩溃路径：

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plan/lib/client.js:107-134 — PlanReviewOpen：同一个组件既渲染「查看全文」按钮，又在 useEffect 里做自动打开；守卫用的是渲染时的 useSidebarMounted(...) 快照（:110）。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plan/lib/client.js:638-651 — openPlan → ctx.sidebarRight.openResource(planAddress(...))。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right/lib/client.js:5995-5998 → :6216-6219 — openResource 第一步 require()，而 require() 只在 this.binding !== undefined 时成功，否则抛 sidebarRight: no session surface is mounted。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right/lib/client.js:5471-5488 — 座位是否登记由 active = visible && view.selected 决定（visible = 对话面板是当前主面板）。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right/lib/client.js:5434-5445 — 座位只在 active 为真时 bindService(...)，active 转假时上一轮的 cleanup 释放 binding；:5976-5984 是 bind/release 与 publishMounted。

竞态（高置信推断，未用断点逐步证实）：PlanReviewOpen 的 effect 读的是 render 时刻的 mounted 快照。座位释放 binding 与「该 effect 被调度执行」可以落在同一次 React commit 内（render → commit → 释放 binding → passive effect）。此时 effect 仍带着过期的 mounted = true 调用 openReview，而 binding 已经为空 → 抛错。
五、为什么必须刷新才能恢复（放大问题的地方）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/lib/client.js：

:611-625 每个 slot 条目都有 SlotErrorBoundary：条目一抛错即 console.error("slot entry crashed in '<key>':", error)，并渲染成 <div data-slot-error="...">；
:1113-1117 对该错误调用 host.reportEntryError(key, entry, error, { abdicate: spec.kind !== "chain" }) —— 对 list / single / keyed 这类遮蔽型插槽，报错即退役（abdicate）该条目；
:1178-1196 list 的渲染里，已退役条目的格子渲染为空 <div data-slot-error>，没有任何可见文案。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots/lib/index.js：

:62 abdicated = new WeakSet()；:286 entriesOfSlot 跳过已退役条目；:456-458 退役后重复上报直接 no-op。

因此：一次瞬时异常 = 该条目在本页生命周期内被永久移除，而 abdicated 是按 entry 对象记录的，只有重新注册（刷新页面 / 一次 HMR reload）才会产生新对象。这就是「刷新才好」的全部原因。
补充：@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions/lib/client.js:276-289 是渲染该插槽的宿主（renderSlot("conversation.plan-review.actions", …)），:883-886 声明了该子插槽为 kind: "list"。
六、影响面（不止计划卡片）
任何 single / keyed / list 插槽条目，只要在渲染、layout effect 或被动 effect 里抛出一次异常，就会：被永久退役 + 界面只留一个空的 data-slot-error div + 用户完全不知道发生了什么。对于「自动打开」这类"顺手做一件事"的副作用，一次瞬时失败赔上一个 UI 能力，代价过高。
七、建议修复
1) 最小修复（建议在 ui-plan 侧，避免瞬时失败逃出条目）
// PlanReviewOpen 的自动打开 effect
useEffect(() => {
  if (opened || !mounted) return;
  try {
    openReview(review, requestKey);
  } catch {
    // 右侧栏座位可能在 render 与 effect 之间被释放：不写 opened，
    // 等 mounted 下次变化（座位重新登记）时自动重试
    return;
  }
  actions.markOpened(identity);
}, [identity, opened, mounted, openReview, review, requestKey, actions]);
同时建议把按钮的 onClick 也包一层 try/catch（点击时若会话面不在，只留一条日志，不再危及条目）。这样条目不再被永久退役、按钮常驻，座位回来后自动打开会补上。
更彻底的 ui-plan 侧改法：useSidebarMounted 只是一个快照；在真正调用 openResource 之前应以「控制器当前的 binding」为准（例如由 ctx.sidebarRight 提供一个不抛错的 tryOpenResource，或让 hook 暴露可在 effect 内重读的 store）。
2) 框架层建议（供维护者判断）

遮蔽型插槽条目因瞬时异常被永久退役，缺少重试/复位通道（例如：允许在重新渲染或下一次 prop 变化时复位该边界，或在 supervision 通道上把失败条目标记为"可重试"）；
crash face 目前是空 div，建议带上条目 id / 注册者 / 原因（至少 DOM 上可诊断），否则用户只会看到"按钮莫名其妙不见了"。

八、附：可粘贴的最小证据

浏览器 Console：slot entry crashed in 'conversation.plan-review.actions': Error: sidebarRight: no session surface is mounted（堆栈见第二节）
DOM 探针：document.querySelector('[data-slot-error="conversation.plan-review.actions"]')
界面行为：计划待审卡片在、按钮不在；右侧栏没有计划标签页；刷新后两者都恢复

threads.title: 【Bug】[Windows] 设置改动被静默回退 —— 启动路径的盘符大小写把 dsh-app-boot 加载成了两个模块实例
threads.bodyText:
[Windows] 设置改动被静默回退 —— 启动路径的盘符大小写把 dsh-app-boot 加载成了两个模块实例
概要
在 Windows 上，如果打包 CLI 的启动路径盘符为小写（例如 PATH 项 d:\Users\<user>\Application Data\npm，由 npm 生成的 dsh.ps1 启动 dsh web），设置面板里的任何改动都会被 Host 拒绝并静默回退：选项立刻弹回原值，~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml 永远不会被改写。
原因是 @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot 这个包在同一个进程里被加载成了两个模块实例：启动器自身的模块图沿用启动时的拼写（小写盘符），而运行时解析拦截（installRuntimeInterception）交给每个插件的路径都经过 realpath 规范化（Windows 上返回大写盘符）。ESM 按解析后的 URL 字符串缓存模块，因此同一个文件的两个拼写互不相等。根 Include 条目记录在模块级 WeakMap bootstrapIncludes 里，插件侧那个实例查不到，于是 reconcileProfilePatches() 抛出 dsh: profile reload requires the root Include entry；Host 拒绝写入，浏览器把这次拒绝当成可恢复的「重读一次」，于是回退到已存的值。
同一份 profile 用源码方式启动（node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web）完全正常，因为那时所有模块 URL 拼写一致 —— 这正是它只在打包安装形态出现的原因。
环境









dsh
0.1.7-rc.1，npm 全局安装（npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh）


启动方式
dsh web（经由 npm 生成的 dsh.ps1 / dsh.cmd shim）


系统
Windows 11


Node
v24.19.0（D:\nodejs\node.exe；shim 旁边没有 node.exe，因此回落到 PATH 里的 node）


全局 bin 的 PATH 项
d:\Users\<user>\Application Data\npm —— 注意盘符是小写 d:


Profile
默认 web；$DSH_HOME 未改动


正常的情况
同一份 profile 从源码启动：node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web



当前源码树里就是同一段实现，所以这不是旧构建产物，相关位置为：packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts 的 :255（bootstrapIncludes 声明）、:274（读取）、:275（抛错）、:581（写入）、:929（audit 使用），以及 packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts:406（createRuntimeResolution）、packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/legacy-links.ts:18（realModuleDirectory，即那次 realpath）、packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile-resolution/resolver.ts:698（installRuntimeInterception）。
复现步骤

让打包 CLI 自身从小写盘符的路径启动（PATH 项写成 d:\...\npm，再执行 dsh web）。
打开 设置 → 通用 → 工作步骤展示，选择另一个模式。
选择器立刻弹回此前已存的模式；cordis.patch.yml 的修改时间不变。

证据

界面表现：不做任何提示，选项自己弹回；工作步骤展示、主题、语言、模型页、插件启用/禁用都一样，说明不是某个设置项的问题。
与浏览器无关的复现：直接调用 Host 自己的 settings RPC（与浏览器同一信封）时，describe 返回的存储层 user 已是新值（说明补丁文件被读到了），而运行时 value 仍是旧值；mutate 返回 settings/rejected，message 正是 dsh: profile reload requires the root Include entry。二者长期不一致，说明失败发生在「把补丁应用进 Loader」这一步，而不是读取或校验。
文件层与运行时层的分离：手工把补丁文件改成目标值后，describe 的 user 立刻反映新值，但运行时 value 不变，直到重启进程才生效 —— 印证了重载链路正是坏掉的那一环。
判定为模块实例分裂的方法（无需起服务、无需 profile）：把同一个 dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js 分别以大写盘符与小写盘符两种 URL 导入，得到两个互不相等的模块实例，导出的 reconcileProfilePatches 也不是同一个函数；用一个实例 boot 出最小 include 树、再用另一个实例对该 ctx 调用 reconcileProfilePatches，即可复现同一句报错，而用 boot 的那一侧调用同一函数则成功返回。这与运行中的 Host 报出的错误完全一致。

预期
选择被持久化：补丁文件被改写，运行时条目同步更新，界面保持所选模式。
实际

写入被拒绝：settings/rejected: dsh: profile reload requires the root Include entry。
浏览器重新读取已存的值并回退，改动静默复原，界面不报错。
补丁文件不被改写（mtime 不变）。
使用同一批调用点的另外两条链路同样失效：profile 补丁热重载与插件启用/禁用，见 packages/boot/config-editor/src/index.ts:84,132,135、packages/boot/hmr/src/index.ts:230、packages/boot/plugin-manager/src/index.ts:764。

根因

mountRootInclude() 把「根 Include 条目」通过模块级状态（bootstrapIncludes，一个模块级 WeakMap）交给进程内其它消费者，因此这次交接只在运行它的那个模块实例内可见。
运行时解析表用 realpath 规范化了每个包目录（realModuleDirectory()），并且 installRuntimeInterception() 让每一次插件导入都从这些规范化路径解析。
Windows 上 realpath 返回的盘符是大写；而启动器自身的模块 URL 保留进程启动时的拼写 —— npm 生成的 shim 执行 node "$basedir/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js"，其中 $basedir 直接来自 PATH 项。
ESM 按解析后的 URL 字符串做模块缓存，于是 file:///d:/…/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js 与 file:///D:/…/dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js 是同一个文件的两个模块实例。启动器把 Include 记在小写实例的 bootstrapIncludes 里；而 dsh-config-editor、dsh-hmr、dsh-plugin-manager 经拦截（大写）导入，从大写实例调用 reconcileProfilePatches(ctx.root, …)，那张表是空的，于是命中 packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts:274-275 的抛错。
任何拼写差异都会造成同类分裂，尤其是 junction/软链路径与其真实路径 —— 本仓库自己就会为 profile link farm 建立这类链接，同样的方式也已实测到实例不等；盘符大小写只是普通 Windows 安装最容易撞上的那一种。
影响只限于「跨实例的模块级状态」，所以其它功能看起来完全正常：两套实例加载的是同样的文件、并通过 Cordis context 交互，被劈开的只有模块级注册表。

影响

所有设置写入被拒绝并静默回退，且不给用户任何错误提示，因此极难自诊断。
profile 补丁热重载与插件启用/禁用以同样方式失败。
触发条件很常见（Windows + npm 全局安装 + PATH 项盘符小写），而源码/开发运行拼写一致、永远复现不了，所以日常开发和 CI 都抓不到，只在打包安装形态暴露。

建议修法
把这次交接移出模块作用域，使其不再依赖模块身份：在 boot 时把根 Include 条目挂到 boot context 上（或挂到已经共享的 profileContext 服务上）携带，reconcileProfilePatches() 与 auditStartupEntries() 先读它、再回落到现有 WeakMap。这样无论进程里存在几个 dsh-app-boot 实例，交接都可见。同一文件 :607 的 assembledActivationRejections 是同类跨实例模块状态（fail-loud 审计使用），建议在同一轮一并迁移。
可选加固（二者择一即可）：构建解析表时沿用安装 anchor 的盘符拼写，而不是 realpath 的结果，使整个进程只保留一种拼写；或在拦截层 / Loader.import 导入前统一拼写规范化。
用户侧绕过

用大写盘符的完整路径直接启动 lib/bin.js（绕开 shim 的拼写），例如 node "D:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js" web。
或把 PATH 项的大小写改对：d:\...\npm → D:\...\npm，让 shim 传出大写路径。
也可以直接编辑 ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml 并重启，让某个偏好生效。

补充背景
这台机器上症状曾分成两段：写入先是卡在约 2 秒的锁超时（一次被中断的插件操作留下的孤儿 package.json.lock，与本问题无关）；清掉锁之后，失败立即变成上面描述的即时 settings/rejected。也就是说模块分裂从头到尾都在，只是先前被那把锁挡在前面。

threads.title: classifyPiAiError maps textual HTTP 5xx errors ("Internal Server Error") to non-retryable PI_AI_ERROR, skipping automatic retries
threads.bodyText:
Filing a bug report here per the README ("Submit feedback or bug reports through GitHub Discussions"). It concerns the error-classification layer of packages/llm/llm-pi-ai, which degrades the retry behavior of dsh-llm-retry for transient upstream 5xx failures.

Summary
When an upstream gateway answers a request with HTTP 500 and a plain-text body like Internal Server Error, the failure is classified as PI_AI_ERROR instead of SERVER. Since PI_AI_ERROR is not in DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES, dsh-llm-retry never retries it, and a transient 5xx that would self-heal under the SERVER code is surfaced to the user as a terminal "round failed" error banner.
Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-rc.1
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai 0.1.7-rc.1
@earendil-works/pi-ai 0.85.1
Route config: custom providers entries (api: openai-completions / openai-responses) behind gateways that return bare-text 5xx bodies.

What happens

Upstream returns HTTP 500 with body Internal Server Error (the default Express/Koa error text; no status digits in the body).
The user-facing failure reads 本轮运行失败 Internal Server Error with error code PI_AI_ERROR.
No retry is attempted although the route's retryPolicy is mode: normal.

Root cause (three compounding steps)


pi-ai drops the status digits on some paths. utils/error-body.js → formatProviderError composes three display shapes. On the messageCarriesBody happy path (SDK already folded the body into error.message) it returns norm.message unchanged — e.g. the bare string Internal Server Error — without a <status>: prefix, so no 5xx digits survive into the message DSH classifies.


classifyPiAiError only detects 5xx by digits. In packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:
if (/\b5\d\d\b/.test(message)) return "SERVER";
...
return "PI_AI_ERROR";
A message consisting of the words Internal Server Error contains no digits, so the SERVER branch never matches and the error falls through to the PI_AI_ERROR catch-all. The same applies to Bad Gateway, Service Unavailable, Gateway Timeout, etc.


The catch-all code is not retryable. packages/llm/llm/lib/types/retry-policy.js:
const DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES = Object.freeze([
    EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE, 'RATE_LIMIT', 'SERVER', 'TIMEOUT', 'TRANSPORT',
]);
PI_AI_ERROR is absent, so dsh-llm-retry (!policy.retryableCodes.includes(failure.code)) stops immediately — a transient upstream 5xx becomes a user-visible failure with zero retries.


Impact

Transient upstream 5xx errors that the retry layer exists to absorb are surfaced as terminal round failures.
The PI_AI_ERROR label is misleading during triage (it reads like a pi-ai internal fault while the real cause is an upstream 5xx).
Severity: medium-low. No data loss, but the retry mechanism silently degrades on exactly the failure class it is meant to handle. Users behind unstable third-party gateways see it often.

Suggested fix (either or both)


In classifyPiAiError, match standard HTTP status phrases:
if (/\b5\d\d\b|internal server error|bad gateway|service unavailable|gateway timeout/i.test(message)) return "SERVER";
(Optionally add /\b4\d\d\b|bad request/ coverage for INVALID_REQUEST in the same style.)


In pi-ai's formatProviderError, keep the status digits on the messageCarriesBody path (e.g. 500: Internal Server Error) so downstream classifiers always have the numeric status available.


Optionally, consider whitelisting PI_AI_ERROR in DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES — though classifying correctly (fix 1) is the more precise remedy.
Workaround (users, current version)
Add the catch-all code to the route's retryableCodes in the profile config (explicit lists replace the default, so include the defaults):
retryPolicy:
  mode: normal
  maxRetries: 5
  retryableCodes: [ EMPTY_RESPONSE, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT, PI_AI_ERROR ]
  backoff: { initialDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 10000, jitterRatio: 0.1 }
Evidence

Failure banner in the running session: 本轮运行失败 Internal Server Error — code PI_AI_ERROR, message with zero digits.
Classifier source: dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js classifyPiAiError (/\b5\d\d\b/ digit heuristic, catch-all return "PI_AI_ERROR").
Retry whitelist source: dsh-llm/lib/types/retry-policy.js DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES.
Error text composition source: @earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/utils/error-body.js formatProviderError / messageCarriesBody.

threads.title: [Bug Report] Windows: workspace ACL with Modify-only (no WRITE_OWNER) makes the ACL sandbox fail at init, disabling all shell tools
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On Windows, if the workspace directory's DACL grants the user only Modify
(no WRITE_OWNER), the ACL sandbox fails at initialization and every shell
tool call dies - not just a denied operation. The error message gives no hint of
the requirement.
The package README documents the requirement, but claims FullControl is "the
normal workspace case". On a normal data volume that assumption is wrong, so this
is a very easy trap to fall into right after upgrading.
Environment

Windows, account <user> - running with a non-elevated token
@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.1 (installed from npm, next tag), dsh web
Workspace: E:\<workspace> - an ordinary folder on a data volume
PowerShell execution policy RemoteSigned; session file policy workspace-write
Was on 0.1.5-rc.3 before the upgrade

Reproduction


Create a folder on a data volume (e.g. E:\<workspace>). It inherits from the
drive root:
E:\<workspace> BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
               NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)
               NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M)   <-- Modify only
               BUILTIN\Users:(I)(RX)

Note: no explicit ACE for the user account, and Modify does not include
WRITE_OWNER.


Start dsh web without elevation and connect the workspace.


Ask the agent to run any shell command.


Current behaviour
Every tool call fails immediately, before the command runs:
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(E:\<workspace>)

Win32 5 = ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED. Because the failure is in sandbox init, all
shell commands are unavailable (even netstat, icacls).
On 0.1.5-rc.3 the same setup worked, because the confinement was silently
skipped. So this is a regression introduced by the switch to fail-closed.
Root cause
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl applies the DACL grant and the low
integrity label in a single SetNamedSecurityInfoW call. Because the label
lives in the SACL, the call needs both:

WRITE_DAC (or ownership), and
WRITE_OWNER, which a Modify-only DACL does not grant.

Independently reproduced outside DSH: writing the DACL on E:\<workspace> from a
non-elevated PowerShell fails with the equivalent
UnauthorizedAccessException: Attempted to perform an unauthorized operation.
After granting the user explicit FullControl, everything works without elevation.
Things that do NOT fix it

takeown /F E:\<workspace> /R /D Y - makes the user the owner, but the owner's
implicit rights cover only READ_CONTROL + WRITE_DAC, not WRITE_OWNER.
icacls E:\<workspace> /reset /T /C - restores inheritance, which restores the
Modify-only ACE. Still fails.

Workaround that works
icacls "E:\<workspace>" /grant "<user>:(OI)(CI)F"
(Or run dsh from an elevated terminal.)
Expected behaviour
Either it should work on a stock workspace, or the failure should tell the user
exactly what to do.
Proposed improvements

Preflight the workspace DACL at startup. Detect the missing
WRITE_OWNER before the first tool call and either (a) offer to apply the
FullControl grant with consent, or (b) fail with an actionable message that
includes the exact icacls command.
Surface the requirement in user-facing docs. The constraint is currently
only in the package README's "Known Limitations", which nobody reads at the
moment the failure happens. A troubleshooting page for the Windows sandbox
would help.
Fix the README's assumption. "A directory whose DACL grants only Modify
now fails the grant loudly ... (a Full-control directory, the normal
workspace case, has it)". On a data volume, Authenticated Users:(M)
inherited from the drive root is the normal case, especially for non-admin
accounts with no explicit ACE of their own. The doc reads as if this were an
edge case; in practice it is the default.

Note
Verified on master that this limitation is still documented unchanged, and
pushed_at still equals the 0.1.7-rc.1 release time, so I'm reporting it as
still open rather than a duplicate of a fix in flight.
概要
Windows 上，如果工作区目录的 DACL 只给用户 Modify（不含 WRITE_OWNER），
ACL 沙箱会在初始化阶段失败，导致所有 shell 工具不可用——不是某次操作被拒。
而报错信息完全没有提示这个前提条件。
该约束写在包的 README 里，但其中声称 FullControl 是"工作区的常态"。在普通数据盘上
这个假设是错的，所以升级后极容易踩到。
环境

Windows，账户 <user>，以非提权令牌运行
@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.1（npm next 标签安装），dsh web
工作区 E:\<workspace>，数据盘上的普通文件夹
执行策略 RemoteSigned，会话文件策略 workspace-write
升级前为 0.1.5-rc.3

复现


在数据盘新建文件夹（如 E:\<workspace>），它从盘根继承：
E:\<workspace> BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)
               NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(F)
               NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M)   <-- 仅 Modify
               BUILTIN\Users:(I)(RX)

注意：没有针对用户账户的显式 ACE，且 Modify 不含 WRITE_OWNER。


不提权启动 dsh web 并连接该工作区。


让 agent 执行任意 shell 命令。


实际行为
每次工具调用都在命令真正执行前就失败：
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(E:\<workspace>)

Win32 5 = ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED。由于失败发生在沙箱初始化，所有 shell 命令
都不可用（连 netstat、icacls 都跑不了）。
在 0.1.5-rc.3 上同样的配置是正常的——因为当时沙箱会静默跳过限制。因此这是切换
到 fail-closed 之后引入的回归。
根因
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl 把 DACL 授权和低完整性标签放在同一次
SetNamedSecurityInfoW 调用里提交。因为标签位于 SACL，这次调用同时需要：

WRITE_DAC（或属主身份），以及
WRITE_OWNER —— 而仅有 Modify 的 DACL 不提供它。

在 DSH 之外独立复现：非提权 PowerShell 向 E:\<workspace> 写入 DACL，报等价的
UnauthorizedAccessException: Attempted to perform an unauthorized operation.。
给用户显式授予 FullControl 后，无需提权即可正常工作。
试过但无效的修法

takeown /F E:\<workspace> /R /D Y —— 用户成了属主，但属主只隐含
READ_CONTROL + WRITE_DAC，不含 WRITE_OWNER。
icacls E:\<workspace> /reset /T /C —— 恢复继承，也就恢复了"仅 Modify"的 ACE，依旧失败。

有效的绕过
icacls "E:\<workspace>" /grant "<user>:(OI)(CI)F"
（或在管理员终端里启动 dsh。）
期望行为
要么在普通工作区上直接可用，要么报错明确告诉用户该怎么做。
改进建议

启动时预检工作区 DACL：在首次工具调用前发现缺失的 WRITE_OWNER，要么（a）
征得同意后自动补上 FullControl 授权，要么（b）给出可执行的报错，直接附上那条
icacls 命令。
把该前提写进面向用户的文档：目前它只出现在包 README 的"已知限制"里，而故障
发生时没人会去翻那里。建议为 Windows 沙箱加一篇排障文档。
修正 README 的假设："(a Full-control directory, the normal workspace
case, has it)" —— 在数据盘上，从盘根继承来的 Authenticated Users:(M) 才是
常态，尤其是没有自身显式 ACE 的非管理员账户。文档读起来像是边缘情形，实际是默认
情形。

备注
已在 master 上确认该限制说明未变，且 pushed_at 仍等于 0.1.7-rc.1 的发布时间，
因此按"尚未修复"报告，而非重复报告在途修复。

threads.title: 复用会话 resume 时 persona prefix 的 {{model}}/{{cwd}} 无值（dsh web 重启后必现）
threads.bodyText:
现象
dsh web 重启后，复用既有会话的任务卡执行失败，报：
UNKNOWN
prompt variable "{{model}}" has no value for this assembly (section "deployment:persona-prefix")

同一个任务卡在重启之前可以正常执行。
环境



项
值




DSH
0.1.5-rc.2（@deepseek-ai/dsh-base / dsh-persona / dsh-agent-presets 均为 0.1.5-rc.2）


平台
Windows


相关插件
@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board（任务板，任务卡开启了「复用会话」reuseSession: true）


preset
自定义 agent preset，其 persona 的 prefix 里使用了 {{model}} 与 {{cwd}}



复现步骤

自定义一个 agent preset，persona 的 prefix 写成类似：
你是「X」，由 {{model}} 模型驱动。你的工作目录是 {{cwd}}。
建一个任务卡，开启「复用会话」，先让它成功执行一次（此时会话已存在）
重启 dsh web（该会话随之进入休眠）
再次触发这个任务卡（它会复用同一个会话）

期望
复用 / 恢复会话时，persona prefix 里的 {{model}}、{{cwd}} 能正常解析；或者变量取不到时优雅降级（省略该句）而不是中止启动。
实际
抛错并中断，agent 未启动。
⚠️ 另外注意一个可观测性问题：任务板把这次执行记录为 succeeded（大概是 prompt 投递成功即算成功），错误只发生在会话运行时。也就是说定时任务静默失效，从任务卡记录上完全看不出来。
观察与分析（不一定对，仅供参考）

dsh-agent-presets 生成的 preset 模板里带一行注释：
# '{{model}}' and '{{cwd}}' resolve from the agent's own route and workspace.
据此推测：resume 路径下 agent 的 route（模型路由）建立晚于 persona prefix 的渲染，变量在渲染时还没有值。
佐证：同一 preset 在新建会话路径下未见此错；差异只在 resume 时 preset 的重新挂载时机。
时间线证据（同一任务卡、同一会话）：

web 进程启动：当天 15:25
该任务卡最后一次成功：当天 13:00（在重启之前）
下一次触发：当天 19:00（重启之后）→ 失败，且会话日志文件有改动、但 executions 里没有新增记录（说明失败发生在很早期）



影响面
任何在 persona prefix 里使用 {{model}} / {{cwd}} 的 preset，只要遇到「web 重启过」+「复用/恢复既有会话」这个组合，就会失败。对长期复用同一会话的定时任务卡而言基本是必现的 —— 而这类场景恰恰是任务板的主用途。
本地规避方式
已把两个 preset 的 prefix 里的 {{model}} / {{cwd}} 换成固定文本（不再使用这两个变量），暂时绕开。
建议

变量取不到时优雅降级（例如 {{model}} 解析失败就省略该分句），而不是抛错终止整个 assembly；
或在 resume 路径上确保 route 就绪后再渲染 persona；
任务板侧：把「agent 启动失败」如实记为该次执行为失败，避免定时任务静默失效。

（如果 {{model}} / {{cwd}} 在 resume 场景下本来就不保证可用，那么文档里也许值得写明这一点 —— 我当初看模板注释以为两者总是可用的。）

dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate

static inject = ['agents','sessions','tools','storageDomain','sessionController','sessionPersistence']。

引入提交：7a362b263b（PR #4335 feat/schedule-storage-phase1）。
sessionController 全仓唯一提供者 packages/api/session-controller/src/index.ts:136，
只有 web bundle 挂：packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml:102-103；
grep -rn sessionController packages/bundle 在 base/tui-app 零命中。

（web-app/cordis.patch.yml:125-128，提交 cad6fef2fd）。仅手工在非 web profile 挂该行的用户中招。

(b) 若非 web 面也应可用：补等价 Session 恢复能力，或把 sessionController 改为可选注入；
不建议让用户自行补挂 @deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller——实测它自身
pending (waiting for services: fileUploads, workspaceRegistry)，需连带整串 web API 行。

threads.title: pnpm run clean fails on a clean checkout: clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types
threads.bodyText:
现象
干净检出上 pnpm run clean 直接失败（master 477b4f4205 ＝ tag dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2，macOS / node v24.19.0）：
$ tsx scripts/clean.ts
clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types: lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.

根因
scripts/clean.ts 的 buildOutputDirectories() 从根 tsconfig.json 沿 projectReferences 递归，要求每个 emitting 工程的 outDir 以 /types 结尾（唯一例外是 native/system/packages/entry/lib），否则抛错；而 tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json（由 tsconfig.client.json 引用）声明 "outDir": "lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types"，不满足该约定。
为何 CI 没拦住
全仓检索 .github/、scripts/、package.json、Makefile：没有任何 workflow 或脚本调用 pnpm run clean（它只出现在 AGENTS.md 的命令清单里），缺陷只在开发者手工清树时暴露。
建议修法（本分支已实现）
把该工程 outDir 改为 lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types/types，保持 clean 的单一约定不被放宽。全仓检索确认没有消费方读旧路径（grep -rn "desktop-keyboard-test-types" 只命中该 tsconfig 自己）。
备选修法：在 clean.ts 的例外表里显式登记该工程并注明理由（若维护者更想保留目录名）。不建议放宽成「任意 outDir 都接受」——那会削弱 clean 对未知产物的拒绝能力（该能力是清理陈旧包目录的前提）。
验证（本机实测，A/B）
在基于该 master 的独立 worktree 内跑真实脚本：

改前：tsx scripts/clean.ts → exit=1，stderr 即上面的报错（复现）；
改后：tsx scripts/clean.ts → clean: already clean，exit=0。

影响面
仅影响手工 pnpm run clean；不涉及构建产物布局的消费方（无引用），不阻断构建与门禁。
可直接拉取的改动
本仓库 Issues 已关闭，我也没有上游写权限，因此改动放在一个 fork 分支上（一行改动）：

分支：shujie2015-a11y/deepseek-harness → fix/clean-desktop-keyboard-outdir（commit 965b30959e）
拉取：git fetch https://github.com/shujie2015-a11y/deepseek-harness fix/clean-desktop-keyboard-outdir
网页开 PR：https://github.com/shujie2015-a11y/deepseek-harness/pull/new/fix/clean-desktop-keyboard-outdir

（我这边用 API 建 PR 被拒：GraphQL CreatePullRequest permission denied、REST 404。原因无法从 API 区分是「仓库限制外部 PR」还是「账号受限」；若维护者接受外部 PR，这条分支即为现成改动，分支上 pnpm run typecheck 与 pre-push 钩子均通过。）

threads.title: Bug: SessionFormatError "format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind" - agent turns intermittently fail (core 0.1.7-rc.1)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Agent turns intermittently fail with SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind when the session persistence layer encodes an event. The session itself survives (later turns succeed), but the failed turn is lost and automatic title generation + projection cache writes also fail.
Environment

DSH Desktop 2.0.14 (dsh-plugin-desktop), core 0.1.7-rc.1
Windows 11 x64, Node v24.18.1
Session storage: session.v4.jsonl.zstd (v4 format, zstd-compressed)

Symptom (host log)
[E] [dsh-agent-error] agent turn failed (session <id>, turn N, step 0/1): format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
[E] [dsh-agent-error] SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
    at source (…/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:126:144)
    at assertV4SourceRowAdmission (…/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:150:71)
    at assertV4RowAdmission (…/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:1112:2)
    at Object.encodeEvent (…/dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:1097:3)
    at eventLine (… dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:955:45)
    at eventLines (…/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:947:16)
    at Proxy.encodeEventBatch (…/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:3196:16)
    at Object.apply (…/cordis/lib/index.js:120:36)
    at Proxy.appendLines (…/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:3216:30)

Followed by:
[W] [session-title-service] automatic title generation failed: SessionFormatError: format v4 message requires a producer-owned source kind
[W] [session-projection-cache] session projection cache: turn/end write failed (cache stays stale): SessionFormatError: …

Observations

Occurs on random hints of a random turn: in one session turns 1–3 (first hints right after session creation), then the same session works fine for many turns; in another session turns 10–11 failed, and the surrounding turns succeeded. It is not deterministic, and no single message type in the session log obviously differs from successful turns.
Also reproduced on a session whose first turn failed with MISSING_CREDENTIAL (user had picked the deepseek-official provider without an API key configured): the failed turn's error-report write then hit the same SessionFormatError, masking the primary cause.
Same core behavior in two independent runs of DSH Desktop 2.0.14 (core 0.1.7-rc.1).

Analysis / hypothesis
The error is raised by source() in dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4/lib/index.js:

assertV4SourceRowAdmission (line ~142) only throws for messages whose source.kind === "plugin" (retired v3 wrapper syntax);
assertV4MessageSources (line ~132) requires every durable message to have a non-empty source.kind that is not "plugin".

So at least one event being encoded contains a message with source.kind === "plugin" (or an empty/missing source) — most likely the agent-error report message written by dsh-agent-error (or an inbox splice produced by a plugin) which still uses the retired v3 { kind: "plugin", plugin: "…" } shape. Because the failure happens inside encodeEventBatch, the whole batch write fails and the primary turn error is swallowed (the log shows only the SessionFormatError, no earlier [E]).
Expected behavior

A turn that fails for a real reason (network, missing credential, etc.) should record its error message in the session log even when that message originates from a plugin producer; the v4 admission check should either accept/adopt plugin-produced error messages or explicitly surface the offending event (seq + type) so the primary error is not masked.
At minimum, the diagnostic should name the event/seq that failed admission instead of failing the whole batch silently.

Notes

This is a release-candidate core (0.1.7-rc.1); happy to provide the zstd session file that reproduces it on request (it contains no credentials; provider names and session ids can be redacted).
Search of existing issues found no prior report for SessionFormatError / "producer-owned source kind".

threads.title: workspace-write sandbox fails entirely on Windows when the workspace grants no WRITE_OWNER (SetNamedSecurityInfoW error 5)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On Windows, after upgrading 0.1.5-rc.3 → 0.1.7-rc.2, every shell command fails before it
runs, and the workflow tool dies with the same error:
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\develop\dsh)
Error: workflow run failed: workflow execution failed (worker-exit):
       SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\develop\dsh)

The workspace is an ordinary directory: owned by the user, whose Modify comes from an
inherited Authenticated Users ACE. Inherited Modify does not include WRITE_OWNER, and
0.1.7's grantWrite now needs it — it writes a Low mandatory label into the object's SACL. One
missing right aborts the whole grant, so the sandbox never comes up and the command never starts.
Giving the workspace WRITE_OWNER fixes it completely, which is why this looks like a
precondition that was added without a fallback rather than a fundamental design problem.
Environment

Windows 11 (Chinese locale); Windows PowerShell 5.1 (no PowerShell 7 on this machine); Node v24.15.0
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-rc.2 (npm tag next), profile web, file policy workspace-write (default)
Workspace D:\develop\dsh on an NTFS data volume
The same workspace and the same user worked normally on 0.1.5-rc.3

Reproduction

Start dsh web on Windows with the default workspace-write policy.
Ask the agent to run any pwsh command (even pwd).
Every call fails immediately with SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(<workspace>).
workflow fails with the worker exiting on the same error.
In-process tools are unaffected — read / write / edit / glob / grep, subagent,
web_fetch / web_search all work. Only the paths that confine a child process break.

What was measured
Workspace DACL (icacls D:\develop\dsh):
D:\develop\dsh S-1-4-60725554-498175233:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)   <- capability ACE left by an earlier DSH run
               BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F) ...
               NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(I)(M)     <- where this user's Modify comes from
               BUILTIN\Users:(I)(RX) ...

Note what is missing: there is no Mandatory Label line, i.e. the Low label was never applied,
and no explicit WRITE_OWNER for the user. The inherited Modify ACE carries the (I) flag, so it
comes from a parent (on this machine the data volume's default permissions).
Isolation, same non-elevated token, scratch directory:



Operation
Result




icacls <dir> /setintegritylevel Low
Access is denied, exit 5


icacls <dir> /grant "*S-1-5-11:(W)" (DACL only)
exit 0


icacls <dir> /grant "<user>:(WO)" then /setintegritylevel Low
exit 0, Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(NW) appears



So the DACL edit is permitted and only the label edit is refused — which is exactly the merge that
grantWrite performs in one SetNamedSecurityInfoW call.
After granting WRITE_OWNER, everything recovers:
1) command runs            OK
2) workspace write/read/delete   ok
3) sandboxed child         integrity = Low Mandatory Level (S-1-16-4096), 1 privilege
4) DSH applied the label   Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)
5) workflow smoke test     {"workflowOk": true}
6) background job          completed, exit 0

Root cause
dsh-sandbox-windows-acl, grantWrite() merges three edits into a single
SetNamedSecurityInfoW(path, 1, SecurityInfo, null, null, dacl, label) call where
SecurityInfo = 20 (DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION | LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION). The package's own
comment states the precondition (lib/types-DxezulnA.js, above grantWrite):

The directory must be owned by the caller AND grant WRITE_OWNER (the label lives in the
SACL; owner-implicit rights cover only READ_CONTROL and WRITE_DAC) — a Full-control workspace
satisfies both.

"Owned by the caller plus inherited Modify" is not enough, and that combination is common:
a directory created by another tool, or one inheriting the data volume's default ACL, looks
perfectly writable to the user and still fails this precondition.
This is a regression from the 0.1.7 sandbox hardening ("fix Windows sandbox deletions escaping
the authorized directory", 0.1.7-alpha.1): 0.1.5-rc.3 wrote the DACL only. The leftover capability
ACE in the DACL above, with no matching label, is the fossil of a successful old-style grant —
which is why the same machine worked before the upgrade.
Suggested fixes

Make the failure actionable. Win32 5 on grantWrite(<path>) gives a user no way to know
that WRITE_OWNER is the missing right. Naming the right and the path (and that the sandbox
therefore cannot start) would have saved a long diagnosis.
Degrade instead of aborting. If WRITE_OWNER is unavailable, applying the DACL without the
label still yields a working sandbox, exactly as 0.1.5-rc.3 did. Losing one hardening measure
is strictly better than losing every command.
Or acquire the right first. The owner can always grant itself WRITE_OWNER (WRITE_DAC is
owner-implicit), so grantWrite could add the missing ACE before applying the label — no admin
rights needed, as the workaround below shows.
Whichever is chosen, the Windows precondition belongs in the docs: an agent workspace must grant
the user Full control, or at least WRITE_OWNER.

Workaround (applied locally)
icacls <workspace> /grant "<user>:(OI)(CI)(WO)"
No elevation required. After this, the default workspace-write policy works again and DSH applies
its Low label itself. It has to be repeated for every workspace whose Modify is inherited, and
again after an ACL reset (e.g. a fresh clone or a restored directory).
Related

#1312 titles a "pwsh sandbox grantWrite failure", but its details live in an inaccessible
.docx attachment and its two comments only cover the subagent-model request. Mentioning it in
case maintainers know whether it describes this same precondition — if so these could be merged.
Other Windows ACL sandbox reports: #401, #423, #469, #3434, #3430.

Happy to test a patch on this machine (0.1.7-rc.2, PowerShell 5.1, secondary NTFS volume) — the
failure reproduces every time.

threads.title: 缺陷报告：SenseVoice 本地模型下载失败 —— Host 未跟随 HTTP 重定向（308 / 302）
threads.bodyText:
摘要
在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版中启用「语音输入」Bundle 并准备 SenseVoice 本地模型时，下载固定失败：
无法下载 model.int8.onnx：下载服务返回 HTTP 308。
下载来源：https://hf-mirror.com

hf-mirror.com 与 huggingface.co 都会把 resolve/<revision>/<file> 重定向到实际 CDN。报错说明 Host 进程收到的就是一个 308 响应，重定向没有被跟随。同一台机器、同一网络下，curl、Node v24.9.0、Node v24.20.0、undici 8.10/8.11 均能正常跟随并下载成功，因此问题定位在 Harness 侧的出站 HTTP 行为。
影响：所有走 HTTP 重定向的模型下载资源都无法通过 Harness 自身的下载通道获取（至少包括 SenseVoice INT8 与 Silero VAD）。用户只能手动放置文件绕过。

环境



项
值




产品
DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 0.1.7-rc.2（玲珑包 com.deepseek.dsh-desktop）


Host 启动方式
<prefix>/node/bin/node <prefix>/harness/lib/bin.js web --patch <overlay> --port 34563（见 apps/desktop-launcher/internal/appenv/env.go:55-68）


Host Node
v24.9.0（随包，内置 undici 7.16.0）


harness 自带 undici
8.11.0（harness/node_modules/undici）


系统
Deepin 25


代理
Clash Verge Rev / mihomo v1.19.21；mixed-port: 7897、allow-lan: false、TUN 开启（gvisor、auto-route）


网络命名空间
容器与宿主共享，127.0.0.1:7897 直达，DNS 走 fake-ip（198.18.0.0/15 路由至 TUN）




代理配置本身已确认正常：curl https://www.google.com、git ls-remote https://github.com/git/git、npm registry、node -e "fetch(...)" 全部成功。


复现步骤

插件页启用「语音输入」Bundle（组件：dsh-experimental-speech-to-text、-speech-to-text-sensevoice、-api-speech-to-text、-client-ui-voice-input）。
在 Bundle 详情点击「下载并准备」（或失败后点「重试准备」）。
观察结果。

期望：模型下载并校验通过，状态变为「本地语音已就绪」。
实际：准备失败 —— 无法下载 model.int8.onnx：下载服务返回 HTTP 308。下载来源：https://hf-mirror.com

证据
1. 服务端行为完全正常
资源固定 URL（来自 packages/experimental/speech-to-text-sensevoice/runtime/assets.json）：
https://huggingface.co/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-2024-07-17/resolve/2365baeacb507f821a0c8120fcee3d484dba7a07/model.int8.onnx

两个源的重定向链（curl -D -，不跟随 vs curl -L 跟随）：



源
首跳
第二跳
跟随到底




huggingface.co
302 → us.aws.cdn.hf.co
—
200 / 206


hf-mirror.com
308 → huggingface.co 同路径
302 → us.aws.cdn.hf.co
200 / 206



curl -L：num_redirects=2，最终 206（带 Range）。
请求头变体测试（默认 / accept-encoding: gzip, deflate, br / Chrome UA / Range: bytes=0- / Accept: */* / 去掉 UA）全部稳定返回 308 且带 Location，排除了 UA 或请求头导致响应差异的可能。
2. UI 的「下载来源」字段证明重定向未发生
packages/experimental/speech-to-text-sensevoice/src/runtime.ts:114-119：
const response = await fetch(asset.url, { signal })
source = new URL(response.url || asset.url).origin
if (!response.ok || !response.body) {
  await response.body?.cancel()
  throw new SpeechDownloadError({ resource: asset.name, source, reason: 'http', status: response.status })
}
source 取自 response.url。UI 显示 下载来源：https://hf-mirror.com，而报错 reason: 'http'、status: 308 —— 二者结合说明：

fetch 返回了一个响应（不是抛网络异常）；
该响应的 status === 308，且 response.url 仍停留在 hf-mirror.com，即重定向没有发生。

3. 两个源都失败，UI 显示的是最后一个错误
runtime.ts:161-174 按源逐个重试，并且抛出最后一个错误：
const urls = await orderModelSources(asset.url, origins, config.modelProbeTimeoutMs, signal)
for (const [index, url] of urls.entries()) {
  try {
    await downloadAsset({ ...asset, url }, root, signal, ...)
    return
  } catch (error) {
    if (signal.aborted || !(error instanceof SpeechDownloadError) || error.download.reason === 'storage'
      || error.download.reason === 'unknown' || index === urls.length - 1) throw error
  }
}
代理侧日志（mihomo /logs 实时流）在点击「重试准备」窗口内捕获到：
[TCP] 127.0.0.1:<port> --> hf-mirror.com:443    match Match using <节点>
[TCP] 127.0.0.1:<port> --> huggingface.co:443   match Match using <节点>

两个域名都被成功请求——证明网络链路完全通畅；也印证了 HF（302）与 hf-mirror（308）两个源都失败，UI 呈现的是顺序上最后一个（hf-mirror）的错误。
4. 命令行无法复现（关键对照）
同一台机器、同一容器、同一 Clash、同一 URL：



客户端
结果




curl -L
200 / 206，redirected ✅


Node v24.9.0（与 Host 同版本）内置 fetch
status=200、redirected=true、url=us.aws.cdn.hf.co ✅


Node v24.20.0 内置 fetch
同上 ✅


npm undici 8.10.0 / 8.11.0 的 fetch
同上 ✅


先调用 installProxyFromEnvironment() 装好全局 dispatcher，再 fetch
同上 ✅


fetch(url, { redirect: 'manual' }) 对照
status=308、redirected=false、url=hf-mirror.com ← 与产品表现逐字吻合



即：产品表现等价于在 Host 进程内以 redirect: 'manual' 发起了请求。

分析
服务端链路正常，客户端链路正常，差异只存在于 Harness 完整进程内。而语音包本身使用裸全局 fetch，未引入任何 fetch 封装或 redirect 覆盖：

源码：runtime.ts:114 → await fetch(asset.url, { signal })
打包产物核对（dsh-experimental-speech-to-text-sensevoice/lib/index.js:266）与源码一致
该包 dependencies 不含 dsh-web-fetch-http 等封装包，无 import ... as fetch 绑定
打包 harness 全树搜索 globalThis.fetch =：无命中

因此需要排查在完整 Harness 启动后，globalThis.fetch 的行为为何退化为不跟随重定向。
待验证线索（均已定位到代码，但尚未证实因果）
线索 A —— setGlobalDispatcher 作用的 undici 与 globalThis.fetch 使用的 undici 可能不是同一份。
packages/util/http-proxy/src/install.ts 通过 await import('undici') 动态导入：
const { getGlobalDispatcher, setGlobalDispatcher } = await import('undici')
...
setGlobalDispatcher(agent)

Host 的 globalThis.fetch 使用 Node 内置 undici 7.16.0；
打包 harness 内 import('undici') 解析到 自带 node_modules/undici 8.11.0。

两者是不同的模块实例，其「全局 dispatcher」状态很可能并不共享。若成立，则 installProxyFromEnvironment() 的安装对 globalThis.fetch 无效（这本身也是一个独立缺陷，与本次重定向问题可能相关也可能无关）。建议先确认该假设是否成立。
线索 B —— 是否存在插件在 Host 侧包装 globalThis.fetch。
仓库内已知存在一处替换：packages/experimental/webworker-runtime/src/polyfill/async-context/async-context-hooks.ts:69：
globalThis.fetch = ((input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> => {
  const snapshot = captureAsyncContext()
  if (snapshot === undefined) return nativeFetch(input, init)
  ...
})
该实现透传 init，理论上不影响 redirect；但需要确认它在 Host 进程中的实际加载范围，以及是否存在其它未纳入搜索的包装点（如打包拼装、动态 import）。
线索 C —— 出站请求策略是否被统一收口。
packages/web/web-fetch-http/lib/index.js:163,197 使用 redirect: "manual"（这是为 web_fetch 工具做 SSRF 防护的主动设计）。需要确认该策略是否通过某个公共出站入口被扩展到其它调用方。

建议的最小复现
在 Harness Host 进程内（而非外部 shell）执行：
const u = 'https://hf-mirror.com/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-2024-07-17/resolve/2365baeacb507f821a0c8120fcee3d484dba7a07/model.int8.onnx'
const r = await fetch(u)
console.log(r.status, r.redirected, r.url)

期望：200 true https://us.aws.cdn.hf.co/...
若得到：308 false https://hf-mirror.com/... → 复现成功

同时建议打印 globalThis.fetch === (await import('undici')).fetch 与 (await import('undici')).getGlobalDispatcher() === /* Node 内置 dispatcher */ 的对比结果，用于验证线索 A。

影响范围

所有依赖出站重定向的资源下载都会失败。已确认受影响：SenseVoice model.int8.onnx（239 MB，308）、tokens.txt、silero_vad.onnx（1.8 MB）。
未验证但存在同样风险的：model.onnx（FP32，937 MB）等其它走 Hugging Face resolve 路径的资源。
不限于代理环境：无论走代理由还是 TUN 直连，只要服务端返回重定向就会触发。

临时绕过（已验证可行）
模型就绪判定只校验文件大小 + sha256（runtime.ts:40-53），手动放置文件即可跳过下载：



目标路径
大小
sha256




~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice/models/sensevoice-onnx/model.int8.onnx
239233841
c71f0ce00bec95b07744e116345e33d8cbbe08cef896382cf907bf4b51a2cd51


~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice/models/sensevoice-onnx/tokens.txt
315894
f449eb28dc567533d7fa59be34e2abca8784f771850c78a47fb731a31429a1dc


~/.dsh/speech-to-text/sensevoice/models/silero/silero_vad.onnx
1807522
