用 curl -L（能正确跟随重定向）下载即可；放置后点「重试准备」会直接校验通过并显示「本地语音已就绪」。

附：本次未改动的说明
排查过程未修改任何 Harness 源码、配置或代理设置；仅新增了上述三个模型缓存文件（约 229 MB）。临时脚本与后台任务均已清理。

threads.title: Session unloadable: v1→v2 migration rejects `assistant/message` 4060703 — declared 874 source refs vs 873 reconstructed (range starts on a `session/end-seed`)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
A long-running session (461 turns, 170,416 records) can no longer be observed/loaded. The v1→v2 session-format migration refuses it because exactly one assistant/message cites a source-event range that starts one event earlier than the first chunk event the migration reconstructs for that attempt.

assistant/message seq=4060703 (turn 450, step 24) declares sourceEventSeqs: [[4059829, 4060702]] → 874 references.
The migration reconstructs 873 chunk events for that attempt: 4059830 … 4060702.
The single extra reference, seq 4059829, is not a chunk event in this file — it is a session/end-seed record ({"type":"session/end-seed","seq":4059829,"time":1788954489814,"data":{}}).

The session data itself looks intact (no records lost; see measurements). I would like to recover this session, and I would like to know whether this is a writer bug, a migration-strictness bug, or both. Full diagnosis below; I am happy to send the file or a redacted extract.
Error
Surfaced by the desktop client when opening the session:
历史加载失败：failed to observe session "session-ec57579b-8cb9-4b35-aa37-fe36c235e5eb":
assistant/message 4060703 chunk references are not one complete ordered attempt;
source v0 artifact remains unchanged
(raw log: C:\Users\34745\.dsh\sessions\--D-Users-34745-Desktop-github-deepseek-aideepseek-harness--\session-ec57579b-8cb9-4b35-aa37-fe36c235e5eb\session.jsonl.zstd)
(gateway/internal)

Where the refusal is thrown
In the installed desktop build (bundled runtime, see Environment):

Module: dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v1-to-v2/lib/index.js inside app.asar
(asar-relative file offset 49,821,697, size 33,614; the migration bundle is also present in dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/worker.cjs)
function transformMessage at asar byte 53,212,045 (≈ line 518 of the module)
the refusal template chunk references are not one complete ordered attempt at asar byte 53,213,008 (≈ line 539)
function matchesChunkSources at asar byte 53,217,517 (≈ line 672)

if (pending === void 0 || !matchesChunkSources(pending.group, sources))
  throw refusal(`assistant/message ${event.seq} chunk references are not one complete ordered attempt`);
...
function matchesChunkSources(group, sources) {
  if (sources.length !== group.chunkCount) return false;
  let index = 0;
  for (const span of group.spans)
    for (let offset = 0; offset < span.eventCount; offset += 1) {
      if (sources[index] !== span.firstSeq + offset) return false;
      index += 1;
    }
  return true;
}
Span accounting is built by transformChunk (one assistant/chunk event → recordChunkSpan(group, event.seq, 1, …)), by transformReleasedRun (a released compacted run → recordChunkSpan(group, run.firstSeq, run.eventCount, …)), and merged in recordChunkSpan; finishAttempt / flushAccumulator / appendStreamRecord are the adjacent paths. So chunkCount/spans describe the chunk events of the attempt, and matchesChunkSources requires the declared sourceEventSeqs to equal that list exactly — same length, same order, no extra member.
Because the throw is immediate and messages are processed in order, the error naming seq=4060703 also means every earlier assistant/message in this 170k-record file passed the same check.
Environment



item
value




DSH desktop
installed build 0.1.7-rc.2 (from resources/runtime/primary-runtime/runtime.json → desktopVersion, and app.asar → dsh/package.json → @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime@0.1.7-rc.2)


session-format package
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-format-v1-to-v2@0.1.7-rc.2 (declared in the same dsh/package.json)


update channel
nightly, https://download.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/feeds/win-x64/ (resources/app-update.yml)


bundled runtime
Node 24.21.0, pnpm 11.7.0, Python 3.12.14, win32 x64


OS
Windows x64



Unverified / caveat: the installed application files are dated 2026-09-24, while the session was written on 2026-09-09/10, so I cannot confirm which build produced the file or threw the original error. The refusal text and the code above match the installed 0.1.7-rc.2 bundle verbatim, but I could not find any build/version stamp for the writing run (the session projection cache only carries its own "version": 5). If you need the exact writing build I will dig further — tell me what identifier to look for.
Happy to provide anything else you need (dsh version output, full log lines, the decoded JSONL, app.asar extraction).
Session

File: …\session-ec57579b-8cb9-4b35-aa37-fe36c235e5eb\session.jsonl.zstd
Compressed 27,245,912 B, mtime 2026-09-10 17:41:51 (+08:00); decodes cleanly with zstd -d (exit 0, no truncation warning) to 165,369,254 B / 170,416 JSONL records.
Header record: {"type":"session","version":0,"id":"session-ec57579b-…","createdAt":1786824256927,"cwd":"D:\\Users\\34745\\Desktop\\github\\deepseek-aideepseek-harness","delegationDepth":0,"agentPreset":"standard"} → source format v0.
Events span 2026-08-15T20:04:16.975Z → 2026-09-10T09:41:51.990Z; 461 turns, 9,042 step/start events, 43 session/end-seed boundaries, 119 compactions.

Measurements



metric
value




records
170,416


records with top-level seq
109,804 distinct, range 0 … 4,125,203


records without top-level seq
60,612 — of which 60,611 carry seq0 (the other is the session header)


seq numbers absent from [0, 4,125,203]
4,015,400, all inside ranges covered by the seq0 compact records (18,192 gap runs)


assistant/message records
8,970


… that satisfy the check
8,969


… that fail the check
1 — seq=4060703, turn 450 step 24


declared refs for 4060703
874 ([[4059829, 4060702]])


reconstructed refs (spans / chunkCount)
873 (4059830 … 4060702)


extra declared ref
4059829 = session/end-seed, data: {}



The 873 decomposes as 12 explicit assistant/chunk events plus 861 seq numbers inside 18 compact records (reasoning-chunks / text-chunks / tool-call-chunks) for that step, which transformReleasedRun folds into the attempt.
How I obtained the 8,969 / 1 split (so you can judge it): I decoded the JSONL and re-implemented the span accounting and matchesChunkSources in a script, treating each compact *-chunks record as one released run spanning [seq0, seq0 + payloadCount). Merging adjacent spans in recordChunkSpan makes any grouping of adjacent records equivalent, but I did not inspect the v0→v1 stage, so the exact run boundaries it produces are unverified. I could not execute the shipped migration directly. The conclusion that all earlier messages pass does not depend on that emulation: the migration throws on the first offending message and reports 4060703.
Avoidable red herring
Counting only materialised assistant/chunk events understates every attempt in this file, because most deltas live in the compact seq0 records. For the failing step that count is 12 against 874 declared; for a passing step such as turn 1 step 2 it is 8 against 128 declared. Those large ratios are expected and are not the defect.
What is actually different in this file
Immediately around the failing attempt (records in file order):
assistant/chunk     seq=4059823  turn 450 step 23  block-end
assistant/message   seq=4059824  turn 450 step 23  sourceEventSeqs=[[4059746, 4059823]]   ← passes
tool/call           seq=4059825
tool/result         seq=4059826
step/end            seq=4059827
turn/end            seq=4059828
session/end-seed    seq=4059829  data {}
assistant/chunk     seq=4059830  turn 450 step 24  reasoning-delta  ("结果")
reasoning-chunks    seq0=4059831 … (18 compact records through 4060697)
assistant/chunk     seq=4060698..4060702  block-end ×3, usage, finish
assistant/message   seq=4060703  turn 450 step 24  sourceEventSeqs=[[4059829, 4060702]]     ← refused

Observations for this attempt, all measured:

there is no step/start record for turn 450 step 24 anywhere in the file;
there is no block-start chunk for the reasoning block — the attempt opens with reasoning-delta at 4059830;
seq 4059829 is occupied by the session/end-seed;
the declared range nonetheless starts at 4059829.

session/end-seed is the only record type in this file that any assistant/message cites as a source event: across all 8,970 messages, exactly one declared reference (this one) is not part of a chunk event.
The declared range is identical in the pre-existing sibling snapshot (below), which is consistent with the range having been written while 4059829 was still the attempt's block-start and not rewritten when that position became the seed. I have not verified the write order — flagging it as an inference, not a measurement.
Control: the older sibling snapshot does not fail
Sibling session.jsonl.zstd.orig53.bak (53,117,939 B, mtime 2026-09-09 22:12:18) decodes to 164,062,629 B / 168,477 records. Same encoding shape (60,611 compact seq0 records, 17,990 gap runs, first run 24..386, 8,932 assistant/message). It contains the same assistant/message at seq=4060703 with the same sourceEventSeqs=[[4059829, 4060702]], and under the same re-implementation 0 messages fail.
The difference at the boundary (both files order records identically before it):




backup
current




seq 4059828
step/start turn 450 step 24
absent


seq 4059829
session/end-seed and assistant/chunk (block-start, turn 450 step 24)
session/end-seed only


re-used top-level seq values
4
0


result of the check on 4060703
passes
refused



So in the backup the replay after the seed re-establishes the attempt's block-start at 4059829 and the declared range is exactly satisfied; in the current file the attempt opens at 4059830 while the declaration still starts at 4059829.
Minimal reproduction
I do not have a minimal repro file yet. What I can offer instead, on request:

a redacted extract around seq 4059740…4060710 (the seed boundary plus the whole failing attempt), which I expect is enough to reproduce the refusal;
the failing assistant/message / session/end-seed / assistant/chunk lines verbatim;
the decoded JSONL (165 MB) or a filtered slice;
the full session file (session.jsonl.zstd, 27 MB) if you would rather have the original.

I have not uploaded anything: this is a private long-running session, so I hesitated to publish it. Tell me which artefact you want, and the smallest one that would let you reproduce this, and I will send it.
Ask
The session data looks intact — nothing else in the file is inconsistent, and the mismatch is a single one-event offset — and I would like to get this session loadable again. Questions, in priority order:

Recovery. Is there a supported way to recover a session that is already unloadable: a repair/dsh-side command, a re-migration flag, a documented procedure to fix one sourceEventSeqs value inside the .zstd JSONL — or should I hand this file to you? I would rather not hand-edit a session store without guidance.
Intended contract. Is sourceEventSeqs meant to list only chunk events of the attempt, or may it also include non-chunk neighbours such as the session/end-seed boundary? If the latter is allowed, should matchesChunkSources compare against the chunk subset instead of requiring exact list equality?
Writer. Is the current file's state — seed at the attempt's first-chunk seq, no step/start and no reasoning block-start for that step, no replayed tail — an expected outcome of a seeded/resumed generation that continues the previous generation's seq numbering, or a sign that the attempt head was lost? Related: could sourceEventSeqs have been computed from a pre-seed / pre-compaction chunk layout that the file no longer matches? I have not verified which component wrote 4059829, so I am phrasing this as a question.
Blast radius. This file has one occurrence in 8,970 messages. Is the "declared range starts on the boundary event" pattern known to occur elsewhere, or would a targeted guard in the migration plus a writer-side assertion be the right shape of fix?

threads.title: 求教：切换对话模型时，web_search 能否也使用对应模型进行搜索？
threads.bodyText:
背景
本人算是AI小白，直至最近才开始使用 Agent 尝鲜。这周 Space Bunny Alpha 在 OpenCode 上可以免费用了，我就在 DSH 中接入了这个模型。
但使用过程中发现：即使当前对话使用的是 Space Bunny Alpha，DSH 的 web_search 仍然会触发 DeepSeek API 请求。删除 DeepSeek API Key 后，搜索工具会返回 401 错误。
通过和模型对话了解到的调用链是：
Agent 调用 web_search
  -> ctx.web.search()
  -> deepseek-official provider
  -> 使用 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
  -> POST https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages
  -> 请求 DeepSeek 原生 web_search 能力
  -> 返回搜索结果

同时，在相同环境中：
web_search -> 401
web_fetch  -> 正常

这说明 DSH 的搜索 provider 和抓取 provider 是两条独立路径，问题主要出在搜索 provider 的配置或凭据上。
DSH 当前的 DeepSeek 搜索 provider 文档也说明，它会复用 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并将搜索请求发送到独立的 Anthropic-compatible /messages endpoint。搜索请求使用独立的搜索模型，并不自动继承当前对话模型。
我希望的是：
使用 DeepSeek 对话
  -> 使用 DeepSeek 自己的 web_search

使用 Space Bunny Alpha 对话
  -> 使用 Space Bunny Alpha 对应的 web_search

也就是说，切换对话模型时，网页搜索能力也应该跟随模型切换，而不是所有模型都固定使用一个全局的 deepseek-official provider。
模型也给出一些配置：
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: brave
来替换搜索 provider。但这只能把所有会话的搜索统一切换到 Brave，并不能实现：
DeepSeek 会话 -> DeepSeek Search
Space Bunny Alpha 会话 -> Space Bunny Search

我目前看到的一些社区方案，例如：

dsh-free-search
dsh-web-search-brave
dsh-searxng-web
dsh-web-search-pro
dsh-web-tools
dsh-web-search-aggregation

主要解决的是“替换全局搜索后端”或“多引擎聚合”，并不完全符合我想要的“按当前对话模型选择对应搜索能力”。
这时候我比较好奇在 OpenCode 里面直接使用 Space Bunny Alpha，web_search 的调用链是什么，模型分析它的调用链可能是：
Space Bunny Alpha
  -> 决定调用 websearch
  -> OpenCode Host 收到工具调用
  -> OpenCode 调用自己的托管搜索服务
  -> Exa 或 Parallel 搜索
  -> 搜索结果返回给 Space Bunny Alpha
  -> Space Bunny Alpha 生成最终回答

并且 OpenCode 官方文档也说 web_search 仅在 OpenCode 本身使用

所以我的理解是：OpenCode 的 websearch 可能是客户端内部工具，外部无法直接获取它的搜索 endpoint，因此 DSH 不能简单复用这个工具。
提问
所以 DSH 中能否通过插件，来为每个会话配置对应的 WebSearchProvider 吗🤔？比如接入 OpenCode 就用 OpenCode 的 API KEY，接入 GLM 就用 GLM 的 API KEY。
并且我还注意到之前在 ZCode、Codex 上使用 DeepSeek 的时候，也不需要填入 GLM 和 GPT 的 API KEY 就能调用 web_search。但是反过来就不太行了🤔。

threads.title: [Bug] dsh-client-ui-workspace: 持久化视图状态缺一个字段即导致 sidebar.workspaces 插槽渲染崩溃（会话列表空白且零报错）
threads.bodyText:
症状（人话版）
打开应用后左侧会话列表整列空白，界面和 host 日志都不报任何错误。排查后发现数据其实一直好好的——215 个会话全部完好、也全部送达了界面。真正的问题是：侧边栏在渲染时崩了。本地保存的"视图状态"少了一个字段，官方代码对这个字段直接做遍历，一崩整个列表插槽就消失，且不留任何痕迹。这是它难排查的原因。
环境

DSH Desktop 2.0.13（harness 0.1.5-rc.2），Windows 11 Pro 25H2 x64
会话数据约 215 条（v0/v3 格式混合），用 DSH 自带 JsonlSessionPersistence 离线实测 100% 可读

证据链

离线用自带持久化代码跑 list()：215 条全部返回 → 数据层正常；
host 日志（logs/host/）无任何 session 相关错误；--dump-config 合成树里会话链路插件全部正常挂载；
以 --remote-debugging-port=9333 启动并附加 CDP，抓到渲染进程控制台反复报错：
slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces': TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object
    at Object.entries at retainAccountKeys ...


CDP 读取 localStorage 的 dsh.workspace.view.v5，确认只有 groupBy/orderBy/groupExpansion/sessionOrderByAccount 4 个字段，缺 sessionUpdatedAtByAccount；
给该键补上 "sessionUpdatedAtByAccount": {} 并刷新 → 列表立即恢复，全部会话回归。

根因
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace 的 retainAccountKeys（lib/client.js）对恢复出的持久化状态直接 Object.entries(state.xxxByAccount)，假定各 account 维度字段必然存在。当状态由旧 schema 写入、或被第三方插件回写时丢掉新字段，缺字段 → TypeError → sidebar.workspaces 插槽每次渲染即崩 → 列表空白且零报错。
最小复现（3 步）

DevTools 控制台执行：
const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5'));
delete o.sessionUpdatedAtByAccount;
localStorage.setItem('dsh.workspace.view.v5', JSON.stringify(o));

刷新页面；
会话列表空白；控制台出现 slot entry crashed in 'sidebar.workspaces'。

修复建议

恢复持久化状态时对 sessionUpdatedAtByAccount / groupExpansion / sessionOrderByAccount 等字段给默认值（?? {}），或做 schema 迁移合并；
插槽加错误边界：单个 slot 崩溃时降级显示（或至少打进 client 日志），而不是整块消失、零痕迹。

疑似触发源（供参考）
第三方插件 dsh-organizer-sidebar 的 pnpm patch 自定义了排序并回写该状态；其 patch 文件早于 sessionUpdatedAtByAccount 字段引入，回写时可能丢掉新字段。但官方侧"缺一个字段就整块白屏 + 零日志"的健壮性问题独立存在。

threads.title: [bug] 实验性 Playwright MCP 启动失败会导致所有会话创建失败（failOnStartupError: true + reconnect: false），并残留孤儿浏览器进程
threads.bodyText:
您好，今天我开机后在后台干净的情况下启动dsh终端进入web页面，发现工作区无法创建新对话，且点击已有对话会直接消失（后证明被自动归档），我找到一个还能对话的聊天让它帮我排查修复，他排查后发现是浏览器工具（Playwright MCP）的启动失败会连坐整个会话创建，本机通过把那个插件的 failOnStartupError 从 true 改成 false后新对话创建恢复正常，以下是dsh写的反馈报告
环境

dsh 版本：0.1.7-alpha.1（npm 安装，2026-09-22）
平台：Windows（win32，Node v24.18.0）
浏览器工具配置（profile/cordis.yml）：

- id: 1afc9ad1
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-playwright-mcp'
  config:
    mode: launch
    headless: true
    executablePath: <EDGE>\msedge.exe

@playwright/mcp：0.0.80（profile 内 .pnpm 安装）
安装布局：dsh 全局安装目录与 profile 目录（~/.dsh/profiles/web）各有一份 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.1.7-alpha.1（下面第 5 点的钩子没生效，可能与此有关，供参考）

影响

所有新会话无法创建：session/create 返回 500
已存在的会话点开后 Agent 无法激活（界面上表现为会话从列表里“消失”）
浏览器工具彻底不可用，只能通过重启 Host 恢复

复现（未能稳定复现，见下）
已观测到的最短序列：

Host 运行一段时间（期间多个会话触发过浏览器工具挂载）
从 Web UI 或直接调用 POST /api/session/create（body: {"type":"client-request","rpcId":"<uuid>","method":"session/create","payload":{"args":{"request":{"workspaceId":"<id>"}}}}）
约 500 ms 后返回失败，之后每次创建会话都同样失败，直到重启 Host

同一台机器上无法稳定复现：用同一份配置、同一个 @playwright/mcp@0.0.80、同一个 executablePath、同一个 cwd 离线执行一次等价的 MCP 挂载，483 ms 成功并注册 24 个工具。因此怀疑是常驻 Host 进程内部的连接/挂载状态问题，而不是配置或环境错误。
实际表现

session/create 连续 3 次失败，报错一致：

failed to create session "session-<uuid>": Error:
mcp-client(playwright-mcp): initial connection or tool synchronization failed

耗时分别 541 ms / 513 ms / 500 ms（约 500 ms 即失败，不像握手超时）。

离线等价挂载（同一配置）成功：

SUCCESS after 483 ms; registered tools: 24


资源泄漏：崩溃后残留 12 个孤儿 Edge 进程（约 1.5 GB），其父链指向一个已经不再关联任何 agent 的浏览器树，需要手动 taskkill /T /F 清理。此外每个会话会各自拉起一个 playwright-mcp 进程 + 一个隔离 headless Edge，部分进程在会话结束后仍常驻。

疑似根因
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-browser-use-runtime 的 mountSessionMcp() 在 Agent 创建流程内同步等待 MCP 挂载：
packages/experimental/browser-use-runtime/src/mcp.ts
ctx.on('agent/created', async ({ agent, signal }) => {
  // resources.get(agent, signal) → open() → scope.ctx.plugin(McpClient, McpClient.Config({...}))
  ...
}, { prepend: true });
await scope.ctx.plugin(McpClient, McpClient.Config({
  transport: 'stdio',
  serverName: options.name,
  command: options.command,
  args: options.args,
  ...
  failOnStartupError: true,
  reconnect: { enabled: false },
}));
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 随后在启动失败时抛错：
packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/index.ts
const outcome = await connection.ready;
if (outcome.error !== void 0 && config.failOnStartupError) {
  throw new Error(`mcp-client(${config.serverName}): initial connection or tool synchronization failed`, { cause: outcome.error });
}
结果：浏览器工具（实验性、可选能力）的一处启动失败，会让整个会话创建失败；同时 reconnect: { enabled: false } 意味着失败后不会自愈，该 Host 进程会持续表现为“无法新建会话”，只能重启。
相关资源泄漏

MCP 子进程与 --isolated 的 headless 浏览器在崩溃/会话结束后可能变成孤儿进程并常驻（本次实测 12 个 Edge 进程、约 1.5 GB）
这些残留会持续占用内存与浏览器 profile，推测会提高后续 MCP 启动失败的概率，形成“越用越坏、重启才好”的循环

本地规避手段
把该处改为 failOnStartupError: false 后，浏览器工具即使启动失败也只会“该会话没有浏览器工具”，不再阻塞会话创建。但这只是掩盖症状，浏览器工具本身仍然不可用。
建议

让浏览器工具的启动失败只降级该工具，不阻塞 Agent/Session 创建（或在 agent/created 钩子里容错）
考虑给该挂载开启 reconnect（当前 enabled: false，失败后不自愈）
修资源回收：会话释放/启动失败时确保 playwright-mcp 进程与隔离浏览器进程树被清理，不留孤儿进程
报错信息请带上真实 cause（包括 MCP 子进程 stderr），现在只有 initial connection or tool synchronization failed，用户侧无法定位

其他
本机无法稳定复现，所以没有最小复现工程。如果能告诉我需要采集哪些诊断信息（例如让 dsh-mcp-client 输出子进程 stderr、插件加载顺序，或是否存在并发挂载竞争），我可以按需补充。

threads.title: [desktop 0.1.7-rc.2] dsh-app:// 转发的响应无法流式返回：/plugins/events(SSE) 恒报 net::ERR_FAILED，连带会话状态、权限预设目录、审批提示与插件热更新一起失效
threads.bodyText:
[desktop 0.1.7-rc.2] dsh-app:// 转发的响应无法流式返回：/plugins/events(SSE) 恒报 net::ERR_FAILED，连带会话状态、权限预设目录、审批提示与插件热更新一起失效
环境

macOS 27.0（26A428），Apple Silicon
DeepSeek Harness 桌面端 0.1.7-rc.2（内置 @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime 0.1.7-rc.2）
profile：desktop（默认 profile）
该 profile 另装有 3 个第三方插件（dsh-selection-toolbar、dsh-approval-gate、@tt-a1i/archify-dsh），但请注意：失败的是内置 host 路由（/plugins/events），转发层出错的证据与任何插件代码无关；插件 bundle 走同一转发路径且工作正常（这也正是"有限响应能过、流式响应过不去"这条不对称的对照）。

现象
桌面窗口 DevTools（F12）Console 持续报同一个错误，且自动重试也一直失败（单次会话中出现 3 次以上）：
Failed to load resource: net::ERR_FAILED
dsh-app://app/plugins/events:1

关键对照：同一路径直连 HTTP 完全正常
用桌面窗口自身的认证 cookie 直接请求同一个路由（curl，非浏览器）：
$ curl -D - -H "Cookie: dsh-auth-<authority-derived>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
       http://127.0.0.1:19387/plugins/events
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: text/event-stream
cache-control: no-cache
connection: keep-alive
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

: connected

data: {"type":"graph","graph":{"rev":"40d2a2b32253","entries":[{"id":"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-open-in-app","url":"plugins/??...&rev=f44f7506b4ea","rev":"f44f7506b4ea","inject":[...]},...]}}

6 秒内稳定收到 28,710 字节，SSE 帧格式正确；
Node 侧 fetch + response.body.getReader() 也能正常拿到 chunk（首 chunk 13B / : connected，随后 28,710B 的 graph 事件）；
只有经过 dsh-app:// 协议转发这一层才失败。

已排除的原因

自定义协议特权没问题（app.asar 中已正确注册）：
protocol.registerSchemesAsPrivileged([{ scheme: SCHEME, privileges: {
  standard: true, secure: true, supportFetchAPI: true,
  corsEnabled: true, stream: true, codeCache: true
}}]);

host 侧路由健康：200 + 合法 text/event-stream + 合法首帧。
URL 处理无误：手工模拟 forwardWebRequest 的 target.pathname = source.pathname; target.search = source.search，转发后 URL 与被请求 URL 逐字节相同（?? 虽被 URL 解析器归入 search，但序列化后完全一致）。
响应头 withhold 是正确的：content-encoding 被去掉是必要且正确的——host 对插件 bundle 会 gzip（实测 Content-Encoding: gzip + Vary: Accept-Encoding），而主进程的 Node fetch 已经解压，原样透传反而会错。实测 10 MB 的插件 bundle 走同一转发路径完全正常。

根因假设
forwardWebRequest（main process）使用全局 fetch（Node/undici），并把它的 response.body 直接交给自定义协议的 new Response(...)：
async function forwardWebRequest(request, host, cookie) {
  /* ... */
  const response = await fetch(target, init);          // ← Node/undici 的 fetch
  const outgoing = new Headers(response.headers);
  for (const name of WITHHELD_RESPONSE_HEADERS) outgoing.delete(name);
  if (PLUGIN_BUNDLE_PATH.test(source.pathname)) outgoing.set("cache-control", "no-store");
  return new Response(response.body, { status: response.status, headers: outgoing });
}
有限长度的响应能通过（Electron 可以读完整个 body 再交付——所以 10 MB 的插件 bundle 正常）；无限流式的响应过不去（永远不会"读完"），表现为 net::ERR_FAILED。/plugins/events 恰好就是那条永不结束的 SSE。
波及面（这是影响最严重的部分）
/plugins/events 是客户端获取「host → client 事件/状态」的唯一通道（其首帧即 {"type":"graph",...}，携带模块图 rev 与模块清单）。它一死，以下四件事同时失效，均在本机稳定复现：

会话状态恒为空：客户端内 sessions.current 一直是空值，第三方插件拿不到当前会话 id（只能自行兜底，例如退回 composer 会话）。符合事件通道未送达的状态。
权限预设目录到不了客户端：本机按某个插件（社区 approval-gate）的官方说明在 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml 里手工添加了 permission 预设（含 auto-approve，name: 自动审批（Flash）），host 侧应已生效，但会话权限下拉里始终不出现该选项；而 label 在 shipped 客户端 locale 字典里的 Auto review 不受影响。这与 @deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets README 中「进程级 catalog() Remote 返回完整可选快照，注册/移除 Auto 会发出 permission-presets/catalog-changed 通知，客户端先订阅再重新读取目录」的描述相符——该通路依赖这条事件通道。
审批提示弹不出来、工具调用直接卡住：把会话审批策略设为 ask 后，需要审批的工具调用会一直等待且不出现任何提示。审批请求需要客户端 UI 应答，事件推不到客户端时即表现为挂起。
装/卸插件后插件会"消失"，且用户没有应用内刷新入口：bundle URL 形如
dsh-app://app/plugins/??<modules>&rev=<per-process revision>

实测 rev 重建后旧 URL 立即 404（rev=32092783b4f0 → 404；当前 rev → 200）。客户端因收不到 graph 事件而继续持用旧 URL，模块加载失败，第三方插件静默失效，必须整页刷新或重启应用才恢复。而打包版把「刷新页面」菜单项隐藏了：
const development = !app.isPackaged;                  // 打包版 = false
...development ? [ { label: reloadPageMenu, role: "reload" }, ... ] : []
同时 devToolsItems 的 toggleDevTools 也是 visible: false（只留了 F12）。因此普通用户既没有"刷新页面"，也看不到"开发者工具"，只能 ⌘Q 重启。

建议修法（任选其一即可）

forwardWebRequest 改用 Electron 的 net.fetch（Chromium 网络栈），而不是全局 fetch，让流式 body 与自定义协议的 Response 兼容；
或让 /plugins/events 这类流式路由不走协议转发，像 DESKTOP_IPC.boot 返回的 streamBaseUrl 那样，由客户端直连 host origin（http://127.0.0.1:<port>，cookie 注入机制已具备）。

附：用户侧临时绕过
在浏览器里打开 host 的 HTTP 源（同一 profile），此时 /plugins/events 是同源直连、不经过 dsh-app:// 转发层，事件通道恢复正常：

取桌面窗口正在使用的认证 cookie（名由 Host 派生、值由本次 activation 密钥签发）：
sqlite3 ~/Library/Application\ Support/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop/Cookies \
  "select name||'='||value from cookies where name like 'dsh-auth%' order by last_update_utc desc limit 1;"

浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:19387/，用 DevTools → Application → Cookies 写入该 name/value，刷新即可。

threads.title: [Bug] 0.1.7-rc.1/rc.2 出口代理策略注入的 undici 8.x 全局分发器与 Node 内置 fetch 主版本错配：进程内所有响应头丢失（MCP HTTP 服务器永久断开、微信图片/文件发送失败）
threads.bodyText:
摘要
0.1.7-rc.1 升级引入的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-http-proxy（依赖 undici: ^8.10.0，实际解析到 8.11.0）在检测到 HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY 时，把 npm undici 8.x 的 Agent 安装为进程全局 dispatcher。实测确认：外部 undici 8.x dispatcher 与 Node 内置 fetch（内置 undici 6.28.0）存在响应头接口错配——安装后进程内所有经内置 fetch() 的响应 Headers 对象为空（status/body 正常）。0.1.7-rc.2 的 dsh-http-proxy/lib/index.js 与 rc.1 零差异，依赖声明仍为 ^8.10.0，问题未修复。
两个实际故障（同一根因）



症状
读哪个响应头
后果




zai-search / zai-reader / zread 三个 streamable-http MCP 永久 server is disconnected（stdio 型 zai 正常）
MCP SDK 版本协商探针读 content-type → null → SdkError: Unexpected content type: null，静默重试 10 次后放弃
HTTP 型 MCP 全灭


微信通道图片/文件发送 100% 失败（CHANNEL_DELIVERY），文字正常
CDN 上传 200 响应里的 x-encrypted-param → 缺失 → invalid-upload-response
图片/文件全灭



最小复现（与代理无关，纯接口错配）
Node v22.23.2（内置 undici 6.28.0）：
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
const u811 = createRequire('/usr/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/')('undici');
u811.setGlobalDispatcher(new u811.Agent());   // dsh-http-proxy 启动时做的事

const r = await fetch('https://open.bigmodel.cn/mcp/zai-search/mcp', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', accept: 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'server/discover' }),
});
console.log(r.status, [...r.headers].length, r.headers.get('content-type'));
// → 405, 0, null   （响应头全空；不装外部 dispatcher 时 → 405, 8, text/html）
版本矩阵（同一台机器、同一时段实测）



全局 dispatcher
status
响应头数
content-type




Node 内置默认（6.28.0）
405
8 ✅
text/html


npm undici 8.10.0 Agent
405
0 ❌
null


npm undici 8.11.0 Agent（现装）
405
0 ❌
null


npm undici 7.29.0 Agent
405
8 ✅
text/html



抓包（tcpdump）佐证：请求正常发出、对端完整返回了头部块，客户端 Headers 对象却为空——损坏发生在客户端响应头交接，不在网络。NO_PROXY bypass 本身工作正常（流量确实直连），与路由无关。
定位

packages/util/http-proxy/src/install.ts → createPolicyDispatcher()：Agent({ factory }) → new Pool(origin, options)（8.x）设为全局。
8.x dispatcher/handler 协议与 Node 22 内置 fetch 期望的接口不兼容；undici 7.x 仍兼容（对照成立）。
另注意：verify-no-bare-dispatcher 只能 gate 仓库内源码，第三方插件（如 dsh-im 的微信 CDN 上传）受此影响却无法被 lint 覆盖。

建议

短期：dsh-http-proxy 的 undici 依赖改为与 Node 内置主版本一致（Node 22 线内置 6.x；或锁定 7.29.x，实测兼容），或在安装全局分发器前校验 process.versions.undici 主版本、不匹配时拒绝安装并告警。
长期：官方最佳实践页应写明「npm undici 8.x 的 setGlobalDispatcher 会损坏内置 fetch 响应头」这一坑（目前该页只说"不会替换内置 globals"，没说全局 dispatcher 会坏）。
用户侧临时方案（已验证）：把 dsh node_modules 里的 undici 替换为 7.29.0 → MCP 三台恢复在线、微信图片发送恢复，代理功能不受影响。

环境与佐证

dsh 0.1.7-rc.1（已核对 rc.2 的 dsh-http-proxy 与 rc.1 零差异、依赖仍 ^8.10.0）
Node v22.23.2（内置 undici 6.28.0），Linux x86_64（NAS 自部署）
关联：xmanrui/dsh-im#270（微信通道侧完整诊断，含抓包与调试日志）；受影响用户可在升级到 rc.2 后复测——预计依然复现

以上内容为AI生成总结

threads.title: Windows: revealNativePath silently reveals nothing — windowsHide: true hides the Explorer window it spawns
threads.bodyText:
Title
Windows: revealNativePath silently reveals nothing — windowsHide: true hides the Explorer window it spawns
Affected
@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command@0.1.5-rc.3, still present in 0.1.7-rc.2 (published 2026-09-24; verified by
downloading the published tarball and reading lib/index.js).
Environment: Windows 10 19045, Node 24.15.0, dsh@0.1.5-rc.3, dsh web.
Symptom
Deliverables card → menu → "Show in File Explorer" reports success (the card shows
"已请求在文件资源管理器中显示" / "Requested display in file manager", i.e. POST /api/present.open?...&action=reveal
returned 204), but no Explorer window appears.
Root cause
runNativeCommand spawns every host command with windowsHide: true
(lib/index.js:17-22 in 0.1.5-rc.3; lib/index.js:18-37 in 0.1.7-rc.2). On Windows Node maps that to
STARTUPINFO.wShowWindow = SW_HIDE (plus CREATE_NO_WINDOW). That is the right default for the console helpers
this runner was written for (reg.exe, powershell.exe, wslpath), but explorer.exe is a GUI process: the
window it creates exists yet is never shown.
Measured on the same command with only that flag changed:



spawn options
new window
IsWindowVisible




windowsHide: true
created (found via Shell.Application.Windows())
false


windowsHide: false
created
true



The process starts and exits normally, so the route reports success.
Repro (self-contained; opens at most 2 windows)
Add-Type -Namespace W -Name U -MemberDefinition '[DllImport("user32.dll")] public static extern bool IsWindowVisible(System.IntPtr hWnd);'
$target = 'file:///C:/Windows/win.ini'
node -e "require('child_process').execFile('explorer.exe',['/select,','$target'],{windowsHide:true},()=>{})"
Start-Sleep 4
(New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).Windows() |
  Where-Object { $_.LocationURL -eq 'file:///C:/Windows' } |
  ForEach-Object { "{0} visible={1}" -f $_.HWND, [W.U]::IsWindowVisible([System.IntPtr][int64]$_.HWND) }
The window is present with visible=False; repeat with {windowsHide:false} and it reports visible=True.
Secondary issue that makes the failure silent
runExplorer accepts any explorer.exe exit 1 as a successful delegated handoff
(lib/index.js:233 in 0.1.5-rc.3; lib/index.js:146 in 0.1.7-rc.2). A genuine failure therefore also returns 204
and the UI claims success. Distinguishing real failures (or at least logging stderr) would have surfaced this bug
immediately instead of presenting it as success.
Suggested fix
Give the runner a per-call override, and keep the GUI launcher visible:
-const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+const runNativeCommand = (command, args, signal, options = {}) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 	execFile(command, [...args], {
 		encoding: "utf8",
 		signal,
-		windowsHide: true
+		windowsHide: true,
+		...options
 	}, (error, stdout, stderr) => {
then at the explorer.exe call site — in 0.1.7-rc.2 there is now exactly one, inside runExplorer, which serves
both open and reveal:
-		await run("explorer.exe", args, signal);
+		await run("explorer.exe", args, signal, { windowsHide: false });
In 0.1.5-rc.3 the site is await run("explorer.exe", ["/select,", target], signal);.
Alternatively, route explorer.exe through the visibility policy dsh-host-open-in-app already applies
(launchDetachedApp passes windowsHide: options.windowsHide, false for GUI adapters) — the codebase has the
concept; only the generic runner lacks it.
Scope
Windows only — macOS open -R and Linux xdg-open are unaffected. In 0.1.7-rc.2 the blast radius is wider:
openWindowsPath now also goes through runExplorer, so "open in default application" would open invisibly as
well, not just "show in file manager".
Why it may have been missed
The comments assume explorer.exe hands the request to the already-running desktop process and exits 1; on that
path the window is created by the shell process and stays visible. The hidden-window case needs the spawned
explorer.exe to create the window itself, as it does on this machine. Linux/macOS CI would not exercise it.
Unrelated but worth noting: the new explorerTarget() escaping work in 0.1.7-rc.2 (commas, equals signs,
non-ASCII percent-escapes, \\?\ prefixes) is exactly the kind of care this call site needs — the command line
was never the problem.

threads.title: [0.1.7-rc.2 regression] CJS resolver cannot resolve punycode/; plugins using jsdom fail to load
threads.bodyText:
Summary A plugin whose dependency graph contains a CommonJS module that requires punycode/ fails to load on dsh 0.1.7-rc.2 with failed to import, while the identical plugin activates normally on dsh 0.1.5-rc.2. The fault is in @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot's new ResolutionRouter, which was rewritten for 0.1.7 and no longer guards createRequire(...).resolve.paths(). (Issues are disabled on this repo, so I'm reporting here — apologies if Q&A isn't the right category; happy to repost wherever you prefer.) Reproduction Plugin: dsh-web-search-pro@0.1.14-alpha.1 (plain npm tarball), which imports jsdom. Require chain: jsdom → whatwg-url → tr46 → require("punycode/"). dsh dsh-app-boot result 0.1.5-rc.2 0.1.5-rc.3 plugin activates: all 11 tools registered, browser: injected 0.1.7-rc.2 0.1.7-rc.2 web-search-pro (dsh-web-search-pro): failed to import Both runs used an isolated DSH_HOME and a profile with the webserver moved off the default port. Defect 1 — unguarded resolve.paths() throws and masks the real error ResolutionRouter.routeScoped (0.1.7-rc.2, lib/index.js:1422): for (const searchPath of createRequire(parent).resolve.paths(name)) { resolve.paths() returns null for a builtin-shadowed name, so for...of null throws: TypeError: createRequire.resolve.paths is not a function or its return value is not iterable at ResolutionRouter.routeScoped (.../dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1422) at ResolutionRouter.routePath (...:1554) at Function.wrappedFilename [as _resolveFilename] (...:1771) at Object. (.../node_modules/tr46/index.js:3:18) Note the CJS hook routePath forwards the raw request to routeScoped with no builtin filter, unlike barePackageName(), which does call isBuiltin(). The 0.1.5 equivalent site was guarded: for (const searchPath of createRequire(anchor).resolve.paths(packageName) ?? []) { 0.1.7-rc.2 has six resolve.paths call sites; five are unguarded (lines 1247, 1422, 1475, 2019, 3263 — only 883 keeps ?? []). Defect 2 — the underlying resolution failure: Cannot find module 'punycode/' Adding ?? [] to all five sites removes the TypeError and exposes the real error: Error: Cannot find module 'punycode/' Require stack: - .../profiles/rescue/node_modules/tr46/index.js - .../node_modules/whatwg-url/lib/url-state-machine.js ... - .../node_modules/jsdom/lib/api.js at resolveRoutedCjs (.../dsh-app-boot/lib/index.js:1740:28) at Function.wrappedFilename [as _resolveFilename] (...:1805:16) punycode is installed in the profile and resolves/loads natively: $ node -e "const r=require('module').createRequire(process.cwd()+'/node_modules/tr46/index.js'); console.log(r.resolve('punycode/'))" /home/gwang/.../profiles/rescue/node_modules/punycode/punycode.js $ node -e "... typeof r('punycode/').toASCII ..." function So native Node resolves it fine, but the router intercepts the require and cannot route it — because it derives search paths from resolve.paths() (which treats punycode as a builtin and yields nothing) instead of the actual resolution. Impact Any plugin that pulls in a CJS dependency requiring a builtin-shadowed name (punycode and similar) cannot load on 0.1.7-rc.2. jsdom → whatwg-url → tr46 is a very common chain, so this may affect a broad set of plugins. Suggested fix Guard every resolve.paths() call with ?? [] (restore 0.1.5 behavior). Apply the same builtin filter in the CJS routePath hook that barePackageName() already applies, so builtin-shadowed specifiers delegate to native resolution or skip routing. Add a regression test that loads a plugin whose dependency graph requires punycode/ (anything depending on tr46/jsdom). Workaround for plugin authors (until this is fixed) Removing jsdom from the dependency graph is enough — the failure only needs some CJS module on the plugin's resolution scope to require('punycode/'), and jsdom → whatwg-url → tr46 is the usual route. I replaced jsdom with node-html-parser (deps: entities, css-select — no tr46/punycode/whatwg-url anywhere), and the same plugin then activates normally on 0.1.7-rc.2. To check whether your own dependency tree is exposed: node -e "const r=require('module').createRequire(process.cwd()+'/index.js'); console.log(r.resolve.paths('punycode'))" A null result is exactly the value the router fails to iterate. You can also just grep the installed tree for tr46, whatwg-url, or punycode. One caveat if you migrate off jsdom: node-html-parser parses 
/ bodies as raw text, so textContent returns inner markup where a real DOM flattens it (
x
 yields "x" instead of "x"). Re-parsing the element's rawText (the original escaped source) restores DOM semantics for nested elements, entities, and escaped tag lookalikes alike. Switching to linkedom, cheerio, or node-html-parser all avoid the bug; pick whichever fits your parsing needs.
Verification of the workaround

Differential harness over 20 HTML cases (headings, lists, tables, JSON-LD, entities, nested 
, fragments without , invalid selectors): the old jsdom-backed extractor and the new node-html-parser-backed one produce identical output.
End-to-end on an isolated 0.1.7-rc.2 profile: the plugin goes from failed to import to activating fully (11 tools registered, browser service injected) — identical to its behavior on 0.1.5-rc.2.

Environment

Node v22.23.2, Linux x64
@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.1.7-rc.2
baseline: @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.1.5-rc.3

threads.title: [Bug] 工作区常驻 Low 完整性标签导致资源管理器把所有文件显示为"来自其他计算机"，且"解除锁定"显示找不到该文件必然失败，移动文件时警告"这些文件可能对你的计算机有害 你的Internet安全设置阻止打开一个或多个文件"
threads.bodyText:
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-rc.2，@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl 0.1.7-rc.2
Windows 11，NTFS，工作区在 D 盘

现象
用过 workspace-write 模式后，工作区内所有文件在资源管理器"属性 → 安全"里都显示"此文件来自其他计算机，可能被阻止以帮助保护该计算机"，并出现"解除锁定"复选框。勾选确定后必报错：文件应用属性时出错：<路径> 系统找不到指定的文件。移动文件时警告"这些文件可能对你的计算机有害 你的Internet安全设置阻止打开一个或多个文件"


根因
dsh-sandbox-windows-acl 的 grantWrite() 在给工作区授权时，会在同一次 SetNamedSecurityInfoW 调用里给工作区根目录加上可继承的 Low 强制性完整性标签（S-1-16-4096，no-write-up），并按其设计常驻不撤销（README.zh.md 第 121 行已说明该标签"生命期长于 DSH"）。Windows Shell 据此把对象判为不受信任来源，于是显示"来自其他计算机"。
但文件里并没有 Zone.Identifier 数据流（真正的 MOTW 载体），所以"解除锁定"要删除的流不存在，必然以 ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND 失败。
证据
icacls "D:\...\some.py"
#   ...\some.py S-1-4-425569831-448124113:(I)(W,D,DC)
#   Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(I)(NW)

Get-Item -LiteralPath "D:\...\some.py" -Stream *    # 只有 :$DATA，无 Zone.Identifier
cmd /c "dir /r ""D:\...\some.py"""                  # 不列出任何备用数据流

# 对照：DSH 在工作区之外写的文件没有 Low 标签、也不显示该提示；
#       浏览器下载的文件有真实 Zone.Identifier，解除锁定正常（两种机制不同）。
# 把标签改回 Medium 后提示消失：
icacls "D:\A_file\PQIP" /setintegritylevel Medium /T /C /Q
影响
用户会把每一条 DSH 产出都当成"来自其他计算机"的不可信文件，而按提示"解除锁定"永远失败，容易误判为杀毒/安全软件告警；也容易与浏览器下载的真实 MOTW 混淆。本机一个 1692 个文件的工作区只能手工 icacls 清扫。
建议

在 README.zh.md 第 121 行那条"常驻 Low 标签"旁，补上这个用户可见副作用（资源管理器"来自其他计算机" + 解除锁定必然失败）。
提供官方回收入口，例如 dsh sandbox unprovision <dir>：把工作区标签恢复为 Medium 并清除常驻 ACE/deny。README 说手工 icacls 清理会 ERROR_NONE_MAPPED (1332)、"请通过模块回收"，但目前没有面向用户的命令。
考虑把工作区标签改为非继承，或在会话结束 / 模式切换时回收（可做成 opt-in 的性能权衡），使其不随会话长期残留。

threads.title: [bug]Windows `workspace-write` 下所有被沙箱包裹的命令失败于 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW (Win32 5)
threads.bodyText:
1. 现象

环境：Windows（native win32）、@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2、
dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.1.7-rc.2、Node v24.18.1、PowerShell 5.1、
工作区 D:\A_file\PQIP（属主=当前用户）。
workspace-write 下任何 pwsh 调用（含 pwd）都在子进程启动前失败：
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(D:\A_file\PQIP)
（Win32 5 = ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED；只写工作区也一样。）
切到 danger-full-access 立即恢复正常 ⟹ 故障在沙箱授权，不在命令。

2. 实测证据



条件（同一工作区/路径）
结果




未提权令牌：whoami /priv 无 SeSecurityPrivilege 行
❌ Win32 5（直接调 AclWriteGrant.add() 复现；workspaceWriteSid(path) 与目录里那条 S-1-4-… ACE 一致）


未提权：PowerShell Set-Acl 写回 DACL
✅ 成功 ⟹ 具备 WRITE_DAC（属主隐式），问题不在 DACL


未提权：读/写 SACL（Get-Acl -Audit / 写回）
❌ does not possess the 'SeSecurityPrivilege'；AdjustTokenPrivileges 启用它 → lastErr 1300（令牌不持有）


提权令牌：SeSecurityPrivilege 显示 Disabled（默认）
✅ AclWriteGrant.add() 成功——在 C:\…\Temp、D:\、D:\A_file\ 三个全新目录及工作区本身全部成功


提权 + 显式启用该特权
✅ 成功（SACL 读写均成功）



所以判据是"令牌是否携带 SeSecurityPrivilege"，不是"是否 Enabled"：
未提权令牌不携带 → 写 SACL 的合并调用被拒；提权令牌携带（哪怕 Disabled）→ 成功。
已排除的方向（都不对症）：takeown、给目录补 (F)/(WO) ACE、把工作区换到 C:\Users\… 或别处、
卸载重装、降级版本。此外 §2 第 2 行已证明 DACL 写入是通的。
3. 代码路径（lib/types-DxezulnA.js）

grantWrite(L587)：仅当 能力 ACE + Everyone 拒绝项 + Low 标签三者精确匹配才短路（L590），
否则 mergeAndApply。
mergeAndApply(L465)：setNamedSecurityInfoW(path, 1, 20, …, newAcl, labelAcl)，
其中 20 = DACL | SACL——一次调用同时写 DACL 与 SACL（Low 完整性标签）；
失败即 throwWin32(... "grantWrite(<path>)")(L483)。
代码中未见在调用前 AdjustTokenPrivileges 启用 SeSecurityPrivilege 的步骤。
副作用：SACL 写失败时，DACL 侧的能力 ACE 仍可能已驻留（本机目录里就有一条），
且因标签缺失仍无法进入短路路径，于是每次调用都重走失败路径；该 ACE 不会被回收。

4. 尚未闭合的一环
实测：以管理员身份启动 DSH（workspace-write）仍然失败。这与 §2 中"提权会话里同一调用成功"
不一致，因此机制的最后一环待上游/复现者确认。两种可能：

该会话的令牌未携带/启用 SeSecurityPrivilege（§2 表明 Disabled 也够，但"不携带"就必然失败）；
测试时 DSH 宿主实际仍是非提权进程（已运行的旧宿主未重启），或模式未切到 workspace-write。

建议上游给出官方判定方法：在宿主启动/首次授权时检查
GetTokenInformation(TokenPrivileges) 是否含 SeSecurityPrivilege，并在失败信息中区分
"DACL 不允许"与"SACL 需要特权"。
5. 建议

文档：在 Windows 相关说明中写明——workspace-write 需要宿主令牌携带 SeSecurityPrivilege
（写 Low 完整性标签所必需）；README 目前只提"属主 + WRITE_OWNER"，据此排查会走错方向。
错误信息：SecurityInfo 掩码 + "该调用同时写 SACL，需 SeSecurityPrivilege"提示，
并说明可用的绕过（danger-full-access）。
代码：① 写标签失败时不要连带丢弃 DACL 授权（可选降级并 warn）；
② 无该特权时启动即 fail-fast，避免每条命令都在授权阶段失败；③ 提供公开的"回收工作区 ACE / 标签"入口。
长期：把 Low 标签与"写授权"解耦（无该特权时用等效但不需要 SACL 的写边界）。

6. 本机绕过
权限模式设为 danger-full-access（命令立即恢复；代价是失去写边界）。
7.相似问题说明
#7912
#7915
可能与该问题同源

threads.title: Row Config writes are silently lost when several fields are written in quick succession (every request answers 200)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Writing several fields of the same row Config in quick succession (~55 ms apart)
loses writes. The client issues them one at a time, the host answers 200 for every
one of them, the UI shows the new state — and profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
ends up missing some of them. After a reload those fields are back to their old
values, so the user's change silently disappears with no error anywhere.
Environment

dsh 0.1.7-rc.2 (local link install; version reported by dsh --version)
macOS (arm64), Node 24
profile web
affected surface: a plugin's settings page (row Config) that renders many
switches, driven through ctx.configForms.get(ns) — the same service the official
plugins page uses
isolated DSH_HOME, dedicated port; no other instance involved

Steps to reproduce

Install any bundle whose row Config has ~16 scalar (boolean) fields — the shape a
settings page with one switch per feature produces.
Open that plugin's settings page.
Toggle every switch, ~55 ms apart (programmatically: one
ctx.configForms.get(ns).set(field, value) per field, not awaited).
Wait a few seconds, then compare three things:

the accepted document (form.getSnapshot().value),
the rendered switches,
profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml on disk.



repro.mjs in this report does exactly that and prints a per-field table
(intent / rendered / on-disk). It is plugin-agnostic: it drives whatever settings
card it finds.
Expected vs actual


Expected: every accepted write is persisted, or a rejected/lost write is
reported to the caller so the UI can say so. 200 should mean "stored".


Actual (16 fields, ~55 ms apart):



reading
value




writes issued
16


HTTP
61 POST / 60 responses / 0 non-2xx


fields present and correct in the patch file
13 of 16


fields left at their old value
3


fields reverted after a page reload
2


rendered switches
all 16 showed the new state





Control run — identical payloads, 500 ms apart: 0 of 16 lost.
Only the interval changed, so this looks like overlapping writes inside the
write/persist path rather than validation, permissions or the client queue.
The client form controller serializes its own set() calls, so the requests
reach the host one after another; the loss still happens.


Impact
Any plugin whose settings surface writes more than one field at once can hit this:
a settings page with many switches, a "reset to defaults" action, an import/apply
button, or a plugin that mirrors a batch of values into its row Config. The failure
is silent in both directions (client and host answer success), which makes it look
like the plugin "forgot" the user's choice.
Workaround we now use (in the affected plugin)

collect the fields the user touched into a map of target values,
flush them inside a ~250 ms window as one mutation with multiple ops
(form.mutate([{ op: 'set', path: [field], value }, …])) instead of N separate
set() calls,
after the write is accepted, re-read the accepted document and compare it with the
intent: re-issue once if it disagrees, and if it still disagrees roll the UI back
and tell the user instead of pretending it saved.

With that shape, the same 16 writes 55 ms apart land 16/16 and survive a reload.
Related observation
Sending 4 requests simultaneously also entered the settings/generation path 4
times (4 × 200) when the caller had not implemented its own single-flight, so the
serialization appears to cover only part of the operation.
Ask
Could the row-Config write path either (a) persist each accepted mutation before
answering, or (b) return a non-2xx / a "superseded" signal when a mutation is
dropped, so plugins can react instead of silently losing the user's settings?
Happy to provide more information, the exact driver script, or to test a build with
extra logging — just say what would help.

threads.title: Throughput in turn footer / session stats is unguarded when a step arrives as whole blocks (10^5-10^6 tok/s)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Some steps persisted in assistant/message.stream carry packed runs where every block has exactly one member and dt is empty. For those steps the decode window (first token → assembled message) collapses to 1–5 ms while usage.outputTokens stays in the hundreds-to-thousands. Both deriveTurnMetrics and the sessionStats projection compute throughput as outputTokens / decodeMs with nothing but a decodeMs > 0 guard, so they emit values in the 10^5–10^6 tok/s range and fold them into the session total.
Measured on one machine, same session data:



session
steps
affected steps
displayed
recomputed from healthy steps only




session-56e9f8cf… (redacted)
125
113
1906.2 tok/s
149.1 tok/s


session-3e54dd78… (redacted)
9
0
131.6 tok/s
131.6 tok/s



Impact

Turn footer and session-wide throughput are not trustworthy for any session containing such steps, and the error grows with their share.
In a scan of recent local sessions, the affected share ranged from 38% to 93% across 9 sessions.
ttftMs / ttftSteps are unaffected (separate accumulators, not derived from the decode window).

Reproduction

Have any session whose assistant/message.stream contains steps where every packed run has a single member.
Open the session and read the throughput in the turn footer or session stats.
Compare against a recomputation that only uses steps whose runs have a non-empty dt.

Decode accounting used here matches the server projection: decode window = assistant/message event time − assistantStreamFirstTokenTime(stream); throughput = that step's usage.outputTokens / decode window.
Evidence
Packed-run shape, healthy steps vs affected steps (members = total texts/args members across runs):



turn/step
runs
members
sum(dt)




1/1
3
927
924


1/2
3
670
667


2/2
3
3
0


2/4
3
3
0



The first affected step is step 2/2; every step from there on shows the same shape.
Analysis
Chunks are stamped at the consumption site, packages/core/agent-loop/src/assistant-stream.ts:
this.accumulator.push({ time: Date.now(), chunk })
So “one member per block and an empty dt” is equivalent to: the whole SSE stream was consumed within the same millisecond, and each content block arrived as a single delta.
Neither accounting entry point protects against that:

packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/contract/turn-metrics.ts (deriveTurnMetrics) only checks decodeMs > 0
packages/session/session-stats/src/projection.ts (sessionStats) accumulates unconditionally

What I could not establish
I did not determine the origin of the whole-block arrival. Ruled out so far:

Upstream always coalescing large requests: control requests through the same gateway and model with 20k / 80k token inputs arrived as 17 / 34 data events with 2–30 ms spacing, i.e. normally streamed.
Context size: one session with 390k input tokens had 0% affected steps.
User mid-turn injections or retries: one session with only 2 injections had 78% affected steps.

Not ruled out: the local path (client → LiteLLM gateway → upstream). The claim in this report is therefore only the missing guard in the accounting layer, which holds regardless of where the coalescing comes from.
Suggested fix
In deriveTurnMetrics and sessionStats: exclude steps where every run has an empty dt and a single member from throughput accounting; or, at minimum, add a floor for the decode window (e.g. a step with no incremental members and a sub-50 ms window does not contribute). TTFT should stay as is.
Related

Discussion #6129 covers a different client-side read of the same packed-run shape (trajectory panel timing unavailable on historical replay). This report is the throughput accounting face of the same data shape.


Environment: dsh 0.1.7-rc.2 (npm global install), macOS. Has anyone else seen this? Happy to open a PR with the guard plus tests if that is useful.

threads.title: Terminal on Windows: CJK bytes escaped as M-... in the prompt, and IME (pinyin) input does not work
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Two problems in the DSH terminal on Windows (Git Bash via the official terminal), both affecting CJK users:

Non-ASCII bytes in the prompt are escaped (M-…) while pwd prints the same path correctly.
An IME (pinyin) cannot enter text in the terminal.

They look independent (one is the shell's prompt string, the other is the frontend input path), so they are reported separately below.
Environment

Windows 11 · DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 (dsh --version) · web GUI
terminal: the built-in sidebar terminal, shell = Git Bash
working directory contains non-ASCII (CJK) characters
(Additional data point collected on macOS with a real pty, see the reproduction.)

Problem 1 — CJK bytes in the prompt become M-…
Actual: the prompt shows the working directory as escaped 8-bit bytes:
~/Documents/<workspace-with-cjk>/M-iM-;M-^XM-hM-.M-$M-eM-7M-%M-dM-=M-^\M-eM-^LM-:> 

Same terminal, same directory: pwd prints it correctly:
/c/Users/<user>/Documents/<workspace-with-cjk>

So the path itself is fine; only the prompt rendering is affected. (This is the same mechanism the user reported as "path display is broken".)
Minimal reproduction / what I could confirm
I could not run the Windows build, so I reproduced the mechanism on macOS through a real pty with a CJK directory and PS1='\w> ':



locale passed to the shell
prompt




LC_ALL=C
/private/tmp/…/M-iM-;M-^XM-hM-.M-$M-eM-7M-%M-dM-=M-^\M-eM-^LM-:>  (escaped)


LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8
escaped identically


LC_ALL=C + TERM=dumb
escaped identically



Two findings worth noting:

A literal non-ASCII PS1 (PS1='中文目录> ') is not escaped in any of those cases. The escaping happens where the shell itself decodes the working directory into the prompt (\w / \W, which the default Git Bash prompt uses). It is therefore not the terminal renderer.
Contrary to my initial hypothesis, the locale did not change the behaviour on that macOS/bash build, so I am not claiming the cause. The Windows check is the missing piece — see below.

Readings requested on Windows (this is the decisive control):
echo "LANG=[$LANG] LC_ALL=[$LC_ALL] LC_CTYPE=[$LC_CTYPE]"
locale
PS1='\w> '          # does the escaped form come back?
export LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8   # or C.UTF-8, whichever Git Bash ships
PS1='\w> '

Expected: the prompt persists the path in its original non-ASCII form (or at least the terminal shows readable CJK), like pwd does.
Actual: the prompt shows M-… escapes.
A code lead (read-only inspection of my local checkout): the terminal backend does not pass any locale to the shell. packages/terminal/terminal-bash/src/index.ts childEnvironment() (around :64-88) sets TERM: 'dumb', PAGER, GIT_PAGER, DSH_*, PS1, PROMPT_COMMAND — and no LANG/LC_ALL/LC_CTYPE; the environment is the subprocess provider's scrubbed ambient base, which on Windows has no locale variables. There is no other LC_ALL in packages/terminal/*, packages/api/terminal-controller or packages/subprocess/subprocess-local except Linux sandbox helpers pinning LC_ALL=C (subprocess-local/src/linux-scope.ts). Passing a UTF-8 locale for the terminal shell (or allowing a per-row env map) would be an upstream change; a third-party plugin cannot do it today because the terminal row's Config only carries shell.path / shell.name / shell.args.
Problem 2 — IME (pinyin) does not work in the terminal
Actual: typing pinyin in the DSH terminal does not produce characters (composition/candidate window does not commit text).
Not reproduced locally (the headless macOS environment has no IME), so this half is reported as observed behaviour plus a code-level pointer rather than a confirmed cause.
Code-level pointer: the terminal frontend is xterm.js (packages/client/ui-sidebar-terminal/src/client/terminal.tsx, new Terminal({…})), so composition handling is xterm's own; DSH's terminal code contains no composition* handling for the terminal surface — the only composition-aware code in that package is the title rename input (TerminalTitle.tsx, which skips Enter while isComposing is true). If the terminal's hidden textarea loses focus, is covered by an overlay, or the key handler swallows keyCode 229 / composition*, the IME never commits. Related reports exist for the chat input (#4233, #1417, #6138) but not for the terminal.
Impact
Any CJK (and generally non-ASCII) user who works in a directory with a localized name sees a mangled prompt, and cannot type their language into the terminal at all. The second one makes the terminal unusable for them, not just ugly.
Ask

Problem 1: is the terminal shell supposed to receive a UTF-8 locale (and would you accept passing one, or a per-row env map)? If the escaping is expected on Windows, is there a recommended shell-side setup?
Problem 2: is IME input in the sidebar terminal supposed to work today? If yes, any pointer to what handles composition there would help us aim the report.

Happy to run anything on Windows, or to provide the exact pty script and raw byte dumps.

threads.title: pnpm run clean fails out of the box on 0.1.7-rc.2: clean.ts rejects the desktop-keyboard-tests tsconfig outDir
threads.bodyText:
pnpm run clean fails out of the box on 0.1.7-rc.2
TL;DR
On a clean checkout of current master (dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2), pnpm run clean exits 1 before deleting anything:
$ pnpm run clean

clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types: lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.

The new tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json declares "outDir": "lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types", and scripts/clean.ts only accepts outDirs whose basename is types (plus one special-cased native entry), so plan-time validation throws and the tool never reaches deletion.
Why it matters
This is the recovery command that several threads prescribe for the class of failure where a version switch over a long-lived checkout leaves stale lib/ output that breaks the typert/tool layer — #7086 documents exactly that symptom and the standard pnpm run clean → pnpm install → pnpm run build procedure. With clean itself broken, that procedure is currently not executable; the only workaround is removing lib/ directories and *.tsbuildinfo files by hand.
Root cause

tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json was added in 6a82709a2b ("fix(shortcuts): preserve focus and tab layout, block overlay input", 09-22) with outDir: lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types.
Root tsconfig.json → tsconfig.client.json (reference at its line 46) → tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json, so the file is reachable from the graph RepositoryCleaner.buildOutputDirectories() walks.
That walk validates every reached outDir: basename(...) === 'types' or the native/system/packages/entry/lib exception; desktop-keyboard-test-types matches neither, so it throws before any target is collected.

Verified against current upstream master: scripts/clean.ts and the tsconfig are byte-identical in my tree, so this is not a fork artifact.
Suggested fixes
Either of:

Nest the outDir so it ends in /types (e.g. lib/desktop-keyboard-tests/types), keeping the clean.ts rule as-is; or
Extend buildOutputDirectories() with this outDir as an explicit exception, the way nativeEntryOutput already is.

Happy to send the one-liner for either direction if maintainers say which they prefer.

threads.title: Web 端闲置 Session 恢复卡住：模型目录正常，但 session/list 与 follow 超时
threads.bodyText:
环境与当前配置

官方仓库：deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness；本机源码分支 master，HEAD 为 46a7f68b09（2026-09-23）。
运行方式：本机 Web Host 监听 127.0.0.1:4280，由 dsh web --no-open --port 4280 启动；Remote Web UI、自动隧道和 relay 已启用，局域网访问要求配对。
默认模型：deepseek-official/deepseek-flash，reasoning effort 为 max。
模型 Provider：xiaomi（4 个 MiMo 模型：MiMo-V2.5、MiMo-V2.5-Pro、MiMo-V2.5-Pro-UltraSpeed、MiMo-V2.6-Pro；配置的 context window 为 1,048,576，max tokens 为 131,072）；newapi（1 个模型 gpt-6-astra，context window 为 1,000,000，max tokens 为 32,000）；deepseek-official（现场模型目录探针返回 2 个模型）。凭证和 Provider 地址未包含在本帖。
并发配置：maxParallelToolCalls: 90，maxActiveSubagents: 64。
systemd 未配置 MemoryMax、MemoryHigh 或 CPUQuota；TasksMax 为 230,950。

问题现象
只有已经活跃的 session 能正常交流。闲置一段时间后，其他 session 周期性刷新但无法恢复，模型选择列表也出不来，无法重新加入交流。
只读探针结果（2026-09-27）

settings/describe：正常，约 1.1 秒。
session/modelCatalog：HTTP 200，约 0.7 秒；3 个 Provider 共 7 个模型，未报告 Provider 失败。
session/list：等待 15 秒后超时。
对两条普通持久化 session 打开 /api/remote.mux 并请求 session/follow：WebSocket 握手成功，但 7 秒内均未收到首帧。
本机约有 2,531 条持久化 session 记录，合计约 0.87 GiB，最大单条约 40.5 MiB。未在帖子中包含 session ID、名称、对话内容或令牌。
主机有 24 个 CPU 线程、188 GiB RAM；采样时约 131 GiB 可用，2 GiB swap 中约 1.9 GiB 已用。系统负载约 37。没有证据表明 DSH 的 systemd CPU/内存硬限制已触顶。

当前判断与问题
模型目录接口本身能够快速返回，但持久化 session 列表和普通 session 的跟随流均超时。因此目前更怀疑闲置 session 的持久化枚举、冷恢复或 session 流初始化路径；根因尚未确认。主机同时有较高的整体负载，可能加重延迟。
请问在这种“活跃 session 正常、闲置 session 的列表/跟随流不返回，但全局 session/modelCatalog 正常”的情况下，维护者建议优先检查哪些 Host 日志或诊断入口？当前持久化 session 数量是否足以触发已知的 session/list 或冷恢复性能问题？
本帖只报告运行配置和脱敏后的接口探针，没有附带任何 API key、令牌、公开隧道 URL、session 标识或用户对话。

threads.title: First headless run of a newly-created profile hangs indefinitely (existing profiles and isolated DSH_HOMEs boot fine)
threads.bodyText:
Issue Draft (English) — 提交目标：deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

状态：草稿，待 Owner 过目后提交。原始 sample/lsof 抓取未单独存档（当时以结论形式
记入测评 SUMMARY）——若维护者需要，可按本文 Reproduction 节当场重抓附上。

Title: First headless run of a newly-created profile hangs indefinitely (existing profiles and isolated DSH_HOMEs boot fine)
Summary
On dsh 0.1.7-rc.2, the first headless invocation of a newly-created profile under a real
DSH_HOME (~/.dsh) hangs forever — no output, no error, no network activity, no child
processes. Previously-initialized profiles work normally, and a fresh isolated DSH_HOME
boots cleanly on first run, so the defect is specific to the "new profile inside an existing
home" path.
Reproduction

With a real ~/.dsh that already contains at least one working profile (e.g. headless):
Create a new profile (we did it via dsh plugin --profile sweep-x add <any-npm-plugin>,
which prints dsh: initialized profile sweep-x at ~/.dsh/profiles/sweep-x; an empty
profile created after a version-gate rejection reproduces it too).
Run dsh --profile sweep-x "<any prompt>" (headless).
Observe: the process hangs indefinitely (observed 30+ minutes before manual kill).

Reproduced with three independent new profiles (sweep-modlens, sweep-routing,
sweep-control — the last with no third-party plugins at all), plus sweep-min
(empty profile). Existing profiles in the same home keep working throughout.
What was ruled out

Network wait: lsof shows zero open connections from the hung process.
Child processes: pgrep -P empty — nothing forked that could be waited on.
stdin interaction: redirecting stdin from /dev/null changes nothing.
Sample stack: sample <pid> shows a pure event-loop idle wait — no meaningful frames.

(Symptoms consistent with a promise that never settles during first-run initialization —
e.g. an import/migration step that awaits something already satisfied in pre-existing
profiles and skipped entirely in fresh isolated homes.)
Environment

dsh: 0.1.7-rc.2 (built from source at 477b4f4, run via node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts)
OS: macOS (arm64) ｜ Node: v25.4.0 ｜ pnpm: 11.21.0
Registry: npmmirror (direct, no proxy) — but network was confirmed idle during the hang.

Expected vs actual
Expected: first run of a new profile initializes and proceeds like any subsequent run
(isolated-home first runs do exactly this).
Actual: indefinite hang with no diagnostic output; only SIGKILL recovers.
Notes

A version-compat gate elsewhere in the same build works correctly
(dsh plugin add @deepseek-ai/dsh-headless is properly rejected against 0.1.7-rc.2
with an allow-version hint), so profile machinery is not wholesale broken.
Happy to attach fresh sample/lsof captures or run a debug/instrumented build —
the repro is 100% deterministic on this machine.

threads.title: Scrolling bug
threads.bodyText: Scroll chaining in the prompt input: when the text in the input box is longer than the box and you scroll through it with the mouse wheel or touchpad, the scroll doesn't stop at the edges of the text. Once you reach the top of the prompt while scrolling up, any further scrolling moves the conversation instead, and you start going back through earlier messages. Scrolling down works the same way: after the end of the prompt, the message list keeps moving. Because of this, it's easy to lose your place in the conversation while you're only trying to read or edit a long prompt.

threads.title: [Bug] macOS: 硬运行时缺少麦克风 entitlement，语音输入被永久拒绝且不弹授权窗（无用户侧绕过方案）
threads.bodyText:
EN · 中文见下
Summary
On macOS, the shipped 0.1.7-rc.2 build is signed with Hardened Runtime but does not declare the com.apple.security.device.audio-input entitlement. As a result, macOS tccd treats microphone access as a hardened-runtime policy violation: it refuses to even show the permission prompt, and every capture request is denied outright. The user can never grant the permission — the toggle in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone never appears.
I verified that this is not a stale/missing TCC row: manually inserting an allow row into the user TCC database for the app's bundle id (auth_value=2) does not help, because the hardened-runtime entitlement check happens before the database is consulted. So this cannot be worked around from the user side.
Environment



Item
Value




App
DeepSeek Harness.app 0.1.7-rc.2 (official notarized build)


Bundle id
com.deepseek.dsh


Team ID
NAN929V4UM


macOS
26.6.2 (build 25G83), Apple Silicon (arm64)


Feature in use
voice input UI (dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle)



Evidence
1. Hardened runtime is enabled
$ codesign -dv --verbose=2 "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app"
Identifier=com.deepseek.dsh
TeamIdentifier=NAN929V4UM
CodeDirectory v=20500 size=444 flags=0x10000(runtime) hashes=3+7 location=embedded
                                             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ Hardened Runtime ON

2. The entitlements do not include audio input
$ codesign -d --entitlements - "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app"
com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit
com.apple.security.cs.allow-unsigned-executable-memory
com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation
# no com.apple.security.device.audio-input

Note that Info.plist does contain NSMicrophoneUsageDescription and NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription — so the intent to use the microphone is clearly there; only the entitlement is missing.
3. tccd denies without prompting (decisive)
tccd[6402] Prompting policy for hardened runtime; service: kTCCServiceMicrophone
  requires entitlement com.apple.security.device.audio-input but it is missing
  for responsible={identifier=com.deepseek.dsh, pid=35214,
     responsible_path=…/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness},
  accessing={identifier=com.deepseek.dsh.helper, pid=51318,
     binary_path=…/Frameworks/DeepSeek Harness Helper.app/Contents/MacOS/DeepSeek Harness Helper}

tccd[6402] Policy disallows prompt for Sub:{com.deepseek.dsh}
  → access to kTCCServiceMicrophone denied

Reproduced 15 times within a few minutes of normal UI usage (just invoking voice input). Both the main process and the audio.mojom.AudioService helper trigger it.
4. A TCC database entry is not sufficient (tested)
I added an allow row for kTCCServiceMicrophone / com.deepseek.dsh (client_type=0, auth_value=2, auth_reason=4) with a csreq blob compiled from the app's actual designated requirement:
$ codesign -d -r- "…/DeepSeek Harness.app"
designated => identifier "com.deepseek.dsh" and anchor apple generic
              and certificate 1[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.2.6] /* exists */
              and certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] /* exists */
              and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = NAN929V4UM

The row is structurally identical to working rows for other apps (e.g. Chrome's), and it survived a tccd reload — yet the app is still denied. That confirms the gate is the entitlement, not the database. (I removed the row afterwards to leave the machine in stock state.)
Suggested fix
Add the entitlement when packaging the macOS build, for both the main process and the helper that performs capture:
<key>com.apple.security.device.audio-input</key>
<true/>
then re-sign and re-notarize. After that, the normal macOS prompt will appear once, and the app will be listed under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
For Electron specifically, the actual capture happens in a helper process (…/Frameworks/<App> Helper.app), so the entitlement must be present there as well — the log above shows tccd blaming the responsible process (com.deepseek.dsh) while the accessing process is com.deepseek.dsh.helper, so both need it.

中文
摘要
macOS 官方构建 0.1.7-rc.2 启用了硬运行时（Hardened Runtime），但没有声明麦克风所需的 com.apple.security.device.audio-input entitlement。macOS 的 tccd 会把这种情况判定为「硬运行时策略违规」：连授权弹窗都不允许弹出，每次采集请求都被直接拒绝。用户永远无法授权——系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 麦克风 里根本不会出现这个 App。
已排除「TCC 数据库缺行」这一可能：手动为 App 的 bundle id 写入一条 允许 行（auth_value=2）同样无效，因为硬运行时的 entitlement 检查发生在查数据库之前。也就是说，这个 bug 用户侧无法绕过。
环境

App：DeepSeek Harness.app 0.1.7-rc.2（官方公证包），bundle id com.deepseek.dsh，Team NAN929V4UM
系统：macOS 26.6.2 (25G83)，Apple Silicon
使用场景：语音输入（dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle）

证据

codesign -dv --verbose=2 → flags=0x10000(runtime)，硬运行时已开
codesign -d --entitlements - → 只有 allow-jit / allow-unsigned-executable-memory / disable-library-validation 三条，没有 com.apple.security.device.audio-input（但 Info.plist 里 NSMicrophoneUsageDescription 是有的，说明只是漏了 entitlement）
tccd 日志：requires entitlement com.apple.security.device.audio-input but it is missing → Policy disallows prompt → denied，几分钟内复现 15 次
手动补 TCC 允许行（csreq 由该 App 的真实 designated requirement 编译而来，结构与其他可用 App 完全一致）仍然被拒 → 瓶颈是 entitlement，不是数据库

修复建议
打包时为主进程与执行采集的 helper 进程都加上：
<key>com.apple.security.device.audio-input</key>
<true/>
然后重新签名并公证。之后正常的系统授权弹窗会出现一次，App 也会出现在「隐私与安全性 → 麦克风」列表中。
Electron 场景要注意：实际采集发生在 helper 进程（…/Frameworks/<App> Helper.app），而日志显示 tccd 追责的是 responsible 进程（com.deepseek.dsh）、实际访问者是 com.deepseek.dsh.helper，所以两边都需要这条 entitlement。
