threads.title: [Windows] 桌面宿主把 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 传给 VS Code,导致「在本地打开」工作区失败(502 launch-failed)
threads.bodyText:
说明:本仓库 Issues 已关闭,故以 Discussion 提交。以下为完整缺陷报告(含环境、逐步复现、根因定位与建议修法);复现脚本与四轮对抗性复核结论见评论。

环境

DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2(D:\DSHHarness\DeepSeek Harness.exe,FileVersion 0.1.7-rc.2)
Windows 11 Pro 10.0.22631 x64
VS Code 1.137.0(commit 645f29cc3176500b4b5762ba887cf2a7f0ffdf2c,x64,per-user 安装:%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe)
涉及包(均在 app.asar 内 dsh/node_modules/):@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app@0.1.7-rc.2、@deepseek-ai/dsh-native-command@0.1.7-rc.2、@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess@0.1.7-rc.2、@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.7-rc.2

现象
会话头右侧「在本地打开」分键按钮(槽位 conversation.session.header.utilities,registrant open-in-app)选择
VS Code 后:未出现预期的工作区窗口,启动进程约 40 ms 后自行退出,界面提示「打开失败，请重试」。
宿主路由 POST /open-in-app/open {"app":"vscode","path":"<workspace>"} 返回
502 {"code":"launch-failed","message":"failed to launch vscode"}。
关于 200 的语义(避免误读):launchDetachedApp 有两个 resolve 条件 —— ①子进程 exit 0;②看护窗口
(launchWatchMs)到期时子进程仍在运行。因此 200 只代表"判定为已启动",不保证 GUI 真的打开;
本例是明确收到 502。
复现
(1) 最小复现 —— 纯 Windows,不依赖 DSH(在带该变量的环境中执行):
set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe" "H:\Harness"
echo %ERRORLEVEL%
:: → 1,耗时约 40 ms
stderr:
Error: Cannot find module 'H:\Harness'
    at Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1524:15)
    ...
    at node:electron/js2c/node_init:2:18159

(2) 环境有/无对照(用归档脚本 env-toggle-proof.mjs;目标默认取一个新建的空目录,
以排除目录内可执行入口的干扰;两次使用同一目标,只改变环境变量):
node env-toggle-proof.mjs "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe"
# ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1      -> exit 1 (FAILED)          ← Node 模式
# ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE unset  -> exit 0 / 到期仍在运行     ← 启动判定通过(GUI 是否打开需另行观察)
(3) 变量的作用(交叉印证):
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe" --version
:: → v24.18.1                     ← Node 的版本,不是 VS Code 的
"%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\bin\code.cmd" --version
:: → 1.137.0 / 645f29cc3176500b4b5762ba887cf2a7f0ffdf2c / x64
(4) UI 复现:桌面端打开任一工作区会话 → 点会话头右侧「在本地打开」→ 菜单选 VS Code。
根因


宿主进程自身带着该变量(实测,非推断)。桌面壳以 Electron 的 Node 模式派生核心宿主:
asar 根 lib/main.js 的 desktopNodeEnvironment(executable, bin, environment) 返回
{ ...environment, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1", ... }(注释即 "Environment for a Node-mode child process")。
在宿主进程(监听 127.0.0.1:19387 的那个进程,本机 PID 70924)内部读到的实测值:
{ "pid": 70924, "action": "removed", "before": "1", "after": null }
(该记录只证明当时的状态,不是实时证明。)


GUI 启动器原样继承。@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app 的运行时入口是 lib/index.js
(package.json 的 exports["."].default);launchDetachedApp 内联在该文件 第 348 行,
第 8 行 import { scrubbedParentEnv } from "@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess":
const env = { ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...options.env };


scrubbedParentEnv() 不剔除 Electron 模式变量。@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess/lib/index.js
第 32 行 const SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN = /KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i;,第 52 行遍历时另丢弃
DSH_* 前缀并处理代理变量 —— ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 不在其中。


启动失败被判定为错误:同一函数中 child.on('exit', ...) 对看护窗口内的非 0 退出 reject;
open 路由据此 sendJson(res, 502, { code: "launch-failed", ... })。


VS Code 在本机由目录表解析为
spec(appPaths('Code.exe'), installRecord('Microsoft Visual Studio Code', 'Code.exe'), file([...]))
(目录表 vscode 条目),即直接启动 exe,因此命中上面整条链。
本机 HKCU\...\App Paths\Code.exe 存在、Code.exe 存在 —— 解析本身是健康的。


⚠️ 修复边界:不要在宿主全局删除该变量
我们最初的临时变通是"在宿主里 delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE",它打断了经 Windows Job runner 的命令执行。
前提限定:以下结论适用于本次这种 Electron Node 模式宿主 + 当前 Windows Job runner 实现;
不涵盖直接调用其它可执行文件、其它 provider、或不同宿主启动方式的情形。
源码链(已逐处核对):

@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner-launch-B2zsQ1Dz.js
1311–1316 行:Windows runner 以 process.execPath(即桌面 Electron 可执行文件)+ runner 脚本启动;
694–695 行:childEnv() → scrubbedParentEnv();
1343–1345 行:runnerEnvironment() 取 childEnv(),没有显式补回 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js
601 行:env: runnerEnvironment(WINDOWS_RUNNER_SELECTION, invocation);
629 行:subprocess-local: Windows Job runner exited with ${status} before proving its managed range empty。

实测后果(删除该变量之后的同一会话内):实测经该 runner 的 pwsh 工具与 grep 工具内部 ripgrep 调用均失败 ——
两者都返回上面第 629 行那句(退出码 0、无残留进程,符合"runner 以 GUI 入口启动、未履行 IPC 协议即退出")。
其它调用未逐一验证,不作断言。
建议修法


应用启动边界(本 issue 的直接修复) —— launchDetachedApp(lib/index.js:348,并同步其源文件):
先清理继承值,再合并适配器的显式值,以保留 GitHub Desktop cli.js 适配器的显式 opt-in:
const inherited = scrubbedParentEnv();
for (const key of Object.keys(inherited)) {
  if (key.toUpperCase() === 'ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE') delete inherited[key];
}
const env = { ...inherited, ...options.env };


内部 runner 显式声明 Node 模式(独立加固) —— 在 runnerEnvironment() 中为"以 Electron 可执行文件启动
Node runner"的路径显式提供该变量。需注意的边界:

Windows 环境键大小写不敏感,避免产生重复键;
确认这项 bootstrap 设置不会被带进目标应用的环境(只作用于 runner);
runnerEnvironment() 也服务其它启动路径,不能仅凭本次 Windows 反例认定无条件补值已完整验证。



回归要求(建议随修复一起给出):

GUI 子进程环境已清理(启动器不再收到该变量);
适配器显式 opt-in 仍保留(GitHub Desktop cli.js 一路仍以 Node 模式运行);
宿主自身环境不被修改(process.env 不因启动应用而改变);
宿主缺少该变量时,runner 的握手与目标命令仍然成功(这条正是本次反例的回归测试)。



关于改哪里:lib/index.js 与 lib/types/resolver.js 是生成产物(后者是同实现的副本),
本次引用它们只为定位受影响产物;正解是在源文件中修改并重新构建,不宜要求维护者手工维护两份生成代码。


不建议用调整 launchWatchMs 来掩盖:增大窗口能覆盖更多较晚发生的失败,但不能修复 Node 模式导致的退出
(本例 42 ms 就结束了);缩短窗口则可能提前判定成功,同样不代表 GUI 已打开。
影响面(收窄后的表述)

本机实测:VS Code 在 Windows 桌面端必失败。
机制上可能同样受影响(未逐一实测):凡"被目录表以 App Paths\*.exe 直接启动、且自身尊重该变量"的
Electron 应用 —— 目录表中的 VS Code Insiders、Cursor、Windsurf 属此形态。
机制上可豁免:Electron 应用若关闭了 runAsNode fuse,会忽略该变量(官方文档:
https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/api/environment-variables#electron_run_as_node),故不做"所有 Electron 应用必失败"的断言。
未验证:非 Electron 条目(JetBrains 系、Sublime、Windows Terminal、shell-open 走 explorer.exe)——
不直接受此机制影响,但未逐项实测。macOS / Linux 未验证。

threads.title: Desktop: image attachments re-encoded to webp in attachment store cause 400 'url' field must be a base64 encoded image with OpenAI-compatible local providers, and the poisoned image block stays in session history so later text-only messages also fail
threads.bodyText:
Bug
Image attachments in the DSH desktop client are stored in webp format, so any
image the user attaches produces a webp data-url image block. OpenAI-compatible
local providers (tested: LM Studio) reject webp data-urls with
400 "'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.", so every message that
contains such an attachment fails with INVALID_REQUEST.
Even worse: the bad image block remains in the session history, and each request
replays the whole history — so even subsequent text-only messages in the same
session keep returning 400 until the user starts a new session.
Environment

DSH desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 (Windows)
Provider: OpenAI-compatible local endpoint (http://<lan-ip>:1234/v1, LM Studio)
Model: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-mtp (vision-capable; input: [text, image])

Reproduction


In a new DSH desktop session, attach a PNG image (1024x1024, ~330 KB).


Send any message — request fails with:
400 "'url' field must be a base64 encoded image." (code: INVALID_REQUEST)


Observe the stored attachment object under
~/.dsh/attachments/v1/objects/...: the file is a webp (330476 bytes,
1024x1024) although the attachment's name is still ...png.


In the same session, send a text-only message (e.g. "hello") — it fails
with the same 400, because the session history is replayed with the bad
attachment block included:
{"type":"image","attachment":{"attachmentId":"sha256:...","mediaType":"image/webp","width":1024,"height":1024,"bytes":330476,"name":"红军小战士.png"}}


Evidence

Format mismatch: the on-disk attachment object is webp while the
attachment metadata says .png; the image block sent to the provider
carries mediaType: image/webp.
Provider acceptance: sending the same image as a PNG data-url directly to
the provider returns 200 and the model correctly describes the image content
(prompt_tokens includes the image). Sending the webp data-url returns the
400 above. So the provider accepts PNG/JPEG data-urls and rejects webp.
History poisoning: session 273b77bb timeline (from
~/.dsh/sessions/.../session.v4.jsonl.zstd):

user sends the image path -> 400 INVALID_REQUEST
user then sends the plain text "你好" (hello) -> still 400 INVALID_REQUEST
every request replays the full session history including the bad webp
attachment block, so the whole session is unusable.



Impact

Any attached image makes the session unusable with OpenAI-compatible local
providers that only accept PNG/JPEG data-urls.
The poisoning is silent: the user sees "just a text message" failing with an
image-related error and has no way to know why.
The only workaround is starting a new session and avoiding the attachment
pipeline (e.g. giving the agent a file path and letting it read the file
itself).

Suggestions

Do not transcode uploaded images to webp in the attachment store; keep the
original format (or at least keep PNG/JPEG when the target provider is
OpenAI-compatible).
If transcoding is required, validate the format against what the provider
accepts, and surface the conversion to the user.
A failed request caused by a bad attachment block should not permanently
poison the session; consider dropping/repairing the block or clearly telling
the user which attachment broke the session.

Related

Similar symptom (empty url in image blocks -> 400 Invalid url.) in Cherry
Studio's built-in gateway: CherryHQ/cherry-studio#21081. Different signature,
likely different code path, but the same user-visible failure class (image
block serialization breaks requests to local OpenAI-compatible providers).

threads.title: [Bug] 会话持久化的 live 写缓冲无上限增长：`dsh web` 进程 RSS 涨到 14.7 GB（0.1.7-rc.2 / Windows）
threads.bodyText:
概要
在分发智能体团队（subagent）任务期间，dsh web 服务端内存从约 3 GB 涨到 14.7 GB，约 2.5 分钟内必须人工杀掉。对运行中进程做采样堆剖析 + 阅读源码后，问题指向 JsonlSessionHandle 的 live 写缓冲（packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/storage.ts）：

每个发布的 session/event 都会 structuredClone 一份、push 进无上限的 buffered: SessionEvent[]；
只要有一次 drain（批量写盘）失败，就会置 drainPaused，enqueueLive 之后不再装批量定时器，唯一的重试机会只剩 session/flush（通常发生在回合结束），而事件仍在持续累积。

环境









dsh
0.1.7-rc.2（next），npm 全局安装


Node
v22.23.3，npm 10.9.9


系统
Windows 11 专业版 Insider Preview 10.0.29667（build 29667），x64


内存
47.4 GB


Profile
官方 web app + 第三方插件（含 experimental agent-team 系列 bundle）


触发条件
在会话里分发团队 / subagent 任务（session/event 速率大幅升高）



现场一：进程自行 OOM 退出
1812440 ms: Mark-Compact 4029.6 (4131.4) -> 3998.1 (4131.9) MB, pooled: 0 MB, 627.10 / 0.00 ms
1813081 ms: Mark-Compact 4030.2 (4131.9) -> 3998.7 (4132.4) MB, pooled: 0 MB, 601.67 / 0.00 ms
FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory

现场二：重启后复现，每 15 s 采样的 RSS
23:19:40  RSS=  3029 MB
23:19:55  RSS=  3332 MB   (+1209 MB/min)
23:20:10  RSS=  3675 MB   (+1371 MB/min)
23:20:25  RSS=  3877 MB
23:21:10  RSS=  4234 MB
23:21:40  RSS=  5767 MB   (+5801 MB/min)
23:21:55  RSS= 10329 MB   (+18210 MB/min)
23:22:05  RSS= 14703 MB   -> 人工杀掉（当时系统可用内存只剩 18.5 GB）

补充观察：

末尾阶段 CPU 时间每 15 s 增加约 47 s（约 3 个核在自旋），符合"反复整批复制 / 重试"的特征；
最新的 session 文件 session.v4.jsonl.zstd 的最后写入时间是 23:17:16，之后约 4 分钟没有任何落盘，而 session/event 仍在产生——说明 live 写管道早已堵住，缓冲只进不出。

证据一：运行中进程的采样堆剖析
我用 process._debugProcess(pid) 从另一个 Node 进程附加 inspector，然后 HeapProfiler.enable + HeapProfiler.startSampling（64 KiB 采样间隔，持续 12 s）+ HeapProfiler.stopSampling。由于采样剖析只统计 startSampling 之后产生的分配，下表是新增且仍然存活的字节数：
total sampled = 174.0 MB over 12 s  (~870 MB/min，与观测到的 RSS 斜率一致)

   65.4 MB  (anon) @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:408   <- ctx.on('session/event') -> enqueueLive
   23.9 MB  walkJsonValue @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-util-values/lib/index.js:46
   16.4 MB  append @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/lib/index.js:1401
   15.1 MB  checkpoint @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection/lib/index.js:196
    9.7 MB  (anon) @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/index.js:2339
    6.9 MB  drive @ .../@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection/lib/index.js:402

其中 dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 的 line 408 对应编译产物里的 install() 路由：ctx.on('session/event', (session, event) => this.writers.get(session.id)?.enqueueLive(event, ...))。
证据二：源码
packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/storage.ts：
 89:  /** Routed live events awaiting their batching deadline (persistence-owned copies). */
 90:  private buffered: SessionEvent[] = []
 91:  private batchTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
 92:  /** Set when a drain failed; the automatic timer stays quiet until the next drain. */
 93:  private drainPaused = false
...
274:  enqueueLive(event: SessionEvent, reportBackgroundFailure: (error: unknown) => void): void {
275:    this.buffered.push(structuredClone(event))
276:    if (this.batchTimer !== undefined || this.drainPaused) return
277:    this.batchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
278:      this.batchTimer = undefined
279:      this.drainLive().catch(reportBackgroundFailure)
280:    }, LIVE_WRITE_BATCH_MAX_DELAY_MS)          // 200 ms，见 :36
281:  }
...
288:  drainLive(): Promise<void> {
289:    return this.draining ??= this.drainBuffered().finally(() => { this.draining = undefined })
292:  }
...
294:  private async drainBuffered(): Promise<void> {
299:    this.drainPaused = false
300:    while (this.buffered.length > 0) {
303:      await this.enqueueChain(async () => {
306:        const batch = this.buffered.splice(0)
307:        try {
308:          await this.persistContiguous(materializeAppendBatch(batch))
309:        } catch (error: unknown) {
310:          this.buffered = batch.concat(this.buffered)
311:          this.drainPaused = true
312:          throw error
313:        }
314:      })
315:    }
316:  }
...
534:  install(ctx: Context): void {
535:    ctx.on('session/event', (session: Session, event) => {
536:      this.writers.get(session.id)?.enqueueLive(event, (error) => {
537:        ctx.logger.warn(`session-persistence: background write for session "${session.id}" failed (buffered events retained): ${String(error)}`)
538:      })
539:    })

分析

没有上限、没有背压。 只要 drain 跟不上（磁盘/杀软慢、fsync 延迟、并发会话多，或 subagent 活动突发），buffered 就会随事件速率持续增长。
每个事件都 structuredClone，使每个被保留的事件占两份内存。
一次 drain 失败就永久断掉自动重试。 失败后置 drainPaused = true（:311），enqueueLive 在 :276 直接 return、不再装定时器；唯一剩下的重试是 session/flush（:540），实践中要等回合结束。于是这一回合剩下的时间里，缓冲就是一个无上限、不排空的队列——正是 :537 那句 "buffered events retained" 警告所描述的状态。
回塞会复制整个缓冲区。 batch.concat(this.buffered) 会复制已缓冲的全部事件；重复重试会在"已保留"之上再叠加大量瞬时分配，这与现场二里 GB/min 级的尖峰和 3 核自旋吻合。
团队 / subagent 任务只是扳机：它把 session/event 的速率放大，从而触发 1–4。

影响

严重级别：高。一次团队任务就能让 dsh web 服务端硬 OOM（现场一），或吃掉大部分系统内存并让整机抖动（现场二：14.7 GB、+18 GB/min，仅剩 18.5 GB 可用）。
内存暴涨期间磁盘持久化停滞，该会话在失控过程中没有可靠的落盘检查点。
并非团队功能独有：任何超过 live 写路径处理能力的 session/event 突发都可能触发。

threads.title: Compaction aborts with "session surface changed during summarization" when a plugin appends events mid-summarization; the session then dies at "pi-ai detected context overflow" with no recovery path
threads.bodyText:
Environment

DeepSeek Harness: served tree 0.1.5-rc.2 (rev 4984b2a) + dev 0.1.7-rc.2 (477b4f4); macOS 15 (arm), Node 22/24 era.
Provider: zai-coding-plan / glm-5.3-flash, declared contextWindow: 262144, maxTokens: 32768 (auto-compaction threshold 0.8 × window ≈ 210k).
Session with heavy multimodal history (images), long-lived, active tool traffic.
Local OpenViking memory integration active (autoCommitOnCompact — an OV boundary-commit notice is appended as a user/message event at compaction start; 66 such notices in this session).

Observed behavior

Context crossed the auto-compaction threshold. Every compaction attempt then aborted:
compaction/end { ..., error: "compaction: session surface changed during summarization" }
Reproduced 9+ times across turns 44–45 (seqs 3178, 3188, 3196, 3204, 3212, 3220, 3238, ...).
In every aborted bracket, an OV boundary-commit notice event lands between compaction/start and compaction/end (pattern 1:1 on all failures). The summarization runs ~60–100 s while the session keeps appending events, so the surface-changed guard always trips.
Each step of an active turn therefore pays a failed-compaction tax (~60–100 s + an LLM summarize call) while the context never shrinks.
Endgame: compaction/end { error: "pi-ai detected context overflow for model \"glm-5.3-flash\"" } (seq 3244) → turn/end { reason: { kind: "error" } } (seq 3246). The session is now unrecoverable in place: every request overflows, including the summarize call that compaction itself needs.

Same pattern in a second session (systemic, not session-specific)
A concurrently active worker session showed the identical compaction/start → OV notice → (abort) bracket at seq 1287–1288 while under moderate context load.
Root cause (confirmed by code reading + log forensics)
Code reading locates two sides of the race:

The compaction surface guard: packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts:423 (0.1.5-rc.2; the same guard sits at region.ts:438 in 0.2.1-alpha.1 — independently confirmed by @PerryLink) performs a deep-strict comparison of the session surface captured at compaction/start against the surface at commit time (a span-local comparison alternative exists at region.ts:432-453, 0.1.5-rc.2). ANY appended event between start and end disqualifies the compaction.
The injecting side: our OpenViking memory integration appends its boundary-commit notice (a user/message event) at compaction start (pre-fix anchor: runtime.mjs:283, append at :285-288) — commit-on-compaction-start is a documented integration point.
Together: an actively working session with plugin traffic always appends during the ~60–100 s summarization window, so the guard trips every time and the session converges to a state where compaction can never succeed. Additionally, pi-ai's overflow detection (packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:106-116 @ 0.1.5-rc.2 — the mapStopReason overflow mapping; the exact error string sits at :115) has no recovery hook — once prompt > window, every request fails, including the summarize call compaction itself needs, so the session cannot self-heal.

Update 2026-10-06: the plugin-side fix has shipped — the boundary-commit notice is now queued, and flushBoundaryNotice appends it after compaction/end, so this injector no longer appends mid-summarization. The upstream guard behavior (abort on surface change, no bounded retry, no overflow recovery) is unchanged and remains the subject of this report.
Proposed directions (for discussion)

a) Guard tolerance: exempt ignorable: true / checkpoint-class events from the deep-strict surface comparison in region.ts, or compare only the model-visible surface.
b) Bounded retry: on surface change, retry summarization once against the refreshed surface before aborting.
c) Overflow recovery ladder: at the stream.ts overflow detection point, run a forced shrink path (drop/summarize oldest tool results) or surface an actionable recovery hook instead of a dead turn — today there is no in-place recovery once prompt > window.
d) Integration guidance: document that commit-on-compaction-start injectors must defer log appends until after compaction/end (shipped on the plugin side — verified: notice queued, flushBoundaryNotice appends after compaction/end).

Evidence availability
Full session log (zstd, ~3.3 MB, append-only, untouched), seq-level event chain, and a reference implementation on our fork can be shared on request. Happy to provide additional traces.
Update 2026-10-06: @PerryLink independently confirmed the guard anchor and the exact error string on dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.1 (region.ts:438); our served tree pins the same guard at region.ts:423 (0.1.5-rc.2) — the guard spans both versions.
Posted by Almaz (almazom) — long-running DSH fleet operator.

threads.title: macOS: Voice input cannot reach the microphone — app ships without com.apple.security.device.audio-input
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On macOS the Voice input bundle can never obtain microphone access. Clicking the microphone in the composer shows "Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings." No macOS permission prompt is ever presented, and enabling the toggle in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone does not help. The packaged app and both helpers are signed with the hardened runtime but do not carry the com.apple.security.device.audio-input entitlement, which macOS requires for microphone access under that runtime.
Environment

DeepSeek Harness (Desktop) 0.1.7-rc.2 (0.1.7-rc.2.20260924.1)
macOS 27.2 (build 26B5091g), Apple Silicon (arm64)
Voice input bundle 0.1.7-rc.2 (Experimental)

The bundle itself reports healthy: all 4 components "Running", and "Local resources are prepared. Recording wakes the recognizer." with SenseVoiceSmall (INT8) selected.
Steps to reproduce

Plugins → enable Voice input.
Confirm it reports ready (4/4 components running, local resources prepared).
Click the microphone between the model selector and Send.

Expected: the recording toolbar opens (prompting for microphone permission on first use if needed).
Actual: "Microphone access is disabled. Allow it in browser and system settings." No system permission dialog is ever shown, and no System Settings change grants access.
Evidence
The app runs with the hardened runtime:
$ codesign -dv --verbose=2 "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app"
CodeDirectory v=20500 size=444 flags=0x10000(runtime) hashes=3+7 location=embedded

Its entitlements contain no audio input:
$ codesign -d --entitlements - "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app"
[Dict]
    com.apple.security.cs.allow-jit
    com.apple.security.cs.allow-unsigned-executable-memory
    com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation
    (no com.apple.security.device.audio-input)

The same holds for both helper bundles:
Contents/Frameworks/DeepSeek Harness Helper (Renderer).app   -> audio-input: absent
Contents/Frameworks/DeepSeek Harness Helper.app              -> audio-input: absent

NSMicrophoneUsageDescription is present in Info.plist:

"DeepSeek Harness uses your microphone to transcribe speech into message drafts."

So microphone support was clearly intended — the entitlement is the missing half.
Why this is the cause
Under the hardened runtime, macOS requires com.apple.security.device.audio-input before a process may use the microphone. Without it the request can never succeed: no TCC prompt appears, and no user-side setting can grant access. This also explains the misleading UI copy, which sends users to a setting that cannot fix the problem.
Suggested fix
Add com.apple.security.device.audio-input to the entitlements used when signing the main app and the Renderer/Helper bundles, then re-sign and re-notarize.
Workaround
macOS Dictation (System Settings → Keyboard → Dictation) works in the composer and does not depend on the app.
中文摘要
macOS 上「語音輸入」外掛無法取得麥克風權限。按下麥克風只顯示 "Microphone access is disabled"，系統從未彈出權限詢問，在系統設定中開啟亦無效。原因：app 以 hardened runtime 簽署，但主程式與兩個 Helper 都未包含 com.apple.security.device.audio-input。NSMicrophoneUsageDescription 已存在，應為漏加 entitlement。建議補上後重新簽署與公證。

threads.bodyText:

threads.title: `llm-pi-ai` never forwards the harness session id, so OpenCode's Go endpoint rejects every request with `400 MissingSessionID`
threads.bodyText:
Component: packages/llm/llm-pi-ai (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai)
Versions: @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai@0.1.7-rc.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm@0.1.7-rc.2, @earendil-works/pi-ai@0.85.1
Verified against: OpenCode Zen Go endpoint, live, with the fix in place (details below)

Summary
OpenCode's Go endpoint (https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1) routes and caches by a per-conversation
x-opencode-session header, and rejects a request that omits it:
400: {"type":"MissingSessionID","message":"Request is missing x-opencode-session and cannot be routed efficiently. Please see https://opencode.ai/docs/go/#where-can-i-use-it"}

The harness does hand a per-conversation session id to the adapter, and the adapter passes it to
pi-ai — but nothing on either side ever emits that header name. OpenCode already lists us for it:
their Go documentation "Known Problematic Clients" table names
DeepSeek Harness — "Session information arrives on some model paths, but is missing on others.
We recognize its native header; the remaining work is to send it across all adapters."
Why configuration cannot fix it
providers.<route>.headers resolves once, when the profile is built, and is typed as static
strings (src/config.ts: headers: z.dict(z.string())). Per-request headers are assembled from it
with no per-call input (src/adapter.ts):
/** Merge deployment headers while removing case-insensitive attribution collisions. */
function requestHeaders(headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | undefined): Record<string, string> {
  const attribution = attributionHeaders()
  const reserved = new Set(Object.keys(attribution).map(name => name.toLowerCase()))
  return {
    ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(headers ?? {}).filter(([name]) => !reserved.has(name.toLowerCase()))),
    ...attribution,
  }
}
The session id travels a different path, into pi-ai's own option:
...options.sessionId === undefined ? {} : { sessionId: String(options.sessionId) },
signal: watchdog.signal,
headers: requestHeaders(profile.headers),
pi-ai then emits only its own affinity names, and only behind a compat flag that is off by default
(@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.85.1, dist/api/openai-completions.js):
if (sessionId && compat.sendSessionAffinityHeaders) {
    if (compat.sessionSessionAffinityFormat === "openrouter") { headers["x-session-id"] = sessionId }
    else {
        if (compat.sessionAffinityFormat === "openai") { headers.session_id = sessionId }
        headers["x-client-request-id"] = sessionId;
        headers["x-session-affinity"] = sessionId;
    }
}
A static value supplied through providers.<route>.headers does silence the 400, but it collapses
every conversation onto one id, defeating the routing and prompt-caching purpose of the header.
Minimal reproduction
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      opencode-go:
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
        apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY
        models:
          - id: deepseek-v4.1-flash
Start a session on opencode-go / deepseek-v4.1-flash and send any message.
Expected: the request succeeds (the subscription is funded; GET /zen/go/v1/models answers 200
and lists deepseek-v4.1-flash).
Actual: 400 MissingSessionID.
Proposed change
Resolve a route header whose value is exactly $sessionId at send time from the request's session
id, and omit that header when the request carries no session instead of sending the token literally:
const SESSION_ID_HEADER_TOKEN = '$sessionId'

function requestHeaders(headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>> | undefined, sessionId: string | undefined): Record<string, string> {
  const attribution = attributionHeaders()
  const reserved = new Set(Object.keys(attribution).map(name => name.toLowerCase()))
  const deployment = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(headers ?? {}).flatMap(([name, value]) => value === SESSION_ID_HEADER_TOKEN
    ? sessionId === undefined ? [] : [[name, sessionId]]
    : [[name, value]]))
  return {
    ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(deployment).filter(([name]) => !reserved.has(name.toLowerCase()))),
    ...attribution,
  }
}
with the dispatch call site passing the session id:
headers: requestHeaders(profile.headers, options.sessionId === undefined ? undefined : String(options.sessionId)),
and headers JSDoc in src/config.ts documenting the token alongside the Fetch-validation and
reserved-name rules it already states.
The route then reads:
        headers:
          x-opencode-session: $sessionId
Verification performed by the reporter (fork of master, 21638c5)
Against the real endpoint, using the repository's own source through ctx.plugin(...), one
streamed completion on opencode-go / deepseek-v4.1-flash, with a personal Go-plan credential
(no credential material appears in this report):

request URL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/chat/completions
outgoing session header: x-opencode-session: <that request's session id> (the token
resolved to the session id passed by the caller)
outcome: model returned text ("OK"), stream completed with finish + usage
(reasoning_tokens: 23)

Focused checks, all green:

packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/*.spec.ts — 14 files, 342 tests passed
three added behaviour tests (per-request resolution across two sessions; header omitted when the
request carries no session; a literal value that merely resembles the token is untouched),
confirmed meaningful by disabling the substitution and observing exactly the two intended
failures (expected [ '$sessionId', '$sessionId' ] to deeply equal [ 'first-session', 'second-session' ]
and the missing-header assertion)
pnpm run verify-config-catalog — up to date after regenerating (the JSDoc edit is its input)
oxlint — 0 warnings, 0 errors on the changed files

Acceptance
With this change, a route configured as above serves OpenCode's Go endpoint with a distinct, stable
per-conversation id, matching what OpenCode's documentation expects from a coding-agent client.

threads.title: dsh-workspace-changes 在 tmpfs /tmp 上堆积数 GB tmp_pack_*`，打包在同一位置反复失败（0.1.7-rc.2）
threads.bodyText:
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.7-rc.2（dsh-workspace-changes 0.1.7-rc.2），dsh web 模式
Linux（KDE），/tmp 为 tmpfs（16G 上限），物理内存 32G
工作区内含较大的非 gitignore 二进制文件

现象
每次提交工作区更改后，/tmp/dsh-workspace-changes-<id>/objects/pack/ 下都会留下一个约 1.9G 的 tmp_pack_* 半成品文件，且没有任何正式 pack 生成。
对比多次失败产物，大小几乎完全一致（1,948,909,580 与 1,948,940,652 字节，仅差 31KB），说明是确定性失败——每次都在打包到同一个对象时中断，疑似在固定位置崩溃或被超时杀死。
半天内积累了 5 个此类文件，共约 7G。由于 /tmp 是 tmpfs，这些文件直接占用物理内存（free 显示 used 17G，其中 shared 7.6G），重启 dsh 也不会清理。
/tmp/dsh-workspace-changes-UhOPq4/objects/pack/
├── tmp_pack_8nEZxr   1,948,909,580 bytes  (16:33, 已死)
├── tmp_pack_D3ubOZ   1,819,541,516 bytes  (15:04, 已死)
└── tmp_pack_gtZyN0   1,948,940,652 bytes  (15:09, 已死)

/tmp/dsh-workspace-changes-EyY8qx/objects/pack/
├── tmp_pack_KUVdFS     720M              (11:23, 已死)
└── tmp_pack_nwfwOO     797M              (11:24, 已死)

源码层面的观察

dsh-workspace-changes/lib/index.js:1067：tempRoot: tmpdir() —— 快照默认落在系统临时目录。在 /tmp 为 tmpfs 的发行版（Fedora 系默认）上，GB 级快照等于直接吃内存。
recorder.js 的清理只在 dispose()（优雅退出）时执行，异常路径/被杀进程留下的目录无人回收，且 tmp_pack_* 从未生效却没有 stale 清理逻辑。
snapshotTree() 会完整复制工作树（含未跟踪文件，仅排除 gitignored），没有单文件大小上限，遇到大文件时快照膨胀到 GB 级。

threads.title: 【Bug】桌面端-会话头部「打开位置 → 文件资源管理器」报成功但什么都没打开（静默空转）
threads.bodyText:
分类：Q&A ｜ 平台：Windows 11 x64，Harness 桌面版 0.1.7-rc.2（Electron 39.8.5）
现象
会话标题栏右上角的分体按钮 → 「文件资源管理器」，点下去完全没有反应：

前台没有新窗口，应用后面没有，任务栏也没有；
界面也没有任何反馈——没有报错、没有提示、没有 toast；
反复点都一样。

排除了"窗口开在应用后面"这种可能：点击后不存在任何新的资源管理器窗口或进程。
对照
同一个会话里手动打开同一个目录，立刻正常出窗口：
& "$env:SystemRoot\explorer.exe" "D:\…\deepseek harness"

%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Recent\ 里也会同步生成该目录的 .lnk 并更新跳转列表。
所以目录、路径形式、explorer.exe、桌面会话都正常，问题只在"从这里点出去"这条路径。
期望
应该实现点击后就打开资源管理器，没有真正打开时不要报成功：应当返回失败并让控件给出提示（哪怕只是"已请求打开"），而不是静默。
判断（供参考）
POST /open-in-app/open 只在 outcome === 'launched' 时回 200，而 runShellOpen()
（packages/host/open-in-app/src/resolver.ts）把看护窗口超时也算成功、并吞掉迟到的错误；
Windows 侧 runExplorer()（packages/util/native-command/src/path-opener.ts）又把 Explorer 的
**退出码 1 当作"已交接"**接受。于是"什么都没发生"走不到失败分支，路由回 200，
而前端只在非 2xx 时才提示 —— 两边叠加就成了静默空转。
同一套判定也覆盖 macOS 的 finder、桌面 Linux 的 xdg-open，以及文档预览里的「显示文件位置」。

threads.title: pnpm run clean fails on v0.1.7-rc.2: "expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types: lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types"
threads.bodyText:
Clean script fails on a fresh rc.2 checkout
Version: tag dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2 (477b4f4), clean checkout, pnpm install done. pnpm 11.7, Node 22.20.
Repro:
$ pnpm run clean
clean: expected TypeScript outDir to end in /types: lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.

Cause: tsconfig.desktop-keyboard-tests.json (added in 6a82709) declares "outDir": "lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types" (emitDeclarationOnly keyboard-test fixture) and is reachable from the root project-reference graph via tsconfig.client.json. scripts/clean.ts buildOutputDirectories() accepts only two forms of outDir: basename types, or the native entry output — any other name throws.
So on every fresh rc.2 checkout pnpm run clean is broken (and stale lib/ from a previous version cannot be cleaned by the script — the exact scenario clean exists for).
Expected: the planner either removes this outDir as well (deleting lib/desktop-keyboard-test-types), or has an allowlist for test-fixture outDirs.
Workaround: manually remove gitignored lib/ directories plus root-level *.tsbuildinfo (replicating the clean plan by hand), then pnpm run build succeeds (exit 0, 343 client artifacts).

threads.title: WS close semantics change in 0.1.7-rc.2 webserver: invalid /api/remote.mux clients destroyed without close frames (was 1008/1003)
threads.bodyText:
WS close semantics change in rc.2 webserver (mux endpoint)
Version: tag dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2 (477b4f4), web profile, ws endpoint wss://…/api/remote.mux.
Observed (rc.2):

Anonymous or dead-cookie WebSocket upgrade → TCP connection destroyed with no handshake response at all (client sees 1006 / socket hang up). No HTTP 401, no close frame.
Authenticated client sending invalid uplink — non-JSON text, unknown type, or a binary frame → connection destroyed immediately (1006), no close frame. On 0.1.7-alpha.1 the same probes received proper close codes: 1008 ("invalid Remote stream request") and 1003 ("text messages required").
After logout, open sockets die silently (no close frame observed client-side).

Question: is the fail-fast destroy intentional (e.g. budget/DoS hardening), or a regression of the close-code contract? Clients that used close codes to distinguish "unauthenticated" (1008) from "malformed frame" (1003) can no longer tell the causes apart — everything is an opaque 1006.
Server-side behavior otherwise looks correct: valid authenticated clients stream fine (101 + upstream 101), and unauthenticated traffic is still rejected — just more silently than before.
Not a blocker for us (our fail-closed expectations are met, arguably exceeded) — asking whether the close-code contract is deliberately dropped, so client SDKs can be adjusted.

threads.title: Office image rendering silently produces empty (fully transparent) PNGs on the macOS native libreoffice-kit engine
threads.bodyText:
中文摘要
DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2 内置的 libreoffice-kit 在 macOS 上执行 render 时，命令返回成功、manifest 正常、missingFonts 为空，但写出的 Office 预览 PNG 全透明。直接按原生 helper 的协议抓取编码前的原始 tile，861,696 个像素全为 0，说明 LibreOffice 从未向调用方提供的缓冲区写入任何内容 —— 既不是字体问题，也不是 PNG 编码问题。
根因：doc_paintTile 通过 SetOutputSizePixelScaleOffsetAndLOKBuffer → SalVirtualDevice::SetSizeUsingBuffer 绑定外部缓冲区，而该方法只有 headless/svp 后端实现；macOS(quartz) 与 Windows(win/gdi) 后端都没有 override，release 构建又编译掉了基类的 assert，于是静默返回 false。paintTile 返回 void，worker.cxx 无从检测，只能上报成功。
影响：macOS 原生引擎的全部 Office→图片渲染（xlsx/docx/pptx）；convert、recalculate、CSV 导出与 PDF(PDFium) 渲染不受影响。按源码推断 Windows 原生引擎同样受影响（未在硬件上验证）。已验证可行的绕行路径是 Office → PDF → PDFium。
TL;DR
libreoffice-kit render on macOS (native engine @deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit-darwin-arm64@0.1.1, shipped inside DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2) reports ok with a valid manifest, but every Office tile it writes is a fully transparent PNG. The raw pre-encode tile buffer is untouched (all bytes zero), so this is not a font or a PNG-encoding problem: LibreOffice never writes into the caller-provided buffer.
Root cause: doc_paintTile binds the caller buffer through VirtualDevice::SetOutputSizePixelScaleOffsetAndLOKBuffer → SalVirtualDevice::SetSizeUsingBuffer, which only the headless/svp backend implements. The macOS (quartz) and Windows (win/gdi) backends do not override it, and the release build compiles out the base-class assert, so the call silently returns false. paintTile returns void, so worker.cxx cannot detect the failure and reports success.
Impact: all Office → image rendering (xlsx/docx/pptx) on the macOS native engine. convert, recalculate, CSV export and PDF rendering (PDFium) are unaffected. The same source reading suggests the Windows native engine is affected as well (not verified on hardware).
Environment

DSH Desktop 0.1.7-rc.2, macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon)
@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit 0.1.1, engine @deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit-darwin-arm64 0.1.1 (backend: "native")
Bundled LibreOffice core bce0998afefdbc355585ca324285661a2170ba77 (26.8.0.3), configured with --disable-debug --disable-dbgutil
npm @deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit@0.1.2 still pins the macOS engine to 0.1.1, so the latest published release does not change this behaviour.

Reproduction
NODE=".../Resources/runtime/primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node"
CLI=".../app.asar.unpacked/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/libreoffice-kit/lib/cli.js"

# any docx/xlsx/pptx
"$NODE" "$CLI" render --input doc.docx --output-dir out --dpi 96
Reported result (looks healthy):
{"schemaVersion":1,"backend":"native","rasterEngine":"libreoffice","dpi":96,"pageCount":1,
 "images":[{"index":1,"page":1,"path":".../out/page-0001.png","width":816,"height":1056,...}],
 "missingFonts":[]}
Actual PNG content, measured with the bundled Pillow:



input
raster engine
alpha min/max
distinct colours
verdict




book.xlsx
libreoffice
0 / 0

correct



The tile buffer is never written
Driving the native helper directly over its documented stdio protocol (--operation render-images, then P <index> <part> <w> <h> <x> <y> <tw> <th>) and inspecting tile-1.rgba before any JS post-processing:
READY: {"ok":true,"kind":"ready","tileMode":1,"documentType":"text","writerRectangles":"284, 284, 12240, 15840"}
PAINT: {"ok":true,"kind":"paint","index":1,"path":".../tile-1.rgba","width":816,"height":1056}
RAW bytes=3446784 px=861696
pixels with alpha != 0 : 0
pixels with RGB   != 0 : 0

All 861,696 pixels are zero. A backend that painted anything would at minimum have filled the page background, so the buffer was never touched. rgbaPixels() then maps alpha == 0 to transparent black, which is a faithful conversion of an empty buffer rather than the cause.
Not an environment, backend-selection or font issue
Same direct-protocol probe, one process per configuration:



env
non-zero pixels




(baseline)
0


SAL_DISABLESKIA=1
0


SAL_FORCESKIA=1
0


SAL_SKIA=raster
0


SAL_USE_VCLPLUGIN=svp
0


SAL_NOOPENGL=1 SAL_DISABLESKIA=1
0



missingFonts is empty in every run, and convert/recalculate on the same documents succeed, so document import and layout work.
Upstream code path
desktop/source/lib/init.cxx, doc_paintTile (macOS is UNX but not IOS, so it takes the #else branch):
#if defined(IOS)
    CGContextRef pCGContext = CGBitmapContextCreate(pBuffer, nCanvasWidth, nCanvasHeight, ...);
    ...
#else
    ScopedVclPtrInstance<VirtualDevice> pDevice(DeviceFormat::WITHOUT_ALPHA);
    pDevice->SetBackground(Wallpaper(COL_TRANSPARENT));
    pDevice->SetOutputSizePixelScaleOffsetAndLOKBuffer(
                Size(nCanvasWidth, nCanvasHeight), 1.0, Point(), pBuffer);
    pDoc->paintTile(*pDevice, nCanvasWidth, nCanvasHeight, nTilePosX, nTilePosY, nTileWidth, nTileHeight);
#endif
vcl/inc/salvd.hxx:
virtual bool SetSizeUsingBuffer(tools::Long /*nNewDX*/, tools::Long /*nNewDY*/, sal_uInt8 * /*pBuffer*/)
{
    // Only the headless/svp virtual device has an implementation.
    assert(false && "unsupported");
    return false;
}
Overrides at the pinned revision:



backend
overrides SetSizeUsingBuffer




vcl/headless/svpvd.cxx
yes


vcl/quartz/salvd.cxx (macOS)
no


vcl/win/gdi/salvd.cxx (Windows)
no



Because the engine is built with --disable-debug --disable-dbgutil, the assert is compiled out and the false return is discarded. SAL_USE_VCLPLUGIN=svp cannot help: the engine's own build script records that configure rejects --disable-gui on macOS and Windows, so no svp plugin exists in this static build.
Finally, worker.cxx cannot observe the failure, because paintTile returns void:
if (part < 0) document->pClass->paintTile(document.get(), pixels.data(), canvasWidth, canvasHeight, x, y, width, height);
else document->pClass->paintPartTile(...);
// unconditional writePixels() + {"ok":true,"kind":"paint",...}
The PDF branch does check its result (if (!api.paint(...)) throw), which matches PDFium rendering being correct.
Suggested fixes, cheapest first

Detect the failure instead of reporting success: verify the tile buffer was written, or reject render with unavailable on native backends that cannot paint into a caller buffer. Today a silently empty image invites callers to conclude that the document itself is broken.
Fix the rendering path: extend the #if defined(IOS) CGBitmapContextCreate branch to MACOSX (CoreGraphics is available and the code is nearly reusable), or implement SetSizeUsingBuffer in vcl/quartz/salvd.cxx and vcl/win/gdi/salvd.cxx.
Interim product behaviour: on affected native engines, render Office documents through Office → PDF → PDFium internally and label it in the manifest (for example rasterEngine: "pdfium", source: "pdf-route"). Verified working locally:

"$NODE" "$CLI" convert --input doc.docx --output doc.pdf
"$NODE" "$CLI" render  --input doc.pdf  --output-dir preview --dpi 110   # correct image
Note that the PDF route follows print settings and cannot reproduce the --sheet / --range worksheet framing, and that the bundled office-* skills currently forbid using PDF conversion as a visual-QA fallback — so with the current instructions an agent on macOS correctly reports "visual inspection unavailable" even though a usable preview is reachable.

threads.title: Tool-result pruner silently truncates without marker; compaction never fires at default minContextRatio; no heredoc protection in pwsh tool
threads.bodyText:
Tool-result pruner silently removes output middles without any marker; compaction never fires at default minContextRatio
Environment

DSH harness (deepseek-harness), Windows 11, PowerShell tool
Preset: cordis-cc (standard coding agent)
Model: GLM-5.3-Flash / DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (both affected)
Workload: long-running book-production session (multi-hour, 270+ tool calls, heavy Word COM + Python + file operations)

Bug 1 — Tool-result pruner silently truncates without marking the cut
Config (from the default preset's compaction-tool-result-pruner):
thresholdChars: 8192
headChars: 4096
tailChars: 1024
What happens: any tool result over 8,192 characters is silently pruned to the first 4,096 + last 1,024 characters. The middle — up to 3,000+ characters — is removed with no marker, no ellipsis, no indication that anything was cut. The result looks like a continuous (but wrong) output.
Why this is dangerous: the model reads the pruned result as if it were the complete output. It cannot know the middle is missing. In our session, this caused:

The model to report file counts, page counts, and image counts that were actually from the tail fragment, not the full result
The model to conclude that directory listings were "fabricated" when they were actually pruned (the model saw the first few and last few entries but not the middle)
A cascade of misdiagnosis where the model re-ran verified work, produced contradictory claims, and eventually refused to use the shell at all

Reproduction: run any command that produces >8,192 characters of output (e.g., a recursive directory listing, a Python script with 50+ lines of output). The model sees ~5,120 chars (4,096 head + 1,024 tail) and fills in the gap from context.
Suggested fix: insert a visible marker between the head and tail, e.g.:
[... 3,072 characters omitted by tool-result-pruner ...]

This costs 1 line but tells the model the output is incomplete, preventing confabulation.
Bug 2 — compaction-basic minContextRatio 0.97 means compaction never runs
Config (code default, no preset override):
minContextRatio: 0.97

What happens: compaction only fires when the session reaches 97% of the model's context window. In practice, this means compaction never runs for most sessions — the tool-result pruner keeps individual results short enough that the context grows slowly, and the model finishes its task before reaching 97%.
Why this is dangerous: pruned tool results (from Bug 1) accumulate unboundedly in the context. Each one is a head+tail fragment that the model partially remembers and partially infers. Over hundreds of tool calls, the context becomes a collage of fragments that the model can't accurately attribute — leading to the model making claims about "what it saw" that don't match any real output.
Suggested fix: lower the default minContextRatio to something like 0.80, or document prominently that the 0.97 default means "compaction will likely never fire."
Bug 3 — PowerShell tool doesn't protect against heredocs/here-strings
What happens: the pwsh tool passes commands directly to PowerShell without checking for here-string (@'...'@) or heredoc (<<EOF) patterns. On Windows, PowerShell here-strings can contain arbitrary content including:

Unbalanced apostrophes (which break the enclosing command)
Backslash sequences (which get halved before the shell sees them)
Content over ~10K chars (which gets silently truncated by the command-line length limit)

Evidence: four independent traps documented and reproduced across multiple sessions on Windows 11 (details in the session tapes and the operator's memory notes). The machine-wide rule (in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) forbids heredocs for this reason.
Existing protection: the project provides no_heredoc.py (a PreToolUse blocker) and nop hook run --policy block (a heredoc detector). Both are registered in ~/.claude/settings.json and work in Claude Code sessions.
The gap: the default DSH preset does not mount the dsh-hooks-claude-code bridge, so these hooks never fire in DSH sessions. A heredoc in a DSH pwsh tool call executes without any check.
Suggested fix (any of):

Mount dsh-hooks-claude-code in the default preset with configPath pointing at ~/.claude/settings.json (where the hooks are already registered)
Or add a built-in heredoc/here-string check in the pwsh tool itself (before execution), similar to kdp_precheck for print interiors
Or at minimum, document in the preset template that the hooks bridge should be mounted for shell-safety

Workaround (applied)
All three were worked around in the operator's preset (agent.cordis.yml):

thresholdChars: 65536 (up from 8,192)
minContextRatio: 0.80 (down from 0.97)
hooks-claude-code bridge mounted with configPath: C:/Users/user/.claude/settings.json

Impact
Without these fixes, long-running sessions on the default preset will: (1) silently lose the middle of long tool outputs, (2) accumulate pruned fragments that look like real data, and (3) execute heredocs that may corrupt file content — all three of which cause the model to produce confidently wrong results that are indistinguishable from hallucination.

threads.title: Session persistence layer is not isolated between sessions - one session's file corruption breaks another session's subagent catalog (bug #5)
threads.bodyText:
Session persistence layer is not isolated between sessions — one session's corruption breaks another session's infrastructure
This is bug #5 filed against this harness. The pattern is clear: DSH's session management has no isolation between concurrent sessions, and every shared-layer vulnerability becomes a cross-session failure.
Environment

DSH harness, Windows 11, single host process serving multiple concurrent sessions
Session A: book-production workload (Kindle + hardcover + paperback, 270+ tool calls)
Session B: diagnostic workload (cutter.exe troubleshooting, Word COM, file forensics)
Both sessions running simultaneously under the same DSH host

What happened
Session B (cutter diagnostics) accidentally wrote an empty string to a live session tape (session.jsonl.zstd) due to an argv-indexing bug in its frame-scan script. The tape went from 155,681 bytes to 733 bytes (zero zstd magic).
DSH's response: the harness detected the corruption, flushed the damaged tape, and repaired it to 51,045 bytes — then further rewrote it to 43,533 bytes. The repaired artifact started at seq 7115 with no session header. The harness's own post-incident behavior (rewriting the artifact smaller, losing the session header) is itself evidence that the persistence layer does not handle concurrent access safely.
Cascade to Session A: while the persistence layer was being repaired, Session A's subagent catalog read failed with subagent catalog read failed. This read hits the same shared session infrastructure that the repair was rewriting. Four actively running subagent workers (translation tasks, 486K+ tokens each) were unaffected because they were already spawned — but spawning new subagents would have failed during the repair window.
Why this is a design flaw, not a user error


Session B's mistake was a file-level write to a JSONL file. It should not have been possible for a file-level mistake in one session's diagnostic script to break another session's subagent infrastructure. The sessions share a DSH host process but should not share mutable session state at the file level.


The persistence layer is not crash-safe. DSH's response to tape corruption was to rewrite the artifact smaller (155,681 → 51,045 → 43,533 bytes), losing the session header and an unknown number of events. A persistence layer that responds to corruption by writing less data is not a persistence layer — it's a liability.


The subagent catalog has no read resilience. A single read failure (during a concurrent write from another session's repair) causes a hard FAIL. There is no retry, no stale-read fallback, no isolation between the catalog's storage and the tape's storage. One file-level operation in one session should never cause a read failure in another session's tool registry.


This is the fifth bug filed against DSH's session management. The previous four:

Tool-result pruner silently removes output middles without marking truncation
compaction-basic minContextRatio 0.97 means compaction never fires for most sessions
No heredoc/here-string protection in the pwsh tool
The default preset doesn't mount the hooks bridge (Claude Code hooks don't fire in DSH)

The common thread: DSH's session management assumes a single-session world and breaks in a multi-session one.


What needs to change


Per-session isolation for mutable state. The subagent catalog, the tool registry, and the session persistence layer must be scoped per-session, not shared across sessions on the same host. A file-level mistake in Session B must be invisible to Session A.


Crash-safe persistence. The tape repair must not lose the session header or silently shrink the artifact. If the tape is corrupted, recover from the last known-good state (checkpoint) or at minimum preserve what exists and log the damage.


Read resilience for the subagent catalog. A transient read failure (during a concurrent write) should retry or serve a stale-but-consistent cached copy, not hard-fail.


The heredoc guards, the tool-result pruner, and the compaction floor should all be session-scoped. Configuration changes in one session's preset should not affect another session's behavior.


Reproduction

Start two DSH sessions on the same host (different workspaces, different tasks)
In Session B, run any script that truncates a file in the session persistence directory
In Session A, attempt to read the subagent catalog (e.g., spawn a subagent)
Observe: Session A's catalog read fails

Impact
Multi-session workflows — which the DSH architecture explicitly supports (the sessions directory contains multiple concurrent sessions) — are unsafe because one session's file-level mistake cascades into every other session on the host. This makes DSH unusable for any workload that requires session independence.

threads.title: Cache-write tokens are silently folded into input tokens for gateways using non-standard field names
threads.bodyText:
## Summary

`parseChunkUsage` in the OpenAI-completions adapter reads cache-write tokens only from
`usage.prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens`. Gateways that report cache writes under a
different key (B.AI uses `prompt_tokens_details.cached_creation_tokens`) are read as `0`, and
`input = prompt_tokens - cacheRead - cacheWrite` then folds the entire cache-write volume into
uncached input. The result is silently wrong token accounting with no error or warning.

Because `inputTokens` is what gets persisted to the session log and surfaced through the
`tokenUsage` projection, downstream consumers (cost/spend UIs, telemetry) cannot recover the
lost distinction — the raw field is gone by the time anything reads the log.

## Environment

- dsh: `0.1.7-rc.2` (also observed on `0.1.5-rc.2`)
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai`: `0.85.1`
- Provider: B.AI (`https://api.b.ai/v1`, `api: openai-completions`, model `gpt-6-sol`)
- Route is not in the pi-ai built-in catalog, so it is declared in `settings.yaml`

## Reproduction

A direct request to the gateway returns cache-write tokens under a non-standard key:

```bash
curl -s https://api.b.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $B_AI_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-6-sol","messages":[
        {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant. ...(long prompt)..."},
        {"role":"user","content":"Say hi."}],"max_tokens":16}'Response usage:json{
  "prompt_tokens": 3613,
  "completion_tokens": 6,
  "total_tokens": 3619,
  "prompt_tokens_details": {
    "cached_tokens": 0,
    "cached_creation_tokens": 3610
  },
  "input_tokens": 3613,
  "output_tokens": 6,
  "claude_cache_creation_5_m_tokens": 0,
  "claude_cache_creation_1_h_tokens": 0
}Here prompt_tokens: 3613 includes cached_creation_tokens: 3610; the genuinely uncached input is 3.Causepi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js (parseChunkUsage):jsconst promptTokens = rawUsage.prompt_tokens || 0;
const cacheReadTokens = rawUsage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens ?? rawUsage.prompt_cache_hit_tokens ?? rawUsage.cached_tokens ?? 0;
const cacheWriteTokens = rawUsage.prompt_tokens_details?.cache_write_tokens || 0;
// ...
const input = Math.max(0, promptTokens - cacheReadTokens - cacheWriteTokens);cache_read already chases three aliases (cached_tokens, prompt_cache_hit_tokens, cached_tokens), but cache_write has exactly one and finds nothing here, so:代码块cacheWriteTokens = 0
input            = 3613 - 0 - 0 = 3613   // 3610 cache-write tokens mislabelled as uncached inputdsh-llm-pi-ai then passes this straight through and only emits the field when non-zero:jsreturn {
  inputTokens: usage.input,
  outputTokens: usage.output,
  totalTokens: usage.totalTokens,
  ...usage.cacheRead  > 0 ? { cacheReadTokens:  usage.cacheRead  } : {},
  ...usage.cacheWrite > 0 ? { cacheWriteTokens: usage.cacheWrite } : {}   // never present for B.AI
};ImpactToken totals stay correct (input + output is unaffected), so this is easy to miss — only the bucketing is wrong. But any per-bucket consumer is wrong, and by a large margin because cache writes are typically priced above uncached input.Observed on a real session (b-ai/gpt-6-sol, the gateway bills in credits/token):
  | uncached input | cache write | cache read | output | total
-- | -- | -- | -- | -- | --
Gateway's own meter | 3 | 5,967 | 0 | 291 | 6,261
dsh log / tokenUsage | 5,970 | (absent) | 0 | 291 | 6,261
With that route's rates (2 / 2.5 / 0.2 / 10 credits per token) the gateway charged 17,833 credits while dsh's numbers imply 14,850 — a 16.7% understatement, entirely from cache writes being priced as plain input. For models where cache write is cheaper than input, it would overstate instead.Note this is provider-specific: b-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash reports cache reads under the recognised cached_tokens key and accounts correctly, so the bug is invisible until a route that writes cache without a recognised field name is used.

threads.bodyText:
Summary
On some startups the host logs a single [E]. It appears to be a duplicate registration of the subagent tool, and it is reproducible from the factory-default profile (no user configuration involved).
[scope] Error: tool "subagent" is already registered in this scope
  at NamedEntries.duplicateError (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2634:59)
  at NamedEntries.insert (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:29:34)
  at layers.effect.label (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2886:62)
  at ScopedLayers.<anonymous> (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope/lib/index.js:206:12)
  at mount (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/lib/index.js:398:35)
  at install (…/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/lib/index.js:574:27)

Reproduction
This is not 100% deterministic — observed once on 2026-09-27 01:18:14 and once on 2026-09-29 11:06:52, while a later restart at 11:24 did not log it. Inspect the config tree instead (deterministic):
dsh --profile desktop --dump-default-config   # no user layer at all
# → `- id: tool-subagent` appears 4 times
Current behavior


dsh --profile desktop --dump-config lists - id: tool-subagent 4 times.


dsh --profile desktop --dump-default-config (no user layer) lists it 4 times as well → unrelated to user config.


Grepping shipped bundles' cordis.patch.yml for dsh-tool-subagent:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-base — 8 hits
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app — 6 hits
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile — 4 hits



@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/cordis.patch.yml:518-532 already suppresses these rows with disabled: true, and the comment acknowledges the collision:

"…a per-session copy would both starve that host row and collide on the second session. What a preset chooses is which delegation TOOLS its agent sees, below."

- id: tool-subagent-control
  disabled: true
- id: tool-subagent-list-agents
  disabled: true
- id: tool-subagent
  disabled: true
- id: tool-subagent-fork
  disabled: true


Expected behavior
Either no error is logged, or it is logged at a lower severity — a single benign duplicate-registration notice should not appear as [E] in dsh-*.error.log, where it can mask genuine errors during triage.
Environment

DSH Desktop 2.0.15 (compatible mode)
Profile: desktop (custom profile under ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop)
OS: Windows

Notes

No functional impact observed: I verified by actually invoking the subagent tool — it returned a normal foreground run. The failing row is the duplicate; the primary registration still serves the tool.
I did not modify any shipped bundle or the profile's bundle list (dsh-base / dsh-web-app are required bundles and get rewritten by the launcher anyway).
Happy to provide the full --dump-config / --dump-default-config output or host logs if that helps.

threads.title: bash/grep/glob tools fail with "spawn bash ENOENT" and "ripgrep provider failure" after desktop app restart
threads.bodyText:
Summary
After restarting the DeepSeek Harness desktop app (or during a long-running session), the bash, grep, and glob tools stop working:

bash returns spawn bash ENOENT
grep / glob return ripgrep provider failure

Meanwhile read, write, web_fetch, and MCP tools keep working.
Reproduction

Start the DeepSeek Harness desktop app.
Restart it (quit and reopen the app, or killall "DeepSeek Harness" then reopen).
Invoke the bash tool → spawn bash ENOENT.

The failure is intermittent — it sometimes recovers after another restart.
Root cause analysis


The bash executor spawns the bare command "bash" (not /bin/bash), relying on PATH lookup:

packages/shell/bash-local — LocalBashExecutor.execute:
return this.executeArgv(spec, ["bash", "-c", spec.command]);




Executable resolution reads PATH from the child environment:

packages/shell/subprocess-local — resolveExecutable / executableCandidates:
const path = environmentValue(env, "PATH") ?? "";
return path.split(delimiter).flatMap(...);

When no candidate exists, it throws SubprocessExecutableNotFoundError.



The child environment's PATH is copied from the harness agent process's process.env:

dsh-subprocess — scrubbedParentEnv():
for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(process.env)) ... env[key] = value;




So when the harness agent process's process.env.PATH is empty or missing (which happens after an Electron desktop-app restart where the environment is not fully reconstructed), resolveExecutable("bash", env) finds no candidates and throws, surfaced as spawn bash ENOENT.
grep / glob fail for the same reason: they spawn ripgrep through PATH lookup.
Evidence

read /bin/bash succeeds (file exists), but the bash tool reports ENOENT — proving the failure is PATH lookup, not a missing file.
read / write (fs API) and web_fetch (HTTP) continue to work — they don't spawn subprocesses.
After a desktop-app restart, the chrome-devtools MCP's Chrome instance was rebuilt (a previously opened tab disappeared), confirming the app did restart — yet bash still reported ENOENT. So the failure is tied to agent-context rebuild, and a restart does not recover it.
When the environment eventually recovered on its own, bash/grep/glob worked again and the process PATH was back to /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin — directly confirming PATH loss as the root cause.

Suggested fix
In dsh-subprocess-local's resolveExecutable (or childEnv), fall back to a system default PATH when the resolved PATH is empty:
const path = environmentValue(env, "PATH")
  ?? process.env.PATH
  ?? "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin";
Or make dsh-bash-local use the absolute path /bin/bash.

threads.title: 扣费问题
threads.bodyText:

threads.title: Windows: pnpm run build fails after following the source installation guide
threads.bodyText:
Windows: pnpm run build Fails After Following the Official Source Installation Guide
Background
I wanted to run DeepSeek Harness from source and followed the official instructions:
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
However, the build failed on Windows during TypeScript compilation.
Environment

OS: Windows 11
Node.js: v24.11.1
pnpm: 11.7.0
Branch: master
Commit: 4878cda

Error
The build reported incompatible versions of micromark-util-types:
error TS2769: No overload matches this call.

Type 'micromark-util-types@2.0.2' is not assignable to type
'micromark-util-types@2.0.3'

Found 3 errors.

The error occurred in:
packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/parse.ts

Workaround
Running pnpm dedupe before building resolved the issue:
pnpm install
pnpm dedupe
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
After running pnpm dedupe, the dependency tree uses a single compatible version of micromark-util-types, and the build succeeds.
Verification
pnpm list micromark-util-types
The resolved version is:
micromark-util-types 2.0.3

Possible Documentation Improvement
Would it be worth adding pnpm dedupe to the “Run from source” instructions?
For example:
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm dedupe
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
This may help Windows users and other contributors who encounter the same dependency-resolution issue after a fresh checkout.
Thank you for maintaining the project. I hope this report helps improve the setup experience for future contributors.

threads.title: DeepSeek Harness：pnpm install / Lefthook Stale Lock 快速排障
threads.bodyText:
DeepSeek Harness：pnpm install / Lefthook Stale Lock 快速排障
1. 问题
Windows 下执行：
pnpm install
失败，核心错误：
[install-lefthook] stale Lefthook installer lock
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1

日志中同时出现：
Unsupported platform
cyclic workspace dependencies
Failed to create bin ... apps/cli/lib/bin.js.EXE

这些在本次问题中都不是最终导致 pnpm install 失败的直接原因。

2. 根因
项目的：
scripts/install-lefthook.mjs

在安装 Git Hooks 时使用：
dsh-lefthook-install.lock

防止多个 Lefthook 安装进程并发运行。
锁文件位于：
Git Common Directory\dsh-lefthook-install.lock

先执行：
git rev-parse --git-common-dir
本次结果：
.git

因此锁文件实际位置：
E:\MyFloder\lizhiwei\eifire\study\DeepSeekHarness\git_source\deepseek-harness\.git\dsh-lefthook-install.lock


3. 定位锁文件
$gitCommon = git rev-parse --git-common-dir
$gitCommon = (Resolve-Path $gitCommon).Path
$lock = Join-Path $gitCommon "dsh-lefthook-install.lock"

Write-Host "Git common dir: $gitCommon"
Write-Host "Lock file:      $lock"
检查：
if (Test-Path $lock) {
    Write-Host "LOCK EXISTS"
    Get-Content $lock
} else {
    Write-Host "NO LOCK"
}
本次得到：
2144 6046dab5-2ba6-4f86-9655-f591fde0193f

其中：
PID = 2144


4. 判断是不是 Stale Lock
不要直接删除锁。
先检查 PID：
Get-Process -Id 2144 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
本次没有任何输出，说明：
PID 2144 对应进程已经不存在

因此这个锁属于：
Stale Lock

也就是残留锁。

5. 清理
确认对应 Lefthook 安装进程已经不存在后：
Remove-Item $lock -Force
验证：
Test-Path $lock
结果：
False


6. 重新安装
pnpm install
最终成功：
. postinstall$ node scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
│ sync hooks: ✔️(pre-commit, pre-merge-commit, pre-push)
└─ Done in 6.2s

Done in 13.7s using pnpm v11.7.0


7. 最重要的排障原则
不要直接删除 node_modules
本次问题不在：
node_modules

而在：
.git\dsh-lefthook-install.lock

不要删除 pnpm-lock.yaml
日志已经显示：
Lockfile is up to date, resolution step is skipped

说明 lockfile 本身没有需要重新解析的问题。
不要删除整个 .git
正确操作是：
确认 PID 不存在
        ↓
只删除
dsh-lefthook-install.lock

而不是删除整个：
.git


8. 快速处理命令
以后再次遇到相同错误，可以使用：
$gitCommon = git rev-parse --git-common-dir
$gitCommon = (Resolve-Path $gitCommon).Path
$lock = Join-Path $gitCommon "dsh-lefthook-install.lock"

Write-Host "Lock file: $lock"

if (Test-Path $lock) {
    Get-Content $lock
}
假设锁内容：
2144 xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx

检查：
Get-Process -Id 2144 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
如果进程不存在，确认没有 Lefthook 安装进程正在运行后：
Remove-Item $lock -Force
pnpm install

9. 一句话记忆

pnpm install → install-lefthook.mjs → 发现旧锁 → 读取 PID → PID 不存在 → 删除 .git/dsh-lefthook-install.lock → 重新 pnpm install。

本次最终结果：
Lefthook 安装成功
Git Hooks 同步成功
pnpm install 成功
