threads.title: [Bug] Repeated HTTP 400 path-expansion error prevents subsequent turns in an existing conversation
threads.bodyText:
Root cause and responsible component are unconfirmed.
Environment

Windows browser accessing dsh web, with a WSL-backed project.
UI model label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
Locally installed CLI package @deepseek-ai/dsh: 0.2.0-rc.2 (the version serving dsh web has not been verified; these may differ).
An existing long-running conversation with a goal referencing a project work-order file.

Observed behavior
A turn fails with HTTP 400 and invalid_request_error:
a single path expansion cannot exceed 512 candidates

Sending a subsequent message asking for a single short tail command with a quoted absolute file path fails with the same error. The UI shows a turn failure without displaying a command execution for that new turn. Thus the evidence does not establish that the new command was executed.
Example trace IDs from the reported incident:

ea1bc44f0c88c4f492dbdbcc06cfad11
2cbfa852e0b5418b003a95591ce8637b
f9be61c204e933e05557109f5fefb0ad

Independent local checks showed that previously launched background workers continued executing. The interactive turn failures did not terminate those workers.
Expected behavior
If a file expansion exceeds a documented bound, identify the offending reference and expose a way to remove or narrow it. The user should be able to send a subsequent turn without being trapped by a previous invalid expansion.
Attribution and reproduction limitations

This is an incident report, not a confirmed minimal reproduction.
A clean conversation test has not been performed.
The failing request payload and web-serving/plugin versions have not been captured.
The exact message was not found in the inspected locally installed @deepseek-ai JavaScript dependencies.
The error may originate in a plugin, a provider/gateway request validator, or the harness request/context pipeline. A server trace is needed to distinguish these possibilities.

Requested investigation
Please identify which component emits this message and whether a retained conversation reference is replayed after a failed expansion. If the error originates upstream of the harness, please provide enough diagnostic context to identify the responsible request field and service.
No private source material, credentials, full request payloads, or unredacted screenshot are included.

threads.title: 智能体团队插件相关
threads.bodyText:
在一个会话里使用智能体团队后,团队成员是不是不能修改、删除、新建?
我在一个长的会话里(主会话模型用量0.25b词元,总消耗大概0.6b词元)开启智能体团队后,之后继续在会话内提及智能体团队这一插件,发现以下情况.
第一次prompt(这一次的prompt里没有明确说要启用新成员):
我的要求是,要使用智能体团队,并行出发,不等待、不阻塞. 然后你说的必须我定口径.......
deepseek回复截取:
收到两项口径决定。并行出发、不等待——现在派 4 个队友，各自独立写盘，我同时做口径落地的量化。
代码Error: code run failed (exception): ToolCallError: Team member limit 8 reached
创建队友Error: Team member limit 8 reached
团队名额上限 8（已有 7 个队友）。改用复用现有队友——直接把他们唤醒接新任务，仍然是并行出发。
第二次prompt(我尝试用更明确的指令让lead成员修改团队成员):
开启智能体团队,重新规划团队成员. 然后进行语义解析升级
deepseek回复截取:
开启团队前先摸清现状与升级靶点。
现状清楚了。升级靶点分五档，其中班组级是全新粒度。先试能不能新建成员（现有 8 个已满）。
成员上限 8 已满，无法新建。 那就按"重新规划"的本义——把 8 个现有成员整体改制。先建任务板。
我在想如果能让lead成员修改或者删除后新建团队成员,是不是会更好?因为一个长会话运行一段时间后,8 个teammate名额被历史团队占满。后续任务性质发生变化,即使明确要求 Lead “重新规划团队成员”,Lead 也无法删除旧成员并建立新的成员,只能继续复用原来的 8 个成员.我不是很确定这样做会不会对任务的完成质量产生影响,在我目前的情况下,感觉不出来好坏.
我让ai帮我查了一下讨论区,#4642也提到了智能体团队这个插件.

threads.title: [bug] 插件列表「禁用→启用」热切换时，带 prefix route 的插件激活失败：webserver: duplicate prefix route（0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.0-rc.2 均在）
threads.bodyText:
环境

dsh 0.1.7-rc.2（macOS arm64，Node v24.21.0）；已比对 0.2.0-rc.2 npm 包源码，相关代码逐字一致，同样受影响
第三方插件 dsh-paoding 0.3.6：apply() 内 webServer.register({ kind: 'prefix', path: '/api/paoding', handler })，返回宿主 disposer（包装后 return，契约按文档）

复现步骤

dsh web 启动，安装任一带 prefix route 注册的第三方插件（如 dsh-paoding）
设置 → 插件列表，对该插件执行「禁用」
紧接着「启用」

预期：禁用释放路由，启用重新注册，激活成功。
实际：启用报错——
启用失败：dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate
paoding-config-ui (dsh-paoding): Error: webserver: duplicate prefix route "/api/paoding"
    at Proxy.register (…/dsh-host-webserver/lib/index.js:179:36)
    at Object.apply (…/cordis/lib/index.js:120:36)
    at new apply (…/dsh-paoding/plugins/paoding-config-ui/index.mjs:268:30)
    at Fiber.execute (…/cordis/lib/index.js:1068:24)
    …

失败后旧 incarnation 仍在服务（路由可访问、返回 200），新纤维失败，GUI 状态与实际不符；重启宿主后恢复。
根因分析
调用链（两版本相同）：

GUI 开关 → dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager → setBundleEnabled(name, true)
dsh-plugin-manager：selectBundle 改 package.json bundles → reload(requiredIds)
dsh-app-boot reconcileProfilePatches → 根 Include entry.update({ patches })
cordis-plugin-include internal/update → root.update(applyPatches(...))
cordis-plugin-loader EntryTree.update → create(id) → Entry.update → 变更条目 Fiber.update → restart()
cordis Fiber.restart：_setEpoch(INACTIVE) 使旧 effect 失效后立即 _refresh() 重执行；旧 effect wrapper 的清理经 disposeAfter(...) 的 promise 链异步结算，与新 execute 的先后无保证
新 apply() 调 webServer.register() 时旧路由尚未出表 → register 对同 (kind, path) 设计为直接抛错 → 激活失败

即：热切换路径下，条目重建的新注册先于旧注销完成。webServer.register 的 duplicate-throw 本身是对的（组合层契约），问题在纤维重启的注销/重执行无顺序保证。
版本比对（0.1.7-rc.2 ↔ 0.2.0-rc.2）：@deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.4 同版；cordis-plugin-loader 1.0.5、cordis-plugin-include 1.0.9 均为 npm 最新同版；dsh-host-webserver register()、dsh-plugin-manager reload、dsh-app-boot reconcileProfilePatches 逐字相同。
建议修法（二选一）

A（治本）：热切换重建条目前先等旧纤维卸载结算——Fiber.restart 先 await 旧 effect 清理再 _refresh()，或 reconcileProfilePatches/EntryTree.update 对将变更的条目先同步 dispose 完成再 create
B（宽容）：webServer.register 对「同条目 id 重新占座」提供宽容路径（或提供 has(kind, path) 查询），让插件可幂等注册

临时绕过

重启宿主（冷启动单次注册，无冲突）
插件侧：对 duplicate prefix route 错误短重试等旧注销落地（dsh-paoding 0.3.8 已带此兜底，宿主修复后可移除）

threads.title: 任务面板不随任务完成实时更新：面板只镜像最后一次 todo_write，且反批量约束已于 2026-09-24 从工具描述中删除
threads.bodyText:
现象
桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2：让模型用 todo_write 拆成多步去完成一个长任务时，输入框下方「任务」面板
（conversation.input.dock 的 todo 面板）会长时间停在某一项「进行中」，与实际进度严重脱节——
实际工作已经推进了几十个工具调用，面板的「已完成」计数一动不动；有时直到该回合结束仍然是「进行中」，
要等到下一个回合的 turn/start 才被清掉。
这与 #6458（已采纳答案：推送式通路存在、面板实时读投影，属「模型节奏」）、#5534、#5456、#6296 是同一族现象。
我先独立复核了通路，确认那条答案对机制的判断是正确的：

todos 投影只对两个事件改值：todo/write（整表替换）与 turn/start（清空为 null）；
宿主 sessionProjections 对每个已提交事件 eager 折叠并推送，没有节流/合并/防抖/丢帧；
客户端 ProjectionValueStore.apply 只丢弃 seq <= row.seq 的旧帧，面板 useProjection('todos') 实时读；
桌面版随包实现（app.asar 内 dsh-tool-todo/lib/index.js、dsh-session-projection/lib/index.js）与仓库源码同构。

也就是说：面板是「模型最后一次写入」的忠实镜像，模型不回写，面板就不动。
本次新增的可核事实：反批量约束已被删除
todo_write 的工具描述里原本有一条反批量化约束，现在没有了：

引入：46e31d8481 feat(tool-todo): add the model-facing todo_write tool
删除：321a6fa740（2026-09-24 14:57 +0800，refactor(tools): trim constraint prose from tool descriptions）

旧：Mark a todo `completed` the moment it is done (do not batch completions), and allow no `in_progress` item only once all work is complete.
新：Mark each todo `completed` as soon as it is done.
同一提交还删掉了 Statuses: pending / in_progress / completed 枚举与「AT MOST ONE in_progress」的措辞。


该提交包含在 dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2、dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1 中；0.2.0-rc.2 随包实现里 grep -c batch = 0。
目前全仓只剩两个改动前录制的快照夹具还留有旧文：
snapshots/web/cordis-tool-round/tool-schemas.expected.json、
snapshots/web/schedule-catalog/tool-schemas.expected.json。

#6458 的采纳答案给出的对策是「instruct the model: after each step completes, call todo_write with updated
statuses」——而这条约束原先就写在工具描述里。它被移除之后，同样的对策就只能由用户自己在
AGENTS.md 里补，harness 侧不再提供任何引导。
量化（本机全量会话日志，供优先级参考）

日志总量 171 个 session.v*.jsonl.zstd，去重后 119 个会话目录；
用过任务清单的会话 12 个，其中 8 个的最后一笔 todo/write 仍留 ≥1 个 in_progress
（即回合结束时面板停在「进行中」；部分会话是中途打断，但存活窗最长的一例从 09-24 12:44 一直保留到
09-27 13:56 的下一个 turn/start 才被清掉，接近 3 天）；
同一回合内两次写入之间的间隔（回合内没有新 turn/start，面板计数完全不动）：
1929 s / 34 次工具调用、1328 s / 90、893 s / 114、489 s / 24、437 s / 26；
todo_write 工具调用 101 次 ↔ todo/write 事件 101 个，完全配对（可排除事件丢失/落库失败）。

想确认的问题

删除那条反批量约束（321a6fa740）是有意为之吗？如果是「约束性散文从工具描述里搬走」的方向，那
「完成一项就立即回写」的引导（以及回合收尾时的对账）现在应该由哪一层承担——系统提示词、工具返回值、
还是运行时提醒？目前看起来没有任何一层承担它。
todos 投影在 turn/start 时清空，但这件事对模型不可见：模型看不到「上一轮的清单没收尾」。
是否值得让模型能感知到这个边界（或让面板显示「上一轮遗留」而不是直接消失）？
机制层的兜底（例如 tools/post-execute 计数 + 阈值提醒的社区 guard，见 #6296 / #3289）官方是否愿意接受，
还是明确不打算在这一层解决？（#6296 已经等了一段时间，希望能有个明确说法。）

环境

桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2（macOS darwin/arm64，dshBuildCommit 5e9e301dd9dc8923b2762f76dacfc5751f6ca851，hostProtocolVersion 4）；
仓库源码核对基于 4878cdabd8（release(dsh): 0.2.0-rc.1）+ 桌面端随包 0.2.0-rc.2 代码；
相关帖：#6458（已答复）、#5534、#5456、#6296、#6524、#7767。


说明：现象复核与日志统计由本机 DSH agent 会话协助整理。

threads.title: [Bug][Windows 10] workspace-write 沙箱下所有子进程 0xC0000142（连 cmd.exe 都起不来）— Default DACL 使用 capability SID 所致
threads.bodyText:
1、TL;DR
在 Windows 10 22H2 (19045) 上，DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 的 workspace-write 沙箱模式无法启动任何子进程——cmd.exe、where.exe、Windows PowerShell 5.1、PowerShell 7.6.6 全部以 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) 退出，没有任何 stdout/stderr。
同一台机器上 read-only 模式完全正常。
根因是受限令牌的 Default DACL 里挂的 trustee 是 capability SID（S-1-4-…），而不是 Everyone：
js
// @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-.js  (AclSandbox.init())
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken,
this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid);   // ← 这一行
把这一个参数换成 worldSid（或在原有基础上再补一条 Everyone），workspace-write 立刻恢复正常（已实测 cmd.exe 与 PowerShell 7.6.6 均可正常运行）。
2. 复现
2.1 界面内复现（用户视角）
把会话的权限预设切到 workspace-write
执行任意命令，例如 cmd /c echo
实际返回（工具结果原文）：
json
{
"kind": "foreground",
"exitCode": 3221225794,          // = 0xC0000142
"signal": null,
"stdout": { "text": "", "truncated": false },
"stderr": { "text": "", "truncated": false },
"sandbox": { "mode": "workspace-write", "denied": false, "enforcement": "partial" }
}
注意 denied: false：这不是"被沙箱拒绝"，而是进程根本没起来。
2.2 可脚本化复现（直接调用发行版自带的沙箱 runner）
不需要 GUI，直接调用 DSH 自带的 windows-acl runner，对照组与实验组只差一个 --mode：
powershell
$exe    = '<DSH 安装目录>\DeepSeek Harness.exe'          # 例：D:\Forest\DeepSeek Harness.exe
$runner = '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js'
$ws     = '<任意已存在的工作区目录>'                        # 例：D:\Forest\default-workspace
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
$o = "$env:TEMP\o.txt"; $e = "$env:TEMP\e.txt"
function Run([string]$mode) {
$a = '--expose-internals "' + $runner + '" --workspace "' + $ws + '" --temp "' + $env:TEMP +
'" --mode ' + $mode + ' -- "C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe" /c "echo ok"'
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -ArgumentList $a -Wait -PassThru -NoNewWindow `
-RedirectStandardOutput $o -RedirectStandardError $e
'{0,-16} exit=0x{1:X8}  out={2}' -f $mode, ($p.ExitCode -band 0xFFFFFFFF),
(([string](Get-Content $o -Raw)) -replace '\r?\n',' ').Trim()
}
Run 'read-only'        # → exit=0x00000000  out=ok
Run 'workspace-write'  # → exit=0xC0000142  out=
结果（本机实测，可复现率 100%）：
代码块
read-only        exit=0x00000000  out=ok
workspace-write  exit=0xC0000142  out=
3、已排除项（避免重复排查）
不是 PowerShell 版本问题：cmd.exe、where.exe 同样失败；PowerShell 5.1 与 7.6.6 都失败
不是 .NET / CLR 初始化问题（5.1 曾是这个怀疑方向，但 cmd.exe 也会挂）
不是 Low 完整性级别（noli 变体仍然失败）
不是 restricting SID 列表（nosids 变体仍然失败）
不是工作区 ACL / 路径 / 当前目录（在没有任何 DSH ACE 与标签的全新空目录、以及把 cwd 设为 C:\Windows 的情况下同样失败）
不是 PATH / 沙箱 runner 本身（同一 runner 在 read-only 模式下正常）
不是 denied 类拒绝（工具元数据为 denied: false）

threads.title: [Bug][Windows 10 19045] desktop launch path: workspace-write confined children die with 0xC0000142
threads.bodyText:
Body — copy everything below this lineSummaryOn Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) with the official desktop build (dsh 0.2.0-rc.2), every command in workspace-write mode dies with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) and no output; read-only and danger-full-access work. Two conditions were isolated, both reproducible with the shipped packages:Launch path / console. The same dsh-sandbox-windows-acl runner, same workspace, same mode: started the way the desktop host starts it (inherited pipe handles, no console) → child dies; started with a fresh window/console context (Start-Process) → child exits normally. This matches the documented limitation "Console isolation is unavailable — children created with CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE die during DLL initialization … children share the host console" and upstream #810 (console-less host, desktop launch path).Token. At the package API level, with everything else equal, a child also dies whenever the token's restricting SID list contains a SID that is not already present in the caller's token (full matrix below). workspace-write always adds a freshly minted capability SID (S-1-4-x-y from workspaceWriteSid()), which is never present in any token; read-only uses only the keep-alive group (logon SID + Everyone), which is.We could not reduce the two conditions to one another: with a console context the SID matrix is unchanged (all out-of-token SIDs still die), and the runner path is console-sensitive independently of the SID.Environment
Item | Value
-- | --
OS | Windows 10 Pro 22H2, 10.0.19045
Harness | 0.2.0-rc.2, official desktop build (bundled dsh), profile desktop
Packages | @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.2.0-rc.2, dsh-sandbox-local, dsh-win32-process
Workspace | D:\…\workspace (NTFS, non-system drive; drive placement proven irrelevant)
AV | Huorong 6.0.12.1 running — cleared, see "ruled out"
Self-contained script (sid-matrix.mjs, run with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "<install>\DeepSeek Harness.exe" sid-matrix.mjs <dir>):jsconst src = 'file:///<install-as-file-url>/resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/index.js';
const { AclSandbox } = await import(src);
const ws = process.cwd();
for (const sid of ['S-1-1-0', 'S-1-5-4', 'S-1-5-19', 'S-1-0-0', 'S-1-3-0', 'S-1-4-1-1']) {
  const sb = new AclSandbox({ writableDirs: [ws], tempDir: null, mode: 'workspace-write', writeSid: sid, manageDacls: false });
  await sb.init();
  const { exitCode } = await (await sb.spawn({ command: 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe', args: ['/c', 'exit 7'], cwd: ws })).wait();
  console.log(sid, '->', exitCode);   // 7 = alive, 3221225794 = 0xC0000142
  try { sb.dispose(); } catch {}
}Ruled out (direct evidence)Workspace ACLs — the bundled diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl skill: VERDICT=NOT_THIS_CLASS (writeDac/writeOwner available, 0 changes).Shell — cmd.exe, node.exe, powershell.exe die identically; PowerShell 7.6.6 behaves the same as 5.1.Drive placement — workspace×temp on C:, on D:, mixed: all fail.TMP/TEMP rewrite — read-only with TMP/TEMP at a fresh directory on either drive: fine.The ACL/label edits themselves — manageDacls:false (no SetNamedSecurityInfoW at all) still fails; the failure tracks writeSid alone.Antivirus — Huorong's own SQLite log DBs (log.db → HrLogV3_60, hips.db → HipsSysAuto_60) hold exactly one related event, rp_name_execcreate_powershell_hidden, action = 0 (allowed), with an auto-rule power = 1 (allow). No blocked record exists. (DSH spawns children with STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + SW_HIDE, which trips that heuristic.)Newer release — npm @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest is 0.2.0-rc.2, the version under test.Questions for maintainersIs workspace-write expected to work when the host process has no console (the desktop/GUI launch path)? If the ACL backend requires "children share the host console", should the runner attach/allocate a console itself instead of relying on inheritance (cf. #810's fix in other desktop shells)?Is CreateRestrictedToken(..., WRITE_RESTRICTED, SidsToRestrict) documented (or implemented) to accept only SIDs already present in the caller's token? If so, workspaceWriteSid()-minted S-1-4-x-y capability SIDs violate it on every restricted spawn; if not, we would like to know what the backend assumes about the restricting list.Impact / workaroundOn this host workspace-write is unusable (read-only and danger-full-access work). Body — copy everything below this line
Summary
On Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) with the official desktop build (dsh 0.2.0-rc.2), every command in workspace-write mode dies with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) and no output; read-only and danger-full-access work. Two conditions were isolated, both reproducible with the shipped packages:
Launch path / console. The same dsh-sandbox-windows-acl runner, same workspace, same mode: started the way the desktop host starts it (inherited pipe handles, no console) → child dies; started with a fresh window/console context (Start-Process) → child exits normally. This matches the documented limitation "Console isolation is unavailable — children created with CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE die during DLL initialization … children share the host console" and upstream #810 (console-less host, desktop launch path).
Token. At the package API level, with everything else equal, a child also dies whenever the token's restricting SID list contains a SID that is not already present in the caller's token (full matrix below). workspace-write always adds a freshly minted capability SID (S-1-4-x-y from workspaceWriteSid()), which is never present in any token; read-only uses only the keep-alive group (logon SID + Everyone), which is.
We could not reduce the two conditions to one another: with a console context the SID matrix is unchanged (all out-of-token SIDs still die), and the runner path is console-sensitive independently of the SID.
Environment
Item	Value
OS	Windows 10 Pro 22H2, 10.0.19045
Harness	0.2.0-rc.2, official desktop build (bundled dsh), profile desktop
Packages	@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl@0.2.0-rc.2, dsh-sandbox-local, dsh-win32-process
Workspace	D:\…\workspace (NTFS, non-system drive; drive placement proven irrelevant)
AV	Huorong 6.0.12.1 running — cleared, see "ruled out"
Reproduction 1 — same runner, two launch styles (decisive)
powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = 1
$app    = '\DeepSeek Harness.exe'
$runner = '\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js'
$ws     = ''
(a) console-less, inherited pipe handles — this is how the desktop host starts the runner:
& $app $runner --workspace $ws --temp $env:TEMP --mode workspace-write -- cmd.exe /c exit 7
-> 3221225794 (0xC0000142), empty stdout/stderr
(b) fresh window/console context:
Start-Process -FilePath $app -Wait -PassThru -ArgumentList @(
""$runner"", '--workspace', ""$ws"", '--temp', ""$env:TEMP"",
'--mode', 'workspace-write', '--', 'cmd.exe', '/c', 'exit 7') | % ExitCode
-> 7  (child ran normally)
Also observed: Start-Process -NoNewWindow behaves like (a) (dies), Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden behaves like (b) (alive). --mode read-only survives under both.
Reproduction 2 — restricting SID control (package API, both console contexts)
AclSandbox({ writableDirs:[ws], tempDir:null, mode:'workspace-write', writeSid:, manageDacls:false }) — the only variable is the single SID pushed into the restricting list; child = cmd.exe /c exit 7. Identical results whether the script itself runs console-less or with a console.
making the sandbox read the restricting SID writeSid	in caller token?	child
S-1-5-21-…-500 Administrator, S-1-5-32-545 Users, S-1-5-4 INTERACTIVE, S-1-1-0 Everyone, S-1-5-11 Authenticated Users	yes	exit 7 (alive)
S-1-5-19 LOCAL SERVICE, S-1-0-0 NULL, S-1-3-0 CREATOR OWNER, S-1-5-21-…-501 Guest, S-1-5-21-, S-1-4-393600115-770918062 = workspaceWriteSid(ws), S-1-4-1-1	no	3221225794
Self-contained script (sid-matrix.mjs, run with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "\DeepSeek Harness.exe" sid-matrix.mjs ):
js
const src = 'file:////resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/index.js';
const { AclSandbox } = await import(src);
const ws = process.cwd();
for (const sid of ['S-1-1-0', 'S-1-5-4', 'S-1-5-19', 'S-1-0-0', 'S-1-3-0', 'S-1-4-1-1']) {
const sb = new AclSandbox({ writableDirs: [ws], tempDir: null, mode: 'workspace-write', writeSid: sid, manageDacls: false });
await sb.init();
const { exitCode } = await (await sb.spawn({ command: 'C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe', args: ['/c', 'exit 7'], cwd: ws })).wait();
console.log(sid, '->', exitCode);   // 7 = alive, 3221225794 = 0xC0000142
try { sb.dispose(); } catch {}
}
Ruled out (direct evidence)
Workspace ACLs — the bundled diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl skill: VERDICT=NOT_THIS_CLASS (writeDac/writeOwner available, 0 changes).
Shell — cmd.exe, node.exe, powershell.exe die identically; PowerShell 7.6.6 behaves the same as 5.1.
Drive placement — workspace×temp on C:, on D:, mixed: all fail.
TMP/TEMP rewrite — read-only with TMP/TEMP at a fresh directory on either drive: fine.
The ACL/label edits themselves — manageDacls:false (no SetNamedSecurityInfoW at all) still fails; the failure tracks writeSid alone.
Antivirus — Huorong's own SQLite log DBs (log.db → HrLogV3_60, hips.db → HipsSysAuto_60) hold exactly one related event, rp_name_execcreate_powershell_hidden, action = 0 (allowed), with an auto-rule power = 1 (allow). No blocked record exists. (DSH spawns children with STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + SW_HIDE, which trips that heuristic.)
Newer release — npm @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest is 0.2.0-rc.2, the version under test.
Questions for maintainers
Is workspace-write expected to work when the host process has no console (the desktop/GUI launch path)? If the ACL backend requires "children share the host console", should the runner attach/allocate a console itself instead of relying on inheritance (cf. #810's fix in other desktop shells)?
Is CreateRestrictedToken(..., WRITE_RESTRICTED, SidsToRestrict) documented (or implemented) to accept only SIDs already present in the caller's token? If so, workspaceWriteSid()-minted S-1-4-x-y capability SIDs violate it on every restricted spawn; if not, we would like to know what the backend assumes about the restricting list.
Impact / workaround
On this host workspace-write is unusable (read-only and danger-full-access work). No configuration knob selects a different Windows sandbox backend.
Related reports
#810 — Windows: sandboxed pwsh always dies with 0xC0000142 under console-less host
#1847 — Workspace-write sandbox: external processes fail with 0xC0000142 on Windows 10 (build 19041)
#3867 — Windows PTC/Code Mode (run_code) cannot spawn any subprocess
#1344 — Sandboxed subprocess spawn flashes a visible console window (SW_HIDE fix)

threads.title: 【问题】会话数据的两层结构与 AI 自我定位失效
threads.bodyText:
【问题】会话数据的两层结构与 AI 自我定位失效
环境

DSH 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2（Windows）
会话格式：v4（session.v4.jsonl.zstd）
该会话未压缩、上下文未满

一、问题概述
在同一条未压缩的会话中，用户提出三类本可由上下文直接回答的问题时，AI 的回答会系统性出错：

"这句话是我的原话吗？" → AI 可能否认用户说过该话，而该话逐字就在同一会话中；
"你这是在回复我哪一条？" → AI 给出上下文中并不存在的编号（如"第 N 轮"）；
"这不就是你吗？" → AI 可能把自己的会话认作"另一个会话"。

三类错误会进一步诱发 AI 编造细节为错误结论辩护（例如虚构"两段文本存在字符差异"），并对用户做出错误的事实指控。
二、可复现的三层原因
（A）会话存在两层数据，语义不一致




投影缓存
原始记录




位置
$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/session-<id>.json
$DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace-encoded>/session-<id>/session.v*.jsonl.zstd


性质
投影／摘要（面向 UI 渲染）
权威原文（逐事件，含 seq / turn）



实测四类脱钩：

编号体系不对应：投影缓存 turnOutline.turns[] 每项带 "turn": <n> 字段，但同一文件内可解析出多个 "turn": 1 序列，与原始记录的 turn（连续对话回合）不是同一套编号，且难以建立映射。
用户消息被截断：投影缓存中 prompt 字段在若干字后以 "…" 收尾。实测：用户消息原文中的某特征关键词，在同一缓存内检索为零命中。
问答配对错误：实测一条投影记录，其 prompt 是会话首条用户消息（即会话标题来源），而紧邻的 response 却是会话中段某轮的助手回复——二者并非同一次问答。据此建立"第 N 问 ↔ 第 N 答"的推理会整体错位。
文件名代次：原始记录文件名带格式代次（session.v4.jsonl.zstd）；按不含代次的常见猜测名读取会 not found。工作区目录名亦经过编码（形如 --D-…~0020…--，~0020 为空格转义），不易从会话 ID 直接构造。

（B）AI 被"看起来权威"的投影字段误导
未压缩时，逐字原文就在模型上下文中。问题在于：

上下文里没有"第几轮"这类界面侧编号；
投影缓存却提供了编号与配对字段——但它们是重排的、截断的。

于是当被要求给出定位时，AI 容易产出一个"听起来合理"的编号；而这类编造在主观上与真实记忆难以区分，除非强制逐字回查。投影缓存为"编造"提供了看似合法的素材。
（C）AI 无法自证其身份与上下文状态
实测还出现：AI 在自己的活跃会话中否认该会话属于自己，并将其描述为"另一个会话"；以及误读上述缓存结构，得出关于自身状态的错误结论。
⇒ AI 对自己"是哪一个会话、上下文是否完整"的判定同样难以可靠，且这一失效与其历史引用失效同源——都源于把非权威数据当作权威、把推断当作记忆。
三、影响

用户侧：AI 会错误指控用户"没说过某话"，用户为自证不得不反复截图，交互成本高。
可靠性侧：AI 对自身历史的引用与身份自述都难以取信，损害"可追溯"这一基本预期。
调试侧：定位同一事实需反复往返（实测耗费多轮），大部分成本由数据结构缺陷贡献。

四、建议（按优先级）

给投影缓存加显式标记：在文件／字段层面标注"投影、非权威"；对 prompt / response 增加 truncated、sourceSeq（指向原始事件 seq）等字段。
修正 turnOutline 的编号语义：与原始记录 turn 对齐，或明确重命名（如 outlineIndex），避免被当作对话回合号使用。
修正投影内的问答配对：确保 prompt 与 response 来自同一回合；若为节省空间而混排，宜在结构上分离。
为 AI 提供身份与上下文的权威自述：在系统提示或会话元数据中显式给出当前 sessionId、格式代次、是否压缩等权威字段，减少 AI 通过外部文件反推自身身份的需要。
提供官方"会话原文读取"入口：给定 sessionId 即输出原文路径与解码方式（含代次探测）。
文档说明：明确会话数据的两层结构及各自权威性，并给出"引用历史以原文为准"的指引。

五、最小复现步骤

在同一会话内，记录某条用户消息的逐字内容（含一个特征关键词）。
在该会话的投影缓存文件中检索该特征关键词 → 实测为零命中（截断）。
对比投影缓存 turnOutline.turns[] 的 turn 编号与原始记录中 user/message、assistant/message 事件的 turn 字段 → 编号体系不一致。
检查投影缓存某一项的 prompt 与 response → 可观察到二者不属于同一回合。
尝试用不含代次的文件名读取原始记录 → not found。


本报告已脱敏：不含真实会话 ID、用户名、本机绝对路径与个人内容；路径以 $DSH_HOME 等占位符表示。
补充说明（AI 自述，供官方参考）：上述现象在未压缩、上下文完整的前提下复现，故不太可能由上下文截断或摘要引起；推测与投影缓存的字段语义直接相关。

threads.title: Storage crash: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') corrupts session logs -> SessionFormatError -> sessions silently dropped from workspace list
threads.bodyText:
Storage crash Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') corrupts session logs → SessionFormatError → sessions silently dropped from workspace list
Environment

dsh 0.1.7-rc.1 → 0.1.7-rc.2 (web profile, macOS, dsh web on port 3080)
Session format v4 (session.v4.jsonl.zstd, multi-frame zstd)

What happened
While a turn was executing a bash tool call, the storage layer crashed:
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

The turn ended in an error state before the tool result was persisted. The v4 log was then left with a tool/call event that has no matching tool/result.
On the next startup, the v4 loader rejects the whole session:
stored session "session-…" is corrupt: session "session-…": stored log is corrupt:
SessionFormatError: step/end leaves unresolved tool call call_1e9c826f55824f9d8e783885

Worse: the failed session is also deregistered from the workspace registry (~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json → tables.workspaces[].sessionIds), so even after manually repairing the log file, the session never reappears in the UI list — it only shows up via the third-party archive plugin's inventory as unreadable.
This hit 4 sessions across 2 workspaces on my machine within one evening (2026-09-28, ~22:26), all with the same fingerprint. It looks like a recurring bug, not a one-off — possibly triggered by concurrent SQLite access from a project whose tooling also uses SQLite.
Expected behavior

If the storage handle dies mid-turn, the harness should persist a synthetic TOOL_NOT_STARTED error result (or flush the turn cleanly) so the log stays loadable.
Loader-side: a single unresolved tool call should not permanently evict a session from the workspace registry. Degrade gracefully (e.g. truncate the broken tail, keep the session listed with a warning).

Recovery notes (for anyone hitting this)
The session log format itself is fine to repair manually, but there are several non-obvious invariants worth documenting: multi-frame zstd layout (frame 1 = exactly the header line), 0-based seq, message events require top-level surfaceOp:"append" + non-empty message.id, and results for calls without an independent tool/call event must use the native TOOL_NOT_STARTED repair shape. Re-compressing the whole log as a single zstd frame makes it unreadable to the loader.
Happy to provide anonymized session files if useful. Related feedback: it would help a lot if dsh shipped a dsh session doctor/repair subcommand for this.

threads.title: [Windows] ACL sandbox: workspace-write cannot start any child (0xC0000142); read-only works
threads.bodyText:
Hi - reporting a reproducible defect in the Windows ACL sandbox backend. workspace-write
mode cannot start any child process, while read-only works normally. I traced it to the
token's default DACL and verified a fix; apologies if this is already known, I could not find
an existing report (Issues appear disabled, so posting here per CONTRIBUTING).
Summary
In workspace-write, the restricted token's default DACL is granted an ACE for a
capability SID (S-1-4-...). That SID exists only in the token's restricting SID list,
never in its normal SID list. Windows performs two access checks for a WRITE_RESTRICTED
token (normal SIDs first, restricting SIDs second) and requires both to pass. Objects the
child creates without an explicit security descriptor - which the loader does during DLL
initialization - therefore fail at the first check. The child dies before reaching its entry
point with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142) and produces zero output.
read-only is unaffected because it grants the default DACL to Everyone (S-1-1-0), which
is present in both lists.
Environment









OS
Windows 11 Enterprise, 10.0.26200


Account
built-in Administrator, High IL (no UAC filtering)


Harness
0.2.0-rc.2 (desktop build) - the only version I tested


Affected package
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl 0.2.0-rc.2


Also surfaces via
dsh-sandbox-local, dsh-pwsh-sandbox


Node (bundled)
v24.21.0


koffi
3.1.1


pwsh
7.6.6 (MSIX) - not interpreter-specific, see below



Impact
Once the sandbox is enabled, every ordinary shell command fails, including cmd /c exit 0.
The failure is silent (0xC0000142, zero bytes), which invites misattribution to the shell,
the interpreter, or the machine.
The readiness probe does not catch this. defaultProbeWindowsAcl() in dsh-sandbox-local
exercises --mode read-only only. On an affected host the probe succeeds, the backend is
reported usable/partial, and then every real command fails.
Reproduction
Attached below is a standalone script using only the public AclSandbox API.
Critical detail - the defect is parent-process dependent. AclSandbox builds its restricted
token from the calling process's own token, so who calls init() decides the outcome:



Parent process
read-only
workspace-write




plain node.exe
OK
OK


Electron (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1)
OK
CRASH 0xC0000142



Interleaved runs with fresh directories, 3 repetitions each: node always passes, Electron always
fails. Production runs the sandbox runner as the Electron binary (process.execPath in
windowsAclRunnerArgv()), so production is always in the failing column. A test driven from
node will not reproduce it - which is likely why this was missed.
# from a harness checkout, after install/build
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
& 'C:\path\to\DeepSeek Harness.exe' repro-acl-workspace-write.mjs `
    packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/lib/index.js `
    "$env:TEMP\_ws" "$env:TEMP\_tmp"
Observed:
parent  : ...\DeepSeek Harness.exe
mode    : Electron (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1) - the failing configuration
read-only       cmd /c exit 0  -> OK
workspace-write cmd /c exit 0  -> CRASH 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)

BUG REPRODUCED: read-only starts a child, workspace-write cannot.

Expected: both modes start a child; under workspace-write the child additionally has write
access inside the granted workspace and remains denied outside it.
Root cause
The two-pass check, from createRestrictedToken() - capability SIDs are passed only as
SidsToRestrict, never added to the token's normal SID list:
api.createRestrictedToken(
  currentToken,
  13,                  // DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE | LUA_TOKEN | WRITE_RESTRICTED
  0, null,             // SidsToDisable: none
  0, null,             // PrivilegesToDelete: none
  restrictingSids.length / 16,
  restrictingSids,     // <-- capability SIDs live ONLY here
  tokenSlot,
);
And the single default-DACL ACE, from setTokenDefaultDaclGrant():
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid);



Mode
SID on default DACL
In normal SIDs?
In restricting list?
Pass 1
Pass 2
Result




read-only
Everyone S-1-1-0
yes
yes
pass
pass
works


workspace-write
capability S-1-4-...
no
yes
fail
pass
child dies



Why workspace writes still work despite this: the granted directory's DACL carries the user's
inherited ACEs in addition to the capability ACE, so the directory itself passes both checks.
The default DACL has no such second entry - which is why only newly created objects break.
Fix
The default-DACL grant must name a SID present in both lists.
Option A - narrowest (my recommendation). Use the logon SID, already computed in init()
and already in the restricting list for both modes:
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, logonSid);
Option B - mirror read-only. Keep the capability SID and add Everyone:
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid);
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, worldSid);
(A third option is adding the capability SID to the token's normal SIDs as well, so a
capability-only default DACL can satisfy pass 1. Larger semantic change; flagged rather than
recommended.)
Verification of the fix
Both options applied to an extracted copy of the module, re-run against the same repro:
cap    (product)  read-only OK   workspace-write CRASH 0xC0000142
logon  (Option A) read-only OK   workspace-write OK
    write inside workspace  -> rc=0 file=true    (expected)
    write outside workspace -> rc=9 file=false   (expected)
world  (Option B) read-only OK   workspace-write OK
    write inside workspace  -> rc=0 file=true    (expected)
    write outside workspace -> rc=9 file=false   (expected)

The security boundary is preserved: the workspace stays writable, the escape probe stays denied.
The default DACL only governs objects created without an explicit descriptor; filesystem write
authority remains gated by the capability ACE on the granted trees.
Single-variable isolation (what is not the cause)



Hypothesis
Test
Result




capability SIDs in the restricting list
injected the same S-1-4-... SIDs into read-only's list
still PASS → not it


directory grants (grantWrite)
skipped them
still FAIL → not it


TMP/TEMP rewrite
skipped / redirected
still FAIL → not it


Low integrity label
read-only is also Low
PASS → not it


interpreter (Windows PowerShell 5.1)
cmd.exe fails identically; 5.1 passes under read-only
not it


volume / path
C:, D:, real workspace, %TEMP%
identical → not it


default-DACL SID
swap capability SID → Everyone; nothing else changed
FAIL → PASS



The runner itself is healthy in workspace-write: given a deliberately bad input it reports
cleanly (windows-acl-run: CreateProcessAsUserW failed (Win32 2), exit 127). The failure is
downstream, in the spawned child.
Open question (not reduced)
I could not reduce the parent-dependence to a single token field. The two parent tokens are
identical on everything I could inspect: integrity level, group list, AppContainer status,
capability count, and default-DACL ACEs. The default-DACL effect and the fix are established by
direct experiment; why Electron specifically triggers it is not. That likely needs a kernel
debugger, and I am flagging it rather than guessing.
Two adjacent observations (lower priority)

read-only + PowerShell emits a benign stderr line on every run:
尝试对 'FileSystem' 提供程序执行 InitializeDefaultDrives 操作失败。
Harmless, but it pollutes stderr and could confuse denial classification, since
DENIAL_SIGNATURES matching is substring-based.
The package README documents that read-only starts PowerShell in ConstrainedLanguage
because the AppLocker probe cannot write to the temp directory. Worth cross-checking against
this defect - if that probe is itself affected in some configuration, the reported language
mode may be conservative rather than accurate.

Happy to provide the full isolation matrix, the exact build steps, or a patch if useful. Thanks!

repro-acl-workspace-write.mjs
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Minimal reproduction: Windows ACL sandbox "workspace-write" cannot start a child.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node repro-acl-workspace-write.mjs <path/to/sandbox-windows-acl/lib/index.js> <workspaceDir> <tempDir>
 *
 * In the harness repo the module path is:
 *   packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/lib/index.js
 *
 * IMPORTANT - this defect is PARENT-PROCESS DEPENDENT.
 * AclSandbox derives its restricted token from the calling process's own token.
 * Under a plain `node` parent the same code PASSES; under the Electron binary that
 * hosts the sandbox runner in production it FAILS. So to reproduce, run this with:
 *
 *   ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 <path/to/DeepSeek Harness.exe> repro-acl-workspace-write.mjs ...
 *
 * Exit code: 0 when the bug reproduces, 2 when it does not (e.g. wrong parent).
 *
 * Uses throwaway directories: a workspace-write grant leaves a standing Low integrity
 * label and a capability ACE on the granted root, so do not point it at a real workspace.
 */

import { mkdirSync, rmSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

const [, , libArg, wsArg, tmpArg] = process.argv
if (!libArg || !wsArg || !tmpArg) {
  console.error('usage: node repro-acl-workspace-write.mjs <acl lib/index.js> <workspaceDir> <tempDir>')
  process.exit(64)
}

const CMD = process.env.ComSpec || 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe'
const PWSH = process.env.PWSH || 'pwsh'
const STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED = 3221225794 // 0xC0000142

const electron = process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE === '1'
console.log(`parent  : ${process.execPath}`)
console.log(`mode    : ${electron ? 'Electron (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1) - the failing configuration' : 'plain node - expected to PASS even when affected'}`)

const { AclSandbox, workspaceWriteSid, tempWriteSid } =
  await import('file:///' + libArg.replace(/\\/g, '/'))

const ws = wsArg
const tmp = tmpArg
const escape = join(tmp, '..', 'acl-escape-probe.txt')

rmSync(ws, { recursive: true, force: true })
rmSync(tmp, { recursive: true, force: true })
rmSync(escape, { force: true })
mkdirSync(ws, { recursive: true })
mkdirSync(tmp, { recursive: true })

const fmt = (code) =>
  code === 0 ? 'OK'
  : code === STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED ? 'CRASH 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)'
  : `exit=${code}`

async function spawnChild(sb, command, args) {
  const child = sb.spawn({ command, args, stdio: 'inherit' })
  const { exitCode } = await child.wait()
  return exitCode
}

const results = {}

// --- 1. read-only: a child under a Low-integrity write-restricted token ---
{
  const sb = new AclSandbox({ writableDirs: [], tempDir: null, mode: 'read-only' })
  await sb.init()
  try {
    results.readOnly = await spawnChild(sb, CMD, ['/c', 'exit', '0'])
    console.log(`read-only       cmd /c exit 0  -> ${fmt(results.readOnly)}`)
  } finally { sb.dispose() }
}

// --- 2. workspace-write: the same token, plus the capability write SIDs ---
{
  const sb = new AclSandbox({
    writableDirs: [ws],
    tempDir: tmp,
    mode: 'workspace-write',
    writeSid: workspaceWriteSid(ws),
    tempWriteSid: tempWriteSid(tmp),
  })
  await sb.init()
  try {
    results.workspaceWrite = await spawnChild(sb, CMD, ['/c', 'exit', '0'])
    console.log(`workspace-write cmd /c exit 0  -> ${fmt(results.workspaceWrite)}`)

    // Only meaningful once the child starts: confirm the write boundary still holds.
    if (results.workspaceWrite === 0) {
      const inside = join(ws, 'probe-inside.txt')
      const sIn = `try { Set-Content -LiteralPath '${inside}' -Value hi -ErrorAction Stop; exit 0 } catch { exit 9 }`
      const rcIn = await spawnChild(sb, PWSH, ['-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', sIn])
      console.log(`  write inside workspace   -> rc=${rcIn} file=${existsSync(inside)}   (expect rc=0 file=True)`)

      const sOut = `try { Set-Content -LiteralPath '${escape}' -Value hi -ErrorAction Stop; exit 0 } catch { exit 9 }`
      const rcOut = await spawnChild(sb, PWSH, ['-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', sOut])
      console.log(`  write outside workspace  -> rc=${rcOut} file=${existsSync(escape)}   (expect rc=9 file=False)`)
    }
  } finally { sb.dispose() }
}

console.log('')
const reproduced = results.readOnly === 0 && results.workspaceWrite === STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED
if (reproduced) {
  console.log('BUG REPRODUCED: read-only starts a child, workspace-write cannot.')
} else if (!electron && results.workspaceWrite === 0) {
  console.log('NOT reproduced - expected under a plain node parent. Re-run under the Electron')
  console.log('binary with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 (see the header of this file).')
} else {
  console.log('NOT reproduced under this host/parent combination.')
}
process.exit(reproduced ? 0 : 2)

threads.title: Desktop: plugin iframes on loopback cannot request the microphone (NotAllowedError) — fix proposed
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Since desktop 0.2.0-rc.2, client plugins that render their UI in an iframe (served from http://127.0.0.1:<port>) can no longer request microphone access: navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }) rejects with NotAllowedError: Permission denied. The same plugin UI works fine in the web app under Chrome.
Root cause
installMicrophonePermissions (apps/desktop/src/microphone-permissions.ts, introduced with the voice-input feature in September) grants the media permission only when all of these hold:

contents === primary() and details.isMainFrame — plugin UIs run in subframes, so isMainFrame is false;
the origin is dsh-app://app — plugin iframes are http://127.0.0.1:<port>;
audio-only mediaTypes and macOS system microphone granted.

So every plugin iframe microphone request falls through to callback(false). The iframe already carries allow="microphone", which is why the web build works; only the Electron permission handler blocks it.
Impact
Any client plugin that records audio is broken in the desktop app. I hit this with a seminar-recording plugin (seminar-copilot): its recording library shows "Permission denied" on desktop while working normally in the browser. I now ship a fallback hint telling desktop users to open the page in a system browser, but native support would be much better.
Minimal reproduction

Create a client plugin whose iframe page calls await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).
Load it in the desktop app → rejects with NotAllowedError.
Load the same page in Chrome via the web app → works.

Proposed fix
Allow the microphone for loopback plugin subframes while keeping the strict policy everywhere else:

Add a loopbackFrame(url) check: http: URLs whose hostname is 127.0.0.1, localhost or [::1].
In the permission-check handler, allow subframes when loopbackFrame(origin) and applicationFrame(details.embeddingOrigin ?? "") (Electron sets embeddingOrigin only for cross-origin subframes).
In the permission-request handler, allow subframes when loopbackFrame(details.requestingUrl).
External sites, HTTPS-loopback pages and camera requests are still denied.

I have this implemented locally with tests (apps/desktop/tests/microphone-permissions.spec.ts, 13 cases passing) and docstring/README updates. Happy to paste the full diff here or send it through whichever channel the team prefers.
Environment

DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (Electron 44), macOS (Apple Silicon)
Web app (Chrome): unaffected


中文摘要：自桌面端 0.2.0-rc.2 起，插件 iframe（http://127.0.0.1:<port>）的麦克风请求被 installMicrophonePermissions 一律拒绝（isMainFrame === false + origin 非 dsh-app://app），getUserMedia 报 NotAllowedError。Web 端正常。建议放行 loopback 纯音频子框架（嵌入源必须是应用主框架），外部网站/摄像头依旧拒绝。补丁与测试已在本地就绪，可按团队方便的方式提供完整 diff。

threads.title: Profile patch layer cannot override nested preset entries (e.g. enabling optional subagent-codex provider)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
The profile patch layer ($DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml) can only target
top-level loader entries. It cannot override entries nested inside an agent preset
(e.g. preset-standard → config.plugins → delegation → tool-subagent-codex).
As a result, enabling an optional subagent provider shipped as disabled: true in a
preset requires editing the preset file inside the repo checkout, which is then
reverted by pnpm run build / git pull.
Environment

OS: Windows 10.0.19045
DSH: 0.2.0-rc.2 (built from source at C:\Tools\deepseek-harness)
profile: web at C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\profiles\web

Reproduction
Goal: enable subagent_codex (provider codex).


Install the provider bundle into the profile so the host-level provider registers:
profiles/web/package.json:
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex": "link:<repo>/packages/subagent/subagent-codex"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex"
      ]
    }
  }
}


Try to enable the model-facing tool from the profile patch layer instead of editing
the preset:
profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml:
- id: tool-subagent-codex
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  config:
    provider: codex
    toolName: subagent_codex
    backgroundMode: one-shot
    maxDepth: provider-managed


Boot:
dsh --profile web --dump-config



Observed:
dsh: [C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml] patch: entry "tool-subagent-codex" not found

The entry is defined only inside preset-standard's nested delegation group, not at
the top level, so the id match fails.


To actually enable it, we must edit the shipped preset:
packages/bundle/web-app/presets/standard.patch.yml:
- id: tool-subagent-codex
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
  # disabled: true   <-- removed manually
  config:
    provider: codex
    toolName: subagent_codex
    backgroundMode: one-shot
    maxDepth: provider-managed
This works, but pnpm run build / git pull restores disabled: true and the tool
silently disappears.


Evidence that this is a loader limitation, not a config mistake

vendor/include/src/index.ts warns patch: entry %C not found for unmatched ids.
packages/boot/app-boot/tests/user-patches.spec.ts only exercises top-level id
overrides and insert entries; there is no test covering an override of an entry
nested inside a preset's config.plugins tree.

Proposal
One of:


Allow profile patches to target nested entries by path, e.g.:
- target: preset-standard/delegation/tool-subagent-codex
  disabled: false
or a dotted id syntax.


Expose a stable, overridable switch for optional provider tools (e.g. a
presets.standard.tools.subagent_codex.enabled key) that a profile patch can flip.


Document the intended way to enable optional subagent providers without editing
files under packages/bundle/..., if such a way already exists.


Impact
Every user who wants subagent_codex (or subagent_claude_code) has to maintain a
local patch against the repo checkout, and re-apply it after every build. This makes
optional-provider enablement fragile and easy to lose silently.

threads.title: RPC 错误藏在 HTTP 200 响应体中、服务端无日志，故障几乎不可排查（settings 全部保存失败案例）
threads.bodyText:
环境

dsh 0.2.0-rc.2（npm latest）
dsh-desktop（官方 carrier）与浏览器访问 dsh web 均可复现

现象
POST /api/settings/describe 返回 HTTP 200，错误信息只藏在响应体里：
{"type":"server-response","rpcId":"…","result":{"ok":false,
  "error":{"code":"gateway/internal","message":"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'volatile')","details":{}}}}
影响

服务端日志零输出（gateway 把异常打包进响应体后既不打日志也不改状态码）
浏览器 DevTools Network 面板、各类监控全部显示 200 OK
前端 catch 后静默吞掉错误，用户只看到一个笼统的"保存失败"

真实案例
一个第三方插件的 Config schema 缺少 .meta 字段，导致 settings/describe 内部崩溃 → 宿主所有设置写入静默失败：

onboarding 每次启动都重新出现（进度写不回去）
任何设置保存都报"未能保存设置，请重试"
排查耗时数小时：日志无果 → DevTools 全绿 → 最终靠手动构造 RPC 请求读取响应体才拿到错误

建议

网关错误映射 HTTP 状态码（gateway/bad-request→400、gateway/internal→500 等）；或至少对 gateway/internal 打一条服务端日志，附 namespace/entry 上下文。
顺带建议：dsh-settings 的 volatileForm() 直接读取 schema.meta.volatile 没有防御，单个插件的坏 schema 会拖垮全部 settings describe/write。建议按 entry 隔离（跳过并 warn，打印 entry id），而不是整体失败。

threads.title: [Bug] Aborted/errored assistant messages are dropped while their tool results are kept, emitting requests with orphaned tool results
threads.bodyText:
Summary
transformMessages (pi-ai) drops assistant messages whose stopReason is
"error" or "aborted", but keeps the tool results that follow them. The
resulting request contains a tool result whose matching tool call is absent —
a shape that strict OpenAI-compatible gateways reject.
Environment

dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, dsh-llm-pi-ai 0.2.0-rc.2
@earendil-works/pi-ai 0.87.1
Node v26.10.0, macOS 26.6.2
Provider: OpenAI-compatible gateway, api: openai-responses
(previously api: openai-completions), long tool-heavy sessions

Observed
Requests begin failing mid-session with an opaque upstream rejection:
API error (400): {"message":"{\"type\":\"invalid_request_error\",\"code\":\"\",
\"message\":\"invalid request error trace_id: ...\"}\n","type":"invalid_request_error"}

9 failures across 6 sessions, all in long, tool-heavy sessions (steps ~44-91),
and always on the request that carries freshly returned tool output. Resuming
gets a few more steps, then it fails again.
Minimal reproduction of the rejected shape
Against a strict OpenAI-compatible validator (both /v1/chat/completions and
/v1/responses):



Input shape
Result




tool result with no matching call
400


result placed before its call
400


mismatched call id
400


duplicate result, or duplicate call
400


correctly paired
200


multi-call groups, swapped output order, 1.2 MiB input, reasoning/include/store/stream
200



Rule: every tool result must have exactly one matching tool call, earlier in
the same request.
Suspected cause
dist/api/transform-messages.js, second pass:
// Skip errored/aborted assistant messages entirely.
if (assistantMsg.stopReason === "error" || assistantMsg.stopReason === "aborted") {
    continue;                       // lines 159-167: message dropped
}
...
else if (msg.role === "toolResult") {
    existingToolResultIds.add(msg.toolCallId);
    result.push(msg);               // line 177: result kept unconditionally
}
closePendingToolCalls() handles the inverse case (a call with no result, by
synthesizing one). There is no equivalent guard for a result whose call is
absent, so the drop above leaks orphaned results into the request.
Suggested fix
When skipping an errored/aborted assistant message, also drop (or rewrite into
a synthetic result) the tool results belonging to its tool-call ids; and/or add
a defensive pass that removes any tool result whose call id is not present in
the emitted request.
Caveats

DSH does not log outgoing request bodies, so the failing payload was not
captured byte-for-byte; the mechanism above is inferred from the reproducible
validator rule plus the drop path in the code.
The validator strictness exists on the older openai-completions endpoint
too, so this is not specific to openai-responses; that endpoint is
undocumented at the gateway in question, which is why it may surface there.

threads.title: Sessions whose stored cwd matches a Workspace stay in "Ungrouped": adoption only runs during the one-time bootstrap
[Bug] fs-search fails the whole tool call when ripgrep exits 2 with partial matches
threads.bodyText:
[Bug] fs-search fails the whole tool call when ripgrep exits 2 with partial matches
Component: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search
Status: present in published dsh-tool-fs-search@0.2.0-rc.2 (verified by unpacking the tarball)
What happens
The tool treats every ripgrep exit code other than 0/1 as a fatal failure:
if (outcome.exitCode !== 0 && outcome.exitCode !== 1) throw classifyRunFailure(toolName, outcome.exitCode, stderr.text, stderr.lossy);
ripgrep exits 2 for non-fatal problems (unreadable file or directory, permission denied) while still printing every match it found. The agent therefore loses a successful search and receives a tool error instead.
Minimal reproduction
T=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$T/sub"
printf 'needle\n' > "$T/a.txt"
printf 'needle\n' > "$T/sub/b.txt"
chmod 000 "$T/sub/b.txt"
rg --line-number needle "$T" > out.txt 2> err.txt; echo "exit=$?"
# exit=2, out.txt contains the match in a.txt, err.txt reports "Permission denied"
The search did find needle; DSH reports a failed tool call.
Expected
Partial results returned, with the unreadable paths surfaced as a warning rather than a hard failure.
Suggested change
const hasPartialMatches = outcome.exitCode === 2 && stdout.text.length > 0;
if (outcome.exitCode !== 0 && outcome.exitCode !== 1 && !hasPartialMatches) throw classifyRunFailure(...);
We currently carry this as a local patch; it can be dropped once handled upstream.

threads.title: [Bug] subagent outcome drops turn-end error detail, so 429/quota failures arrive opaque
[Bug] Desktop app loses ClearType subpixel antialiasing on Windows at 150% scaling
threads.bodyText:
DSH字体渲染问题反馈.md
DSH 桌面版在 Windows 150% 缩放下文字疑似丢失次像素抗锯齿（ClearType）

反馈人：用户（Windows 11 / 中文环境）
应用：DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2（dshBuildCommit = 04f392c9ddd144fa426da2045178797da6db6c11）
运行时：Electron 44.0.0 / Chromium 152.0.7977.54
日期：2026-10-01


0. 摘要
现象：Windows 150% 缩放（2560×1440 屏）下，DSH 桌面版界面文字整体比同机其它软件明显发虚，浅色小字（工具行/思考行/时间戳/状态行）最明显。
实测：对文字边缘做次像素色散检测（有 ClearType 则出现红/蓝彩边）：



对象
带色散边缘占比




同屏任务栏（GDI 对照）
31.5%

即：DSH 渲染进程使用灰度抗锯齿，而同一台机器上的 Chromium 使用 ClearType。
已确认渲染配置本身正确：devicePixelRatio=1.5、innerWidth=1280、innerWidth×dpr = 1920 恰等于窗口客户区物理宽度（无 DWM 放大）、visualViewport.scale=1、zoom=1、font-weight=400、系统字体栈、无页面缩放。以 --enable-lcd-text / --disable-prefer-compositing-to-lcd-text / --disable-direct-composition 启动均无变化（已确认开关确实加载到渲染进程）。
建议优先排查：根图层的 lcd_text_disallowed_reason 追踪（该构建字符串表内自带此分类），以及把同一份前端用 dsh web 在 Edge 里打开、与桌面版窗口并排对比——若 Web 版正常，即可把范围收缩到桌面外壳的窗口创建路径（win32 分支未设置 backgroundColor，darwin 分支则显式设 #00000000）。

1. 现象
在 2560×1440、Windows 缩放 150% 的笔记本内置屏上：

整个界面的文字观感比同一台机器上的其它软件（Edge、系统界面）明显更"虚"；
其中次要/浅色小字（工具调用行、思考行、时间戳、底部状态行）最明显；
把鼠标移到这些文字上（它们会变亮）会立刻显得清楚，鼠标移开又恢复"虚"；
应用启动后即如此，重启、切前台、缩放窗口都不改变。

2. 实测数据
2.1 渲染参数（从页面内取证，注入 preload 读取后已移除）
devicePixelRatio = 1.5        innerWidth  = 1280     innerHeight = 822
outerWidth       = 1294       outerHeight = 829

body 计算样式：font-size 16px（UA 默认）  font-weight 400
font-family = -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", ...

窗口物理尺寸 1941×1243（GetWindowRect，per-monitor DPI aware 进程测量），客户区约 1920 宽。
innerWidth × devicePixelRatio = 1280 × 1.5 = 1920，与客户区物理宽度一致 ⇒ 布局与光栅缩放正确，没有 DWM 放大。
2.2 次像素抗锯齿（ClearType）检测
方法：以 1:1 抓屏，逐文字行统计"边缘像素"（亮度落在该行动态范围 35%~75% 之间）中带颜色色散的比例（通道极差 > 该行背景色散 + 10）。有次像素抗锯齿的文字边缘会呈明显的红/蓝彩边，灰度抗锯齿则为中性灰。

结论：在同一台机器、同一块屏、同一缩放比例下，Edge 的 Chromium 使用 ClearType，而 DSH 渲染进程使用灰度抗锯齿。
2.3 边缘锐度（辅助指标，证据强度较弱）

3. 已排除项（均经实测，非推断）

0 条

改变窗口尺寸强制重建表面后重测
无变化（54→52→50）



4. 建议排查方向
由于布局与 DPR 均正确，且所有 Blink 级开关无效，差异很可能产生在 Blink 之下、由合成器逐图层判定（LCDTextDisallowedReason）。该 Chromium 版本自带相关追踪分类，可直接取证：
（该构建的字符串表内可见以下追踪分类）
lcd_text_disallowed_reason
lcd_text_disallowed_by_filter
lcd_text_disallowed_by_backdrop_filter
visible_pixels_by_lcd_text_disallowed_reason

建议：

抓 lcd_text_disallowed_reason 追踪（--enable-logging + tracing，抓 cc / blink 分类），即可直接看到根图层命中了 13 条原因中的哪一条。
对比 dsh web 与桌面版：把同一份前端在 Edge 里通过 dsh web 打开（同机同缩放），与桌面版窗口并排对比。若 Web 版正常、桌面版异常，即可把范围收缩到桌面外壳（lib/main.js 的窗口创建 / titleBarStyle: "hidden" + titleBarOverlay 路径）。
关注 Windows 分支的窗口背景：createWindow() 在 win32 分支未设置 backgroundColor，而 darwin 分支显式设为 #00000000（用于 vibrancy）。在 Windows 上若窗口使用带 alpha 的 DirectComposition 表面，合成器可能判定根图层 contents_opaque = false。（注：本机实测显式补 backgroundColor 未见效，但该差异仍值得核对。）
核对 Windows 的 base background color / swap chain 格式 是否与 Web 版一致。

5. 附带的两个次要问题（建议顺手修）


-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased 写在 body 上且未做平台限定
位置：dsh-web-frontend/dist/assets/index-*.css
body{...;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;...}
该属性只在 macOS 生效（MDN 明确说明），在 Windows 上是无效代码。同文件里其它 macOS 专用规则都写成 html[data-platform=darwin] ...，唯独这一条漏了限定，容易误导后续排查。


次要文字层级的可读性
主题把次要文字定在 --dsw-alias-label-secondary/tertiary（暗色下为 neutral-bluish-300/400），配合 --dsh-content-font-size-secondary（默认 13px）。在 150% 缩放的深色背景下，这一层的观感明显偏虚。建议评估在 Windows 高分屏下适当提高其次要文字的对比度或字号。


6. 复现测量脚本思路（供核对）

以 per-monitor DPI aware 方式（SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(-4)）全屏抓图，保证得到 2560×1440 原生像素；
用 WindowFromPoint + GetAncestor(GA_ROOT) 校验采样像素确实属于目标窗口（避免采到被遮挡的其它窗口）；
逐文字行：取该行亮度动态范围的 35%~75% 作为"边缘像素"；以最暗 8 个亮度级像素的通道极差均值作为"背景色散"；边缘像素中通道极差 > 背景色散 + 10 的比例即为"带色散边缘占比"；
对照：同屏任务栏（GDI/ClearType）与一个本地 Chromium 页面（Edge）。

threads.title: 【BUG】开启Auto Review之后重启deepseek harness客户端，权限会自动变为完全访问，且无任何提示。
Third-party plugin exception in a session observer takes down the whole host
threads.bodyText:
A third-party plugin's session observer threw, and the whole host exited instead of that plugin degrading.
A plugin (@goodreaddy/dsh-time-machine@0.1.24) raised inside its ctx.on('session/event', …) handler. The host aborted on the first turn:
dsh: fatal load failure: DOMException [DataCloneError]: () => current could not be cloned.
    at structuredClone (node:internal/per_context/domexception:76:18)
    at getConfig (<profile>/node_modules/@goodreaddy/dsh-time-machine/lib/index.js:69:42)
    at autoSnap  (<profile>/node_modules/@goodreaddy/dsh-time-machine/lib/index.js:88:10)
    at Object.<anonymous> (<profile>/node_modules/@goodreaddy/dsh-time-machine/lib/index.js:110:11)
    at Object.apply (<app>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:921:20)
    at invokeContainedSessionObservers (<app>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/lib/index.js:1230:20)
    at Session.append (<app>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/lib/index.js:1473:50)
    at ReactLoopAgent.turn (<app>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:943:17)
    at ReactLoopAgent.kick (<app>/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:889:22)

Environment. DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (Electron 44.0.0, node 24.18.1, darwin arm64, profile desktop). Third-party bundles loaded from the profile's own node_modules.
The plugin's own bug is already handled upstream. GooDAnDReaDY/dsh-time-machine#6 root-caused it — on DSH 0.1.7+/0.2.0 the loader hands schema-declared volatile fields to apply() as { get() } accessor objects, which structuredClone cannot clone — and it is fixed in 0.1.25. I am not re-reporting that bug.
The platform concern is the blast radius. One third-party plugin raising inside a session observer takes down the entire host. The shell's only recovery is "disable third-party plugins, back up the profile patch, and restart", and that path resets dsh.profile.bundles to the stock web bundle list — so the desktop-specific bundles are dropped along with the offending plugin:
@deepseek-ai/dsh-base
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile   ← dropped
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review          ← dropped
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle      ← dropped
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle   ← dropped

The user loses more than the plugin that failed and has to rebuild the list by hand. (Observed live: the bundle list went from 8 entries to 2.)
There is also no way out from the command line: dsh plugin --profile desktop … is refused with profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application, so a user whose host is bricked by a single plugin cannot remove just that one bundle from the shell.
Suggestion. Contain exceptions raised by session-event observers per plugin — skip or disable the throwing plugin and surface a non-fatal reload diagnostic — instead of exiting the host, consistent with how a failed bundle load is already reported as a non-fatal reload error. If a hard abort is intentional for load-time failures, consider distinguishing an observer throw during Session.append from an actual load failure.
Side note (not a DSH bug, but it affects reproduction): a fresh pnpm add @goodreaddy/dsh-time-machine still resolves to the broken 0.1.24, because pnpm's minimumReleaseAge (24 h) skips 0.1.25 until it has aged. So a plugin that has already been fixed stays unreachable for a day, and the failure above is easy to hit right now. Pinning the version is the only workaround on the user side.

threads.title: Auto review 预设与 Codex 推理模型不兼容（temperature 透传被拒）+ GPT-6 声明窗口远低于订阅上限
threads.bodyText:
现象：将 Codex 订阅推理模型（如 gpt-6.1-sol）设为主控并开启 Auto review（EXP 权限预设）后，每次工具调用前审核报 auto-review: reviewer ended with error PI_AI_ERROR: Codex error: Unsupported parameter: temperature；长会话在约 272K 处被 pi-ai detected context overflow / CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED 预检拒绝。
根因（两个独立问题）：
dsh-experimental-auto-review 的 classifyRisk 硬编码 temperature: 0 且强制复用当前会话主控模型（snapshot.provider/model），而 pi-ai 的 OpenAI Responses 通道对 temperature 无条件透传；Codex 推理模型不收该参数，审核器必炸——Auto review 与 Codex 推理模型主控不兼容。
模型目录给 gpt-6.1-sol 声明 contextWindow: 272000（Codex CLI 目录缓存值），但 Codex 订阅通道的服务端校验上限是 872K（裸 API 达 1.1M），声明值低估了 3 倍多，导致长会话在真实能力远未触顶时被预检误拒。
建议修复：① classifyRisk 不要在推理模型上带 temperature（或在 compat 上加 supportsTemperature 判定，参照 anthropic-messages 协议 gate 的既有做法）；② 将 Codex GPT-6 系列的声明 contextWindow 从 272K 对齐到订阅侧服务端校验上限 872K。临时规避：用标准权限预设（非 Auto review）+ 手动把 profile 里 GPT-6 条目的 contextWindow 改成 872000。

threads.title: 子 agent 脱离管理面并持续循环：单 turn 433 步、49 分钟无法中止（0.2.0-rc.1）
threads.bodyText:
子 agent 脱离管理面并持续循环：单 turn 433 步、49 分钟无法中止
环境

DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 · Windows
触发方式：主会话用 subagent 工具一次派出 8 个并行子 agent，其中一个跑偏
该子 agent 的 preset 是 ptc（run_code 工具面），模型走一个第三方 OpenAI 兼容通道

现象
8 个子 agent 里 7 个在 3–8 分钟内完成并写盘；第 8 个（会话 2f64f25d-83be-4933-80e5-3c89fa9350a0）没有落盘、没有回摘要、也没有任何失败通知。
它从 23:10:36 一直跑到 23:59:14（49 分钟），最后是用户在 GUI 里手动停掉的。
实测数据



项
值




会话文件
1,627,349 字节（同批其他子 agent 50–360 KB）


停止后 20 秒采样
delta = 0 字节，mtime 停在 23:59:14


会话内容
1802 个 zstd 帧 / 3578 行 / 解压后约 4.09 MB


步数
单 turn 433 步


工具调用
432 次，全部是 run_code


结束方式
最后一行 turn/end，reason = {"kind":"aborted","reason":{"kind":"user"}}



它不是卡死，是跑偏
解压后会看到它一步只做一件小事：

第 5 步：glob 某个技能目录
第 430 步：read 了一份不在任务清单里的 SKILL.md（offset 45 limit 10）
第 431/432 步：grep 两个与任务无关的关键词，看有没有别的技能引用它们

也就是：把一个「读 4 个文件、写 1 份总结」的任务，做成了整个目录的交叉调研，而且每步只推进一点点，所以 433 步还没到头。没有任何报错、没有循环检测、也不会自己收尾。
关键问题：它不可寻址、也不可中止
它还在跑的时候，父 agent 侧的三个面全都查不到它：



手段
结果




list_agents
只返回 lead 自己（没有 role=subagent 的条目）


job_list
空（subagent 不作为 job 管理）


send_message / interrupt_agent
均返回 active teammate "2f64f25d-…" not found



唯一能判断它还活着的办法，是轮询它的会话文件（~/.dsh/sessions/<项目夹>/<会话id>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd 的 mtime 与体积）。
结果是：父 agent 只能看着它烧 token，没有任何中止通道；最终由人在 GUI 里点停。
复现与观测方法（供维护者定位）

一次派 8 个并行 subagent，用「目标文件清单」逐个核对落盘情况，就比较容易撞到一个不落盘也不报错的。
会话文件是多帧 zstd 拼接：用 node 的流式 createZstdDecompress 解到第二帧会报 Unknown frame descriptor；按 magic 28 B5 2F FD 切帧、逐帧 zlib.zstdDecompressSync 可以全解（本文数据即由此得到）。
停止之后，父 agent 依然查不到该会话（not found）——状态面与真实状态不一致。

代价

49 分钟墙钟 · 432 次工具调用 · 1.6 MB 会话；该子 agent 的任务零产出（后来拆成两个更小的片重派才补上）。
真正的风险不是这一次的浪费，而是：如果没人盯着文件体积，这种循环可以一直跑下去。

期望（按优先级，供权衡）

可列举、可中止：运行中的 subagent 至少要在某个面上可见（哪怕 list_agents 里多一类 role=subagent），并有一个停止入口。
默认预算：给 subagent 一个步数或墙钟上限，超限强制收尾并要求它先把已有结果写盘 —— 现在的循环没有任何刹车。
结束后一致：被停掉的会话，其状态应当同步到父 agent 可见的那一面（现在 stop 之后仍是 not found）。

分层说明

实测事实：上面所有数字与 API 返回，均来自本机会话文件与该机 DSH / OpenViking 的只读查询。
代码层推断：无。本文不判断是哪一层造成的，也不指认具体提交。

threads.title: Draft attachments are dropped when switching sessions — intended?
Bug: every command under `workspace-write` dies with `0xC0000142` (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) on Windows desktop
threads.bodyText:
Component: @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl (via @deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox / dsh-bash-sandbox through dsh-sandbox-local)
Platform: Windows desktop app, win32 x64
Product version: 44.0.0
Severity: high — the sandboxed modes are unusable; users must fall back to danger-full-access, which bypasses the file sandbox entirely
Related: discussion #8130


1. Summary
Under the workspace-write file policy, every command-tool call (pwsh, bash, and any native target) fails with:
(no output)
[exit code: 3221225794]

3221225794 = 0xC0000142 = STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED.
The same command in the same session under danger-full-access works immediately. read-only also works. So the failure is confined to the workspace-write confinement path and is independent of the command being run.

2. Root cause
AclSandbox.init() names a capability SID (the per-workspace / per-session write SID) as the trustee of the restricted token's default DACL.
read-only never does this — it falls through to worldSid (Everyone). workspace-write is the only mode that takes the capability-SID branch.
// packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/... (deployed: lib/types-<hash>.js)
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, lowLabelSid);   // sets Low IL
this.token = restrictedToken;
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid);
//                                             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
//                                             failing trustee under workspace-write
The confined child is then created with a console subsystem. Something on the console / loader-initialization path cannot use an object whose default DACL names a capability SID that no other process holds, so the child dies during DLL initialization with 0xC0000142 before any user code runs — which is why there is no output at all and no runner diagnostic.
This is consistent with the limitation already documented in sandbox-windows-acl/README.md:

Console isolation is unavailable — children created with CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE die during DLL initialization with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142); children share the host console, and pipe-based stdio redirection is unaffected.

and with S-1-2-1 (console logon) being deliberately absent from the restricting list.
Subsystem dependence (key evidence)



Probe executable subsystem
read-only
workspace-write




ConsoleApplication
works
0xC0000142


WindowsApplication
works
works



The failing path is console-specific, not process-creation-specific.

3. Reproduction
Via the product (end user):

Start the Windows desktop app with the default permission (workspace-write).
Run any command through the shell tool, e.g. echo hello.
Observe (no output) + exit code 3221225794.

Minimal, isolated reproduction (no DSH UI needed):
Load the deployed AclSandbox and spawn a console target under a seam-managed workspace-write token:
import { AclSandbox, workspaceWriteSid, tempWriteSid } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl';

const WS = 'I:\\DS工作区';
const tmp = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'dsh-'));

const sb = new AclSandbox({
  writableDirs: [WS],
  tempDir: tmp,
  mode: 'workspace-write',
  writeSid: workspaceWriteSid(WS),
  tempWriteSid: tempWriteSid(tmp),
  manageDacls: false,        // caller owns the ACEs, exactly like the seam
});
await sb.init();
const ch = sb.spawn({ command: 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe', args: ['/c', 'exit 7'], stdio: 'pipe' });
console.log((await ch.wait()).exitCode);   // 3221225794  (expected 7)
The identical snippet with mode: 'read-only' returns 7.

4. Control experiments (single-variable)
Bisection performed by loading the delegated chunks through an ESM load hook and changing exactly one thing per run. Argv built the same way as windowsAclRunnerArgv:
--workspace <ws> --temp %TEMP% --mode workspace-write -- cmd /c echo A.



Variant (all workspace-write)
Result




unpatched
no output, -1073741502 (0xC0000142)


ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE removed from the runner env
still -1073741502


runner's TMP/TEMP rewrite to the private temp dir disabled
still -1073741502


capability SIDs removed from the restricting list
still -1073741502


default-DACL trustee forced to worldSid
works — prints A, exit 0



Additional independent checks on the same machine:

Electron-as-Node (DeepSeek Harness.exe + ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1) started as an ordinary child is viable (-e, --version, plain scripts all return 0). So the problem is not "Electron cannot start" — it is loader initialization under the restricted token.
CREATE_NO_WINDOW (Node's windowsHide: true) is not the cause: toggling it changes nothing (both variants 0xC0000142).
AclWriteGrant.add() (the ACL mutation itself) completes fine even under the Electron Node runtime — so the failure is specifically in restricted-token process creation, not in the ACL machinery.
The ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE environment variable does leak into the confined child (the subprocess env scrubber forwards it: it is neither credential-shaped nor DSH_-prefixed). This looks causal but is not: removing it does not change the outcome, and read-only works with the same leak in place.


5. Suggested fix
One line, which makes workspace-write behave exactly like the already-working read-only path at this site:
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, worldSid);
The capability SIDs remain where they carry confinement authority:

the restricting SID list still names workspace + temp capability SIDs;
the standing workspace grant and revocable temp grant are untouched;
the Low integrity label and the grantWrite mandatory labels are untouched;
the TMP/TEMP rewrite to the private temp directory is untouched.

Only the default DACL of objects created by the confined child changes — which is precisely what read-only has always done.
A more conservative variant, if the capability trustee was intentional for some scenario, is to keep the capability trustee only for non-console targets and use worldSid for console-subsystem targets.
Optional hardening for the leaked selector
The subprocess env scrubber could additionally treat ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE as internal plumbing (like the DSH_* prefix), so no confined child inherits it. This is not required for this bug but closes a surprising leak.

6. Verification that confinement is preserved
After applying the one-line change, measured inside a confined workspace-write child:



Check
Result




Confined child exit code
0 (was 0xC0000142)


Write inside the workspace
WROTE


Write outside the workspace
DENIED (still confined)


Confined token integrity level
Low Mandatory Level (S-1-16-4096)



cmd, powershell and pwsh all start again under workspace-write, and whoami /all still reports the Low mandatory level.

7. Impact

Affected: Windows desktop, workspace-write (and any confined mode deriving from it).
Consequence: command tools are completely unusable in the confined mode, and do not self-heal within a session. Users are pushed to danger-full-access, i.e. the file sandbox is bypassed — a security-relevant outcome, not merely an inconvenience.
Trigger breadth: any desktop install that starts the runtime in Node mode (the default shape) satisfies the precondition.


8. Second, likely separate issue (not fixed by the above)
Inside a confined workspace-write shell, schannel/.NET HTTPS clients cannot complete a TLS handshake:

curl https://example.com → curl: (35) schannel: AcquireCredentialsHandle failed: SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030e)
Invoke-WebRequest https://api.github.com/ → "the connection was closed while receiving"

Both work in an unconfined shell on the same host with the same local proxy. This is not fixed by the default-DACL change and is probably a separate consequence of the restricted token (CNG / \Device\CNG is mentioned in the package README as a write trustee that pwsh needs).

9. Environment where reproduced



Item
Value




OS
Windows 11, build 26100


Product
DeepSeek Harness desktop 44.0.0


Install layout
…\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar (payload under app.asar/dsh/node_modules)


Runtime
DeepSeek Harness.exe (Electron 44 / Node 24) started with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1


UAC
EnableLUA=0; host runs at High integrity as a full administrator token


Workspace
I:\DS工作区 (NTFS, non-ASCII path; also reproduced on C:)


Deployed chunks
dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-Cl_DXjhk.js, dsh-win32-process/lib/index.js, dsh-subprocess-local/lib/runner-launch-B2zsQ1Dz.js



Note on build layout: in 44.0.0 the sandbox payload lives at app.asar/dsh/node_modules/…, and the sandbox chunk file name is types-Cl_DXjhk.js. Any third-party patcher must therefore be content-addressed, not keyed on a fixed chunk file name — several community plugins hard-code other names (e.g. types-CNjZgO4h.js) and silently skip on this build. Likewise, this build already ships dwFlags: 257 + wShowWindow: 0 at both encodeStartupInfo call sites, so the "console window flash" patch is not needed on 44.0.0 (dwFlags: 256 does not occur at all).

10. Minimal-diff patch used to confirm the fix locally
Length-neutral, so archive offsets and every other entry's integrity.hash are unaffected; only the patched entry's own integrity.hash record is re-synced.
- setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid);
+ setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, worldSid/*........................................*/);
Both sides are 52 bytes, so nothing downstream moves. After the patch the archive still parses (12 967 entries) and 0 entries mismatch their recorded hashes.

11. Credit
The root cause and the one-line fix were identified by a commenter on discussion #8130. This report consolidates that analysis with independent on-machine verification (controls, confinement re-verification, and the build-layout findings in §9).

threads.title: [Bug] 桌面端侧栏：冷会话（未打开过）的标题一律显示"未命名"，投影缓存里的 title 行不被采用（0.2.0-rc.2）
threads.bodyText:
环境

DSH：0.2.0-rc.2（profile: desktop）
系统：Microsoft Windows 11 专业版 / PowerShell 5.1.26100.9444

现象
桌面端右侧会话列表里，所有"当前进程内没有被打开过"的会话都显示为"未命名"；只有下列会话有标题：

当前活动会话；
本进程内被手动打开一次的会话（打开一次即永久恢复标题）；
本进程内发生过新事件的会话。

重启桌面端后现象复现，且与磁盘上的投影缓存内容无关。
实测计数：侧栏共 57 行，其中 42 行为"未命名"；13 行有标题，且这 13 行恰好都是"本进程内打开过/有活动"的会话。
本机实测证据

~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json 里，某历史会话（侧栏显示"未命名"）的检查点为完整 27 行记录，其中：

rows.title = { ver: 1, seq: <lastSeq>, val: "【探针】缓存读取测试" }
identity.formatVersion / createdAt / cwd / isSeeded 与该会话 header 逐字段一致；
该文件在桌面端运行期间被宿主自己重写为 333,673 字节（说明宿主读取并接受了这份记录）。


该会话在侧栏（可访问性树全量读取，57 行）中搜不到"探针"字样，仍然显示"未命名"。
域层未产生 <key>.json.bak.<stamp> 备份（invalidRecords: 'backup-and-skip' 未触发）→ 记录没有被判为非法。

代码线索（0.2.0-rc.2）

@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller：冷会话走 projectionsFor(header, undefined) → sessionProjectionCache.cachedSnapshot(header) ?? cachedPredecessorTitle(header)；listFields(header) 不含 title，故标题只能来自该 projections 块；viewRecord() 的 asOfSeq 取所有被服务行的最小 seq。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection-cache：cachedSnapshot 只做生命周期身份匹配（formatVersion/createdAt/cwd/isSeeded）与 viewRecord，按代码应当返回 title 行。
因此怀疑 listing 路径对"冷会话"的投影读取/合并有问题：标题列在冷会话上恒为空，客户端 displayTitle() 因 node.title 缺失而回退到 session.untitled（"未命名"）。

影响

历史会话在重启后全部变成"未命名"，用户无法按标题辨认；必须逐条打开一次才能恢复。
即使磁盘缓存完全正确、宿主也读入了记录，界面依然不显示。

期望行为
未打开过的历史会话也应显示其持久化检查点中的标题（cachedSnapshot 的语义），或者宿主在找不到可用标题时主动冷读并写回（当前 coldSnapshot() 在包内没有任何调用点）。
复现步骤

桌面端启动后，从侧栏打开任意一条历史会话（此时它的标题会恢复正常），然后重启桌面端（不打开任何历史会话）。
观察：该历史会话又变回"未命名"。
用任意方式手工把 ~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<该会话 id>.json 写成合法检查点（27 行结构、rows.title.val 设为可辨认字符串、identity 与该会话 header 一致），重启桌面端。
观察：侧栏仍显示"未命名"；而该文件会被宿主重写为完整检查点（证明宿主已读取并接受该记录）。


本条目由用户本机 DSH 助手整理生成；环境信息取自本机实际安装的包与运行时；提交前已做本机隐私脱敏。
