threads.title: [Bug] 第三方 Electron 宿主（Electron-as-node）下 dsh 全量启动失败：require-builtin 指纹门补丁精确 + app-boot 无 --expose-internals 回退
threads.bodyText:
现象
在把 Electron 二进制当 node 用的宿主环境里（实测：Kimi 桌面 Electron 43.7.3 / Node 24.21.0 / V8 15.0.245.31-electron.0），dsh 0.1.7-rc.2 与 0.2.1-alpha.1 的任何 profile 启动即 fatal，与 profile 内容无关（健康内置 profile 同样失败）：
dsh: fatal uncaught exception: Error: dsh: host preparation failed:
node-addon-require-builtin unsupported: Unsupported/no-context
(unsupported Electron runtime fingerprint: Node 24.21.0, V8 15.0.245.31-electron.0
(supported Electron versions: 43.0.0, 44.0.0, 45.0.0-alpha.6))

根因链（均已本机实测）
1. 指纹门的位置与引入版本。 node-addon-require-builtin 的预编译二进制（darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node）内含 Electron 运行时指纹校验，在 requireBuiltin() 调用时触发（getBindingInfo() 不触发）。strings 取证：0.1.5 二进制无任何指纹逻辑，0.1.6（2026-09-14）起存在，0.1.7 同。
2. 白名单是补丁级精确，报错文案却写大版本。 二进制内白名单为三个精确 V8 指纹（15.0.245.13 / 15.2.124.13 / 15.4.80 的 -electron.0 变体）。双向实测闭环：

Electron 43.0.0（V8 恰为 15.0.245.13-electron.0）→ requireBuiltin('fs') 通过；
Electron 43.7.3（V8 15.0.245.31-electron.0，同 43 大版本）→ 拒绝。

报错文案 (supported Electron versions: 43.0.0, 44.0.0, 45.0.0-alpha.6) 与行为不一致。
3. --expose-internals 救不了。 dsh 内部有两条获取 Node 内部模块的路径：

cordis-plugin-loader 的 requireInternal() 认 --expose-internals（有 flag 走官方 require——实测在该 Electron 下 require('internal/modules/cjs/loader') 成功）；
但 @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot 的 internalModules()（lib/index.js 与 lib/worker/profile-resolution-bootstrap.js 内各 5 处直调 requireBuiltin）不查 flag、无 try/catch，启动路径绕过全部回退。实测加 flag 仍 fatal。

门的动机（理解其合理性）
0.1.5 及之前在 Electron patched Node 下是缺符号崩溃——实测 0.1.5 在上述 Kimi Electron 下报 Unsupported/no-realm (no compatible GetAlignedPointerFromEmbedderData symbol found)。门把静默崩溃变成响亮报错，方向是对的；问题在「补丁精确 + 文案误导 + CLI 无回退」的组合。
影响面
任何把自家 Electron 二进制暴露为 node 的 agent 宿主（Kimi 桌面已实锤；机制上门只读 process.versions，与具体宿主无关），其派生会话内 dsh 全命令启动即败。普通 Node 运行时不受影响（Node v25.4.0 实测正常；二进制内有 untagged Node 20/22/24 family 放行条目）。
补充：同一变量、两个方向 —— "Electron-as-node" 边界双向破损
本 Issue 是内向方向：第三方 Electron 宿主 → dsh 作为子进程继承宿主运行时指纹 → 指纹门 fatal。
经 PerryLink 提示（见本串讨论）存在镜像的外向方向并已由其核实：DSH 桌面端 spawn 外部应用时将 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 透传给 VS Code/Cursor 等，使其以纯 Node 模式启动失败。我对该方向的源码机制做了复核（master @ 5badb150）：packages/host/open-in-app/src/resolver.ts:80 以 scrubbedParentEnv() 为子进程基础环境，而该 scrub（packages/subprocess/subprocess/src/index.ts:47,66-80）只剔除 credential 形态（KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN）与 DSH_* 变量，不剔除 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE；resolver.ts:584 的显式 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1' 是 argv 拉起 CLI 助手的有意用法，与透传无关。
两个方向共享同一变量、同一条边界，建议一并纳入优先级评估。
最小复现
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 <任一非白名单 Electron 二进制> <dsh 的 bin.js> --profile headless "say hi"
# => dsh: fatal uncaught exception: ... unsupported Electron runtime fingerprint ...
修复建议（按推荐序）

app-boot 的 internalModules() 复用/对齐 cordis-plugin-loader 的 requireInternal()（--expose-internals 时走官方 require）——改动局部、不碰安全模型，直接救活第三方 Electron 宿主；
报错文案诚实化（写明补丁精确指纹），或真按大版本放行（需安全评估）；
增加 opt-in 环境变量逃生门（默认 fail-closed 不变）。

环境

dsh：0.1.7-rc.2、0.2.1-alpha.1（npx 发布包）均复现
宿主运行时：Kimi 桌面 Electron 43.7.3（Node 24.21.0，V8 15.0.245.31-electron.0）；对照 Electron 43.0.0 通过
macOS arm64

threads.title: Auto review spends unbounded uncached tokens per tool call, and its spend is unattributable in cost-meter (0.2.0-rc.2)
threads.bodyText:
Environment: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 (Windows, Electron desktop profile); provider xiaomi / model mimo-v2.6-pro (contextWindow 1,048,576); third-party MiMo pay-as-you-go account. Packages: @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review@0.2.0-rc.2 (packages/experimental/auto-review), dsh-cost-meter@1.8.5.
Summary
With the Auto permission preset active, the built-in auto-review layer issues one additional, uncached, full-context model request per supported tool call. In a session that entered a tool-call repetition loop, 102 review requests in 57 minutes consumed 25,052,220 uncached input tokens and cost the user ≈¥78.49 (¥0.77 per tool call) — an order of magnitude more than the entire session's own bill for that day (¥7.42, 97.88% cache hit). Because reviewer usage carries no sessionId, cost-meter cannot attribute it: the entire amount appears only as 「未关联对话的费用」 ("unattributed conversation cost"), so the user has no way to discover what spent the money. 57 of those reviewer requests returned protocol-invalid output and were still billed while denying the tool call, which made the model retry — paying again for each retry.
Impact
Silent, uncapped spend on a third-party pay-as-you-go account. The user's MiMo balance went to ¥0 in one hour; 5 API keys were exhausted one after another and all parked until the next UTC quota reset.
Cost is not visible or attributable. No UI element shows auto-review spend; cost-meter's per-conversation ranking cannot include it, and the user only discovered the loss by comparing the model total against the conversation list.
Charged-but-failed calls. Reviewer output that violates the risk/decision protocol is billed, then the tool call is denied with an error, causing additional agent turns and additional (also uncached, also billed) reviews.
Compounded by the missing hard stop on repeated tool calls. The repeat-tool reminder fired 52 times in this session without breaking the loop.
Steps to reproduce (observed)
Use a session with a large context and a paid, cache-priced provider (here xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro, prompt ≈75K tokens median / 180K max).
Switch the session to the Auto permission preset (permission/preset {"preset":"auto"}, at 2026-10-06 18:21:31 in session session-8d0fcf74-…).
Let the agent loop on a read-only tool. Here: 103 tool calls in 57 minutes = 1 compress + 102 grep.
Observe the provider bill: mimo-v2.6-pro day total 1,321 calls, of which the session's own ledger row accounts for 1,219; 102 calls (25,052,220 uncached input + 455,168 cacheRead + 2,402 output tokens) exist in the day total but in no session row, and appear in the UI only as 「未关联对话的费用 ¥78.4904」.
Evidence


Arithmetic closes exactly
Scope	Calls	Cost
Day 2026-10-06, xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-pro	1,321	$11.9315 (≈¥85.9067)
Session 8d0fcf74 row in the same ledger day	1,219	$1.0300 (≈¥7.4163)
Difference (reviewer requests)	102	$10.9014 (≈¥78.4904)
Token deltas match too: 26,271,660 − 1,219,440 = 25,052,220 uncached input; 111,928,704 − 111,473,536 = 455,168 cacheRead; 115,369 − 112,967 = 2,402 output → 245,610 uncached input and 23.5 output tokens per review request, i.e. a full-context prompt with a tiny decision payload — the signature of a per-call reviewer.


The 102 count matches the tool calls made in the window
Session session-8d0fcf74-…, 18:21:27–19:18:59 local: 103 tool/call events, tool-name histogram {"compress":1,"grep":102}.


Documented behavior (shipped package)
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review/README.md:


L46: "Auto reviews every supported call once before its body".
L87: "The reviewer uses the latest request/header.config provider and model" → reuses the agent's expensive model instead of a cheap one.
L91 (Token effect, verbatim): "One additional model request per supported call, without caching, retries, truncation, compaction, or a separate small output budget. An oversized request fails the call with the provider error."
L60: the review input is "a frozen RequestUserInput without durable identity or source" → no sessionId, hence unattributable.
4. Charged-but-failed reviews
18:00–19:19 local: 57 tool results with
Error: Auto review of tool "grep" failed; its body was not executed: auto-review: reviewer output does not match the risk/decision protocol …
Each of these still cost a full review request while denying the tool call.


In-session loop that generated the volume
Same session: 5,440 tool calls, only 342 distinct fingerprints (15.9× redundancy), grep = 5,150. Longest strictly identical run: 702 × grep("function saveState", store.js), 12:10:01→14:36:15. Longest near-identical run: 793 calls / 158 min with zero writes. Turn 16 (11:28–14:38) alone: 1,078 calls / 105.90M prompt tokens. Of 79 user/message events, only 18 were genuine human input; 33 + 19 were repeat-tool reminders ("You are repeating the exact same tool call with identical arguments…", "Repeated tool call detected: - tool: grep - consecutive_calls: 5|8 … Do not call this tool with these exact arguments again.") — they did not stop the loop.


Attribution path in cost-meter
dsh-cost-meter/lib/billing-statistics.js:68: unassignedCost: Math.max(0, valueOf(totals, query.basis) - valueOf(assigned, query.basis))
dsh-cost-meter/lib/index.js:3102 (comment): 无 sessionId 的后台调用只进入日/月总计
dsh-cost-meter/lib/ledger-persistence.js:88: session row is created only when sessionId is non-empty
A reviewer request therefore cannot be attributed by design, and the UI surfaces it as 「未关联对话的费用」 with no hint that an experimental feature produced it.


Expected behavior
Review spend should be bounded and predictable, and must respect the user's cost constraints.
Review spend should be attributable (at minimum to the originating session/turn, preferably as a separate "auto-review" line).
A review request that fails its own output protocol should not cost the user a second full-price retry loop.
Enabling Auto mode on a large-context, pay-as-you-go provider should warn about the per-call cost multiplier (and ideally show a running meter).
Suggested fixes
Make reviews cacheable. Construct the reviewer prompt as a stable prefix (system + conversation prefix + the tool call last) so the provider's prefix cache applies, or reuse the main request's cached prefix. without caching is the single largest multiplier here.
Cap the reviewer. Per-turn/per-session review budget, max prompt tokens, and a hard limit of one review per distinct (tool, fingerprint) within a turn; fail closed with a clear error rather than silently reviewing again.
Use a cheap reviewer model by default. Add explicit config (reviewModel/reviewProvider) that defaults to the cheapest available route instead of request/header.config.
Attribute the usage. Tag reviewer usage with the originating sessionId + source: "auto-review" and let cost-meter group it; surface it in the conversation cost ranking as its own row.
Do not charge-and-fail. On protocol-invalid reviewer output, either deny with a documented policy (and no extra review) or downgrade to a fixed heuristic — do not create a paid retry loop.
Enforce repetition limits in Auto mode. The repeat-tool reminder should become a hard stop (or force the reviewer to see the repetition) when a session shows N consecutive identical tool calls.
UI transparency. Show an "auto-review spend" counter in the permission selector and in the cost dock.
References
Content	Location
cost-meter ledger (day / session / model totals)	.dsh/storages/cost-meter/ledger.json
Full session transcript (permission switch + 102 greps + 57 reviewer errors)	.dsh/sessions/…/session-8d0fcf74-f67f-4ea9-977e-ea070993920e/session.v4.jsonl.zstd
Key-pool state showing 5 keys exhausted in the same window	.dsh/profiles/desktop/dsh-key-rotation-state.json
Shipped reviewer README (quotes above)	app.asar → node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review/README.md
Ask
Please confirm (a) whether reviewer spend is intended to be uncached and uncapped, (b) whether unattributed reviewer usage can be attributed in the ledger/UI, and (c) whether DSH offers any remediation for third-party provider credit consumed by this behavior. I have already disabled @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review in my profile and switched the session off the Auto preset.

threads.title: Assistant text is folded away when the final Step also calls a tool: nothing stays outside whole-Turn folding (0.2.0-rc.2)
threads.bodyText:
Version: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (npm latest, published 2026-09-29) · Web client (dsh web, default profile) · macOS
Symptom
In a completed Turn whose last Step simultaneously contains visible reply text and a tool-call block, whole-Turn folding hides everything — including that reply text — and only the took Ns duration/status header remains. The final answer is visible to nobody: not the user, and not even a "collapsed into the fold" marker of its own.
Reproducible with the default work-details mode (detailed) whenever the Turn is otherwise fold-eligible (no interleaved user/steering input after the first process evidence).
Root cause
latestAnswer() in packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/conversation-nodes/turn-process.ts treats a final Step that carries any tool-call block as "no answer":
function latestAnswer(turn: TurnLocation): Readonly<FinalAssistantChatData> | null {
  const latestStep = turn.steps.at(-1)
  const data = latestStep?.data.get('assistant-step')
  if (!isFinalAssistant(data) || !hasAssistantReplyContent(data.blocks)) return null
  return data.blocks.some(block => block.kind === 'tool-call') ? null : data
}
Then processSpec() sets answerStep: null / answerAnchorSeq: null, so no node in the Turn is exempt from whole-Turn folding. The Step's text is rendered inside the process window and receives the data-turn-process-hidden treatment when the Turn folds.
In practice this fires whenever the last model step both speaks and acts — e.g. an agent that writes its reply and then performs a bookkeeping tool call (memory/session log) in the same Step. In a 3-Step Turn where Step 3 is the final text, a Step 2 that contains a 1200-character answer + one tool call gets hidden wholesale while only the short Step 3 text stays visible.
Documentation contradiction
packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/conversation-nodes/README.md:94:

The final answer is the latest Step's settled Assistant reply, provided it has visible reply content and no tool-call block. Its response remains outside whole-Turn folding.

So the restrictive definition is intended — but the README also states the promise (README.md:13, :85): work-details modes control process visibility "without hiding final answers". When the Step is disqualified as an answer, nothing is protected, and the user-facing reply disappears with the process. From the reader's perspective the outcome is "the answer was hidden", which is exactly what the docs promise cannot happen.
Suggested fix directions

When latestAnswer() returns null because the final Step has a tool-call, keep that Step's visible text outside the fold (it is the last thing the model said), or
Let the whole-Turn fold leave any Step containing visible reply text rendered in place, or
Add a "never hide visible reply content" guard to the fold, and/or an explicit user setting that is independent of the four work-details modes.

Workarounds (no source change)

Show all process rows for every Turn: Settings → General → work-details mode → Verbose (ui-chat.transcriptView: verbose, foldCompletedTurns: false). Trade-off: applies to every Turn, is global rather than per-Turn, and has no collapse action.
Inside the folded region, hidden="until-found" is used together with a beforematch reveal handler, so the browser's in-page find (Ctrl/⌘+F) automatically expands the hidden content when a query matches it — a usable escape hatch while reading.

Happy to file a PR with a repro/unit test for latestAnswer if you would like the fix in-tree.

threads.title: [Bug] pi-ai 路由声明的 contextWindow 未进入 resolveModelInfo，导致自动压缩静默失效、超限被误报为「额度已用尽」（0.2.0-rc.2）
threads.bodyText:
[Bug] pi-ai 路由声明的 contextWindow 未进入 resolveModelInfo，导致自动压缩静默失效、超限被误报为「额度已用尽」（0.2.0-rc.2）
摘要
在 llm-pi-ai 的 provider models[] 中显式声明了 contextWindow 和 maxTokens，但 compaction-basic 的自动压缩对该路由完全失效：它在压力路径上调 ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo() 得到 info.context === undefined，随即抛 TargetPressureConfigError，压缩中止，请求原样发出，被网关以 HTTP 400 拒绝。
UI 最终显示 「当前请求的额度已用尽」，但网关的真实响应是 上下文超限 —— 文案与实际错误不一致，会把排查方向带偏。
关键矛盾：异常信息写着 "configure contextWindow on that adapter model"，但 pi-ai 路由的 contextWindow 已经配在 provider 的 models[] 里了，只是没有进入 llm 服务的 model-info 解析链。这条指引对 pi-ai 路由不成立。
复现步骤

DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2，profile desktop，挂载 dsh-llm-pi-ai
在 cordis.patch.yml 声明一个 OpenAI 兼容网关路由：

- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      my-gateway:
        api: openai-completions
        apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_KEY
        baseURL: https://example-gw/v1
        models:
          - id: some-large-model
            contextWindow: 1048576
            maxTokens: 65536
            input: [text]

让会话累积到超过 contextWindow × thresholdRatio（默认 thresholdRatio = .8、headroomTokens = 65536，见 resolveConfig()）
发送消息 → 预期自动压缩，实际未压缩

观测到的现象
UI 报错文案：
当前请求的额度已用尽

网关侧同一时刻的真实响应：
{"error":{"message":"estimated input tokens exceed the model's context limit",
          "type":"invalid_request_error","code":"invalid_request_error"}}
把该响应体喂给 @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm 的 isQuotaExceededError 五条正则实测：



判定器
结果




QUOTA（额度）正则 ×5
全部不命中


上下文超限正则
命中 3 条



即：网关的错误分类是正确的，是 UI 文案把它错误地呈现成了额度问题。
代码路径
@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic 0.2.0-rc.2，lib/index.js：
async compactIfNeeded(agent, trigger, signal) {
    const target = routedTarget(agent.session);
    const policy = resolveTargetPolicy(this.config, target);
    ...
    if (trigger === "context-overflow") {
        // 这条路径不需要 contextWindow，直接压缩
        ...
        return this.compactRegion(range.start, range.end, agent, signal);
    }
    const info = await this.ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(target.provider, target.model, signal);
    if (info.context === void 0)
        throw new TargetPressureConfigError(targetKey,
          `compaction-basic: no context capacity for ${targetKey}; configure contextWindow on that adapter model`);
形成死循环：压缩需要先知道窗口 → 但要触发溢出判定必须先发请求 → 而压缩在压力阶段就已经失败，context-overflow 分支永远进不去。
补充：手动 /compact（dsh-command-compact）不受影响，可正常完成 —— 后端本身可用，问题只在自动路径的容量解析。
环境信息

DSH 版本: 0.2.0-rc.2（DSH Desktop，Windows x64，Electron 44.0.0，Node 24.18.1）
内核包: @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai / @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic 均 0.2.0-rc.2
操作系统: Windows
网关: OpenAI 兼容，/v1/chat/completions
无第三方插件参与复现

一个重要的复现前提：该网关的 /v1/models 返回 OpenRouter 风格嵌套 schema：
"input_modalities": [{"type":"text",
  "supported_inputs":{"max_context_length":{"value":1048576,"unit":"token"}}}],
"output_modalities": [{"type":"text","max_length":{"value":1048576,"unit":"token"}}]
顶层没有 context_length / max_output_tokens。DSH 的模型发现解析扁平字段，因此必须手填 contextWindow —— 而手填的值又没进入 resolveModelInfo，正是本 issue 的触发条件。
冒烟测试

环境: DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 + 内核 dsh-llm-pi-ai / dsh-compaction-basic 0.2.0-rc.2
执行步骤与观察结果:

声明 pi-ai provider（api: openai-completions + 手填 contextWindow: 1048576 / maxTokens: 65536）
用同一网关直接发请求：

小输入 → HTTP 200
输入约 40 万 token → HTTP 200（网关不拦，只在超限时才报错）
输入约 105 万 token → HTTP 400 estimated input tokens exceed the model's context limit
输入约 198 万 token → 同样 HTTP 400


把 400 的响应体喂给 isQuotaExceededError 的五条正则 → 全部不命中；上下文超限正则命中 3 条
在 DSH 内让会话超过阈值 → UI 显示「额度已用尽」，压缩未发生
执行 /compact → 压缩正常完成（证明后端可用，问题在自动路径）


对照 / 历史版本差异: 未在其他 DSH 版本上对照（本地仅 0.2.0-rc.2）。步骤 1-3、5 为本次实际执行并记录的输出。

引用代码

@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js — compactIfNeeded() 中 resolveModelInfo 后的 info.context === void 0 抛错分支，以及 context-overflow 分支的早返回
@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js — resolveConfig()：DEFAULT_THRESHOLD_RATIO = .8、headroomTokens = config.headroomTokens ?? 65536、auto: config.auto ?? true
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm — isQuotaExceededError() 正则集合，以及 CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE 的判定路径

对应主仓库源码路径形如 packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts。
建议方向（供参考）
问题核心是 pi-ai 路由声明的 contextWindow 没有汇入 llm 的 model-info。可能的最小修复面：

让 dsh-llm-pi-ai 在注册路由时把 models[].contextWindow / maxTokens 一并注册进 model-info；
或让 compaction-basic 在 resolveModelInfo 返回 context === undefined 时回退到 pi-ai provider 的声明值；
顺带建议修正 UI 文案分流 —— 上下文超限不应落入 message.failure.quota。

影响面
该问题对所有使用 pi-ai 声明网关的用户静默生效：压缩不报错地失效，只在会话涨过阈值后才以「额度已用尽」的形式暴露，排查方向容易带偏。

threads.title: Automatic compaction falls into a permanent thrash loop when a route declares a large `maxTokens`; the threshold collapses silently and compaction stops being net-reductive.**
threads.bodyText:
Environment: DSH Desktop, client UA deepseek-harness/0.2.0-rc.2, @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic 0.1.7-rc.2. Local OpenAI-compatible model route: contextWindow: 262000.
Symptom. One agent session compacted itself 42 times in 6.63 h (median gap 7.4 min, P10 3.0 min), spending 153 min (38.5% of the window) just generating summaries. Each cycle freed 6.6 K tokens net and re-triggered within 1–3 steps. Every compaction looked like a hang, so the user aborted 11 of 32 turns.
Mechanism (dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js):
// L63-64
headroomTokens = config.headroomTokens ?? 65536;
maxTokens      = config.maxTokens      ?? headroomTokens;   // summary output cap
// L757
reserved       = session.requestHeader()?.config.maxTokens ?? adapterDefaultMaxTokens ?? 0;
// L128-133
threshold = floor(min(contextWindow * 0.8, contextWindow - reserved - headroomTokens));
retain    = floor((contextWindow - reserved) * 0.16);
With contextWindow = 262000:



route maxTokens
threshold
retain
observed




unset (0)
196,464
41,920
compaction fired at pressure ≈169 K–196 K; one healthy cycle removed 89,702 / wrote 3,614


128000
68,464
21,440
compaction fires at 65,990–73,761, every 1–3 steps



The route's declared output cap is subtracted from the same budget the compaction threshold is drawn from, so maxTokens = 49% of the window drags the threshold down to 26% of the window. Post-compaction floor is then retain 21,440 + system/tool envelope 23,551 + summary output — with measured summary output averaging 12,639, only ≈10.8 K tokens of working band remain, i.e. one step of tool results re-crosses the threshold.
Four defects, in order of importance:

Silent pathological band. The only guards are reserved ≥ contextWindow (L129) and reserved + headroom ≥ contextWindow (L131), both of which throw with actionable text. reserved + headroom = 193,536 < 262,000 passes, and the configuration lands in the band where compaction cannot help. Nothing is logged; the agent just thrashes forever.
No progress guarantee on the pressure path. retainTokens is validated only against thresholdTokens (L134). There is no check that threshold − retain can actually absorb (system + tool envelope + summary output), and no "compaction made no progress → stop" bail-out. Compare the overflow path, which does have maxOverflowRetries. Measured: at 17:20:46 the summary wrote 15,473 tokens while removing 13,642 — compaction increased context by 1,831 tokens, and the loop continued.
headroomTokens is an absolute 65,536 and doubles as the summarizer's output cap. On any window ≤ 200 K it unilaterally claims ≥ 25–33% of capacity, and it is the very quantity that pushes threshold down. A capacity-relative default (e.g. min(65536, 0.1 * contextWindow)) would not create the trap.
Summary ratchet. Each summary re-summarizes the previous summary with no size feedback. In one session the output grew monotonically 3,614 → 20,037 tokens (5.5×) over 6 h, so cost per cycle rises without bound while usefulness falls.

Reproducer (deterministic, no local GPU required). Register an adapter model with contextWindow: 262000 and defaultMaxTokens: 128000; compose compaction-basic with defaults; drive a session from ~55 K to ~70 K estimated tokens with ordinary tool results. Expected (and observed): compaction/start at essentially every step boundary, retainTokens = 21440, thresholdTokens = 68464, and summary.outputTokens ≥ shadowedTokenCount within ~10 cycles. With maxTokens unset or ≤ 16,384 the same session compacts ~once per 130 turns and never re-fires.
Suggested fix.
(a) At spec-resolution time, verify thresholdTokens − retainTokens > envelopeTokens + expectedSummaryTokens (use policy.maxTokens as the worst case) and, if it fails, throw/warn with the same actionable wording as L131 ("reduce the effective request maxTokens or compaction headroomTokens, or configure a larger contextWindow").
(b) Track net reduction per session and stop auto-compacting when consecutive attempts do not reduce pressure (mirroring maxOverflowRetries).
(c) Cap summary output by the available band rather than by headroomTokens.

threads.title: cancel() 把 turn/end 写成 reason:null（违反 TurnEndReasonMap 协议）—— 客户端事件订阅者永久死亡，对话区全空白
threads.bodyText:
问题：程序化 cancel() 把 turn/end 持久化为 reason: null（违反协议），导致客户端事件订阅者永久死亡、对话区全空白
环境

DSH 版本：0.2.0-rc.2（Windows x64 桌面版）；0.2.1-alpha.1（dsh web）同样复现
操作系统：Windows 11 x64
触发方式：客户端插件在回合运行中调用程序化 session.cancel(reason, { keepInbox })

摘要
通过程序化 cancel() API 停止一个运行中的回合时，落盘的 turn/end 事件的 data.reason 被写成 null。这违反了文档中 TurnEndReasonMap 的协议约定（取消中断应产生 { kind: "aborted", reason: <AgentCancelCause> }）。随后 Web/桌面客户端的事件流订阅者（event feed subscriber）读到该事件即抛异常，整个事件流的订阅者全局死亡——所有会话的对话视图全部空白，直到重启应用或刷新页面。轨迹（Trajectory）视图不受影响，因为它不读取 reason 字段，所以表现为「轨迹正常、对话空白」，非常具有迷惑性。
复现步骤

启动一个正在执行工具调用的回合
由插件调用 controlTarget.cancel("some-reason", { keepInbox: true })，随后 steer(...)（重规划模式）
检查会话日志（~/.dsh/sessions/<工作区>/session-*/session.v4.jsonl.zstd）

真实会话中实际落盘的事件（seq 1030）：
{"type": "turn/end", "seq": 1030, "time": 1791299223721, "data": {"turn": 3, "reason": null}}
客户端表现
打开该会话后，浏览器控制台：
[session-controller] event feed subscriber failed:
  TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'kind')
    at Object.start (…/plugins/??@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-open-in-app/client.js,…)
Error: Minified React error #130
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.composer.dock'


对话视图：完全空白（无消息、无输入框）
之后切换到任何其他会话也都是空白（订阅者已全局死亡），直到重启
轨迹视图仍能正常渲染（不读取 reason）

期望行为
按 docs/subsystems/session 与 python/sdk/README.md 的约定：

turn/end 必须携带字符串类型的 data.reason.kind —— 官方 Python SDK 对缺失 kind 的事件直接抛 SdkProtocolError: "turn/end event requires a string data.reason.kind"
取消请求导致的中断应持久化为 { "kind": "aborted", "reason": <AgentCancelCause> }

实际行为
reason 被持久化为 null。Python SDK 会按协议违规拒收这份日志；JS 客户端则直接在它上面崩溃。
修复建议
在 turn-end 序列化路径上，把程序化 cancel 的原因映射为结构化的 TurnEndReason（例如 { kind: "aborted", reason: <cause> }；拿不到 cause 时回退 { kind: "interrupted" }）。另外建议加固客户端组装器：遇到畸形的 turn/end 事件时跳过或降级处理，而不是让整个事件流订阅者崩溃。
临时规避方案
对会话日志做「帧感知」的定点修复（把 reason: null 改写为 {"kind": "completed"} / {"kind": "interrupted"}，保持 zstd 帧结构与 seq 连续性不变），即可恢复受影响的会话。

补充说明：触发源是一个桌宠插件的重规划控制（cancel + steer）。插件侧调用的是公开 API，用法本身符合文档；缺陷在 DSH 写入侧的序列化。

threads.title: subagent-model-selection-settings: allowedModels 改动对运行中的 Session 不生效，报错也无补救提示 / changes do not apply to a running Session, error gives no remedy
threads.bodyText:
现象
subagent-model-selection-settings 里 allowedModels 的改动对正在运行的 Session 不生效，而且报错信息没有给出可操作的补救方式。
复现（本机 DSH Desktop，profile desktop）：

    enabled: true

      - provider: openai-codex

  - provider: openai-codex
    model: gpt-6.1-sol
  - provider: openai-codex
    model: gpt-6-astra

调用 subagent，provider: openai-codex、model: gpt-6-astra：

Error: child LLM route "openai-codex/gpt-6-astra" is not allowed for this Session

改回、再改、反复调用都一样。该模型本身在 provider 目录里是存在的（llm-openai-codex 的 models 列表含 gpt-6-astra），所以不是模型 id 写错。
期望
三选一即可：

A：改动即时生效（每次调用重新读一次设置），或
B：报错里明确说明「本 Session 的白名单在会话组装时已采样，需新建会话才能生效」，或
C：提供查看当前 Session 生效白名单的手段（例如让 list_subagent_models 反映 Session 级的 effective 白名单）

现状是：设置静默不生效，报错只说 "not allowed for this Session"，用户无法区分「模型 id 写错了」「provider 不允许」「需要开新会话」。
影响

用户改了配置却看不到任何提示，只能靠猜；排查成本高。
会话白名单对用户不可见，list_subagent_models 返回的是 provider 目录而不是 Session 生效集合，两者不一致会误导。
无法在不重开会话的前提下放行新模型。

环境

DSH Desktop（macOS 26.6），profile desktop
设置项 id：subagent-model-selection-settings
相关包：@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent

说明
我理解这可能是有意设计——@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent 的 README 提到策略在会话组装时采样、"unchanged by later settings edits"。这个取舍本身可以理解（避免在途会话权限漂移），但当前的失败模式（静默无效 + 无补救提示）建议至少按上面 B 改一下报错文案。

English
Symptom
Changes to allowedModels in subagent-model-selection-settings have no effect on a running Session, and the error offers no remedy.
Reproduction (local DSH Desktop, profile desktop):

Session starts with allowedModels: [openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol].
While that session is running, the profile config is edited to add openai-codex/gpt-6-astra.
Calling subagent with provider: openai-codex, model: gpt-6-astra fails:

Error: child LLM route "openai-codex/gpt-6-astra" is not allowed for this Session

Re-editing and retrying makes no difference. The model itself is present in the provider catalog (llm-openai-codex.models includes gpt-6-astra), so this is not a typo in the model id.
Expected
Any one of:

A — the change applies immediately (settings re-read per call), or
B — the error states that the Session allowlist was sampled at session assembly and a new session is required, or
C — a way to inspect the Session's effective allowlist (e.g. list_subagent_models reflecting the session-level effective set)

Today the setting silently does not apply, and the message does not distinguish "wrong model id" from "provider not allowed" from "new session required".
Impact

A config edit produces no feedback; users can only guess.
The session allowlist is invisible, and list_subagent_models reports the provider catalog rather than the effective session set, so the two disagree.
No way to allow a new model without restarting the session.

Environment

DSH Desktop on macOS 26.6, profile desktop
Settings id: subagent-model-selection-settings
Package: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent

Note
This may well be intentional: the @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent README says the policy is sampled at session assembly and is "unchanged by later settings edits". That trade-off is understandable (it avoids mid-session permission drift). The request is mainly about the failure mode: at minimum, option B in the error text.

threads.title: [Bug] 出站消息含孤立代理(lone surrogate)时 400 无定位信息，且污染历史后会话永久失败不可恢复
[Bug] Optional experimental bundles cannot keep their enabled state across restarts — the launch projection prunes them from `dsh.profile.bundles` (Voice input switch resets)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
An optional bundle shipped with the desktop app — Voice input (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle) — can be enabled from the Plugins page and works immediately, but every launch silently rewrites the profile manifest and drops the bundle from dsh.profile.bundles. The next time the Plugins page opens, the switch is off again and the feature is gone. Nothing is logged. This is not a UI-state glitch: the manifest itself is rewritten at boot, and the switch state is derived from it.
Every installation-supplied optional bundle is affected — the four experimental bundles (dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle, dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile, dsh-experimental-auto-review, dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle) are all in the pruned class.
Why this must be fixed

The Plugins page presents these bundles as ordinary toggleable plugins. An enable action that cannot survive a restart breaks the contract the switch implies.
The failure is silent: no warning, no log line, no error. The only symptom is a switch that is off again after a restart, so users re-enable it every session and cannot tell why.
The same prune resets the switch for every other optional bundle, so no experimental bundle can be kept on.

Facts
The launch projection rebuilds the bundle list roughly as follows (desktop package, generation-package backend projection routine; identifiers as shipped):
// Bundle entries that survive: in-box bundles, plus any kept dependency that
// declares its own `dsh.bundle` (dshmarket). ...
const declaredBundles = bundles.filter((name) => IN_BOX_BUNDLES.has(name));
for (const name of Object.keys(dependencies)) {
  if (declaredBundles.includes(name) || enabled.has(name)) continue;
  if (await declaresBundle(join(dir, 'node_modules', name))) declaredBundles.push(name);
}
const pluginNames = [...enabled.keys()].sort();
bundles = [...declaredBundles, ...pluginNames];
with IN_BOX_BUNDLES = new Set(['@deepseek-ai/dsh-base', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app']). An optional bundle shipped inside the app's own node_modules belongs to none of the three kept groups (not in-box, not a profile dependency, not a generation plugin), so the projection drops it from dsh.profile.bundles on every launch that syncs the manifest. The Plugins page derives the switch from that list, hence the reset.
Two adjacent persistence weak points make the setting impossible to pin from the UI (plugin-manager service):

selectBundle returns early without writing anything when the name is already in the list — re-enabling stores no defense against the prune.
recordBundleSwitch silently returns when the package backend is unavailable, so the switch is not recorded anywhere else either.

Reproduction (Windows desktop build, product 0.11.0 / harness 0.2.0-rc.2)

Enable Voice input in the Plugins page. The entry @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle appears in dsh.profile.bundles; voice input works (local SenseVoice models download and transcribe).
Restart the desktop app.
Compare the profile manifest across the restart: exactly the voice-input entry is removed from dsh.profile.bundles; the other 15 entries are untouched. The Plugins page shows the Voice input switch off.

Observed across three restarts: one restart kept the entry while the log reported profile package maintenance deferred while plugin removal is pending verification; the next restart pruned it. The prune is therefore easy to miss once and hit on the next restart.
Impact

Enabled state of any installation-supplied optional experimental bundle never survives a restart.
Silent failure: the manifest rewrite is the only trace; logs say nothing.
Together with the two weak points above, users cannot make the setting stick from the UI at all.

Suggested fix direction

Treat installation-supplied optional bundles like in-box bundles in the projection keep rule — e.g. extend IN_BOX_BUNDLES with the OPTIONAL_BUNDLES list, or keep any entry that is neither generation-managed nor dependency-managed unless the user removed it.
Make recordBundleSwitch's recorded state authoritative for launch reconciliation for these bundles as well; its own contract says "which launch reconciliation cannot revert", and optional bundles are exactly the case where it currently can.

Acceptance

Enable Voice input (or any optional bundle), restart: switch stays on and dsh.profile.bundles still lists the bundle.
Disable it, restart: stays off.
No behavior change for dependency-managed and generation-managed bundles.

Related discussions (distinct root causes)

#7141 — plugin-manager dead switch for bundle-declaring packages
#2854 — third-party bundle plugins silently disabled after boot (HMR recompose persists disposed insert objects)
#7805 — the Schedule bundle ships its rows disabled
#8536 — desktop microphone permission policy (the microphone half of voice input)


中文摘要：随安装提供的可选实验组合包（语音输入等）在插件页开启后立即可用，但每次启动时投影会重写 profile manifest，把该组合包从 dsh.profile.bundles 剔除：开关静默复位、功能消失、无任何日志。投影的保留规则只认内置组合包、声明 dsh.bundle 的依赖、代际插件三类，可选实验组合包三类都不是。受控复现：重启前后 manifest 对比，仅语音输入一条被精确移除，其余 15 条不动；三次重启中一次因"包维护推迟"而幸免，下一次即被剔除。影响全部 OPTIONAL_BUNDLES。建议：投影保留规则覆盖随安装提供的可选组合包；recordBundleSwitch 记录的开关状态应对这类组合包同样跨重启生效。

threads.title: 桌面版「查询用量」只显示 DSH 客户端 key 的用量，与网页版「全部」差 46 倍
threads.bodyText:
桌面版「设置 → 账号 → 查询用量」与网页版用量不一致（差 46 倍）

作者：Mark（GitHub shujie2015-a11y）｜日期：2026-10-08
环境：DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2（bundle id com.deepseek.dsh）/ macOS

English summary: In the desktop app, Settings → Account → 查询用量 embeds platform.deepseek.com/usage in a native view. That embedded page reports the usage of one API key only (DeepSeek Harness, key_type: "DSH"), while the same page in a normal browser reports the whole account ("API Key = 全部"). Same minute, same account, 46× difference in cost (¥4.92 vs ¥226.96). The embedded view exposes no API Key filter, so the user cannot switch scopes. Requested: show account-level totals in the embedded view, or expose the filter.

1. 现象
同一时刻（2026-10-08，窗口「近 30 天」＝ 2026-09-09 ~ 10-09）、同一账号：

2. 定因证据：嵌入视图显示的正是 DSH 那把 key 的用量
用页面自己发起的请求 /api/v0/usage/by_api_key/{cost,amount} 拉全量、按 key 拆分（同一窗口）：

嵌入视图那三个数字（¥4.92 / 600 / 86,284,336）与 DeepSeek Harness(key_type=DSH) 逐位相同 ⇒ 嵌入视图在按这把 key 取数。
3. 已排除的可能

不是账号不同：两边余额/累计消费一致（§1）。
不是 URL 参数可控：https://platform.deepseek.com/usage?api_key=<DSH tracking_id> 打开后页面仍显示「API Key = 全部」、总额不变 ⇒ 无法用 URL 指定 key 来变通。
不是本地筛选状态：桌面版加载的就是官方页面、只注入客户端身份头与 cookie，见 §4；清本地存储无法改变口径。
不是延迟：页面提示延迟 ≤5 分钟，两处读数在同一分钟内取。

4. 相关实现位置（供维护者定位）

apps/desktop/src/platform-view.ts：new URL(page === 'usage' ? '/usage' : '/top_up', account.origin) → loadURL（仅在存在 account.embeddedPageDist 时附加 dist 参数，不带任何 key 参数）；请求经 onBeforeSendHeaders 注入 platformClientHeaders(...) 与 cookie；视图 preload 通过 bootstrap 拿到 { origin, token, locale }。
嵌入视图是英文 UI：桌面版会把自身 locale 推给页面（IPC dsh-platform:locale-changed）；网页版为中文 UI 且有 API Key 下拉，嵌入版看不到该控件 ⇒ 用户无法自行切到「全部」。

5. 期望行为（任选其一）

嵌入用量页显示账号级总量（与网页版「全部」一致）；或
露出 API Key 筛选控件（当前英文嵌入版没有该控件）；或
至少在页面上标明"此处仅显示本客户端所关联 key 的用量"，避免与网页版对不上。

6. 影响
用户（以及第三方记账工具）会以为账单出错：本例中本机记账口径为 ¥205.43（近 30 天），与官方 deepseek key 的 ¥222.04 只差 −7.5%，但被嵌入页的 ¥4.92 一比，看起来像差了 46 倍，直接引发"用量信息不对"的误判与排障。
7. 附件（截图）

① 桌面版设置里打开的用量页 —— Cost ¥4.92 / API requests 600 / Tokens 86,284,336
② 同一时刻网页版（API Key = 全部） —— ¥226.96 / 26,935 / 3,957,645,577


图放在本人 fork 的独立分支 evidence/usage-scope（未改动上游仓库）。因本机网络直连 raw.githubusercontent.com 超时，此处用 blob 链接而非内嵌图片。

声明（本稿的事实边界）

已实测：§1、§2 全部数字来自 2026-10-08 页面自身接口响应（/api/v0/usage/by_api_key/cost、/api/v0/usage/by_api_key/amount、/api/v0/users/get_user_summary）与两次页面读数；§3 的 URL 参数无效为实跑验证。
未读：未阅读平台侧前端代码，也未看到平台服务端实现。
推断：§2 的"按 DSH 这把 key 取数"是由三个数字逐位相同推出的强证据推断；其机制（平台按客户端身份取数 vs 嵌入版页面默认筛选）未证实，故 §5 只提期望、不断言根因。

threads.title: 问一下官方：有没有打算支持「多个终端都能收到通知、并且直接回答」？
threads.bodyText:
现在 DSH 卡在等人处理的时候（要你批准某个操作、或者要你选一个东西），只有你正看着的那个界面能回答。人不在电脑前，它就在那儿干等。
我做了个插件，把这类「要你决定」的消息推到 Discord（手机上能收），并且在 Discord 里点一下就能答：

要你批准 → 「允许一次 / 拒绝」两个按钮
要你选一个 → 选项变成按钮（多了变下拉菜单），也可以点「自己写」弹输入框自己填
一次问你好几个问题 → 一题一题来，全答完再交回去
桌面那边照常能用，谁先答算谁的

东西都在这儿（MIT）：

插件：https://github.com/DWJZ/dsh-notify
我的 fork：https://github.com/DWJZ/deepseek-harness （两个改动：1aa8c6884a、7470ec25b6）

做的过程中踩到一个坑，顺便说一下：在 Discord 上答完之后，桌面那张卡片不会自己消失，得重新加载会话才干净。看代码的原因是——「已经有人答了」这件事没有通知还在等的其他界面，它们就一直等着。我在 fork 里补了两处：拿到答案之后把这次提问撤回，另一边收到就收掉卡片（本机验证是好的）。
我知道已经有不少人做过类似的东西（#6410、#3653、#7284、#3156 都是手机/远程这一类），#5324 和 #5178 也聊过「多个回答者共存、谁先答谁生效」。所以这次不重复造轮子，直接问官方三件事：

官方有没有计划自己做「多终端通知 + 多终端应答」？
如果没有，那「某个界面已经答了，请其他界面收掉」这个通知，愿不愿意在框架里给一个？（现在第三方只能自己绕）
我这两处改动有没有必要整理成 PR 提上来？方向不对也请直接说，我就不折腾了。

纯粹问计划，不是催活，谢谢 🙏

threads.bodyText:
环境

DSH：桌面版，bundles @deepseek-ai/dsh-base 0.2.0-rc.2 / @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app 0.2.0-rc.2

pwsh --version → 7.6.6（cmd 手动跑正常）

会话：文件策略 workspace-write，工作区 D:\Users\wujie\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace，审批 ask
MSI 安装时已勾 ADD_PATH，DSH 已完全退出重开

复现

权限切到 工作区内修改 (workspace-write)
DSH 里跑：
Write-Output "pwsh-workspace-write-retest"; $PSVersionTable.PSVersion
结果：(no output) [exit code: 3221225794]
3221225794 = 0xC0000135 STATUS_DLL_NOT_FOUND
切到 完全权限 (danger-full-access) 跑同样命令 → 成功：
pwsh-danger-retest，7 6 6，Path: ...\default-workspace
cmd 手动 pwsh --version → 一直 7.6.6

文件沙箱作用到了子进程镜像加载，不只是写。商店版（WindowsApps）双层沙盒更严重，但 MSI 版同样失败，说明缺的是通用 allowlist。

threads.title: edit 高频报 FS_STALE_VERSION：macOS 下版本判据含 ctime，纯元数据变化即失效（附可复现实验）
threads.bodyText:
Summary
在 macOS 上，edit / write 工具会高频报 FS_STALE_VERSION（cannot edit "...": file changed since it was read — re-read the file, then retry），必须重新 read 一次才能编辑成功。
用户侧观感是「几乎每次编辑都失败一次，重读就好了」。统计本机 119 个历史会话：edit/write 调用共 802 次，观察类失败 125 次（15.6%），22 个有编辑行为的会话中有 17 个出现过。
排查后确认是两条独立路径共用了同一个错误表象：

版本判据包含 ctime，而 macOS 会在写入后异步更新扩展属性（com.apple.macl 等），导致文件内容一字未改、ctime 却变了，版本比对失败。
bash 绕过 fs-observation-policy：agent 用 python3 / sed -i / cp / git checkout 直接改文件时，观察状态不更新。

Reproduction
复现 A：纯元数据变化导致版本失效（确定性）
versionOf 把 ctime 纳入版本令牌（@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local/lib/index.js:146-148）：
function versionOf(info) {
	return FsVersion(`${info.dev}:${info.ino}:${info.size}:${info.mtimeNs}:${info.ctimeNs}`);
}
而 editText 用的是严格全等比对（@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local/lib/index.js:889）：
if (expected && existing.version !== expected.version)
	throw new FsError(`cannot edit "${target.displayPath}": file changed since it was read`, "FS_STALE_VERSION");
只要 ctime 变了就必然失败，哪怕 ino / size / mtimeNs 全部不变。最小复现（macOS 27.0.1 实测输出）：
1) read 记录的 version : 16777232:95837611:40:1791452468393678804:1791452468397488610
2) 之后的 version      : 16777232:95837611:40:1791452468393678804:1791452468402251753
   dev 相同 = true | ino 相同 = true | size 相同 = true | mtime 相同 = true | ctime 相同 = false
   文件内容 = "export const a = 1;\nexport const b = 2;\n"
3) edit 判定          : FS_STALE_VERSION — file changed since it was read

各类「内容不变但触发报错」的操作实测：

复现 B：ctime 在写入后异步漂移（间歇性）
在真实项目目录（~/Documents 下，受 TCC 保护、带 com.apple.macl）反复执行与 writeFileAtomic 等价的原子写入，写入后立即取一次版本、隔 10–300ms 再取一次：

同一份代码在 /tmp（无 com.apple.macl）下跑 160 次，漂移 0 次。
复现 C：bash 绕过工具改写文件
在失败案例的前一次同文件操作中，有 19/66 例是 bash 直接改了文件：
python3 - <<'PY'          # s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace(...)
cat >> src/client/frame-meter.ts <<'TS'
cp -r /tmp/src-new/. src/
git checkout -- src
fs-observation-policy 只记录 DSH 自身 read/write/edit 的观察结果，感知不到 bash 的写入，记录的版本自然过期。
Current behavior

上述情况下 edit/write 直接抛 FS_STALE_VERSION，错误文案要求模型 re-read the file, then retry。
模型重读后同一编辑即可成功——与用户观察到的「重读一次就能编辑」一致。
另有 50 次 FS_NOT_OBSERVED（cannot modify "...": file has not been read — read the file, then retry），其中 45 例模型确实从未 read 过该文件，属于正常的策略拦截，不是本报告的问题；剩余 5 例发生在前一次 edit/write 成功之后。

失败案例按「前一次同文件 DSH 工具操作」归因（115 条失败链的首次失败）：

Expected behavior

文件内容确实未变（ino / size / mtimeNs 均相同，仅 ctime 变化）时，edit 不应报 FS_STALE_VERSION。
若确实是外部改动，仍应正常拦截。

修复建议（按性价比排序）


主修：versionOf 去掉 ctime，只保留 dev:ino:size:mtimeNs。
实测该判据对真实内容变化仍然可靠，包括最严苛的同长度替换（sed -i 's/1/2/'，size 不变）也全部能检测到：
=== 真实内容变化的各种方式 ===
  shell >> 追加        size变=是  mtime变=是  → 能检测
  node appendFile    size变=是  mtime变=是  → 能检测
  shell 覆写 >         size变=是  mtime变=是  → 能检测
  sed -i 替换          size变=是  mtime变=是  → 能检测
=== 同长度内容替换（size 不变，最严苛）===
  第1次 size变=否  mtime变=是  → 能检测
  第2次 size变=否  mtime变=是  → 能检测
  第3次 size变=否  mtime变=是  → 能检测

代价是丢失「内容不变但权限/xattr 变化」的检测，但对「文件是否被外部改动」这一目的，ino + size + mtimeNs 已足够。


更保守：保留 ctime，但在 editText 失败分支加降级——若 ino/size/mtimeNs 均未变、仅 ctime 变，则视为同一版本放行（或自动重新 stat 后静默重试一次），不把错误抛给模型。


缓解路径 C：bash 执行后若触及工作区文件，主动失效对应 target 的观察状态；或至少在 edit 失败时自动重试一次，而不是要求模型重读。


Environment

DSH Desktop：0.2.0-rc.2（dshBuildCommit: 5e9e301dd9dc8923b2762f76dacfc5751f6ca851，dshBuildDirty: false）
系统：macOS 27.0.1（Build 26A434），Apple Silicon
Node：v24.19.0

涉及包：@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local、@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-observation-policy、@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs
出错文件均位于 macOS TCC 保护目录（带 com.apple.macl 扩展属性）；/tmp 下无法复现


排查依据：本机 119 个会话日志（~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v4.jsonl.zstd）中的 tool/result.error.code 字段，以及上述可复现实验。

threads.title: Web GUI: inline image in a message doesn't reserve height — following block overlaps it (0.2.0-rc.2)
threads.bodyText: Environment @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (npm published build) Web GUI served at http://127.0.0.1:3081, Chromium-based browser, viewport 1280×813, Linux Summary In the chat view, an assistant message that contains a markdown image followed by another content block (e.g. a rendered UI card) draws the following block on top of the image instead of below it. A hard refresh does not fix it, so it looks structural rather than a cache issue. Steps to reproduce Open a session whose latest assistant message contains an inline markdown image, immediately followed by a non-text block (a rendered UI card in my case). Observe the two blocks overlapping: the card (translucent background) is painted over the image, text lines interleave. DOM observations (measured on the live page) Some image wrappers with class pattern _imageButton_* measure 0×0 (both wrapper and report width:0; height:0), i.e. that image path reserves no layout space. Another image path renders inside a *_frame wrapper with a fixed width: 238px and overflow: hidden — so the renderer has two image paths with inconsistent layout behavior. The overlapping sibling after the image participates in normal flow; when the image wrapper contributes 0 height, it slides up over the image. Expected Every block reserves its own height and blocks stack vertically, regardless of image load state. Happy to test a patch if you point me to the component — I could not find the Web GUI source in the published package (only the compiled lib).

threads.title: Bug: single-dollar math parsing swallows dollar amounts in assistant prose ($3,641 … $200/mo becomes KaTeX garbage)
threads.bodyText:
Upstream bug report: single-dollar inline math swallows dollar amounts in prose
Package: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives (markdown renderer)
Severity: high for agent-output readability — money amounts and other $-bearing prose are silently destroyed
Environment observed: DSH Desktop 0.x (shipped app.asar, Sep 29 build), dark theme, macOS
Summary
parseGfmWithMath() registers the TeX math extension without options:
function parseGfmWithMath(text) {
	return recoverLocalImages(fromMarkdown(text, {
		extensions: [
			gfm(),
			cjkFriendlyStrong(),
			mathCompatibility(),
			math()          // <-- no options
		],
		mdastExtensions: [gfmFromMarkdown(), mathFromMarkdown()]
	}), text);
}
micromark-extension-math defaults singleDollarTextMath: true when unset
(confirmed in the shipped vendor bundle: let n={}.singleDollarTextMath; n==null&&(n=!0)).
So a pair of $ characters anywhere in a paragraph opens an inline-math node.
Repro
Assistant output containing dollar amounts:
Cost avoidance over 14 days: **$3,641** *in Sonnet — equivalent API terms*
(18,206 Opus-equivalent) — a $200/mo Max plan covers 0.8 days of that burn.
The $ in $3,641 and the $ in $200/mo are consumed as inline-math
delimiters. Everything between them — 3,641** *in Sonnet — equivalent API terms* (18,206 Opus-equivalent) — a — is handed to KaTeX and typeset as math:

all spaces collapse (math mode ignores them): "inSonnet—equivalentAPIterms"
the font switches to KaTeX's serif math fonts mid-sentence
the markdown emphasis markers ** / * render as literal centered asterisks
the throwOnError fallback never fires, because prose is valid TeX

Verified live: an assistant message rendered the sentence as
**3, 641** *inSonnet—equivalentAPIterms* inside a KaTeX span, with
$200/mo Max plan covers 0.8 days continuing as plain text after it.
Why the existing guard does not catch it
renderTexToReact renders with throwOnError: true and falls back to
throwOnError: false on failure. Dollar-amount prose parses as valid TeX, so
both paths "succeed" and the mangling is rendered without any error marker.
Suggested fixes (any one of these)


Disable single-dollar text math (recommended default for a chat/agent
renderer, matches Claude Desktop / ChatGPT behavior):
math({ singleDollarTextMath: false })
$$…$$ display math and \(…\) / \[…\] keep working via the existing
mathCompatibility() extension.


Gate dollar-math behind a user setting, defaulting off.


If single-dollar math must stay, require currency-hostile context before
opening a math span (e.g. the opening $ must not be followed by a digit,
or must be preceded by whitespace AND followed by a non-space non-digit) —
this is what other chat renderers do to avoid exactly this failure.


Local mitigation shipped meanwhile
A client plugin (@local/dsh-readability) detects rendered span.katex
elements whose annotation[encoding="application/x-tex"] source is prose
(contains **, or * without any \command, or ≥4 word-like tokens) and
swaps them back to plain text with the consumed $ delimiters restored. It
never touches TeX containing backslash commands.

threads.title: WSL: "Show file location" fails when the host PATH has no Windows directories (systemd-managed hosts)
threads.bodyText:
WSL: reveal/open in Explorer depends on PATH, and open-in-app's file-manager entry is not WSL-aware (0.2.0-rc.2)
Two findings on a WSL2 Web deployment whose host runs under systemd --user:


dsh-native-command's WSL opener is only half WSL-aware. Capability detection is
correct (canOpenNativePath() → true via isWsl(), nativeFileManager() → 'explorer'),
but the launch runs the shell by bare name (path-opener.ts:139 → run('explorer.exe', …),
runner.ts → plain execFile). A systemd unit gets an explicit PATH without /mnt/c/...,
and WSL's appendWindowsPath only reaches login sessions, so the call fails with
spawn explorer.exe ENOENT while the UI still offers "Show file location"
(toast = path.revealError). Appending /mnt/c/Windows to the unit PATH fixes it.
Suggest resolving the shell absolutely on WSL (%SystemRoot% + wslpath -u); note
C:\Windows\explorer.exe exists while C:\Windows\System32\explorer.exe does not (Win11 26200).


open-in-app's Linux file-manager entry has no WSL branch — catalog.ts:202:
{ id: 'filemanager', platforms: { linux: spec(desktopCli('xdg-open')) } }. The
requiresDesktop gate passes on WSL, then it resolves xdg-open, which is usually
absent and, when present, opens a Linux file manager instead of the Windows desktop
that nativeFileManager() reports for the same host. Suggest resolving filemanager
to a shell-open launch when isWsl().


Env: Windows 11 26200 + WSL 2.7.13.0 / Ubuntu 26.04, interop healthy
(/mnt/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe /c "echo OK" → 0.11s), DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, Web profile,
host = systemd --user service. Re-checked master (last push 2026-10-03): both unchanged.

threads.title: Web GUI: AppFrame is a scroll container — one programmatic scroll permanently shifts the whole shell
threads.bodyText:
Posting this here because CONTRIBUTING.md routes bug reports to Discussions. It is a reproducible shell-layout defect with a measured root cause and a suggested one-declaration fix; a maintainer verdict on whether the frame is the right place to fix it is what I need.
Summary
In the Web GUI the three-column shell frame (div.pI_x6G_frame, .frame in packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/AppFrame.module.css, line 6) declares overflow: hidden. That keeps the element a scroll container: a focus-driven scroll or any descendant's scrollIntoView() scrolls it, nothing ever resets it, and every column moves at once.
Observed in a live session: after pressing Page Down the whole shell stayed shifted 362 px to the left, leaving a 362 px dead band at the right edge. Setting frame.scrollLeft = 0 in DevTools restored the GUI instantly; nothing else recovered it, and it survived re-renders.
Reproduction
Observed trigger:

Web GUI, long-running session (~430 turns) with the conversation in the shared-scrollport mode; the transcript is very tall (scrollHeight ≈ 101 000 px) and the shell contains the trajectory panel.
Press Page Down with the conversation focused.
The shell is then left shifted left by exactly the frame's scroll offset and stays there; frame.scrollLeft reports 362.22222900390625.

We have not pinned the exact call, and the report should not pretend otherwise: nothing in the repository writes the frame's offset, so the shift comes from a browser-side scroll-into-view path (focus scrolling or Element.scrollIntoView), which scrolls every scrollable ancestor, including an overflow: hidden one. Page Down is the observed correlation, and it is a first-class key in the chat viewport (packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/use-chat-viewport.ts:42 and use-process-scroll.ts:7) as well as in the focus-navigation set (packages/client/ui-primitives/src/client/input-modality.ts:14), while the shell does contain callers of the ancestor-walking form — packages/client/ui-trajectory/src/client/TrajectoryTable.tsx:2458 (row.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' })) and packages/client/ui-plugin-manager/src/client/PluginManagerPage.tsx:1356. To confirm which one runs, break on Element.prototype.scrollIntoView and watch frame.scrollLeft while pressing Page Down.
Deterministic demonstration of the same defect, no keystroke required, given that the frame has scrollable overflow:
const f = document.querySelector('.pI_x6G_frame')
f.scrollLeft = 500   // the whole shell shifts 500 px left and stays there
f.scrollLeft = 0     // restores it
Equivalently, any scrollIntoView() on a descendant that lies outside the frame's box reproduces it. The captured state had 676 px of scrollable overflow, which is the precondition; with overflow: clip neither assignment can take effect.
Environment

DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, installed from npm, dsh web on http://127.0.0.1:3080
master at 5badb15009ae1756c3afe0ae0cef1faafc290ccc (2026-10-03) for the file references
Chrome 154.0.8037.93, Windows 10.0.19045, viewport 1356×875 CSS px, devicePixelRatio 2.25
Long-running session (~430 turns) with the conversation in the shared-scrollport mode ([data-conversation-scroll] on wSkVaW_scrollBody)

Measured state while broken
Console, in the affected page:
frame:       0..1356   w=1356
gridUsed:    280px 1076px 0px        # the tracks themselves are correct
sidebarCol: -362..-82  w=280
centerCol:   -82..994  w=1076
rightbarCol: 994..994  w=0
frame.scrollLeft  = 362.22222900390625   # 815 device px at dpr 2.25
frame.scrollWidth = 2032
frame.clientWidth = 1356                 # 676 px of horizontal scrollable overflow
centerCol.scrollLeft 0 / scrollWidth 1076 / clientWidth 1076   # the centre itself does not overflow
document.scrollingElement: scrollHeight == clientHeight == 875 # the document does not scroll

The arithmetic identifies the frame as the offset owner: 280 − 362 = −82, 280 + 1076 − 362 = 994, 1356 − 994 = 362. Every column is displaced by exactly the frame's scroll offset, and the remainder is the dead band. It is not a paint artefact: a dump of 25 leaf elements showed strictly increasing getBoundingClientRect().top values with ≤2 px spread inside a line, i.e. the box layout was intact and only the scroll offset was wrong.
Current behavior

The whole shell stays shifted left; the sidebar sits at -362..-82 and is partly off-screen, the centre column at -82..994, and 362 px at the right edge are dead.
The state is stable across re-renders and does not self-correct; only frame.scrollLeft = 0 or a reload clears it.
The frame meanwhile accepts a programmatic scroll at any time — document.querySelector('.pI_x6G_frame').scrollLeft = 500 moves the shell by 500 px in the same way.

Expected behavior
The shell frame is chrome, not a scrollport: nothing inside it may scroll it, and its scroll offset is always 0. A wide descendant must be clipped exactly as it is today without creating scrollable overflow in the frame.
Root cause

.frame { overflow: hidden } (line 6). hidden clips, but the element remains a scroll container, so scrollIntoView(), focus scrolling and .scrollLeft = n all move it. No code resets it.
The scrollable overflow exists because a shell-level wide element is never clipped: .overlayLayer { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 20; pointer-events: none } (line 281) declares no overflow, hence visible, and its descendants extend the frame's scrollable overflow (676 px in the session above). .rightbarCol { overflow: visible } (line 270) is the same kind of path, but it is deliberate and documented in the file (lines 260–266: the occupant anchors a fixed-width panel to the frame's edge and hangs it over the centre from a zero-width column) — it must stay open.
We did not isolate the wide element. What we could identify past the frame’s right edge were TextShimmer instances (packages/client/ui-primitives/src/TextShimmer.module.css; classes root/content/text/decoration/sweep/highlight, which is why those names appear in the shell bundle index-*.js — ui-primitives is a static client library merged into the Web shell build) rendering chat group titles through packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/ChatGroupSeat.tsx:123, with right edges 2 000–47 000 px past the frame. They live inside the trajectory ledger, which holds that overflow itself, and the centre column reports no overflow (0 / 1076 / 1076), so they illustrate the hazard rather than the source; the 676 px must come from a shell-level element, and .overlayLayer (unclipped) and .rightbarCol (deliberately unclipped) are the two paths.

Suggested fix
 .frame {
   …
-  overflow: hidden;
+  /* Not `hidden`: a scroll container still accepts programmatic scrolling from
+     focus or a descendant's scrollIntoView, which shifts every column at once. */
+  overflow: clip;
 }
overflow: clip is not a scroll container at all — scrollLeft stays 0 and scrollWidth == clientWidth — while clipping and layout are identical to hidden, so no other rule in the file changes. Two optional follow-ups: overflow: clip on .overlayLayer (its bounds equal the frame’s, so nothing visible changes, but descendants stop reaching the frame’s scrollable overflow), and a defensive scrollLeft/scrollTop reset in AppFrame’s existing layout effect (the one holding frameRef and the ResizeObserver), which also covers .sidebarCol/.centerCol while they stay hidden.
This is already the project’s practice for clip-only containers, so the fix introduces no new pattern: TextShimmer clips its moving mask with the comment “The moving mask must not enlarge any ancestor’s scrollable area” (packages/client/ui-primitives/src/TextShimmer.module.css:28), and the dock tab strip “clips its overflow on purpose (so it never becomes a scroll container that claims a drag)” (packages/client/ui-dockkit/src/components/TabMenu.tsx:11), a rule recorded in .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-09-04-right-sidebar-docking-infrastructure.md. The frame is the container that was missed.
Regression coverage: assert that the frame cannot be scrolled. Note that overflow: clip asserted through getComputedStyle may not survive jsdom, which can discard the clip keyword — a CSS-module source assertion, or the browser-level rung (DSH_SNAPSHOT=replay pnpm run test:web), is more reliable.
Verification

Before the fix: frame.scrollLeft = 362.22222900390625, GUI shifted; frame.scrollLeft = 0 restored it immediately.
Harness for the patched state (what we used on the shipped bundle, and what a reviewer can repeat): replace overflow:hidden with overflow:clip in the .pI_x6G_frame rule of @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/lib/client.js, reload, then check that getComputedStyle(frame).overflow reports clip, that frame.scrollWidth - frame.clientWidth is 0, and that frame.scrollLeft = 500 cannot take effect.

Screenshot of the broken state (attached below): the blue tint is DevTools' element highlight on div.pI_x6G_centerCol, not part of the GUI. The sidebar is off-screen, the highlighted centre column reports -82..994, and the 362 px band at the right edge is dead space. The Elements panel also shows the frame's inline grid-template-columns: 280px minmax(0px, 1fr) minmax(0px, 0px) — correct tracks with displaced columns, which is the visual counterpart of the measurements above and the reason the offset can only come from the frame's own scroll position.

在 Windows 11 build 28000 上，会话权限为 workspace-write 时，通过 shell 工具执行的每一条命令都会让子进程在早期 DLL 初始化阶段终止，退出码恒为 0xC0000142（STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）。它是确定性的：前台调用、后台任务、以及 cmd /c ver 探针全部同样失败。同一会话切到完全权限（danger-full-access）后，同一条命令立即成功。
该故障与目标程序无关：在解析器的 Windows PowerShell 5.1 回退路径下复现，装入机器范围的 PowerShell 7.6.6 之后依旧复现——非受限对照实测证明，受限运行失败时解析到的目标就是 7.6.6。

threads.title: Automatic compaction never triggers in image-heavy sessions — token-meter prices image blocks by JSON reference size, not visual tokens
threads.bodyText:
Summary
In image-heavy sessions (agent calls a read-image tool repeatedly), the automatic
compaction never triggers even though real prompt usage far exceeds the configured
threshold, and manual /compact fails to shrink context. The session gets "stuck"
at a high context percentage until a new session is started.
Environment

dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (desktop), compaction-basic (thresholdRatio 0.5) + compaction-tool-result-pruner

Evidence (from session log analysis)

Real prompt usage (from assistant/message usage records): grew monotonically
152k → 178k tokens against a 256k contextWindow (60-70% occupancy), with ZERO
automatic compactions triggering after image reading became frequent.
Earlier in the same session (text-only), compaction triggered correctly
(e.g. 61k/72k-token ranges shadowed, usage dropped 123k → 14k).
All compactions observed in the image-heavy phase were manual /compact runs,
and each only shadowed the 2-3k-token command message itself — the compaction
range selector never selected the actual conversation body.
78 read-image tool calls; per-call usage jumps of +8k to +37k input tokens
confirmed images are billed at visual-token cost in real requests.


Root cause (source-level)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter estimateStructuralBlock() prices an image
content block by the JSON length of its reference (BLOCK_OVERHEAD + JSON length / 4),
i.e. a few dozen tokens. The code comment itself notes "request price is
route-owned rather than fixed" — the routed request bills images at visual-token
rates (often 1k-2k+ tokens per image).
Consequences:

compaction-basic compactIfNeeded() compares meter.measure(session).totalTokens
against thresholdTokens — with images underpriced, the estimate stays well
below the threshold (estimated ~40k vs real 158k), so automatic compaction
never fires.
Manual /compact uses the same meter for range selection, so it also
under-selects what to compact.

Suggestion
Give image blocks a route-calibrated price floor (e.g. max(structural estimate,
known visual-token estimate per image dimensions), or feed back the provider's
reported inputTokens into the meter so threshold comparison uses measured usage
instead of the heuristic.
Environment

dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, Windows desktop client
compaction-basic: thresholdRatio 0.5

threads.title: 已认证的非回环 Web 客户端无法加载模型配置页
threads.bodyText:
问题描述
通过非回环域名或 IP 访问 Web 界面时，即使请求已通过 Host/Origin 检查和浏览器会话认证，模型配置页仍显示：

加载提供商目录失败: settings are unavailable in this browser
点击“重试”无法恢复。

原因
客户端根据页面 hostname 判断 isLoopback，并据此选择设置持久化模式：
const persistence = ctx.remote.$host.isLoopback ? 'host' : 'memory'
非回环页面选择 memory 后，设置镜像直接进入 unavailable 状态，不读取服务端设置；模型配置页依赖该镜像，因此进入错误状态。
代码依据（提交 5badb15009）：

设置模式选择
设置镜像跳过加载
模型配置页进入错误状态

复现步骤

为非回环访问地址配置 --trusted-host。
使用有效启动 token 建立浏览器会话，确认 API 请求不存在认证或信任检查错误。
在已挂载设置提供者的实例中打开模型配置页。
观察上述错误，点击重试后仍然失败。

期望行为
设置能力应由明确的服务端策略决定，而不是仅由页面是否回环决定。
若远程模型配置有意不受支持，应显示明确的限制说明，避免呈现为可重试的加载错误。

threads.title: [Bug][Windows Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2] Generic transport failure persists across reinstall/reset due to Node CA, stale state, and Electron UI cache
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On Windows Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2, DeepSeek Messages transport failed can become very hard to recover from in a normal proxy / TLS-inspection environment.
The same DeepSeek API key and deepseek-flash request work outside the desktop app, but the desktop UI may still keep failing until all of these are handled together:

stale per-session model selections under %USERPROFILE%\.dsh;
the Electron/Node host process not trusting the OS certificate store unless launched with NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca;
the already-running Electron single-instance process keeping the old environment;
Electron UI state under %APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop, which is not reset by reinstalling the app or moving %USERPROFILE%\.dsh.

This makes the visible error look like a generic model transport failure, while the real cause is hidden in the desktop host / runtime state.
Environment

OS: Windows 11 25H2 (CurrentBuild=26200)
DeepSeek Harness Desktop: 0.2.0-rc.2
Installed path: default per-user Windows install
Network environment:

local proxy env vars existed (HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / ALL_PROXY -> local proxy port)
NO_PROXY was configured for localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1, deepseek.com, .deepseek.com, api.deepseek.com
TLS inspection / proxy-style certificate chain was suspected from prior SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN reproduction



What I observed
The desktop UI repeatedly showed:
DeepSeek Messages transport failed

Reinstalling the desktop app did not fix it, because the failing state survived in user data.
After a clean %USERPROFILE%\.dsh reset, the app still did not fully recover until the desktop UI data directory was also reset.
Checks that passed
The key and provider were not the root issue:

GET https://api.deepseek.com/models with the configured key returned 200.
A minimal deepseek-flash chat completion with the same key returned 200.
Fresh sessions used:

{
  "provider": "deepseek-official",
  "model": "deepseek-flash",
  "reasoningEffort": "high"
}

Local desktop host was listening on 127.0.0.1:19387.
Searching the fresh %USERPROFILE%\.dsh showed no stale deepseek-v4-pro / deepseek-v4-flash strings.

Recovery steps that were required
The desktop app only became recoverable after doing all of the following:

Back up and move %USERPROFILE%\.dsh.
Let the app generate a fresh %USERPROFILE%\.dsh.
Restore / configure the API key.
Add a desktop profile patch for the default model:

- id: agent-default-model
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model"
  config:
    provider: deepseek-official
    model: deepseek-flash
    reasoningEffort: high

Launch the app with:

$env:NODE_OPTIONS = "--use-system-ca"
$env:NO_PROXY = "localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,deepseek.com,.deepseek.com,api.deepseek.com"

Before launching, force-close all existing DeepSeek Harness.exe processes. Otherwise Electron single-instance behavior can reuse the old process and the new environment does not take effect.
Back up and move the Electron UI data directory:

%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop

After that directory was regenerated, the desktop app started again with a fresh UI state.
Why this feels like a product bug
I understand that the local machine has a proxy / TLS-inspection environment, so a Node CA issue is plausible. But the desktop app currently makes the failure much harder to diagnose than it needs to be:

The UI only reports DeepSeek Messages transport failed.
It does not expose the underlying cause such as SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN, proxy failure, stale model selection, or host process reuse.
Reinstalling the app does not reset either %USERPROFILE%\.dsh or %APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop.
Resetting %USERPROFILE%\.dsh alone still leaves Electron UI/local-storage state behind.
Launching again may reuse an existing Electron single-instance process, so environment fixes like NODE_OPTIONS=--use-system-ca may not apply.

Suggested improvements

Detect SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN / certificate validation failures and show an actionable message in the UI.
Consider launching the bundled Node host with OS trust store support on Windows, or provide a documented desktop setting for it.
Add a "Reset desktop state" / "safe mode" option that clearly resets both:

%USERPROFILE%\.dsh
%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop


When the user changes settings or relaunches after a transport failure, ensure the host process is restarted instead of silently reusing an old process environment.
Include the original transport cause in the UI or diagnostic export, not only the generic DeepSeek Messages transport failed.

I can provide more sanitized diagnostics if needed, but I intentionally omitted API keys and full personal paths here.

threads.title: [Bug] Windows: Open In 无法用 VS Code 打开工作区 — ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 污染启动环境
threads.bodyText:
Bug 反馈：Open In 无法用 VS Code 打开工作区（Windows）
摘要
在 Windows 上，DSH 桌面版的 Open In → VS Code 永远无法打开工作区，接口固定返回：
POST /open-in-app/open
502 (Bad Gateway)
{"code":"launch-failed","message":"failed to launch vscode"}

根本原因：宿主进程以 Electron Node 模式运行时设置了 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1，该变量经环境继承进入 open-in-app 的启动环境。VSCode 的 Code.exe 本身是 Electron 程序，检测到该变量后会以 Node 解释器模式运行，把传入的目录当成脚本路径，找不到即退出码 1。
影响范围：所有基于 Electron 的编辑器（VS Code、VS Code Insiders、Cursor、Windsurf）大概率同样受影响；而走 shell-open 路径的文件管理器（资源管理器）不受影响。

环境



项目
值




DSH 版本
0.2.0-rc.2（package.json，build commit 04f392c）


平台
Windows 10/11，x64


安装方式
打包版（app.isPackaged === true）


目标应用
Visual Studio Code 1.140.0（User 版），%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe


Profile
desktop


工作区
D:\workspace（本文中已脱敏）




复现步骤

安装 VS Code（User 版，默认路径）
启动 DSH 桌面版
在会话标题栏点击 Open In 按钮 → 选择 VS Code
观察：无法打开，且手动调用接口返回 launch-failed


排查证据
1. 主机认为 VSCode 可用（探测层正常）
浏览器控制台：
fetch('open-in-app/apps').then(r=>r.text()).then(console.log)
// => {"apps":["explorer","vscode"]}
即目录表 OPEN_IN_APP_CATALOG 的三条定位链（file 已知路径 → app-paths 注册表 → install-record 卸载记录）均命中，探测层完全正常。
2. 启动失败（launch 层异常）
fetch('open-in-app/open',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},
  body:JSON.stringify({app:'vscode',path:'D:\\workspace'})})
  .then(r=>r.text()).then(console.log)
// => {"code":"launch-failed","message":"failed to launch vscode"}
3. 直接启动同样失败（与 DSH 无关）
Start-Process "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe" `
  -ArgumentList 'D:\workspace' -PassThru
# 退出码 1
4. 决定性证据：Code.exe 进入了 Node 模式
> Code.exe --version
v24.21.0                       ← 这是 Node 的版本，不是 VSCode 的 1.140.0

> Code.exe --help
Usage: node [options] [ script.js ] [arguments]

> Code.exe --verbose
bad option: --verbose

正常的 Code.exe --version 应返回 1.140.0。文件本身完好：
ProductName   : Visual Studio Code
ProductVersion: 1.140.0
OriginalFilename: electron.exe

5. 变量来源
[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE','User')    # 空
[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE','Machine') # 空
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE                                             # 1



作用域
值
说明




用户环境变量
空
未污染


系统环境变量
空
未污染


进程环境
1
由 DSH 宿主自身设置




代码路径分析
变量注入点
lib/main.js:3529-3538
function desktopNodeEnvironment(executable, bin, environment) {
    return {
        ...environment,
        ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1",
        ...bin === void 0 ? {} : {
            DSH_DESKTOP_NODE_EXECUTABLE: executable,
            PATH: `${bin}${delimiter}${environment.PATH ?? ""}`
        }
    };
}
此变量本意是让 Electron 以 Node 模式运行 DSH 自身，其作用域应严格限制在 DSH 的子进程内。
环境清理未覆盖该变量
dsh-subprocess/lib/index.js:32,50-55
const SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN = /KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i;

function scrubbedParentEnv() {
    const env = {};
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(process.env))
        if (value !== void 0
            && !SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN.test(key)
            && !key.toUpperCase().startsWith("DSH_"))
            env[key] = value;
    // ...
}
该函数剔除凭据类变量和 DSH_* 前缀变量，但 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 两个条件都不满足，因此原样传递给子进程。
启动链路
dsh-host-open-in-app/lib/types/resolver.js:37-43
export const launchDetachedApp = (command, args, options) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(command, [...args], {
        detached: true,
        stdio: 'ignore',
        windowsHide: options.windowsHide,
        env: { ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...options.env },
    });
    // ...
    child.on('exit', (code, signalName) => {
        if (code === 0) settle(resolve);
        else settle(() => { reject(new Error(`launcher exited with code ${code}...`)); });
    });
});
为何文件管理器正常
explorer 走 shell-open 路径（resolver.js:586 的 runShellOpen → openNativePath），不经过 spawn(executable)，因此不受该变量影响。VSCode 等走 argv 直接 spawn 的目标则全部中招。

根因
DSH 宿主以 Node 模式启动
  → 设置 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1
    → 变量进入宿主 process.env
      → scrubbedParentEnv() 不剔除它
        → spawn('Code.exe', [workspaceDir])
          → Code.exe 检测到该变量，进入 Node 模式
            → 目录参数被当作脚本路径
              → exit code 1 → launch-failed


建议修复
方案 A（推荐）：启动前剥离该变量
在 launchDetachedApp 中，对目标为 Electron 程序的场景显式移除：
const { ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: _ignored, ...parentEnv } = scrubbedParentEnv();
const child = spawn(command, [...args], {
    detached: true,
    stdio: 'ignore',
    windowsHide: options.windowsHide,
    env: { ...parentEnv, ...options.env },
});
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 是 Electron 运行时内部开关，不应传递给任何被启动的用户应用；对所有 launch 目标统一剥离是安全的——不存在依赖该变量启动的应用。
方案 B：在 scrubbedParentEnv 中加入该变量
把 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 纳入剔除清单，与 DSH_* 同等对待：
if (value !== void 0
    && !SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN.test(key)
    && !key.toUpperCase().startsWith("DSH_")
    && key.toUpperCase() !== "ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE")
    env[key] = value;
覆盖面更广（所有子进程均受益），但需评估是否有内部调用路径依赖该变量经由 scrub 后继续可见——当前代码中该变量均由各 spawner 的显式 env 提供（host-index.js:819、desktop-host-index.js:240、main.js:3532），不经过 scrub，因此移除应无副作用。
方案 C：改用 CLI 启动器
VSCode 自带不依赖 Electron 运行时模式的包装器：
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\bin\code.cmd

但当前目录表在编译期固定（README 明确说明 "The catalog is fixed at build time"），无法通过配置调整，仅可作为长期方向参考。

复现用验证脚本
// 在 DSH DevTools 控制台中执行
(async () => {
  const apps = await fetch('open-in-app/apps').then(r => r.json());
  console.log('可用应用:', apps.apps);

  for (const app of apps.apps) {
    const res = await fetch('open-in-app/open', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        app,
        path: 'D:\\workspace',
      }),
    });
    console.log(app, res.status, await res.text());
  }
})();
在 PowerShell 中验证 Electron 是否被误判为 Node：
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\Code.exe" --version
# 正常应输出 1.140.0；若输出 v24.x.x 则已污染

备注
排查过程中另发现两处可改进点，与本 bug 无直接关系：


profile/cordis.patch.yml 中的无效条目：存在 - id: vscode 条目但缺少 name 字段，且安装包内并不存在 dsh-vscode 插件。该条目既不会报错也不生效，建议移除以免误导。


主按钮默认目标易被误解：当 choice 为空时，主按钮默认指向列表首项（本例为文件资源管理器），VSCode 仅存在于下拉菜单中。建议在按钮上增加当前应用名称提示，降低误判概率。


Windows 无可见的开发者工具入口：lib/main.js:11921-11930 中两个 toggleDevTools 菜单项 visible: false，仅保留 F12 加速键。排查问题时缺少可发现的入口。



环境补充信息

工作区权限曾异常（SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5)），已单独修复，与本 bug 无关
DSH 进程启动时间与 VSCode 安装时间无关联性，排除"探测快照过期"假设（README 中 "New installs appear after a restart" 所述行为不影响本场景）


说明：本文所有路径与用户名均已脱敏。本问题与特定机器无关，任何 Windows + 打包版 DSH + Electron 系编辑器的组合都可能复现。

threads.title: dsh-tools: createExecution identity is mutable until final notification — pre-execute listeners can retarget calls (0.1.6-alpha.2 → 0.2.1-alpha.2)
threads.bodyText:
Bug report (upstream Issues are disabled, so posting here per README "Submit feedback or bug reports through GitHub Discussions").
Summary
ToolRegistry.createExecution builds the execution identity (name, callId, rootCallId, token, ...) as ordinary writable object fields. The only Object.freeze(exec) in lib/index.js runs at the start of notifyResult(exec, result) — i.e. when the final result is notified — not at creation. dispatchToolBody then resolves the tool body via this.resolveExecution(exec.name, ...), i.e. from the still-mutable exec.name.
Any tools/pre-execute listener can therefore run exec.name = '<another-allowed-tool>' and silently retarget the call to a different whitelisted tool's body. Guards/policy sitting downstream of pre-execute only ever see the rewritten name. TypeScript readonly provides no runtime protection.
Affected versions
Reproduced on every published version we tested, from 0.1.6-alpha.2 (pinned) through the latest 0.2.1-alpha.2 (2026-10-09), including 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.2. Key lines in lib/index.js (0.2.1-alpha.2): createExecution at ~3129, const name = exec.name at ~3134, execution object construction (only arguments deep-frozen) at ~3165, dispatchToolBody/resolveExecution(exec.name) at ~3292/3305, and the single Object.freeze(exec) in notifyResult at ~3408. Line numbers shift slightly per release but the structure is identical across all nine releases we audited (0.1.6-alpha.2, 0.1.7-alpha.1/.2, 0.1.7-rc.1/.2, 0.2.0-rc.1/.2, 0.2.1-alpha.1/.2).
Minimal reproduction

Register two tools, e.g. dengue_weekly_descriptive and brief_verifier (both allowed).
Register a tools/pre-execute listener that mutates the execution object and allows the call:

ctx.on('tools/pre-execute', async (exec) => {
  exec.name = 'brief_verifier'; // retarget to another whitelisted tool
  return { action: 'allow' };
});

Invoke dengue_weekly_descriptive.

Observed: the actual executed body is brief_verifier's; the result reports isError=false; the runtime raises no error (no mutation_rejected_by_runtime signal). The mutation is not rejected in strict mode either, because the identity fields are plain writable properties.
Expected: the executed body must remain the originally requested tool, or the call must be rejected with a structured error.
We ran this against pinned 0.1.6-alpha.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.2, plus 0.1.7-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.2, in isolated installs (npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh@<version>): the attack succeeded on all four, with zero model calls / zero session events.
Suggested fixes (any one closes the hole; A is preferred)
A. Freeze identity at creation (immutable identity interface). Before createExecution returns, freeze the identity fields — at minimum name/callId/rootCallId/agent/parent/token (e.g. shallow-freeze the base object before composing the execution object, or expose identity through a read-only accessor view). In dispatchToolBody, use the name captured at creation instead of reading exec.name. A listener attempting the rename then throws TypeError in strict mode, which is a sufficient signal.
B. Anti-drift assertion. If a mutable carrier must be kept, after the pre-execute waterfall and before the guard, compare exec.name against the original name recorded in the token; on mismatch, terminate with a structured error without entering dispatch. Also provide a supported read-only query for the original identity on ToolExecutionToken.
C. Sampling seed pass-through (related gap). LlmCallConfig/GenerateOptions have no seed field (absent across 0.1.6-alpha.2 → 0.2.1-alpha.2 in dsh-llm; grep -i seed over all lib sources returns nothing), and dsh-llm-deepseek's request construction (~lines 1705–1721 in 0.2.1-alpha.2) forwards only model/stream/messages/max_tokens/thinking/system/temperature/stop_sequences/tools. Please add an optional seed: number to the config types and zod schemas, forward it in the adapter when the provider supports it, and raise an explicit UNSUPPORTED_* error rather than silently dropping it.
Acceptance criteria

With a renaming listener from the repro, the executed body is still the originally requested tool, or the call is rejected with a structured error.
A request carrying seed makes that field observable at the adapter layer.

Impact statement
We treat this as a security/adversarial defect (EXECUTION_IDENTITY_MUTABLE) in our evaluation harness: any pre-execute plugin can silently substitute the tool that actually runs, which breaks the integrity of audited/agentic evaluation pipelines. Combined with the missing seed pass-through (no way to make sampling reproducible), we currently fail-closed: all live model entry points exit before startup (live_ready=false) and we stay pinned on 0.1.6-alpha.2 until an upstream fix or a supported hardening interface lands.
Evidence: full per-version audit (sha256 of released lib/index.js for all nine versions, line-level findings, adversarial probe outputs) is maintained in our downstream project (CTModelling-LLMdev/dsh-plugin-public-health, docs/reviews/20261009-execution-identity-upstream-audit.md). Happy to share the probe scripts or adapt them into a PR if that helps.
