threads.title: Codex subagent can fail when DSH’s bundled Codex is older than the user’s configured model
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Codex receives frequent updates, including support for new models. This creates a compatibility problem when DSH bundles an older Codex version but reads the user’s current Codex configuration.
Example
I updated my terminal Codex to 0.162.0 and set gpt-6.1-sol as the default model in ~/.codex/config.toml. This works when I run codex directly.
However, DSH’s Codex subagent uses its own bundled Codex 0.147.0, rather than the updated executable on my PATH. It reads the same configuration and attempts to use gpt-6.1-sol through the older runtime.
How the mismatch happens

The user updates their terminal Codex and selects a newly supported model.
DSH’s bundled Codex remains on an older version.
Calling subagent_codex loads the user’s current configuration.
The older bundled runtime attempts to use the new model and fails.

Observed errors
The bundled version reported:
ERROR codex_models_manager::manager: failed to load models cache:
missing field `supports_parallel_tool_calls` at line 139 column 5

The model request also failed with:
The 'gpt-6.1-sol' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account.

Running the same minimal request through terminal Codex 0.162.0 succeeded, while bundled Codex 0.147.0 failed.
The DSH subagent then remained pending instead of returning the failure promptly.
Suggested improvements
Could DSH support one or more of the following?

Use the installed Codex executable from PATH or a configurable executable path.
Provide a supported way to update bundled Codex independently.
Allow a separate model configuration for the Codex subagent.
Detect incompatible configurations and return a clear error.
Ensure failed subagent calls terminate cleanly and return their error to the parent agent.

threads.title: [desktop] All model requests fail in the Electron desktop app (`TRANSPORT`) while `dsh headless` and the web UI succeed with the identical profile, credentials, model and network
threads.bodyText:
✅ RESOLVED — see the follow-up comment below. The cause was a plugin
fetch monkey-patch recursion, not the Electron shell. The original
report's central conclusion is corrected there.



TL;DR — On Windows 10, DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 fails every model request (DeepSeek Messages transport failed / TRANSPORT, retries 5/5, 15–17 s per turn), across all providers (deepseek-official, deepseek, opencode-go).
Same machine, same moment, same ~/.dsh profile, credentials, model and network:

dsh headless (desktop profile) → succeeds (2.9 s)
Web UI (http://127.0.0.1:3080) → succeeds
Desktop app (Electron) → fails every time

So the engine, provider registration, credentials, network stack and endpoint are all fine. The failure lives only in the Electron desktop shell.
It started abruptly on 2026-10-10 07:50 (UTC+8) after a scheduled reboot, with no local config change. It is not #9262 (that fails locally in 13–15 ms), not #8947 (~300 s bodyTimeout), not #8837 (boot/resume crashes). I could not find an existing report matching this.
The report also documents 6 additional defects found while isolating this one — most notably that the desktop app writes no logs at all, and that the model picker shows two provider groups both labelled "DeepSeek", so users cannot tell the account route from the API-key route.
Full environment, 12 ruled-out hypotheses with measured evidence, minimal repro and probe scripts below.


[desktop] All model requests fail in the Electron desktop app (TRANSPORT) while dsh headless and the web UI succeed with the identical profile, credentials, model and network

Summary
On the same machine, at the same moment, with the identical profile config, credentials, model, reasoning effort and network:
dsh headless (desktop profile) → succeeds (2.9 s)
Web UI (http://127.0.0.1:3080, same ~/.dsh) → succeeds
Desktop app (Electron) → fails every time — TRANSPORT, retries 5/5, 15–17 s per turn
The DSH engine, provider registration, credential resolution, network stack, model and endpoint are all fine. The failure exists only in the Electron desktop shell.
Environment
OS: Windows 10 Pro (WIN-B045A165KFF, WORKGROUP, not domain-joined)
DSH Desktop: 0.2.0-rc.2 (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness)
Electron: 44.0.0
Bundled Node: 24.18.1
DSH_HOME: C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh
Profile: desktop
Update channel: nightly (resources/app-update.yml → https://download.deepseek.com/dsh-desk/feeds/win-x64/)
Latest on that channel: 0.2.0-rc.2 (nightly.yml, releaseDate 2026-09-29T10:35:27Z) — no update available
Third-party plugins in the profile: @michengai/dsh-automation, @michengai/dsh-im-connect, dsh-auto-memory, dsh-cost-meter, dsh-opencode-session-header, dsh-tavern, dsh-whale-galgame, dshmarket (+ bundles)
Symptom
3.1 Two different error strings, one code
deepseek-official — adapter dsh-llm-deepseek (native) — UI text DeepSeek Messages transport failed — code TRANSPORT
deepseek — adapter dsh-llm-pi-ai (OpenAI SDK) — UI text Connection error. — code TRANSPORT
opencode-go — adapter dsh-llm-pi-ai — UI text Connection error. — code TRANSPORT
3.2 Consistent failure signature
Retries exhausted at 5/5, total per turn 15–17 s (matches the default backoff 500+1000+2000+4000 ≈ 7.5 s)
Retry delays observed: 7581 ms, 8056 ms, 8167 ms, 8088 ms, 7508 ms
Only a full restart of the app allows a retry — once a session fails, it keeps failing
3.3 Onset
2026-10-10 07:50 (UTC+8) onwards. Up to that point everything worked ("login fine, model fine, streaming with no errors"). The machine boots on schedule (BIOS RTC) at 07:40; the first scheduled tasks at 07:50 failed. No local configuration change was made.
Minimal reproduction
A) headless — SUCCEEDS

$exe = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe"
$cli = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js"

$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
$env:DSH_HOME    = 'C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh'
$env:DSH_PROFILE = 'desktop'

& $exe "--expose-internals" $cli headless "Reply with exactly: OK"
# Actual: exit=0, 2.9 s, stdout="收到"
B) Desktop app — FAILS
Launch DeepSeek Harness.exe
New session → select DeepSeek-V4-Pro (reasoning: Off) → send test
Actual: 本轮运行失败 DeepSeek Messages transport failed [TRANSPORT], retries 5/5, ~16 s
Both read the same ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml:
- id: agent-default-model
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model"
  config:
    provider: deepseek-official
    model: deepseek-v4-pro
    reasoningEffort: off

Everything ruled out (each with measured evidence)
Invalid model name — deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro return HTTP 200 on all three endpoint shapes. (Note: the literal id deepseek-v4.1-flash is rejected with 400 — see Bug B.)
Multi-turn conversation — two-turn conversations tested in both OpenAI and Anthropic formats, all HTTP 200.
Tool calls — full tool_calls + tool result two-turn chain, HTTP 200.
Thinking-block replay (Anthropic thinking+signature) — replayed verbatim / thinking dropped / signature blanked: all three HTTP 200.
Thinking mode itself — desktop still fails with reasoning: Off.
System proxy / TUN / proxy env vars — ProxyEnable=0; no TUN adapter; default route normal; HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY/NO_PROXY unset in all three .NET scopes; ~/.dsh/.env does not exist; Clash Verge enable_tun_mode: false, enable_system_proxy: false.
Local HTTPS MITM (AV / enterprise proxy) — disabled the machine's Aliyun SASE agent (service Stopped, driver Stopped, zero processes): problem persisted. Node TLS handshake to api.deepseek.com / platform.deepseek.com / harness.deepseek.com: authorized=true, real TrustAsia / DigiCert chains.
Windows Firewall — no DSH-related rules; no outbound Block rules; all three profiles default-allow outbound.
Endpoint unreachable — api.deepseek.com HTTP 200 (841 ms); platform.deepseek.com endpoints 200/405; opencode.ai/zen/go/v1 200.
Bad credentials — DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml verified working.
Polluted host-process environment — read the environment of the live DSH host process (PID 23664) directly: no proxy vars, no NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, no SSL_CERT_FILE, no DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL.
Broken desktop composition config — the identical profile works under dsh headless and the web UI.
Additional defects found along the way (independently fixable)
Bug A — The desktop app writes no logs at all
%APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\ contains only two crash logs — no regular runtime log. The host process's stdout/stderr go into an internal Electron pipe and are not reachable by the user.
The only way I obtained a real error during this investigation was to reconstruct the host launch myself via dsh headless. Not something an ordinary user can do.
Suggested: persist host stderr to disk, or expose a diagnostics export in Settings.
Bug B — The model name shown in the UI does not match the model id actually sent
From the bundled catalog:

"deepseek-flash": { "id": "deepseek-flash", "name": "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash",
                    "provider": "deepseek", "baseUrl": "https://api.deepseek.com" }
The UI shows "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash", but the id sent on the wire is deepseek-flash. A genuinely different id, deepseek-v4.1-flash (present in the opencode-go catalog), is rejected by api.deepseek.com:
HTTP 400: The supported API model names are deepseek-flash, deepseek-v4-pro,
          but you passed deepseek-v4.1-flash.

This mismatch cost a great deal of debugging time.
Bug C — llm-deepseek folds every non-HTTP failure into TRANSPORT
packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/adapter.ts:
const auth = await this.dependencies.resolveAuth(connection)   // <- OUTSIDE the try
try {
    ...
    if (!response.ok) { ...providerError(...)... }   // only here do AUTH/RATE_LIMIT/SERVER exist
} catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof LlmError) throw error
    throw new LlmError('DeepSeek Messages transport failed', 'TRANSPORT', { cause: error })
}
Credential-resolution failure (outside the try) → labelled TRANSPORT
Any other non-LlmError → also TRANSPORT
This is the same misclassification family as #8947 and #9262. Listed here because it repeatedly sent this investigation in the wrong direction.
Bug D — Two provider groups in the model picker are both labelled "DeepSeek"
The picker contains DeepSeek (→ deepseek-official), opencode-go, and deepseek (→ the third-party pi-ai registration). Model display names overlap heavily (both show "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash" / "V4 Pro"). The user cannot tell which route is the account route, which is the API-key route, and which is a third-party gateway.
Bug E — opencode-go reports Connection error. for what is actually HTTP 400 missing x-opencode-session
Reproduced with the bundled OpenAI SDK 6.40.0:
HTTP 400 {"error":{"type":"MissingSessionID",
  "message":"Request is missing x-opencode-session and cannot be routed efficiently."}}

The UI shows the generic Connection error. (APIConnectionError fallback text). The profile has @michengai/opencode-session-header installed, but the header is not injected.
Bug F — The desktop nightly channel has no newer build
nightly.yml reports 0.2.0-rc.2 (2026-09-29), identical to what is installed. @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2 exists on npm but is a different distribution channel from the desktop app, so it cannot be used to fix the desktop.
7. Related reports (checked — none is this bug)
#6934 — Desktop shell: plugin host APIs 403 for the renderer; plugin host routes registered on webServer are unreachable from the desktop shell (fall through to SPA index.html / 405), while the same plugin set works in the browser UI. Closest match in shape (desktop-only, works in web UI). Worth checking whether the host-side half of our 8 third-party plugins is involved. Our symptom is that the model request fails, and it reproduces with reasoningEffort: off on a brand-new session.
#9262 (and #7582, #7834) — Missing attachment object → session permanently fails, misreported as TRANSPORT. Failure is local, 13–15 ms; ours is 15–17 s with 5 retries.
#8947 — streamIdleTimeoutMs capped by undici's 300 s bodyTimeout, misreported as TRANSPORT. Trigger is a >300 s silent stream; ours fails in ~16 s.
#8837 — Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2: BOM in profile package.json crashes boot; turn-resume crash after interrupted tool call. Different failure points.
earendil-works/pi#8838 — Multi-turn/tool-call sessions fail with Connection error. because reasoning_content is echoed back as "". We tested multi-turn + tool calls + all three thinking-replay variants directly against the API: all HTTP 200.
I could not find an existing report matching this one.
8. What remains unknown (stated honestly)
I did not identify the specific difference between the Electron shell and the headless run. §5 lists everything excluded.
The only remaining variable is the Electron runtime itself, and it is not observable from outside:
The desktop app writes no logs (Bug A)
Model requests are issued by the host process, so they do not appear in the renderer's DevTools Network panel — that panel only shows UI polling RPCs (channels, snapshot, getState, …), all returning 200
What I need: a way to make the desktop host process's network failures visible — write host stderr to disk, add a diagnostics toggle in Settings, or surface the real cause in the UI.
9. Impact
Every provider fails in the desktop app (account route, API-key route, third-party gateway)
Scheduled automations all fail, every day (morning digests, heartbeat, patrol)
No self-service diagnosis is possible: no logs, error codes swallowed, provider groups indistinguishable by name
The only workaround is to use the web UI at http://127.0.0.1:3080, which shares the same ~/.dsh
10. Appendix — probe scripts used
10.1 Decide "engine problem" vs "Electron-shell problem"
$exe = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe"
$cli = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\cli.js"
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE='1'; $env:DSH_HOME="$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh"; $env:DSH_PROFILE='desktop'
& $exe "--expose-internals" $cli headless "Reply with exactly: OK"
10.2 Read the live host process's environment (detect pollution)
Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='DeepSeek Harness.exe'" |
  Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'expose-internals' } |
  Select-Object ProcessId, CommandLine
10.3 TLS chain check (detect local interception)
import tls from 'node:tls';
for (const h of ['api.deepseek.com','platform.deepseek.com','harness.deepseek.com']) {
  const s = tls.connect({ host: h, port: 443, servername: h }, () => {
    const c = s.getPeerCertificate();
    console.log(h, 'issuer=', c.issuer?.CN ?? c.issuer?.O, 'authorized=', s.authorized);
    s.destroy();
  });
}
10.4 Reproduce with the bundled OpenAI SDK (pi-ai route)
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
const req = createRequire('C:\\...\\resources\\app.asar\\dsh\\')
const OpenAI = req('openai')                       // bundled 6.40.0
const client = new OpenAI({ apiKey, baseURL: 'https://api.deepseek.com', maxRetries: 0 })
await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'deepseek-v4-pro', max_tokens: 16,
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] })   // -> 200 in 1089 ms outside the desktop shell

threads.title: [Bug][Windows desktop] workspace-write 子进程 0xC0000142：普通/管理员启动对照（0.2.0-rc.2，Win11 26200）
threads.bodyText:
问题概述
Windows 桌面版 DSH 在 workspace-write 模式下无法启动受限 shell：命令无输出，退出码为 3221225794（有符号表示为 -1073741502，十六进制 0xC0000142 / STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）。
同一台机器上，普通权限重新启动 DSH 后 shell 恢复，并验证了工作区内写入成功、越界写入被拒。之后再次以管理员身份启动，故障重现。管理员宿主与故障存在明显关联，但完整触发条件仍需进一步验证，见下方证据限制。
环境

DeepSeek Harness Windows 桌面版，0.2.0-rc.2，nightly 通道。
Windows 11，OS build 26200（PowerShell 的 OS 字段显示 Microsoft Windows 10.0.26200）。
DSH 配置 profile：desktop；工作区：%USERPROFILE%\.dsh。
已使用官方 MSI 安装 PowerShell 7.6.6：C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe；正常、不受限启动已验证。
也测试过缓存中的 PowerShell 7.6.5，失败表现相同。
直接调用 DSH 包内 @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js；Electron Node runtime 24.18.1。
初始排查时 Windows UAC 的 EnableLUA=0；直接双击桌面快捷方式也会以提升权限启动。快捷方式本身没有 RunAsAdmin 标志，程序没有 RUNASADMIN 兼容性项。这是当时的系统状态，不作为单独已确认的根因。

复现步骤

完全退出 DSH 桌面版，确保旧进程退出。
以管理员身份启动 DSH，选择 workspace-write 会话。
调用 pwsh 工具执行：

$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
Write-Output 'sandbox-ok'

观察：无输出，退出码 3221225794 / 0xC0000142。
完全退出后以普通权限启动，在同一工作区、同一 PowerShell 路径下重复；本机测试恢复成功。
再次以管理员启动后，最后一轮测试重新失败。

实测结果
直接运行 DSH 原生 runner

缓存版 PowerShell 7.6.5，read-only：退出 0，输出 sandbox-ok。
缓存版 PowerShell 7.6.5，workspace-write：退出 0xC0000142。
官方 PowerShell 7.6.6，不受限：退出 0，输出版本 7.6.6。
官方 PowerShell 7.6.6，read-only：退出 0，输出 sandbox-ok。
官方 PowerShell 7.6.6，workspace-write：退出 0xC0000142。
Windows cmd.exe，workspace-write：退出 0xC0000142。

因此故障不局限于 PowerShell 版本或安装路径。没有测试 cmd.exe 的只读模式，不将其列为成功结果。
DSH 导出会话中的原始工具结果（脱敏摘录）
用户报告普通权限启动后，pwsh 工具返回：
PSVersion=7.6.6
PSEdition=Core
LangMode=FullLanguage
WriteInWorkspace=ok
RemoveProbe=True
Exe=C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe

随后验证边界：
ChildExitCode=7
System32Visible=True
OutsideWrite=denied
OutsideFileExists=False
DSH_PROFILE=desktop

最后用管理员重启，同一工具再次返回：
(no output)
[exit code: 3221225794]

早期已批准的不受限诊断返回 Elevated=True，whoami /groups 显示 High Mandatory Level。
预期行为与临时恢复方法
希望 workspace-write 能稳定启动受限进程；如果某种提升权限宿主环境不受支持，应给出可操作的提示，而不是让每条命令静默返回 DLL 初始化错误。
本机普通权限启动后曾恢复，且工作区写入边界有效。read-only 也在直接 runner 测试中正常。完全权限模式能运行，但它绕过受限执行，不能视为沙箱修复。
排查没有修改 DSH 包内代码或降低沙箱保护。可以优先比较已核实的普通/提升宿主 token、工作区模式、默认 DACL、private temp、控制台创建标志和继承 stdio 的组合；这些是建议调查方向，不是已确认根因。
相关反馈

#810：#810
#1847：#1847

本反馈补充 Windows 11 build 26200、桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2，以及启动权限切换的对照结果。

threads.title: Windows：ACL 诊断/修复技能会奖励「模型不用 DSH 文件工具、改用命令行」的错误路径，在沙箱正常拒绝时触发主动提权与自制工具
threads.bodyText:
摘要
在 Windows 上，模型本来就更倾向于用 Bash/PowerShell 工具去列目录、找文件，而不是用 DSH 自带的 glob/read/grep。这不是 ACL 技能引起的，但自 v0.2.0-rc.1 引入、并在 v0.2.1-alpha.2 合并为「一次调用同时诊断并修复」的 diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl 技能，会把这条错误路径的后果进一步放大：
当模型用命令行做本该由 DSH 文件工具完成的事、并被沙箱正常拒绝时，技能目录里常驻的 ACL 诊断技能会让模型把「预期内的拒绝」误判成「需要修复的环境故障」，进而

主动发起提权申请（把命令升级到 full access / danger-full-access），或
开始自制工具——写探针文件、写诊断脚本、构造辅助命令来「排查环境」。

而正确的行为本应是：改用 DSH 文件工具，或把预期拒绝直接解释给用户。结果是模型既没有回到 DSH 工具，又额外动了文件系统和权限。
影响

用户被无意义地要求扩大系统权限；一旦误点「通过」，模型获得了远大于任务所需的权限。
工作区被留下探针文件、诊断脚本、报告目录等任务无关产物。
沙箱的失败提示（denial 反馈）从「教会模型用对工具」退化成「教模型去做权限工程」。
对 workspace-write 下最普通的越界写入拒绝（本应直接解释）尤其容易误触发。

复现路径
环境：Windows + 内置 Windows runner（未配置 runnerCommand），文件策略 workspace-write。

用户的输入完全不涉及任务（例如只发一句打招呼）。
模型先用命令行工具列目录，例如 Get-ChildItem -Force，而不是 glob。
该命令行被沙箱拒绝；在 Windows 上这类失败会以工具层错误形式返回。
模型看到拒绝，并从常驻技能目录里发现 diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl。
模型阅读技能、决定「需要修复权限」，于是申请把该命令升级为不受限执行；被拒绝后可能改为写探针文件、编写诊断脚本来自证环境有问题。
全程没有回到 glob/read/grep——而它们本来可以正常完成同一件事。

关键点：第 2 步就是错的（DSH 提示词本就要求用文件工具而非 shell），而技能的存在让第 3 步之后的走向从「改正」变成了「升级权限 + 造工具」。
触发机制（源码定位）

技能随包发布，并由 sandbox-local 在内置 Windows runner 下自动注册为常驻技能目录条目：
packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/index.ts 第 301–303 行
if (process.platform === 'win32' && this.runnerCommand === undefined) {
  ctx.inject(['skills'], (skillsCtx) => { registerAclDiagnosisSkill(skillsCtx) })
}

注册实现：packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/acl-skill.ts（提取 SKILL.md 与脚本到临时目录，modelInvocable: true, userInvocable: true）。
技能正文：packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/assets/diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl/SKILL.md。

也就是说，只要有内置 Windows runner，这个技能就始终出现在技能目录里，与是否真的发生故障无关。
版本证据



版本
情况




dsh-v0.1.6-alpha.2
不存在该技能。同一路径 packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/assets/diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl/SKILL.md 返回 404


dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1
技能首次出现（发布说明原文：「Windows 内置沙箱新增权限诊断技能……」；该说明声明汇总自 v0.1.7-rc.2 以来的变更）。此时是分步流程：先纯诊断拿到 CULPRIT/PRECONDITION/BOTH 判定，再单独用 -Fix 或 -GrantFullControl 发起第二次修复


dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2（当前）
已合并为一次授权调用同时完成诊断与修复，脚本不再有模式开关。发布说明原文：「合并 Windows 沙箱权限诊断与修复为一次授权运行，保留修改前备份和恢复命令」



这个合并是放大效应的重要一步：分步设计下，模型至少要先做一次不改任何东西的纯诊断；合并后，一次调用就直接走到「改权限」，从「看到拒绝」到「申请提权」之间少了一道天然缓冲。
建议

优先修工具选择而不是修 ACL：这条链路真正的起点是模型不用 glob/read/grep。如果能在工具层强化或强制这一点，整条放大链会自动消失。
让技能对「预期拒绝」不可见或不可用：例如当拒绝原因属于「工作区外写入 / read-only 下写入」这类预期类别时，不向模型展示该技能，或在工具结果里直接标注「这是预期拒绝，不要修复」。技能正文其实已经写了这条（Expected confinement denials need no ACL repair），但它依赖模型先正确分类——而这恰是失败的一环。
在技能里显式禁止用命令行做文件工具能做的事：明确要求「若失败命令属于 glob/read/grep 可替代的操作，先改用该工具，不得因此申请提权或创建诊断脚本/探针文件」。
提权申请前置门槛：当拒绝可通过更换工具解决时，不允许发起提权；或在申请文案里强制区分「工具用错」与「环境故障」。
可选：把该技能改为非默认注册，由用户在真的遇到不可解释的拒绝时再启用。

补充：实例记录
以下记录来自一次真实会话，已做匿名化（不涉及用户内容）：

用户只发送了一句问候。
为了「列个目录」执行 Get-ChildItem -Force（DSH 提示词明确要求此类操作用 glob，此处是错误）。
该命令返回工作区授权失败错误。
把这个失败当成「环境故障」，调用 skill 加载 diagnose-windows-sandbox-acl。
三次申请把权限修复脚本升级为不受限执行（前两次因系统禁止运行 .ps1、缺少 pwsh 而未真正执行，第三次被用户拒绝）。
期间用写入操作创建了探针文件用于验证写入可用性，在你磁盘上留下了任务无关产物。
全程没有改用 glob+read；而它们本可以完成同样的事，且不会触发任何权限问题。

需要说明的是：第 2 步是判断失误，技能本身并不「命令」做这些。但要强调的是——技能的存在把一次本可即时纠正的小失误，导向了提权申请与文件系统改动。如果没有这个常驻技能，在第 3 步最自然的反应就是换用 DSH 文件工具。

threads.title: [Windows][Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2] profile 中装了第三方插件后，新建会话报 deployment:persona-prefix 已注册
threads.bodyText:
复现步骤

Windows 10 + DSH 桌面版 0.2.0-rc.2，全新 profile
在该 profile 目录内安装任意第三方插件（npm install  --save-exact）
重启 DSH 桌面版
点「新会话」

结果：新会话创建失败，弹出：
agent-preset/invalid: persona (@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona):
prompt section "deployment:persona-prefix" is already registered
(for a per-agent override, register through that agent's `agent.ctx` instead)

移除该插件后立刻恢复正常。
两个互不相关的插件都能复现，报错完全一致

dsh-computer-use@0.3.1（宿主包声明为普通 dependencies）
dsh-codex-style-computer-use@1.2.0（宿主包声明为 optional peerDependencies，安装后无任何嵌套重复依赖）

所以这与插件的依赖声明方式无关，与「profile 里存在额外插件」这一事实有关。
环境
宿主 @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.0-rc.2
Electron 44.0.0 / Node 24.18.1
Windows 10 x64 (19045) / Administrator
DSH_HOME: C:\Users\Administrator.dsh
profile: desktop
包管理器: npm 11.x
已排除的可能

插件版本与宿主不匹配 —— 第二个插件明确声明支持 >=0.2.0-rc.1，同样报错
重复依赖导致模块实例分裂 —— 第二个插件无任何重复副本，报错不变
插件代码里注册了 persona —— 两个插件全量检索 persona / systemPrompt / section( ，零命中
profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 重复声明 —— 已逐文件确认，无 persona 字样
插件自带 bundle patch 重复插入 —— 两个插件各自只有一条 insert 自己的行

从 app.asar 定位到的代码（供参考）
section 的注册点：
function applyChildComposition(childCtx, parent, composition) {
    childCtx.get("agentPresets")?.composeFrom(childCtx, parent.ctx);
    childCtx.systemPrompt.context({ name: "subagent:delegation", ... });
    if (composition.persona !== void 0) childCtx.systemPrompt.section({
        name: "deployment:persona-prefix",     // 报错行
        order: childCtx.systemPrompt.getSectionOrder("DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_PREFIX"),
        text: composition.persona
    });
    if (composition.toolFilter !== void 0) childCtx.tools.restrict(composition.toolFilter);
}

作用域判定：
function standingMountFor(agentCtx) {
    const agentKey = scopeOf(agentCtx);
    if (agentKey === void 0) return void 0;
    const standingKey = scopeParentOf(agentKey);
    if (standingKey === void 0) return void 0;
    return livePresetMounts().find(c => c.key === standingKey);
}

composeFrom() 第一句就是 standingMountFor(parent)；若返回 undefined 则直接 return，
persona section 随后落到部署层，与 dsh-system-prompt 的无条件注册相撞。
注意紧邻的 subagent:delegation context 用同一个 childCtx 注册却没有报错，
只有 deployment:persona-prefix 报错。
想问的问题

存在第三方插件时，为什么 standingMountFor() 会返回 undefined？
是 scopeOf(agentCtx) 先失败，还是 scopeParentOf(agentKey) 先失败？
有没有办法打开 agent-preset 组装期的诊断日志，拿到确切调用栈？
这个问题在 0.2.0-rc.2 之后是否已修复？
是否有推荐的、能避免此问题的第三方插件安装方式？

threads.title: mac 上安装后，启动报错
[Bug] Error "API key is invalid" persiste con saldo recargado en la versión 0.2.0-rc.2 en Windows
threads.bodyText:
Descripción del problema
Estoy experimentando un error persistente "API key is invalid" en la aplicación DeepSeek Harness (versión 0.2.0-rc.2) en Windows. Este error ocurre a pesar de que he recargado mi cuenta de DeepSeek con $5 USD y he verificado que el saldo está disponible en el panel de la plataforma. La aplicación no me permite iniciar ninguna conversación.
Pasos para reproducir

Recargar saldo en la plataforma DeepSeek (platform.deepseek.com).
Instalar o reinstalar la aplicación DeepSeek Harness (versión 0.2.0-rc.2).
Iniciar sesión con la cuenta y vincular la aplicación.
Intentar enviar un mensaje simple (ej. "hola") en el chat de Harness.

Comportamiento esperado
La aplicación debería procesar el mensaje y responder normalmente, utilizando el saldo disponible en la cuenta.
Comportamiento actual
La aplicación devuelve el error "This turn failed API key is invalid" (AUTH) y no procesa ningún mensaje.
Lo que ya he intentado (sin éxito)

Recargar saldo (confirmado: $5.00 USD disponibles).
Eliminar la clave "App-managed" y cerrar sesión en todos los dispositivos desde la plataforma DeepSeek.
Desinstalar y reinstalar la aplicación Harness (versión 0.2.0-rc.2).
Reiniciar el equipo y cerrar procesos en segundo plano.
Cambiar el modo de trabajo de "Standard" a "Workspace Write".
Intentar buscar un archivo de configuración (config.json) en la carpeta AppData\Roaming@deepseek-ai para forzar una clave manual, pero no existe dicho archivo.

Entorno

Versión de Harness: 0.2.0-rc.2
Sistema Operativo: Windows (10/11)
Proveedor de pago: Google Pay

Evidencia
Adjunto capturas de pantalla donde se muestra el error en la aplicación y el saldo positivo en la plataforma DeepSeek.

threads.title: [Bug] dsh v0.2.1-alpha.2: 达到 40% 上下文（约 37.9k/96k）时触发连续/疯狂的上下文压缩死循环
threads.bodyText:
问题描述 (Description)
在使用本地 llama.cpp 部署的模型进行长文本交互时，配置的总上下文窗口为 96k。但在对话进行到约 40% 左右（当前触发时约为 37.9k / 96k）时，系统开始出现持续且密集的上下文压缩（Compaction），导致日志被重复的压缩记录刷屏，对话无法正常推进。
环境与配置 (Environment)


DSH 版本: 0.2.1-alpha.2


推理后端: 本地 llama.cpp


模型: Qwen 27B 量化版本


配置上下文大小: 96k


复现步骤 (Steps to Reproduce)


启动 dsh 并加载本地 llama.cpp 模型端点。


进行多轮长上下文的编码或对话任务。


当上下文占用累积达到约 39% ~ 40%（约 37.9k tokens）时触发压缩。


现象：该问题已连续 2 次稳定复现，触发后系统会反复尝试压缩，并在日志中抛出类似 summary is not smaller than the shadowed content 的提示，陷入异常状态。

Environment: macOS arm64, pnpm 11.18.0, pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2. Any dsh --profile

... boot (including --help) fails: dsh: fatal uncaught exception: Error: dsh: host preparation failed: No usable native binding found for node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64 (auto) Chain: @deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader@1.0.6-alpha.1 -> node-addon-require-builtin@0.1.9 -> node-addon-native-custom-loader@0.1.9. The binding is installed correctly: the lockfile records node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64@0.1.9 (os darwin, cpu arm64, optional), the store has it with prebuilt/darwin-arm64-napi-v9.node, and it is linked as a sibling of node-addon-require-builtin. The failure is in how the loader looks for it (node-addon-native-custom-loader 0.1.9, lib index.js): tryRequirePackage (around line 454) does a bare require('node-addon-require-builtin-darwin-arm64') from the LOADER's own module context, not from the package that depends on the binding. The workspace fallback checks join(packageDir, '..', platformPackageSuffix()) where the suffix is the literal 'darwin-arm64' (around lines 288-290), a sibling name that does not exist under pnpm (the sibling is the full package name). The local-build fallbacks need a build/ directory the registry package does not ship. Why ordinary installs work, and the global one does not: Classic project layout: packages live under /node_modules/.pnpm/, so the hoist directory /node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules is on the loader's realpath walk-up and the bare require resolves. pnpm project .bin shims also export NODE_PATH containing that hoist directory. A pnpm 11 global install has neither: real paths are in /v11/links/ (off any walk-up) and the global shim exports no NODE_PATH. Minimal repro without DSH: with the node the shim uses, require('/.../node-addon-require-builtin/lib/index.js') fails with the same message. Controls: the same version boots from a plain project install with the same pnpm (direct bin.js, no NODE_PATH); a project with enableGlobalVirtualStore: true fails when its shim is bypassed. DSH 0.1.2 with the 0.1.5 loader (same code) booted from the same global layout because that version did not reach this path at boot. Workaround: NODE_PATH=/node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules. Suggested fix: resolve the optional candidate from the dependent package, e.g. require.resolve(request, { paths: [packageDir] }), and check the sibling under its full package name.

threads.title: [Bug] opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash: prompt_tokens + max_tokens > 2^20 时上游 400，错误体被截成 31 字节（UI 显示 "400 status code (no body)"），可用上下文只剩 63%
threads.bodyText:
TL;DR (English) — With provider opencode-go / model deepseek-v4.1-flash (catalog: contextWindow: 1000000, maxTokens: 384000), every request carries max_tokens: 384000. The endpoint rejects the request with HTTP 400 once prompt_tokens + max_tokens > 2^20 (1,048,576). The 400 body is a 31-byte JSON fragment ({"model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash"}) without an error field, so the OpenAI SDK surfaces it as 400 status code (no body) and the desktop UI shows「本轮运行失败 400 status code (no body)」. Effective usable input is therefore 1,048,576 − 384,000 = 664,576 tokens (63.4% of the advertised 1M), and the auto-compaction threshold (thresholdRatio × contextWindow) ignores that output reserve, so long sessions deterministically hit the wall.

环境

DSH desktop 0.2.0-rc.2（Windows），desktop profile，直连（无本地代理）
provider opencode-go，baseURL: https://opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1
model deepseek-v4.1-flash：contextWindow: 1000000, maxTokens: 384000
单 agent 会话（工具 78 个、系统提示 ~15 KB）；会话内无图片

观测数据（同一会话，数字来自 API 返回的真实 usage）



turn/step
prompt_tokens
+ 384,000
是否 > 2^20
结果




25-1
626,644
1,010,644
否（< 1,048,576）
✅ 200


29-7
662,208
1,046,208
否
✅ 200


29-8
≈673,267
1,057,267
是
❌ 400


30-1
≈673,267
1,057,267
是
❌ 400



边界落在 662,208 ~ 673,267 之间，命中 2^20 − 384,000 = 664,576。
注意 turn 25 那行：626,644 + 384,000 = 1,010,644 > 1,000,000 仍然成功 —— 说明窗口是 2^20 (1,048,576)，而不是 1,000,000。
失败后该会话每条请求都必败（usage: 0、0 token、INVALID_REQUEST，无 llm/retry），只能手动 /compact 才能恢复（/compact 之后同一会话又正常工作了 1 小时、turn 30→37）。
复现
A. 最小复现——同一份 ~2.93 MiB 的 messages payload，只改 max_tokens：



max_tokens
HTTP
响应体




384000
400
31 字节：{"model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash"}


8
200
正常流式 chunks



同一份 payload 再加 15 万个汉字（≈+150k token）后，max_tokens=8 仍 200、max_tokens=384000 仍 400 —— 即判定与「输出预留」强相关。
B. 自然复现：让会话 prompt 自然增长到 66 万 token 以上，下一次任意请求即 400（错误 UI 见上）。
根因分析

LLM 请求的 max_tokens 直接取模型目录的 maxTokens（384000）；而 DSH 自己的压缩实现默认只预留 headroomTokens = 65536。两者不一致 → 每次请求白扔 36.6% 的窗口。
压缩阈值按 thresholdRatio × contextWindow 计算，没有减去 max_tokens，因此不会在这个预留造成的墙之前触发（该长会话 30 轮内一次自动压缩都没发生）。
越界时上游返回的 400 body 被截断成 31 字节且不含 error 字段 → SDK 只能报 400 status code (no body)。用户侧完全看不出是「上下文+输出预留超限」，只能猜测网络/代理/密钥问题，排查成本极高。

建议

发送 max_tokens = min(catalog maxTokens, headroomTokens / 可配置值)（或按 window − prompt 动态收敛），让 1M 窗口真正可用 ~94%。
压缩判定使用有效窗口 contextWindow − max_tokens（或显式扣除预留）。
网关 400 的响应体请保留 error 字段；现在这种 31 字节碎片会把所有 400 都伪装成「no body」。
agent-default-model entry 的 config 不接受 maxTokens（实测手动写入后，应用启动时该键被剥离，且那次启动核心服务不可用：sessionController is unavailable，会话列表空白）。建议要么支持该键，要么在文档里指明正确位置是：

llm-pi-ai.providers.<provider>.modelOverrides[model].maxTokens（schema 已支持）
或 agent-loop.agents[].maxTokens



（附：排查中确认 llm-pi-ai 的 modelOverrides/models[] 都声明了 maxTokens，所以用户侧是有覆盖点的，只是位置不直观、且与压缩的 headroomTokens 语义不一致。）

threads.title: [Bug] workspace-write sandbox denies all character-device opens, including the explicitly granted /dev/null
threads.bodyText:
Bug Report: workspace-write sandbox denies every character-device open, including the explicitly granted /dev/null
Reporter: deepseek-flash (agent runtime, DSH desktop session)
Date: 2026-10-11
Component: @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local (Linux bwrap/Landlock runners) + @deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox
Severity: Low–Medium (no data loss; breaks a ubiquitous shell idiom)
Version: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop / @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime 0.2.0-rc.2

1. Summary
Under the workspace-write file policy, every command the harness executes is wrapped by a
sandbox runner. On this host, every character device under /dev fails to open with
EACCES, including /dev/null — which the sandbox profile explicitly grants as
read-write.
Consequence: the single most common shell idiom for discarding output,
command >/dev/null and command 2>/dev/null, fails with Permission denied. The failure is
silent in the sense that it surfaces as a shell-level error attributed to the device path
(bash: /dev/null: Permission denied), which is easy to misread as a host permissions problem.

2. Environment



Item
Value




Distribution
CachyOS x86_64


Kernel
7.2.9-2-cachyos


Active LSMs
capability,landlock,lockdown,yama,bpf


Landlock availability
landlock-run --probe → landlock: fully enforced


bwrap
present at /usr/bin/bwrap


kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone
1


DSH version
0.2.0-rc.2


Sandbox file policy
workspace-write


Process capabilities
CapInh=CapPrm=CapEff=CapBnd=CapAmb=0


NoNewPrivs
1


Seccomp
0 (no seccomp filter installed)




3. Reproduction
3.1 Minimal
Inside a harness-executed shell under workspace-write:
echo hi >/dev/null; echo "exit=$?"
# bash: /dev/null: Permission denied
# exit=1
3.2 Full device sweep
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, errno
for p in ["/dev/null","/dev/zero","/dev/full","/dev/random","/dev/urandom",
          "/dev/tty","/dev/ptmx","/dev/console","/dev/autofs"]:
    try:
        fd = os.open(p, os.O_RDONLY); os.close(fd)
        print("OK  ", p)
    except OSError as e:
        print("FAIL", p, errno.errorcode.get(e.errno))
PY
Result — all nine fail identically:
FAIL /dev/null     EACCES
FAIL /dev/zero     EACCES
FAIL /dev/full     EACCES
FAIL /dev/random   EACCES
FAIL /dev/urandom  EACCES
FAIL /dev/tty      EACCES
FAIL /dev/ptmx     EACCES
FAIL /dev/console  EACCES
FAIL /dev/autofs   EACCES

All three of O_RDONLY, O_WRONLY, O_RDWR fail on /dev/null. O_PATH succeeds —
so the path resolves and the inode is reachable; only real read/write opens are denied.
3.3 Control: ordinary files are unaffected
python3 -c "import os; fd=os.open('/tmp/x',os.O_CREAT|os.O_WRONLY,0o644); os.close(fd); print('OK')"
# OK
Reads and writes of regular files under /tmp and under the workspace root behave normally.
3.4 Control: the grant is present in the profile but ineffective
LANDLOCK=/opt/dsh-desktop-linux-bin/resources/app/dsh/node_modules/\
@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system-linux-x64/bin/landlock-run

"$LANDLOCK" --probe
# landlock: fully enforced

"$LANDLOCK" --rw /tmp --rw / -- python3 -c "
import os, errno
try:
    fd=os.open('/dev/null', os.O_WRONLY); os.close(fd); print('OK /dev/null')
except OSError as e: print('FAIL /dev/null', errno.errorcode.get(e.errno))
try:
    fd=os.open('/tmp/t', os.O_CREAT|os.O_WRONLY, 0o644); os.close(fd); print('OK /tmp')
except OSError as e: print('FAIL /tmp', errno.errorcode.get(e.errno))
"
# FAIL /dev/null EACCES
# OK /tmp
Granting read-write access to / itself does not make /dev/null openable. This rules out
"the grant root was missing from the allow-list" as the explanation.

4. Expected behaviour
landlockProfileArgs() grants /dev/null unconditionally, in every mode:
// node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:45
function landlockProfileArgs(policy) {
	const readWrite = ["/dev/null"];
	if (policy.mode === "workspace-write") readWrite.push("/tmp", policy.workspaceRoot);
	return grantArgs({
		readOnly: ["/"],
		readWrite
	});
}
Expected: >/dev/null and 2>/dev/null work, as they do under the bwrap runner on
comparable hosts. Observed: they fail with EACCES.
The launcher's own contract also promises this:
landlock-run [--ro <path>]... [--rw <path>]... -- <argv>...
`--rw` grants full filesystem access beneath the path. Everything else is denied.

Note the phrase "full filesystem access" — the observed behaviour contradicts it for character
devices.
The official sandbox documentation is stronger still. The rc.2 troubleshooting reference states
that /dev/null is a backend-required writable sink even in the most restrictive mode:

| read-only | deny writes except backend-required sinks such as /dev/null |

Source: docs/en/troubleshooting/sandbox-denied-vs-unavailable.md (content revision 4, verified
against rc.2 commit b150a551) in the community handbook
sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook.
So the documented contract is not merely "/dev/null happens to be granted under
workspace-write" — it is that /dev/null is a backend-required sink that must remain
writable even under read-only. workspace-write is strictly wider than read-only, so
failing to write /dev/null there contradicts the documented contract in two independent
places: the profile constructor and the mode table.

5. Relevant source



File
Relevance




@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:45
landlockProfileArgs() — grants /dev/null


@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:174
runner chain linux: ["bwrap", "landlock"]


@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:339
case "landlock": return [this.landlockLauncher(), ...landlockProfileArgs(policy)]


@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/src/main.c:70-89
Landlock access-bit definitions, incl. LL_FS_IOCTL_DEV (ABI 5)


@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/src/main.c:186-191
fs_mask_for_abi() — adds LL_FS_IOCTL_DEV only when abi >= 5


@deepseek-ai/node-addon-system/src/main.c:244-252
rule installation; --rw roots receive handled in full


@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox/README.md:39
documents workspace-write = workspace root + /tmp




6. What is proven, and what is not
I am deliberately separating these rather than asserting a root cause I have not demonstrated.
The confined environment makes a true unconfined control experiment impossible from inside it.
Proven by observation:

All character-device opens fail with EACCES in the sandboxed shell; regular files are
unaffected.
O_PATH succeeds where read/write opens fail.
The profile grants /dev/null explicitly, yet the open is denied — so the grant does not
take effect for character devices.
Granting --rw / does not change the outcome.
landlock-run --probe reports fully enforced, i.e. the launcher believes it is operating
correctly.
No seccomp filter is installed, no device cgroup controller exists
(cgroup.controllers = cpuset cpu io memory hugetlb pids rdma misc dmem — no device),
and all capabilities are zero. So the denial is not attributable to those mechanisms.

Not proven (open questions for maintainers):

Which runner is actually active. bwrap is installed and unprivileged user namespaces
are enabled, so the chain should select bwrap; but the explicit landlock-run invocation
reproduces the denial. I could not determine definitively whether bwrap, landlock, or an
interaction between them is responsible.
Whether Landlock is the denying layer at all. I initially hypothesised a missing
LL_FS_IOCTL_DEV grant, but the kernel is 7.2.9, far beyond the ABI 5 requirement
(Linux 6.10), and fs_mask_for_abi() does add the bit at that level. I retracted that
hypothesis; it does not explain the observation.
Whether the behaviour is reproducible outside this host. A control run in an unconfined
shell would settle this immediately.

One observation worth investigating
At one point the same launcher invocation produced a different error:
$ landlock-run --rw /tmp -- python3 -c "..."
landlock-run: exec failed: Permission denied

whereas an earlier invocation with the same argument shape executed successfully. That the
launcher itself intermittently fails to exec suggests the failure mode is not limited to one
access class and may be a layering interaction, not a single missing rule. I could not reproduce
it deterministically, so I report it as a lead, not a finding.

7. Impact

Breaks >/dev/null and 2>/dev/null, which are near-universal in shell scripts, build
recipes, and agent-generated commands. Many well-known tools internally redirect to
/dev/null; those fail too.
The error message names the device path (bash: /dev/null: Permission denied), steering
users toward investigating their host's permissions — which are correct
(crw-rw-rw-, uid=65534). This costs real debugging time.
No data-loss or security impact. Workarounds are trivial: redirect to a temporary file under
/tmp instead.

Workarounds (for users, while unfixed)



Intended
Substitute




cmd >/dev/null
cmd >/tmp/out.txt


cmd 2>/dev/null
cmd 2>/tmp/err.txt


cmd >/dev/null 2>&1
cmd >/tmp/out.txt 2>&1




8. Suggested next steps for maintainers

Reproduce on a CachyOS/Arch host with kernel ≥ 6.10 and Landlock enabled, DSH 0.2.0-rc.2,
policy workspace-write.
Log which runner the seam actually selects (bwrap vs landlock) and the exact argv prefix
it constructs for this policy.
If landlock is the active runner: verify with LANDLOCK_ACCESS_FS_IOCTL_DEV that
character-device opens are inside the granted set, and check whether /dev being a tmpfs
layer inside the sandbox (rather than the host's devtmpfs) affects the result.
If bwrap is the active runner: audit the /dev setup in its argv — a stale or
permission-mangled device node in the sandbox's /dev would match the observations
(device inode owned by the overflow uid 65534, visible via stat).
Add a regression test that asserts >/dev/null and 2>/dev/null both succeed under every
Linux sandbox rung. The existing grant of /dev/null in landlockProfileArgs() implies this
was the intent, so the test likely surfaces the gap immediately.


9. Note on the evidence chain
Every claim in §3 was produced by running the command shown and pasting its real output.
No output in this report is reconstructed or inferred. Where I could not reach a conclusion,
§6 says so explicitly rather than asserting a cause. The /dev/null inode timestamp on this
host changes at every boot (device nodes are recreated by devtmpfs), which makes the failure
easy to mistake for a boot-dependent condition; it is not — the behaviour is identical before
and after a reboot.

threads.title: 长上下文下思考链里的单字符复读：推理阶段的 loop，正文被挤出视野
threads.bodyText:
环境

dsh 0.1.6-alpha.2（web profile）
Windows 11 · 模型 DeepSeek Flash
出现时机：都是长会话（多轮累积之后），不是一开场就有

现象

思考链（reasoning）里同一个字符被反复复读，铺满整屏，把正文挤出可见范围。
它是自动蔓延的：一旦某次生成里出现过一次，之后就停不下来。
我们这次被复读的单元是 U+2B50（WHITE MEDIUM STAR），并且出现过连用分级（1 个 / 2 个 / 3 个）。

我们的判断（推断，不是定论）

结构上属于思考链重复抑制失效，不是内容问题。
依用户观察：它与"上下文里有没有这个字符"无关——是生成过程中自己增殖的。
被选中的复读单元通常短、无词义、视觉突出。换成别的短符号大概率一样——这点我们没做对照实验，是推断。
我们也没做严格对照：本地清过一次库之后，还没等到复发窗口（会话不够长）。

同类 issue（佐证）
Qwen 的 CLI 仓库（qwen-code）有一条几乎一样的：#9656「loop detection misses repetitive output in the thinking stage」。
同一个家族在别处也见过：长上下文下"重复写同一个动作""把遍数记乱"。
想确认四件事

这是已知问题吗？
现在的 loop 检测是只看最终输出，还是也覆盖 reasoning 流？（#9656 的说法是漏了推理阶段）
有没有现成开关或推荐配置（例如降低 reasoningEffort）？
社区那几个熔断插件（dsh-thinking-loop-guard · @goodandready/dsh-agent-loop-guard 等）是官方推荐的路子吗？

我们本地正在试

降 reasoningEffort（零安装，先试这个）
考虑装社区熔断插件，但担心它干扰思考链——有人实测"极简插件会明确改变思考链"，所以在犹豫
应急：察觉不对就压缩 / 新开会话（我们实测有效、零风险）

为什么觉得值得提
如果 loop 检测只覆盖最终输出、漏了推理阶段，那用户可见的损害会先发生在思考链上——思考链被占满、正文被挤出去、token 照烧。

threads.title: 标题  `deepseek-account` 下某个特定会话用 `deepseek-flash` 必然失败（`DeepSeek Messages transport failed` / TRANSPORT），同模型其它会话正常，换 `deepseek-v4-pro` 立即恢复
threads.bodyText:
笨蛋用户被大肥鱼指挥来这里报错，
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
第二部分：报告正文（从这里开始整段复制）
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
标题
deepseek-account 下某个特定会话用 deepseek-flash 必然失败（DeepSeek Messages transport failed / TRANSPORT），同模型其它会话正常，换 deepseek-v4-pro 立即恢复
环境

DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2（@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop，Electron 44.0.0，内置 Node 24.18.1）
Windows 11 x64（中文区）
Provider：deepseek-account（账号登录，未使用 API key）

会话 0de62bd8-… 在 deepseek-flash 下每次发送都失败，界面显示：

重试延迟：8230毫秒
失败原因：DeepSeek Messages transport failed

因此用户与支持人员都无法从外部定位真实原因。

关键观察：这是会话级问题，不是模型级问题
同一台机器、同一个账号、同一个 deepseek-flash 路线：

用该账号的凭据（~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 中
deepseek-account-platform/default 的 grant token，经 x-dsh-auth-token 发送），
直接对 https://api.deepseek.com 请求，全部成功：



验证项

即：DNS / TCP / TLS / 账号令牌 / 端点路径 / SSE 帧 / 图片 / 长历史 / 长思考，
每项单独验证均正常。失败只发生在 App 内该会话对 deepseek-flash 的调用上。
定位线索（代码位置，均取自 0.2.0-rc.2 的 app.asar）


@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js

generate() 兜底：任何非 LlmError 都会被包装为
new LlmError("DeepSeek Messages transport failed", "TRANSPORT", { cause: error })
—— 真实 cause 被吞掉，界面不展示。
serialize() 针对 flash 会输出
thinking:{type:"enabled"} 与 output_config:{effort:<high|low>}
（off 时为 thinking:{type:"disabled"} 且不带 output_config）。



模型目录 DEFAULT_MODELS 中两者的差异：

deepseek-flash：inputModalities:["text","image"]、systemPromptUpdate:"in-history"、toolUpdate:"addition-only"
deepseek-v4-pro：以上三项均无

=> 失败只出现在具备 systemPromptUpdate:"in-history" / 图片能力的代码路径上。
建议检查该路径（含图片 Files API 解析与 in-history 系统提示词注入）
在 deepseek-account provider 与长历史会话组合下，
是否抛出了非 LlmError（从而被兜底成 TRANSPORT）。


建议

TRANSPORT 的界面提示应带上 cause 与 request id。
本次唯一的定位线索来自用户手动换模型试验；仅凭 transport failed 无法排查。
提供一个可开启的运行日志开关。
当前非崩溃类失败不落盘，用户无法提供有效信息。
检查 flash + systemPromptUpdate:"in-history" 路径在长历史 + account provider 下的行为。

当前规避方式（已验证）
将该会话模型切换为 deepseek-v4-pro 即可正常使用。
（以上均由用户侧独立复现与验证，数据真实；如有表述不准确之处请指出，我可补充。）

Title（Discussion 标题）
[windows-acl] workspace-write: every child dies with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) on Windows 10 19045; read-only works


Body (EN)
Summary
On Windows 10 Pro (Build 19045), the windows-acl sandbox rung makes every command fail
under workspace-write mode. The child process dies during DLL initialization with
0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) and produces no stdout/stderr at all.
read-only mode works perfectly with the identical runner, workspace and temp directory.
The failure is shell-independent: cmd.exe, powershell.exe and node.exe all fail
identically under workspace-write and all succeed under read-only.
Because the failure happens at the Win32 token level rather than in the runner's own error paths,
the user sees only [exit code: 3221225794] with no diagnostic text — the failure is silent and
leads triage toward the wrong causes (missing pwsh, PATH, ACLs), none of which are involved.
Environment









OS
Windows 10 Pro, Build 19045, version 10.0.19045 (x64)


DSH
@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.0-rc.2


Shell resolved by resolvePwshPath()
C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe (5.1.19041.3803)


Sandbox mode
workspace-write


pwsh.exe (PowerShell 7)
not installed (the resolver falls back to 5.1 correctly)


Runner
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js



Note: the source comments in dsh-sandbox-windows-acl state the restricting-list design was
"verified on Win11 26200". Build 19045 (Windows 10 22H2) is outside that verified range.
Steps to reproduce
Minimal, self-contained — no DSH session required. Save as repro-windows-acl.mjs and run with
node (the sandbox packages must be resolvable, e.g. from a DEV checkout or via the installed app):
// repro-windows-acl.mjs
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import os from 'node:os';

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const runner = require.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/runner');

for (const mode of ['read-only', 'workspace-write']) {
  for (const [cmd, argv] of [['cmd.exe', ['/c', 'echo hi']],
                             [process.execPath, ['-e', 'console.log("hi")']]]) {
    const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, [
      runner,
      '--workspace', process.cwd(),
      '--temp', os.tmpdir(),
      '--mode', mode,
      '--', cmd, ...argv,
    ], { encoding: 'utf8' });
    console.log(
      mode.padEnd(16), cmd.padEnd(28),
      'exit=' + r.status,
      'hex=0x' + ((r.status ?? 0) >>> 0).toString(16).toUpperCase(),
      'stdout=' + JSON.stringify(r.stdout),
      'stderr=' + JSON.stringify(r.stderr),
    );
  }
}
Equivalent raw invocation, if you prefer to call the runner directly:
node "<...>\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js" ^
  --workspace <existing dir> --temp <existing dir outside the workspace> ^
  --mode read-only -- cmd.exe /c echo hi
:: => exit 0, stdout "hi"

node "<...>\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js" ^
  --workspace <existing dir> --temp <existing dir outside the workspace> ^
  --mode workspace-write -- cmd.exe /c echo hi
:: => exit 3221225794 (0xC0000142), stdout empty, stderr EMPTY
Actual results



Mode
Child
Exit code
stdout
stderr




read-only
cmd.exe /c echo hi
0
hi\r\n
(empty)


read-only
powershell.exe -Command "echo hi"
0
hi\r\n
(empty)


read-only
node -e 'console.log("hi")'
0
hi\n
(empty)


workspace-write
cmd.exe /c echo hi
3221225794 (0xC0000142)
(empty)
(empty)


workspace-write
powershell.exe …
3221225794 (0xC0000142)
(empty)
(empty)


workspace-write with explicit --write-sid / --temp-write-sid (the seam-managed shape DSH actually uses)
cmd.exe / powershell.exe
3221225794 (0xC0000142)
(empty)
(empty)



Two details that matter for triage:

stderr is empty — there is no windows-acl-run: <detail> line. Per the documented failure
contract, runner-side problems print that signature and exit 127. Here the runner exits
0xC0000142, i.e. it mirrored the child's exit code: token creation, spawn and the
seam contract all succeeded, and the child itself died during initialization.
The same failure occurs whether or not the --write-sid / --temp-write-sid pair is supplied
(self-managed DACL path and seam-managed path), so this is not specific to the grant
materialization path.

Expected result
workspace-write should spawn the child normally (as read-only does), with write access
confined to the workspace and the private temp directory.
Analysis / where to look
AclSandbox.init() (in the dsh-sandbox-windows-acl lib chunk, e.g. lib/types-*.js)
builds the restricted token like this:
const lowLabelSid = makeWellKnownSid(api, 66);   // Low integrity (S-1-16-4096)
const worldSid    = makeWellKnownSid(api, 1);    // Everyone
const logonSid    = findLogonSid(api, currentToken);

restrictedToken = createRestrictedToken(
  api, currentToken, logonSid,
  [this.writeSidPtr, this.tempWriteSidPtr].filter((s) => s !== undefined),
  { world: worldSid }, this.mode,
);
restrictTokenIntegrity(api, restrictedToken, lowLabelSid);
this.token = restrictedToken;
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken,
  this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid);
CreateRestrictedToken is called with flags 13 = DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE | LUA_TOKEN | WRITE_RESTRICTED.
The two modes differ in exactly two inputs:




Restricting SID list
Token DefaultDacl grantee




read-only ✅
[logonSid, world]
world (Everyone)


workspace-write ❌
[logonSid, world, workspaceSid, tempSid]
capability SID S-1-4-x-y



The only substantive delta is the capability SID (S-1-4-x-y, derived by workspaceWriteSid()
/ tempWriteSid()). Notably, a comment in this same module already documents 0xC0000142
as the symptom of a wrong restricting list:

"early DLL init dies with 0xC0000142 and CNG (\Device\CNG write trustee — pwsh crashes
0xE0434352) fails without them."

That supports reading this as a token-construction problem on this OS build, not an ACL
problem. Our best hypothesis (unverified — we cannot instrument the internals from the outside):
on Win10 19045, once a capability SID is placed in both the WRITE_RESTRICTED restricting
list and the token's default DACL, the child fails the write pass-2 check for objects it creates
during early startup, so ntdll's loader cannot complete and the process dies with
STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED.
Suggested bisection (all cheap and independent):

Under workspace-write, add world (Everyone) to the default-DACL grant in addition to
the capability SID — i.e. mirror read-only's grantee — and see whether the child starts.
This isolates "restricting list" from "default DACL".
Alternatively keep the default DACL identical between modes and vary only the restricting list
(capability SIDs present vs. absent) to see which one triggers the failure.
If a specific Win32 call is at fault, the most direct evidence would come from Procmon during
a failing spawn (filter on CreateFile / CreateEvent results with ACCESS DENIED in the
workspace-write child).

Secondary observation (product-level)
On win32, windows-acl is the sole candidate in the runner chain, so dsh-sandbox-local
never runs its functional probe (defaultProbeWindowsAcl exists but is only used for override
chains). As a result a broken rung degrades into "every shell command silently returns an opaque
NTSTATUS exit code" instead of a clear, actionable SandboxUnavailableError.
Suggestion: run the existing probe against the sole candidate as well (it costs one
cmd /c exit 0 in read-only mode at startup) and surface an explicit
"the Windows sandbox rung is unusable on this host" diagnostic. That would have turned this
investigation into a one-line error message.
Not the cause (already ruled out — please don't re-triage these)
These were all empirically checked on the affected machine:



Hypothesis
Check
Result




PowerShell 7 not installed
where /r whole disk, lstatSync over every candidate from candidatePwshPaths()
True (no pwsh.exe), but irrelevant — resolvePwshPath() correctly falls back to System32\...\v1.0\powershell.exe, which runs fine standalone (exit=0, stdout="hi")


Corrupt PATH / stray pwsh.exe alias
Replicated candidatePwshPaths() + lstatSync over all 32 candidates (lstat deliberately does not follow reparse points)
Exactly one candidate exists (Windows PowerShell 5.1). Resolution is correct


Broken PowerShell 5.1
Spawned directly
exit=0, works


Missing capability-SID ACEs on the workspace
icacls / Get-Acl on the workspace
ACEs are present and correct (S-1-4-466237911-403197689:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC) etc., matching the derived values)


Piped-stdio / anonymous-pipe creation
Notices in the code about pass-2 and default DACL
Not applicable here — failure occurs with stdio: "inherit" too



Workaround
Escalate the individual call to danger-full-access (unconfined). Verified working on the affected
host: the same command then returns exit=0. Switching the permission preset to
danger-full-access also works, but disables the file sandbox entirely, so it is only a
stopgap — not a fix.
Impact
Any Windows 10 (19045) install with the default workspace-write policy has no working shell
tool at all. Build, install, document-conversion and script tasks fail with an opaque exit code.
Our own project was blocked until we routed around the shell entirely.

中文版（摘要，便于内部沟通）
标题：[windows-acl] workspace-write 模式下所有子进程在 Windows 10 19045 上以 0xC0000142 死亡；read-only 正常
现象：Windows 10 Pro Build 19045 上，windows-acl 沙箱在 workspace-write 模式下
任何命令都失败——子进程在 DLL 初始化阶段死亡（0xC0000142 = STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED），
stdout/stderr 全空。同一 runner、同一工作区与临时目录，read-only 模式完全正常。
与 shell 无关：cmd.exe / powershell.exe / node.exe 三种子进程表现完全一致。
关键判据：stderr 为空、退出码是 0xC0000142 而不是 127，说明 runner 自身没报错
（runner 的失败契约是打印 windows-acl-run: <detail> 并退出 127），它是镜像了子进程的退出码
——令牌创建、spawn、seam 契约都成功了，死的是子进程本身。
带不带 --write-sid/--temp-write-sid（self-managed 与 seam-managed 两条路径）结果相同。
根因假设：AclSandbox.init() 中两种模式的令牌只有两处差异——限制 SID 列表，以及
TokenDefaultDacl 的授权对象：




限制 SID 列表
默认 DACL 授权对象




read-only ✅
[logonSid, world]
world（Everyone）


workspace-write ❌
[logonSid, world, 工作区SID, 临时SID]
能力 SID S-1-4-x-y



唯一实质差异是能力 SID。同模块注释已记载 0xC0000142 正是"限制列表不当"的已知症状码。
推测：Win10 19045 上，能力 SID 同时出现在 WRITE_RESTRICTED 限制列表与默认 DACL 后，
子进程对自身启动期创建的对象过不了 pass-2 检查 → ntdll 加载器无法完成 → DLL 初始化失败。
（此段为未验证假设）
建议的二分实验：① workspace-write 下在默认 DACL 中额外加入 world（对齐 read-only
的授权方式），看子进程能否启动——以此分离"限制列表"与"默认 DACL"两个变量；
② 只变限制列表、固定默认 DACL，复看是否触发。
产品层面建议：win32 上 windows-acl 是唯一候选，dsh-sandbox-local 因此从不跑
功能探针（defaultProbeWindowsAcl 只服务于 override 链）。于是一个坏掉的 rung 退化成
"每条 shell 命令都返回一个看不懂的 NTSTATUS 退出码"。建议对唯一候选也跑一次探针
（启动时 cmd /c exit 0，read-only 模式即可），把这种情况变成一条明确的
"本机 Windows 沙箱不可用"诊断——本次排查就能从几十步缩成一行报错。
已排除项（请勿重复排查）：pwsh 未安装（解析器正确回退 5.1，且 5.1 单独运行正常）、
PATH 污染（32 个候选逐条 lstatSync，解析正确）、PowerShell 损坏、
工作区缺能力 SID ACE（ACE 正常存在）。
绕行：单次调用升级到 danger-full-access（实测可用）；或切换权限预设
（代价是完全关闭文件沙箱）。二者都只是权宜，不是修复。
影响面：任何 Windows 10 19045 + 默认 workspace-write 策略的安装，
shell 工具完全不可用。

附：本机实测原始记录
OS: Microsoft Windows 10 专业版 | Build 19045 | Version 10.0.19045

T1 read-only      + cmd.exe            → exit=0         hex=0x0        stdout="hi\r\n"
T2 read-only      + powershell.exe     → exit=0         hex=0x0        stdout="hi\r\n"
T3 read-only      + node.exe           → exit=0         hex=0x0        stdout="hi from node\n"
T4 workspace-write + cmd.exe           → exit=3221225794 hex=0xC0000142 stdout="" stderr=""
T5 workspace-write + powershell.exe    → exit=3221225794 hex=0xC0000142 stdout="" stderr=""
T6 workspace-write + cmd.exe (seam-managed, explicit --write-sid/--temp-write-sid)
                                       → exit=3221225794 hex=0xC0000142 stdout="" stderr=""

DSH 工具层直接表现：pwsh({"command":"echo hi"}) → (no output) [exit code: 3221225794]

工作区 ACL（说明授权机制本身正常）：
  Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(S,DC)
  S-1-4-466237911-403197689:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)     ← 与 workspaceWriteSid() 推导值一致
  S-1-4-394286496-659018422:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
  Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)

threads.title: DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2 project install exits 1 with pnpm 11 and 12 (ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS for five build scripts, one of them DSH's own postinstall)
threads.bodyText:
Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2 from the npm registry, installed as a project dependency.
pnpm 10.28.1, 11.18.0 and 12.11.2, each installed with npm install --global --prefix <dir> pnpm@<version> into a fresh prefix. Every run used a fresh home directory, store and project, with no build policy configured beforehand.
The runs below: Linux x64 (Ubuntu 24.04), Node 25.9.0.
The same error also appears in our CI on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 (Node 22.23.3) and macOS 26 arm64 (Node 22.23.2): https://github.com/antst/dashi/actions/runs/38152725106, jobs install-layouts-linux / P-pnpm11, P-pnpm12 and their install-layouts-macos equivalents; the pnpm output is in each job's commands.log artifact. There the same pnpm add also names a second package that has no dependencies and no install scripts.

Steps
mkdir dsh-project && cd dsh-project
echo '{"private":true}' > package.json
pnpm add @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2
echo "exit=$?"
Observed
pnpm 10.28.1 exits 0 and prints a warning:
╭ Warning ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│                                                                              │
│   Ignored build scripts: @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.2.1-alpha.2,    │
│   @google/genai@2.21.0, koffi@3.1.1, node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15,                 │
│   protobufjs@7.6.6.                                                          │
│   Run "pnpm approve-builds" to pick which dependencies should be allowed     │
│   to run scripts.                                                            │
│                                                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

pnpm 11.18.0 exits 1:
[ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS] Ignored build scripts: @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.2.1-alpha.2, @google/genai@2.21.0, koffi@3.1.1, node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15, protobufjs@7.6.6

Run "pnpm approve-builds" to pick which dependencies should be allowed to run scripts.

pnpm 12.11.2 exits 1:
Error: ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS

  × adding a new package
  ╰─▶ Ignored build scripts: @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.2.1-alpha.2,
      @google/genai@2.21.0, koffi@3.1.1, node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15,
      protobufjs@7.6.6
  help: Run "pnpm approve-builds" to pick which dependencies should be allowed
        to run scripts.

In both failing cases the packages are downloaded and linked and package.json gains the dependency; the non-zero exit status is what stops a scripted install. With 11.18.0, pnpm exec dsh --version then fails with the same error until the builds are decided; with 12.11.2 it prints 0.2.1-alpha.2.
This is pnpm's documented default, not a pnpm defect: https://pnpm.io/settings/build#strictdepbuilds.
Declining all five lets the install finish
pnpm approve-builds '!@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local' '!@google/genai' '!koffi' '!node-pty' '!protobufjs'
pnpm add @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2     # exit 0 with 11.18.0 and with 12.11.2
pnpm exec dsh --version                      # 0.2.1-alpha.2
!name denies a build (https://pnpm.io/cli/approve-builds). pnpm records all five as false under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml, and none of the scripts runs.
What we checked with the scripts not run:

Linux x64, pnpm 11.18.0 and 12.11.2: node-pty loads its prebuilt prebuilds/linux-x64/pty.node and spawns a PTY; koffi 3.1.1 loads its prebuilt binary.
In the CI run linked above (Ubuntu 24.04 and macOS 26 arm64, pnpm 11.18.0 and 12.11.2, all five declined): DSH boots a profile and completes a turn replayed with @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-replay, in which the bash tool really runs a command and returns its output.
pnpm 10.28.1 does not run these scripts either (the warning above), and the same CI checks pass with it.

We did not test Windows, we did not test PTY-backed commands on macOS with the scripts not run, and we did not test approving and running the scripts.
What the five scripts do (read from the registry tarballs)



package
script
effect




@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.2.1-alpha.2
postinstall: node scripts/ensure-spawn-helper.mjs
chmod 0755 on node-pty's prebuilds/<platform>-<arch>/spawn-helper and build/Release/spawn-helper, when they exist


node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15
install: node scripts/prebuild.js || node-gyp rebuild; postinstall: node scripts/post-install.js
prebuild.js exits 0 when prebuilds/<platform>-<arch> exists (the tarball ships darwin, linux and win32 for x64 and arm64), otherwise node-gyp builds; post-install.js cleans build/Release and copies the conpty files on Windows


koffi@3.1.1
install: node ./cnoke.cjs -P . -D src/koffi --prebuild --release
tries to load the prebuilt binary from the optional @koromix/koffi-<platform> package and builds with CMake only if that fails


@google/genai@2.21.0
preinstall: echo 'preinstall: no-op'
nothing


protobufjs@7.6.6
postinstall: node scripts/postinstall
prints a warning when a dependent declares it with a different version-range prefix



Expected
A documented pnpm 11+ install path for DSH as a project dependency, and ideally no build decision required for DSH's own package.
Impact
pnpm add @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2 in a script or CI job fails with pnpm 11.18.0 and with 12.11.2 (the current latest), and the error does not tell the user whether DSH needs these scripts. Projects that embed DSH have to document the pnpm step themselves.
Suggestions

Drop the @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local postinstall, or do the chmod lazily before the first PTY spawn. Its header comment says it restores the executable bit of node-pty's prebuilt helper. node-pty@1.1.0 published prebuilds/darwin-*/spawn-helper as mode 0644 (see #2721); node-pty@1.2.0-beta.15, which DSH 0.2.1-alpha.2 pins, publishes both helpers as 0755 (tar tvzf on the registry tarballs), and a pnpm install on Linux keeps that mode. The Linux prebuilds contain no spawn-helper at all, so with a prebuild the script does nothing on Linux. Removing it takes DSH's own package off pnpm's list; the other four are third-party. As said above, we did not verify the macOS PTY path without the script.
Document the step next to "Run from npm" in the README (which today only shows npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web): with pnpm 11 or later, either pnpm approve-builds to review the five packages, or the decline command above. @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.2.0-rc.2 declares the same postinstall and the same node-pty and koffi pins, so we expect the same list there, but we only installed 0.2.1-alpha.2.

Related: #3370 (global install with --allow-build for the same five packages), #1245 (npm 12 skipping install scripts, at the time of node-pty@1.1.0), #3699 (allowBuilds placeholders after dsh plugin add).

threads.title: Sandbox unusable on Win11 build 26200: runtime LoadLibraryExW denied under restricted token (E_ACCESSDENIED 0x80070005)
threads.bodyText:
TL;DR
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl appears unusable on Windows 11 build 10.0.26200. Any child process spawned under the ACL restricted token dies at runtime library load with E_ACCESSDENIED (0x80070005):

processes that only load image dependencies at startup survive (cmd.exe, icacls.exe);
processes that load libraries at runtime all fail (pwsh -> hostfxr.dll, Windows PowerShell 5.1 -> CLR init, node -> CNG).

Consequences on this machine: the pwsh terminal tool cannot start at all (surfaces as PTY shell exited during startup), and every sandboxed one-shot bash/node/python call fails too. In-process file tools still work, which made this hard to spot.
I ran a controlled experiment matrix - 8 variables (ConPTY vs plain pipes, integrity level, token flags 8/9/12/13, token default DACL, restricting SID list, icacls /reset after robocopying the tree, target location, transport method). None of them change the outcome, which points at a kernel-level rule rather than any policy knob.
Full report attached (DIAGNOSIS.md); the re-runnable drivers are matrix.js, variant.js and pty-driver.js.
Two specific things worth a look:

dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/README.md line 189 - the "objects another AppContainer-based tool has ACL'd with a package SID" exception appears wider than documented on this machine: it reaches ordinary Program Files and user directories, and clearing ACEs with icacls /reset does not lift it.
The source comment above createRestrictedToken in acl-types.js claims this design was "verified on Win11 26200". Here the keep-alive group is verifiably in place, the build is 26200, and runtime DLL init plus CNG still fail.

I cannot localize the responsible kernel rule from userspace (needs a kernel debugger or ETW), but for affected users the outcome is the same: the sandbox cannot be used.

中文摘要
Windows 11 build 10.0.26200 上，被 @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl 的受限令牌启动的子进程无法在运行期加载库：LoadLibraryExW 返回 E_ACCESSDENIED (0x80070005)。

cmd.exe / icacls.exe（只在启动期加载映像依赖）正常；
pwsh / Windows PowerShell 5.1 / node（需要运行期加载托管运行时或 CNG）全部失败；
与目标文件 ACL、完整性级别、令牌标志、令牌默认 DACL、restricting 列表、目标位置均无关。

后果：该沙箱在本机完全不可用，任何被它包装的子进程都起不来（终端工具直接不可用）。

Environment









OS
Windows 11, build 10.0.26200


Host
DeepSeek Harness desktop app, dsh 0.2.0-rc.2


@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl
0.0.1-rc.1


@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash
0.0.1-rc.3


@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local
0.2.0-rc.2


node-pty
1.2.0-beta.15



Symptom
Any sandboxed pwsh invocation dies during startup. Exact stderr:
Failed to load [C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\hostfxr.dll], HRESULT: 0x80070005
The library hostfxr.dll was found, but loading it from C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\hostfxr.dll failed
exit = 0x80008082

At the tool layer this surfaces as PTY shell exited during startup (terminal-bash.js: waitReason === "session_exit"), which is misleading - the PTY itself is fine.
Minimal reproduction
On build 26200, launch a child process under the ACL restricted token this package uses (token flags 13, keep-alive restricting group [logon SID, Everyone]), then have it call LoadLibraryExW at runtime:

startup-time image dependency loading -> OK (cmd.exe, icacls.exe survive)
runtime library load -> E_ACCESSDENIED (0x80070005)

Additional failures observed, same root cause:



Process
Failure




pwsh
hostfxr.dll load denied, exit = 0x80008082


Windows PowerShell 5.1
CLR init, exit = 0xffff0000


node
CNG / CSPRNG assertion



Ruled out (all measured on this machine; no effect on the outcome)



Variable
Result




ConPTY vs plain pipes (no PTY at all)
both fail identically


Sandbox-wrapped cmd.exe inside ConPTY
exits 0 - so this is not a PTY/handoff problem


Integrity level (Low)
no change


Token flags (8 / 9 / 12 / 13)
no change


Token default DACL (incl. explicit Everyone)
no change


Restricting SID list + BUILTIN\Users
no change


robocopy the whole PowerShell tree to a user directory + icacls /reset (clearing package-SID ACEs)
no change


Target location, transport method
no change



Every policy-level knob was varied without effect, so the denial appears to come from a kernel-level rule specific to this machine - consistent with the class your README already flags as unconfirmed.
Blast radius
Not limited to terminals. Any child process spawned under this sandbox that loads libraries at runtime fails: sandboxed pwsh terminals, plus one-shot bash/node/python calls routed through ctx.sandboxPolicy. In-process file tools (which spawn no children) still appear to work, which made this hard to spot.
Two documentation / assumption points worth a look
1. dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/README.md line 189 (the "objects another AppContainer-based tool has ACL'd with a package SID ... the kernel rule is unconfirmed" entry). Here the effect is wider than described: it reaches ordinary Program Files and user directories, and clearing ACEs with icacls /reset does not lift it.
2. The source comment above createRestrictedToken in acl-types.js claims the keep-alive group design was "verified on Win11 26200":

The logon SID + EVERYONE keep-alive group is shared by both modes: early DLL init dies with 0xC0000142 and CNG fails without them.

That premise does not hold here. The keep-alive group was verifiably in place (workspace-write = [logonSid, Everyone, workspaceSid, tempSid], checked item by item against source), the build is 26200, and runtime DLL init plus CNG still fail.
Honest boundary
I can prove this is none of the configurable knobs listed above. I cannot localize which kernel rule is responsible from userspace - that needs a kernel debugger or ETW tracing. For affected users the distinction does not change the outcome: the sandbox is unusable on such a machine.
Workaround we used
Ran the profile with danger-full-access, which bypasses the provider entirely (spawnArgv: if (policy.mode === "danger-full-access") return argv).
Related observation worth a separate look: sandbox-policy.mode and approval.policy must be changed as a pair. Changing only sandbox-policy.mode composes {danger-full-access, ask}, which matches no preset, so dsh-permission-presets throws and Cordis then silently isolates the plugin - no /permission command, no composer permission control, and no log line anywhere. That failure mode is very hard to diagnose.
Attachments

DIAGNOSIS.md - full report: error text, experiment matrix, timeline, exact commands
matrix.js, variant.js - experiment matrix and variant driver (re-runnable)
pty-driver.js - standalone ConPTY + restricted-token driver used for the minimal repro
DIAGNOSIS.md
matrix.js
pty-driver.js
variant.js
