threads.title: [BUG] Windows：文件「打开方式」把列表第一项标成默认，认不出商店应用的真实默认程序
threads.bodyText:
环境

OS：Windows 11 x64
安装资源时间戳：2026-10-17（桌面端 app.asar）
相关包：dsh-native-command、dsh-client-ui-open-in-app
运行时代码：dsh-native-command/lib/index.js 里嵌的 DshFileAssociations.List

现象
文件卡片和文档预览的「打开」分体按钮，把列表第一项标成默认，而不是 Windows 当前的默认应用。
本机 .mp3、.mp4、.wav 的用户默认程序都是「媒体播放器」（Microsoft.ZuneMusic）。DSH 里：

.mp4 主按钮是「用 照片 打开」，菜单第一项为「照片（默认）」
.mp3 主按钮是「用 Microsoft Clipchamp 打开」
「媒体播放器」在菜单里，但没有被标成默认

重新打开卡片、重启进程都会再查一次系统，结果不变。这不是缓存没刷新，而是每次都没把真正的默认程序认出来。
和 #9790 不是同一个问题。#9790 说的是菜单用 SHAssocEnumHandlers(..., 0) 把全部注册处理器都列出来了。这里说的是：在这份列表里，哪一项被标成「默认」。
原因
List 只在 GetName() 等于下面两个值时把 default 设为 true：

AssocQueryString 种类 2（ASSOCSTR_EXECUTABLE）
种类 21（ASSOCSTR_APPID）

本机这三种扩展名的查询结果：



查询
结果




种类 2 可执行文件
空。商店应用没有 exe


种类 20 ProgId
AppXqj98qxeaynz6dv4459ayz6bnqxbyaqcs


种类 21 应用 ID
Microsoft.ZuneMusic_8wekyb3d8bbwe!Microsoft.ZuneMusic


种类 4 显示名
媒体播放器



UserChoice 的 ProgId 也是 AppXqj98qxeaynz6dv4459ayz6bnqxbyaqcs，对应应用名是「媒体播放器」。
但 SHAssocEnumHandlers 对商店应用的 GetName() / GetUIName() 返回的是显示名，不是应用 ID：

.mp4：照片、Microsoft Clipchamp、媒体播放器，然后才是记事本、VS Code、Word 的 exe 路径
.mp3：第一项是 Microsoft Clipchamp，其后是 媒体播放器

应用 ID 和显示名对不上，于是没有任何一项 default == true。
界面接着用了兜底（OpenTargetButton）：
applications.find((app) => app.id === defaultId) ?? applications[0]
找不到 defaultId 就用列表第一项，并标上「（默认）」。所以 .mp4 变成照片，.mp3 变成 Clipchamp。
IAssocHandler::IsRecommended() 不能用来判断默认。本机上照片、Clipchamp、媒体播放器都返回 0，记事本、VS Code、Word 反而返回 1。
期望
主按钮和「（默认）」标记应该落在 Windows 当前的默认应用上。本机应为「媒体播放器」。
建议在 DshFileAssociations.List 里：

继续用种类 2 和种类 21 做标识比较，并加上种类 20（ProgId）。
标识都对不上时，再用种类 4 的显示名和 GetUIName() / GetName() 比较。商店应用走这条才能命中。
有标识命中时不要再用显示名命中别的项。多项命中时只保留一项。
仍然没有任何命中时，第一项可以继续当主按钮，但不要标成「（默认）」。

请不要把 #9790 的修法（把枚举过滤从 0 改成 ASSOC_FILTER_RECOMMENDED）当作这个问题的修复。推荐集和用户默认不是一回事，而且 #9790 已经说明：推荐集为空时菜单会退化。

threads.title: HMR profile recomposition leaves Desktop with no active "sessionController" — all session RPCs fail with gateway/service-unavailable until app restart
threads.bodyText:
Posting this in Discussions because GitHub Issues are disabled for this repository.

Environment

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (app + bundled runtime), macOS 15.7.3 (24G419), arm64
Profile: desktop (bundles: dsh-base, dsh-web-app, plus several third-party/local plugin bundles)
HMR enabled (default from dsh-base: disabled: !!js "!ctx.get('profileContext')")

Summary
While a session is running, editing ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml triggers the expected HMR profile
recomposition: the running turn is aborted with {"kind":"aborted","reason":{"kind":"disposed"}}
about 2 s after the write (the HMR awaitWriteFinish window). But the recomposition does not
end in a usable state: the typert gateway stays up while no active sessionController service is
registered, so every session/create and session/prompt call keeps failing with
gateway/service-unavailable until the app is restarted. The exact same config boots fine on a
cold start.
Steps to reproduce (observed twice, 2026-10-19)

Open Desktop, start a session, send a prompt.
While it is running, edit ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml (first occurrence: add a
session-query-sqlite override; second occurrence: remove it — i.e. any write is enough).
~2 s later the running turn is aborted with reason disposed.
Try to create a session or send a prompt → errors below, repeatedly, until the app is restarted.
(Observed continuously for ~6 minutes in the first occurrence.)
Restart the app → everything works and the new config applies normally.

Errors
typert gateway: session/create: active Service "sessionController" is unavailable (gateway/service-unavailable)
typert gateway: session/prompt: active Service "sessionController" is unavailable (gateway/service-unavailable)



Evidence (redacted structural records from session logs)
13:24:21.0  edit ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml (file mtime 13:24:21)
13:24:23.4  turn/end  {"kind":"aborted","reason":{"kind":"disposed"}}
13:24:23 → 13:30:19  every session/create + session/prompt fails with
                     active Service "sessionController" is unavailable
13:30:19    old app process exits; 13:30:50 new process starts
13:33:11    (after restart) the new config takes effect normally
# second occurrence: same pattern, and it aborted ALL running sessions at once
13:39:40.1  edit ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml (rollback of the change)
13:39:42.6  two different running sessions' turns both aborted with reason "disposed"
13:41:06    app restarted again

Expected vs actual

Expected: after a profile recomposition either the new generation serves sessions, or the change
is reported as "restart required" (v0.2.1-rc.1 release notes: hot-reloadable plugins apply
directly, non-hot-reloadable ones prompt for a restart).
Actual: the whole plugin tree is recomposed (all running sessions die), the typert gateway remains
active, sessionController never (re)registers, there is no prompt/rollback, and the only
recovery is a full app restart. Desktop does not persist host-side logs, so users cannot see
which entry failed to activate.

Notes / hypotheses

typert-gateway (dsh-base) and session-controller (dsh-web-app) are rows of the same recomposed
tree; after recomposition the gateway is active but sessionController is not. This looks like the
in-place recompose failing to activate the session-controller entry, combined with the documented
failure policy (dsh-hmr README: after eviction, a replacement that fails to import/start is an
activation failure; the operation fails and its old code no longer runs).
The profile also contains third-party/local plugin bundles. We could not exclude them as the
activation-failure trigger, because host-side logs are not persisted.
A clean-profile repro (official bundles only, no third-party plugins) has not been done yet.

Asks

Is leaving the app without an active sessionController after an HMR recomposition intended
behavior, or a bug in the recompose/activation-failure path?
Could Desktop persist host-side logs (or expose diagnostics) so users can identify which entry
failed to activate?
Could home-patch edits be treated as "restart required", or the previous generation be restored
on activation failure, instead of leaving the tree partially active?
Any recommended workaround besides disabling HMR (- id: hmr / disabled: true) in the profile
patch?

Workaround we are using
Disabling HMR in the desktop profile patch, so patch edits simply require an app restart
(- id: hmr + disabled: true).

threads.title: [BUG] workspace-write 沙箱下所有子进程都以 0xC0000142 失败（含 cmd.exe）
threads.bodyText:
题：[Windows] workspace-write 沙箱下所有子进程都以 0xC0000142 失败（含 cmd.exe）
一、摘要
在 Windows 11 build 26200 上，workspace-write 模式下的 ACL 受限令牌沙箱无法启动任何子进程：每个子进程都在 DLL 初始化阶段以 0xC0000142（STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）死亡。同一台机器、同一工作区、同一个可执行文件，在 read-only 模式下完全正常。
用户可见的症状是 pwsh 工具对任何命令都返回空输出加 exit code 3221225794。这个故障与 PowerShell 无关——cmd.exe 以完全相同的方式失败。
二、复现步骤
方式一：通过 DSH（用户实际遇到的路径）

把会话的沙箱模式设为 workspace-write。
调用 pwsh 工具，命令内容任意，例如输出一行 ping。
同一会话切到 danger-full-access 后，同一条调用立即成功，说明执行器、pwshPath 解析和 PowerShell 安装本身都没有问题。

方式二：直接调用 runner（最小复现，不需要 DSH 会话）
runner 自己创建受限令牌，因此在 DSH 会话之外也能复现。以下命令在 PowerShell 中执行：
$exe    = 'C:...\DeepSeek Harness.exe'   # 需要 asar 感知的模块解析
$runner = 'C:...\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js'
$ws     = 'C:\Users\me\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace'
$tmp    = 'C:\Users\me\AppData\Local\Temp'
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
# read-only：正常
& $exe $runner --workspace $ws --temp $tmp --mode read-only -- cmd.exe /c "echo OK"
# 结果 exit 0，输出 OK
# workspace-write：子进程还没开始跑就死了
& $exe $runner --workspace $ws --temp $tmp --mode workspace-write -- cmd.exe /c "echo OK"
# 结果 exit -1073741502（即 0xC0000142），无任何输出
三、实际结果
模式            子进程                          结果
read-only       cmd.exe /c "echo PROBE-OK"     exit 0，输出 PROBE-OK
read-only       pwsh.exe (7.6.7)                启动成功；后续仅报 ConstrainedLanguage 错误
read-only       powershell.exe (5.1)            启动成功；同样只报 ConstrainedLanguage
workspace-write cmd.exe                         失败，exit -1073741502 / 0xC0000142，无输出
workspace-write pwsh.exe                        失败，exit -1073741502 / 0xC0000142，无输出
两种 workspace-write 变体都测了以下组合，四种组合全部以同样方式失败，因此不是早期授权残留导致的：

workspace 指向真实工作区（...\default-workspace）
workspace 指向一个全新的空目录（不带任何 ACE）
temp 指向 %TEMP%
temp 指向一个全新空目录
已排除的可能：


PowerShell 安装 / pwshPath。read-only 能在同一工作区启动同一个 pwsh.exe。
windowsHide / CREATE_NO_WINDOW。在普通令牌下用 ProcessStartInfo.CreateNoWindow = true、UseShellExecute = false、重定向 stdio 启动 pwsh.exe，exit 0 且正常输出。窗口标志本身不是触发条件。
可执行文件权限。pwsh.exe 及其 DLL 授予的是 SYSTEM、Administrators、Users、ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES 的 (RX)，没有 Everyone。但 read-only（其 restricting list 含 Everyone）能启动同一目录下的同一二进制，而 workspace-write（同样含 Everyone）不能，可执行文件 DACL 不是差异点。
参数校验。故意传入不匹配的 SID 会被干净拒绝：windows-acl-run: --write-sid does not match --workspace，exit 127。参数解析与 SID 与路径的校验工作正常。
DSH 宿主进程。直接调用 runner.js、不经任何 DSH 会话也能复现。

宿主机工作区当前的安全描述符，供参考：
Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(DC)
S-1-4-558760496-443788980:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
MININT-D4NGPV1\huangzhichen:(I)(OI)(CI)(F)
Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)

四、期望结果
workspace-write 模式下子进程应当正常启动，仅把写入与删除限制在工作区和私有临时目录内。目前 cmd.exe 这类系统自带程序都无法启动，说明失败发生在子进程自身代码之前。
五、环境
操作系统：Microsoft Windows 11 家庭版，版本 10.0.26200，Build 26200
DSH：0.2.1-rc.2（桌面版，resources/app.asar）
相关包：@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox、dsh-sandbox-local、dsh-sandbox-windows-acl，均为 0.2.1-rc.2
Shell：PowerShell 7.6.7（C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe），经 pwsh-sandbox.config.pwshPath 指定
令牌：交互式登录，已提权（High integrity），属于 BUILTIN\Administrators
六、分析线索
createRestrictedToken() 构造的 restricting list 是：
read-only：       [logonSid, world]
workspace-write： [logonSid, world, ...writeSids]

源码注释明确写到 logonSid + Everyone 这对 keep-alive 组在两种模式都必须存在，缺少它会导致 early DLL init dies with 0xC0000142。两种模式都带了该组，却只有 workspace-write 失败，所以触发点在 workspace-write 额外加入的部分：

追加到 restricting list 的 capability SID（S-1-4-*）；
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(..., tempWriteSidPtr ?? writeSidPtr ?? worldSid) —— 在 workspace-write 下这里写入的是 capability SID，而 read-only 回退到 worldSid（Everyone）。

失败发生在任何子进程代码执行之前（连 cmd.exe /c echo 都没有输出），与进程或令牌级初始化失败一致，而不是子进程自身的启动问题。一种合理推测是：默认 DACL 中的 capability SID 无法满足 Windows 在进程启动期间创建对象时的 pass-2 检查（与 setTokenDefaultDaclGrant 注释里描述的匿名管道问题同类）。但我没能定位是这两个改动中的哪一个造成的——这需要在 createRestrictedToken 与 setTokenDefaultDaclGrant 内部加埋点。
七、影响
在这台机器上，默认预设 workspace-write 完全无法执行任何命令。用户唯一可用的变通是把会话切到 danger-full-access，也就是彻底放弃写入隔离。对配置相近的 Windows 11 环境来说，这是一个与安全相关的回归。
八、建议的排查方向

在 createRestrictedToken 与 setTokenDefaultDaclGrant 加埋点，记录失败启动的确切 Win32 状态。
分别尝试 restricting list 带 capability SID 加默认 DACL 用 worldSid，以及反过来，以隔离两个变量。
确认 build 26200 相对其前代是否改变了 Low 完整性写受限令牌下 DLL 初始化的行为——源码注释标注的是 verified on Win11 26200，而这正是当前失败的版本。

threads.title: Deleting an attachment object permanently bricks the session (ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND is not degraded)
[Bug] ask_user_question 长内容时选项不可见，只能关面板放弃选择（0.2.1-rc.2）
threads.bodyText:
问题
ask_user_question 在 question 或选项描述较长时，选项区会被正文挤出视口
（没有固定底栏、没有独立滚动区），面板看起来正常打开却点不到任何选项。
请帮忙确认：这是使用方式/配置问题，还是界面缺陷？
按我的观察是后者。补充背景：本仓库 Issues 已关闭，所以发在 Q&A；
如果应该转到内部跟踪，或另有反馈渠道，请指路。
TL;DR
question 或 options[].description 较长时，选项被推到可视区域之外；
唯一可行的操作是关闭面板，然后在输入框用自然语言重述需求 ——
这次工具调用提供的结构化选项完全没被使用。
为什么我认为这不是纯样式问题

失败是静默的：没有报错、没有降级提示，面板照常弹出。
用户第一反应是"我是不是漏看了"，而不是"这是 bug" —— 这类缺陷内部自测极难发现，也不产生日志。
存在安全隐患：用户关掉面板后通常只在输入栏补一句话，模型容易按"默认分支"继续执行。
对会执行破坏性操作（删文件、改配置、commit、部署、调外部接口）的 agent，
"确认环节被静默跳过"比慢一点严重得多。
确认机制本身退化：本意是把歧义收敛成有限分支，实际变成
"模型输出一大段 + 用户手打回复"，多一轮往返，用户在重述时还容易漏分支。
会训练用户规避该工具：反复遇到后，用户会要求模型"别用 ask_user_question，直接给编号选项"，
这等于让这个能力在长上下文场景下失效。
触发门槛不高：不需要极端内容，中等长度 + 笔记本分辨率（1366×768 / 100%）就会触发。

环境

DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.2（Windows x64），内嵌 Web GUI（127.0.0.1:xxxx）
模型：deepseek-flash（前端布局问题，应与其他模型无关）
窗口约 ______ × ______，缩放 ______%
工具入参：questions[] / header / question / options[]{label, description} / multi_select

现象

question 较长，或选项数多、每个 description 较长时，选项区被推到视口外，
或压缩成极窄一条，不可点击。
正文与选项共用同一滚动容器，没有"选项固定在下部"的布局；
往下读正文时选项被一起带出视口，面板也没有独立滚动条。
面板内没有可见的"跳过 / 自定义回答"兜底入口。
用户只能点关闭（×）再在输入栏重述 —— 也就是
用户宁可"跳过"也不愿在看不见的选项里盲选，而"跳过"之后这次提问的上下文就丢了。

最小复现

让模型发出如下形状的调用（question ≈ 300+ 字，6 个选项，description 各 60–100 字）：

{
  "questions": [{

threads.title: [BUG-Windows] 非 C: 盘 cwd 无法加载 koffi.node / koffi.node fails to load when cwd is not on C:
threads.bodyText:
环境

deepseek-harness-sdk==0.2.1rc2、deepseek-harness-runtime-bin==0.2.1rc2
Windows 11 x64，Python 3.13
使用内置单文件 runtime：deepseek-harness-sdk-runtime-win-x64.exe

现象
DeepSeekHarness(cwd=...) 指向非 C: 盘目录时，每一轮都会以 finish_reason="error" 结束，没有任何回复。turn/end 事件内容如下：
{"reason": {"kind": "error", "error": {"code": "UNKNOWN",
  "message": "The specified module could not be found.\r\n\\\\?\\D:\\snapshot\\node\\node_modules\\@koromix\\koffi-win32-x64\\win32_x64\\koffi.node"}}}
另外，失败后会留下一个空的会话目录 sessions/<group>/<session_id>/。
复现
from deepseek_harness import DeepSeekHarness

with DeepSeekHarness(dsh_home=r"D:\tmp\home", cwd=r"D:\tmp\ws",
                     base_url=..., api_key=..., model="deepseek-v4-flash") as h:
    r = h.start_session("s1").run("hello")
    print(r.finish_reason)  # "error"

把同样的代码放到 C: 盘目录下，结果为 completed。
在 D: 盘上只做简单问答时也会触发（runtime 挂载了 MCP 插件）。

原因分析
runtime 的 VFS prelude 只认以下 snapshot 前缀：
var SNAPSHOT_PREFIXES_WIN = [
  { prefix: "V:\\snapshot", sep: "\\" }, { prefix: "V:/snapshot", sep: "/" },
  { prefix: "C:\\snapshot", sep: "\\" }, { prefix: "C:/snapshot", sep: "/" }
];

toPlatformPath() 也是写死 "C:" + p。
SDK 默认用 cwd 作为子进程 cwd。进程 cwd 在 D: 盘时，/snapshot/... 被解析成 D:\snapshot\...。
这个路径不被 insideSnapshot() 识别，原生模块没有从 VFS 中取出，LoadLibrary 因此失败。

临时规避
传入 runtime_cwd="C:\\"，Session 工作目录仍由 cwd 指定。用这个办法后，首轮、工具调用和 resume_session 都正常。
建议

按当前进程盘符判断 snapshot 前缀，或者统一按"盘符无关"的方式匹配 ?:\snapshot。
turn 在会话记录写入前失败时，不要留下空会话目录，或者让 resume_session 能区分这种情况。

threads.title: `Error: cannot get required service "sessionProjections" in inactive context` after running several tasks
threads.bodyText:
Here comes a fatal problem to me. Have other users found similiar problems? The issue is summarized by DSH.
Bug: Error: cannot get required service "sessionProjections" in inactive context after running several tasks
环境 / Environment

DSH 版本: 0.2.1-rc.2（@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime，见 package.json 的 version 字段，所有 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* / @deepseek-ai/cordis 依赖均为该 RC 版本）
受影响包:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop 0.2.1-rc.2
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection 0.2.1-rc.2
@deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.5（vendor，反射/注入层）


平台: Windows 11 / Electron（resources/app.asar 打包）
复现概率: 跑多个任务（多个 subagent / background job / 长时 agent 运行）后，短时间（"不久"）内必然出现，且会蔓延到该会话的所有工具调用（包括 read/bash/glob/working_directory），导致整个会话瘫痪，只能靠新建会话恢复 active context。

复现步骤 / Reproduction


在 DSH 中连续发起多个并行/串行任务（subagent、background job、workflow 等）。


让部分任务（子 agent / scope）完成并进入 teardown，同时其他任务继续运行，制造频繁的 scope 创建 / 销毁。


观察数分钟到数十分钟后，随机一次工具调用或 loop 内部访问抛：
Error: cannot get required service "sessionProjections" in inactive context



此后该会话的所有工具调用持续返回同一错误，直到新建会话。



实测佐证：报告撰写者的 agent 会话本身就现场复现过——上一轮会话所有工具（含 working_directory）均返回同一条错误，新建 active 会话后立即恢复正常，可直接读取源码，证明这是"失效 context"问题而非用户任务逻辑。

错误源码定位 / Root-cause source trace
1. 错误抛出点（Cordis 反射/注入层）
jsonl/lib/worker.cjs（即 vendor/cordis/src/reflect.ts 的编译产物）：
// worker.cjs:2442-2444  ReflectService.handler.get
if (prop in fiber.inject) {
  error.message = `cannot get required service "${prop}" in inactive context`;
  throw error;
}
含义：组件在 inject 中声明了 sessionProjections，但读取时所在的 fiber / context 已被 dispose（状态 INACTIVE/__INACTIVE__，见 worker.cjs:1963、_setEpoch(INACTIVE)）。 Cordis 会沿父级 fiber 向上查找，但路径上第一个命中 inject 且已 inactive 的就直接抛错，不会回落到仍存活的父级运行时。相关常量：INACTIVE_EFFECT（worker.cjs:1961）、INACTIVE = "__INACTIVE__"（worker.cjs:1963）。
2. 服务定义
@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-projection/lib/index.js：SessionProjectionRegistry extends Service，以 super(ctx, "sessionProjections") 注册在根 app 上下文，承载每会话的投影状态（inbox、turnBoundary、runtimeContext 等），通过 session/event 订阅做 eager drive。
3. 触发点（消费方）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js：

每个 agent / 子任务 createScope(loopCtx, this) 建子 scope 上下文，this.ctx = this.scope.ctx（:778-779）。
大量通过 this.ctx.sessionProjections 访问投影服务（绑定在子 scope 上）：

new ReactLoopInbox(this.ctx.sessionProjections, session, this.dispatch)（:780）
this.loopCtx.sessionProjections.stateOf(session, "turnBoundary")（:782）
注册投影：ctx.effect(function*(){ const unregisterTurnBoundary = ctx.sessionProjections.register(...); ... })（:1580-1589），disposer 绑在 fiber 上。


当任务完成 / 子 agent 结束 / scope 回收时，该 scope 的 fiber runtime 进入 inactive。

根因：scope 被 dispose 之后，仍有延迟执行逻辑（inbox 变更、turnBoundary 更新、change-feed 监听回调、ownership teardown 回调等）继续用 this.ctx.sessionProjections（已死 scope）去读投影服务。第一次在 dispose 后触发的访问即抛 "in inactive context"。任务越多、scope 生灭越频繁，撞上失效访问的概率越高 → "跑一阵就全挂"。
佐证：同文件 ReactLoopInbox.current() 已写过正确的同类守卫
if (state === void 0) throw new Error(`agent "${this.session.id}" cannot read inbox state: its projection registration is not active`);
且多处已有 if (!this.ownership.isActive()) return;（:1625/:1643/:1651/:2009）的 active 守卫惯例——但投影访问路径未全覆盖。
建议修复 / Suggested fixes
临时规避（用户侧）

会话卡死时新建会话恢复 active context（最有效）。
降低并发：maxParallelToolCalls 默认 10（:1554），压低并行 subagent / background job 数量。
任务结束前 job_kill 或等子任务回写完成，避免它们在会话失活后回碰会话级服务。
关注是否有更新的 build（当前为 RC）。

代码层根治（维护者侧，按优先级）

投影访问绑定活根上下文：延迟回调 / teardown / ReactLoopInbox 调用时不要持有 this.ctx.sessionProjections（子 scope，随 dispose 失效），改为捕获并保持 this.loopCtx.sessionProjections（根/loop 上下文，不受子 scope dispose 影响）。
所有延迟 / teardown 访问前加 active 守卫：对齐既有 if (!this.ownership.isActive()) return; / 检查 fiber.runtime，把失效访问在用户态短路，而非交给 Cordis 抛底层错。
监听器随 scope 注销：SessionProjectionRegistry.listeners（全局 Set）注册了 change-feed 监听的 scope 一旦 dispose，其回调若仍引用失效 session/scope 会回调进死 ctx；确保 scope 卸载时从 listeners 移除回调。
注册 disposer 收尾幂等 + 读取侧安全降级：ctx.effect 中 unregisterInbox/TurnBoundary（:1585-1588）在 scope dispose 后才执行，期间其他组件读该 key 会命中 "registration not active"；让 stateOf / 读取侧在注册已卸时安全降级（参考既有 state === void 0 守卫），而非抛错中断整个 loop。
（框架层，谨慎） 可在 ReflectService.handler.get 中，当本 fiber inactive 但父级仍有 live 运行时提供该服务时回落到父级——会改变注入语义，风险高，优先在用法侧（1–4）修。

补充 / Notes

源码取自本地 unpacked 副本：C:/Users/15940/Documents/deepseek-harness/default-workspace/_work/pkg/（dsh-agent-loop、dsh-session-projection、jsonl 等），与 resources/app.asar 内 0.2.1-rc.2 一致。
该错误类（inactive context）一旦发生会阻塞整个会话的全部工具调用，建议作为**阻断级（blocker）**问题处理，而非普通 bug。

threads.title: [Bug] 5-min /compact cancel on v0.2.1-rc.2 — streamIdleTimeoutMs patch not applied (regression)
threads.bodyText:
Environment
DSH: dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2 (regression) — works on dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2
OS: Windows 11, Node.js 24.x
Engine: Local Strata v0.1.41 (llama.cpp-based, OpenAI-compatible)
Patch (in ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml):
yaml

id: llm-pi-ai
name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
config:
providers:
strata:
api: openai-responses
baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
streamIdleTimeoutMs: 3600000   # 1 hour — DOES NOT TAKE EFFECT
timeoutMs: 3600000             # 1 hour — DOES NOT TAKE EFFECT
models: [...]
id: llm-deepseek
name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek-api-key"
config:
streamIdleTimeoutMs: 3600000       # 1 hour — DOES NOT TAKE EFFECT
timeoutMs: 3600000                 # 1 hour — DOES NOT TAKE EFFECT
models: [...]
Related to discussion #3157 — but the dsh-fetch-timeouts / dsh-undici-timeout-fix plugins solve the Node-undici 5-min body timeout, not this streamIdleTimeoutMs / idleWatchdog 5-min timeout. Both timeouts are independent and need fixing.

Summary
/compact against a long session (≥130k tokens) is cancelled at exactly 5:00–5:20 min with (disconnect, cancel=True) on the Strata engine, even though streamIdleTimeoutMs: 3600000 is set. The patch value is silently ignored — the default 3e5 (300,000 ms / 5 min) wins. 3 /compact attempts are required for one summary to land.
Reproduction
Fresh DSH install on dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2
Local Strata engine on
http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
cordis.patch.yml as above
Restart DSH
Trigger /compact on any session whose compacted prompt is ≥130,000 tokens
Engine log shows: prefill running for ~5 min, then (disconnect, cancel=True) with 0 generated tokens
Trigger again: same 5-min cancel
Trigger a 3rd time: completes in <90 s (engine KV cache hot from previous attempts)
Engine log:
代码块
L8228: prompt 116026 tokens = 0 reused + 116026 read in 267625 ms (4.46 min),
1088 generated in 37361 ms (29.1 tok/s)          ← engine kept running 8s after DSH closed
L8234: prompt 116026 tokens = 116019 reused + 7 read in 111 ms (0.00 min),
4200 generated in 132854 ms (31.6 tok/s)         ← 3rd attempt: 90%+ cache hit
Expected behavior
streamIdleTimeoutMs: 3600000 is documented in @deepseek-ai/dsh-timeout (idleWatchdog(upstream, timeoutMs, code)). Per the dsh-fetch-timeouts README, the user-supplied patch value should propagate to profile.streamIdleTimeoutMs in llm-pi-ai, which feeds idleWatchdog(upstream, streamIdleTimeoutMs, 'LLM_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT') in prepareCall. Setting it to 1 hour should mean the watchdog waits 1 hour before throwing LlmError('pi-ai stream idle timeout after 3600000ms', 'TIMEOUT'). The 5-min cancel indicates the watchdog is being armed with the default 3e5 (300,000 ms) instead.
Actual behavior
The 5-min cancel is the default streamIdleTimeoutMs: 3e5 value. The patch's streamIdleTimeoutMs: 3600000 is not applied to the resolved provider profile for either llm-pi-ai (strata) or llm-deepseek (deepseek-flash).
Regression analysis: v0.2.0-rc.2 → v0.2.1-rc.2
This is a regression in 0.2.1-rc.2 caused by the net effect of two simultaneous changes:
Change 1: dsh-timeout's idleWatchdog.next now actively throws on idle (a fix)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-timeout/src/index.ts (git tree SHA c69d539ce... → 16b74e94...):
v0.2.0: await iterator.next() — the timer only aborts the signal; if the iterator ignores the abort, no error propagates
v0.2.1: Promise.race([iterator.next(), expired.promise]) — when the timer fires it expired.reject(reason), so the next-call immediately throws TimeoutReason even if the iterator never settles
Change 2: llm-pi-ai's adapter.ts removed the in-loop timeoutOf check
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts (git tree SHA de9f3e0e... → a912fff6...):
ts
// v0.2.0
const result = await watchdog.next(iterator)
const timeout = timeoutOf(watchdog.signal, 'LLM_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT')
if (timeout !== undefined) throw timeout   // ← in-loop check (REMOVED in 0.2.1)
// v0.2.1
const result = await watchdog.next(iterator)
if (result.done) { exhausted = true; return }
yield result.value
The catch block (if (timeoutOf(watchdog.signal, ...) !== undefined) throw LlmError('TIMEOUT', ...)) is preserved, so the end-state is the same if the timer actually fires.
Net effect
v0.2.0: streamIdleTimeoutMs default 3e5 is loaded by idleWatchdog but never throws — /compact runs until the upstream signal terminates it. The patch value is also not applied, but the bug is hidden.
v0.2.1: streamIdleTimeoutMs default 3e5 does throw TimeoutReason after 5 min, which propagates as LlmError('pi-ai stream idle timeout after 300000ms', 'TIMEOUT'). The patch value is also not applied — but now the 5-min error surfaces, breaking /compact on any prompt over ~5 min.
The user-supplied streamIdleTimeoutMs: 3600000 patch does not take effect, so the 5-min default wins. The patch-loading path that fails is unknown.
What was tried (none work)
Two-argument form (current cordis.patch.yml):
yaml


id: fetch-timeouts
name: dsh-fetch-timeouts
config:
headersTimeoutMs: 3600000
bodyTimeoutMs: 3600000
Three-argument form (the form in d3vmeh/dsh-fetch-timeouts README):
yaml


id: fetch-timeouts
config:
headersTimeoutMs: 3600000
bodyTimeoutMs: 3600000


insert:

id: fetch-timeouts
name: dsh-fetch-timeouts
Patch values: 600_000, 1_800_000, 3_600_000 for both streamIdleTimeoutMs and timeoutMs
Adding dsh-fetch-timeouts plugin (d3vmeh/dsh-fetch-timeouts 0.1.1) — installed via junction to ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-fetch-timeouts with pnpm link; DSH startup log is no longer persisted in 0.2.1, so plugin-loaded confirmation is not visible to the user
Restarting DSH multiple times after each change
Direct verification of pi-ai's Config schema: Config = z.object({ providers: z.dict(profile).default({}).volatile() }) — providers is .volatile() and should hot-reload. The streamIdleTimeoutMs field on profile is a regular z.number() accepting up to MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS = 2^31 - 1. The read code const streamIdleTimeoutMs = source.streamIdleTimeoutMs ?? 3e5 is straightforward.
All attempts produce the same 5-min cancel. The patch's value is not reaching source.streamIdleTimeoutMs for any tested provider.



Workaround (proven, 11 min total)
3× /compact (each failed attempt primes the Strata engine's conversation cache; the 3rd attempt with ≥90% cache hit completes in under 90s).
Files affected (per-tree-SHA, master)
packages/util/timeout/src/index.ts — c69d539ce... → 16b74e94... (change 1)
packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts — de9f3e0e... → a912fff6... (change 2)
packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/{config,stream,provider}.ts — identical between versions (same SHAs)
packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/Config schema — Config = z.object({ providers: z.dict(profile).default({}).volatile() }) — unchanged
packages/compaction/{command-compact,compaction-basic}/src/... — identical between versions
Requested
Confirm whether the user-supplied streamIdleTimeoutMs patch is expected to be applied to source.streamIdleTimeoutMs in llm-pi-ai's resolved provider profile. If so, identify where in the patch-loading chain (dsh-app-boot → readProfilePatches → parsePatchList → Config → volatile reload → resolveProfiles) the value is being dropped or overwritten.
Related: discussion #3157 covers a similar but separate issue (the Node-undici 5-min body timeout, addressed by dsh-fetch-timeouts plugin). This discussion is specifically about the dsh-timeout idleWatchdog 5-min default and the missing patch application.

threads.title: 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.2：打包运行（app.asar）启动必失败 desktop welcome: Web authentication failed，解包成目录就正常
threads.bodyText:
环境

DSH 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.2，Windows 11 x64
Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0
装了若干第三方插件（已排除，见下）

现象
以打包形式运行（D:\deepseek\resources\app.asar 存在）时，启动必然失败，连续 10 次全部是同一个错误：
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
    at connectDesktopWelcome (lib/main.js:8886)
    at async Object.start (lib/main.js:12195)

把同一份 app.asar 解包成 resources/app 目录运行 → 100% 成功，认证返回 303 再 200 OK，主界面正常。
也就是说：问题只在 isPackaged = true 这条路径上出现。现在我还在用解包目录跑，所以这件事"能绕过去但没修好"。
已经排除的可能


asar 文件本身没有损坏
解析它的文件表：18309 个文件、目录结构完整，dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host/lib/cli.js 也在里面。


不是"Electron 读不了 asar"
用 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 启动 Electron 去读 asar 内部目录，fs.readdirSync 正常返回；普通 node 才读不了（ENOENT）——但桌面启动 host 用的正是 Electron 的 node 模式。


与第三方插件无关
解包模式下，全部插件（12 个 bundle + 自定义插件）都加载时，启动正常。而且插件报错不会以"认证失败"的形式出现。


「禁用第三方插件」按钮没能真的禁用
这个按钮只把 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 清成了 []，
但插件实际是挂在 package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 里的 —— 那一层没有任何改动，点完之后第三方插件照旧全部加载。
（我留有按钮写的空 patch 备份作证。）


缺失的关键信息

host 子进程的 stderr 从来没有落盘：crash-*-host.log 里只有外层那一句，host 自己输出什么完全看不到。
（DesktopHostProcess 里有一个 64KB 的 stderr 环形缓冲，但失败时没有写进 crash log。）
Windows 应用事件日志在该时间段没有任何错误记录 ⇒ 进程不是崩溃被系统记录，而是被优雅地判定为"启动失败"。

建议（按重要性）

把 host 子进程的 stderr 写进 crash log（失败时把那个环形缓冲 flush 出来）。
现在"认证失败"这一句把四种完全不同的死因（host 起不来 / 端口没开 / 权限 / 内部抛错）压成了同一句话，用户和插件作者都无从下手。
「禁用第三方插件」应同时清 dsh.profile.bundles，否则它不是一个真正的安全模式，无法用来二分定位。
打包分支（isPackaged=true）与解包分支的差异值得查一下：从现象看，外壳在等后端的 ready URL，但打包时没等到可用的那一个。

现在的临时解法
把 resources/app.asar 改名为 .bak，把它的内容解包成 resources/app/ 目录 —— 之后启动、认证、插件全部正常。
副作用：dsh 命令行工具仍硬编码 app.asar 路径，会报 MODULE_NOT_FOUND（不影响桌面使用）。

English summary: On DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (Windows), launching from the packaged app.asar always fails at
desktop welcome: Web authentication failed (10/10 attempts), while the same app extracted to a plain
resources/app directory starts fine (303 → 200). The asar is intact, Electron's node mode can read it, and the
failure is unrelated to third-party plugins. The host child process's stderr is never persisted, so the real cause
cannot be diagnosed. Suggested fixes: persist host stderr into the crash log, and make "disable third-party plugins"
also clear dsh.profile.bundles.

threads.title: Bug report: live-streamed assistant text corrupted in the Web GUI (duplicated boundaries, dropped fragments) until reload
threads.bodyText:
Bug report — this repository has issues disabled, so this is filed under Q&A.
Summary
Assistant message text rendered by the DSH Web GUI gets corrupted during live streaming: small boundary fragments are duplicated and middle fragments are dropped. The corruption persists after the reply settles. A page reload (F5) restores the correct text.
Observed corruption
Session with deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro on @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (Web GUI). The assistant message is correct on the host, corrupted on screen:

Intended: Почему два сбоя (оба — не поломка плагина) → rendered: Почему два с (tail dropped)
Intended: 1. **EROFS** — npm-кэш \/home/glavnaya/.npm` вне воркспейса→ rendered withoutкэш` and most of the tail
Intended: 2. **Баг doctor 0.1.0** (нашёл по стеку, \source.js:60`)→ renderedнаш source.js:60` (middle dropped, fragments glued)
Duplicated boundaries: не не выполнена, /home/ + home/glavnaya (i.e. /home/home/glavnaya), duplicated {"d prefix inside a code span

The corruption also leaks into user selections: annotation quotes (built from DOM selection via sel.toString()) were stored garbled in the session journal, i.e. the DOM text itself is broken, not just pixels.
Evidence chain

Host-side data is intact. The session journal (session.v4.jsonl.zstd) stores final assistant/message events with the full correct text (verified byte-level). The journal does not persist assistant/chunk events.
Reload repairs the text. After F5 the same messages render correctly → durable history replay is clean; only the live transient assembly corrupts.
Pattern matches a rebaseline artifact. Duplicated small boundaries + dropped middles is consistent with re-application of transient chunks in the client stream fold.
The annotation plugin was excluded. @changfenhuang/dsh-annotation only replaces «Annotation N:» with chips and hides the protocol block in user bubbles; the corruption appeared in message bodies unrelated to those operations.

Suspected area

packages/api/session-controller/src/client/sessions/assistant-stream.ts — ClientAssistantStream.replace() / acceptFrame(), fractional transient seqs, rebaseline re-emission of the whole attempt
packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation/assembler.ts — application of transient assistant/live-chunk entries

The exact offending line is not yet pinned: I could not run the local test suite (sandboxed npm cache is read-only, vitest not installed in the checkout), and live chunk frames are not persisted anywhere.
Versions

Reproduced on: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (running GUI)
Source reviewed at: 0.2.1-alpha.1 (master at 5badb15009)
git log dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2..HEAD shows no fixes in packages/api/session-controller, packages/client/ui-conversation, packages/llm/llm for this path, so the defect presumably exists on master too.

Repro hint
Long assistant replies with interleaved tool calls (e.g. bash) corrupt most reliably; the broken text persists until the page is reloaded.

threads.title: [Windows 10] 受限 pwsh 在进程启动阶段就死于 0xC0000142（DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2）
threads.bodyText:
[Windows 10] Confined pwsh dies at process start with 0xC0000142 on DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2
Summary
On DSH Desktop (Electron, Windows 10 22H2), every pwsh tool call under the
default workspace-write sandbox returns no output and exit code 3221225794
(0xC0000142, STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED). The same command runs fine when retried
once with danger-full-access. This makes the whole confined-shell path unusable on
this host.
Environment



Item
Value




DSH Desktop
0.2.1-rc.2


OS
Windows 10 Pro 22H2, 10.0.19045, x64


Profile
desktop (managed by DSH Desktop)


Bundled runtime
Node v24.21.0, pnpm 11.28.5 (managed runtime dsh-primary-runtime)


Shell resolved by executor
Windows PowerShell 5.1 (System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe); no pwsh 7 installed


Sandbox mode
workspace-write (session default), approval policy ask


Antivirus
Kaspersky installed on the machine (version not collected; no exclusions or setting changes were made)



Steps to reproduce

Start DSH Desktop, open a session with the default workspace-write policy.
Call the pwsh tool with any command, e.g. Write-Output 'ok'.

result: (no output)
exit code: 3221225794  (0xC0000142)


Retry the exact same call with sandbox_permissions: danger-full-access.
Result: runs normally, High integrity, output returned.

Expected
The confined command runs and returns its output.
Actual
The confined child process never initializes: no stdout, no stderr, exit code
0xC0000142. A file-access denial would have surfaced as
[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]; it does not.
Evidence collected

The runner itself starts. A runner-side failure prints
windows-acl-run: <detail> and exits 127. We get neither, so the restricted
child was created and died during DLL initialization — this is not a
token/grant/DACL provisioning failure.
Not a file-permission problem. No [sandbox: …] marker, and the workspace
chain has plain inherited full control for the signed-in user.
Not the PowerShell 5.1 fallback. Overriding the executor to a portable
PowerShell 7.6.7 (- id: pwsh-sandbox → config.pwshPath) reproduced the exact
same 0xC0000142. (See caveat below.)
Windows Event Log / WER: no Application Error 1000 entry and no crash report
was produced for the failing child.
Host has no console. DSH Desktop is an Electron GUI app. Per
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl README, children created with
CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE die with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED
(0xC0000142) during DLL initialization. @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local
launches Windows children with windowsHide: true, i.e. CREATE_NO_WINDOW;
the restricted child then has no inheritable console and must allocate one at
init, which is the documented failure mode.

Secondary observation (possible separate bug)
While the pwsh-sandbox override above was live, even danger-full-access
spawns came up as Low integrity (Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level,
S-1-16-4096) and could no longer write outside the workspace (writing
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh was denied). Removing the override immediately restored High
integrity and full write access. This suggests the sandbox provider's confined
token can leak into the unconfined spawn path across a config hot-reload. It may
or may not be related to the main issue.
Possible causes (ranked)

Console-less restricted child — the Windows ACL backend requires a
shared/inheritable console; the Desktop host supplies none, so the restricted
pwsh dies in DLL init. This matches the documented 0xC0000142 signature
exactly.
Antivirus hook injection — Kaspersky injects a hook DLL into new processes;
inside a Low-integrity, write-restricted child that DLL may fail to initialize
and take the process down with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED. This is a hypothesis
only: no exclusion, pause, or setting change was made to test it, deliberately.

Workaround used locally
Keep the session at workspace-write + ask, and escalate individual shell
commands once via sandbox_permissions: danger-full-access. File read/write tools
stay under the workspace policy.
Additional context

The failure is deterministic and independent of the command content, working
directory, or whether pwshPath points at 5.1 or 7.6.7.
No environment variable or profile setting changes the outcome so far.
Kaspersky is mentioned only as an environmental suspect; I did not modify it.


中文摘要
DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2（Windows 10 22H2）上，受限（workspace-write）的 pwsh
调用全部在进程启动阶段以 0xC0000142（STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）退出，无任何输出；
提权到 danger-full-access 后同一命令正常。排查排除了文件权限、runner 初始化失败、
以及 PowerShell 5.1 兜底（换成 7.6.7 同样复现）三种原因。最符合现象的是 Windows ACL
受限令牌后端对「控制台」的要求：桌面端是 GUI 宿主、子进程按 windowsHide 启动，
受限子进程拿不到可继承的控制台，就在 DLL 初始化阶段死亡。另外观察到：临时覆盖
pwsh-sandbox 配置热加载后，连 danger-full-access 的命令也会以 Low 完整性运行，
撤回后恢复，疑似受限令牌泄漏到非受限路径，建议一并排查。机器装有卡巴斯基，注入钩子
与受限令牌冲突是另一种可能，但没有做任何排除/关闭操作去验证。

threads.title: [Bug][Web Search settings] A refused API-key replacement is treated as saved when an old key exists
threads.bodyText:
When replacing an API key in Plugins → Built-in plugin settings → Web search, a failed credential write can leave the old key active while the form clears the new key draft and reports no failed save. This also affects the settings used by the new Search/Fetch APIs.
Environment and verification scope

Official master at 687f282e8625c6b8d11ff58211a90524be2e4317, repository/package version 0.2.1-rc.2.
macOS arm64, Node v26.10.0, TypeScript 5.9.3, Zustand 4.5.7, Immer 10.2.0, React 18.3.1.
Executed the existing WebSearchCardController, SettingsFormModel, and snapshot-store source; no controller/form logic was reimplemented.
Verified with both controlled Remote failure results (5/5 separate Node processes, including success and first-key-failure controls) and a real filesystem refusal from the published 0.2.1-rc.2 LocalCredentialProvider and CredentialsController.
The real-provider check uses an isolated temporary directory and dummy keys. A direct test adapter converts the Host method's RemoteError to the supported ok:false result. This is a controller/Host-service reproduction; it does not claim Chromium, full Desktop, live network, or production-profile reproduction.

Minimal scenario

credentials.describe(['DEEPSEEK_API_KEY']) reports {configured:true,writable:true} because an old key is stored.
Stage apiKey = 'new-test-key' through controller.inject().edit() and call save().
Make the Remote test double return its supported failure result from credentials.set(): {ok:false,error:{code:'credential/rejected',message:'test write refusal',details:{ref:'DEEPSEEK_API_KEY'}}}. Keep the stored key unchanged.
The subsequent describe() still reports {configured:true,writable:true} for the old key.
Read the card's actual snapshot after save settles.

Actual: dirty:false, failed:false, apiKey.text:''; the backing test store still holds old-test-key.
Expected: preserve the new-key draft, keep the form dirty, and surface the failed save. A previously configured value does not establish that its replacement was accepted.
The same probe with no pre-existing key correctly finishes dirty:true, failed:true with the draft retained. A successful replacement correctly updates the stored value and clears the draft. The failure is specific to treating an existing configured key as proof of the new write.
Cause
WebSearchCardController.writeKey() currently does:
await this.ctx.remote.credentials.set(this.ref(), value)
await this.readCredential()
return this.credential.configured
The structured set() response is ignored. Since describe() answers whether any key is configured, it stays true after a refused replacement. SettingsFormModel.save() then clears its staged fields based on that true result.
The Host already maps provider refusals to credential/rejected in CredentialsController.write(). These Remote failures arrive as ok:false, not necessarily as thrown promises. The sibling Models settings implementation checks response.ok.
Real persistence failure check
In addition to the controlled cases above, I ran the real published credential provider and Host controller:

Boot LocalCredentialProvider with {path: '<temporary-directory>/.credentials.yaml', watch:false} and mount CredentialsController in a fresh Cordis Context.
Save dummy old-test-key under DSH_AUDIT_ROTATION; have the Web Search card refer to this key.
Set only the temporary directory to mode 0500, leaving the existing credential file readable, and stage new-test-key in the card.
Save using the real CredentialsController.set()/describe() calls, adapting their return/throw into Remote results. The write fails when it tries to create .credentials.yaml.lock.
Compare the card snapshot, credentials.resolve() and the credential file. Restore directory mode 0700 and delete the temporary directory in finally.

Observed output (dummy values only):
{
  "writeResult": {
    "ok": false,
    "error": {
      "code": "credential/rejected",
      "message": "EACCES: permission denied, open '<isolated-test-directory>/.credentials.yaml.lock'",
      "details": {"ref": "DSH_AUDIT_ROTATION"}
    }
  },
  "after": {
    "dirty": false,
    "failed": false,
    "apiKeyText": "",
    "apiKeyConfigured": true
  },
  "storedAfter": {"value": "old-test-key", "source": "file"},
  "diskStillOld": true
}
LocalCredentialProvider.write() replaces its cached value only after locking and durable writing succeed. This check therefore confirms an actual provider refusal, while the original configured value stays available.
Proposed correction
Check set()'s structured result and return failure when ok:false. A re-read can refresh the badge, but should not substitute for write acceptance. Keep the draft so the user can retry. Regression cases should cover:

replacement rejected while an old key remains configured;
successful replacement;
first-key write rejected;
replacement rejected and the following describe also fails.

Related public reports and search limits
Repository Discussion searches for credentials/API key/密钥 and Web Search save terms were paginated to exhaustion (1,382 distinct results); focused controller/function/error searches also found no equivalent report.
This differs from #9706, which concerns later edits lost during a successful pending save; this case makes no concurrent edit and the credential write fails. #2363 / #3696 concern Models skipping the credential write after an earlier settings mutation failure; here Web Search invokes the write and ignores its explicit refusal result. #8988 / #7625 concern missing deletion controls. #9054 requires navigating away from Models; this test remains in one mounted controller.
The public Issues list returned empty; credential/save Issue and PR searches returned empty. The public pulls REST endpoint returned 404, so full PR visibility is unavailable and private or unindexed work cannot be excluded.
AI-assisted audit and reproduction with Codex. Only isolated dummy credentials were used; no production profile was changed.

threads.title: [Bug] cannot get required service "sessionProjections" in inactive context — terminal-bash 护栏在 owner scope 销毁后仍被全局派发触发
threads.bodyText:
[Bug] cannot get required service "sessionProjections" in inactive context — terminal-bash 的沙箱模式护栏在 owner scope 销毁后仍被全局派发触发
环境

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2（Windows x64）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash 0.2.1-rc.2
@deepseek-ai/cordis 4.0.5
平台：Windows 11，PowerShell / bash 终端后端

现象
会话运行中/结束后，日志里反复出现：
Error: cannot get required service "sessionProjections" in inactive context

不是每次必现，但一旦本轮用过终端工具（shell / pwsh / terminal_*），之后并发会话或续跑会话越多，出现得越频繁。
根因（已定位到具体代码）
报错本身来自 cordis 的服务解析代理：
vendor/cordis/lib/index.js（src/reflect.ts:156-166）
while (true) {
  const impl = fiber.store?.[prop]
  if (impl) return getTraceable(ctx, impl.value)
  if (prop in fiber.inject) {
    error.message = `cannot get required service "${prop}" in inactive context`
    throw error          // fiber 已卸载（store === undefined），但 inject 里仍声明了该服务
  }
  ...
}
触发方是 packages/terminal/terminal-bash/src/index.ts 里的 ensureSandboxModeFence：
const sandboxModeFences = new WeakMap()

function ensureSandboxModeFence(ctx, owner) {
  const existing = sandboxModeFences.get(owner)
  if (existing !== undefined) {
    existing.pty = ctx.terminals
    existing.sandboxPolicy = ctx.sandboxPolicy
    existing.sessionProjections = ctx.sessionProjections   // ← 每次 spawn 都重读
    return
  }
  const state = {
    pty: ctx.terminals,
    sandboxPolicy: ctx.sandboxPolicy,
    sessionProjections: ctx.sessionProjections,
  }
  sandboxModeFences.set(owner, state)

  owner.ctx.on('internal/dispatch', (_mode, eventName, args) => {   // ← global 监听器
    if (eventName !== 'session/event') return
    const [session, event] = args
    if (session !== owner.session || event.type !== 'sandbox/mode') return
    const currentMode =
      state.sessionProjections.stateOf(session, 'sandboxMode') ??      // ← 在这里抛
      state.sandboxPolicy.defaultMode
    ...
  }, { global: true })
}
调用点在同文件的 BashTerminalBackend.spawn：
async spawn(spec) {
  spec.signal?.throwIfAborted()
  ensureSandboxModeFence(this.ctx, spec.owner)   // ← 每 spawn 一次终端就执行一次
  ...
}
因果链

每次启动终端都会调用 ensureSandboxModeFence(this.ctx, spec.owner)，它把 state.sessionProjections（即 agent scope 的 ctx）闭包捕获，并注册一个 { global: true } 的 internal/dispatch 监听器。
agent / 会话结束后，该 scope 的 fiber 被 Fiber._unload() 卸载，fiber.store 变成 undefined。
但 { global: true } 的监听器在 fiber 销毁后仍然会收到任意会话的 session/event。
回调进入后读取 state.sessionProjections；解析向上回溯到已卸载的 fiber，命中 prop in fiber.inject 分支，于是抛出 ... in inactive context。

注意第 3 步：监听器不仅存活，而且对其他会话的事件也会触发，所以错误会跨会话共鸣放大——这就是"老出现"的原因。
复现步骤

打开一个会话，让 agent 通过终端工具（ops_bash / pwsh / terminal_*）执行至少一条命令，触发 BashTerminalBackend.spawn。
结束该会话（或关闭标签页 / 结束该 agent scope）。
在另一个会话里继续正常对话（或让任意会话产生 session/event）。
观察日志：出现 cannot get required service "sessionProjections" in inactive context。

会话越多、并行子 agent 越多，出现频率越高。
预期行为
已卸载 scope 的监听器不应再解析服务，更不应把内部生命周期问题抛到 UI/日志里。沙箱模式护栏应只在 owner 的 session 仍存活时生效。
建议修复
主修复（建议在上游做）：让监听器在 owner 已销毁时直接退出，而不是去读 ctx。例如在 ensureSandboxModeFence 的回调开头加守卫：
owner.ctx.on('internal/dispatch', (_mode, eventName, args) => {
  if (eventName !== 'session/event') return
  // owner scope 已销毁：fiber.store 被清空，此时读取任何注入服务都会抛
  if (owner.ctx.fiber?.store === undefined) return
  ...
}, { global: true })
或者在 owner scope 销毁时主动释放该监听器（把 internal/dispatch 监听改为挂在 owner 自己的生命周期 effect 里，而不是 global）。
可选加固：ReflectService.handler.get 在 fiber.store === undefined 时返回 undefined 而不是抛错——已卸载的 fiber 语义上就是"服务不可用"，这样能避免同类问题从其他插件再次冒出来：
if (prop in fiber.inject) {
  if (fiber.store === void 0) return void 0   // fiber 已卸载：服务不可用
  error.message = `cannot get required service "${prop}" in inactive context`
  throw error
}
影响

功能上不致命（护栏失效，沙箱模式切换校验可能被跳过），但错误会持续刷日志/UI。
频繁中断或关闭会话时噪声明显，且可能掩盖真实错误。

threads.title: Windows 10: shell tool fails with 0xC0000142 in workspace-write mode
threads.bodyText:
Environment

OS: Windows 10 Pro 22H2, build 19045
DSH: desktop app 0.2.1-rc.2 (@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime 0.2.1-rc.2), account = Administrator (elevated)
PowerShell: 7.6.7 at C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe (also reproduced with cmd.exe)
Session permission preset: workspace-write

Symptom
Every pwsh tool call in a workspace-write session fails with exit code 3221225794 = 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) and completely empty stdout/stderr. Switching the session to danger-full-access makes the same commands work immediately. Reboot, reinstalling PowerShell 7, and fixing PATH all change nothing.
What the spawned chain looks like (from Security 4688 with command line auditing)
DeepSeek Harness.exe  ...\dsh-subprocess-local\lib\runner.js --
  DeepSeek Harness.exe  ...\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js
    --workspace <ws> --temp %TEMP%\dsh-XXXX --mode workspace-write
    --write-sid S-1-4-... --temp-write-sid S-1-4-... --
    "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "..."
-> exit status 0xC0000142

Isolation (same argv, same workspace/temp, same elevated console)



runner process
mode
child
result




DeepSeek Harness.exe (Electron, process.execPath)
workspace-write
pwsh 7
0xC0000142


DeepSeek Harness.exe
workspace-write
cmd.exe
0xC0000142


DeepSeek Harness.exe
read-only
pwsh 7
OK (exit 0)


bundled node.exe
workspace-write
pwsh 7
OK (exit 0)


DeepSeek Harness.exe
workspace-write, seam-managed ACEs (--write-sid given)
pwsh 7
0xC0000142


bundled node.exe
workspace-write, seam-managed ACEs
pwsh 7
OK (exit 0)



Also ruled out: workspace path (C:\dshws fails too), TMP/TEMP rewrite (patched out, still fails), ACE granting (seam-managed still fails), pwsh/.NET (cmd.exe fails identically).
Instrumenting dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js shows the runner itself survives:
sandbox-inited     <- token created
before-spawn       <- about to create the child
runner-exit:-1073741502   <- mirrors the child's 0xC0000142

Suspected cause
Fails only when the runner is the Electron binary and the token carries the extra workspace-write capability SIDs (S-1-4-...); read-only (same Electron parent, no capability SIDs) works, and the bundled node with capability SIDs also works. The source comment in dsh-sandbox-windows-acl says the token design was "verified on Win11 26200" — this machine is Win10 19045. Looks like a CreateProcessAsUserW + WRITE_RESTRICTED/Low-IL interaction that differs by parent process and/or OS build on Windows 10.
Impact
workspace-write — the default confinement level — is unusable on Windows 10 for any tool that spawns a process; users must either grant danger-full-access or fall back to read-only.
Ask
Could you confirm whether Windows 10 (19045) is a supported target for the ACL sandbox, and whether using the bundled node.exe instead of process.execPath for the subprocess supervisor/runner is intended to work on Win10?
Minimal reproduction
A self-contained PowerShell script that drives dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js directly with the bundled node.exe vs DeepSeek Harness.exe and prints the exit codes; I can attach it if useful.

[bug] Agent Teams 会话下 send_message 无法按 id 寻址子代理，但 subagent 工具描述声称可以，这个bug之前修复过一次，但没有修好
threads.bodyText:
send_message cannot address subagents by id in Agent Teams sessions, but the subagent tool description says it can
中文版见下方
Summary
In a session where Agent Teams is enabled, the send_message tool exposed to the model accepts only teammate names (target parameter). Passing the agent_id returned by the subagent tool fails with a misleading error:
Error: active teammate "79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd" not found

This contradicts the subagent tool's own description, which instructs the model to "use send_message to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes".
The dsh-tool-subagent-control package already implements id-based messaging correctly, but in an Agent Teams session its tool is shadowed by the Team-scoped send_message, so the model never gets access to it.
Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 (latest on npm at the time of writing)
Live-reproduced on 0.2.1-alpha.2 and 0.1.7-rc.2 as well. On 0.2.0-rc.2 the same code path (resolveActiveMember in dsh-experimental-agent-team) is byte-for-byte identical, so the same failure applies.
Windows 11, Node.js, dsh web GUI session with Agent Teams enabled
Session role: Team Lead

Steps to reproduce

In an Agent Teams session (Team Lead), call the subagent tool with run_in_background: true.
Read the returned subagent id, e.g. 79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd.
Send it a message:

send_message({
  target: "79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd",
  message: "please continue with step 2"
})
Expected
Per the subagent tool description, the message should steer the running child (or start a new turn in it).
Actual
Error: active teammate "79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd" not found

The child itself has no trouble reporting back to the parent — the up-channel works:
Agent 79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd sent a message: READY-RC2

So the failure is asymmetric: child → parent works, parent → child does not.
Root cause
Two different tools register the same model-facing name send_message, with different schemas and semantics:



Package
Parameter
Accepts




@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team
target
teammate names from list_agents (or "lead")


@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control
agent_id
agent ids (UUIDs)



dsh-tool-subagent-control is a dependency of dsh-base (node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/package.json), so it is part of the base bundle. The Agent Team plugin then registers its own send_message through agent.ctx (per-agent scoped tools), which overrides the base tool for that agent. The result is that a Team Lead sees only the target-based tool.
Code references (0.2.1-rc.2 compiled output):

dsh-experimental-agent-team/lib/types/roster.js:18-27 — resolveActiveMember() resolves strictly by name and throws the generic error:
const member = state.members.find(candidate => candidate.name === name);
if (member === undefined || member.phase !== 'active') {
    throw new TeamError(`active teammate "${name}" not found`, 'TEAM_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND');
}

dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team/lib/index.js:292-306 — Team-scoped send_message with target only. It does not carry the adjacentAgentSendMessageTool marker.
dsh-tool-subagent-control/lib/index.js:22-36 — the id-based tool with agent_id.
dsh-tool-subagent/lib/index.js:384 — the subagent description that promises the capability.

Additional notes:

list_agents returns only Team members, not plain subagents, so the Lead cannot discover an addressable name for a subagent child — the child has no name at all.
The error text says "teammate … not found", which steers the model toward list_agents and name-based retries, not toward the actual cause (an id handed out by subagent).

A previous fix attempt exists, but it does not cover Agent Teams
Commit 43840d6ece — "fix(subagent): harden adjacent message guidance" (2026-08-31) already tried to address this class of problem:

Added the adjacentAgentSendMessageTool marker in packages/subagent/subagent/src/internal.ts:
export const adjacentAgentSendMessageTool = Symbol.for('dsh.subagent.adjacentAgentSendMessageTool')
export function markAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool(definition: ToolDefinition): ToolDefinition { … }
export function isAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool(definition: ToolDefinition | undefined): boolean { … }

Marked the send_message definition in dsh-tool-subagent-control with it.
Used it in packages/subagent/subagent/src/manager.ts:463 to decide whether to inject withContinuableReturnGuidance into a child's initial prompt:
spec.delivery !== 'caller' && isAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool(this.ctx.get('tools')?.get('send_message', child))
  ? withContinuableReturnGuidance(parent.id, request.prompt)
  : request.prompt

Clarified the subagent description wording.

The gap: dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team never calls markAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool. Verified in the compiled 0.2.1-rc.2 package: the Team send_message definition carries no such marker. So when the Team tool shadows the control tool, the runtime cannot recognize it as the standard adjacent-message tool, and the guidance/description mismatch persists.
The wording of the description has also changed across releases without resolving the underlying tool-availability question:



Release
subagent description (relevant sentence)




0.2.0-rc.2
"It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with send_message; you are notified when the run settles."


0.2.1-alpha.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2
"The child reports results with send_message; use send_message to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes."



Both promise id-based steering; neither is achievable in an Agent Teams session.
Suggested fixes

Avoid the name collision (preferred). Give the two tools distinct names (e.g. keep send_message for Team members and expose the control tool as send_subagent_message / message_agent), so both can be visible at once.
Fall back to ids in the Team tool. Let the Team send_message fall back to ctx.subagents.sendMessage() when target is not a known member name but is a live continuable child of the caller.
Mark the Team tool. Have dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team mark its definition with markAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool so the runtime recognizes it (this fixes the guidance gating, but not the missing agent_id capability).
At minimum, fix the messaging. Detect UUID-like input in resolveActiveMember and report that an agent id cannot be addressed by the Team tool, pointing to the correct mechanism. Likewise, make the subagent description conditional on which send_message variant is actually installed.

Minimal repro harness (if useful)
The whole failure is observable without any domain code:

Enable Agent Teams, open a session as Lead.
subagent({ description: "probe", prompt: "reply READY", run_in_background: true })
Take the id from the result and pass it to send_message({ target: id, … }) → the error above.
list_agents({}) lists neither the subagent nor any name that could address it.


Verified against installed @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 on 2026-10-20. Happy to test a patch or provide additional traces.

【中文版】Agent Teams 会话下 send_message 无法按 id 寻址子代理，但 subagent 工具描述声称可以
概述
在启用 Agent Teams 的会话中，模型拿到的 send_message 工具只接受队友的名字（target 参数）。把 subagent 工具返回的 agent_id 传进去，会得到一个极具误导性的报错：
Error: active teammate "79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd" not found

这与 subagent 工具自身的描述相矛盾——它明确让模型"用 send_message 引导正在运行的子代理，或在它结束后继续对话"。
dsh-tool-subagent-control 包其实已经正确实现了按 id 投递，但在 Agent Teams 会话中，它的工具被 Team 作用域的 send_message 遮蔽，模型根本没有机会用到。
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.2（撰写时 npm 上的最新版本）
另在 0.2.1-alpha.2 与 0.1.7-rc.2 上实测复现。在 0.2.0-rc.2 中，同一代码路径（dsh-experimental-agent-team 的 resolveActiveMember）逐字节完全相同，因此同样会失败。
Windows 11、Node.js、启用 Agent Teams 的 dsh web GUI 会话
会话角色：Team Lead

复现步骤

在 Agent Teams 会话（Team Lead）中，调用 subagent 工具并设置 run_in_background: true。
从返回值中取出子代理 id，例如 79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd。
向它发送消息：

send_message({
  target: "79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd",
  message: "please continue with step 2"
})
预期结果
按 subagent 工具描述的承诺，消息应当能够引导正在运行的子代理（或在它空闲时开启新一轮对话）。
实际结果
Error: active teammate "79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd" not found

子代理反过来向父代理汇报则完全正常——上行通道是通的：
Agent 79557625-e036-4217-97bd-b157672f2ecd sent a message: READY-RC2

也就是说，故障是不对称的：子 → 父可用，父 → 子不可用。
根因
两个不同的工具注册了同一个模型可见的名字 send_message，但 schema 与语义都不相同：



包
参数
接受值




@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team
target
来自 list_agents 的队友名字（或 "lead"）


@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control
agent_id
代理 id（UUID）



dsh-tool-subagent-control 是 dsh-base 的依赖（node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-base/package.json 的 dependencies 段），因此属于基础 bundle。Agent Team 插件随后通过 agent.ctx（按代理作用域的工具）注册自己的 send_message，覆盖了该代理上的基础工具。结果就是 Team Lead 只能看到基于 target 的那个。
代码引用（0.2.1-rc.2 编译产物）：

dsh-experimental-agent-team/lib/types/roster.js:18-27 —— resolveActiveMember() 严格按名字解析，找不到就抛通用错误：
const member = state.members.find(candidate => candidate.name === name);
if (member === undefined || member.phase !== 'active') {
    throw new TeamError(`active teammate "${name}" not found`, 'TEAM_MEMBER_NOT_FOUND');
}

dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team/lib/index.js:292-306 —— Team 作用域的 send_message，只有 target。它没有携带 adjacentAgentSendMessageTool 标记。
dsh-tool-subagent-control/lib/index.js:22-36 —— 基于 id 的工具，参数为 agent_id。
dsh-tool-subagent/lib/index.js:384 —— 承诺了该能力的那句 subagent 描述。

补充说明：

list_agents 只返回 Team 成员，不返回普通 subagent。因此 Lead 无法为 subagent 子代理解析出可寻址的名字——它根本没有名字。
报错文案写的是 "teammate … not found"，会把模型引向 list_agents 和基于名字的重试，而不是真正的成因（这是个由 subagent 发出的 id）。

此前已有一次修复尝试，但未覆盖 Agent Teams
提交 43840d6ece —— "fix(subagent): harden adjacent message guidance"（2026-08-31） 已经尝试处理过这一类问题：

在 packages/subagent/subagent/src/internal.ts 中新增 adjacentAgentSendMessageTool 标记：
export const adjacentAgentSendMessageTool = Symbol.for('dsh.subagent.adjacentAgentSendMessageTool')
export function markAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool(definition: ToolDefinition): ToolDefinition { … }
export function isAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool(definition: ToolDefinition | undefined): boolean { … }

用它给 dsh-tool-subagent-control 中的 send_message 定义打了标记。
在 packages/subagent/subagent/src/manager.ts:463 用它决定是否向子代理的初始提示注入 withContinuableReturnGuidance：
spec.delivery !== 'caller' && isAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool(this.ctx.get('tools')?.get('send_message', child))
  ? withContinuableReturnGuidance(parent.id, request.prompt)
  : request.prompt

澄清了 subagent 的描述文案。

缺口在于： dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team 从未调用 markAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool。已在 0.2.1-rc.2 编译产物中验证：Team 的 send_message 定义上不存在该标记。因此，当 Team 工具遮蔽 control 工具时，运行时无法把它识别为标准邻接消息工具，指引与描述不一致的问题便一直存在。
描述文案在各版本之间也改过，但都没有解决"工具到底可用不可用"这个根本问题：



版本
subagent 描述（相关语句）




0.2.0-rc.2
"It runs in the background by default and returns a subagent id you can continue with send_message; you are notified when the run settles."


0.2.1-alpha.2 / 0.2.1-rc.2
"The child reports results with send_message; use send_message to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes."



两者都承诺了按 id 引导子代理，但在 Agent Teams 会话里都做不到。
修复建议

避免重名（推荐）。 让两个工具使用不同的名字（例如 send_message 继续用于 Team 成员，把 control 工具暴露为 send_subagent_message / message_agent），使两者可以同时可见。
让 Team 工具回退到 id。 当 target 不是已知成员名、但确实是调用方的一个存活的可继续子代理时，让 Team 的 send_message 回退到 ctx.subagents.sendMessage()。
给 Team 工具打标记。 让 dsh-experimental-tool-agent-team 用 markAdjacentAgentSendMessageTool 标记自己的定义，以便运行时识别（这能修好指引的判定条件，但补不上缺失的 agent_id 能力）。
至少修正提示信息。 在 resolveActiveMember 中识别 UUID 形态的输入，明确报告"代理 id 无法通过 Team 工具寻址"并指向正确机制；同时让 subagent 的描述依据实际安装的 send_message 变体来决定措辞。

最小复现
整个故障不需要任何业务代码即可观察：

启用 Agent Teams，以 Lead 身份打开一个会话。
subagent({ description: "probe", prompt: "reply READY", run_in_background: true })
从结果中取出 id，传给 send_message({ target: id, … }) → 出现上述报错。
list_agents({}) 既不会列出该 subagent，也不会给出任何可用于寻址它的名字。


基于 2026-10-20 已安装的 @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2 验证。乐意配合测试补丁或提供更多 trace。

threads.bodyText:
问题
这是 read-only 沙箱的BUG吗？
环境

DSH 版本：<v0.2.1-rc.2>
使用模型/Agent：<Deepseek-V4.1-Flash-1017>
2026.10.20
场景：read-only 沙箱模式

背景
我是从完全权限切换到只读模式下使用的，但切换后我没有明确指明其只能进行只读操作。我希望让 AI 指导我把项目部署到服务器。结果 AI 没有只给部署步骤，而是在只读模式下直接通过 ssh 连进远程服务器执行操作。命令格式为 ssh ip "mv ..."  。我询问他为什么没有拦截，他给出的理由是：DSH 的 read-only 沙箱管的是本机文件工具（write/edit、本机删除改写等），ssh ip "mv ..."这条命令在本机看来只是“启动一个出站进程”，真正被改的是服务器上的磁盘，不经过本机沙箱裁决，所以它没被拦

Context indicator pinned at 100%: pressureTokens exceeds the declared contextWindow (Auto/FallbacksChain)
threads.bodyText:
Symptom
With provider FallbacksChain / model Auto, the context indicator sits at 100 % for the rest of the session, although the live prompt is ~19.5k tokens (about 10 % of the reported window). It never recovers, so the indicator stops carrying information.
dsh 0.2.1-rc.2, macOS, default Web GUI.
What the session log says
request/context event:
{"provider":"FallbacksChain","model":"Auto","contextWindow":200000}
Usage samples from the same session (assistant stream, in order):



#
inputTokens
cacheReadTokens
cacheWriteTokens
outputTokens
totalTokens




1
23,963
0
0
91
24,054


2
143,734
684,160
0
2,091
829,985


3
101,977
105,856
0
643
208,476



The contextPressure projection then reports:
{"pressureTokens":827894,"contextWindow":200000,"surfaceTokens":19510,"sampledSurfaceTokens":19510,"projectedTokens":827894}
827894 / 200000 is about 414 %, and the UI clamps (dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js, contextOccupancy):
percent: Math.min(100, Math.round(usedTokens / pressure.contextWindow * 100))
Result: 100 %.
Why this looks wrong

pressureFrom counts inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens (dsh-token-meter/lib/index.js:367). On sample 2 that is 827,894, i.e. a prompt four times the declared 200k window, which a single request cannot have.
Sample 3 has cacheReadTokens (105,856) larger than inputTokens (101,977), so these are not prompt_tokens / cached_tokens of one Anthropic-style request. Either they are disjoint buckets, or the numbers aggregate several attempts.
The denominator comes from FallbacksChain.resolveModel, which forwards the head model's metadata (dsh-llm-fallbacks/dist/index.js:2873-2885). After a mid-turn fallback the answering model may have a different window than the head.

Expected

Denominator should describe the model that actually served the request (or be omitted when unknown).
Occupancy above 100 % should be shown as a mismatch ("window unknown") instead of a silent clamp, which currently looks like a full context.
Alternatively show surfaceTokens for live occupancy and keep pressureTokens as a separate (labelled) metric.

Side observation (minor)
glob/grep results carry the same match list twice: model-facing text in content and a structured meta with shape: "paths" / "matches". The meta is persisted with the session log and re-sent on every request, so a single glob of ~100 paths costs roughly double. The docs in dsh-tool-fs-search/lib/index.js describe this as intentional (the UI needs the structured shape); still worth revisiting, because the token cost lands on the model side.

threads.title: 桌面版从 0.2.0-rc.2 升到 0.2.1-rc.2：升级路径不可用 + 定制 profile 启动后进恢复模式（含二分证据）
threads.bodyText:
建议发到 Discussions（本仓库 has_issues: false，实测 New issue 按钮提示 "Issue creation is restricted in this repository"）。
下面「复现步骤」全部是可直接粘贴执行的命令，环境为 Windows 11 / 自打包桌面版（dsh-desktop-next 2.0.17-next）。

一句话结论
核心包升到 0.2.1-rc.2 后，出厂空白 profile 能干净启动，带真实定制（第三方插件 + 782 行 cordis.patch.yml）的 profile 一定进恢复模式，客户端报 16 个 entry 永不激活；而且报错文字不指明缺失的 provider 是谁，社区只能自己二分。升级过程本身还有 4 个结构性障碍（见 §4），合起来就是普通用户"升级非常繁琐"的技术原因。
1. 版本矩阵



项
值




壳
dsh-desktop-next 2.0.17-next（自打包 Electron 桌面版）


升级前核心
@deepseek-ai/dsh / dsh-agent / dsh-base / dsh-web-app = 0.2.0-rc.2


升级后核心
同上 = 0.2.1-rc.2（install exit 0，Done in 1m 3.1s，+959 包）


profile 插件
24 个 dependency（12 个 github:、8 个 npm 版本、3 个 link:）+ 32 项 dsh.profile.bundles + cordis.patch.yml 782 行 / 49149 字节


本地模型
llama.cpp OpenAI 兼容服务 127.0.0.1:8080（llama_status → models ["swift-1.5-iq3_s"] reachable），profile 内 provider qwen38



结论方向：provider 是 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace\lib\client.js:1380 的 super(ctx,"uiWorkspace")；副本与真身 node_modules 包集合 diff 一致、关键 UI 包都已是 rc.2，安装层无缺失 → 断点在 rc.2 客户端图 + 桌面壳（预打包于 0.2.0 时代）的组合，且第三方插件在场时触发。
4. 升级路径本身的 4 个结构性障碍

CLI 完全不能选 profile："DSH NEXT.exe" --profile desktop-rc2 → bad option: --profile；desktop-cli.js --help 写着支持 --profile / web / headless，实跑报 error: too many arguments. Expected 0 arguments but got 2: headless, "..."（bin.js:105 除 plugin 外没有子命令）。→ 无 GUI、无 SSH 的场景无法自测升级。
发布物缺私有依赖，pnpm install 必失败：app package.json:13 "@agents-anywhere/dsh-bridge-next": "file:../vendor/agents-anywhere/…tgz"，而装好的程序目录里根本没有 resources\vendor（打包者预装进 node_modules）→ ENOENT ... vendor\...tgz；pnpm 失败时还会把 12 个顶层目录（含 pnpm 自己）移进 node_modules\.ignored\。同理 dsh-community-market@0.1.0-dev.0 在 registry 不存在（latest=0.0.1）。
rc.2 不是完整发版：160 个 @deepseek-ai/* 依赖里 151 个有 0.2.1-rc.2，官方没发的 3 个只能钉回旧版 —— dsh-invariants（next=0.2.0-rc.2）、dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle（next=0.2.0-rc.2）、dsh-subagent-in-process-driver（next=0.2.1-alpha.1，比 rc.2 旧）。→ 把全部 pin 一把改成 rc.2 直接 ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION。
兼容性判定静默：profile 的 compatibility.json 只有 {"dsh-tool-folder@0.2.5": ["0.2.0-rc.2"]}，升 rc.2 后该插件被判不兼容、不加载且界面无提示；只能靠 --dump-config + compatibility.json 手写 {"plugin@ver": ["*"]} 豁免（实测有效：被拒插件 3 → 0）。

5. 请求（按性价比排序）

恢复模式报错请指名缺失 provider 的提供方 bundle（现在只给 consumer 侧 pending 清单，社区二分成本极高）。
桌面版提供可脚本化的 profile 选择 / 无头自检（--profile 在 Electron CLI 里必须能用，或给 dsh doctor --profile X）。
发版请保证依赖闭包完整：随 rc.2 发出 §4.3 那 3 个包，并把私有 bridge 的 tgz 打进发布物（或改成 registry 版本）。
插件不兼容请在设置界面显式列出「X 插件因兼容性未加载」，不要静默。
给出官方升级手册：核心在哪层（app vs profile）、compatibility.json 语义、file: 依赖与 link: 依赖在升级时怎么处理。

threads.title: Windows desktop: getUserMedia throws NotAllowedError while permissions.query reports granted
threads.bodyText:
Microphone permission is denied on Windows: permissions.query says granted, getUserMedia throws NotAllowedError
Environment



Item
Value




App
DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 (official Windows desktop build)


Electron
44.7.0


Node
24.21.0


OS
Windows 11 Home (China), 10.0.26200, Build 26200, x64


Page origin
dsh-app://app (as served by the desktop shell)


Feature
Built-in experimental voice input (the microphone button in the composer)



Steps to reproduce

Install the official Windows desktop build (0.2.1-rc.2) on Windows 11.
Confirm the OS allows microphone access:

Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone → Microphone access = On
Let desktop apps access your microphone = On
Registry: HKCU\...\CapabilityAccessManager\ConsentStore\microphone = Allow
and ...\microphone\NonPackaged = Allow


Open DevTools in the app window (Ctrl+Shift+I, devTools is enabled) and run:

navigator.permissions.query({ name: 'microphone' }).then(s => console.log(s.state))
navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true })
  .then(s => { console.log('OK'); s.getTracks()[0].stop() })
  .catch(e => console.log(e.name, e.message))
Actual behaviour
granted
NotAllowedError

The permission status reports granted, but the actual capture request is denied.
The in-app voice button shows:

麦克风权限未开启，请在浏览器和系统设置中允许访问。

Nothing is written to Windows' per-app microphone usage records
(ConsentStore\microphone\NonPackaged has no entry for
...\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe), which indicates the request is
rejected inside Chromium before it ever reaches the OS.
Expected behaviour
getUserMedia({ audio: true }) resolves, and the voice input starts recording.
Analysis
installMicrophonePermissions() installs two handlers whose predicates do not match.
The check handler uses the origin parameter, so it succeeds and reports granted:
session.setPermissionCheckHandler((contents, permission, origin, details) => {
  if (permission !== "media") return true;
  return contents != null
    && contents === primary()
    && details.isMainFrame
    && applicationFrame(origin)          // "dsh-app://app" → true
    && details.mediaType === "audio"
    && (process.platform !== "darwin" || ...);
});
The request handler instead requires details.mediaTypes to be present and to be
exactly ['audio']:
session.setPermissionRequestHandler((contents, permission, callback, details) => {
  if (permission !== "media") { callback(true); return; }
  if (!(contents === primary()
        && details.isMainFrame
        && applicationFrame(details.requestingUrl)
        && "mediaTypes" in details
        && details.mediaTypes.length === 1
        && details.mediaTypes[0] === "audio")) {
    callback(false);      // ← request denied here
    return;
  }
  ...
});
Per the Electron API, MediaAccessPermissionRequest.mediaTypes is optional:

mediaTypes string[] (optional) — The types of media access being requested - elements can be video or audio.
— https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/api/structures/media-access-permission-request

So when Electron 44 omits mediaTypes (or reports it in a shape the guard does not
expect), "mediaTypes" in details / the length check fails, the handler calls
callback(false), and the renderer receives NotAllowedError — while the check handler
still advertises granted.
The same applies to applicationFrame(details.requestingUrl): requestingUrl is a
PermissionRequest field, while the check handler compares a normalized origin.
Any difference between the two strings (or a missing value) also turns into a deny.
Suggested fix

Treat a missing mediaTypes as audio-only, e.g.
const types = details.mediaTypes ?? ['audio'].
Keep the check and request handlers' origin predicates identical
(compare new URL(details.requestingUrl).origin to the same allow-list used by the
check handler).
Consider being lenient: deny only when mediaTypes explicitly includes video.

Workaround that works
Launching the app with the Chromium switch below makes the capture request succeed,
because Chromium auto-accepts media requests at the engine level and never reaches the
request handler:
"DeepSeek Harness.exe" --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream

(Note: the switch is process-wide, so it also auto-grants microphone and camera to any
page opened inside the app, e.g. sidebar browser tabs. A proper fix is preferable.)
中文摘要
官方 Windows 桌面端（0.2.1-rc.2 / Electron 44.7.0）的实验性语音输入无法使用：

navigator.permissions.query({name:'microphone'}) 返回 granted
navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio:true}) 抛 NotAllowedError
Windows 的麦克风权限（总开关 + 桌面应用开关）均为「允许」，但系统没有记录到本应用的任何麦克风请求，说明请求在 Chromium 内部被拒

原因推测：installMicrophonePermissions 中「检查处理器」用 origin 参数判断，能够通过；
而「请求处理器」额外要求 details.mediaTypes 存在且等于 ['audio']。Electron 文档中
mediaTypes 是 optional，Electron 44 未传该字段时条件不成立，于是 callback(false)，
渲染进程收到 NotAllowedError。
建议：mediaTypes 缺省时按音频处理；两个处理器的来源判断保持一致。
临时绕过：以 --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream 启动应用即可正常录音。
