threads.title: Windows: overwriting or editing an existing file fails with SetFileSecurityW EACCES (Win32 5) when the workspace is on a ReFS volume (creating files and NTFS workspaces are unaffected)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On Windows with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, when the workspace lives on a ReFS volume (reported by fsutil as a
Developer Drive), write/edit of an existing file fails with SetFileSecurityW EACCES (Win32 5).
Creating new files and shell commands work; the same operations succeed on NTFS volumes.
Affected scenario: Windows users with a ReFS workspace cannot modify existing files with the file tools.
Reproduction

Provision a ReFS volume (here E: is a file-backed VHDX; Get-Disk reports BusType=File Backed Virtual) and create a workspace directory on it.
Run DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, profile web, with danger-full-access (to rule out the ACL sandbox).
Create E:\ws\demo\probe.txt with the file tools → succeeds.
write to the same file again (any content) → fails with SetFileSecurityW EACCES (Win32 5).
edit line 2 of that file → same error.
Repeat steps 4-5 on a NTFS volume (C: / D:) → both succeed.

Current behavior



Operation
E: (ReFS Dev Drive)
C: / D: (NTFS)




create a new file (write)
OK
OK


overwrite an existing file (write)
SetFileSecurityW EACCES (Win32 5)
OK


edit an existing file
SetFileSecurityW EACCES (Win32 5)
OK



Exact message:
Error: SetFileSecurityW EACCES (Win32 5): E:\ws\demo\src\Services\.Log.cs.5492.611cb9dd-7b07-403c-b970-0a76f64fd0a5.tmpdir\Log.cs.tmp

Shell commands are unaffected once the ACL sandbox is not in the path (profile running with
danger-full-access): dotnet --version = 10.0.402, git rev-parse works, git diff --stat works.
The failure is specific to the atomic-write publication path of the file tools.
Expected behavior
Overwriting and editing an existing file should succeed; if the volume cannot store security descriptors, the
write should fall back to publishing with rename (as already done for ENOENT) instead of failing the call.
Environment

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, profile web, Windows 11 (win32)
Workspace: E:\ws\demo — volume E: is ReFS, reported by fsutil fsinfo volumeinfo E: as a Developer Drive
(保留并加强 ACL, 支持完整性流), backed by a file-backed VHDX: Get-Disk 2 → FriendlyName=Msft Virtual Disk,
BusType=File Backed Virtual, Location=D:\vhd\devdrive.vhdx
fsutil devdrv query E: → 此卷已格式化为开发人员驱动器，但在此计算机上不可用
Control volumes C: / D: are NTFS, 1861 GB / 3726 GB

Root cause (narrowed)
writeFileAtomic in packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts (master, today) does, for platform === 'win32' && mode !== undefined:
await copyFileDacl(absolutePath, tempPath)   // fsio.ts:622-623
...
await replaceFile(absolutePath, tempPath)    // fsio.ts:641, fallback to rename only on ENOENT
copyFileDaclWin32 (win32.ts:103-114) reads the source DACL with GetFileSecurityW and re-applies it with
SetFileSecurityW using (DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION | PROTECTED_DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION).
On E: that call returns 0 and GetLastError() == 5; on C: it succeeds. New files use the hard-link publish
branch (createIfAbsent) which never copies a DACL — hence "new file OK, overwrite fails".
This is the same publication path as #3237 (ReplaceFileW EACCES), but failing one step earlier, at the DACL copy.
Closest analogue for the failing step on a non-NTFS volume: #3919 (Google Drive virtual FS, SetFileSecurityW Win32 87).
Evidence that it is not ReFS data-integrity semantics, and not the sandbox token
On the same volume/path:

write 200 KB of data → OK; read the file back → OK
read the DACL: GetFileSecurityW(DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION|LABEL_SECURITY_INFORMATION), needed = 152 → OK
Set-Acl on an E: file → UnauthorizedAccessException: 尝试执行未经授权的操作
create a file with an explicit security descriptor (FileSystemAclExtensions.Create) → RuntimeException
start a detached, out-of-sandbox process via WMI Win32_Process.Create (ReturnValue=0) and run
icacls 'E:\ws\demo\…' /grant %USERNAME%:F → still 拒绝访问; the same command on D: / C: prints GRANT_OK
icacls 'E:\ws\demo' → %USERNAME%:(OI)(CI)(F) (explicit, non-inherited) + Administrators/SYSTEM
FullControl, Authenticated Users Modify, Users ReadAndExecute, no Deny ace; owner = %USERNAME%
icacls 'E:\' → no ACE for %USERNAME% at all
process is unelevated (WindowsPrincipal.IsInRole(Administrator) = False), while net localgroup Administrators contains %USERNAME%

So the volume refuses writes of security descriptors from this context regardless of the DACL's contents
(adding the exact same grant as an explicit ACE makes no difference), while ordinary data writes and DACL reads work.
Workaround in use here
A profile patch row replaces the two internals hooks (the same seam as write-text/edit-text use):

copyFileDacl → best-effort: swallow ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (DACL copy is a hardening step, not a correctness requirement)
replaceFile → on SetFileSecurityW/ReplaceFileW access-denied, publish with rename(tempPath, absolutePath)

After that row, overwrite and edit on E: work; dotnet build → 0 warnings / 0 errors, dotnet test → 175/175.
Suggested fix
In writeFileAtomic, treat an access-denied copyFileDacl as non-fatal and publish via rename when
replaceFile reports access denied (currently only ENOENT is downgraded, fsio.ts:639-647).
Alternatively probe the volume once (e.g. a write of a buffer with DACL set) and cache "no SD writes" per volume.


AI-assistance disclosure: this report was drafted with AI assistance to make it reproducible.
Every command output, error string, version and source line number above comes from a real session on the
affected machine and was not rewritten; the diagnosis and suggested fix are inferences from those outputs
plus the upstream source, stated in a form that can be checked.

threads.title: [Bug] open-in-app returns 502 for all Electron-based editors (Cursor / VS Code / Windsurf) — scrubbedParentEnv() leaks ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1
threads.bodyText:
Environment

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.2), Windows 11 24H2 (build 26100), x64
Cursor 3.25.9 (Electron), PyCharm 2025.3.2.1 (JVM) — both installed locally
File policy: workspace-write

Steps to reproduce

Install Cursor (or VS Code) normally; make sure DSH's "Open in…" dropdown lists it (it resolves fine).
In the DSH Web GUI, click the split "Open in" button → Cursor.
Observe: toast 「打开失败，请重试」, and DevTools shows POST dsh-app://app/open-in-app/open → 502, body {"code":"launch-failed","message":"failed to launch cursor"}.

Works for PyCharm and "文件资源管理器" (Explorer, shell-open). Fails only for Electron-based editors.
Root cause
The DSH desktop main process runs in Electron node mode (ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1", set in lib/main.js of the desktop app), and that variable is inherited by the whole child tree. When open-in-app launches an external app it uses scrubbedParentEnv():

@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app/lib/index.js → launchDetachedApp():
spawn(command, args, { detached: true, stdio: "ignore", windowsHide, env: { ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...options.env } })
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess/lib/index.js → const SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN = /KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i;
scrubbedParentEnv() only strips that pattern and DSH_-prefixed keys.

(Paths above are from the shipped 0.2.1-rc.2 bundles; the TypeScript sources presumably live under packages/host/open-in-app and packages/shell/subprocess.)
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE is not filtered, so Cursor.exe "D:\project" boots as Node and treats the directory as a JS entry point:
Error: Cannot find module 'D:\project'
    at Module._resolveFilename (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:1524:15)
Node.js v24.18.1

Exit code 1 within the watch window → launchDetachedApp rejects (launcher exited with code 1) → route returns 502.
Verified on the same machine: with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE present, Cursor.exe --version prints v24.18.1 (the bundled Node version) instead of the Cursor version; with it unset, Cursor starts normally.
Secondary issue: the error detail is swallowed
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-open-in-app/lib/client.js (OpenInAppController.launch):
if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`open failed: HTTP ${String(response.status)}`);
The host's { code, message } is dropped, so the UI can only show 「打开失败，请重试」 and users cannot self-diagnose. Suggest surfacing message (or logging it to the console) in OpenInAppController.launch.
Suggested fix
Strip process-mode-altering variables in scrubbedParentEnv() (or in launchDetachedApp for external app launches):
const SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN = /KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i;
const DROP_EXACT = new Set([
  "ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE",
  "ELECTRON_NO_ATTACH_CONSOLE",
  "ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING",
  "NODE_OPTIONS",
]);
Rationale: any Electron app launched by open-in-app is affected (Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf are all in OPEN_IN_APP_CATALOG), so this is a catalog-wide bug, not a Cursor-specific one.
Workaround used locally (not a fix)
Redirect HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\Cursor.exe to a small wrapper that clears ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE / ELECTRON_NO_ATTACH_CONSOLE / NODE_OPTIONS and then starts the real Cursor.exe. The wrapper must live outside the workspace: on Windows, DSH's ACL sandbox labels the workspace (and everything under it) as Low integrity + NO_WRITE_UP, and a process started from a Low-labeled image runs Low — where Chromium's sandbox fails (STATUS_BREAKPOINT 0x80000003) and %APPDATA% writes fail with EPERM. That secondary effect is worth a doc note: executables placed inside a DSH workspace run at Low integrity.
中文摘要
DSH 桌面端以 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 运行，scrubbedParentEnv() 只过滤 KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN 与 DSH_ 前缀，没过滤这个变量。于是 open-in-app 启动 Cursor / VS Code 这类 Electron 应用时，它们被当成 Node 运行时，把工程目录当脚本加载 → 立刻非 0 退出 → 接口返回 502。PyCharm（JVM）和资源管理器（shell-open）不受影响，所以表现为「只有 Cursor 打不开」。
建议：scrubbedParentEnv() 增加精确剥离 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE、ELECTRON_NO_ATTACH_CONSOLE、NODE_OPTIONS（以及 ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING）。另外前端 client.ts 把宿主返回的 message 丢了，只显示「打开失败，请重试」，建议透出。

threads.title: [Bug] Cordis loader fails to import a valid ESM plugin entry point (failed to import)
"Open in app" 菜单无法启动vscode
threads.bodyText:
问题概述
"Open in app" 菜单能正确识别 VS Code 和 Cursor，但启动失败（HTTP 502 launch-failed）。同一菜单里的 PyCharm、文件资源管理器、Windows Terminal 均能正常启动。
根本原因
桌面端主进程以 Electron 的 Node 模式启动 host（lib/main.js → desktopNodeEnvironment()），因此 host 的环境变量里带着 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1。@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-open-in-app 通过 scrubbedParentEnv() （@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess）构造启动器环境，而该函数只清除 KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN 以及 DSH_* 命名的变量。ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE 因此被保留下来，导致所有 Electron 系编辑器都以纯 Node 模式启动、而非 GUI， 随即以退出码 1 退出，launchDetachedApp 把这次退出判定为启动失败。
建议修复
packages/host/open-in-app/src/resolver.ts → launchDetachedApp：在合并适配器 的显式 env 之前，先从父环境里剔除该标志（GitHub Desktop 会主动传入 ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: "1"，因此显式值仍须优先）。
影响范围
所有 Electron 系编辑器：VS Code、VS Code Insiders、Cursor、VSCodium、 Windsurf。原生启动器（JetBrains）、Explorer shell verb 与 Windows Terminal 不受影响。

threads.title: [Bug] workspace.json 的 sessionIds 被静默截断，重启后历史会话从侧边栏消失
threads.bodyText:
问题描述
DeepSeek Harness 桌面端重启后，侧边栏中所有历史会话消失，仅显示当前会话。磁盘上的会话数据文件完好无损，但 workspace.json 中的 sessionIds 索引被静默截断。
环境信息

应用：DeepSeek Harness 桌面端（Windows）
操作系统：Windows 10/11
用户名包含非 ASCII 字符：是汉字
DSH 数据目录：%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\

复现步骤

正常使用 DSH 桌面端数天，在同一工作区下积累多个会话。
关闭并重新打开 DSH 桌面端（或重启电脑）。
观察到侧边栏仅显示最新的一个会话，之前的所有会话均消失。

根因分析
~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json 文件中每个工作区维护了一个 sessionIds 数组。重启后该数组从 5 条记录缩减为 1 条，但磁盘上全部 5 个会话目录及其 projcache JSON 文件均完好存在：
// 预期状态（正常）
"sessionIds": [
  "session-666417ac-...",
  "session-7f8586dd-...",
  "session-a0eac71f-...",
  "session-743bd856-...",
  "session-011ec8c0-..."
]

// 实际状态（异常）
"sessionIds": [
  "session-666417ac-..."   // 仅剩最新会话
]

threads.title: DSH 0.2 plugin ecosystem: 5 questions after debugging plugins on Windows (notes included)
threads.bodyText:
Hi everyone 👋
I've been running DSH on Windows with 0.2.0-rc.2 and spent the last few days debugging plugin issues for my setup. I wrote everything down and open-sourced it here: https://github.com/qinyangcheng8-lab/dsh-field-notes
The notes cover: plugin breakage after the 0.2 upgrade, pnpm lockfile recovery after an interrupted pnpm remove, the 0.2 RPC wire format, Windows sandbox ACL problems, and building client-side (slot-injected) plugins.
A few questions I could not answer from the docs or the code alone:


Plugin API migration. 0.2 removed installSettingsSection and settingsNamespace from @deepseek-ai/dsh-settings, and assertNever from @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm. Third-party plugins that statically import those names now fail at module-link time (The requested module ... does not provide an export named ...), so the host half never mounts. What is the recommended migration path — SettingsProvider.installSection on newer hosts? Is there a compat shim, or are settings sections simply unsupported in 0.2?


Plugin health check. Is there an official way to list loaded plugins and report load failures? Right now I smoke-test by dynamically import()-ing every package under the profile's node_modules and diffing against dsh.profile.bundles. bundles appears to be the only source of truth for "is this plugin actually enabled" — worth documenting if so.


Prompt-cache best practices. In long sessions every step re-sends the context. Any change to the tool set or injected sources breaks the prefix, and the cache hit rate can jump from ~0.1% to >10% (uncached tokens cost roughly 50x more). Is "freeze injected sources and batch all changes into one window" the recommended approach? Is there a recommended way to measure hit rate?


"webchat"-style plugins. Plugins that drive the DeepSeek web UI to avoid API billing — is that path still viable on 0.2, or is it deliberately not supported? If not supported, is there any recommended alternative for cheap "quick questions" outside the main session?


Sandbox boundary. Under workspace-write, writing to $DSH_HOME/profiles/** fails with EPERM and requires danger-full-access. Is that intended (profiles are protected), or is it an oversight that could be relaxed for plugin management use cases?


Happy to add more detail or reproduce any of these. Thanks for the great tool! 🐋

中文摘要（给中文用户）
这篇帖子是在 Windows + DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 上踩了一周插件坑之后整理的，完整笔记开源在这里：https://github.com/qinyangcheng8-lab/dsh-field-notes
想请教 5 个问题：

插件 API 迁移：0.2 移除了 installSettingsSection / settingsNamespace（dsh-settings）和 assertNever（dsh-llm），静态 import 的插件在模块链接期直接报 does not provide an export named ...，host 段根本挂不上。推荐的迁移方式是 SettingsProvider.installSection 吗？有没有兼容层？
插件健康检查：有没有官方的「已加载插件 / 加载失败」查询命令或 RPC？现在只能对 node_modules 逐个 import() 冒烟，再按 dsh.profile.bundles 判断是否启用——如果「bundles 才是唯一启用清单」属实，建议写进文档。
前缀缓存：长会话每步都会重发上下文，工具集或注入源一变，命中率就从 0.1% 级别崩到十几个百分点（未命中价差约 50 倍）。官方是否建议「冻结注入源、所有改动攒到同一窗口」？有没有推荐的量化方式？
webchat 类插件：用网页版对话替代 API 计费的插件，在 0.2 上还有没有可行路径？如果没有，有没有别的方式做「低成本快问快答」？
沙箱边界：workspace-write 下写 $DSH_HOME/profiles/** 直接 EPERM，必须 danger-full-access。这是有意保护 profiles，还是可以放宽？

感谢阅读 🙏

threads.title: [auto-review] Reviewer reuses the persona-injected model route & history → emits prose instead of the JSON protocol → every tool call fails closed (Auto preset unusable under custom personas)
threads.bodyText:
Component: @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review (experimental, packages/experimental/auto-review), version seen in the packaged app: 0.2.1-rc.2
Trigger: Auto permission preset (auto-authorization reviewer) + a session whose context carries a strong persona/instruction injection (memory plugin / custom system prompt)
Severity: High for affected users — it makes the entire Auto mode unusable (every tool call is rejected before its body runs), and the failure is silent to non-technical users.

TL;DR
The Auto reviewer is instructed to return exactly one JSON object (REVIEW_POLICY), and the response is parsed with a strict JSON.parse in parseDecision. But classifyRisk:

sends the review request through the current session's own model route (provider/model come straight from session.requestHeader()), and
includes the session's raw user-message history in the FILTERED_HISTORY section — including persona / memory injections that are tagged as human-instruction.

When the active model route has a strong persona system context (here: a Chinese "whale-girl maid" persona with 只输出简体中文 / "reply in Simplified Chinese only" / self-referential roleplay), that persona overrides the JSON-only output contract. The reviewer replies in in-character Chinese prose, JSON.parse throws on the very first CJK token, readDecision → parseDecision throws, classifyRisk rejects, and the gate returns:
Auto review of tool "<name>" failed; its body was not executed: Unexpected token '本', "本鲸先把真实启动路径"... is not valid JSON

Because a reviewer failure is materialized as kind: "deny", the tool never executes and the whole task stalls — not because the action is dangerous, but because the judge was role-playing.
Exact code path (from packages/experimental/auto-review/src/index.ts @ master)

REVIEW_POLICY — fixed system text; correctly says "Return exactly one JSON object and no other text" and "never by … message tone". This is fine.
classifyRisk() builds GenerateOptions:
provider: snapshot.provider,   // == session.requestHeader().config.provider
model:    snapshot.model,      // == session.requestHeader().config.model  ← SAME route as the main agent
system:   REVIEW_POLICY,
messages: [{ role: 'user', content: [{ type: 'text', text: reviewUserText(snapshot) }] }],
temperature: 0,
→ the reviewer shares the main agent's model route, so whatever persona/LANG_ZH_CN_ONLY behavior that route exhibits leaks into the reviewer.
snapshotAutoReview() → filteredUserEntries() pushes every non-tool user/message into history, and textRole() classifies real human user messages as human-instruction. Persona/memory content delivered as user-role context is therefore fed to the reviewer as an authoritative instruction.
reviewUserText() serializes snapshot.history verbatim into the FILTERED_HISTORY section.
readDecision() → parseDecision():
const value = JSON.parse(text)   // throws SyntaxError on non-JSON / prose
The thrown error becomes the failure message, and:
function failed(exec, error) {
  return { kind: 'deny', reason: `Auto review of tool "${exec.name}" failed; its body was not executed: ${message}` };
}


Observed evidence (this session)
Repeated pwsh/ops_bash calls all returned Auto review … failed; its body was not executed: Unexpected token '<CJK>', "<persona prose>"... is not valid JSON, with a different in-character Chinese sentence each time (本鲸 / 呜 / 主人别急 / 好的主人 …), confirming it is live model output being role-played, not corrupted static data. Setting the approval policy to never (which bypasses this reviewer gate entirely) made the identical call succeed immediately — isolating the gate as the cause.
Why it matters

The failure is fail-closed: an ambiguous judge silently blocks legitimate, user-authorized work. The user sees no "reviewer" concept, just tools mysteriously refusing to run.
Custom personas / system-prompt layers are a first-class, encouraged DSH feature (memory plugins, dsh-plugin, etc.). Auto mode silently breaks for any user using them.
The error surfaces only as a SyntaxError string; there is no retry, no "output wasn't JSON" re-prompt, and no fallback.

Suggested fixes (any one helps; 1+3 together are robust)

Don't reuse the main route for the reviewer. Send classifyRisk through a dedicated, neutral authorization route (own provider/model, no session persona). The reviewer is a mechanical judge; it must not inherit role-play.
Filter persona/style context out of FILTERED_HISTORY. Style/instruction injections are irrelevant to effect-based risk classification. Either drop agent-instructions/persona blocks that aren't genuine human turn text, or tag them with a role (e.g. style-context) that the policy explicitly states must not affect output format or tone.
Make decision parsing robust to prose. Before JSON.parse, extract the first balanced top-level JSON object from the text (tolerate leading/trailing prose). Only treat it as a hard failure if no parseable object exists.
On non-JSON output, re-prompt once with a tightened "you returned non-JSON; output ONLY the JSON object" follow-up instead of failing closed on the first slip.
Prefer native structured output (provider JSON-schema / constrained tool-call) over a prose protocol, so tone can't bleed into the response.
Distinguish "reviewer failed" from "reviewer denied" in UX/logging — today both read as tool denial to the user, hiding a judge-side bug as a permission problem.

Repro

Enable the Auto permission preset (auto-authorization reviewer).
Load a strong persona with an explicit "reply only in one language, in character" instruction (e.g. via a memory/plugin system-prompt layer).
Ask the agent to run any tool (even a read-only pwsh Get-ChildItem).
The reviewer returns in-character prose; the call is rejected with Auto review of tool "…" failed; … is not valid JSON, and the tool body never runs.
Switching approval to never (bypassing the gate) makes the same call succeed.

Environment: Windows 11, DSH Desktop build (packaged app.asar), reviewer plugin @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-auto-review@0.2.1-rc.2.

threads.title: Model misreads delivered messages as empty/zero-width-space messages and replies "empty message, maybe a mis-touch"
threads.bodyText:
Environment

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 0.2.1-rc.2, npm @deepseek-ai/dsh, dsh web on Linux (Ubuntu 22.04, Node 22)
Custom model provider: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (company LLM gateway relaying to GLM-5.3),
model id auto, reasoning effort high
Web UI, Chinese conversations; long multi-step sessions

Symptom
In long multi-step turns (steps 2..N of a turn), the model repeatedly states in its reasoning
that "the user just sent an empty message (a zero-width space)", and sometimes answers with
"you sent an empty message, maybe a mis-touch" — although the user's message was delivered
normally. It starts intermittently and then recurs on almost every step/turn in that session.
Evidence that the user's message WAS delivered

Session event log contains the exact text (user/message seq 718, 794).
A request-capturing proxy (provider baseURL -> local proxy -> gateway) shows the actual
outbound request for the step that made the claim: 97 messages; the full 68-char user message
is present at index 94/97; U+200B count in the whole request: 0; no empty user messages;
42/42 tool_call IDs matched.
The model answered that same question correctly in the same step, then appended
"the message I received was empty (only a zero-width char)" — self-contradictory.

Where U+200B actually appears
Only inside the assistant's own reasoning text (e.g. The user sent just "​" (zero-width space)),
never in any user/tool message nor in the outbound request.
First occurrence: turn 2 step 5 — reasoning starts with "The user has now sent an empty-ish
continuation (ZWSP)". Afterwards the model keeps re-referencing this belief.
Likely amplifier: reasoning replay + no empty-content sanitisation

dsh replays prior reasoning: 39 of 42 assistant messages in the captured request carry
reasoning_content. A one-off misreading is fed back each following step and self-reinforces.
Comparison with opencode 1.18.31 on the same gateway/model (5-day, 228-message session):
it hit empty-content events 42 times, but represents them explicitly in assistant content as
[System: Empty message content sanitised to satisfy protocol].
That marker is absent in dsh sessions/captures (0 occurrences); the model never misreads those
as user messages there, and the user never sees "empty message" replies.

Suggestion

For empty content (including empty model responses where the protocol needs non-empty content),
insert an explicit system-labelled placeholder (as above) instead of an empty/zero-width
placeholder that can be attributed to the user.
Reconsider replaying reasoning_content verbatim, or annotate/isolate it so a reasoning error
cannot self-reinforce across steps.
If a zero-width space placeholder is used during request assembly, tag it with a system note so
the model cannot interpret it as user input.

Repro sketch

dsh web + custom OpenAI-compatible provider to a reasoning model
Long session with multi-step tool loops (dozens of steps, context pressure >70%)
Ask a question requiring several tool calls; steps >=2 start claiming an empty user message
Capture the outbound request to confirm user text present and U+200B absent
(redacted request excerpts / session log slices available on request)

threads.title: dsh web: keepAliveTimeout (5 s default) still unfixed in 0.2.1-rc.2 — independent reproduction and verified fix
threads.bodyText:
Continues #2270, which was closed as Q&A on 2026-08-16 with no answer and no code change. The bug is still
present in the newest published package: @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver@0.2.1-rc.2 (npm tag next)
contains zero occurrences of keepAliveTimeout, and createServer is still called without any timeout
configuration.
Summary
On a high-latency link (~300 ms RTT) the browser cannot complete the WebSocket upgrade to /api/remote.mux.
The UI stays on "reconnecting" and chats never load. On the server side nothing is visible: no request
line, no status code, no log entry, because the handshake dies before the request is read. This makes the
failure expensive to diagnose — the browser-trust fence, cookies, TLS, the reverse-proxy shape and
Tailscale/DERP were all verified innocent first.
Reproduction

dsh --profile web --port 3080 --tls-cert … --tls-key … on a host reachable over a high-latency path.
Expose it through an L4 forward, e.g. tailscale serve --bg --tcp 3080 tcp://127.0.0.1:3080.
From a client at ~200–400 ms RTT load the UI, let the connection go idle, then reload.
Browser console: repeated WebSocket connection to 'wss://…/api/remote.mux' failed: The network connection was lost.

Server-side proof: strace -f -p <pid> -e trace=read shows zero GET /api/remote.mux reads over 90 s
while ordinary HTTP traffic keeps flowing. Probes that always open a fresh connection (curl,
http.request) upgrade fine — the failure only occurs on connection reuse.
Current behavior

Upgrade fails repeatedly, UI stuck on "reconnecting".
Server logs nothing.
Response headers: Connection: keep-alive, Keep-Alive: timeout=5.

Expected behavior
The upgrade succeeds when the browser reuses a connection it had kept idle, and the session stays stable.
Analysis
Matches #2270: createServer() / createServer$1() in @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver set neither
keepAliveTimeout nor headersTimeout, so Node's 5 000 ms default applies. Browsers keep idle keep-alive
connections and reuse them for the upgrade; at ~300 ms RTT the server's FIN has not arrived yet.
Fix verified locally (immediately before this.server.listen(...)):
this.server.keepAliveTimeout = 65000;
this.server.headersTimeout = 66000;
Result: Keep-Alive: timeout=65, three live mux sessions exchanging ping traffic (~120 bytes per 8 s), and
no reconnects across 90-second windows and a 120-second single-connection hold — with two different
browsers (Safari and Firefox).
Additionally useful for a fix: making both values configurable on the webserver entry, and defaulting
keepAliveTimeout well above 5 000 ms, since deployments behind a proxy/NAT are exactly the ones that hit it.
Environment

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (npm global), Node 22.22.1
Raspberry Pi 5, aarch64, Linux 6.12
dsh --profile web --port 3080 --no-open --trusted-host <tailnet-name> --tls-cert … --tls-key …
Transport: tailscale serve --bg --tcp 3080 tcp://127.0.0.1:3080 (L4, no L7 proxy)
Clients: macOS, Safari and Firefox, RTT ~300 ms

threads.title: Intermittent opaque `400 {"model":"..."}` from OpenCode Go ends the turn without retry
threads.bodyText:
Summary
OpenCode Go intermittently rejects a fully valid chat request with a 31-byte body that
contains no error information at all — just the requested model id:
HTTP 400
{"model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash"}

The exact same bytes succeed on immediate replay, so the refusal is transient. But
dsh-llm-pi-ai classifies every 400 as INVALID_REQUEST
(packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts, classifyPiAiError), and INVALID_REQUEST
is not in the default retryable set
(packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts, DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES =
EMPTY_RESPONSE, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT). So one transient
gateway refusal ends the entire turn, with an error message the user cannot act on.
Environment

DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (desktop 0.12.1), Windows
Provider route: opencode-go (https://opencode.ai/inference/go), openai-completions
Model: deepseek-v4.1-flash

What was observed
A local passthrough proxy was placed in front of the OpenCode Go endpoint (plain HTTP,
records the outgoing body, forwards to https://opencode.ai/inference/go, streams the
response back). One normal working session produced 15 requests:



#
messages
tools
body
result




1–14
85 → 111
255
~1.1 MB
200 every time


15
113
255
1,148,636 B
400, 31-byte body



The failing request is structurally unremarkable:

messages is present and is an array of 113 elements;
tools holds 255 schemas; stream: true; max_tokens within the model's limit;
x-opencode-session carries the stable conversation id, as the Go docs require;
compared with the previous successful request it differs only by two appended messages.

Replay experiment (the decisive part)
The captured failing body was replayed verbatim:



variant
result




identical body, original x-opencode-session × 3
200 (≈20 s)


identical body, fresh x-opencode-session × 2
200 (≈11–15 s)


identical body with tools removed
200


body reduced to the first message
200



Same bytes: 400 at the time, 200 minutes later. This rules out request content,
session header, quota, max_tokens, body size, and tool schemas.
For completeness, the terse body can be reproduced deterministically — but only by
omitting the messages field entirely ({"model": ...}, messages: null, {}, or a
string all return {"model":"<id>"}), while messages: [] returns a different, explicit
Empty input messages error. That is a red herring for the case above: the captured
request definitely had messages.
Where DSH turns a transient refusal into a dead turn
// packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts
if (/\b400\b|invalid.?request/i.test(message)) return 'INVALID_REQUEST'
// packages/llm/llm/src/retry-policy.ts
const DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES = Object.freeze([
  EMPTY_RESPONSE_CODE, 'RATE_LIMIT', 'SERVER', 'TIMEOUT', 'TRANSPORT',
])
And the retry executor skips anything outside that list:
// packages/llm/llm-retry/src/index.ts
} else if (!policy.retryableCodes.includes(failure.code)) return next()
So the chain is: transient gateway refusal → INVALID_REQUEST → not retryable →
turn/end with {"kind":"error","error":{"code":"INVALID_REQUEST", ...}} → the user sees
only 400 {"model":"deepseek-v4.1-flash"} and must retry by hand.
Suggested fixes


classifyPiAiError — don't treat an information-free 4xx as permanent.
A 4xx whose payload carries no error / message / detail field is not evidence
that the request is malformed. Classify it as SERVER (already retryable) or add a
dedicated retryable code such as PROVIDER_REJECTED.


Give the failure message context. 400 {"model":"…"} mentions no provider, no
endpoint, and no payload digest, so neither a user nor a log reader can tell whether
the request, the route, or the gateway is at fault.


Consider bounded retry for INVALID_REQUEST. The current comment explains the
intent — a rejected body cannot succeed by resending — but the evidence above shows
providers do return transient 400s. A small maxRetries with backoff would cover it.


Workaround available today (no code change)
Per-route policy override in the profile patch layer; only the affected route opts in:
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      opencode-go:
        apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY
        retryPolicy:
          mode: normal
          maxRetries: 3
          retryableCodes:
            - EMPTY_RESPONSE
            - RATE_LIMIT
            - SERVER
            - TIMEOUT
            - TRANSPORT
            - INVALID_REQUEST
          backoff:
            initialDelayMs: 1000
            maxDelayMs: 15000
            jitterRatio: 0.2
Cost: a genuinely malformed request now retries up to three times before failing.

No credentials, session identifiers, endpoints of private services, or conversation
content are included in this report. The captured request body was reduced to the
structural facts listed above.

threads.title: Resume fails with "already registered" when a profile bundle and the session preset mount the same plugins
threads.bodyText:
Version: DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, macOS arm64 (nightly feed)
Symptom
Resuming an existing session fails with a RemoteError that lists core tools and prompt sections as duplicated:
RemoteError: persona (@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona): prompt section "deployment:persona-prefix" is already registered (for a per-agent override, register through that agent's agent.ctx instead)
tool-bash (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash): prompt section "tool:bash" is already registered ...
tool "todo_write" is already registered (for a per-agent variant, register through that agent's agent.ctx instead)
...
tool-subagent (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent): tool-subagent: standing modelSelectionSettings requires a scoped preset Context
(gateway/internal)


The affected session header is agentPreset: "cordis".
New sessions start fine; only this session's resume fails.
The session log itself is intact.

Environment

Desktop profile with 15 bundles and a hand-maintained cordis.patch.yml.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex appeared both in dsh.profile.bundles and as an installed dependency, plus patch-level entries for the same plugin family.
Two subagent providers (dsh-subagent-codex, dsh-subagent-claude-code) are installed as dependencies.

What changed it
Removing @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex from dsh.profile.bundles (keeping the dependency installed and leaving the remaining patch config) made the resume work again — the duplicate mount disappeared.
Hypothesis / question
It looks like resuming a preset-backed session mounts the preset's plugin set into the same (Host) scope that already has those plugins registered from the profile bundles, so every NamedEntries registration throws instead of scoping into agent.ctx.
Questions:

Is there a supported way to declare a plugin exactly once when both a bundle and a session preset may provide it, without disabling the bundle entirely?
Should resume degrade gracefully (scope the preset mounts, or report a single clear error) instead of emitting a wall of duplicate-registration errors?
Any recommended ordering between dsh.profile.bundles and cordis.patch.yml entries to avoid double mounts?

Happy to attach a redacted profile patch/config if useful.

threads.title: 会话中途注册的 MCP 工具会让该会话此后每一轮 400：`tool_addition` blocks can only be in `system` messages
threads.bodyText:
Summary
会话进行到中途时，一个 MCP server 连上并把工具补进注册表，DSH 会在该轮写出一条 developer/message（source.kind = "tool-registry"，内容是若干 tool-addition 块）。此后每一轮都要重放这条消息，而 Messages 端点返回 400：
messages.112: `tool_addition` blocks can only be in `system` messages

结果是该会话永久不可用：用户消息正常入库、助手一轮都不回，UI 侧没有任何错误提示，用户只能丢弃会话重新开始。
English: after an MCP server registers tools mid-session, the session is poisoned by the recorded tool-addition message; every later turn is rejected with messages.N: tool_addition blocks can only be in system messages (400, INVALID_REQUEST).
Reproduction

起一个会话，此时某个 MCP server 尚未连上（工具不在注册表里）；
让该 MCP server 在会话进行中连上（例如服务先挂、随后被 launchd/重连拉起），使它的工具在后续某一轮才进入注册表；
这一轮会写出一条 developer/message，source.kind = "tool-registry"，content 为若干 {"type":"tool-addition","toolName":"…"}；
从这一轮起，每次发消息都返回 messages.N: tool_addition blocks can only be in system messages，表现为"发消息没有回复"。

复现性：我本地两次踩到（一次是 29 个工具的中继首次连上，一次是重启后补连），无例外。
Current behavior
同一会话连续三轮 step 1 直接失败，assistant/attempt 的错误逐字如下（code: INVALID_REQUEST, status: 400）：
messages.112: `tool_addition` blocks can only be in `system` messages (request_id: 29e341ef-5a64-43e2-bedf-c5f75086c446)
messages.112: `tool_addition` blocks can only be in `system` messages (request_id: e0527d5e-e0ac-486b-9f1e-acbbc7ad3113)
messages.112: `tool_addition` blocks can only be in `system` messages (request_id: d33a7259-e5e2-4d84-9d2d-f890bf8ce14d)

会话记录（第 12 轮）里唯一新增的记录是工具注册：
seq 1508  system/message        （运行时上下文）
seq 1509  user/message          （用户发「验证」）
seq 1510  request/header        （工具表快照：29 个 mcp__klox__* 工具均在）
seq 1511  developer/message     source.kind = "tool-registry"，29 × {"type":"tool-addition","toolName":"mcp__klox__…"}
seq 1512  assistant/attempt     → 400

第 13、14 轮只多了一条 user/message，没有新的 developer/message，错误依旧且下标相同（messages.112）——说明失败请求被当作历史的一部分反复重放，会话自身无法恢复。
注意该下标是 0 基：线上被拒的是第 113 条消息，其角色不是 system。
Expected behavior

这些请求应当成功：工具变更不应让整轮请求报废；
即使请求失败，也不应让会话进入"永久失败"状态（重放同一段历史必须仍能成功）；
工具变更的编码方式应满足端点约束（端点明确要求 tool_addition 只出现在 system 消息里）。

Environment



项
值




DSH
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.2（npm 全局安装，launchd 常驻 dsh --profile web）


OS / Node
macOS Darwin 27.2.0 arm64 / node v24.21.0


provider / model
deepseek-account / deepseek-flash（systemPromptUpdate: "in-history"）


MCP
klox（streamable-http 本地中继，29 个工具，会话进行中才连上）



Additional analysis
按 0.2.1-rc.2 的 @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek（lib/index.js）阅读，这条 developer 消息只可能落到末尾的 system 消息里：

lib/index.js:1625 flushSystemUpdates：仅在 messages.at(-1)?.role === "user" 时追加累积的 system 更新；
lib/index.js:1638 / :1645：tool-addition / tool-removal 被翻成 {type:"tool_addition", tool:{type:"tool_reference", name}} 并包进 {role:"system", content:[…]}；
lib/index.js:1685：只在进入 assistant 消息前以及循环结束时 flush；
lib/index.js:2216：仅当 body.messages 含有 tool_addition/tool_removal 时才加 anthropic-beta: mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01（常量在 :560）。

但我用同一把 key 直连 https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages（model: deepseek-flash）做对照，凡是"末尾 system 消息 + 若干 tool_addition 块"的形状全部 200，包括：

1 个块 / 29 个块；
带 / 不带上述 beta 头；
带顶层 system 参数，以及 [user, system(text), system(tool_addition)] 相邻；
112 条消息的长历史 + 末尾 [user, system(tool_addition)]；
[user, system(tool_addition), user]、[user, assistant, system, user]。

唯一能复现逐字相同错误的形状，是把块放进非 system 消息：
// messages[0] 是 user，其中掺入一个 tool_addition
{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"a"},
  {"type":"tool_addition","tool":{"type":"tool_reference","name":"demo_tool"}}]}
// → 400 messages.0: `tool_addition` blocks can only be in `system` messages
（我已逐一排除 prepareRequestExtensions、dsh-deepseek-llm-api-extensions（只加顶层字段）与 prepareImages（只替换图片引用）会改动 messages。）
因此想请你们确认：除了 serialize()，还有哪条路径会把历史重新投影成 messages，从而可能把 tool-change 块放在非 system 消息里？ 可疑方向：compaction / 标题等旁路请求、dsh-api-session-controller 的重放路径，或端点对"末尾 system 更新"在某些条件下做的内部合并。
Workaround
在 serialize() 之后、prepareRequestExtensions 之前加一层归一化：把任意消息里的 tool_addition / tool_removal 块改写成等价文本（Tool now available: <name> / Tool no longer available: <name>，任何位置都合法），并把改写前的消息角色与块结构写进日志。上述 29 块形状改写后实测 200，会话立即恢复。
建议官方在请求出口做同类防御，或保证重放时丢弃失效的工具变更。

本报告由本人 DSH 会话中的 Agent 整理；日志、请求下标（0 基）与上述直连对照均在本机复现。

threads.title: 【Bug】慢性累积型 bug
threads.bodyText:
每次启动成功，都会在 Chromium cookie 库里写入一条认证 cookie，且 name 是随机的 （dsh-auth-<随机串> ，每条约 225B）
Chromium 按 name+domain+path 判重——随机 name 永不覆盖、永不清理 ，每启动一次永久累积一条
累积约 70 次后，请求头里的 Cookie 总量 16186 字节 ，突破了宿主 Node http 服务的 16KB 请求头上限
宿主返回 431 Request Header Fields Too Large → 壳判定“认证失败” → 弹出错误，导致无法使用。

threads.title: Near-window turns are not classified as context overflow: output !== 0 or < 99% misses recovery (2 defects)
threads.bodyText:
Two defects make a near-window turn unrecoverable without a human
DSH 0.2.1-rc.2. A turn that stops on length with a small but non-zero output token count near the context window is not classified as context overflow, so the built-in recovery never runs and the turn dies turn-fatal.
Defect 1 — isContextOverflow() under-detects (pi-ai adapter)
Case 3 of isContextOverflow requires both:
message.usage.output === 0  &&  input+cacheRead >= contextWindow * 0.99
Real observed failures missed both conditions. Homelab route, contextWindow = 1,048,576:



session
seq
outputTokens
input+cacheRead
% of window
Case 3 fires?




7776739a
5190
1
1,024,835
97.7%
no


7776739a
5287
1
1,036,806
98.9%
no


7776739a
5295
1
1,036,807
98.9%
no


b771ceb8
4566
1
975,170
93.0%
no



Nine failing turns in one session, two in another. Each emitted exactly one token.
Consequence
Because the finish is not classified CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED, the agent/request-error recovery handler (which compacts and returns {kind:"retry"}, bounded by maxOverflowRetries) never fires. mapStopReason then maps length unconditionally to max-tokens:
case "length": return { kind: "max-tokens" };
and a max-tokens finish is turn-fatal: the loop latches it and returns before executeToolCalls, silently abandoning pending tool calls. The goal driver then disarms. A human must send "continue". Observed stalls ran for hours.
Defect 2 — isRecoverableLength() is dead code
export function isRecoverableLength(message, desiredMaxOutput) {
    return message.stopReason === "length" && desiredMaxOutput > 0 && message.usage.output < desiredMaxOutput;
}
It is exported and documented as enabling "one bounded compact-and-retry attempt", but occurs exactly once in the shipped bundle — its own definition. Nothing calls it. A designed recovery path that was never wired.
Suggested fix
Broaden Case 3 to tolerate small non-zero output at a wider margin:
const out = message.usage.output ?? 0
const inp = message.usage.input + message.usage.cacheRead
if (contextWindow && message.stopReason === "length"
    && out <= SMALL_OUTPUT_TOKENS            // e.g. 32
    && inp >= contextWindow * NEAR_WINDOW) { // e.g. 0.95, not 0.99
    return true
}
and wire isRecoverableLength (or its intent) so a length-stop short of the requested maxTokens gets the one bounded compact-and-retry it was designed for.
Why this matters beyond one harness
We confirmed a userland plugin can recover these turns: it detects the shape via agent/turn-stopping, calls ctx.compaction.compactIfNeeded(agent, "context-overflow", signal) (which, unlike compactNow(), takes no idle admission), and steers the turn open. A controlled A/B at a 30k window: with the plugin, 5 compaction events and the work completed (a 6,527-char answer); without, 0 events and the turn died at the 1-token end.
So a fix in the adapter would make this recovery built-in rather than requiring every user to ship a plugin — and would also move the turn onto the retry seam that already exists.
Happy to provide the full transcripts if useful.

threads.title: 【中文】Compaction 中两处独立缓存失效（补丁 + 回归测试）— Two independent cache breaks in compaction on master @ 687f282e86: patch and regression specs
threads.bodyText:
中文摘要 🔍 问题：自动压缩时，摘要请求几乎完全不命中前缀缓存（KV Cache），在 master @ 687f282e86 上仍可复现。原因有两个，彼此独立：① 摘要请求没有继承请求头中的 reasoningEffort / temperature / stop；② 新发现：tool-result 修剪器在摘要之前改写了摘要请求要重放的历史，从第一个被改写的字节起全部重新计算。只修复 ① 解决不了 ②。 🔧 修复：仅在 provider / model 完全一致时继承这三个字段；需要摘要时，修剪器只处理保留的尾部，被摘要的区域保持逐字节不变。 📊 效果：真实 agent loop + 模拟前缀缓存：每次摘要的未缓存部分从约 2.2 万 / 8.4 万 / 33 万 token 降到约 470 token（32k / 128k / 512k 窗口），整个会话的未缓存 token 减少 34–41%。 ✅ 验证：新增及修改的回归测试在 master 上 6 个失败，打补丁后全部通过（见下方回答）；packages/compaction/ 共 236 个测试通过，tsc -b 与 oxlint 无报错。 📦 补丁：10 个文件，+630 / −29，可直接 git apply 到 687f282e86（即当前 master），见下方回答。 ImportantTL;DR: The summary call misses the prefix cache for two independent reasons. Effort parity, as discussed in #1944 and #3002, fixes the first; the second survives it. The answer below has a patch that fixes both, with regression specs. Through the real agent loop on a simulated prefix cache, the uncached part of every summary call drops to the ~470-token instruction, at 32k, 128k and 512k windows alike (master: about 22k / 84k / 332k). 🔍 Two independent causes Cause Where on master Already reported in #1944 as 1 Envelope drift: the summary call drops reasoningEffort, temperature and stop from the routed header summarizer.ts#L152-L162 vs. the loop's agent.ts#L695-L702 11.8% hit, cached part = static head (@deepseekv41flash); high vs none (@bulhenvaster) 2 New: the prune pass rewrites the region the summary call is about to replay index.ts#L321-L326 "24% right after a history rewrite" (@codeOct); "~110K re-reads" (@bulhenvaster) Both break a guarantee the package README states twice: the replayed prefix "match[es] the conversation's last routed request byte-for-byte" (README#L108, README#L233). Cause 1: the request envelope The loop builds every request by spreading the durable request header, ...header.config (agent.ts#L696). summarizeWithLlm reads the very same header (summarizer.ts#L127) but keeps only provider and model, so dsh-llm substitutes the adapter's default effort. The package's own doc names exactly these fields as cache-relevant (call-config.ts#L1-L7), and the DeepSeek adapter serializes effort as thinking plus output_config.effort (serialize.ts#L147-L157). Field Conversation request Summary call on master Summary call, patched provider, model from the header from the header from the header reasoningEffort from the header, e.g. max missing, adapter default high from the header, same route only temperature, stop from the header missing from the header, same route only tools from the header from the header from the header maxTokens from the header policy cap policy cap (reason in the answer below) Cause 2: the prune pass rewrites the replayed region The base bundle mounts the tool-result pruner by default (cordis.patch.yml#L425-L430, 8,192 chars). Once pressure qualifies, compactIfNeeded lands pruneSession() over the whole surface and only then builds the summary input, from the rewritten surface. Oversized tool results admitted since the last checkpoint are still verbatim in the cached prefix, so the first one rewritten becomes the first divergent byte. Effort parity cannot touch this. How a prefix cache bills: a request is charged at the cache-hit price up to the first byte that differs from an earlier request, and at the full price from that byte on. %%{init: {"flowchart": {"rankSpacing": 28, "nodeSpacing": 24, "padding": 8}}}%% flowchart TB subgraph A ["① cached: last request"] direction LR a1["tools +

threads.title: Long sessions: turn marked completed but assistant message contains only reasoning (no visible reply)
threads.bodyText:
现象
长会话中，助手有时只输出 reasoning（思考），没有任何可见回复，但该轮仍被标记为 completed，UI 上表现为「停在思考、没有下文」。没有报错、没有重试入口。
复现特征

会话已经很长（本例：单会话 16,872 个事件、14 MB 会话文件、turn 409）
模型：deepseek-flash，reasoningEffort: high
平台：DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2（macOS arm64，Electron 44.7.0，Node 24.21.0）

证据（会话事件）
最后一个 assistant message（turn 409 / step 6）：
{
  "type": "assistant/message",
  "data": {
    "turn": 409,
    "step": 6,
    "message": {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": [
        { "type": "reasoning", "text": "# 我先说结论：…（2256 字符，全部是 reasoning，没有 text 块）" }
      ]
    }
  }
}
紧接着：
{ "type": "step/end",  "data": { "turn": 409, "step": 6 } }
{ "type": "turn/end",  "data": { "turn": 409, "reason": { "kind": "completed" } } }
注意该 assistant message 的 usage 为 null，同轮前面的 assistant message 也是 null（疑似流式收尾异常）。
期望行为
两种任选其一，但不应出现「既无输出、也无错误」：

如果模型只返回了 reasoning 就结束，本轮不应标记为 completed；应提示「本轮未产生回复」并允许重试；
或把 reasoning 之后的空白当作截断，自动重试一次（或在 UI 显示中断原因）。

影响

用户侧表现为任务"执行到一半消失"，且无法判断是模型、网络还是 DSH 的问题；
在同一会话里重复发生（本例此前多轮也出现过「思考后无输出」）。

可能原因（供参考）

输出 token 上限在 reasoning 阶段耗尽，stream 直接以 finish 结束，DSH 将其当作正常完成；
长上下文（接近上限）下模型返回结构异常；
流式收尾时 usage/token 统计缺失。

环境

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2（Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0 / macOS arm64）
Profile：desktop，模型 deepseek-flash，reasoningEffort: high
会话：单 workspace 长会话，事件数 16,872

threads.title: [Desktop] App stops opening after ~70 launches: every launch adds a persistent auth cookie, and the Cookie header exceeds Node's 16KB limit
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On the desktop build, every launch adds one persistent cookie:

name: dsh-auth-<sha256("127.0.0.1:<port>")>
Max-Age: 60 days
the host starts on a random port each time, so the cookie name changes every launch and old ones are never overwritten or pruned

After enough launches the Cookie request header grows past Node's default http.maxHeaderSize (16,384 bytes), the host rejects the request, and the desktop app can no longer open — including a manual double-click.
Symptom
The main process starts, the host prints dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:<port>/?token=..., then:

desktop welcome: Web authentication failed (thrown by connectDesktopWelcome() in the Electron main process, after net.fetch returns non-2xx)
no window is created

A manual double-click reproduces it. A launch with a fresh --user-data-dir works, so the app / runtime / plugins are intact — the broken state is persisted user data.
Evidence (measured, 2026-10-22, Windows 10 22H2, Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0)



Item
Value




dsh-auth-* cookies in Network/Cookies
71


Average name=value length
226.8 bytes


Total Cookie header
16,110 bytes


Node default http.maxHeaderSize
16,384 bytes


Budget left for Host / User-Agent / Accept / Sec-Fetch-*
~274 bytes (needs ~300–500)



Timeline that pins the threshold:

launch #70: Cookie header ≈ 15,875 bytes → still fits → 303 + writes cookie #71
the redirect request right after that already carries 71 cookies → rejected → window never appears
every launch since then fails on the first request (the failing port has no cookie row, which confirms the host never reached the 303 branch)

Deleting the 71 dsh-auth-* rows restores the app immediately.
Reproduction
Option A: start the desktop app ~70 times.
Option B: seed the cookie DB directly (app fully closed):
-- Network/Cookies (SQLite)
INSERT INTO cookies (host_key, name, value, path, expires_utc)
VALUES ('127.0.0.1', 'dsh-auth-<random>', '<226 random bytes>', '/', <now + 60d>);
Then launch → desktop welcome: Web authentication failed, no window.
Suggested fixes

Prune on start — delete host_key='127.0.0.1' AND name LIKE 'dsh-auth-%' when the host starts. These cookies are per-launch by design, so removing old ones is safe.
Stable cookie name — drop the port from the hash (e.g. dsh-auth) so each launch overwrites the previous cookie.
Fixed port for the desktop host (also removes this failure class).

A defensive increase of maxHeaderSize only delays the problem and is not recommended.
Impact
This "works for ~70 restarts, then breaks permanently" pattern is easy to miss in normal use but hits long-term users hard — every app restart counts, including the ones triggered by plugin updates.
I can attach the (redacted) cookie DB backup or a small reproduction script if useful.

中文摘要：桌面版每次启动随机端口，认证 cookie 名带端口哈希、有效期 60 天、旧的不清理。攒到 71 条时 Cookie 请求头 16,110 字节，超过 Node 默认 16KB 上限，host 直接拒收 → desktop welcome: Web authentication failed → 窗口不出现（手动双击也一样）。删掉这 71 条 cookie 即恢复。建议启动时清理旧的 dsh-auth-*，或让 cookie 名不带端口。

threads.title: workspace-changes: git snapshot in agent/turn-stopping can block turn/end for a minute on large workspaces
threads.bodyText:
现象
每次模型回复结束后，界面上的「深度求索中」状态行仍会继续转圈、计秒十几秒到几十秒才消失。模型实际生成只用了 1.9 秒，但整轮迟迟不结束。
从 Session 日志看得很清楚（一次「你好」对话）：
0.000s  turn/start
1.939s  assistant/message + step/end   ← 模型早就说完了
30.607s turn/end                        ← 又空等 28.7 秒

根本原因
@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes 在 agent/turn-stopping 里同步等待一次完整的 git 工作区快照。该钩子是阻塞的，turn/end 必须等它跑完才会写入，所以前端 running 标记在模型已经输出完毕之后仍保持为 true。
相关代码：

packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:361-364 — await this.dispatch.serial('agent/turn-stopping', ...)
packages/deliverables/workspace-changes/src/index.ts:155-157 → recorder.stopping(turn)
packages/deliverables/workspace-changes/src/recorder.ts:310 → snapshotTree(...)
packages/deliverables/workspace-changes/src/git.ts:165 — git add --all --ignore-errors 写私有 index

关键点：慢的不是受跟踪文件，而是未跟踪文件
我在 Windows 11 + git 2.52.0.windows.1 上，对 DSH 源码仓库（16,347 个受跟踪文件）做了对照测量：



操作
修复前
修复后
说明




git ls-files
0.065s
0.065s
受跟踪文件本身很快


git status --porcelain
0.11s
0.11s
只做 stat，不动 index


git ls-files --others --exclude-standard
121,182 个文件
67
未跟踪、未被忽略的文件


git add --all
66.03s
0.13s
全量重算 blob 哈希


git write-tree
1.65s
0.04s



单次快照合计
67.7s
0.17s




也就是说：受跟踪文件只有 1.6 万个，但工作区里有 12 万个未被 .gitignore 覆盖的未跟踪文件（本例中 .dsh-build-tmp/ 一个目录就贡献了 115,776 个，4.98 GB）。git add --all 会为它们全部计算 blob 哈希并写入 index，这才是耗时来源。
把相关目录补进 .gitignore 后，未跟踪文件从 121,182 降到 67，单次快照从 67.7s 降到 0.17s，卡顿随之消失。
想请教的问题


这是否是已知问题？ 类似场景下是否有推荐的规避方式？


工作区快照是否必须同步阻塞 turn/end？ 按代码，end() 那条路径（turn/end 之后）本来就是异步的，而 stopping() 是同步等待。能否把记录整体移到 turn/end 之后，让 turn/end 先落、workspace/changes 事件后到？这样至少 UI 不会被拖住。


是否考虑过限制 add --all 的范围？ 例如只快照受跟踪文件，或对未跟踪文件加数量/耗时预算，超过就退化记录（就像现有 maxFiles / maxFileBytes 那样）。现在 --ignore-errors 会让超长路径被静默跳过，快照实际是不完整的，但没有提示。


Agent Note 里的性能结论是否是在 macOS/Linux 上测的？ 2026-09-11-turn-changed-files-card 中写「一万个文件约 60ms，stat 缓存在 index 里对耗时没有可测量的影响」。这个结论在 Windows + 大量未跟踪文件时不成立——我在本机测到 66 秒。如果 Windows 是支持目标平台，这条结论可能需要补充平台条件和未跟踪文件数量的前提。


环境

平台：Windows 11
git：2.52.0.windows.1
仓库：deepseek-harness 源码仓库，16,347 个受跟踪文件，.git 约 1.1 GB
DSH 版本：Web bundle 内置 @deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes 0.2.1-rc.2

感谢！

threads.title: [Bug] Kylin V10 / Chromium 128: three client-side failures (dsh-resource protocol, PDF worker features, session-log download)
threads.bodyText:
Environment

dsh 0.2.1-rc.2, dsh web profile, Linux arm64 (Kylin V10 SP1)
Browser: the distro's bundled Chromium 128.0.6613.119 Built on Kylin (this build reports a x86_64 UA on an aarch64 host, i.e. it is a custom/older branch)
Three unrelated-looking failures all trace back to this browser being older than what the client code assumes. All three are reproducible on a stock Chrome 130+ only in the sense that they don't happen there; the code paths are still non-portable.

I patched all three locally against the built artifacts (node_modules/**/lib/client*.js) to keep working, but the proper fixes belong in source. Diffs below are conceptual — I can send PRs if the project wants them.

1. dsh-client-resources: protocolOf() returns undefined for valid dsh-resource:// addresses
packages/client/resources derives the protocol key with new URL(address).hostname. For non-special schemes the WHATWG URL parser is not required to populate hostname, and this Chromium build returns "" for dsh-resource://file/x. The address is then classified as "not a resource", every record stays in status none, and the right sidebar shows "文件资源服务不可用" — with no console error, a clean host log, and no recovery on refresh. Meanwhile every workspaceFiles.* RPC works fine, which makes it very hard to localize.
Proposed fix — parse the authority from the string and keep URL only as a fallback:
function protocolOf(address) {
  const match = /^dsh-resource:\/\/([^/?#]*)/i.exec(address)
  if (match !== null) {
    const authority = match[1]
    const host = authority.slice(authority.lastIndexOf('@') + 1)
    return host === '' ? undefined : host.toLowerCase()
  }
  let parsed
  try { parsed = new URL(address) } catch { return }
  if (parsed.protocol !== 'dsh-resource:') return undefined
  return parsed.hostname === '' ? undefined : parsed.hostname.toLowerCase()
}
This is behaviour-identical to the current code on conforming parsers (I checked DSH-RESOURCE://File/x, dsh-resource:///x, dsh-resource://user@file/x, /home/a.md, and bare paths).

2. dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview: PDF worker throws n.toHex is not a function
Opening any .doc/.docx yields "无法显示 PDF：n.toHex is not a function". The conversion succeeds — the PDF bytes arrive — the failure is inside pdf.js 6.3.289.
pdf.js depends on several recent JS built-ins: Uint8Array.prototype.toHex / toBase64, Uint8Array.fromHex / fromBase64, Math.sumPrecise, Map.prototype.getOrInsert(Computed), RegExp.escape, Error.isError, and Promise.try. Upstream pdf.js installs these itself in src/shared/util.js, but the bundler treats those statements as side-effect-free and drops them, so the shipped chunk contains the call sites only.
Two details that matter for a fix:

The failing call is in the worker, not the main thread. PDFDocument.fingerprints does calculateMD5(...).toHex(), and the worker source is an inline 1.27 MB string in the chunk that is turned into a blob at runtime:
url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([_dsh_pdf_worker_default, '\nself.postMessage(...)'], { type: 'text/javascript' }))
worker = new Worker(url, { type: 'module', name: 'dsh-pdf' })
Patching the main thread alone is useless; wrapping Worker is fragile. What works is prefixing the polyfill into that string (var _dsh_pdf_worker_default = "<polyfill>(self);" + "<original>").
Promise.try is used unguarded by the worker message pump, so it must be in the set even though it happens to exist in Chrome 128.

Suggestion: ship the polyfills as a tiny module that is concatenated in front of the worker string and also evaluated at chunk top-level, rather than relying on pdf.js's own side effects surviving tree-shaking.

3. dsh-session-log-export: "Download session log" silently downloads nothing
session-log-export/lib/client.js ─ downloadUrl():
const anchor = document.createElement('a')
anchor.href = url
anchor.download = filename
anchor.click()          // anchor is never appended to the document
The host side is fine (HEAD /api/session.export?... → 200 + content-disposition: attachment; filename="dsh-session-<id>.zip", and a manual GET returns the ZIP). But the <a> is detached, and several Chromium forks ignore click() on a detached anchor. Result: no download, no error, no browser download-history entry — the FE reports success because it only checked the HEAD.
const anchor = document.createElement('a')
anchor.href = url
anchor.download = filename
anchor.rel = 'noopener'
anchor.style.display = 'none'
;(document.body ?? document.documentElement).append(anchor)
try { anchor.click() } finally { anchor.remove() }
This one is a one-liner and is correct in every browser, not just this one.

threads.title: ui-primitives MenuSurface 的 macOS backing 在真实 Chromium 上从未生效:anchor-name / position-anchor 经 var() 引用不被应用
threads.bodyText:
现象
macOS 桌面壳(透明 vibrancy 窗口)上,官方 MenuSurface 的 macOS backing(MenuSurface.module.css 中 :global(html[data-platform='darwin']) .backing)从未实际生效:菜单只有 .material 45% 半透明层,没有不透明垫底——压在网页内容上透出模糊文字,压在窗口透明区则直接透出被系统糊匀的壁纸,呈均匀亮灰(采样 ≈ (135,135,135)),与设计上 backing 生效应有的不透明深灰(≈ (42,43,46))不符。源码注释承诺的「Chromium needs opaque pixels behind the page content to blur it over native vibrancy」没有兑现。
定位
MenuSurface.tsx 用 CSS 自定义属性中转每实例锚点名:CSS 侧 anchor-name: var(--dsh-menu-anchor) 与 position-anchor: var(--dsh-menu-anchor),锚名经 inline custom property 注入。实测(Electron 44.0 / 44.7,macOS 15,透明 vibrancy 窗口):CSS.supports 对 anchor-name、position-anchor、anchor()、anchor-size() 全部返回 true,但布局不应用——backing 的 getBoundingClientRect() 为 0×0 错位;同一窗口里把锚名改为字面量(不经 var())则 backing 与 surface 完全对齐。即:Chromium 不应用经 var() 到达 anchor-name / position-anchor 的引用。

threads.title: Every subprocess spawn costs 4-6s on Windows — hooks, pwsh, MCP alike, independent of what the process does
threads.bodyText:
Environment
DSH desktop (Electron) on Windows 10, Chinese-localized UI. Four Claude-Code-style hooks configured via hooks.json (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse). All hook commands are D:\Node\node.exe <script>.
Symptom
Every tool call that spawns a subprocess takes 4-6 seconds longer than the work itself. This is steady, not intermittent: 4,298-4,429 ms across 8 consecutive calls (spread 131 ms).
Measurements from one session (37c0c192, ~14 hours of normal use):
Hook duration as recorded by DSH itself (hook/result.durationMs):

PreToolUse: 324 calls, mean 4,046 ms, total 1,311 s
PostToolUse: 64 calls, mean 4,024 ms, total 258 s
UserPromptSubmit: 33 calls, mean 4,310 ms, total 142 s
=> 421 hook spawns, 1,711 s (~28.5 min) spent waiting on hooks alone.

Tool call duration (tool/call -> tool/result), by tool:

read: 49 calls, mean 4,860 ms (no subprocess involved)
grep: 11 calls, mean 4,309 ms (no subprocess)
mcp__dmind__save: 13 calls, mean 4,251 ms (MCP stdio child)
pwsh: 174 calls, mean 10,621 ms
Total across all tool calls in the session: 3,058 s (~51 min)

The control that isolates it

Same hook scripts run manually from a terminal: block_delete.js 206 ms, post_edit_check.js 51 ms, route_hook.js 51 ms. Twenty to eighty times faster than inside DSH.
I temporarily made block_delete.js exit immediately as its first statement (process.exit(0) — zero work), then triggered one tool call. DSH still recorded 4,298-4,429 ms for that PreToolUse hook. So the time is not the script.
A pwsh call running just echo 1 took 10 s end to end: 4.4 s PreToolUse hook, then another 6 s from hook completion to tool result. echo 1 itself is milliseconds.

Where I got to in the source
hooks-claude-code/lib/index.js:182 -> hook-protocol runHook() -> await bash.run(bash.resolve(request)) with ctx.shell. durationMs wraps that entire await. So the 4-6 s is inside ctx.shell / the subprocess runner, before and after the child actually works.
Related

#5635 proposes running compatibility hooks through ctx.subprocess instead of ctx.shell to fix "session unresponsive" cases, with a runHookOnHost path. It has 0 replies. My case is not a hang — the session recovers every time — but it looks like the same layer.
A community write-up describes a Windows failure mode where "the runner waits for a launch frame that never arrives and there is no timeout". Mine behaves like a mild version of that: a fixed ~4 s wait, then it proceeds.

Questions

Is a 4-6 s fixed cost per subprocess spawn a known Windows issue, or is something in my setup making the runner wait?
Is there a config knob (runner timeout, start-frame wait, sandbox mode) that would reduce it? I am on workspace-write.
Does the runner do any Windows ACL / sandbox setup per spawn that could account for a fixed multi-second cost? If so, is it cached across spawns?

Numbers table (same as above, for clarity)
hook PreToolUse      324  4046 ms avg   1311 s total
hook PostToolUse      64  4024 ms avg    258 s total
hook UserPromptSubmit 33  4310 ms avg    142 s total
tool read             49  4860 ms avg
tool grep             11  4309 ms avg
tool pwsh            174 10621 ms avg
tool mcp dmind save   13  4251 ms avg
manual block_delete.js     206 ms
manual post_edit_check.js   51 ms
manual route_hook.js        51 ms

threads.title: Windows workspace-write sandbox leaves Low integrity label on a workspace after it stops being a workspace
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On Windows, a directory that was used as a DSH workspace in workspace-write
mode keeps the sandbox's ACL edits after it is no longer a workspace. The
remaining Low integrity label then makes Windows treat the directory as an
untrusted source, which produces a user-visible security prompt when files
under it are opened.
What I observed
I used D:\Desktop as my DSH workspace (Windows, workspace-write mode) for a
while, then moved the workspace elsewhere. After that, icacls D:\Desktop
still showed three explicit entries that are not part of a normal user
directory:
D:\Desktop Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(DC)
           S-1-4-xxxxxxx:yyyyyyyy:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
           Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)

The same directory's inherited entries were untouched, so the difference is
exactly these three explicit entries.
User-visible impact
From inside D:\Desktop, double-clicking the user-profile shortcut raises a
Windows security prompt:
Windows Security Center
Opening these files might be harmful to your computer
Your Internet security settings blocked one or more files. Do you want to open
these files anyway?
D:\Desktop

The dialog names D:\Desktop, i.e. the directory carrying the Low label.
After I removed the Low integrity label from that directory, the prompt no
longer appeared.
Where the entries come from
I did not write a reproduction test, so this part is from reading the shipped
code rather than from controlled experiments. In
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl:

buildLowLabelAcl() — the doc comment says the label is
"applied with every write grant: ... with the no-write-up policy,
inheriting to subcontainers and objects so later children carry the same
label".
grantWrite() — the doc comment says each grant applies three edits in one
SetNamedSecurityInfoW call: the capability-SID allow ACE, a deny ACE that
removes the ambient FILE_DELETE_CHILD right from the world SID, and a Low
no-write-up mandatory label. That matches the three entries above one to one.
AclWriteGrant.add(path, standing) — a workspace path is recorded with
standing = true, described as "the edits outlive this grant (the workspace
reuse cache; dispose() skips revoking it)".
AclWriteGrant.dispose() — "Revoke every revocable grant (standing security
descriptor edits stay)", and the loop only walks this.revocablePaths.

runner.js states the same intent differently: it "revokes its temp grant on
exit (workspace ACEs stay standing as the reuse cache)", and for the
--write-sid / --temp-write-sid contract it notes that the caller "owns
their revocation".
So the cleanup path exists, but the standing workspace grant is deliberately
outside it. That is reasonable while the directory is still a workspace; the
question is what happens once it is not.
What I would like to know

When a directory stops being a workspace (the user switches workspaces, or
removes it from the composition), is the standing workspace grant supposed
to be revoked at some point? I could not find such a step.
If it is intentionally kept for reuse, could the documentation mention the
leftover Low label and its effect on ordinary Windows shell operations — or
could there be a command to clear a directory's sandbox grants?
Is the Low integrity label on the workspace the intended way to make the
directory writable for the restricted token, or could the grant rely on the
capability SID alone?

Environment

Windows 10/11 desktop
DSH desktop build, workspace-write file policy
The affected directory was D:\Desktop; the workspace has since moved to
another directory

Notes
I did not run a controlled reproduction; everything above is a record of what
happened on my machine plus pointers into the shipped code. Happy to provide
further icacls output if that helps.

threads.title: [Bug] anthropic-messages：网关把缓存读折叠进 input_tokens，导致误判上下文溢出、整轮失败并丢弃完整回答
threads.bodyText:
摘要
使用 dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 api: anthropic-messages 连接第三方 Anthropic 兼容网关时，该网关返回的 input_tokens 已经包含 cache_read_input_tokens（非标准行为；Anthropic 的约定是只报未缓存部分）。
这个折叠在 DSH 中造成 4 个后果，其中第一个会直接杀掉整个 turn 并丢弃已经完整生成的模型回答。后果 1、2、3 同源，修一处即可全消；后果 4 是独立的既有缺陷，只是被这里放大暴露。
环境：DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai，api: anthropic-messages。

后果 1（最严重）：误判上下文溢出，整轮失败并丢弃完整回答
机制
packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:81 把 pi-ai 的原始 usage 交给上游的静默溢出检测：
const piAiOverflow = isContextOverflow(message, contextWindow)
isContextOverflow 的 case 2 按"互不重叠"假设求和：
// @earendil-works/pi-ai dist/utils/overflow.js
if (contextWindow && message.stopReason === "stop") {
    const inputTokens = message.usage.input + message.usage.cacheRead;
    if (inputTokens > contextWindow) return true;
}
折叠后这个和接近真实 prompt 的 2 倍。真实 60 万的 prompt 被按 120 万判超 100 万窗口，mapStopReason 返回 CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED，agent loop 结束本轮。
实测证据（本地会话日志）

真实 prompt 分别为 75 万和 60 万，都低于网关实际接受的 1,048,568——这些请求本来能成功。
被丢弃的回答

用户侧看到的是「本轮运行失败 / CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED」，且重试无法脱困——下一轮请求会被同样判超。这会形成稳定的死锁，而不是偶发失败。
另外，stopReason: "stop" 且内容非空时判为溢出本身即自相矛盾：真正溢出的请求不会收到完整回答。这一条可以独立作为兜底。

后果 2：缓存命中率显示约 50%，实际约 99.8%
packages/client/ui-chat/src/client/chat/StatsPills.tsx:118 把三个桶相加作分母：
export function billedInputTokens(usage: TokenUsageProjection): number {
  return usage.uncachedInputTokens + usage.cacheReadTokens + usage.cacheWriteTokens
}
而 uncachedInputTokens 直接来自 usage.inputTokens（packages/llm/token-meter/src/usage-projection.ts:22），折叠时它并不减少。
复现（向网关发送三次完全相同的请求，大且稳定的 system prompt）：
#1 input=2433 cacheRead=2432 cacheWrite=0
#2 input=2433 cacheRead=2432 cacheWrite=0
#3 input=2433 cacheRead=2432 cacheWrite=0

缓存命中时 input_tokens 不减少，说明它是总量而非未命中量。DSH 按 2432 / (2433 + 2432) ≈ 50% 显示，真实值 2432 / 2433 ≈ 99.96%。

后果 3：上下文占用接近翻倍，压缩阈值被提前触发
packages/llm/token-meter/src/usage-projection.ts:78 与 packages/llm/token-meter/src/index.ts:71 同样按互不重叠求和：
const pressureFrom = (usage: TokenUsage): number =>
  usage.inputTokens + (usage.cacheReadTokens ?? 0) + (usage.cacheWriteTokens ?? 0)
function usageTokens(usage: TokenUsage): number {
  return usage.inputTokens + (usage.cacheReadTokens ?? 0) + (usage.cacheWriteTokens ?? 0) + usage.outputTokens
}
前者驱动 ContextMeter 占用显示与 projectedTokens，后者是 token-meter 的用量锚点（baseline）。折叠时两者都接近翻倍。
compaction-basic 用 measurement.totalTokens < spec.thresholdTokens 判断是否压缩（packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts:319、:327、:340），所以压缩会在真实占用约一半时触发，白白截断仍然可用的上下文。
实测（contextWindow = 1,000,000）：

注意后果 1 与后果 3 方向相反：与 contextWindow 直接比较的一侧会误判溢出，与阈值比较的一侧会提前压缩。两者必须一起修，否则只修一边会让另一边继续保持错误。

后果 4：真溢出时恢复路径本身不可能成功（既有缺陷，被此折叠放大）
即使溢出是真的，compaction-basic 的恢复也救不回来。
packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts:190 的 agent/request-error 收到 CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED 后调用 compactIfNeeded(agent, 'context-overflow', …)。摘要请求由 buildSummarizationInput()（packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts:544）构造：system + tools + 被压缩区域的完整消息，设计上刻意复用 KV cache（packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/summarizer.ts:28-30）。
当被压缩区域接近整段历史（正是溢出的情形），这个辅助请求与原请求几乎等大，于是摘要本身再次溢出，compaction/end 记录的错误与 turn/end 完全相同：
compaction/start {"compactionId":"e4f33c52-…","turn":1}
compaction/end   {"compactionId":"e4f33c52-…","turn":1,"error":"…context overflow…"}
turn/end         {"turn":1,"reason":{"kind":"error","error":{"code":"CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED"}}}

maxOverflowRetries 默认 1（packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/config.ts:106），用完即 next() 并保留原始错误。而 summarizationProvider/summarizationModel 默认回落到被路由模型本身——也就是刚刚溢出的同一个窗口。
本地会话里连续多个 turn 都停在这一步：2b4d209e 的 turn 3 / 4 / 5 各自产生一次 compaction/start + 同错 compaction/end，期间没有任何一次成功的 pre-step 压缩。

根因归属
packages/llm/llm/src/types.ts:170-173 已声明该契约：

Counts are DISJOINT: inputTokens is uncached input only; cached input is reported separately as cacheReadTokens/cacheWriteTokens (billed input = sum of the three). Adapters whose providers fold cache hits into a total prompt count subtract them out.

两点澄清：

llm-deepseek 并没有做减法，也不需要——它走 Anthropic 风格的 input_tokens，本就只报未缓存部分（packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts:36 直接映射）。该文档句子里提到的 prompt_tokens 折叠属于 openai-completions 协议，pi-ai 自己的该实现确实做了减法（dist/api/openai-completions.js:1177：Math.max(0, promptTokens - cacheReadTokens - cacheWriteTokens)）。
anthropic-messages 不能假定折叠，因为标准 Anthropic 不折叠；折叠只出现在部分兼容网关上。

因此归一化应发生在适配器摄入点（mapUsage），而不是各个消费方分别求和；且必须是 opt-in 的兼容开关，不能改变标准网关的行为。

建议修复
A. pi-ai 路由在摄入时归一化 usage（修后果 1、2、3）
在 packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:24 的 mapUsage() 增加兼容参数：
export function mapUsage(usage: PiUsage, inputIncludesCacheRead = false): TokenUsage {
  const cacheRead = Math.max(0, usage.cacheRead)
  const cacheWrite = Math.max(0, usage.cacheWrite)
  const input = inputIncludesCacheRead
    ? Math.max(0, usage.input - cacheRead - cacheWrite)
    : usage.input
  return {
    inputTokens: input,
    outputTokens: usage.output,
    // pi-ai 的合计口径是 input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite，
    // 折叠时这个和也重复计数，必须一并重算，否则 usageTokens() 仍会翻倍。
    totalTokens: input + usage.output + cacheRead + cacheWrite,
    ...cacheRead > 0 ? { cacheReadTokens: cacheRead } : {},
    ...cacheWrite > 0 ? { cacheWriteTokens: cacheWrite } : {},
  }
}
调用点两处（stream.ts:209、:219）透传开关。
开关位置：不能放进 PiAiCompatProfile——那个接口由 EveryProfileFieldIsOffered / EveryProfileFieldMatchesUpstream 编译期钉死在 pi-ai 上游的 compat 类型上，加非上游字段无法编译。应作为普通的配置字段加入：

路由级：packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts 的 route profile（紧邻 defaultContextWindow），schemastery 声明 inputTokensIncludeCacheRead: z.boolean()
模型级：PiAiModelProfile（catalog.ts:603）+ config.ts 的 modelFields，覆盖路由默认
解析：沿用 configuredMaxTokens 的既有做法——在 catalog.ts 的 resolveEntry 旁记入一个 Map<string, boolean>，由 adapter.ts 的 modelInfo() / generate() 读取后传给 toStreamChunks

默认关闭，标准 Anthropic 端点与 llm-deepseek 完全不受影响。
B. 不要用未归一化的 usage 判溢出（同源，需一并修）
仅靠 A 还不够：mapStopReason 目前把 pi-ai 的原始 Usage 交给 isContextOverflow。归一化后仍应让 DSH 自己掌握这条判定，而不是依赖 pi-ai 的 usage.input + usage.cacheRead。
建议改 toStreamChunks 的签名（packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:142，调用点 adapter.ts:426），把 contextWindow 换成 { contextWindow, inputIncludesCacheRead }，然后：

case 1（错误文本模式）继续用 isContextOverflow(message, undefined) —— 显式 provider 错误仍然可信；
case 2 / 3（静默溢出）在 DSH 侧用归一化后的 prompt 量重算，而不是交给上游；
额外兜底：stopReason === 'stop' 且 content.length > 0 时永不判为溢出。

C. 摘要请求加大小上限（修后果 4，独立改动）
buildSummarizationInput() 应受一个按 token 计价的预算约束（可复用 tokenMeter 的 node 价格）。超出时改为分段摘要，或退回更小的区域。同时，summarizationProvider/summarizationModel 默认不该回落到刚刚溢出的同一路由；若确实回落，至少应在日志中明确提示「摘要使用了与溢出相同的窗口」。
D. 文档修正
packages/llm/llm/src/types.ts:173 提到 "DeepSeek's prompt_tokens"，但 llm-deepseek 走 Anthropic 协议、从不接收 prompt_tokens。这句应改为指名 openai-completions 协议（pi-ai 实现），否则读者会以为减法已经发生在错误的包里。

影响面

计费不受影响：提供商按自己的 input_tokens 计费，DSH 只是读数与阈值错了。
受影响：缓存命中率显示、ContextMeter 占用、compaction-basic 的触发时机，以及后果 1 的整轮失败与回答丢弃。
默认不受影响：llm-deepseek 与标准 Anthropic 端点；受影响的只有把缓存读折叠进 input_tokens 的兼容网关。


附：复现用最小配置
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      compat-gateway:
        displayName: compat gateway
        apiKeyEnv: GATEWAY_API_KEY
        api: anthropic-messages
        baseURL: https://<gateway>/v1
        defaultContextWindow: 1000000
        inputTokensIncludeCacheRead: true   # 修复后新增
        models:
          - id: <model-id>
判定网关是否折叠：连发两次相同请求，若 input_tokens 不随命中下降、且 input ≈ cacheRead，即属于本 issue。

threads.title: dsh plugin add fails with ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT on a fresh dsh-initialized profile (pnpm 9 in PATH)
threads.bodyText:
Environment









dsh
0.2.1-rc.2


Node
v22.22.0


pnpm in PATH
9.15.9


OS
Windows 11



Summary
dsh plugin --profile <name> add <spec> fails with ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT on a freshly initialized profile.
dsh initializes every profile with its own pnpm-workspace.yaml (packages: - .), but the plugin command forwards pnpm add without --workspace-root. On pnpm 9 that is rejected by pnpm's workspace-root guard.
Minimal reproduction

Machine where pnpm --version reports 9.x.
Build a dependency-free tarball, so dependency resolution cannot be the cause.
Use a brand-new profile name (so dsh creates it):

dsh plugin --profile wprobe add D:\probe\dsh-probe-pkg-1.0.0.tgz
Actual
dsh: initialized profile wprobe at C:\Users\<user>\.dsh\profiles\wprobe
ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT  Running this command will add the dependency to the workspace root,
which might not be what you want - if you really meant it, make it explicit by running this
command again with the -w flag (or --workspace-root). ...
dsh: plugin command failed; diagnostics: ...\.plugin-manager\logs\operation-iVz9LN\pnpm.log
[exit code: 1]

.plugin-manager/logs/operation-*/pnpm.log contains:
Command failed with exit code 1: pnpm add "D:\probe\dsh-probe-pkg-1.0.0.tgz"

The profile that dsh had just created contains:
# pnpm-workspace.yaml — generated by dsh itself
packages:
  - .

nodeLinker: hoisted
autoInstallPeers: false
// package.json — generated by dsh itself
{ "name": "dsh-profile-wprobe", "private": true, "dependencies": {} }
So dsh creates a workspace root and then immediately runs a command that pnpm refuses to run in a workspace root.
Expected
dsh plugin add should install into the profile it just created.
Control experiments (same layout)



pnpm version
-w passed to pnpm?
Result




9.15.9
no
ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT, exit 1


9.15.9
yes
exit 0, installed


11.28.5
no
exit 0, installed



Notes:

The failure is pnpm-major dependent: pnpm 9 enforces the workspace-root guard, pnpm 11 does not.
Passing -w through the plugin command makes the identical command succeed:
dsh plugin --profile wprobe add -w <tgz> → exit 0.

Why this matters
Tools that automate companion/plugin installation by driving dsh plugin --profile ... add break on machines where pnpm 9 is the one on PATH.
One concrete downstream case: OpenDesign's agent-companion setup invokes exactly this command and can only surface a generic failure to the user (nexu-io/open-design#8919). That report was traced to the same pnpm add call, and the ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT symptom there matches this reproduction byte-for-byte.
It is also worth noting the failure gives no hint about the pnpm major, so a user cannot tell whether they hit a version-support problem or a plugin problem.
Possible fixes (any one would close this)

Have dsh plugin append --workspace-root when forwarding add/remove for a managed profile — the profile is the workspace root by construction, so this is always correct for that command.
Or write ignore-workspace-root-check=true into an .npmrc next to the generated pnpm-workspace.yaml.
Or stop generating pnpm-workspace.yaml for single-package profiles.

Question
Is pnpm 9 outside the supported range for dsh plugin?
If it is supported, the forwarding looks like a bug. If it is not supported, documenting a minimum pnpm major (and warning when a lower one is detected) would already save a lot of debugging time — right now the only signal is an opaque pnpm error inside a log file.
Thanks!
