threads.title: [Windows/Desktop] pwsh tool cannot spawn: exit 3221225794 (0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) under sandbox runner
threads.bodyText:
Environment
DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, Electron build, installed under a portable folder
Windows 11 x64, Intel 24-core / 31 GB RAM
Sandbox: default workspace-write, approval policy ask
Agent process observed at Low mandatory integrity level (Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level, S-1-16-4096)
Symptom
Every pwsh tool call returns:
代码块
exit code 3221225794   (0xC0000142, STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)
with no stdout and no stderr. The tool call itself is delivered to the host and the command string is intact — other tools (read, write, glob, grep, web_fetch) keep working in the same turn. So this is not a tool-call/parsing issue; the child process fails to initialize.
Evidence (all reproduced on this machine)
Same commands work when the user runs them. cmd /k node script.mjs from a normal shell returns normally. So the OS, the user token and Node itself are fine.
Reinstalling DSH fixes it temporarily. Immediately after a reinstall, the agent could run echo alive; node -v and got output. After roughly a day of normal use the same calls fail again with 0xC0000142. This is a stable "works, then degrades" pattern rather than a one-off corruption.
Switching the session to full access did not help. After switching the session to danger-full-access, the agent still got exit 3221225794 on echo alive. (If the intended knob is sandbox-policy.mode rather than the session permission, please say so — we may have flipped the wrong one.)
The agent process cannot write outside the workspace at all. mkdir C:\Users<user>.dsh_wtest.txt and writeFileSync on C:\Users<user>.dsh... both fail with EPERM, while writing under E:... succeeds. Combined with (3), we suspect the child's low-IL / restricted token is part of the failure mode.
Suspected cause
A report we found says the sandbox runner still spawns its helper with CREATE_NO_WINDOW, which fails with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED in restricted-token sessions; DSH's own tool path apparently switched to CreateNoWindow = false + WindowStyle = Hidden since 0.1.6-alpha.2, but the sandbox runner path did not. That matches our observation exactly: normal tools fine, pwsh never starts.
Why the documented runnerCommand workaround is not applicable here
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local is not unpacked in this build:
代码块
resources/app.asar.unpacked/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/
├─ libreoffice-kit/
├─ libreoffice-kit-win32-x64/
└─ dsh-session-log-export/
dsh-sandbox-local lives only inside app.asar. The documented adapter approach is "rewrite process.argv, then import the official runner", but a plain console-subsystem node.exe cannot import() from an asar archive (asar support is an Electron fs patch). Using Harness.exe with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 can read asar, but that is the GUI-subsystem binary we are trying to avoid.
So for packaged desktop users the workaround has no viable runner to delegate to.
Questions
Does the Windows sandbox runner still use CREATE_NO_WINDOW in 0.2.1-rc.2?
Is the runnerCommand escape hatch intended to be usable from the packaged desktop build, given dsh-sandbox-local is inside app.asar?
Is there a recommended mitigation for desktop users in the meantime (other than turning the sandbox off)?
Additional observation (possibly related)
While debugging we found %USERPROFILE%.dsh\shots\video had an ACL that denied writes to the owner account (Permission denied / EACCES from ffmpeg when muxing into a subdirectory there), while the parent .dsh\shots was writable. That smells like the sandbox's ACL bookkeeping leaving a bad DACL behind. Not fatal, but possibly the same subsystem.

threads.title: 【BUG】heredoc / 单行命令含 ! 会导致整个命令行挂死
threads.bodyText:
调研闭环。以下是基于 deepseek-harness 源码的系统性定位报告。

Bug 报告：bash 工具遇 ! 字符挂死 300 秒
一句话结论
命令投递层用 ANSI-C 引用（$'...'）包裹模型命令，但受控 shell 是交互式 bash（history expansion 默认开启），$'...' 不像单引号那样豁免 !——含 ! 的整行被 bash 以 event not found 整行丢弃；丢弃后的提示符不带完成检测标记，工具层又没有对此状态的早退，三者叠加导致空转到 300s 超时。
最小复现（已实证）
命令 printf 'p4-start %s p4-end\n' '!' 被投递层包成（tool-bash-persistent/src/index.ts:82 wrapCommand）：
printf '%s\n' $'__DSH_START__'; eval -- $'printf \'p4-start %s p4-end\\n\' \'!\''; __dsh_s=$?; printf '%s%s\n' $'__DSH_END_:' "$__dsh_s"

喂给与生产完全同构的 bash --noprofile --norc -i（PS1=dsh> 、PROMPT_COMMAND 发 OSC 133;D），输出逐字：
bash: !\: event not found
dsh>                        ← 裸提示符，注意：前面没有 OSC 133;D 标记

START printf、eval、END printf 全部未执行。
三层根因
层 1｜触发层：quoteForBash 的引用形式不防 history expansion
packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/src/index.ts:74-78
function quoteForBash(value) { return `$'${…replaceAll("'","\\'")…}'` }

转义了 \ 和 '，唯独没处理 !；
shell 以 --noprofile --norc -i 启动（terminal-bash/src/config.ts:65）——交互模式，histexpand 默认开，初始化序列（index.ts:273 只有 stty -echo）没关它；
bash 在读行时先做 history expansion（先于任何解析/执行）：! 后跟 \' 被当作事件标识符 !\，查找失败 → 打印 event not found → 丢弃整行。bash 的历史扩展对单引号内字符豁免，对 $'...' 不豁免。

层 2｜放大层：丢弃行后的提示符缺少完成标记
packages/terminal/terminal-bash/src/index.ts:83-87、sanitize.ts:6

完成检测协议 = PROMPT_COMMAND 打印 \033]133;D;<exit>\007，sanitizer 只认这个 OSC 为 prompt；
但 bash 在 history-expansion 丢弃行后重打的提示符不执行 PROMPT_COMMAND（复现输出可见：错误后是裸 dsh> ，之后的正常命令才带标记）；
于是 session.ts pollReadiness 的 stdin_read 分支（:567-571，要求 promptSeen && promptTextSeen）永不满足，只剩 inferred_idle（:596）兜底结算。

层 3｜空转层：工具循环对 inferred_idle 无早退
packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/src/index.ts:321-389
while (true) {
  …startSend({ text: first ? wrapped : '', submit: first })   // 空轮不写入、不重置 readiness
  if (latest.text.includes(marker.end)) return …              // ① 不可能：END 没执行
  if (sessionStatus.kind === 'exited') return …               // ② 否
  if (result.waitReason === 'stdin_read') return …            // ③ 否：见层 2
  await pause()                                               // 25ms 后再来
}
inferred_idle 不在任何返回分支里 → 每 25ms 空转一轮直到 300s deadline → 走 timeout 分支 → shells.reset() 杀掉整个 shell。
连锁效应（解释现场所有怪象）

set +H 自救无效：跨调用的 set +H 被 timeout 后的 shell reset 抹掉；同行的 set +H 无效——expansion 发生在读行时，行内语句还没执行；
满屏 dsh> ：丢弃行后 bash 停在无标记提示符，后续调用/空轮产生的提示符文本进 scrollback；超时后 partialOutput 找不到 START 标记（整行被丢弃，START printf 也没跑），回退 scrollback 尾部 → 模型只看到一串 dsh> ，真正的错误消息 event not found 被 scrollback 上限截掉（LOST_PREFIX_MESSAGE 正是现场看到的「beginning was dropped」）。

修复方案（B、C 已复现验证通过）



#
层
改法
验证




B
层1
quoteForBash 改用传统单引号引用（'…'＋'\''）替代 $'...'——历史扩展对单引号内容豁免
✅ 全链正常输出


C
层1
shell 初始化序列（:273 stty -echo 处）追加一条 set +H，交互 shell 全程关闭 histexpand——agent 场景本就用不到它
✅ 同上


D
层3
executeCommand 循环对连续 N 轮 inferred_idle 且无输出增长加早退，报文识别 event not found 特征提示模型「命令行被 shell 丢弃，检查 ! 字符」
韧性加固


E
层2
完成检测不能只依赖 PROMPT_COMMAND：inferred_idle ＋ 前台=shell 本身即「回到提示符」
韧性加固



建议：C 一行根治（B 作为纵深防御一起上，注意 $'...' 换 '...' 需保留对 \r/\n 字面量的处理）；D/E 让任何未来的「行被丢弃」类故障快速失败而非烧 300 秒。
附注：本机 PATH 解析到 /bin/bash 3.2.57（macOS 系统 bash），复现与生产行为一致；bash 5.x 上 $'...' 是否豁免 ! 未在本机验证，修复不应依赖版本行为。

threads.title: 无限崩溃问题
threads.bodyText:
这个问题第一次是出现在DSH桌面端首次发布 我拿他做游戏跑了一段时间后出现无限崩溃 就算删除 再安装 只要进入该任务也会触发无限崩溃  二是今天拿新版本问怎么解决新版本里面dsh不显示的问题 还在问没开始修 也出现了同样的无限崩溃



项目
内容




时间
2026-09-29T18:33:32Z = 本地 20:33:32（正好是这个会话最后一轮的时候）


当时的版本
app @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.0-rc.2（安装在 D:\DSH）


直接错误
Error: Desktop renderer exited: crashed —— 渲染进程被杀


崩溃前控制台
连续 6 条 Uncaught Error: Minified Lexical error #14


出处
客户端插件合并 bundle 第 70188 行



Lexical error #14 的官方含义是「一个或多个 transform 在无限触发另一个 transform（无限递归）」。这是前端编辑器（输入框/引用 chip）里最典型的一种死循环，会把渲染进程拖死。
那个 bundle 行号 70188，按崩溃日志里的插件拼接顺序换算，落在 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation —— 这是唯一内置 Lexical 0.49 的客户端插件，负责对话输入框、@文件 引用 chip、/命令 chip 的渲染。
时间线也对得上：20:33:32 渲染进程崩 → host 在 20:33:36 记完第 2 轮、立刻起第 3 轮 → 20:33:41 记为 interrupted。会话里最后那条「已中断」就是这次崩溃造成的，不是模型或任务本身失败。
ui-conversation 在打开会话前会从 localStorage 的 dsh.conversation.chat. 恢复该会话的输入框草稿（含每个引用 chip 的 offset/length/label）。崩溃发生时那份草稿被留在了本地；之后每次打开这个会话，同一份草稿又被灌进 Lexical，于是在同一处再次死循环、渲染进程再崩一次。
这解释了你观察到的三个现象：只有这一个会话有问题、每次都复现、重开整个应用也没用（草稿存在客户端数据目录里，重启不消失）。
需要说明的置信度：今天重装已把旧安装（D:\DSH）连同其客户端数据删掉了，我读不到那份旧草稿原文，所以「草稿是诱因」是日志+代码路径能推出的最合理结论，不是逐字节实证。

threads.title: Windows: every `pwsh` call fails with exit code 3221225794 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) under the workspace-write sandbox, works under danger-full-access
threads.bodyText:
Environment



Item
Value




DSH version
0.2.1-rc.2 (dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2, latest published release)


Build
Desktop app (Electron), profile desktop


OS
Windows 11, build 10.0.26100.9703


Shell invoked by DSH
C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe, PowerShell 7.6.7


.NET runtime present
Microsoft.NETCore.App 10.0.13, Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App 10.0.13 (also 8.0.32, 9.0.21, 11.0.0-rc.2)


File policy when failing
workspace-write


Approval policy when failing
ask (also reproduced with never)


Workspace path
C:\Users\<user>\OneDrive\Документы\deepseek-harness\default-workspace



Summary
With file policy workspace-write, every pwsh invocation through the shell tool fails immediately with exit code 3221225794 (0xC0000142, STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED). The process produces no stdout and no stderr — a bare Write-Output "probe" does not run at all. Switching the same session to danger-full-access makes the identical command succeed.
Steps to reproduce

Launch the desktop app on Windows 11 (build 10.0.26100.9703), profile desktop.
Keep the file policy at workspace-write (default) and approvals at ask.
Ask the agent to run any shell command — e.g. Write-Output "probe".
Observe: exit code 3221225794, empty output.
Then, as a control:
Switch the same session to danger-full-access.
Repeat the identical command.

Expected
Command executes and returns its output (as it does in step 6).
Actual
Step 4: [exit code: 3221225794], zero bytes of output, both in the foreground and as a background job.
pwsh: Write-Output "probe"
(no output)
[exit code: 3221225794]

Evidence that the failure is confined to the sandboxed launch path

pwsh itself is healthy. Run by the user in a normal PowerShell window:
& 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe' -NoProfile -Command 'echo ok'
ok


Same failure regardless of working directory. Reproduced with the default OneDrive workspace and with workdir: C:\Windows\Temp.
Same failure regardless of approval policy. Reproduced with ask and with never.
Same failure in background jobs (run_in_background: true), so it is not a foreground/TTY artifact.
Only the confinement mode changes the outcome. Under danger-full-access the same call returns:
probe-full-access
7.6.7


Not a missing runtime. C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.runtimeconfig.json requires net10.0 / 10.0.13, and both Microsoft.NETCore.App\10.0.13 and Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App\10.0.13 are installed.
Not a broken install. The failure predates and survives an app reinstall attempt; dsh.cmd --version reports 0.2.1-rc.2 both before and after.

Suspected area
The confined process-creation path on Windows. 0xC0000142 is raised during DLL initialization, before main — which matches a process created in a form it cannot initialize in (restricted token / window station) rather than a PowerShell-level error. The packaged PTY layer is the other candidate: resources\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\node-pty\build\Release\conpty\ ships conpty.dll and OpenConsole.exe, and its failure would also surface as a raw NTSTATUS with no output.
Workaround
Switch the session to danger-full-access for shell work; workspace-write remains usable for file-only tasks.
Impact
On Windows the shell tool is completely unusable under the default policy, which removes command execution, tests, builds, installs, and any network access through the terminal — the default configuration is effectively file-only.
Secondary observation
dsh --profile desktop --dump-config refuses to run outside the desktop app:
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application

This blocks diagnosing the shipped shell/sandbox configuration from the CLI and may be worth documenting or relaxing for read-only dumps.

threads.title: 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.2：profile 根目录不可达时静默退出（ENOENT mkdir .dsh\profiles\desktop）
threads.bodyText:
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.2（nightly），Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0，win32 x64
Windows 10 Pro 22H2（19045.6466），Intel i5-9400F / 16 GiB
安装路径：G:\deepseek；DSH_HOME = %USERPROFILE%.dsh
（G:\deepseek.dsh 是指向该目录的目录联接）

现象
启动桌面版后没有窗口，进程直接退出，无任何错误提示。
关键日志
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, mkdir 'C:\Users\<user>\.dsh\profiles\desktop'
    at mkdirSync (node:fs:1410:26)
    at DesktopProjectManager.withLock (app.asar/lib/main.js:3600:3)
    at DesktopProjectManager.applyRelease (app.asar/lib/main.js:3592:14)
    at app.asar/lib/main.js:12314:32

当天 12 条崩溃记录，其中 11 条堆栈完全一致：

12:13:52 / 12:13:55 / 12:13:57（把 .dsh 改名备份之后）
20:44:57 – 20:45:17 共 8 次（卸载重装、清理数据目录期间）
另有 1 条 11:05:10 的 Desktop renderer exited: launch-failed。

复现步骤

安装并启动一次后退出
把 %USERPROFILE%.dsh 改名为 .dsh.bak
启动 DeepSeek Harness.exe → 进程立即退出，并在 %APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\ 写入上述 ENOENT 日志
目录改回原名 → 恢复正常

期望行为
withLock 在启动最早期就 mkdir(profile)。DSH_HOME 不可达（目录被移走 / junction 目标失效）时，建议：

启动前校验 DSH_HOME（realpath + reparse point 状态），失败则回退默认目录并提示；
复用已有的 "DeepSeek Harness is unavailable" 恢复界面，给出可操作选项，而不是静默退出；
崩溃日志补充 raw path / realpath / reparse point 信息，便于定位迁移问题。

附带发现

与 dsh web 互斥时的提示不足（startupAddressInUse），实际很难判断是端口占用还是目录问题。
profile 写锁残留会永久阻塞插件安装：lock 文件记录 PID，此处 PID 11252 恰好是一个存活的 DSH 进程，之后所有写入 package.json 的操作都 atomic-write: timed out waiting for the writer lock。建议锁记录 PID + 进程启动时间 + token，或提供 --force-unlock。

附件

threads.title: [Desktop] Balance/usage panel missing: profile references unpublished settings-account plugin
threads.bodyText:
桌面版看不到账户余额：profile 引用了不存在的 settings-account 插件，第三方面板插件又加载失败
现象

桌面版能看到「本次会话累计 token」，但看不到账户余额 / 今日花费 / 历史趋势
网页版（dsh web）两者都有

根因一：桌面版 profile 引用了一个不存在的插件
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml 里有这一段：
- id: ui-settings-account
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account"
  config:
    version: 1
    step: done
    usage: detailed
    developerTools: true
    purpose: null
    process: standard
    completion: api-key
配置写得很明确：usage: detailed，也就是「账户页显示详细用量」。
但 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account 这个包在三个位置都找不到：
x %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-settings-account
x D:\deep seek\resources\app.asar\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-settings-account
x D:\deep seek\resources\app.asar.unpacked\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-settings-account

已安装的 settings 系列插件（v0.2.0-rc.2）：
OK  dsh-client-ui-settings
OK  dsh-client-ui-settings-general
OK  dsh-client-ui-settings-models
OK  dsh-client-ui-settings-plugin-inventory
OK  dsh-client-ui-settings-plugins
--  dsh-client-ui-settings-account      被 patch 引用，但没有发布

结论：patch 层指向一个未发布的包，设置页的「账户 / 用量」入口因此不存在。
根因二：第三方面板插件在桌面端加载失败
@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter（v0.2.0-rc.2）已在 dsh-base 依赖里，桌面版确实加载了它，
但它只是 ctx.tokenMeter 后端服务，没有界面。
提供界面的第三方插件 dsh-whale-widget 在网页版正常，加到桌面版 profile 后：
DevTools Console:
  dsh-app://app/plugins/events           net::ERR_FAILED
  dsh-app://app/api/ch...cae3097c&seq=4954   404

插件菜单显示「已启用 / 运行中」，但客户端 bundle 从未加载。
加上去还会导致启动失败：
dsh: startup failed: 2 required plugins did not activate
Failed plugins (1):
  webserver (required)

环境



项目
值




DeepSeek Harness 桌面版
0.2.1.0


DSH 运行时
0.2.1-rc.2


@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter
0.2.0-rc.2


Windows
11 Build 26200



期望行为（任一即可）

发布 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account，让 profile 里那段 patch 真正生效
或者桌面版内置一个余额 / 用量面板（dsh-token-meter 的数据已经有了）
或者修复 dsh-app://app/plugins/ 协议，让第三方 UI 插件能在桌面端加载

补充：数据本身是有的
dsh headless --json 的输出里能看到完整用量：
{"type":"status","phase":"step_end","turn":1,"step":1,
 "usage":{"inputTokens":465,"outputTokens":2,
          "cacheReadTokens":5760,"cacheWriteTokens":0,"totalTokens":6227}}
而且 https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance（Bearer API key）能直接查到余额：
{"is_available":true,
 "balance_infos":[{"currency":"CNY","total_balance":"4.80",
                   "granted_balance":"0.00","topped_up_balance":"4.80"}]}
数据和接口都在，只是桌面版没有地方显示。
临时方案
写了个 ~200 行的 PowerShell 悬浮面板，直接调 user/balance 接口，
显示余额、今日花费、7 天柱状图，每 60 秒刷新。
这说明了问题只在 UI 层，接口层没有任何障碍。
影响
不影响核心功能（对话、代码编辑、工具调用都正常），
但对按量计费的用户来说，看不到余额是个实际缺口 —— 尤其是没有「今日已花」这个数字。
相关

#8999 macOS desktop cannot view usage — same symptom reported on macOS

可用的替代方案
dsh-cost-usage-monitor (community plugin, v1.0.2) loads fine in the desktop app
and puts account balance plus session cost in the composer dock. Its Host half
proxies GET /user/balance, so the API key never reaches the browser.
安装（四个空格缩进，避免代码围栏冲突）：
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-cost-usage-monitor

重启应用后，GET /usage-monitor/balance 就会在本地端口上应答。
所以数据和管道都是现成的 —— 缺的只是一个内置界面。

threads.title: Bug: thinking block 无限重复循环，无产出空转（thinking loop, no tool calls）
threads.bodyText:
现象
会话中模型的 thinking 块出现自我复读死循环：连续数百次生成几乎相同的短句，期间没有任何工具调用，直到用户手动打断（发送「停止」「直接调用工具」）才终止。
观测到的重复模式：
写。执行。时间：06:12。
写。执行。时间：06:12。
...（持续数百次）

环境

DSH 桌面版（Web GUI），Windows 11（10.0.26200）
模型 deepseek-flash，reasoningEffort: high
长会话（约 100 轮，已触发 1-2 次自动上下文压缩）
触发时任务：修改一个 Ruby 插件文件，约 3 处小改动

推测触发链
想清楚方案 → 想「现在动手」 → 又想「确认一下方案」 → 回到最初
因为没调工具，状态没变，所以每轮输入相同 → 输出相同 → 自回归强化这个模式。
影响

浪费大量 token（可能数十万）
用户体验像死机
任务完全停滞，且模型自身无法察觉

建议

thinking 循环检测：n-gram 重复率超阈值时强制结束 thinking
thinking 长度硬上限：超限时提示模型必须立刻调工具或结束
thinking → action 强制引导：超长且未产生 tool call 时注入系统提醒
暴露可配置项：允许用户设 thinking 上限或降低推理强度
UI 层提示：检测到重复时提示用户「模型可能陷入循环，建议打断」

threads.title: subagent_codex always fails with product-error: parent model name (deepseek-flash) is sent to Codex and rejected with 400
threads.bodyText:
Issues are disabled on this repository, so I'm filing this here under Q&A. Happy to move it or open a PR if that's preferred.

Environment

DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (macOS 27.0.1 arm64)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex 0.2.1-rc.2 (installed in the desktop profile)
Codex CLI 0.163.0, authenticated with a ChatGPT (Pro) account
Default agent model: deepseek-account / deepseek-flash

Symptom
Every subagent_codex call fails:
Product subagent failure (product: Codex; stage: turn; category: product-error)

codex exec works fine on the same machine (returns PONG, exit 0), so auth and model access are fine at the CLI layer.
What I checked


Driving codex app-server --stdio manually with exactly the provider's parameters succeeds:
initialize → thread/start {cwd, ephemeral: true, approvalPolicy: "never"} → turn/start {threadId, input:[{type:"text",text:"...",text_elements:[]}]}
→ turn/completed with status: "completed" and agentMessage.phase: "final_answer" in ~12s.


Adding "model": "deepseek-flash" to the same thread/start reproduces the provider failure exactly:


{"status":"failed","error":{
  "message":"{\"type\":\"error\",\"status\":400,\"error\":{\"type\":\"invalid_request_error\",\"message\":\"The 'deepseek-flash' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account.\"}}",
  "codexErrorInfo":"other"}}
codexErrorInfo: "other" is what the provider maps to category: "product-error", which matches the reported failure.
Attempted workaround (did not work)
Added this to the preset's tool row and restarted the app:
    - id: tool-subagent-codex
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
      config:
        provider: codex
        toolName: subagent_codex
        backgroundMode: one-shot
        maxDepth: provider-managed
        agentOptions:
          model: gpt-6.1-sol
Still product-error at stage: turn, so agentOptions.model does not reach the provider's thread/start.
Expected
subagent_codex should either omit model from thread/start (letting Codex use its own config) or accept an explicit model override for out-of-process providers. The parent session's DSH model name (deepseek-flash) should not be forwarded to a different product.
Workaround in use
Calling codex exec through the bash tool instead of the native provider.
If there's a configuration key I'm missing that pins the provider's model, I'd be glad to be pointed at it.

threads.title: [Bug] macOS: Dock accumulates duplicate DeepSeek Harness icons — no single-instance lock, and 939 stale session.lock files never reclaimed
threads.bodyText:
Environment



Item
Value




DSH Desktop
0.2.0-rc.2 (CFBundleVersion = 0.2.0-rc.2)


Bundle ID
com.deepseek.dsh


OS
macOS (Darwin, arm64)


Install
single copy at /Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app


Launch method
double-click from Desktop/Dock only — never CLI, never a second bundle



Summary
Two related defects on macOS:

The Dock fills up with many identical DeepSeek Harness icons, even though exactly one app bundle is installed and only one pinned Dock entry exists.
939 stale session.lock files have accumulated under ~/.dsh/sessions/ and are never reclaimed.

The two are likely the same root cause: the app has no single-instance guard, so repeated launches create independent processes, each holding its own session lock. The lock files then outlive the processes.
Evidence
1. Only one bundle, only one Dock pin
$ ls -d /Applications/*Harness*.app | wc -l
1

$ defaults read com.apple.dock persistent-apps | grep -c "com.deepseek.dsh"
1

There is no second copy under ~/Applications, /Users/Shared, or the Desktop. The Desktop contains no launcher for DSH. So the multiplicity in the Dock is not pins and not duplicate bundles — it is runtime state.
2. No single-instance protection in the bundle
Contents/Info.plist does not declare:
LSMultipleInstancesProhibited   → absent (0 occurrences)
LSUIElement                     → absent

Because LSMultipleInstancesProhibited is absent, LaunchServices happily starts a fresh process for every open/double-click instead of activating the existing window. This also matches the previously reported symptom in discussion #9078 ("退出后需点击两次图标才能重新打开").
3. Session locks are never cleaned up
$ find ~/.dsh/sessions -name "session.lock" | wc -l
939

Distribution by date of the oldest surviving lock:



Date
Stale session.lock count




2026-09-23
(earliest)


2026-09-26
89


2026-09-27
115


2026-09-28
146


2026-09-29
31


2026-09-30
11


2026-10-11
10


2026-10-13
23


2026-10-16
39


2026-10-18
42


2026-10-20
22


2026-10-21
21


2026-10-22
7


2026-10-23
4



Locks from 2026-09-23 — a month old — are still present. Note the step change on 09-26 → 09-28 (89 → 115 → 146), which is consistent with a launch loop rather than organic session churn.
A sample of the current lock for a live session:
~/.dsh/sessions/--<workspace-A>--/session-<uuid>/session.lock   (0 bytes, live)

Zero-byte locks are indistinguishable from abandoned ones by inspection, which is what makes them unrecoverable in practice (cf. discussion #7158 "Writer-lock timeout error names only the path, leaving an orphan lock unrecoverable in practice").
4. Actual activity does not justify the icon count
Only 3 workspace session directories were touched on 2026-10-23 (today):
10-23 13:48   sessions=1    ...<workspace-A>--      ← the only live session
10-23 12:07   sessions=30   ...<workspace-B>--
10-23 11:40   sessions=154  ...<workspace-C>--

Everything else is dated 10-22 or earlier — historical session files, not live sessions. A single active session is producing a Dock with many icons.
Expected

Launching the app while it is already running should focus the existing window, not add another Dock tile.
Terminated sessions should release/remove their session.lock.
The Dock should show at most one icon per running instance, and ideally exactly one for the whole app.

Actual

The Dock accumulates one tile per launched process (observed: a long row of identical icons from a single install with a single pin).
939 session.lock files persist indefinitely across app quits and restarts.

Suggested fixes

Add a single-instance guard in the main process (app.requestSingleInstanceLock() and quit/bail when not acquired, or second-instance → focus()). This is the primary fix for the Dock symptom.
Optionally set LSMultipleInstancesProhibited in Info.plist so macOS enforces it at the LaunchServices layer as well.
Reclaim session.lock on startup: sweep locks whose owning PID is dead (and whose session has no live writer), and delete them. 939 accumulated files indicate this never runs.
Consider LSUIElement or an explicit Dock policy if N windows are intentional — a single Dock tile with multiple windows would match user expectations better than N tiles.

Related discussions (checked, not duplicates)

#9078 — 退出后需点击两次图标才能重新打开 (same missing-lock root cause, different symptom)
#9823 — Document an isolated Desktop launch (userData, instance lock, profile)
#6889 — Live sessions have no retention policy (unbounded growth, analogous to lock accumulation)
#7158 — orphan writer-lock unrecoverable in practice
#9653 — Windows: permanent empty .lock blocking later boot (Windows analogue of the stale-lock issue)

Reproduction sketch

Install DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (single copy).
Confirm one Dock pin: defaults read com.apple.dock persistent-apps | grep -c com.deepseek.dsh → 1.
Launch the app repeatedly over days (double-click from Dock/Desktop).
Observe: Dock shows many identical DSH tiles, while only one or two sessions are actually active.
Observe: find ~/.dsh/sessions -name session.lock | wc -l grows monotonically and never shrinks.

Note on collection limits
ps, osascript (System Events), and launchctl list were all unavailable in the sandboxed collection environment, so a direct process count could not be captured. The Dock-tile multiplicity is therefore established from the screenshot plus the absence of any pin/bundle duplication and the absence of LSMultipleInstancesProhibited; the lock-file count is a direct filesystem measurement.

threads.title: [BUG]图片发送失败被误报为 session/agent-busy，且宿主图片管线没有对原生模块冲突做防护
threads.bodyText:
版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop@0.2.1-rc.2（Windows 11 10.0.26200，Electron 44.7.0）
类型：bug / DX / 防御性改进
现象

聊天里粘贴或拖入图片，发送后界面提示：
prompt rejected (session /agent-busy)

但会话并没有在跑任何东西，也没有任何"忙"的状态。
宿主侧完全没有收到字节：%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\attachments\v1\objects\ 和
.dsh\llm-deepseek\files-v3.json 在失败后零新增（最后一次成功是几天前）。
edit_image / generate_image 同时报：
Could not load the "sharp" module using the win32-x64 runtime
ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED: The specified procedure could not be found.
...\app.asar.unpacked\dsh\node_modules\@img\sharp-win32-x64\lib\sharp-win32-x64-0.35.5.node



这三个现象是同一个原因：宿主进程里的 sharp 被另一个版本的 sharp 顶掉了。
（安装的第三方插件把 sharp@0.34.5/libvips 8.17.3 带进了同一进程，宿主自带的
sharp@0.35.5/libvips 8.18.7 随后加载失败——Windows 一个进程只能映射一份
libvips-42.dll。）
插件侧的问题我会单独报给维护者。这里想反馈的是 DSH 侧的三处可改进点。
问题 1：附件/准入类异常被兜底改写成了 session/agent-busy
SessionController.prompt() 的兜底 catch（dsh-client-ui-conversation 打包产物内）：
} catch (error) {
  if (remoteErrorOf(error) !== void 0) throw error;
  if (error instanceof AttachmentError) throw new RemoteError('session/attachment-invalid', error.message, { reason: error.code });
  throw new RemoteError('session/agent-busy', 'prompt rejected', { reason: String(error) });
}
ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED 是 Node 抛的普通 Error，不是 AttachmentError，于是直接落进
最后一行，被标成"会话忙"。真正的原因 String(error) 存在 details.reason 里，
但 UI 只显示 message，用户永远看不到。
建议：至少把 reason 显示出来（或加一个"详情"折叠），并把这类失败归类为
session/attachment-unavailable 之类的新码。现在的行为会让用户和排查者都往
"会话状态"方向找，完全跑偏。
问题 2：原生模块加载失败没有任何启动自检
sharp 的加载是懒的：直到用户第一次发图才炸，而且只在工具返回值/控制台里可见。
图片是 DSH 的核心能力，这种"用的时候才发现坏了"的体验很差。
建议：boot 时做一次 require('sharp') 探针，失败就在 UI 上给一条明确的横幅：

图片功能不可用：原生模块 sharp 加载失败（模块路径 …，原因 …）

这样用户能立刻知道"是环境问题，不是我的操作问题"，也不会把时间花在重启和重发上。
问题 3：宿主的原生依赖可以被插件污染（建议做隔离）
libvips-42.dll 这种不带版本号的 DLL 名，决定了同一进程内两个 sharp 版本必然互斥。
任何插件把另一份 sharp 带进来，宿主的图片管线就会被静默打死，而且只在用到时才现形。
建议（按成本排序）：

把图片处理放到 utility process（Workers / child process），与插件依赖树隔离；
或者给 libvips 用带版本号的 DLL 名 / 独立目录，让两份并存；
退一步：boot 时校验已加载模块的版本，发现冲突就报警，而不是任由它静默失败。

影响
这个错误的误导性很强：我从 14:49 第一次失败查到 15:36 才定位到 sharp，中间走了
"会话忙 → 上传通道 → 网络" 三条错路。用户侧唯一的线索就是那句 session/agent-busy，
而它恰好是错的。
复现方式

在 Windows 的 desktop profile 里安装任何会带入 sharp@0.34.x 的插件
（本例：@steven-stack-s/dsh-memos-local，它依赖 @huggingface/transformers@4.2.0 → sharp@0.34.5）；
重启 App，在聊天里发一张图；
观察 prompt rejected (session /agent-busy) 与附件库零新增。

在宿主同款 Electron 运行时里可以直接验证加载顺序：
plugin sharp 0.34.5 → OK  (libvips 8.17.3)
host   sharp 0.35.5 → FAIL: Could not load the "sharp" module

两个包单独加载都正常，只有共存时失败——所以这确实不是插件"坏"，是共存问题，
而 DSH 目前对这个共存问题没有任何防护。

threads.title: Plugin install/update fails when a dependency name matches a Node core module (werift → buffer)
threads.bodyText:
Environment

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (packaged runtime), Windows 11 x64
Plugin: ds-harness-remote@0.5.18 (installed from the registry)

Symptom
Installing or updating the plugin fails at the generation-install step:
generation-install: promoted to ds-harness-remote+0.5.18+b2f836f946ac
generation-install: generation peer validation failed: werift: buffer resolves outside the generation and installation closure: buffer

The host then also reports that the pre-update build could not be verified for recovery, because restoring the previous generation (0.5.7) fails the same check — so the update cannot be rolled back either. The profile is left half-updated (the new version is in package.json/node_modules, but its generation is never projected) and the plugin market keeps the plugin disabled, because its enable path cannot hot-mount a bundle whose patch is not "plain insert".
Root cause
verifyGenerationPeers() in dsh-desktop-market-installer/generations/installer.mjs walks every installed package and resolves each dependency with createRequire(<pkg>/package.json).resolve(dependency), then requires the resolved real path to be inside the generation directory or the installation closure ($DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules).
werift@0.24.4 declares "buffer": "^6.0.3" as a dependency. buffer is also a Node core-module name, so require.resolve("buffer") answers the builtin id "buffer" instead of a file path — the installed buffer@6.0.3 is shadowed by the builtin. realpath("buffer") then fails and falls back to the raw value, isInsideDirectory() is false, and the validator reports it as outside the closure. The trailing : buffer in the message is the proof that it is a builtin id, not a path.
The validator module does not import isBuiltin/builtinModules at all (searching the asar finds those imports only in other modules, e.g. the runtime resolver), so a core-module name can never pass.
Impact

Any plugin whose installed dependency tree contains a package that declares a core-module-named dependency (buffer, util, events, process, stream, …) cannot be installed, updated, or rolled back on this host. Those names are extremely common browser-polyfill dependencies (buffer, process, util are the classic ones).
Rollback is affected too, so a failed update leaves the profile in a mixed state and needs manual repair.
The plugin market then cannot re-enable the plugin, because its toggle only persists "enabled" when the bundle can be hot-mounted; a non-plain bundle patch is refused (enable failed; leaving it disabled rather than persisting a state that crashes at boot).

Suggested fix
Skip Node builtins before resolving, in verifyGenerationPeers() — for the plugin root manifest and for every nested package:
import { isBuiltin } from 'node:module'
// ...
for (const dependency of candidates) {
  if (isBuiltin(dependency)) continue          // also covers 'node:' prefixed names
  // ...existing resolution and closure checks
}
A builtin has no install path inside the closure by definition, and no dependency graph can satisfy it by generating a package.
Minimal reproduction

Create a staging project whose only dependency is ds-harness-remote@0.5.18.
pnpm install --node-linker=hoisted --config.auto-install-peers=false (the same layout/pnpm the host uses; 83 packages).
Run the generation peer validation: it fails with
werift: buffer resolves outside the generation and installation closure: buffer.
Bundle werift into the plugin entry and drop it from dependencies, then repeat 1–3: the generation has 41 packages and validation reports zero problems.

I verified both directions locally with a staging generation and a reimplementation of the same rule; the plugin-side workaround is in liguobao/ds-harness-remote#151.
中文摘要
DSH Desktop 0.2.x 的 generation 依赖校验把 Node 核心模块名当成了越界路径：werift 把 buffer 声明为依赖，而 require.resolve("buffer") 返回内建 id 而不是文件路径，校验器又没有 isBuiltin 跳过，于是插件安装、更新、回滚全部失败（回滚用的旧 generation 也一样）。任何依赖树里出现 buffer / util / events / process / stream 这类名字的插件都会中招。建议在校验前对 Node 内建模块名直接放行；插件侧已通过把 werift 内联进 bundle 规避。

threads.title: Plugin patch hot-reload re-runs apply() but keeps already-imported ESM modules cached
A query string in a plugin's file:// path causes a duplicate load and a duplicate route
threads.bodyText:
Repro
Register a local plugin with a cache-busting query string on the file:// path:
- insert:
    - id: live-workbench
      name: 'file:///F:/.../plugin/dsh-live-workbench/dist/plugin.js?v=2'
Expected
The plugin loads once; ?v=2 is treated as a harmless suffix (or rejected up front).
Actual
The package name fails to resolve correctly. The same plugin ends up loaded twice, and the second registration throws duplicate route for the prefix route it registers — the whole plugin tree fails at boot.
Evidence
I hit this on my web profile (an entry for media-studio broke exactly this way and took a restart cycle to diagnose). Switching to a clean file:// URL with no query string fixed it immediately.
Suggestion
Either:

Normalise — strip the query string before resolving the package name, so a cache-busting suffix can't change identity; or
Reject loudly — if a file:// path contains ?, stop with an explicit error along the lines of "query strings are not supported in plugin paths; use a clean path".

Right now the failure mode is a duplicate-route stack from somewhere else in the tree, which doesn't point at the real cause. A clear error at parse time would save the restart-and-guess loop.
Environment

DSH desktop, local plugins mounted with file:// paths in a profile cordis.patch.yml
Same plugin path with and without ?v= compared side by side

threads.title: MCP client does not reconnect after HTTP 404 for an expired session
threads.bodyText:
Summary
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client does not recover when a Streamable HTTP MCP server returns HTTP 404 because the client's session has expired or been invalidated.
The current tool call correctly fails without being automatically replayed. However, the client keeps using the stale session ID for subsequent calls, even with reconnection enabled.
Reloading the MCP plugin or restarting DSH Web temporarily restores the connection, but the problem recurs if the session becomes invalid again.
Configuration
Both affected servers use the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client, with Streamable HTTP and reconnection enabled:
transport: streamable-http
reconnect:
  enabled: true
  initialDelayMs: 500
  maxDelayMs: 30000
  maxAttempts: 10
The official client's installed @modelcontextprotocol/client version is 2.2.0.
The third-party dsh-mcp management plugin 1.14.1 is also installed, but the issue was independently reproduced by directly loading the official client without loading that plugin.
Steps to reproduce

Connect the official MCP client to a stateful Streamable HTTP MCP server.
Complete initialization and initial tool discovery.
Invalidate the session on the server.
Call a registered tool. The server returns HTTP 404 for the stale session.
Allow time for the configured reconnect backoff.
Make another explicit tool call.

Actual behavior

The first tool call throws SdkHttpError with HTTP status 404.
That call is not automatically replayed.
No new initialization or tool discovery occurs.
The next explicit tool call still carries the old Mcp-Session-Id and fails with another 404.

An isolated reproduction using a mocked HTTP endpoint and the installed official client produced this request sequence:
POST initialize                 → session established
POST notifications/initialized
GET                             → 405 (standalone SSE unsupported by mock)
POST tools/list                 → success
POST tools/call [old session]   → 404
POST tools/call [old session]   → 404

The two tools/call requests above were two separate explicit invocations. Neither invocation was automatically replayed.
The test used shortened reconnect delays and still observed no new initialize or tools/list request after the first 404.
Expected behavior
When an established stateful HTTP session is reported as invalid with HTTP 404:

Return the error for the current invocation. Do not automatically replay it, since tool calls may have side effects.
Retire and close the stale client/transport.
Create a fresh client/transport and initialize a new session.
Synchronize tools and replace registrations so future explicit calls use the new client.
Coalesce concurrent invalid-session failures into a single recovery attempt.

Suspected cause
The official client's connection manager starts reconnection from generation.onclose.
However, the installed SDK's HTTP POST error path throws SdkHttpError and reports onerror for a 404 without closing the transport. Consequently, the connection manager never receives the close event needed to trigger recovery.
The tool execution path also propagates the error without invalidating the stale connection.
Relevant areas in the installed packages:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client: connectGeneration(), generation.onclose, and the tool-call bridge.
@modelcontextprotocol/client: StreamableHTTPClientTransport HTTP POST error handling.

This appears to be a missing session-invalidation recovery path, rather than a missing reconnect configuration.
Impact
After server-side session invalidation, MCP tools remain unusable until the user manually reloads the plugin or restarts DSH Web.

threads.title: Windows sandbox: every subprocess dies with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) in the desktop app
threads.bodyText:
Windows sandbox: every subprocess dies with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) in the desktop app
Version: DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (Electron 44.7.0, bundled node 24.21.0) OS: Windows 10 Pro 10.0.19045 (win32 x64, zh-CN) Severity: sandbox mode (workspace-write) is unusable — every pwsh tool call returns no output and exit code 3221225794 (0xC0000142). danger-full-access works fine.
Symptom
With the session file policy set to workspace-write, any shell call:
代码块
Write-Output "probe-ok"
→ (no output)  [exit code: 3221225794]
Zero bytes of stdout and stderr — the command never starts executing.
Happens regardless of command content, working directory, or whether PowerShell 7 is installed.
Switching the same session to danger-full-access makes the identical command succeed immediately:
代码块
Write-Output "probe-ok"
→ probe-ok
C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe
7.6.7
So it is not a missing/misconfigured shell, not PATH, not an endpoint-security product (plain powershell.exe -Command "echo hi" from a normal console works; Windows Application log has no Id 1000 crash records for pwsh/node, so the child never reaches the WER stage).
Root cause (from the shipped code)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox/lib/index.js — danger-full-access bypasses ctx.sandbox.confine(); every other mode wraps the argv through the Windows ACL restricted-token runner chain.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-*.js documents the boundary:
console isolation is unavailable — children share the host console (CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE children die with STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED under the restriction)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js — launchWindowsJob() spawns the runner with windowsHide: true unconditionally (Node maps this to CREATE_NO_WINDOW).
The desktop app is a GUI process, so it has no host console to share. The combination restricted token + CREATE_NO_WINDOW + no inherited console kills the runner during DLL/conhost initialization, before the target program is ever resolved — which is why installing PowerShell 7 changes nothing.
Reproduction
Fresh Windows 10 x64 machine (desktop app installed via NSIS).
Start DeepSeek Harness from Explorer (i.e. a GUI launch with no attached console).
New session, file policy workspace-write.
Ask the agent to run any shell command, e.g. echo hi.
Observe zero output + exit code 3221225794.
Switch the session to danger-full-access, repeat → succeeds.
Notes / hypothesis for the fix
The failure is plausibly absent when the harness is launched from a terminal, because the child can inherit the parent's console handles instead of allocating a new conhost under the restricted token. Confirming that A/B would pin the fix:
avoid windowsHide: true when a sandbox token is applied (spawn with the inherited console, per the documented boundary), or
route sandboxed launches through a runner that already owns a console, or
document that Windows sandbox mode requires launching the harness with a console.
Impact
On this configuration the Windows ACL sandbox provides zero usable shell capability, so users are forced to choose danger-full-access — i.e. the safe default is unavailable exactly where it is supposed to protect the user.

threads.title: 已声明组合包，但仍然提示未声明组合包

threads.title: [Bug] 发送消息后同一条用户消息出现两个气泡（数据层只有一条，疑似 queued 提交未参与去重）
threads.bodyText:
摘要
在 DSH 桌面端（0.2.1-rc.2, Windows）里,我会连续看到两个内容完全相同的「我」的气泡（同一句话、同一时间戳），但会话日志里只有一条真实用户消息。数据没问题，是前端把语音渲染了两次。
环境

DSH: 0.2.1-rc.2（Desktop, win-x64）
OS: Windows 11
模型: deepseek-official / deepseek-flash
已装插件与本问题无关（我把所有第三方插件逐个排除过；日志层可证明只有一条消息）

现象
截图（正文里无法内联，描述如下）：对话流里连续出现两个用户气泡，内容都是「好了吗」，两个气泡下方的时间戳都是 00:17，各带一个复制按钮——视觉上完全像发了两次。
数据层是干净的
同一个会话的 session.v4.jsonl.zstd 里，那次发送只有 1 条 source.kind === "user" 的事件（其余是 cadence 自动注入的 memmy-memory / runtime-context / time-context，都是 role: "user" 但不是用户输入）：
00:17:41  user/message  kind=user            "好了吗"
00:17:41  user/message  kind=memmy-memory    "<memmy_l3_world_model ..."
00:17:41  user/message  kind=runtime-context  "Current runtime context ..."
00:17:41  user/message  kind=time-context     "Time sampled ..."

所以：不会重复计费、不会重复回答，纯前端显示问题。
事件链：发送时 Agent 正在运行



时刻
事件




00:22:12
agent/inbox/spliced target=next-step，插入「没好」


00:22:16
agent/inbox/spliced target=next-step，removedCount:1


00:22:20
user/message kind=user「没好」



另一次在 Agent 空闲时发送（00:24:40）走的是 next-turn，入队与出队同时发生——那种情况下我只看到一条气泡。所以触发条件很可能是：消息进入排队（queued）路径时才会重复。
代码定位（@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat/lib/client.js）
const localIds = new Set(pendingSubmissions
  .filter((submission) => submission.placement !== "queued")   // ← queued 被排除
  .map((submission) => submission.requestId))
...
return [...inboxSteering.flatMap((item) => {
  const source = item.source
  if (source.kind !== "user" || !("rpcId" in source)) return [item]
  const submission = local.get(source.rpcId)
  if (submission === void 0) return localIds.has(source.rpcId) ? [] : [item]   // ← 不在集合就渲染
  ...
推断：

Agent 运行中发送 → placement === "queued"；
visibleSubmissions 把 queued 的提交从 transcript 里隐藏；
但 localIds 同样把 queued 排除 → 队列里的那条在 inboxSteering 中被当成独立气泡渲染；
消息落到 transcript 后再渲染一次 → 两个气泡。

期望

同一条用户消息只显示一个气泡；
排队期间与落盘后应互相替代（或排队气泡在 claim/落盘后消失）。

复现步骤

发送一条消息让 Agent 开始回答（回答有工具调用，耗时间较长）；
在 Agent 仍在运行时再发一条短消息；
观察：新消息出现两个相同气泡。

其他

0.2.1-rc.3 的 release note 中没有相关修复。
截图我无法通过 API 上传（GitHub API 不支持往 Discussion 传二进制），维护者需要的话我可以补，或直接看上面的事件链复现。

threads.title: [Bug] DSH 桌面端认证崩溃：dsh-auth-* Cookie 累积导致请求头超限
threads.bodyText:
现象描述
应用启动即崩溃，日志（crash-*-host.log）连续多次报错：
text
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
at connectDesktopWelcome (...app.asar/lib/main.js:8886:31)
环境：Windows (win32 x64)，Electron 44.7.0，Node 24.21.0，DSH 桌面端 0.2.1-rc.2。
根因分析
经逆向 app.asar 及抓包验证，问题出在 Electron 会话 Cookie 罐中累积了过多的陈旧 dsh-auth-* Cookie，导致认证请求头超限被服务端拒绝。
每次启动应用时，服务端 Set-Cookie 签发的 Cookie 名都是随机的（dsh-auth- + 43位随机字符），且有效期长达 30 天。
主进程使用 net.fetch(..., { credentials: "include" }) 请求时，会自动带上所有匹配 127.0.0.1 的 Cookie。
实测发现 Cookie 罐（SQLite）中积压了 71 条历史遗留的 dsh-auth-* Cookie（约 20KB），超出了 HTTP 服务端请求头大小上限，导致请求被拒绝（返回 401），进而抛出认证失败错误。
佐证：清理 Cookie 库后，应用恢复正常启动。
临时修复方案（SQL 清理）
关闭所有应用进程，打开 %APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\Cookies（SQLite），执行：
sql
DELETE FROM cookies
WHERE host_key LIKE '%127.0.0.1%' AND name LIKE 'dsh-auth-%';
清理后重启应用，握手成功，Cookie 罐仅保留本次启动新签发的一条。
给官方的修复建议
固定 Cookie 名（例如统一使用 dsh-auth），让新 Set-Cookie 覆盖旧值。
启动时主动清理：在主进程握手前后，调用 session.defaultSession.cookies.remove() 清理陈旧 Cookie。
认证接口可考虑返回 431 Request Header Fields Too Large 并在日志中明确记录，便于排查。
可选：设为会话级 Cookie（不发 Max-Age），退出时自动清除。
附加
dsh-startup-auth-crash-report-public.md
dsh-auth-cookie-clean.py
dsh-auth-cookie-inject.py

threads.title: Frequent abnormal WebSocket closes (1006) on reconnect as open-session history grows
threads.bodyText:
I maintain a third-party VS Code client for DSH and traced repeated, intermittent disconnects to a session-lifecycle scaling issue. I'd like to share the root cause and ask how the maintainers intend this to be handled.
Symptom
Over a local loopback connection (no physical network), the client's WebSocket to the gateway is terminated repeatedly right after a reconnect — an abnormal close with no close frame (code 1006). It correlates with the number of open sessions, not with network conditions.
Root cause
Two mechanisms combine:


Aggressive heartbeat. packages/api/gateway/src/stream-server.ts pings every websocketHeartbeatIntervalMs (default 2000 ms) and calls socket.terminate() once MAX_MISSED_HEARTBEATS = 2 pongs are missed. A client has roughly 4–6 seconds to answer a ping before being dropped.


Eager, full history delivery. On connect, the client subscribes to every open session and receives the entire history of each via session/follow. With ~23 sessions and multi-hundred-KB histories in my environment, that is ~18 MB of records that must be decoded and validated against the session codec. That decode is CPU-bound; if it runs synchronously, pongs are starved past the 4–6 s window and the socket is terminated — even though the client is doing legitimate work rather than hanging.


The client-side mitigation is to decode snapshots incrementally and yield to the event loop (I have applied this), which keeps pongs flowing. But that only masks the underlying scaling problem.
The deeper question
Session state is delivered eagerly and in full: every reconnect re-sends the complete history of every subscribed session, so the work is O(number of open sessions × history length). As a user accumulates sessions, reconnects get progressively heavier and eventually trip the heartbeat. There is no archive/lifecycle mechanism to bound this — a user must manually close old sessions to keep the client responsive.
How is this intended to be handled?

Must users archive sessions by hand? That feels counterintuitive — other AI coding assistants do not require you to prune history to stay responsive.
Should DSH auto-archive idle sessions under some policy?
Or should history delivery be improved instead — e.g. lazy/paginated snapshots, delta-only delivery on reconnect, or a more forgiving heartbeat?

I would appreciate guidance on the intended direction, or a pointer to any existing mechanism (projection, history window, archive flag) I may have missed.

threads.title: Session search fails entirely when any single stored session is unreadable
threads.bodyText:
Summary
session_search and session_event_search fail for the entire corpus when a single stored session cannot be read. In my workspace, 8 legacy-format sessions out of 170 made every search fail — while exact reads kept working normally.
Environment

dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2, commit 687f282e86, Linux x64, Node 26.11.1, pnpm 11.28.5
Session root: ~/.dsh/sessions — 170 sessions, 98.7 MB compressed logs
Index config: path: ':memory:', openAt: first-search

Observed behavior
Every search returns:
session history storage is unavailable

Meanwhile exact reads keep working fine — session_trace and session_event_read both return correct data. So the session data is intact; only search is broken.
Root cause
SqliteSessionQueryEngine._observeStable (packages/session-query/session-query-sqlite/src/index.ts:495) enumerates every persisted session via persistence.list() — the engine has no workspace scoping — then cold-reads each one with readColdSessionLog. Any single failure propagates out of the try block and aborts the whole search with SESSION_QUERY_PERSISTENCE_FAILED.
My session root mixes three format generations:



Format
Count




session.v4.jsonl.zstd
115


session.v3.jsonl.zstd
16


session.jsonl.zstd (v0)
39



Four of the v0 sessions cannot be migrated at all:
cannot safely transform unclassified message source;
source v0 artifact remains unchanged

So pnpm run migrate:sessions-to-v4 cannot fix this: those sessions can never become readable, and they permanently disable search for every other session.
Proposed fix
Treat one unreadable stored session as a skipped session, not a failed search — log it and continue, keeping any previously indexed documents. Cancellation must still propagate, and persistence-level failures (a rejected list, a malformed snapshot) should still fail the whole call, because they leave the corpus itself unknown.
I verified this locally: after the change, the same 170-session root returns correct results, and vitest run packages/session-query passes 351 tests.
Two related issues
1. The error code is downgraded to a misleading message.
packages/experimental/tool-session-query/src/service-boundary.ts maps SessionQueryError.code to model-safe text, but the code is lost across the PTC process boundary. SESSION_QUERY_SEARCH_DISABLED and other specific codes surface as the generic SESSION_QUERY_PERSISTENCE_FAILED → "session history storage is unavailable", which wrongly implies data loss.
2. Search latency is 23–27 s on a warm process.
With path: ':memory:' every search re-runs a full reconcile: 170 sessions and 98.7 MB of zstd logs decompressed and validated each time. A persistent index path plus incremental reconciliation (only sessions whose revision changed) would remove this cost.
Workaround
Pointing --sessions-dir at a directory containing only v4 sessions works around it, but that excludes the historical sessions from search.

threads.title: [Bug] Single large session OOMs at startup: agent-loop re-copies the whole event array even when closers is empty
threads.bodyText:
摘要
单个会话的日志变得足够大之后，冷启动就会撞 V8 堆上限并 FATAL 崩溃，而崩溃点不在"读文件"那一步，而在把已经读进来的事件数组再复制一份那一步。
我们这边实测：一个会话 session.v4.jsonl.zstd 100 MB（zstd）→ 解压 341 MB，启动后 43 秒堆涨到 2045 MB 撞顶（默认 ~2 GB），栈是 node::worker::Message::Serialize。
环境
DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（PVE 上的 Linux 部署，非桌面端）
Node 默认堆上限（未设 NODE_OPTIONS 时）
会话目录 47 个会话 / 157 MB 压缩，其中单个会话占 100 MB

根因（定位到具体代码行）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js（0.2.1-rc.2）：
const coldRead = await handle.read(0, void 0, { signal: fused });   // 恢复路径要全部事件
const persisted = coldRead.events;
const closers = interruptedTurnClosers(persisted);
if (closers.length > 0) await handle.append(closers);              // 上一行判断了空
preparation = SessionPreparation.create(this.runtime.ctx.sessions.prepare(id, {
  seed: [...persisted, ...closers],                                // 下一行无条件展开复制
closers 只有在"上次崩在回合中间"时才非空；平时它是空数组，但这一行照样把 persisted 整个展开复制一份。于是同一个事件数组在峰值时存在两份（再叠加 worker 侧 structuredClone 的传输副本）。
我们的实测对得上这个判断：
峰值 2131 MB → 稳定后 1649 MB
差值 ≈ 480 MB = 那份复制被 GC 掉

为什么换持久化后端解决不了
恢复路径调用的是 read(0, void 0)（从头读到尾、不限长度）。任何 persistence 实现都必须把全部事件交出来，所以：

换 sqlite / mysql 后端：省不掉"事件数组驻留"
加一个"状态快照"旁路：SessionPreparation.create 吃的就是 seed: events[]，没有这个接缝

（read(offset, length) 的窗口读接口是有的，但只有 log-export / session-query 在用。）
建议（按代价从低到高）

closers 为空时不复制：seed: closers.length ? [...persisted, ...closers] : persisted
语义等价（空数组展开等于不展开），峰值直接腰斩，改动面一个表达式。
给大日志会话一个加载预算：比如超过 N MB 的会话走"分段加载 / 懒加载尾部"。
会话分段：让长会话能按阶段拆成多个 session，冷启动成本就恒定。

一个愿望：希望支持切换会话持久化后端
我们在另一套自建 agent（Hermes）上用 SQLite 存会话，它的好处是行可寻址 + active=0 标记，可以让"历史查询"和"恢复上下文"走不同的读取路径。
DSH 现在只有 dsh-session-persistence-jsonl 一个实现（接口 dsh-session-persistence 是抽象的、干净、其它包都依赖接口而不是实现）。所以从架构上换实现是可行的，但如上节所述：只要 agent-loop 的恢复路径固定为 read(0, void 0)，换后端也治不了内存问题。
因此这个愿望更准确地说是两条：
① 让持久化实现可替换（接口已经有，缺的是官方愿意承认"这是可换的"）
② 让恢复路径支持"从某个检查点接着读"，而不是必须从头

如果 ② 成立，后端换成 sqlite/mysql 才有意义 —— 否则换的只是"怎么读"，读的量一点没少。

threads.title: Startup fails with "Web authentication failed": local dsh-auth-* cookies accumulate on every restart until the request header limit is exceeded (win32, 0.2.1-rc.2)
threads.bodyText:
Environment: Windows 11 (win32 x64) · @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 · Electron 44.7.0 · Node 24.21.0
1. Background

Installed the DeepSeek desktop app on Oct 18 and used it daily with 2–3 restarts per day (71 launches in ~4 days)
About one day after installing, I wrote my own desktop-pet plugin (dsh-whale-pet) — pure UI decoration and voice playback, nothing related to auth, cookies, or networking. Plugin debugging involved a lot of restarts
On the evening of Oct 22, the app suddenly failed to start: the process appeared and exited four times in a row, each time with Web authentication failed

2. The issue I'd like to report
Crash log logs/crash-2026-10-22T14-35-51-369Z-host.log:
source: host
phase: startup
app: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.2
platform: win32 x64
electron: 44.7.0
node: 24.21.0

--- error ---
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
    at connectDesktopWelcome (…/resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:8886:31)
    at async Object.start (…/lib/main.js:12195:22)
    at async …/lib/main.js:7162:5
    at async …/lib/main.js:12313:4

While investigating, I found that 71 dsh-auth-* cookies had accumulated under 127.0.0.1. The Cookie request header alone is 16,186 bytes (per cookie: 52-char name + = + 173-byte value = 226 B, plus a 2-byte ;  separator between entries, i.e. 71×226 + 70×2). Add the usual Host, User-Agent and other headers, and the total necessarily exceeds Node.js's default 16,384-byte header limit (maxHeaderSize).
The issue: the cookie count grows by exactly 1 on every restart, and I suspect that once the header crosses the limit, startup authentication fails. To confirm, I ran three sets of verification.
3. Verification
Check 1: each launch adds one cookie, and old ones are never removed

The 71 cookie names follow dsh-auth- + base64url(sha256(authority)), where authority contains the random listening port
Brute-forcing 127.0.0.1:1024–65535 mapped all 71 records to 71 distinct ports (range 49662–65534, the Windows dynamic port range)
So: one launch = one new record. Since the port changes every time, the cookie name changes too, so records can never overwrite each other; and I saw no sign of old records being deleted
All records had expires set to 30 days after creation, so none would naturally expire during Oct 18–22
Common suspects were ruled out along the way: no system proxy (ProxyEnable=0); credentials intact (after clearing the cookies the app started without re-login); no port conflict; authenticateWebHost had already passed — the failure happened on the subsequent welcome connection

Check 2: forced over-limit reproduction — push the cookies past the limit and it always crashes; roll back and it recovers
This is the most direct check. I ran an injection experiment on a copy of the app's Cookies database (the app itself was not modified):



Stage
dsh-auth-* count
Cookie header size
Launch result




Before injection
2
454 B
✅ normal start


After injecting 120 format-identical rows
122
27,814 B
❌ crash on startup


After rolling Cookies back from backup
original state
—
✅ relaunched successfully




The injected rows were synthesized to match the real cookies exactly: 52-char name, 173-byte plaintext value, empty encrypted_value, +30 days expiry
The crash behavior was identical to the natural accumulation: crashDetected=true, one crash-*-host.log (phase: startup), zero renderer logs, 4 leftover processes
The stack trace was word-for-word the same: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed at connectDesktopWelcome (main.js:8886:31)

This closes the causal loop: cookies over the limit → startup authentication failure.
Check 3: ruled out my own plugin (control experiment)
To rule out "my plugin broke the environment", I ran a control experiment:

Removed the plugin from the profile completely before the experiment
Launched the app 8 times in a row; each round: launch → wait for the main window to actually appear → close normally → count cookies (Chromium holds the DB exclusively while running, so counting had to happen after exit)
3 rounds were discarded as invalid (2 never really started; 1 closed too early, before the handshake reached the cookie-writing step). The remaining 5 valid launches each added exactly 1 cookie, monotonically increasing
During the experiment the plugin was not loaded, and the leftover-process behavior was unchanged

Conclusion: with or without the plugin, the behavior is identical — this is not related to third-party plugins.
A related observation: closing the main window leaves 5 DeepSeek Harness processes behind. On the next launch the UI shows "no response / spinning forever" because control is handed to the windowless old instance — and every such retry also appears to add one more cookie.
4. Code I came across (for reference only)
In app.asar, lib/types/browser-auth.js (part of @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host), the issuance logic looks like:
const COOKIE_PREFIX = "dsh-auth-";
const DAY_MILLISECONDS = 1440 * 60 * 1e3;   // 30 days

function cookieName(authority) {
    return COOKIE_PREFIX + encodeBase64Url(sha256(authority));
}
From what I could see, there is no logic that cleans up old cookies (neither expiry-by-authority nor a cap with recycling). I did not read the entire codebase, so this is only my observation and may be incomplete — sharing it in case it helps the team.
5. My current workaround
Since I still need to use the app, I wrote a small local guard script (dsh_cookie_guard.py) that watches for process exit and then deletes records matching host_key='127.0.0.1' AND name LIKE 'dsh-auth-%', with autostart, process patrol, and log rotation.
This is only a stopgap so I can keep working — it doesn't modify the app, and I understand it is not a real fix. Long term, I'd hope the issuance/cleanup strategy could be revisited on the official side.
6. A few rough ideas (just brainstorming, take or leave)

On startup, delete historical records that don't match the current authority
Persist the host service port, so a fixed port means a fixed cookie name and same-name overwrite
Make the cookie a session cookie (expires with the session)
Add a cap that recycles the oldest records beyond a threshold
Ensure child processes fully exit when the main window closes, so leftover processes can't hold the single-instance lock

7. How to reproduce / check, and evidence
-- current accumulated count
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cookies
WHERE host_key='127.0.0.1' AND name LIKE 'dsh-auth-%';

-- estimate cookie header size (226 B per cookie + 2 B between entries)
SELECT SUM(LENGTH(name) + LENGTH(value) + 1) + (COUNT(*) - 1) * 2 AS header_bytes,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM cookies
WHERE host_key='127.0.0.1' AND name LIKE 'dsh-auth-%';
DB path: %APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\Cookies (if the header size is already over the limit, fully quit the app first — otherwise the file is locked).
Evidence package (sanitized, safe to share): dsh-cookie-repro-20261023-redacted.zip


Contains: before/after Cookies DB snapshots (real values replaced with 173-byte dummies; names, counts and header sizes preserved), crash logs, and a machine-readable repro-result.json
dsh-cookie-repro-20261023-redacted.zip


SHA256: 00aeecda666c951a85061e09817da76b81e4b4a13c0fc3cec1c6e6b6e245acb2


Happy to attach it or send it by email if further investigation needs it (no credentials included)

threads.title: llm-deepseek: a missing attachment surfaces as TRANSPORT ("DeepSeek Messages transport failed"), is retried 5x, and blocks the session
threads.bodyText:
Issues are disabled on this repo, so posting here per README (feedback/bug reports go to Discussions).

Environment

DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 (dshBuildCommit 332895e0f7c9d4dbfb29729f5eb367fa263ff986)
Windows 11 x64, Electron 44.7.0
provider deepseek-official, model deepseek-flash, reasoningEffort: high
default baseURL (https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic), no proxy, no custom endpoint

Symptom
Once a session's durable history contains an image block whose attachment blob is gone from the local content-addressed store, every subsequent request in that session fails immediately:
assistant/attempt { finish: { kind: "error", failure: { message: "DeepSeek Messages transport failed", code: "TRANSPORT" } } }
llm/retry        { retry: 1..5, maxRetries: 5, failure: { ... code: "TRANSPORT" } }
turn/end         { reason: { kind: "error", error: { message: "DeepSeek Messages transport failed", code: "TRANSPORT" } } }


First failure lands ~80 ms after the blob disappears — no network round trip is made, so this is a local failure, not transport.
The default retry policy (["normal", 5, ["EMPTY_RESPONSE","MALFORMED_RESPONSE","RATE_LIMIT","SERVER","TIMEOUT","TRANSPORT"], 500, 10000, 0.1]) puts TRANSPORT in the retryable set, so every step burns 5 attempts (~15–20 s) before the turn ends in error.
It never self-heals: the dangling reference stays in history, so every later turn repeats it. The only way out is abandoning the session (or hand-editing its journal).
The message points the user at the network, while the actual cause is "attachment object is missing". The cause carried on the LlmError never reaches llm/retry / turn/end, so the journal alone cannot distinguish this from a real socket failure.

Root cause
prepareImages() is the first statement of request():
packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/adapter.ts:96
const { messages, versions } = await prepareImages(
  options.messages, connection, options.model, this.dependencies.resolveAttachments?.(), this.imageAccess, signal,
)
prepareImages() resolves every retained image through attachments.readImageRequest(...). When the blob $DSH_HOME/attachments/v1/objects/<h[0:2]>/<h> is absent, @deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local throws
AttachmentError('Attachment object is missing.', 'ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND')

AttachmentError extends Error, not LlmError, and generate() only preserves LlmError:
packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/adapter.ts:76-80
} catch (error) {
  if (timeoutOf(watchdog.signal, 'MESSAGES_IDLE') !== undefined) throw new LlmError('DeepSeek Messages stream idle timeout', 'TIMEOUT', { cause: error })
  if (options.signal?.aborted) throw new LlmError('DeepSeek Messages request aborted', 'ABORTED', { cause: error })
  if (error instanceof LlmError) throw error
  throw new LlmError('DeepSeek Messages transport failed', 'TRANSPORT', { cause: error })
}
So a deterministic, purely local "attachment missing/corrupt" condition is classified as a transient transport failure and retried.
Same shape exists one layer down for the Files API: file-store.ts — throw new LlmError('DeepSeek Files API request to ${this.baseURL} failed', 'TRANSPORT', { cause: error }).
Reproduction (self-contained, no user data)

Start a session and get an image into it, e.g. a tool result with { "type": "image", "attachment": { "attachmentId": "sha256:<h>" } }.
Confirm the object exists at $DSH_HOME/attachments/v1/objects/<h[0:2]>/<h>.
Delete just that object file (leave the session journal untouched).
Send any follow-up message. Every step fails in <100 ms with TRANSPORT, 5 retries, then turn/end error.
Restore the exact same bytes at the same path → the session works again.

Step 5 isolates the blob as the only variable: nothing about credentials, network, model or journal changed.
Expected

A non-retryable, self-describing error, e.g. code: "ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND" with a message naming the attachment id, surfaced in the transcript as such.
Optionally, a UI affordance on resume: "N images in this conversation are no longer available" with an action to drop/placeholder them from history (the alternative today is abandoning the session).

Suggested fix (minimal)
In generate()'s catch, before the catch-all wrap:
if (isAttachmentError(error)) throw new LlmError(`Image attachment unavailable: ${error.message}`, error.code, { cause: error })
and keep that code out of the retry policy (it is deterministic). Consider also surfacing cause.message on llm/retry / turn/end, so an attachment failure is not indistinguishable from a socket failure in the session journal.
Impact
Anyone who cleans, restores, syncs, or partially loses $DSH_HOME/attachments (a privacy-motivated cleanup of locally generated images is an obvious case) permanently loses the ability to continue those conversations, and is told the network is broken.

threads.title: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client npm `latest` tag points at 0.0.1-rc.1, so an unpinned `dsh plugin add` is rejected as incompatible
threads.bodyText:
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client on dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 fails:
dsh: installation rejected: Plugin @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.0.1-rc.1 is incompatible with dsh 0.2.1-rc.2: requirements {"@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm":"^0.0.1-rc.1","@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools":"^0.0.1-rc.1","@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants":"^0.0.1-rc.1","@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess":"^0.0.1-rc.1"}. Running it may cause crashes or data loss. ...
dsh: nothing was installed.

Cause: the package's npm dist-tags are out of step with the rest of the scope, so an unpinned install resolves the first release candidate.
$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client dist-tags
{ latest: '0.0.1-rc.1', alpha: '0.2.1-alpha.5', next: '0.2.1-rc.3' }

$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh dist-tags
{ latest: '0.2.1-rc.2', alpha: '0.2.1-alpha.5', next: '0.2.1-rc.3' }

Workaround: pin the version.
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.2

That installs cleanly, mounts from cordis.patch.yml, spawns the server at boot and registers its tools. Verified with chrome-devtools-mcp@1.12.0 (35 tools registered as mcp__chrome__*) on arm64 Linux, node 22, pnpm 12.
Suggested fix: npm dist-tag add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.2 latest.
Also, the install example in packages/mcp/mcp-client/README.md uses the bare package name, so it reproduces the failure for anyone who copies it until the tag is fixed. Happy to send a docs PR with a chrome-devtools-mcp example alongside the memory-server guide if that would be useful.

threads.title: [Bug] Desktop: 卷根 ACL 含包 SID 但缺 ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES 时启动即崩；自动更新后必现「双击无反应」
threads.bodyText:
Windows 11，安装于 D:\。卷根 ACL 含 AppContainer 包 SID ACE、但缺 ALL
APPLICATION PACKAGES（S-1-15-2-1）ACE 时，桌面端启动即静默崩溃：无窗口、
无提示，双击没反应。自动更新后必现（更新文件继承坏 ACL 且未补授），重装无效。
环境

Windows 11 家庭版 Build 26200
桌面端 0.2.0.2 / 0.2.0.3（Electron 44.7.0），安装路径 D:\deepseekherness

日志
以 --enable-logging 启动，stderr：
FATAL:electron\shell\browser\win\install_dir_access.cc:52] Sandboxed processes
cannot read D:\deepseekherness: its ACL has an entry for an AppContainer package
SID but none for ALL APPLICATION PACKAGES...
事件日志（每次一致）：Event 1000，Exception 0x80000003，fault offset 0x7356e49，
faulting module 为 exe 自身。
根因
Chromium 沙箱要求：安装目录 DACL 有包 SID ACE 时必须同时有 AAP ACE，否则
沙箱进程无法读取安装目录，主进程 FATAL 退出。更新器不补授该 ACE，故每次
更新后复发。
临时解决
icacls "<安装目录>" /grant *S-1-15-2-1:(OI)(CI)(RX) /T
执行后立即恢复正常。
建议

安装器/更新器写入后补授 AAP ACE
启动时预检 ACL，失败弹窗提示，而非静默崩溃
疑与 #10448 属同类沙箱 ACL 问题

threads.title: [dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 / Windows] desktop host 进程反复异常退出（exit 3758096392 / 0xE0000008），shell 自动重启
threads.bodyText:
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.3（前一版本 rc.2 也出现过一次），win32 x64，electron 44.7.0，node 24.21.0，locale zh-CN
机器使用 nvm-windows，bili 日志显示 host 检测到 d:\nvm\nodejs/node.exe 是包装器并直接拉起真实 node（v=0.1.204，日志引用 #1887）
配置了 Atlassian (Jira) MCP server（stdio 方式）

现象
host 子进程静默异常退出，Electron 主进程在 main.js:3844 的 close 处理器按致命错误处理并自动重启（GUI 端口变更、会话恢复）。两天内三次：

2026-10-22 14:51:30（0.2.1-rc.2）exited with 1073807364（0x40010004）
2026-10-24 15:50:04（0.2.1-rc.3）exited with 3758096392（0xE0000008）

[Bug] shell 工具 100% 失败 (0xC0000142)；重装后应用无法启动 (0.2.1-rc.3 / Win11)
threads.bodyText:
DeepSeek Harness 预览版 Bug 报告
报告人：普通用户（非开发者）
日期：2026-10-24
版本：DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.3（更新通道 nightly）
系统：Windows 11，64 位，中文计算机名
安装方式：官方下载 https://download.deepseek.com/desktop/dsh-latest-windows-x64.exe

摘要
两个独立问题：

所有 shell 命令执行失败，错误码 3221225794（0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）
卸载重装后程序无法启动，进程启动即退出，退出码 0x80000003，无任何日志输出

第 2 个问题可能是第 1 个问题排查过程中触发的，也可能是独立缺陷。

Bug 1：shell 工具 100% 失败
现象
任何通过 shell 执行的命令都返回相同错误：
运行命令 · Retry shell with explicit workdir
✗ 退出码 3221225794

即使用最简单的命令也一样：
echo ok

模型侧收到的反馈是：shell 起不来，所有 pwsh 调用返回 exit code 3221225794（0xC0000142，DLL 初始化失败），连 echo ok 都不行。
复现步骤

安装 0.2.1-rc.3
新建会话（创造模式 / 标准模式均如此）
让 Agent 执行任意命令，例如「运行 echo ok」
必现

已排除的原因（均为实测，非推测）



怀疑项
测试方法
结果




工作目录含中文
把工作区切到纯 ASCII 路径 C:\Users\wx200\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-test 后重试
仍失败


缺少 VC++ 运行库
检查 System32 下 vcruntime140.dll、vcruntime140_1.dll、msvcp140.dll、concrt140.dll
全部存在，且已安装 VC++ 运行库


系统 ConPTY 损坏
独立安装 node-pty（npm），用同一 ConPTY 机制 spawn cmd.exe /c echo ok 与 powershell.exe
均正常输出 ok，退出码 0


系统 PATH 损坏
用 Node 的 child_process.spawnSync 直接 spawn powershell.exe -Command echo ok
正常，退出码 0


权限模式
沙箱模式 workspace-write 下复现
未能在 UI 中切换 Full access 后复测


环境变量被裁剪
用 Node 以空 env {} spawn powershell
仍正常启动



附加线索

程序内部模块：resources/app.asar.unpacked/dsh/node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/win32-x64/conpty.node
该文件大小 304,616 字节，SHA256 前 16 位 B1FD2914229C11B0
卸载后重新安装，该文件哈希完全一致
终端控制器模块名：@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-terminal-controller，其中 shell 候选顺序为 zsh → bash → fish → pwsh → powershell → cmd
本机未安装 PowerShell 7（pwsh.exe 不存在），系统只有 Windows PowerShell 5.1

建议排查方向

检查 conpty.node 是否与目标系统的 CPU 特性 / Windows 版本兼容（是否使用了特定指令集编译）
检查 dsh-api-terminal-controller 验证 shell 候选时的 spawn 参数（是否传入了非默认的 env / cwd / detached 组合）
在 spawn 失败时把底层系统错误码完整打印到日志，目前用户侧完全看不到原因


Bug 2：卸载重装后程序无法启动
现象
卸载（Uninstall DeepSeek Harness.exe /S /KEEP_APP_DATA）后重新安装，程序启动即退出：
退出码: -2147483645  (0x80000003 STATUS_BREAKPOINT)

关键细节

stdout、stderr 全部为空
Windows 事件查看器 → 应用程序日志中没有任何 DeepSeek 相关记录
%APPDATA%\DeepSeek Harness 与 %LOCALAPPDATA%\DeepSeek Harness 根本没有被创建
说明进程在初始化早期就退出了，连用户数据目录都没走到

已排除



怀疑项
结果




安装路径含中文
分别装在 …\大肥鱼的工作台\dsh；\ 与纯 ASCII 的 C:\DSH\


残留进程占用
确认无任何相关进程


残留锁文件
~/.dsh 下无 lock / pid 文件



时间线

15:45 首次安装（/S 静默装到 %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DeepSeek Harness）→ 可以正常启动和使用
因 Bug 1 排查，执行卸载
之后无论装到哪里，都无法启动

建议排查方向

卸载程序是否删除了重装后不会重建的必要组件（注册表项、清单文件、运行库）
首次启动与二次启动的初始化流程差异
该退出码在 Electron 中通常对应原生模块加载失败或单实例检测，建议在失败时输出至少一行日志


其他观察

安装程序不支持静默安装：带 /S 参数执行返回退出码 2（即使已经指定 /D= 目标目录），只能走 GUI
GUI 安装时对某些路径误报「无法写入此位置。请选择当前用户可写入的文件夹」，但该路径实测普通账户完全可写（C:\ 根目录对 Authenticated Users 完全控制），疑似路径可写性检查逻辑缺陷


期望

shell 工具能正常执行命令
启动失败时至少输出一行可读的错误信息，而不是静默退出
卸载重装应当是可靠路径，不能把「能用的」变成「不能用的」


报告基于 2026-10-24 的完整排查过程整理。排除了 5 类常见原因，均附带测试方法，便于复现核对。

threads.title: **标求助：DSH 定时任务如何实现 WorkBuddy 式“独立会话”模式？81 个任务挤在一个对话里已无法管理**
threads.bodyText:
中文版
之前用 WorkBuddy，建定时任务就是对话里说一句，任务直接挂到独立的自动化列表里，每次执行拉起独立会话，跟当前聊天完全解耦。81 个任务各跑各的，互不干扰。
现在迁到 DeepSeek Harness，发现定时任务（或当前可用的调度方式）是绑定对话的——81 个任务全部落在同一个对话里，改一个任务要翻半天历史，执行记录和日常聊天混在一起，完全没法正常维护。
我知道 DSH 是插件化架构，调度层本身可替换。想找的是不把任务绑死在创建对话上的方案，类似 WorkBuddy 的模式：

任务独立创建、独立管理，不依赖某个“宿主对话”存活；
每次执行使用独立 Session，或至少不把提示词注入回创建时的会话；
最好有 Web 管理面板，能批量查看、启停、编辑 81 条量级的任务。

我目前了解到 DSH 生态里有几个社区插件可能接近这个方向，但不确定哪个对“81 条任务、不绑对话”的支持最稳：

@liushutan/dsh-automation — 每次执行“fresh root Agent and Session”，不继承源对话历史；
dsh-plugin-automations（Sev7een） — 明确“每次执行使用独立 Session”，支持 cron + once；
dsh-polling — 任务本身就是一个独立会话，出现在侧边栏“轮询”工作区；
dsh-schedule-tasks — 支持 headless / 独立进程运行，侧边栏管理面板。

想请教有实际使用经验的朋友：

以上哪个（或还有其他插件）最接近 WorkBuddy 那种“建完就丢在那儿、每个任务独立跑”的体验？
在 81 条任务量级下，哪个插件的 Web 管理面板还能保持可操作，不会卡顿或混乱？
如果插件路线都不理想，有没有外置调度 + headless DSH 调用的替代思路（比如系统 cron / n8n 之类触发 dsh 一次性执行）？
这些插件在 DSH 版本升级后的兼容性怎么样，有没有已知的“升级即挂”的坑？

感谢任何实际经验或踩坑反馈。

English Version
Title: Help: Is there a WorkBuddy-style "standalone session" scheduler for DSH? 81 tasks crammed into one conversation is unmanageable
On WorkBuddy, creating a scheduled task was trivial—say it in chat, and the task lived in a separate automation list. Each run spun up its own independent session, fully decoupled from the conversation where it was created. I had 81 tasks running side by side, no interference.
Moving to DeepSeek Harness, I'm hitting a wall: scheduling appears to be conversation-bound. All 81 tasks ended up tied to a single conversation. Editing one means scrolling through a massive history, and execution logs are mixed with everyday chat. It's not workable.
I understand DSH has a pluggable scheduling layer. What I'm looking for is a non-conversation-bound model, similar to WorkBuddy's:

Tasks created and managed independently, not tied to the lifespan of a "host conversation";
Each execution uses a fresh / independent Session, or at minimum does not inject the prompt back into the creating conversation;
A Web management panel that remains usable at the ~81-task scale—batch view, enable/disable, edit.

I'm aware of a few community plugins that seem to point in this direction, but I'm not sure which handles "81 tasks, not conversation-bound" most reliably:

@liushutan/dsh-automation — starts each occurrence in a "fresh root Agent and Session", no source-chat history inherited;
dsh-plugin-automations (Sev7een) — explicitly "each execution uses an independent Session", supports cron + once;
dsh-polling — each task is its own session, surfaced in a sidebar "Polling" workspace;
dsh-schedule-tasks — headless / standalone process support, sidebar management panel.

Would appreciate input from anyone who has actually run these at scale:

Which of the above (or any other plugin) comes closest to the WorkBuddy experience—set it and forget it, each task running on its own?
At 81 tasks, does any plugin's Web UI remain operable without becoming a mess?
If no plugin fits cleanly, is the external scheduler + headless DSH route viable (system cron / n8n triggering a one-shot dsh run)?
How stable are these plugins across DSH upgrades—any known "upgrade breaks it" traps?

Any real-world experience or gotchas would be greatly appreciated.

threads.title: Supported browser-session revocation procedure for Harness 0.2.1-rc.2

I'm running DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 on Windows 11 using the Web client.
I'm preparing a security-sensitive local integration and need to revoke a previously exposed Web launch token and any browser-session cookies derived from it.
The published Connection documentation indicates:

Restarting Harness rotates the process launch token.
Browser-session cookies remain valid across ordinary restarts.
Global revocation requires deletion of the client-connection/browser-session credential record followed by a restart.

I found the credential service's deleteRecord API, but couldn't identify a supported CLI command or administrative UI action.
What is the recommended operator procedure to globally revoke existing browser sessions on this version?
Ideally, I'm looking for a supported approach that preserves unrelated model credentials, sessions, profiles, and workspace configuration.
I'd also appreciate guidance on verifying that previously issued browser cookies can no longer authenticate.
Thank you!

threads.title: 9999 tok/s 高速输出时 GUI 明显卡顿——是渲染优化问题还是低配机器？
threads.bodyText:
简单说：用本地 OpenAI 兼容 mock 让模型以 9999 token/s 输出 1 秒，dsh 自己统计的速度没问题，但界面在这一秒明显卡。想问问大家高 token 速率下是否也这样，好判断是客户端渲染优化问题还是我这台老机器的锅。
环境
DSH 0.2.1-rc.2（桌面端）
Windows 10 19045 / i5-4590（4C4T，核显）/ 16GB
测试时没有跑其它重负载
复现
本地 mock（OpenAI 兼容）：固定 1 秒输出 9999 个 token，SSE 每 8 个 token 一条事件（约 1250 条事件/秒）。
在模型选择器里选这个 mock，发一句普通消息。
现象
dsh 自己记录的 decode 约 9.9k–10.1k tok/s，host 侧跟得上。
这一秒内 GUI 明显卡顿（打字延迟、点击/滚动不跟手），输出结束后恢复。
速度降到几百 tok/s 就不卡。
想请教
有没有人用更好的机器（高主频 / 独显 / 别的浏览器）试过同样的速率？是否一样卡？
这看起来像 #1316 里提到的「token 级 chunk + mux 全量广播/无背压」那一类吗？单会话高速输出也会触发吗？
感谢。

threads.title: [Bug] Win11下Electron客户端静默闪退及GPU进程被底层锁死 (error_code=18)
threads.bodyText:
底层抓包报错：使用 ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 启动，爆出 ERROR: GPU process launch failed: error_code=18 及 FATAL: GPU process isn't usable. Goodbye.。
文件锁死：报错指向 Failed to open persistent cache files... 另一个程序正在使用此文件 (0x20)，路径为 %APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\GPUPersistentCache。
已做修复尝试：重装覆盖系统、补齐 PowerShell 7、重装 VC++ 运行库、使用 takeown 与 icacls 强制夺权并成功删除了被锁死的 GPU 缓存文件夹。但重启后客户端依然静默闪退，事件查看器无任何记录。

“你好，我的 Windows 11 系统（版本 10.0.26300.9711）在运行完 DSH Bot 后遭遇了灾难性破坏。目前的结果是：任何基于 Electron 的客户端（包括最新的 DSH 桌面端和腾讯 WorkBuddy）双击均直接静默闪退。


我通过 ELECTRON_ENABLE_LOGGING=1 抓到了底层报错，核心是 GPU process launch failed: error_code=18 以及 GPU 缓存文件被系统死锁。虽然我通过覆盖安装重装了系统、补齐了 PowerShell 7、甚至用最高权限删除了死锁的 GPUPersistentCache 文件夹，依然无法启动。
怀疑是系统底层的安全沙箱机制或显卡内核驱动被之前的 Bot 操作修改了底层注册表/策略，导致 Windows 对特定 Chromium 内核进程进行无差别的底层拦截。请协助排查，谢谢。”
