threads.title: [Desktop/Windows] workspace-write on a drive root stamps a Low integrity label on the volume root and bricks every Chromium app on it
threads.bodyText:
Summary
A session whose cwd was a drive root (D:\) running under workspace-write caused the sandbox to write its three security edits onto the volume root itself:
Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(S,DC)
S-1-4-577378087-9516596:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)

Those entries inherited to every file on the volume, including installed applications. From the next launch onward, every Chromium/Electron app installed on D: dies at startup with 0x80000003 (STATUS_BREAKPOINT) — the Chromium sandbox CHECK fires ~41 ms in, before any child process is created.
The sandboxed command itself failed to start (0xC0000142), and the model retried three times, re-stamping the root each time. No rollback ever happened.
Environment

Windows 10 1909, build 10.0.18363.418, x64, zh-CN
@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 (Electron 44.7.0), per-user install on D:\工具\DeepSeekHarsh
UAC disabled (EnableLUA=0), interactive account is a member of Administrators
Volume D: = 291 GB NTFS, not the system volume (chkdsk D: /scan → clean, 0 bad sectors)

Timeline



Time
Event




2026-10-26 11:52:27
Session diagnostic-ab-B-20261026 created with "cwd":"D:\\", preset: workspace-write


2026-10-26 11:52:2x
glob over D:\ → rg: D:\System Volume Information: 拒绝访问 (os error 5)


2026-10-26 11:52:3x
pwsh ×3 → all return empty output, exit code 3221225794 = 0xC0000142


2026-10-26 11:54:30
Session ends. ACL edits are still on D:\. No rollback.


2026-10-27 14:00
User tries to launch apps installed on D: → silent instant exit



Evidence
1. The session record
{"type":"session","version":4,"id":"diagnostic-ab-B-20261026","cwd":"D:\\", ...}
{"type":"permission/preset","seq":0,"data":{"preset":"workspace-write"}}
{"type":"sandbox/mode","seq":1,"data":{"mode":"workspace-write"}}
Tool calls from the same session:
glob :: {"pattern":"**/ab-legacy-*.md","path":"D:\\"}
   → Error: glob search failed (exit 2): rg: D:\System Volume Information: IO error ... 拒绝访问。 (os error 5)

pwsh :: {"command":"Get-ChildItem -Path 'D:\\' -Directory -Force | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name"}
   → (no output) [exit code: 3221225794]

pwsh :: {"command":"cmd /c dir D:\\ /b /ad"}
   → (no output) [exit code: 3221225794]

pwsh :: {"command":"Write-Output ok","description":"Test whether pwsh starts"}
   → (no output) [exit code: 3221225794]

2. The ACL left behind on the volume root
D:\ Everyone:(CI)(DENY)(S,DC)
    S-1-4-577378087-9516596:(OI)(CI)(W,D,DC)
    BUILTIN\Administrators:(F)
    NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM:(F)
    NT AUTHORITY\Authenticated Users:(M)
    BUILTIN\Users:(RX)
    Mandatory Label\Low Mandatory Level:(OI)(CI)(NW)

Note: Get-Acl <path> | % Sddl on this machine does not show the S:(ML;…) entry — only icacls <path> does. This cost significant debugging time and is worth documenting.
3. What happens to an Electron app installed on that volume
DeepSeek Harness.exe → exit 0x80000003 after 41 ms, empty stderr, no window, no userData created

Under a debugger (DEBUG_ONLY_THIS_PROCESS):
[exception] 0x80000003 @ DeepSeek Harness.exe + 0x33A29CE   (first-chance; exe's own code)
threads created just before: LoaderLockSample, BrokerEvent  ← sandbox broker
no child process is ever created

RIP-relative string literals at the fault site:
lea -187 -> browser_v8_context_snapshot.bin
lea  -65 -> no-sandbox

i.e. Chromium's "sandbox info missing ⇒ require --no-sandbox" CHECK.
--no-sandbox bypasses the first CHECK but the process then dies at crashpad (crashpad_client_win.cc: not connected), exit 0xFFFF7003.
4. A/B control (this is the part that pins it down)



Variant
Result




D:\工具\DeepSeekHarsh (untouched)
❌ 0x80000003, 41 ms


Same tree copied to E:\dsh-test (no label)
✅ window appears, alive 12 s+


Same tree copied to D:\dsh-test (inherits label)
❌ 0x80000003, 46 ms


Same dir, deny ACE removed, label kept
❌ 0x80000003, 42 ms


Same dir, label set to Medium
✅ window appears, alive 12 s+



Only the integrity label correlates. Not the deny ACE, not AV, not a display driver (an emulator virtual-display A/B was negative), not disk corruption.
Affected on D:: DSH desktop, Qoder, WorkBuddy, Cherry Studio, Doubao — all Chromium/Electron.
Unaffected: .NET/WPF apps on D:; Chromium apps on C:/E:.
Root cause
windows-acl-run treats the workspace root as the object to harden. When the workspace root is a volume root, the three edits land on the volume root and inherit across the entire volume. Nothing validates that the target is not a drive root, and nothing rolls the edits back when the subsequent CreateProcess fails (0xC0000142).
Additionally, the failure is invisible to the model: the tool result is (no output) [exit code: 3221225794], which reads like "command produced nothing", so the agent retries — re-stamping the root each time.
Proposed fixes (in priority order)

Reject volume roots as workspace / cwd. In workspace.create, in session.create, and in the folder picker. If a root is genuinely needed, require an explicit opt-in flag plus a warning that it will modify the volume root ACL.
Journal → rollback. Before applying the three edits, persist (path, original label, original DACL). Roll back on: command failure to start, non-zero sandbox setup result, and session end. Never leave the stamp behind on a failure path.
Make the failure legible. Return the sandbox setup stage and the stamped path in the tool error, e.g. sandbox: hardened D:\ (volume root) but failed to spawn: 0xC0000142. Today the agent cannot distinguish "command ran and printed nothing" from "sandbox never started".
Block silent retry. After a sandbox-setup failure, the next tool call should require the model to acknowledge the failure rather than silently retrying with a different shell.
Fix the underlying 0xC0000142: spawning under the restricted token fails when the workspace root is a volume root. (It is plausible the Low label written onto the volume root is itself what prevents the restricted-token process from starting — in which case fix 2 would also fix this.)

Recovery (verified)
# roll the label back to the Windows default
icacls "D:\" /setintegritylevel (OI)(CI)Medium

# remove the deny ACE
icacls "D:\" /remove:d "Everyone"

# remove the capability SID (icacls /remove fails with 1332 for this SID)
# use .NET: $acl.RemoveAccessRuleSpecific(<rule>) ; Set-Acl "D:\" $acl
After step 1 alone, every affected app launches normally again.
Suggestion
Add a line to the Windows troubleshooting docs: if several Chromium/Electron apps stop starting at once, run icacls <volume root> and check for a Low Mandatory Level label. Get-Acl alone will not reveal it.

threads.title: [0.2.1-rc.3 follow-up] 970-char CJK heredoc hangs persistent bash for 300s; Agent Teams looks stuck after all children finish
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 (bundled DSH 0.1.208, macOS 26.6.2 arm64), a short bash call (970 characters) containing a Python heredoc with CJK UI string literals never executed and occupied the tool call for the full 300 s deadline. The final tool result was:

Your command timed out after 300 seconds or experienced an OOM error. The persistent bash shell was reset.

This appears to be the same failure class as #3522 (macOS persistent shell + CJK/readline) and #11085 (multiline PTY input), still present on the current Desktop build.
The user-visible symptom was especially misleading. While the parent sat on Running command, all four delegated children had already done real work and finished; the Agent Teams view showed them as idle/continuable and the task board showed 5 members / 0 tasks. It therefore looked as if the subagents were stuck, but their own sessions show execution and final output. The parent resumed immediately after the 300 s timeout result.
Timeline (Asia/Shanghai)

Around 16:47-16:58: four delegated children completed separate work (roughly 6m46s to 10m02s each).
17:37:14.997: parent step 121 issued the bash call. Command shape: git apply <temp patch> && python3 - <<'PY' ... PY; the embedded Python replaced strings including 通知 未读通知.
17:37:15.000: the external provider log recorded client aborted mid-stream. I am not claiming this is causal; it is included only because it is the nearest timestamped transport event.
17:37:15-17:42:21: no output from the requested command. The input file edit did not occur.
17:42:21.817: the tool returned the 300 s timeout/OOM message and reset the shell.
17:42:21.857: parent resumed normally at step 122.

A subsequent 511-character git apply && perl -0pi ... command containing CJK succeeded, so the shell recovered after reset.
Why this is not a subagent hang in this incident

The four children had completed before the parent's stuck tool call.
Their sessions contain actual tool calls and final messages.
The parent, not a child, was the only active work at the stuck point.
The parent advanced as soon as the bash tool returned its timeout result.

The remaining UX problem is that completed children are rendered as idle/continuable and no task outcome survives in the task board, so the human cannot distinguish "children finished; parent is blocked on bash" from "children never ran". Related visibility discussion: #6216.
Reproduction

Use the Desktop build with the persistent bash tool and an Agent Teams session.
Let several delegated children finish.
From the parent, issue a roughly 1 KB python3 - <<'PY' command that contains CJK string literals used for a file replacement.
Observe that the intended edit does not run and the tool call remains active until the 300 s timeout.
The timeout result resets the shell; a smaller subsequent CJK command may succeed.

The exact command and event excerpt can be sanitized and provided if useful. No session log, account data, credentials, or private host details are attached.
Expected behavior

A short CJK heredoc passed to bash should execute, or be rejected immediately with a clear input-size/locale error rather than waiting 300 s.
The timeout should not be diagnosed as possible OOM unless OOM was actually observed (also noted in #1186 / #3926).
After a transport abort, the tool call should surface an interrupted/retryable state promptly instead of remaining visually active until the hard deadline.
Agent Teams should retain whether a child completed, failed, or is genuinely waiting, rather than collapsing completed children to an indistinguishable idle state.

Related discussions

#3522 - persistent shell stalls for the full 300 s timeout on CJK input
#11085 - bash tool hangs on large multiline commands / PTY input path
#6216 - bare idle is indistinguishable from a stalled child

threads.title: Session events are validated on read, not on write (invalid payload persists an unreadable session)
threads.bodyText:
[Bug] Session events are validated on read, not on write — an invalid payload persists an unreadable session
Summary
A session event that violates the log's own invariants can be appended successfully. The failure
only surfaces later, when the session is opened:

a message whose content is not a parts array → every following turn throws
TypeError: content.some is not a function, and reloading the session reports it as corrupt
(message has invalid content);
a session header without cwd → the session is listed normally, but opening it returns
session/not-found.

The validators already exist (assertMessageEventShape, validateSessionHeader); they run when an
event is adopted/snapshotted, and again when the log is read — but not at the persistence boundary.
So the error is attributed to the reader ("corrupt", "not found") instead of the producer that
wrote it, and the session cannot be repaired from the UI.
Where it happens
Message shape — assertMessageEventShape (packages/core/session/src/index.ts:332) is invoked by
adoptSessionEvent (:167) and snapshotSessionEvent (:196). The agent inbox path does not reach
either: it validates only message-id uniqueness (packages/core/agent-loop/src/inbox.ts:223) and
then persists the batch verbatim (inbox.ts:235):
const event = this.session.append('agent/inbox/spliced', splice)
createUserMessage is generic over its input (packages/llm/llm/src/message.ts:246-253) and does not
normalize content, so a non-array value survives into the log.
Missing cwd — projectDir(root, undefined) deliberately maps to sessions/_no-cwd/
(packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/format.ts:255), so such a header can be written and
is returned by the session listing; history then rejects it outright
(packages/api/session-controller/src/history.ts:254-257). The bucket is writable, listable and
unreadable at the same time.
Reproduction
1. Wrong content shape — any in-process producer handing the agent a message whose content is
not an array:
const message = createUserMessage({ content: 'plain string', source: { kind: 'my-plugin' } })
agent.followup(message)
Observed in a real log (0.2.0-rc.2, format v4): the turn ends with
{"kind":"error","error":{"message":"content.some is not a function"}}, and after a restart the
session reports:
Failed to load history: stored session "…" is corrupt:
  session event at seq N message has invalid content (gateway/internal)

The record:
{"type":"user/message","seq":N,
 "data":{"content":"…","source":{"kind":"my-plugin"},"role":"user","id":"…"}}
2. Header without cwd:
$ ls ~/.dsh/sessions/_no-cwd/
<session-id>  <session-id>  <session-id>  <session-id>

$ open one of them
Failed to load history: session "<id>" not found (session/not-found)

All four appear in the session list; none can be opened. (These were produced by a local import path
that materialised conversations from another product, where "project directory" has no meaning — but
the inconsistency is on the DSH side: the write is accepted, the read is refused.)
Suggested hardening

Validate at the persistence boundary. Run the existing assertMessageEventShape before an
event is appended, so a malformed producer fails immediately and the error names the producer.
Valid producers are unaffected; invalid data simply cannot be committed.
Make _no-cwd self-consistent. Either reject headers without cwd at write time, or let
history load them — reading a log does not require a project directory.

Why we think it matters for the plugin ecosystem
DSH's premise is "everything is a plugin", and plugins are plain JavaScript loaded at runtime, so
TypeScript types are erased exactly at that boundary. Today a single wrong field in a plugin turns
into a conversation the user can never open again, discovered hours later with no pointer to the
cause. One write-side check converts that class of failure into an immediate, attributable error.
Environment

dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, Node v26.x, Arch Linux, session format v4, profile web
Session logs: multi-frame session.v4.jsonl.zstd under ~/.dsh/sessions/<project>/<id>/

threads.title: inspector: uncaught throw in setState kills the host when the cordis/tree source state reaches the frame budget
threads.bodyText:
What happened
On 2026-10-26 14:10 UTC the DSH desktop host process exited. The last line of crash-*-host.log was:
dsh: fatal uncaught exception: Error: inspector: source state exceeds the source-frame byte limit
    at InspectorSourceBuffer.setState (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector/lib/index.js:996:10)
    at HostBridgePublisher.setState (lib/index.js:1109:16)
    at HostInspectorSource.setState (lib/index.js:836:18)
    at lib/index.js:2322:13
    at publish (lib/index.js:2294:3)
    at ChildProcess.<anonymous> (lib/main.js:3844:64)

Environment: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, Windows 11, desktop profile with ~25 bundles including community plugins. Agent context usage at the time was about 47%, so this is unrelated to the model context window.
Mechanism

InspectorSourceBuffer.stateFits() requires jsonByteLength(all retained topic snapshots) + SOURCE_FRAME_OVERHEAD_BYTES (4096) <= maxSourceFrameBytes (default 128 KiB).
The Host source retains exactly one topic: cordis/tree. publishCordisTree passes { maxNodes: spec.maxCordisNodes, maxBytes: spec.maxSourceFrameBytes - 4096 } to CordisTreeCollector (index.js:2402-2405).
The collector prunes until jsonByteLength(snapshot) <= maxBytes, i.e. it is allowed to stop exactly at the whole available budget. The record envelope that setState() then adds (topic, sequence, monotonicMs) has no headroom reserved.
Consequently, once the Cordis tree grows enough to require pruning, the pruned snapshot plus its envelope exceeds maxSourceFrameBytes, stateFits() fails, and setState() throws instead of degrading. The uncaught exception inside the publish microtask terminates the Host process.

Two defects (as I read the code)

Budget collision: the tree's prune target equals the entire frame budget (maxSourceFrameBytes - 4096), while the state check also has to fit the record envelope. Please reserve the envelope in the prune target, or measure the budget after wrapping.
Error-handling asymmetry: enqueue() silently drops one oversized record (return, index.js:1070), but setState() throws when the sum exceeds the limit (index.js:993-996). The over-budget path should degrade non-fatally (drop or roll back the topic, log a warning), consistent with enqueue().

Workaround in use
The Config schema already accepts maxSourceFrameBytes, so a profile patch raises the budget. Note that a user patch replaces the whole config of the matched entry, so captureFetch must be restated:
- id: experimental-inspector
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector'
  config:
    captureFetch: true
    maxSourceFrameBytes: 1048576
The Client bootstrap (bootstrap.maxFrameBytes) follows the Host value, so raising it on the Host is enough. This avoids the crash but does not fix the underlying budget collision.
Expected
A Host inspection plugin exceeding a self-imposed frame budget should log and degrade; it should never be able to take down the Host process.

threads.title: [Bug] 0.2.1-rc.3 桌面端：零第三方插件下 host/renderer 循环崩溃（crypto_context.cc:884 / absl raw_hash_map::at / renderer 静默退出）
threads.bodyText:
## TL;DR

DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.3`（nightly，Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0，Windows 11 25H2 build 26200.9711）在**不加载任何第三方插件**时仍循环崩溃，三类失败交替出现：

1. `node::crypto::InitializeBundledRootCertificates()` @ `crypto_context.cc:884` → `Assertion failed: (x509) != nullptr`（宿主启动期、插件操作子进程各复现）
2. `absl::container_internal::raw_hash_map<>::at` → `NOTREACHED hit`（壳进程，有完整 dump）
3. renderer 反复 `Desktop renderer exited: crashed`，**无 console、无 WER、无 dump**

安装包与安装结果均已逐字节校验，排除文件损坏。

## 环境

- DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.3`（channel: nightly，2026-10-27 00:39 更新落地，覆盖 rc.2）
- Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0 / win32 x64
- Windows 11 25H2 (build 26200.9711)，Intel Core i9-14900，BIOS microcode 0x12B
- 触发时 `dsh.profile.bundles` 仅含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`（第三方插件全部停用）

## 复现

1. 冷启动应用，约 1/3 概率在启动后 1 分钟内出现上述断言或 renderer 崩溃；
2. 在插件管理里安装/卸载任意插件（会拉起 `DeepSeek Harness.exe` 的 node 模式子进程），子进程有较大概率以同一 crypto 断言 abort，UI 显示「卸载失败」，重试通常成功；
3. renderer 崩溃后应用自动重启，随后再次崩溃，形成循环。

## 证据（详见附件）

### 1) 宿主启动期 crypto 断言

Error: dsh desktop host exited with 134:
DeepSeek Harness.exe[23928]: std::vector<X509 *> __cdecl
node::crypto::InitializeBundledRootCertificates(void)
at ....\third_party\electron_node\src\crypto\crypto_context.cc:884
Assertion failed: (x509) != nullptr

发生在 Node 环境初始化（`phase: startup`），插件代码尚未加载。

### 2) 插件操作子进程，同一函数同一行


DeepSeek Harness.exe[13280]: ... crypto_context.cc:884
Assertion failed: (x509) != nullptr
---- Native stack trace ----
1: node::SetAbortHandler+54
2: v8::SharedArrayBuffer::ByteLength+2976
3: uv_exepath+218701
4: uv_exepath+216047
5: node::loader::ModuleWrap::SetInitializeImportMetaObjectCallback+24783
6: llhttp_execute+133739
7: uv_cond_signal+286655
8: BaseThreadInitThunk+23
9: RtlUserThreadStart+44

### 3) 壳进程 absl NOTREACHED（有完整 dump）

`dumps/DeepSeek Harness.exe.24360.dmp` 解析：PID 24360，启动即崩（创建时间 = 崩溃时间 20:43:57），22 线程含 4 × `V8Worker`，崩溃线程 `V8Worker`（tid 24184），异常 `0x80000003` @ `exe+0x7356e49`，栈上保留：


[24360:1027/204357.553:FATAL:throw_delegate.cc:107] NOTREACHED hit.
absl::container_internal::raw_hash_map<>::at

模块表 39 项：仅 exe + 38 个 `C:\Windows\System32\*.dll`，无第三方 DLL。

### 4) 宿主无断言退出，退出码 `4294930435`


Error: dsh desktop host exited with 4294930435:
[llm-deepseek-api-key] model listing ... loaded 2 model(s) ...
[1027/215622.075:ERROR:crashpad_client_win.cc:867] not connected

`4294930435 = 0xFFFF7003 = -36861`，非标准 NTSTATUS。同一码也出现在 `subprocess-local: Windows Job runner exited with exit code 4294930435 before proving its managed range empty`。怀疑与 `dsh-subprocess-local` 的 Job Object（`JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`）生命周期/退出码有关。

### 5) renderer 静默退出

多次 `Desktop renderer exited: crashed`，`renderer console` 为空，事件日志无 Application Error，已开启 `LocalDumps DumpType=2` 仍无 dump。更像被结束（Job/`TerminateProcess`）而非页错误。

## 已排除

- **第三方插件（全部）**：卸载 dshmarket 后仍崩；`bundles` 仅 base + web-app 时仍连续崩溃（22:03:33 / 22:03:54）。
- **安装包/安装结果损坏**：安装包 SHA-512 与 `update-info.json` 一致；外层 NSIS 与内层 `app-64.7z` 完整性测试通过（7,811 文件 / 1.09 GB）；`app.asar` 16,603 块 / 177.7 MB 全部匹配；安装目录与官方 payload 逐文件 SHA-256 比对 7,811/7,811 一致。
- **内存**：系统内压测 8 GiB × 3 轮、24 次回读校验，0 不一致。
- **联想电脑管家 minifilter**（本机历史蓝屏原因）：已彻底移除，之后无新蓝屏。

## 附件

`dsh-crash-report-20261027-redacted.zip`（已脱敏：用户名/主机名/机型替换为占位符；dump 用等长占位符替换，结构与偏移不变，可正常加载）

内容：12 次崩溃日志、壳进程 dump、插件操作子进程断言日志、更新器记录（含两次解压 CRC 失败）、profile 快照、系统事件与应用崩溃记录、完整分析报告 `README.md`。
[dsh-crash-report-20261027-redacted.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34023660/dsh-crash-report-20261027-redacted.zip)

threads.title: [Bug] Windows workspace-write: 0xC0000142 comes from the token default DACL naming a non-restricting capability SID (corrected; follow-up to #8991 / #8067)
threads.bodyText:
Relation to existing reports
This continues #8991 ("every confined pwsh command exits with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)") and #8067 (the 0xC0000142 bubble). Both describe the symptom. #8991 explicitly labels its root cause as "hypothesis, not verified against source" and asks whether the runner needs SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege, a specific UAC configuration, AppContainer support, or particular workspace ACLs.
This post answers that question: it is none of those. The trigger can be isolated with a controlled experiment.
#8067 quotes sandbox-windows-acl/README.zh.md describing 0xC0000142 at DLL-init as a known limitation of CREATE_NO_WINDOW / CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE. The data below shows a second, distinct trigger that also fires on the ordinary stdio: "inherit" path, so the README's framing does not cover every affected host.
Summary
On Windows, every pwsh/shell tool call under the default workspace-write sandbox mode fails before the command ever runs. The restricted-token ACL runner starts fine in read-only mode, but as soon as the mode becomes workspace-write the child process exits with 3221225794 (0xC0000142, STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) and produces no stdout and no stderr at all.
Two distinct problems:

The sandbox cannot start a child process under workspace-write on this host. Root cause: the token's default DACL names the derived capability SID (setTokenDefaultDaclGrant, index.ts:304), and under a WRITE_RESTRICTED token the image section carrying that DACL fails the access check, so the loader dies before any user code runs. The earlier "capability SID has no read ACE on System32" claim is withdrawn — see Root cause (corrected) below.
The failure is mis-classified. dsh-pwsh-sandbox's classifyRunnerFailure / isRunnerSpawnFailure only recognises spawn ENOENT/EACCES of argv[0]. A child that exits with 0xC0000142 is not treated as a sandbox failure, so the user sees a generic command failure instead of SandboxUnavailableError. This is what made the bug hard to diagnose, and it is arguably the more important half to fix.

Environment



item
value




DSH app
desktop 0.2.1-rc.3, commit be72761ee1a6736ebcdf4f3739363b083ae53c98


Electron / node
Electron 39, embedded node v24.21.0


OS
Windows 10/11 x64


User
COMPUTER\Administrator (S-1-5-21-…-500), high integrity, elevated via UAC


App manifest
requestedExecutionLevel level="asInvoker"


Workspace
D:\DSH-Workspace


Temp root
C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Temp, and separately D:\DSH-ww-probe (outside the workspace)



Steps to reproduce
Run the sandbox runner directly, bypassing DSH tooling:
$exe = "D:\DSH\DeepSeek Harness.exe"
$runner = "D:\DSH\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js"

# read-only: works
& $exe $runner --workspace "D:\DSH-Workspace" --temp "D:\DSH-temp" --mode read-only -- cmd /c "echo RO-OK"
# -> exit 0, stdout "RO-OK"

# workspace-write: child dies before running
& $exe $runner --workspace "D:\DSH-Workspace" --temp "D:\DSH-temp" --mode workspace-write -- cmd /c "echo WW-OK"
# -> exit 3221225794 (0xC0000142), stdout "", stderr ""
Same result through the DSH pwsh tool under the default permission preset.
What is not the cause (all verified empirically)

Not elevation. An unelevated run (scheduled task, RunLevel=LeastPrivilege, ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1) reproduces 0xC0000142 identically while read-only still succeeds.
Not the privileges named in #8991. See the dedicated section below.
Not the temp directory. Moving the temp root outside %TEMP% (to D:\DSH-ww-probe) changes nothing.
Not a missing/incorrect DACL grant. Passing a fabricated capability SID S-1-4-424242-424242 that has no ACE anywhere, with manageDacls: false, still fails.
Not the runner itself. AclSandbox.init() and win32() binding load succeed in-process (3 ms / 7 ms); the runner reaches spawn() and gets a pid. The crash is in the child.
Not the executable. cmd.exe, where.exe, hostname.exe, whoami.exe all fail identically.
Not permission on the exe's own directory. Copying where.exe into a directory the capability SID can read does not help.
Not a corrupted app.asar. read-only runs from the same asar path successfully; a SHA-256 sweep over the archive is clean.

Explicitly ruled out: the privileges named in #8991
#8991 asked whether the runner needs SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege. On this host:

SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege is absent from the token entirely; LSA policy (secedit /export /cfg) grants it only to *S-1-5-19,*S-1-5-20 (LOCAL SERVICE, NETWORK SERVICE). AdjustTokenPrivileges returns ERROR_NOT_ALL_ASSIGNED (1300).
Despite that, CreateRestrictedToken succeeds, AclSandbox.init() succeeds, and spawn() returns a pid — the privilege is not on the failing path for this backend.
The app runs elevated (TokenElevation=1, high integrity) via UAC, yet an unelevated run reproduces 0xC0000142 identically while read-only still succeeds.

The variable is the content of the restricting-SID list, as shown next.
Root cause (corrected 2026-10-31)

Correction. The original version of this section claimed the trigger was the capability SID lacking a read ACE on C:\Windows\System32. That claim is withdrawn — see my reply below for the single-variable experiment. Read-only and workspace-write differ in two places at once (the restricting list and the token's default DACL), so the original two-mode comparison could not attribute the failure to either one. The corrected root cause is:

dsh-sandbox-windows-acl builds the child token with
CreateRestrictedToken(..., flags = 0xD, ...)   // 0xD = DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE(0x1) | LUA_TOKEN(0x4) | WRITE_RESTRICTED(0x8)

and then grants the derived capability SID in the token's default DACL (index.ts:304):
setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid);
When the process creates kernel objects without an explicit security descriptor — pipes, events, image sections — those objects inherit that default DACL. Under a WRITE_RESTRICTED token the access check consults the restricting SIDs, and an object whose DACL names only a SID that cannot satisfy the check makes the loader fail to map the system DLL, surfacing as STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED before any user code runs.
The invariant that predicts the outcome is "the SID named in the default DACL must also be a restricting SID". Everyone is in the restricting list ([logonSid, known.world, ...writeSids]); a capability SID, Authenticated Users, and BUILTIN\Users are not.
Controlled experiment (only the default DACL changes)
Token built exactly as shipped; only TokenDefaultDacl overwritten via SetEntriesInAclW + SetTokenInformation(TokenDefaultDacl = 6). Workspace write SID and temp write SID are the shipped capability SIDs in every row. Workspace has inheritance disabled, AU:(M) removed, granting only BA:(F), SY:(F) and the capability SID (W,D,DC).



#
restricting list
default DACL names
child exit




A1
logon, world, cap
cap (as shipped)
0xC0000142


A2
logon, world, cap
S-1-1-0 Everyone
0


A3
logon, world, cap
S-1-5-11 Auth. Users
0xC0000142


A4
logon, world, cap
S-1-5-32-545 Users
0xC0000142


B1
logon, world, world
cap
0xC0000142



A1 vs A2 is the isolating pair: identical restricting list, only the default DACL SID differs, and the outcome flips. The earlier "System32 read ACE" table below is retained only as a record of what was actually run; its interpretation was wrong.

Original (withdrawn) table, kept for the record



restricting SID
System32 ACE rights
child result




S-1-5-32-545 BUILTIN\Users
0x1200a9 (read+execute)
exit 0


S-1-1-0 Everyone
no explicit ACE (inherits read)
exit 0


S-1-5-11 Authenticated Users
no explicit ACE (inherits read)
exit 0


S-1-5-21-…-500 current user
no explicit ACE (inherits read)
exit 0


S-1-5-18 LOCAL SYSTEM
0x1301bf (full control)
0xC0000142


S-1-5-32-544 BUILTIN\Administrators
0x1301bf (full control)
0xC0000142


S-1-5-80-… service SID (TrustedInstaller)
0x1f01ff (full control)
0xC0000142


S-1-4-136077656-194402612 capability SID
absent
0xC0000142



This table varied the write SID, which changes the restricting list and the default DACL together — it could not attribute the failure.

Relevant code:

dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js — windowsAclRunnerArgv() adds --write-sid / --temp-write-sid when policy.sessionId !== undefined && mode !== "read-only"; materializeAclGrant() creates the standing recursive workspace ACE.
dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js — const api = await win32(), then new AclSandbox({... manageDacls: !seamManaged }) → init() → spawn({ stdio: "inherit" }).
dsh-win32-process/lib/index.js:425-427 — createRestrictedProcess() calls CreateProcessAsUserW with lpEnvironment = NULL (documented workaround for a koffi ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER); every failure there throws and emits the windows-acl-run: signature, so a silent 0xC0000142 cannot originate in that code.

Impact
On affected hosts the default workspace-write preset makes the shell tool unusable, which is the primary tool for most workflows. The only working configurations I found are read-only (no writes) and danger-full-access (no sandbox).
Suggested fixes for the sandbox half (in order of preference)

Corrected. Fix 4 of the original list ("there is no acceptable local fix") was based on the withdrawn System32 theory and is removed.


Add the logon SID to the default DACL alongside the capability SID (rather than replacing it with a well-known SID). findLogonSid already exists in token.ts and is imported at index.ts:55. The logon SID is already in the restricting list, so the pass-2 check that motivated the grant still passes, and the "never tag default-DACL objects with the shared workspace capability" intent still holds. This is the change that matches the A1–A4 data; replacing the SID with Authenticated Users (as proposed in #11448) is expected to keep failing on this host, because AU is not a restricting SID here. Not yet verified by me — it is the next experiment.
Probe workspace-write, not just read-only. dsh-sandbox-local selects windows-acl from PLATFORM_CHAINS = { win32: ["windows-acl"] } without probing (chainVerdict() returns the first candidate when the rest list is empty), even though L137 documents a "functional windows-acl probe" that runs the runner in read-only mode only. Extend that probe to workspace-write and surface SandboxUnavailableError when it fails.
Widen the documented limitation. README.zh.md line 119 and the keep-alive-group note at line 94 describe 0xC0000142 as a CREATE_NO_WINDOW issue; per the data above the default-DACL composition is an independent trigger.

Additional note
app.asar in the desktop distribution is a valid asar plus a DSH trailer JSON appended after the data section (data base = 8 + headerSize + 4 = 4748104 for this build). Not a bug, just worth documenting — it cost me a false "corrupted archive" hypothesis early on.

threads.title: Windows 桌面版：「工作区内修改」(workspace-write) 沙箱下所有命令以 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) 退出
threads.bodyText:
Windows 桌面版：「工作区内修改」(workspace-write) 沙箱下所有命令以 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) 退出
环境

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3（Windows x64，中文 UI）
安装路径：D:\Program Files\DeepSeek Harness（非默认盘符）
Windows x64，powershell.exe 版本 5.1.26100.9444（build 26100）
运行用户：BIELNB1094\Administrator（SID S-1-5-21-2189205611-531090084-720113286-500），完整性级别 High
未安装 PowerShell 7：C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe 不存在，PATH 中也没有可用的 pwsh.exe，shell 解析落回系统 WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe
随包 Node 运行时：resources\runtime\primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe（v24.21.0）

现象
会话权限设为「工作区内修改」时，任何 shell 调用都在启动阶段以退出码 3221225794（0xC0000142，STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED）结束，且没有任何输出。多次重试、换命令、换工作目录均一致，模型侧表现为 "pwsh is broken entirely"。
同一会话改为「完全权限」或「自动审查」后一切正常；「仅可查看」实测也正常。
复现步骤

打开桌面版，新建会话，把会话权限切换为「工作区内修改」。
让 agent 执行任意一条命令，例如 Get-ChildItem "$HOME\.dsh"。
观察工具结果：退出码 3221225794，无 stdout/stderr。

预期：命令被沙箱约束执行，正常返回输出。
实际：子进程从未完成 DLL 初始化，直接以 0xC0000142 终止。
根因分析
1. 沙箱 runner 由 process.execPath 启动
packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/index.ts 的 windowsAclRunnerInvocation() 返回 [process.execPath, builtEntry]。桌面版中 process.execPath 是 Electron 可执行文件本身。
进程列表可以确认当前 DSH 服务与子进程层都跑在 Electron 二进制上：
DeepSeek Harness.exe --expose-internals "...\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\index.js" ...
DeepSeek Harness.exe "...\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-subprocess-local\lib\runner.js" -- C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe ...

因此 ACL 沙箱的 runner 同样是 [DeepSeek Harness.exe, <asar>\...\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js, ...]。
2. 从 app.asar 解出真实 runner 做宿主对照
从安装目录的 app.asar 中提取真实的 dsh-sandbox-windows-acl runner（同一份 0.2.1-rc.3 产物，补齐 koffi 原生模块），用不同宿主进程启动同一条 argv，目标为 powershell.exe，参数与 DSH 实际调用一致（--workspace、--temp 为会话的私有 temp 目录、--mode、--write-sid、--temp-write-sid，并保留 DSH_SUBPROCESS_CONTROL=pipe 的第 7 号控制管道）：



宿主进程
模式
结果




node.exe（随包 Node v24.21.0）
workspace-write
0，输出正常


node.exe
read-only
0，输出正常


DeepSeek Harness.exe（ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1）
read-only
0，输出正常


DeepSeek Harness.exe
workspace-write
0xC0000142



结论：runner 逻辑与 token 构造本身没问题，故障只在「Electron 作为 runner 宿主」且「模式为 workspace-write」时出现；把宿主换成随包 node.exe 后两种模式都正常。
3. 失败点在 runner 派生的受限子进程，而非 runner 自身
在 runner 入口插入一行 console.error('RUNNER-START ' + process.execPath) 后重跑：两种宿主都打印了该行，说明 runner 已正常启动并执行到 CreateProcessAsUserW；0xC0000142 来自被沙箱包裹的子进程。
4. 已排除的变量
逐项做了对照，均与本问题无关：

ACL 授权、Everyone 的 DeleteSubdirectoriesAndFiles 拒绝项、Low 完整性标签（工作区上这些常驻项符合设计，不是损坏）
私有 temp 目录 + 两个能力 SID（--write-sid / --temp-write-sid）
TEMP/TMP 改写到私有 temp（在 runner 中临时关闭改写，问题依旧）
第 7 号控制管道（DSH_SUBPROCESS_CONTROL=pipe）
Job 对象、控制台可用性（无控制台父进程下用 node.exe runner 依然成功）
环境变量（node.exe 与 Electron 进程的 process.env 逐项比对完全一致）
目标程序（cmd.exe 同样失败；GUI 目标在只读模式下成功）
手动重建 CreateRestrictedToken + Low 完整性 + default DACL 授权 + kill-on-close Job + TEMP 改写的独立探针，全部成功

5. 尚未定位
Electron 作为父进程时，受限子进程为何在 loader 初始化阶段失败，本轮没有定位到具体机制（控制台、Job、process mitigation、环境块均已排除）。现象本身是确定性、可稳定复现的。
影响

只要会话权限为「工作区内修改」，桌面版在 Windows 上完全无法执行任何命令，该模式不可用。
「完全权限」「自动审查」「仅可查看」不受影响（自动审查按设计不使用沙箱）。

建议修复

在 Electron 宿主下不要让沙箱 runner 走 process.execPath：windowsAclRunnerInvocation() 检测 process.versions.electron，改用随包的 Node 运行时（resources/runtime/primary-runtime/dependencies/node/bin/node.exe）。同一台机器上该改动已验证可使 workspace-write 恢复正常。
dsh-subprocess-local 的 runner 也通过 process.execPath 启动（见上方进程列表）；虽然它派生的子进程不受限、目前未出错，建议一并统一到同一 Node 运行时，避免同类问题。
若短期无法发布修复，可考虑在 Windows 桌面版对「工作区内修改」给出明确提示或兜底，而不是让每条命令都以 0xC0000142 结束。

补充说明
复现过程中未修改安装目录、未手工改动任何 ACL；实验用的解包 runner 与探针脚本已清理。工作区上残留的 S-1-4-… 授权项、Everyone deny 与 Low 标签是沙箱的常驻授权缓存，属预期行为，不属于本问题。

threads.title: [Bug] Desktop host dies with CordisError INACTIVE_EFFECT during plugin hot-reload (Fiber._reload)
threads.bodyText:
Describe the bug
The desktop host can die during a plugin hot-reload with CordisError: cannot create effect on inactive context (code INACTIVE_EFFECT). The error is raised inside Fiber._reload while dsh-desktop-host re-applies the bundle; the host process then exits and the desktop app quits.
Stack trace (from crash-<ts>-main.log)
DesktopHostFatalError: cannot create effect on inactive context
    at ChildProcess.<anonymous> (file:///.../resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:3711:49)
    at ChildProcess.emit (node:events:509:28)
    at emit (node:internal/child_process:972:14)
    at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:91:21)

--- host diagnostic (as reported by the Host process) ---
CordisError: cannot create effect on inactive context
    at Fiber.assertActive (file:///.../app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:1133:9)
    at Proxy.plugin (file:///.../@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:1622:18)
    at Object.apply [as callback] (file:///.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host/lib/index.js:80:12)
    at async Fiber._reload (file:///.../@deepseek-ai/cordis/lib/index.js:1356:5) {
  code: 'INACTIVE_EFFECT'
}

The companion crash-<ts>-web-boot.log adds:
Error: Error invoking remote method 'dsh-desktop:boot': Error: cannot create effect on inactive context
    at file:///.../resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:11573:15
    at Session.<anonymous> (node:electron/js2c/browser_init:2:122853)

Environment

@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.2
Electron 44.0.0 / Node 24.18.1
Windows 11 x64

To reproduce
Not deterministic. Observed once, during a window in which the loader was reloading plugin entries (a plugin config patch had just been written). It looks like a race between Fiber._reload and context disposal: the reloaded entry's apply callback (dsh-desktop-host/lib/index.js:80) calls ctx.plugin(...) after its fiber context has already been deactivated.
Additional context

Both crash logs are written to the desktop logs directory (%APPDATA%/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop/logs).
After this fatal, the renderer also reports N entries did not activate.
Happy to provide the full crash logs if useful.

threads.title: 【BUG】read_image 图片块在 openai-responses 协议下未做能力适配，触发 400 且会话永久卡死
threads.bodyText:
1. 摘要（DSH 侧问题）
DSH 中配置为 pi-ai openai-responses 协议的 provider（本例为 agnes / agnes-3.0-flash），在 read_image 工具结果含本地图片块 {"type":"image","attachment":{...}} 后，该图片块被原样拼入下一次请求的 input，网关拒绝整条请求（400 json_parse_error，input 反序列化失败）。该图片块停留在会话历史里，导致该会话之后所有请求（含纯文本）全部 400，会话永久卡死、无恢复路径，用户只能新建会话。
DSH 的 dsh-llm 已具备图片降级原语（textOnlyImageText、projectImagesForTextModel、requiredImageOffload 等），但 pi-ai 的 openai-responses 路径并未在组装请求时按 provider/协议的图片输入能力对图片块做降级或剔除，也未对这类 400 提供会话自愈。
2. 环境

Windows，DSH Web GUI（dsh-primary-runtime 0.2.1-rc.2）
provider：agnes（https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1），模型 agnes-3.0-flash，协议 pi-ai openai-responses
出事故会话：session-3188ae7b-ea39-460a-a6c5-098310da31f6
该模型本身支持图片输入（视觉模型），但其 Responses 端点对图片块的接受情况与文档描述不符（见 §4.1），属于 provider 侧环境事实，不作为本 bug 的归因主体

3. 复现步骤（DSH 内操作）

在协议为 openai-responses 的 provider 会话中，让 agent 调用 read_image 读任意本地图片
工具结果返回后（content 含 {"type":"image"} 块）
下一条 LLM 请求 → 400
之后任意用户消息（纯文本）→ 全部 400，会话卡死

4. 证据
出事前该会话已正常执行 30+ 次 LLM 请求（56K token 历史、含 reasoning/thinking 回放），全部成功；第一次 400 恰好出现在 read_image 图片块首次进入历史那一步，唯一新变量即该图片块。
涉事工具结果内容：
[
  {"type": "text", "text": "<path>…010.webp</path>\n<type>image</type>\nimage/webp image, 512x512 px, 33116 bytes"},
  {"type": "image", "attachment": {"attachmentId": "sha256:3ffcabdc…", "mediaType": "image/webp", "bytes": 33116, "width": 512, "height": 512, "name": "010.webp"}}
]
DSH 报出的三次 400 原文（网关侧 input 反序列化失败）：
agnes API error (400): {"message":"***.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - {\"error\":{\"message\":\"Invalid JSON data: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type: input: data did not match any variant of untagged enum ResponseInput at line 1 column 422733\",\"type\":\"invalid_request_error\",\"code\":\"json_parse_error\"}}"}


三次失败列号 422557 → 422664 → 422733，随会话尾部追加内容单调右移，失败点位于请求体尾部（图片块所在区域）
line 1 表明请求体为单行 JSON，body ≥ 422KB

4.1 网关侧实测（环境佐证，2026-10-28，curl + 有效 key）



请求
结果




POST /v1/chat/completions 纯文本
200


POST /v1/chat/completions + 公开图片 URL
200，image_tokens: 176


POST /v1/chat/completions + base64 data URL
200，image_tokens: 176


POST /v1/responses 纯文本（连试 3 次）
全部 500 bad_response_body


POST /v1/responses + 图片块（3 种形态）
400，图片 part 被标 type:'unknown'


GET /v1/models
200



即该 provider 的 Responses 端点当前对图片块不可用，Chat Completions 端点完整可用。此事实仅用于说明「该协议路径下图片块没有合法形态」，不是本 bug 的归因主体；DSH 侧的问题在于：即便目标 provider 的某协议不支持图片块，也应在请求组装时降级/剔除图片块（或按 provider 声明的可用协议发送），而不是让图片块卡死整个会话。
5. 期望行为（DSH 侧）

组装请求时按 provider + 协议的图片输入能力处理图片块：不支持时降级为文本占位（[image: 010.webp 512x512 33116B]，复用 dsh-llm 已有原语），支持时以该协议接受的形态发送
捕获此类 400（请求体校验失败）后提供会话自愈：清理历史中的图片块后自动重试，或明确提示「本会话无法恢复，请新建会话」

6. 用户侧规避（配置层面，非 DSH 缺陷）
本例的 agnes provider 属个人配置问题：桌面端把 api 声明为 openai-responses（该端点对图片块不可用），而 Chat Completions 端点完整可用。规避方式（无需等 DSH 修复）：

将该 provider 的 api 改为 openai-completions（chat 端点文本与图片均可用，本地 base64 图片 200）
或将该模型的能力声明降为纯文本（input: [text]），避免 DSH 走图片输入路径

threads.title: [Windows] workspace-write sandbox cannot spawn any child process (exit 0xC0000142); read-only works
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On Windows the local sandbox provider's windows-acl rung cannot start any confined child process in
workspace-write mode. The child dies during process initialisation with 0xC0000142
(STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED), writes nothing to stdout/stderr, and the runner emits no windows-acl-run:
diagnostic. The identical child starts normally in read-only mode.
The failure is therefore independent of the spawned program, the workspace path, and the FS ACL grants.
Environment

DSH desktop app, runtime @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime 0.2.1-rc.3
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl 0.2.1-rc.3, @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local 0.2.1-rc.3,
@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox 0.2.1-rc.3
Windows 10 (build 19041 family), x64
Windows PowerShell 5.1.19041.6456 and PowerShell 7.6.9 both installed
(C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe, i.e. the resolver's first candidate)
Session file policy workspace-write, approval policy ask
Account is a member of BUILTIN\Administrators; the app was launched elevated

Reproduction
Invoke the runner directly so the tool layer and ctx.sandbox are out of the picture. ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1
lets the app's Electron binary load runner.js from inside app.asar.
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = '1'
$exe    = 'D:\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\DeepSeek Harness.exe'
$runner = 'D:\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-sandbox-windows-acl\lib\runner.js'
$ws     = 'C:\some\workspace'
The app binary is GUI-subsystem: use Start-Process -Wait (or a pipe) to read the exit code.
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $exe -Wait -PassThru -ArgumentList @(
('"{0}"' -f $runner), '--workspace', ('"{0}"' -f $ws), '--temp', ('"{0}"' -f $env:TEMP),
'--mode', 'read-only', '--', '"C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe"', '/c', '"echo ok"'
) -RedirectStandardOutput out.txt -RedirectStandardError err.txt
$p.ExitCode
Repeat with --mode workspace-write.
Results
Same machine, same runner, same child command; only --mode differs.



--mode
cmd.exe /c echo ok
powershell.exe 5.1
pwsh.exe 7.6.9




read-only
exit 0, prints ok
exit 0
exit 0


workspace-write
exit -1073741502 (0xC0000142), no output
exit 0xC0000142
exit 0xC0000142



workspace-write also fails identically for three different --workspace values (C:\dsh-ws-test,
%TEMP%\dsh-ws-test, and the real project workspace), while read-only keeps succeeding on the same set.
What this rules out

PowerShell / .NET: cmd.exe fails identically, so this is not CLR or PowerShell initialisation.
Installing PowerShell 7.6.9 (the resolver's preferred executable) changed nothing.
Workspace path or its ACL: three unrelated paths fail the same way, and read-only succeeds on them.
The runner itself: a runner-side failure prints windows-acl-run: <detail> and exits 127
(RUNNER_FAILURE_RULES["windows-acl"]). Neither appears; the exit code is the child's own. Token
construction, grant materialisation and CreateProcessAsUserW all succeeded — the child was created and
then died at init.
Seam-managed vs standalone grants: the harness path (--write-sid + --temp-write-sid,
manageDacls:false) and the standalone owned-temp path (manageDacls:true) fail identically.

Where the two modes diverge
In @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js (main()), the only differences between the modes are
in the token and the environment:

read-only: restricting SID list = logon SID + Everyone; setTokenDefaultDaclGrant() adds a full-access ACE
for Everyone to the token default DACL; TMP/TEMP left ambient.
workspace-write: the two capability SIDs (workspaceWriteSid(), tempWriteSid()) are added to the
restricting list and to the token default DACL; the token is lowered to Low integrity
(restrictTokenIntegrity); TMP/TEMP are rewritten to the private temp directory.

Both then call the same AclSandbox.spawn().
0xC0000142 for even cmd.exe is consistent with the child failing while the kernel/CSRSS creates its initial
objects against that token — i.e. the workspace-write token cannot be used to create a process at all on this
host. I could not narrow it further than that without instrumenting the token.
Impact
In workspace-write, only child processes are affected: the in-process FS tools read and write the workspace
normally. The shell tool (dsh-tool-pwsh) is unusable, and read-only is not a workaround because it blocks
workspace writes.
Workaround
Run the session with danger-full-access; shell commands then work normally.

threads.title: Bug][Desktop] Windows 客户端在高刷高分屏上，窗口内文字在输入/流式输出时发虚（其他窗口正常）
threads.bodyText:
[Bug][Desktop] Windows 客户端在高刷高分屏上，窗口内文字在输入/流式输出时发虚（其他窗口正常）环境
项 | 值
-- | --
系统 | Windows 10 专业版 10.0.19045（最近更新 2026-09-13 KB5126256）
显卡 | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti，驱动 32.0.16.2101（2026-10-22 安装）
显示器 | 2560×1440 @ 240Hz，DisplayPort，32 位色（SKG H24E7-2）
缩放 | 125%（DpiValue=0 跟随推荐）；改为 100% 后问题依旧
客户端 | DeepSeek Harness 桌面版，app.asar 时间戳 2026-10-23 16:00
其他 | MPO 已关闭（OverlayTestMode=5）；HAGS 开启（HwSchMode=2）
现象只有 DeepSeek Harness 这个窗口的文字会发虚，同屏其他窗口（浏览器、Steam、资源管理器）全部清晰。具体表现：静止时文字清晰；一旦开始打字，输入框附近文字立刻变软，打完字又恢复清晰。助手流式输出（每个 token 都触发重绘）期间，聊天区文字持续发软。静止时个别区域会一直糊着，例如输入框右侧「发送」按钮所在的区域，不碰它就一直是低清晰度。出现过「一半清晰一半模糊」的分界现象；点击/选中/拖拽窗口边缘会短暂恢复清晰。已排除不是显卡/驱动故障：近 90 天 NVIDIA 驱动崩溃（TDR 4101）0 次；历史 3 次 TDR 全部发生在换卡前（AMD amduw23g，2026-10-14）。不是系统缩放：100% 与 125% 下现象相同。不是 CPU 争抢：用 4 个 BelowNormal 线程（界面优先级完全压过它们）跑 90 秒，输入时照样发虚。不是 MPO：OverlayTestMode=5 已设置并重启，无改善。不是内存/句柄压力：物理内存 32GB，可用 27GB；应用进程内存正常。不是 DPI 兼容性覆盖：AppCompatFlags\Layers 中没有该应用的条目。应用未设置 disableHardwareAcceleration / disable-gpu / force-device-scale-factor。技术推测表现完全符合 Chromium 的既有行为：图层一旦参与合成（动画、光标闪烁、流式更新、transform/opacity/backdrop-filter），Blink 会禁用 LCD 亚像素抗锯齿，改用灰度抗锯齿；图层销毁后恢复。11–12px 的系统级 UI 字号在灰度渲染下会明显发虚，240Hz 屏又把这一瞬间放大。可能相关的实现细节，建议排查：是否对消息容器/输入区使用了 will-change、transform、filter、backdrop-filter，导致其长期处于合成层。是否用 webFrame.setZoomFactor() 做了非整数缩放（与系统 DPI 叠加后会二次栅格化）。是否为输入框光标动画、流式输出的逐字更新使用了独立图层。Electron / Chromium 版本中 LCD text 的启用策略（--enable-lcd-text 等开关在打包版本里是否被覆盖）。期望输入和流式输出期间，文字保持与静止时一致的清晰度；或在发虚期间不做「一半子像素、一半灰度」的混合渲染。补充该现象在 100% 与 125% 缩放下均可复现，且只影响本应用窗口，因此判断为客户端渲染层问题，与用户硬件无关。

threads.title: 发现bug，本轮对话已完成，但任务一直显示执行中
Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 on Windows: startup fails with "desktop welcome: Web authentication failed" after many launches
threads.bodyText:
Hi — not sure whether this is already a known issue, so apologies in advance if it has been reported before.
I've been using the Windows desktop build (0.2.1-rc.3, nightly channel) on a machine that gets restarted fairly often. After a few dozen launches it stopped opening entirely: double-clicking the icon brings the process up and it exits again immediately, with no window.
The crash log is the same every time:
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
    at connectDesktopWelcome (.../resources/app/lib/main.js)
    at async Object.start (.../main.js)
source: host
phase: startup

Looking at the Electron profile, the cookie store had built up a fair number of entries:
cookies 总数: 71
dsh-auth-*: 71
host 分布: 127.0.0.1 x71

Reading through the startup path, it looks like this might be a small leak that compounds over time:

the Host binds a new port on each launch, so ready.url differs every time;
authenticateWebHost() mints a dsh-auth-<host-hash> cookie per port, and cookies for ports that are already gone are never removed;
connectDesktopWelcome() calls net.fetch(..., { credentials: "include" }), which puts every 127.0.0.1 cookie into a single Cookie header;
once that header grows past Node's http.maxHeaderSize (16 KB by default), the request comes back 401, authenticated.ok is false, and startup throws.

Since a failed launch still leaves a new cookie behind, retrying seems to make the next attempt slightly more likely to fail rather than less — which is probably why it felt like a sudden breakage instead of something that crept up.
Removing the stale dsh-auth-* cookies by hand brought startup back, so this isn't blocking me permanently. But a long-lived install would presumably hit it eventually, and the message ("Web authentication failed") points at the network rather than at cookie accumulation, which made it take a while to track down.
If it's helpful, a few possible directions:

sweep dsh-auth-* before minting a new one (those ports are gone, so the values are stale);
or overwrite one stable cookie name instead of accumulating per-port ones;
or give the cookie a short expiry so the set converges on its own;
and perhaps check the projected Cookie header size before the request, so the failure surfaces as something more diagnosable than "authentication failed".

Happy to share logs, try a build, or provide anything else that would help. Thanks!

threads.title: Sandbox bricks itself on Windows when %TEMP%\dsh-* is deleted: cached temp capability is never re-validated
threads.bodyText:
Symptom
On Windows, the ACL restricted-token sandbox stops working mid-session and never recovers:
sandbox mode "workspace-write" is requested but no sandbox backend is usable on this host;
refusing to run the command unconfined. ...
Runner failure: windows-acl-run: --temp is not an existing directory:
C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-tnHFGf

Every non-escalated pwsh call fails this way. %TEMP% itself exists; only that dsh-* child is gone. Other dsh-*
directories in the same temp root were still present, so this is not a blanket temp wipe.
Root cause (read from the shipped 0.1.5-rc.3 sources)


dsh-sandbox-local creates a private temp directory per (session, workspace) and caches it in memory:
// dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:401-403
const existing = this.tempCapabilities.get(key);
if (existing !== void 0) return existing;          // returned without an existence check
const tempDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "dsh-"));


dsh-sandbox-windows-acl refuses to start unless that directory still exists:
// dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/runner.js:110
if (!existsSync(path) || !statSync(path).isDirectory()) fail(`${label} is not an existing directory: ${path}`);


So if anything outside DSH deletes %TEMP%\dsh-* (Disk Cleanup, Storage Sense, an antivirus, a manual temp purge — all
common on a machine with little free space), the cache keeps handing out a dead path and every subsequent sandboxed
call fails until the process restarts. Cleanup only happens through revokeAclGrants(), which also clears the map, so
nothing reconciles the two.
Why it is worth fixing

It is silent and sticky: the agent simply cannot run commands any more; nothing in the message says "restart".
The trigger is ordinary housekeeping on Windows, not a misconfiguration.
danger-full-access is the only escape, i.e. users are pushed from more confinement to none.

Suggested fix
Re-validate on the cache hit and recreate when it is gone:
const existing = this.tempCapabilities.get(key);
if (existing !== void 0 && existsSync(existing.dir)) return existing;
if (existing !== void 0) { /* dispose grant, drop the entry, fall through to mkdtemp */ }
Alternatively make the runner tolerant: mkdirSync(parsed.temp, { recursive: true }) instead of fail() — though the ACL
grant would still have to be re-applied, so the first option is probably the correct one.
Environment

Windows 11 (26200), Node 24.14.0, @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.3
Sandbox mode workspace-write; no other backend available on this host, so the ACL runner is the only path.
Reproduced with a single echo hi after the directory disappeared.


Posted here because this repository has Issues disabled; feel free to move it if another channel is preferred.

threads.title: [Bug] Benign Chinese ops prompt → stream ends with stop reason "refusal" → client reports MALFORMED_RESPONSE (deepseek-flash)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
A benign operational instruction (24 Chinese characters, no sensitive content) caused the Messages-style stream to terminate with an upstream stop_reason of refusal, which the client surfaces as a hard error:
本轮运行失败  DeepSeek Messages stream: unsupported stop reason refusal   MALFORMED_RESPONSE

The model had already emitted a reasoning block (it clearly understood the task), then the stream closed with finish.reason.kind = error instead of a normal message. No answer was produced.
Environment



Item
Value




Surface
DSH Web client (DeepSeek Harness) on a local deployment


Model
deepseek-flash


Provider stream label
DeepSeek Messages stream (Messages-format streaming)


Time (UTC+8)
2026-10-28 20:31:15 → error at 20:31:18


Retries
0 (turn aborted immediately)


Reproduced
1 time so far (single occurrence; no retry yet)



Input (verbatim)
今天行情日K数据已经更新完成了，可以将预约的任务提前执行

Translation: "Today's market daily-candle data has finished updating; you can run the scheduled tasks ahead of time."
Context: this is a message from a human operator to an assistant working inside an internal automation setup. It contains no request for harmful content — it is purely about triggering previously agreed, already-scheduled work now that its data dependency is satisfied.
What the client received
An assistant attempt stream with four items — a reasoning block, then finish:
{"type":"chunk","chunk":{"type":"block-start","index":0,"blockType":"reasoning"}}
{"type":"chunk","chunk":{"type":"reasoning-chunks","index":0,...}}
{"type":"chunk","chunk":{"type":"block-end","index":0,"block":{"type":"reasoning","text":"New user message: \"今天行情日K数据已经更新完成了，可以将预约的任务提前执行\" ... (the model correctly restates the task and plans which pending item to run) — omitted here for brevity"}}}
{"type":"chunk","chunk":{"type":"finish","reason":{"kind":"error","failure":{"message":"DeepSeek Messages stream: unsupported stop reason refusal","code":"MALFORMED_RESPONSE"}}}}
So the reasoning was produced normally; the stream then reported a refusal stop reason instead of a message/finish reason the client recognises.
Why I believe this is a false positive

No violence, self-harm, illegal activity, sexual content, personal data, or political content in the message.
It is an operational scheduling instruction, addressed to an assistant that already has an established, approved plan for that work.
The model's own reasoning shows it read the message correctly and was planning to execute the pending task — the refusal appears to come from a post-hoc safety classification, not from misunderstanding.
One hypothesis (not a claim): a classifier may be reading "run the scheduled tasks ahead of time" as an agentic/external action and routing it to refusal. If so, that pattern will hit many legitimate automation users.

Questions for maintainers

Is stop_reason: "refusal" an expected value of the Messages-style stream? If yes, could the set of possible stop reasons be documented (at minimum refusal, and how clients should treat it)? Right now an unrecognised value turns into MALFORMED_RESPONSE, which looks like a transport bug rather than a content decision.
If the refusal is intentional for this input, could you share the general category that triggered it? The text has no obvious sensitive term, and a false positive here blocks a routine automation task.
Client guidance: should a refusal stop reason be surfaced as "the model declined" (with no retry), or retried with a modified prompt? A short note in the docs would let client authors stop guessing.

Notes

The screenshot of the Web UI (处理失败 / 本轮运行失败 / MALFORMED_RESPONSE) will be added in a follow-up comment — GitHub's CLI API cannot upload images.
Happy to re-test on request, or to provide a longer trace if it reproduces.
Nothing sensitive is included in this report: no credentials, no session identifiers, no business data.


中文摘要：一条完全无害的运营指令（「今天行情日K数据已经更新完成了，可以将预约的任务提前执行」）被上游以 stop_reason: "refusal" 结束流；客户端不认识这个 stop reason，于是报 MALFORMED_RESPONSE（界面显示「本轮运行失败」）。模型其实已经正常产出了 reasoning（说明它读懂了任务），所以更像事后安全分类误判，而非真的越界。想请官方确认：refusal 是否为 Messages 流的合法 stop reason、能否在文档里列出全部取值与客户端处理建议；以及这种"执行已预约任务"的措辞是否会被误伤。

threads.title: Turn ends normally but the assistant message has no text block (only reasoning + tool-call)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
A turn completes normally (turn/end received) but the assistant/message event contains only reasoning and tool-call blocks — no text block at all. The client receives nothing to display, so the user sees "no reply" even though the turn finished successfully.
Environment

DeepSeek Harness desktop 0.2.1-rc.2, Windows x64, nightly channel
Model: deepseek-official/deepseek-flash, reasoning effort max
Context plugin: billion-context 0.1.206
Client: custom Node client driving session/prompt over the local API and consuming streamed session events

Event sequence observed
step/start → assistant/message → tool/call → tool/result → step/end → turn/end

The assistant/message blocks were:
["reasoning(N)|tool-call"]

No text block in any of them.
Frequency (single day, same session)
4 occurrences, all around :12 past the hour:
17:12:18  blocks=["reasoning(163)|tool-call"]
18:12:18  blocks=["reasoning(161)|tool-call"]
19:12:38  blocks=["reasoning(72)|tool-call"]
20:12:21  blocks=["reasoning(868)|tool-call"]

The first two coincide with an hourly proactive/silent wake — arguably fine there. The latter two happened during real conversation: the user had just asked a question and expected a reply; the tool call was followed by no text.
Expected behavior

If a turn intentionally ends after tool calls without prose, it would help if that state were distinguishable (e.g. a flag on turn/end, or an explicit empty text block), so clients do not treat it as a lost message.
If it happens while a reply is expected, a continuation nudge before turn/end (or a visible warning in the events/log) would help.

Notes

No HTTP errors, no stream interruption, no corrupt session log.
billion-context's "degenerate turn" detection did not trigger, because the event sequence looks complete from the client's perspective.
Other turns in the same session are fine.

Question
Is assistant/message with only reasoning + tool-call followed by turn/end an expected path? If not, is this a known issue — the r0.2.1-rc.3 (2026-10-23) release notes don't mention it.

threads.title: Desktop startup crash loop: accumulated dsh-auth-* cookies exceed the Host's 16 KB header limit (HTTP 431)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
The desktop app enters a startup crash loop after enough launches: the shell fails during desktop welcome: Web authentication and exits. Root cause is unbounded accumulation of dsh-auth-* session cookies in the Electron session jar, until the Cookie request header exceeds the Host's 16 KB HTTP header limit and every launch fails with HTTP 431.
（中文版摘要见文末。）
Environment

App: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.3
Platform: macOS arm64 (also affects any platform — the mechanism is generic)
Electron: 44.7.0 / Node: 24.21.0

Root cause analysis
In @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection, the browser-session cookie name is derived from the authority including port:
const COOKIE_PREFIX = "dsh-auth-";
function cookieName(authority) {
  return COOKIE_PREFIX + encodeBase64Url(createHash("sha256").update(authority).digest());
}
The Desktop Host binds to a new random 127.0.0.1 port on every launch, so every launch mints a cookie with a different name (dsh-auth-<sha256("127.0.0.1:<port>")>). Cookies carry a 30-day expiry and are never cleaned up. Since cookies are not port-scoped, Chromium sends every accumulated dsh-auth-* cookie on each request to 127.0.0.1.
After ~70 launches the jar held 71 live cookies ≈ 16,117 bytes of Cookie header (measured). Adding the remaining request headers exceeds Node's default --max-http-header-size (16,384), so the Host responds 431 Request Header Fields Too Large.
The desktop shell then maps any non-OK response to a startup failure (connectDesktopWelcome throws on !authenticated.ok), and each failed attempt stores one more cookie via Set-Cookie on the 431 response, creating a death spiral (observed 7 crash-restart cycles in ~3 minutes):
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
    at connectDesktopWelcome (.../app.asar/lib/main.js:8886:31)
    at async Object.start (.../app.asar/lib/main.js:12195:22)

Reproduction

Install @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop and launch it once per day for ~2–3 weeks (each launch = new random host port = one new cookie).
Observe ~/Library/Application Support/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop/Cookies accumulate one dsh-auth-* row per launch, all unexpired (30-day TTL).
Once the combined Cookie header for 127.0.0.1 exceeds 16 KB, every launch crashes with the log above (~/Library/Logs/DeepSeek Harness/crash-*-host.log).

Current behavior
Startup crash loop; the app never opens. Each retry adds another cookie, worsening the failure.
Expected behavior
Startup succeeds regardless of launch count.
Suggested fixes (any one)

Make the cookie name port-independent (e.g. hash the host only, not host:port), or give the Host a stable port per profile so the same cookie name is reused and refreshed in place; or
Have the desktop shell purge stale dsh-auth-* cookies from the session jar before authenticating (it already owns the jar), e.g. keep only the cookie matching the current authority; or
As a mitigation only: start the Host's HTTP server with a larger --max-http-header-size.

Workaround for affected users
Quit the app completely, then delete the accumulated cookies (macOS example):
sqlite3 "$HOME/Library/Application Support/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop/Cookies" \
  "DELETE FROM cookies WHERE name LIKE 'dsh-auth-%';"
Relaunch — it starts cleanly. No account login is lost; dsh-auth-* is only the local Host session cookie. The problem will slowly recur until one of the fixes above ships.

中文版摘要
桌面端每次启动时，Desktop Host 会在 127.0.0.1 的随机新端口上监听，而会话 Cookie 名是 dsh-auth-<端口哈希>，因此每次启动都会签发一个新名字的 Cookie（30 天有效、从不清理）。Cookie 不区分端口，约 70 次启动后 Chromium 会把全部 ~71 个 Cookie（约 16.1 KB）一起发给 127.0.0.1，超过 Node 默认 16 KB 的请求头上限，Host 返回 431，桌面端把它报成 desktop welcome: Web authentication failed 并崩溃退出；且每次失败还会再新增一个 Cookie，形成恶性循环。建议：Cookie 名不绑定端口（或 Host 使用固定端口），或启动时清理旧的 dsh-auth-* Cookie。临时 workaround：退出应用后删除上述数据库中的 dsh-auth-% Cookie 即可正常启动。

threads.title: [Bug] Inline file links with Windows paths open wrong path: Markdown backslash escaping breaks _-prefixed segments; sidebar reports file-not-found
threads.bodyText:
[Bug] Inline file links with Windows paths open a wrong path: Markdown \_ escaping breaks _-prefixed segments, sidebar reports "文件不存在"
Environment

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 (dshBuildCommit: be72761ee1a6736ebcdf4f3739363b083ae53c98), Windows 11 zh-CN
Affected surface: the right-hand "sidebar" document preview panel

Symptom
Clicking an inline file link rendered from a reply opens the wrong path in the sidebar and shows the empty-state text "文件不存在，可能已被移动或删除" (file does not exist), while the tool-result card for the same file ("在侧边栏预览") opens it correctly.
Reproduction


Agent writes G:\AI\_dsh_tools\_issue-body.md.


Agent replies with a Markdown link:
[\_issue-body.md](G:\AI\_dsh_tools\_issue-body.md)


Click the inline link → the sidebar tries G:/AI/_dsh_tools_issue-body.md → "文件不存在".


Click the tool-result card → opens G:\AI\_dsh_tools\_issue-body.md correctly.


Checks on the machine:
Test-Path G:\AI\_dsh_tools\_issue-body.md        -> True   (real file)
Test-Path G:\AI\_dsh_tools_issue-body.md         -> False  (what the sidebar tried)

Root cause (two channels, one is lossy)


Tool-result card: uses structured meta.path (absolute, from the tool call) → reliable.


Inline link: uses the Markdown-authored text path. CommonMark backslash escapes apply inside link destinations — \_ becomes _ (while \A stays literal) — so
G:\AI\_dsh_tools\_issue-body.md → G:\AI_dsh_tools_issue-body.md
The client then normalizes \ → / in fileAddressFor() and opens the result without any existence check or fallback; the only failure surface is the sidebar's error.notFound string.


Bundle references (0.2.1-rc.3):

dsh-client-ui-reference/lib/client.js → fileAddressFor(sessionId, cwd, path) (~line 194): only path.replace(/\\/g, "/") + relative-join; no validation, no fallback.
dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview/lib/client.js line 1467 → "error.notFound": "文件不存在，可能已被移动或删除", no retry/fallback.
dsh-client-ui-deliverables/lib/client.js line 1115 → if (typeof meta.path === "string" && isAbsoluteWorkspacePath(meta.path)) return meta.path; — this is why cards work.

Impact
Deterministic (not intermittent) for any Windows path whose segment starts with _ after a backslash — e.g. _dsh_tools, _dsh_probe, _dsh_export, _issue-body.md. This is a very common naming pattern on Windows dev machines, so the failure is systematic rather than rare.
Suggested fix (any of these)

Fallback on open failure: resolve by basename within the session workspace, or match against the turn's tool-call meta.path list, and open the unique match.
Prefer structured paths: render inline file references from the tool-result meta.path where available instead of trusting authored Markdown text.
Validate before opening: if keeping text links, decode and existence-check the destination against the workspace, and show "did you mean ?" instead of a dead end.

threads.title: [Bug] Desktop Host aborts with SIGABRT (exit 134) at the ~4 GB V8 heap ceiling; restored long sessions reach it during startup
threads.bodyText:
Summary
@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 (Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0 / Windows 11 26100) quits without any dialog while in normal use. Four occurrences in 24 hours, all with the same signature: the Host child process hits the V8 heap ceiling and aborts.
There is no Application Error event, no WER report and no crash dump — this is not a native crash. app.asar/lib/main.js treats the Host exit as fatal and takes the window down.
Evidence
Crash logs land in %APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-<iso>-host.log.



local time
Host uptime
heap at abort

Error: dsh desktop host exited with 134
<--- Last few GCs --->
[29836:...] 46777186 ms: Scavenge 3986.4 (4036.3) -> 3974.4 (4046.7) MB ... allocation failure;
FATAL ERROR: MarkCompactCollector: young object promotion failed Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory

v8.getHeapStatistics().heap_size_limit under the bundled Electron is 4192 MB.
Not a slow leak — the ceiling is reached while restoring sessions

One restart aborted after 9 minutes 15 seconds.
Measured 3 minutes 27 seconds after launch, the Host working set was already 4074 MB of a 4192 MB ceiling.

So the process lands near the ceiling while opening/restoring sessions, and any later allocation can abort it.
Where the memory goes
Decompressed the six largest session.v4.jsonl.zstd files frame by frame:



session (prefix)

Event mix is stable across all six: assistant/message 62–64 %, tool/result 15–23 %, tool/call 5–6 %, user/message 4–5 %, request/header 2–9 %.
1.95 GB of raw events becomes 3–4 GB of JS heap — i.e. exactly the ceiling.
Raising the limit with flags does not work on this build



attempt
heap_size_limit




default
4192 MB


NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192
4192 MB (filtered by Electron's allow-list)


Electron.exe --max-old-space-size=8192 -e …
4192 MB — although process.execArgv does contain the flag


real node.exe with the same flag (control)
16576 MB



Root cause: the Host is spawned with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1, and Electron initialises V8 before V8 flags are parsed, so --max-old-space-size reaches execArgv but never the heap configuration. Adding it to the spawn argument list in lib/main.js:3794 therefore has no effect either.
Suggested fixes (ordered by payoff)

Load session events lazily — do not rehydrate the whole event stream when a session is restored; page/window it and stream when building requests. This is the root cause.
Deduplicate assistant/message — 62–64 % of the stream. If a message is persisted per streaming step, keep only the final state or deltas.
Set the Host heap limit explicitly — but --max-old-space-size must be delivered to a real Node runtime (or via worker_threads resourceLimits.maxOldGenerationSizeMb); the current RUN_AS_NODE path cannot honour it.
Protect the user — when the heap approaches heap_size_limit, persist state, restart the Host gracefully and restore the window, instead of letting the whole client disappear.
Log quality — exited with 134: appends the last stderr line (GitNexus MCP (1.6.12), or a SessionAlreadyOwnedError from dsh-wechat). That reads like the cause and sends debugging in the wrong direction. Please print the FATAL ERROR: … heap out of memory line explicitly.

The DesktopHostFatalError: cannot create effect on inactive context in main.log is a secondary race during the post-crash restart (phase: startup), not an independent fault.
Environment
dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 (nightly channel)
Electron 44.7.0 | Node 24.21.0 | win32 x64 | Windows 11 26100
64 GB RAM — 27.5 GB still free at crash time (so it is the V8 limit, not the OS)
6 sessions open simultaneously in one window

threads.title: [Bug][Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3] Auth cookies accumulate across restarts, causing HTTP 431 and startup failure
threads.bodyText:
Summary
DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 can fail to launch after repeated restarts with the following error:
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed

I investigated this issue on macOS arm64 and identified a reproducible cause: stale authentication cookies accumulate across launches until the HTTP Cookie header exceeds Node.js's default 16 KB request-header limit.
The server then returns HTTP 431, which the Desktop application incorrectly reports as an authentication failure.
I verified that clearing the stale cookies restores the application without reinstalling it.
Environment



Component
Version




DeepSeek Harness Desktop
0.2.1-rc.3


Electron
44.7.0


Node.js
24.21.0


Operating system
macOS arm64


Locale
zh-CN



The application passed code-signature and integrity verification.
Root Cause Analysis

The local host listens on 127.0.0.1 using a new random port on each launch.
The authorization flow issues a cookie named dsh-auth-<base64url(sha256(authority))>, where authority includes the randomly assigned port.
HTTP cookies are scoped by hostname and path, not by port. Cookies from earlier launches are therefore sent to the new host port.
Those older cookies cannot authenticate the current host because their signed payload refers to a different authority.
The cookies remain in Electron's persistent session for up to 30 days, so repeated launches can accumulate many obsolete cookies.

In the affected session, I measured:



Measurement
Observed value




dsh-auth-* cookies
71


Cookie name length
52 bytes each


Cookie value length
173 bytes each


Combined name=value;  entries
16,117 bytes


Node.js default HTTP header limit
16,384 bytes



Once ordinary HTTP headers are included, the request exceeds the limit and the server returns:
HTTP/1.1 431 Request Header Fields Too Large
The Desktop welcome handler checks only whether the response is successful and reports HTTP 431 as a generic authentication failure. The subsequent recovery guidance incorrectly recommends reinstalling the application, although reinstalling does not necessarily remove persistent Electron cookies.
Direct Verification
I reproduced the welcome request using Electron's net.fetch:
const response = await net.fetch(readyUrl, {
  credentials: "include"
});
Observed results:

Before cookie cleanup: HTTP 431
After cookie cleanup: HTTP 200
Remaining authentication cookies: 1

The application installation and user profile remained unchanged. This supports cookie accumulation, rather than corrupted application files, as the immediate cause of this failure.
Steps to Reproduce

Install and launch DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3.
Repeatedly start and quit the application, approximately 70 times within the 30-day cookie lifetime.
Launch Desktop again.
Observe the Web authentication failed error.
Inspect the local welcome request and confirm HTTP 431.
Fully close Desktop and remove stale dsh-auth-* cookies from its Electron session.
Restart Desktop and confirm successful authentication.

For deterministic regression testing, seed a fresh Electron session with approximately 70 dsh-auth-* cookies for http://127.0.0.1/, each with a value close to 173 bytes, before attempting the welcome handshake.
Suggested Fixes
Immediate mitigation
Remove stale local authentication cookies before initiating the Desktop welcome handshake:
async function clearStaleHostAuthCookies(session) {
  const stale = (
    await session.cookies.get({ url: "http://127.0.0.1/" })
  ).filter(({ name }) => name.startsWith("dsh-auth-"));

  for (const { name } of stale) {
    await session.cookies.remove("http://127.0.0.1/", name);
  }
}
Long-term improvements

Use a stable, bounded authentication cookie name instead of generating a new name for every ephemeral port. Review concurrent-host behavior when implementing this change.
Consider isolating authentication cookies in a dedicated Electron session or local hostname.
Distinguish HTTP 431 from genuine authentication failures and include the HTTP status in diagnostics.
Avoid recommending application reinstallation for cookie-header overflow.
Add regression tests covering repeated Desktop launches, successful authentication and bounded cookie counts.

Relevant Code Locations
Based on the packaged Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 runtime:

app.asar/lib/main.js: authenticateWebHost() around line 8229.
app.asar/lib/main.js: connectDesktopWelcome() around lines 8882–8886.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js: authenticatedUrl() around line 440, authorizeIndex() around line 458, and default cookie age around line 1017.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver/lib/index.js: HTTP server creation around line 412.

Impact
This issue can make the Desktop application completely unusable after frequent restarts. The current error message also incorrectly suggests reinstalling the application.
I recommend treating this as a high-priority Desktop reliability issue.
I have already sent a detailed report to harness-service@deepseek.com on October 29, 2026.
Could the maintainers confirm this issue and consider adding a fix to an upcoming release?
I can provide sanitized logs and further reproduction details privately if needed. I have not included raw authentication cookies, launch tokens or the cookie database in this public discussion.
Thank you.
