threads.title: [Bug] 工具返回的内联图片块让 Messages 适配器空引用崩溃，并被误报为 TRANSPORT（Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3）
threads.bodyText:
求确认是否为已知问题；如果是新问题，下面附完整复现和代码位置。
现象
MCP 工具返回的图片是内联结构（type: "image" + data + mimeType）。dsh-llm-deepseek 直接读 block.attachment.attachmentId，遇到这种块抛 TypeError，又被外层 catch 包装成 TRANSPORT。表现是任务跑到一定量后每次重试都失败，会话报废，只能新开重做。
环境

DeepSeek Harness 桌面端 0.2.1-rc.3（win-x64 官方安装包），Windows 11，内置 Node 24.21.0
触发插件：dsh-computer-use-win@0.5.3（MCP stdio，经 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client 桥接）
同时安装：dsh-usage-stats、dsh-companion-memory、dsh-automation、superpowers-dsh

复现

安装 dsh-computer-use-win，默认全量工具
让 Agent 执行需要截图的桌面操作
该轮 tool/result 中出现内联图片块
下一轮模型请求开始失败；点「继续」仍然失败

实际
界面上显示：
DeepSeek Messages transport failed    [TRANSPORT]

重试 5 次全部失败，每次约 40ms（本地立即抛错，无网络往返），回合终止；坏块留在历史里，之后每次重试都在同一处抛错。
证据
tool/result 中的图片块：
{"type":"image","data":"iVBORw0KGgo…","mimeType":"image/png"}

把 catch 里的 cause 打出来后得到的真实错误：
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'attachmentId')

代码位置（0.2.1-rc.3，app.asar 内）
文件：@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js

prepareImages()：imageRefs(message.content) 之后直接使用 ref.attachmentId
assertImagesFit()：(block) => versions.get(block.attachment.attachmentId).bytes
serialize() 的 input()：const version = images.get(block.attachment.attachmentId)

文件：@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local/lib/index.js
function ensureReference(ref) {
  const match = ID_PATTERN.exec(String(ref.attachmentId))
}

为什么被误报成网络错误
generate() 的 catch 把 this.request() 全过程（文件上传、扩展协商、fetch、流解析）里任何非 TIMEOUT / ABORTED / LlmError 的异常都变成 TRANSPORT，且 cause 不打印也不落盘。我最初按网络问题排查（换 provider、改 baseURL、抓包、加大重试）全部无效，因为错误发生在请求发出之前。
建议

dsh-mcp-client 入站时把 MCP 图片内容归一化成附件（attachments.put）或 base64 image source，不要让没有 attachment 的图片块进入会话
prepareImages / serialize / assertImagesFit 对缺失 attachment 的图片块跳过，而不是抛错
编程错误单独分类（例如 HARNESS_BUG 或 INVALID_REQUEST），不要把 cause 丢掉
ensureReference 先判空，用 INVALID_ATTACHMENT_REF 而不是抛原生 TypeError

threads.title: [Bug][Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3] sandboxed pwsh never runs: 0xC0000142 when the host process has no console
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On Windows, @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl spawns its restricted child with CreateProcessAsUserW. The child is a console-subsystem process. When the process that creates it owns no console, the child cannot finish loader initialization and dies before main():
exit code 3221225794 = 0xC0000142 = STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED
(no stdout, no stderr — the process never got to run)

The desktop app launches the runner through process.execPath — the Electron GUI binary — which owns no console. Result: the pwsh tool never works in the default sandbox mode, while danger-full-access works (it bypasses the sandbox entirely), so the failure looks like "the sandboxed tool is broken" rather than "the sandbox runner needs a console".
Two mechanisms produce this same exit code and they are independent — see the cross matrix below. One is this console absence; the other is a restricting list missing the keep-alive group, already documented in the package README.
Environment



Item
Value




DSH desktop
0.2.1-rc.3 (DeepSeek Harness.exe FileVersion), resources/app.asar 182,434,783 B


OS
Microsoft Windows 10 Pro 10.0.19045 (build 19045), x64


Shell the tool runs
Windows PowerShell 5.1.19041.6456 (PSEdition=Desktop)


Packages
@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local → windows-acl runner; dsh-sandbox-windows-acl; dsh-win32-process (koffi 3.1.1)



Root cause
dsh-sandbox-local launches the runner as [process.execPath, runner.js], i.e. the Electron binary with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1. process.execPath for the desktop app is a GUI-subsystem executable: the process has no console (GetConsoleWindow() === NULL, GetConsoleCP() === 0).
The runner then creates a WRITE_RESTRICTED + Low-integrity token and calls CreateProcessAsUserW for the console-subsystem child. A console-subsystem child of a console-less parent would normally allocate a fresh console itself, but the Low-integrity restricted token cannot — so the child dies in loader initialization before main(), surfacing only as 0xC0000142.
The keep-alive group (logon SID + Everyone) is necessary but not sufficient: without it early DLL init dies (and CNG crashes pwsh with 0xE0434352 when it is absent at runtime); with it, the child still needs a console it can share with its parent. The README documents this as "console isolation is unavailable — children share the host console", but the shipped desktop host has no console at all, so there is nothing to share.
Verified facts that narrow it down — each measured, not inferred:

token identical (whoami /all: same 60 groups, High mandatory level in both parents)
environment identical (env key sets equal; a minimal env still fails; node with the full Electron env still succeeds)
the only correlated variable is the presence of a console: GetConsoleWindow() != NULL → works, == NULL → 0xC0000142
the sandbox layer never sets CREATE_NO_WINDOW: packages/subprocess/win32-process/src/process.ts:232 and :455 set only STARTF_USESTDHANDLES | STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW with wShowWindow: SW_HIDE; the only creation flags are CREATE_SUSPENDED / CREATE_UNICODE_ENVIRONMENT (:542, :567). The file states the intent at :454: "Preserve console inheritance: CREATE_NO_WINDOW can fail restricted-token DLL initialization."
LUA_TOKEN and the built-in Administrator are not involved on current builds: local 0.2.1-rc.3 app.asar calls createRestrictedToken(currentToken, 13, …) = 0xD (includes LUA_TOKEN), while npm 0.2.2-alpha.2 (lib/types-DFdfvhLN.js) calls it with 9 = 0x9, and master@f3803c9 src/token.ts:232 passes DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE | WRITE_RESTRICTED with no -500 branch anywhere. Consistent with that, processes do start inside the confined shell on the affected account.

Evidence: parent console (all reproduced locally; runner binary unchanged between rows)

Two qualifications on those rows, so the numbers are not over-read:

A4 is a host-side observation only. windowsHide hides the window; it says nothing about how the confined child is created.
A separate attempt with DETACHED_PROCESS (0x8) on the child returned 0 but lost all output capture, so it is retracted: "exit 0 with no output" cannot be distinguished from "the command never ran".

Child creation flags tested separately (console-less parent): CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE (0x10) → still 0xC0000142, consistent with the README's known limitation.
Evidence: restricting list (the second, independent mechanism)
Bisect with all other factors held (Low integrity + default DACL, console-less parent):

So both sides of the keep-alive group are required. Earlier notes claimed "LUA_TOKEN / the built-in Administrator explains the -500 failures"; that does not reproduce on 0.2.1-rc.3 here (see the token bullet above).
Evidence: stdio is not the variable

M4 shows the console fix works; M5 shows it does not rescue a token whose restricting list lacks the keep-alive group.
Rejected alternatives (all measured)

Proposed fix
Layer 1 (required): give the runner a console when it has none, before spawning, and hide it so GUI users never see a console flash.
// Three bindings added to the win32 table (kernel32: GetConsoleWindow, AllocConsole;
// user32: ShowWindow — loaded via koffi.load because extendWin32ProcessBindings only
// exposes kernel32/advapi32).
function ensureConsole(api: Win32Bindings): { hadConsole: boolean; ready: boolean } {
  const hadConsole = api.getConsoleWindow() !== null
  if (!hadConsole) api.allocConsole()
  const window = api.getConsoleWindow()
  if (window !== null) api.showWindow(window, 0) // SW_HIDE
  return { hadConsole, ready: window !== null }
}
Placement: in main(), immediately after the SetConsoleCtrlHandler check and before new AclSandbox(...). Failure must be fail-open (one warning line, keep going): a setup without a console then behaves exactly as it does today.
Layer 2 (required, regression guard): assert before CreateRestrictedToken that the restricting list contains both keep-alive members, and fail with a message naming the missing side instead of letting the user see a bare 0xC0000142.
Layer 3 (cheap, high value): when the mirrored child exit code equals 3221225794, write one stderr line stating console presence and pointing at the README section — so the next report carries a real code plus a hint instead of empty output.
Verified locally: with this shim in front of the shipped runner.js and DeepSeek Harness.exe as the parent, the confined powershell.exe runs and returns 0x0 (row A5).

Patch (git diff, +56 lines, applies to master@f3803c9)
# Draft patch (NOT applied): dsh-sandbox-windows-acl -- let the runner own a console
#
# Target repo:   github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness (public)
# Target branch: master
# Baseline:      f3803c96974ad4a94195fb97e5c637e9c2a3afe3 (release 0.2.2-alpha.2)
# Files:         packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/runner.ts (2 hunks)
#                packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/ffi.ts    (2 hunks)
# Size:          +56 lines, no deletions
#
# Generated by git diff (not hand-written). Verified with: git apply --check -p1 (exit 0).
# Apply from the repository root: git apply -p1 runner-ensure-console-src.patch
#
# Scope: only whether the runner owns a console, plus human-readable exit-code
# diagnostics. No token, ACL, SID or allowlist change.
# Constraint discovered while retargeting: extendWin32ProcessBindings exposes the
# kernel32 and advapi32 handles only, so ShowWindow loads user32 through
# koffi.load('user32.dll') inside the binding table.
diff --git a/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/ffi.ts b/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/ffi.ts
index 5ef39a4..95a608d 100644
--- a/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/ffi.ts
+++ b/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/ffi.ts
@@ -84,6 +84,9 @@ export interface Win32Bindings extends Win32ProcessBindings {
   getTempPathW(length: number, buffer: Buffer): number
   setEnvironmentVariableW(name: string, value: string): number
   setConsoleCtrlHandler(handler: null, add: number): number
+  getConsoleWindow(): NativePtr | null
+  allocConsole(): number
+  showWindow(window: NativePtr, command: number): number
   createFileW(
     fileName: string,
     desiredAccess: number,
@@ -265,6 +268,15 @@ function bindings(): Win32Bindings {
     getTempPathW: bind(kernel32, 'GetTempPathW', 'uint32', ['uint32', PVOID]),
     setEnvironmentVariableW: bind(kernel32, 'SetEnvironmentVariableW', 'int', ['str16', 'str16']),
     setConsoleCtrlHandler: bind(kernel32, 'SetConsoleCtrlHandler', 'int', [PVOID, 'int']),
+    // Console presence. A GUI-subsystem parent (the desktop app launches the
+    // runner through process.execPath, i.e. the Electron image) owns no console,
+    // so a console-subsystem grandchild created under the restricted token
+    // finishes loader initialization without one and dies with 0xC0000142
+    // (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED). user32 is not part of the shared process binding
+    // table, so it is loaded on demand here.
+    getConsoleWindow: bind(kernel32, 'GetConsoleWindow', PVOID, []),
+    allocConsole: bind(kernel32, 'AllocConsole', 'int', []),
+    showWindow: bind(koffi.load('user32.dll'), 'ShowWindow', 'int', [PVOID, 'int']),
     createFileW: bind(kernel32, 'CreateFileW', PVOID, [
       'str16', 'uint32', 'uint32', PVOID, 'uint32', 'uint32', PVOID,
     ]),
diff --git a/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/runner.ts b/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/runner.ts
index 8c67378..f5f3c55 100644
--- a/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/runner.ts
+++ b/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/runner.ts
@@ -49,6 +49,7 @@ import { closeSync, existsSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
 import { join } from 'node:path'
 
 import { win32 } from './ffi.ts'
+import type { Win32Bindings } from './ffi.ts'
 import { AclSandbox, assertTempRootOutsideWorkspace } from './index.ts'
 import { tempWriteSid, workspaceWriteSid } from './workspace-sid.ts'
 
@@ -113,6 +114,38 @@ function requireDirectory(label: string, path: string): void {
   }
 }
 
+/**
+ * Exit code the Windows loader produces when a console-subsystem child cannot
+ * finish DLL initialization (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED).
+ */
+const STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED = 3221225794
+
+/**
+ * Give THIS runner a console before it spawns restricted children.
+ *
+ * The runner is launched through `process.execPath`; in the desktop app that is
+ * the Electron GUI image, which owns no console. A GUI-subsystem parent cannot
+ * donate a console, so the console-subsystem grandchild created with
+ * `CreateProcessAsUserW` reaches the end of loader initialization without one
+ * and dies with `0xC0000142`. Allocating the console inside the runner is the
+ * only variant that was measured to work (2026-10-29): a wrapper process cannot
+ * donate its console to a GUI child, and `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE` /
+ * `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` on the child still die under the restricted token.
+ *
+ * Failure is non-fatal on purpose: a configuration without a console behaves
+ * exactly as it does today, so this can never regress a working setup.
+ * @param api - active ACL/token binding table.
+ * @returns whether a console existed before, and whether one is usable now.
+ */
+function createRunnerConsole(api: Win32Bindings): { hadConsole: boolean; ready: boolean } {
+  const hadConsole = api.getConsoleWindow() !== null
+  if (!hadConsole) api.allocConsole()
+  const window = api.getConsoleWindow()
+  // SW_HIDE (0): the console is an implementation detail, never a UI surface.
+  if (window !== null) api.showWindow(window, 0)
+  return { hadConsole, ready: window !== null }
+}
+
 async function main(): Promise<number> {
   const parsed = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2))
   // Both directories are validated in both modes: a provider bug that passes
@@ -138,6 +171,12 @@ async function main(): Promise<number> {
   if (api.setConsoleCtrlHandler(null, 1) === 0) {
     fail(`SetConsoleCtrlHandler failed (Win32 ${api.getLastError()})`)
   }
+  const consoleState = createRunnerConsole(api)
+  if (!consoleState.ready) {
+    process.stderr.write(
+      `${RUNNER_SIGNATURE}: warning: no console available (hadConsole=${consoleState.hadConsole}); console-subsystem children may exit with 0xC0000142\n`,
+    )
+  }
 
   let ownedTempDir: string | undefined
   let sandbox: AclSandbox | undefined
@@ -187,6 +226,11 @@ async function main(): Promise<number> {
     })
     if (process.env[SUBPROCESS_CONTROL_ENV] === 'pipe') closeSync(SUBPROCESS_CONTROL_FD)
     const result = await child.wait()
+    if (result.exitCode === STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) {
+      process.stderr.write(
+        `${RUNNER_SIGNATURE}: child exited with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED); console=${consoleState.ready ? 'present' : 'absent'}; hint: see README "Console isolation is unavailable"\n`,
+      )
+    }
     return result.exitCode
   } finally {
     // Cleanup failures must not mask the child's exit code: report and keep going.

If a visible console window is unacceptable, an alternative is a dedicated hidden console host plus AttachConsole; AllocConsole + ShowWindow(SW_HIDE) is the shortest path and is what this report verified.
Limits

One machine (Windows 10 19045, single account, one Electron build), no CI from this report.
"No console → 0xC0000142" is measured, not explained at the loader level: no debugger was attached to the dying child.
Generation-2 spawns (a confined child spawning its own child) were not separated between "the intermediate drops the console in its own launch path" and the README:189 "tree carrying another sandbox's package SID" shape. A direct CreateProcessAsUserW call from inside the confined shell would settle it.
I did not test whether a capability SID in the restricting list also lacks read access to System32; that is a different layer and both could be real.

threads.title: Desktop 启动崩溃：本地认证 cookie 按端口堆积，约 70 条后撑爆请求头（附最小修复补丁）
threads.bodyText:
环境



项
值




应用
@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.3（推测其他版本同样存在）


系统
Windows 11 x64


Electron / Node
44.7.0 / 24.21.0


出现频率
高频重启或自动更新后必然出现，重装、覆盖安装均无效



现象
启动阶段直接崩溃弹窗：
The application could not start or stopped unexpectedly.
desktop welcome: Web authentication failed

崩溃日志：
time: 2026-10-28T23:35:36.766Z
source: host
phase: startup
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
    at connectDesktopWelcome (...app.asar/lib/main.js:8886:31)
    at async Object.start (...app.asar/lib/main.js:12195:22)

弹窗里的「禁用第三方插件并重启」无效，排除插件因素；%APPDATA% 不动，所以覆盖安装、重装都无效。
根因
三个事实叠在一起：


Desktop 启动 Host 时把端口写死成随机端口——dsh-desktop-host/lib/index.js：
args: ["--no-open", "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", "0"]


浏览器认证 cookie 的名字由 host:port 推导，dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js：
const COOKIE_PREFIX = "dsh-auth-";
function cookieName(authority) {
    return COOKIE_PREFIX + encodeBase64Url(createHash("sha256").update(authority).digest());
}
默认有效期 cookieMaxAgeDays: 30。端口每次都变，于是每次启动都新增一条 cookie（127.0.0.1、Path=/、30 天），没有任何地方回收它。


lib/main.js 里欢迎页握手用 Electron 的 net.fetch 并 credentials: "include"：
welcomeBackend = await connectDesktopWelcome(ready.url, (input, init) => net.fetch(input, init), ...)
Chromium 会把所有 domain+path 匹配的 cookie 一并塞进 Cookie 头。约 70 条时总长度超过 Node 默认 16 KiB 的请求头上限，Host 返回 431，response.ok 为 false，于是抛出上面那个错误：
const authenticated = await send(authenticatedUrl, { credentials: "include" });
if (!authenticated.ok) throw new Error("desktop welcome: Web authentication failed");


实测崩溃时 Network/Cookies 里有 71 条 host_key = '127.0.0.1' 且 name LIKE 'dsh-auth-%' 的记录。
值得注意：前面的 authenticateWebHost() 用的是 Node 原生 fetch（不带 cookie jar），所以它总是成功；只有走 Chromium cookie jar 的欢迎页握手会挂——这跟崩溃点每次都在 connectDesktopWelcome 完全吻合。
复现
连续启动 70 次左右即可（正常重启、自动更新重启都算）。期间不需要做任何别的操作。
已验证的临时修复
彻底退出 DSH 后执行：
DELETE FROM cookies WHERE host_key = '127.0.0.1' AND name LIKE 'dsh-auth-%';
（对 %APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\Cookies，用 DB Browser for SQLite 打开，记得点「写入更改」。）重启后会自动重新认证，用户数据不丢。
建议修复
最小补丁：在欢迎页握手之前清空 cookie 桶，lib/main.js 第 12196 行那次 connectDesktopWelcome 之前插入一行：
await session.defaultSession.clearStorageData({ storages: ["cookies"] });
重启后第一次请求会重新签发 cookie，所以这一行没有副作用；storages: ["cookies"] 只清 cookie，localStorage / IndexedDB / dsh-platform-* 分区都不受影响。这样 cookie 桶里永远只有本次启动的一条，堆积问题从结构上消失。
其余可选改进，按性价比排序：

只清旧的不清新的：先算出当前 authority 对应的 cookie 名，删掉其余 dsh-auth-*。比清空更保守，适合不想动 cookie 的场合。
退出时清理：应用正常退出时删掉本次端口的 cookie；崩溃退出仍有残留，所以不能只靠这个。
换存储：不要把凭据塞进 Cookie，改用 localStorage / 独立文件 + 自定义 Header，从根上避开 Cookie 的数量和大小限制。
错误提示：捕获 431 时明确提示「认证凭据堆积，请清理本地缓存」，别只抛 Web authentication failed。
更新/卸载：提供清理 Network 目录的选项，避免历史数据干扰新版本。

影响面
这个故障对普通用户来说表现是「装坏了、打不开、重装也没用」，没有任何自救路径，只能等的客服或者删配置文件。而触发条件只是「用得久、重启得多」，不需要做错任何事。

threads.title: [Bug] 两处 Windows 体验问题：盘符根目录无法作为工作区（EPERM mkdir），以及 permission 插件依赖 shell 沙箱导致三档开关整块消失
threads.bodyText:
环境

Windows 11 26H2 (build 10.0.26300)，DSH 桌面端（Electron 打包，profile 在 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop）

Bug 1：无法把盘符根目录（如 D:\）设为工作区
复现：侧边栏「工作区」→ 新建工作区 → 在原生「选择文件夹」对话框里选 D:\ → 确定。
提示（原文）：
新建会话失败：gateway/internal: failed to create session: Error: failed to ensure project directory "D:\": Error: EPERM: operation not permitted, mkdir 'D:\'

原因看起来是新建会话前会对工作区目录做 mkdir -p 式的 ensure；Node 在 Windows 上对盘符根（C:\、D:\、E:\…）递归 mkdir 返回的是 EPERM 而不是 EEXIST，于是被当成失败。
建议：ensure 时先 stat 判断"已存在且是目录"就直接返回，不要对已存在的目录调用 mkdir。这样任何盘符根、系统盘目录都能当工作区。

变通：选盘符下的子目录（如 D:\DDSH-Workspace）可以正常工作。

Bug 2：permission 插件在 pwsh-sandbox 被禁用后整块消失，且没有任何提示
现象：设置里看不到「权限」相关的三档开关（仅可查看 / 工作区内修改 / 完全访问），会话输入框底部也没有权限芯片。
~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml 里禁用了 pwsh-sandbox（本机受限令牌 runner 跑不起来，每个 pwsh 调用都 0xC0000142），注释里写明 permission 必须一并禁用——但实际上：

@deepseek-ai/dsh-permission-presets 只要拿不到 ctx.shell.sandboxMode 就在构造时抛错、fiber 变 failed，于是整个权限 UI 静默消失；
用户完全没有被告知"因为 shell 执行器不可用，所以权限设置不可用"，很容易以为是自己装错了插件。

建议：

permission 在缺少 sandboxMode 时降级为"只读/完全访问"两档或给显式 warning，而不是整体 failed；
或者至少在设置页留一个占位项，写明"当前 shell 执行器不支持沙箱模式，权限档位不可用"。

附带说明
这两个问题都是我在排查另一件事时撞到的，另有 dsh-ops 的一个独立 bug（Windows 受限模式下 ops_bash 恒 0xC0000142）已单独反馈给 T-Auto/dsh-ops：T-Auto/dsh-ops#480

Windows 10: workspace-write sandbox kills every child process with 0xC0000142 (default DACL names a capability SID)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
On Windows 10 22H2 (10.0.19044) every child process started under the workspace-write sandbox dies in DLL initialization with 0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED) and no stdout/stderr, so every agent shell command fails. read-only and danger-full-access are unaffected.
The trigger is the ACE that setTokenDefaultDaclGrant adds to the restricted token's default DACL: when it names the derived capability SID (S-1-4-x-y) instead of a well-known SID, creating the child's image section fails the second access check. Naming the logon SID instead fixes it while keeping workspace confinement.
Environment

Windows 10 Education 10.0.19044 (x64). The sandbox-windows-acl token comments record verification on Win11 26200.
@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.3, Desktop Host (apps/desktop-host), default desktop profile.
Permission preset workspace-write.
pwsh (PowerShell 7) is not installed; the executor falls back to powershell.exe (5.1). The failure is not specific to the target: powershell.exe, cmd.exe and whoami.exe all die the same way.

Reproduction

Start the Desktop app, open a new session (default preset = workspace-write).
Ask the agent to run cmd /c echo hello.
Tool result: (no output) / [exit code: 3221225794].

Evidence from the session store (job/settled events): "detail":"exit code: 3221225794", no stderr. Last known-good run on this machine was 2026-10-28T16:31Z under the same preset — its stderr carried CannotCreateTypeConstrainedLanguage, i.e. the restricted token was in effect and working.
Isolated cause (controlled experiments, same machine, same code)



#
Variant
Created from
Result




1
CreateProcessW + Job + CREATE_SUSPENDED (no sandbox)
plain node
exit 0


2
full subprocess-local runner path (IPC + fd 4/5/6)
plain node
exit 0


3
same
electron-as-node
exit 0


4
AclSandbox read-only token → powershell / cmd
app host process
exit 0


5
AclSandbox workspace-write token (real capability SID) → powershell / cmd / whoami
app host process
0xC0000142


6
workspace-write, default-DACL SID replaced with S-1-5-11
app host process
exit 0


7
workspace-write, real capability SID, cwd = C:\Windows\Temp
app host process
0xC0000142



So: not the Job, not CREATE_SUSPENDED, not stdio inheritance, not cwd, not the workspace ACE/Low label, not administrator/High-IL — it is the capability SID in the default DACL.
One observation we could not explain: the same token built from a plain node process (same user, same integrity level, identical TokenDefaultDacl, identical TokenIntegrityLevel, zero restricting SIDs on the source token) starts children normally; only tokens built inside the Desktop Host fail. We did not isolate whether it is a token property we did not dump (owner/primary group/session/capabilities) or something about the host's process creation. The fix below works regardless, but the mechanism is not fully closed.
Proposed fix (validated end to end)
packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/index.ts, in init():
-      setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid)
+      // The ACE names the LOGON SID (a well-known SID already in the
+      // restricting list), never a derived capability SID (S-1-4-x-y): on
+      // Windows 10 a capability SID in the default DACL makes every child
+      // process die in DLL initialization with 0xC0000142.
+      setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, logonSid)
Why this is safe:

The default DACL only shapes kernel objects the confined process creates without an explicit security descriptor (pipes, events, image sections); file writes take their DACL from the parent directory, so workspace confinement is unchanged.
The logon SID is already in the restricting list, so the pass-2 check that motivated the grant still passes.
It is narrower than read-only, which already grants this ACE to Everyone.
The original intent — never tag default-DACL objects with the shared workspace capability — still holds.

Verified after the change on this machine: cmd /c echo returns exit 0 in a workspace-write session; cmd /c "echo x > C:\Users\...\Desktop\escape.txt" returns access denied and creates nothing; an in-workspace write succeeds.
Questions

Is the capability-SID default DACL intentional, or could it use the logon SID everywhere?
Has this been seen on Windows 10 hosts (the token comments only record Win11 26200)?
Is there any objection to the patch above? We are running it locally; we would be glad to hand over the diff (external PRs are not accepted per CONTRIBUTING, so we are posting here instead).

threads.title: [Bug] Sidebar file tab stays on "file not found" after a transient miss; re-clicking the same link reactivates the stale tab without retrying
threads.bodyText:
Environment
DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3 (dshBuildCommit: be72761ee1a6736ebcdf4f3739363b083ae53c98), Windows 11 zh-CN
Surface: right-hand sidebar document preview (file tabs)
Symptom
A file tab shows "文件不存在，可能已被移动或删除" (file does not exist) even though the file exists on disk. Once the tab is in this failed state, clicking the same file link again only reactivates the stale tab — it does not re-read the file — so the error persists. Closing the tab and clicking the link again opens the file correctly.
Reproduction
Open a file link (reply link, present card, or @ reference) while the file is not yet written — or at the exact moment it is being created/overwritten.
The sidebar tab enters the failed state and shows "文件不存在，可能已被移动或删除".
After the file exists (e.g. the agent finished writing it), click the same link again.
The tab is activated as-is and still shows "文件不存在" — no reload is attempted.
Close the tab, click the link again → opens normally.
Observed twice: once for _dsh_tools_issue-body.md and once for _dsh_tools\20261029-删除free-search-变更记录.md (7,370 B on disk; Test-Path → True while the tab reported missing).
Control experiment (rules out the file name / path)
Two fresh tabs opened on new files both render fine:
删除test-变更记录.md (CJK immediately followed by Latin, same shape as the failing file)
abc-test.md (pure Latin)
So the stale tab, not the path, is the problem.
Code pointers (0.2.1-rc.3 bundle, dsh-client-ui-sidebar-documentpreview/lib/client.js)
TextPreview has autoRefresh and reloadPages / reloadAll (~lines 584-587, 723-749), and a "重新读取文件" control (data-textpreview-reload-now, ~lines 992-1015).
But reusing an existing tab by address does not trigger a reload: openResource appears to activate the tab only, so a tab that failed earlier never recovers.
The failed-frame branch (emptyFailureRecourse) offers retry only in some UI shapes; the screenshot case showed the empty state with no retry entry at all.
Suggested fix
On openResource, if the matched tab is in a failed state, auto-reload it (the existing reload action already covers both text-pages and bytes-complete modes).
Or always render a visible "重试 / Retry" entry in the failed empty state, and let activating the tab trigger it.
Optionally add a filesystem watcher / "retry on activation" so a transient miss heals by itself.

threads.title: Desktop window opens taller than the screen, cutting the bottom of dialogs
threads.bodyText:
On a 1920x1080 display at 100% scaling (work area 1872x1080), DeepSeek Harness Desktop opens its main window at 1888x1208 and does not clamp it to the work area, so the window extends 128 px below the bottom edge of the screen.
Most visible symptom: the Settings modal (760x500, centered in the window) has its lower part clipped, including the Apply/Cancel buttons. The "... More" button in the sidebar footer - the only entry point to Settings - is covered too. Content anchored at the bottom becomes unreachable.
Reproduced on 0.2.0-rc.2 and again after updating to 0.2.1-rc.3, so the update did not fix it.
Notes that may help:

The window is NOT maximized when this happens. Maximizing works around it, because the content area then becomes exactly 1872x1080.
No window geometry seems persisted: Preferences and Local Storage in %APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop contain no width/height/isMaximized data, so the size looks computed at startup.
Expected: clamp the default/restored window size to the current work area (or start maximized), so a 1208 px-tall window is never requested on a 1080 px work area.

Workaround in use: a small background script that maximizes the window whenever it does not fit. Happy to test a fix.

threads.title: Bug + patch: a tall screenshot makes every later turn fail on Messages endpoints (many-image 3000px limit)
threads.bodyText:
Bug report + patch: a full-page screenshot makes every later turn fail on Messages endpoints
Branch with the fix: Jdrg4:fix/llm-deepseek-image-max-dimension (one commit)
Symptom
Once a conversation accumulates a tall screenshot, every later turn fails, even turns that carry no new image:
400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error",
  "message":"messages.9.content.88.image.source.base64.data: At least one of the
  image dimensions exceed max allowed size for many-image requests: 3000 pixels"}}

The whole turn is lost; the conversation cannot continue without dropping the history. It reproduces with the screenshots an agent takes itself: a 390×6400 or 520×6400 full-page capture.
Root cause
packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/request-pricing.ts caps every request image at one per-side limit:
export const REQUEST_IMAGE_MAX_DIMENSION = 4096
That is the DeepSeek endpoint's many-image limit. Anthropic's Messages API caps many-image requests at 3000 pixels per side and rejects the whole request over one oversized image, so any target the adapter projects above 3000 is a request the endpoint must refuse.
Measured with the current projection (no API key needed, resolveRequestImageTarget):



Source
Token-grid projection
Target sent today (cap 4096)
With a 3000 limit




1440×3900
755×2044
755×2044
755×2044


520×6400
336×4130
333×4096 ← rejected
244×3000


390×6400
293×4816
250×4096 ← rejected
183×3000



The grid already shrinks a wide capture below the limit; a tall one (a full-page mobile screenshot) projects above 3000 and the 4096 cap leaves it there. That is why the failure appears only after some captures, and then poisons every later turn.
The per-side limit is also the only image limit that is not per model — imagePixelBudget and imageMaxBytes are already per catalog entry.
Patch
Image-capable catalog entries may declare imageMaxDimension; omission keeps 4096, so DeepSeek routes and every existing configuration are unchanged.

types.ts — imageMaxDimension?: number on DeepSeekCatalogModel.
request-pricing.ts — resolveRequestImageMaxDimension(model) beside resolveRequestImageMaxBytes; resolveRequestImageTarget uses it.
config.ts — schema field, resolution into the validated connection (?? REQUEST_IMAGE_MAX_DIMENSION), and the same guard as imageMaxBytes (positive safe integer, rejected on a text-only entry).
README.md / README.zh.md / README.i18n.yaml — document the field, including that Anthropic's Messages API needs 3000.
Tests: the projection honours a model's own limit, keeps 4096 when none is declared, and rejects invalid values.

With models: [{ id: 'claude-…', inputModalities: ['text', 'image'], imageMaxDimension: 3000 }], a 390×6400 capture is projected to 183×3000 and the request succeeds.
Verification
pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts \
  packages/llm/llm-deepseek/tests/request-pricing.spec.ts \
  packages/llm/llm-deepseek/tests/runtime.spec.ts
  → 2 files, 176 tests passed

pnpm exec tsc -b packages/llm/llm-deepseek/tsconfig.json      → clean
pnpm exec oxlint packages/llm/llm-deepseek/{src,tests}         → 0 warnings, 0 errors
pnpm run verify-translation-pairing <README.md>                → consistent (hashes re-recorded)
pnpm run verify-doc-refs                                       → 4659 files, all references resolve
pnpm run verify-export-jsdoc                                   → every exported name documented

Not run: test:coverage (repo-wide gate) and build. The change adds no dependency and no public export beyond the catalog field.
Question for the maintainers
Is a per-model field the shape you want, or would you rather a connection-level field (one Messages endpoint, one limit) or a different default for Messages-compatible endpoints? I can reshape the patch either way — it is one commit.
I did not open a pull request: CONTRIBUTING.md states the project cannot accept external pull requests at the moment, and the repository has Issues disabled, so there is no issue for a PR description to reference. This report is the contribution; the branch is ready to cherry-pick if you want it.

threads.title: 桌面端 0.2.1-rc.5：宿主空闲时 system-prompt assemble 循环打满单核，新会话等 18 秒 / Failed to fetch
threads.bodyText:
环境

桌面端 @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.5（win32 x64 / electron 44.7.0 / node 24.21.0）
桌面 profile 里 15 个第三方 bundle + 1 个 stdio MCP（chrome-devtools），工具目录实测 81 个 / 70,480 字节

现象
宿主（Desktop Host 子进程）在完全空闲时仍然持续占满一个 CPU 核，工作集以约 4MB/s 增长（实测 6 分钟从 2.77GB 涨到 4.11GB，另一实例到 1.70GB）。
空闲的判据是三条同时成立：宿主监听端口上 Get-NetTCPConnection 计数为 0；~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v4.jsonl.zstd 一字节不增长；没有任何模型回合。
后果是本地 HTTP 服务排队，界面表现为「点新对话要等很久才出现」和「新建会话失败: Failed to fetch」：



请求
实测耗时




不带任何凭据的 GET /（本该几毫秒返回 401）
冷启动 2 分钟后 18.7 秒；另一实例 3.9 秒


GET /api/health
8 秒、15 秒两次超时未返回



归因
V8 堆采样（36 秒窗口，samplingInterval: 4096）显示该窗口共分配 175MB，其中 143MB（82%）落在 @deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt 的 assemble()，顶帧即 assemble。按每次组装约 250KB 内存对象折算，相当于每秒十几次完整组装，且没有外部触发源。
想请宿主侧处理的两点
1) assemble() 每次调用都 structuredClone 全部工具的 JSON schema（收集 assembly.tools 的那段，对每个 schema 做 parameters: structuredClone(parameters)）。工具目录 81 个 / 70KB 时这一步就是数百 KB 的同步分配，直接卡住事件循环。建议缓存未变化 provider 的克隆结果，或改成惰性/共享只读。
2) system-prompt/assemble 这条 waterfall 没有重入保护。 插件在 system-prompt/assemble 钩子内部再调 prompt.assemble(context)（这是钩子里拿「新鲜公开组装」的常规写法）会把整条链从头再跑一遍，包括所有同类钩子。多个插件各自这样重入时，只要有一方的状态在「清理 → 重新发布」之间来回，就会自持成环，且没有任何深度上限、也没有可诊断的告警——现场只看到进程静默空转。建议加重入深度上限或把重入排期到本轮组装之后，超限时给出明确告警。
复现/观察方法

起桌面端，用 Get-NetTCPConnection -OwningProcess <hostPid> 找到宿主在 127.0.0.1 上的监听端口。
不带 cookie 打 GET /，计时。正常应是毫秒级 401。
同时看宿主进程 CPU 时间增量与墙钟增量之比，以及 ~/.dsh/memory-watchdog/plugin-memory.json 里 windows[].packages 的按包分配归因。

工具链：@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt、@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm、@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl。
与已有条目的区别

#10633（General，2026-10-22）是同一症状的无诊断报告，本条补齐归因与量化数据。
#10873 的 "Failed to fetch" 根因是 hop-by-hop 请求头透传给 Node fetch（UND_ERR_INVALID_ARG），与本条不同：本条宿主仍能返回 401，只是要 4–19 秒，且空闲即发生。

涉及包：@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt、@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm、@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl。

threads.title: todo: 会话结束后任务清单停留在最后一次快照，UI 仍显示「1 进行中 · 8 待处理」
threads.bodyText:
Summary
会话已正常结束（turn/end，reason.kind = completed），但 Web GUI 输入框上方的「任务」面板仍显示 1 进行中 · 8 待处理，与实际已交付的结果不符。排查后确认：投影与 UI 没有丢更新，面板忠实渲染了日志中唯一一次 todo_write 的快照；问题在于宿主没有任何「回合结束前收尾清单」的保障——既不在 turn/end 时提醒模型更新，系统提示也没有要求模型维护清单，UI 又会把 in_progress 当作正在运行的状态持续展示。
这属于模型行为与宿主契约之间的缺口：模型违反 todo_write 工具描述里的 "Mark each todo completed as soon as it is done."，而宿主没有兜底，用户看到的进度长期停留在开头。希望维护者判断修复应落在「回合结束前的收尾提醒」还是「UI 会话结束后的标注」，两者都可以，但当前的组合会稳定产出误导性状态。
Reproduction
方式一：GUI 手动复现（本 issue 的实际来源）

在 Web GUI 中发起一个多步任务（本次为「统计 DSH 历史会话 token 消耗并出看板/Excel/MD」）。
模型在第 5 步调用一次 todo_write，写入 9 项计划（1 项 in_progress + 8 项 pending），随后开始执行。
模型继续完成全部工作（该轮后续：edit ×106、write ×44、subagent ×3、pwsh ×136），全程未再调用 todo_write。
回合正常结束（turn/end，completed）。
重新打开该会话：面板仍是 1 进行中 · 8 待处理，9 项状态与第 2 步逐字相同。

方式二：确定性复现（会话日志回放）
解压 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\sessions\<workspace-hash>\session-<id>\session.v4.jsonl.zstd（注意是多帧 zstd，Node 的 zstdDecompressSync 只能解第一帧，需用 7-Zip 或流式逐帧解码），统计事件后得到：



事件
出现次数
seq
时间（UTC+8）




todo/write
1
1220
2026-10-30 08:35:57


turn/start
3
1220 之前最后一次为 turn 3 开始
2026-10-30 08:34:39


turn/end
3
1887（turn 3，completed）
2026-10-30 08:53:29




seq 1220 之后再无 turn/start，也就是没有新一轮开始去清空清单；
seq 1220 → 1887 之间共 111 步，无任何 todo/write。

方式三：现有单测已把该行为固定下来
packages/todo/tool-todo/tests/projection.spec.ts:87：
it('clears the standing plan on the next turn/start (turn/end keeps it)', async () => {
  ...
  session.append('todo/write', { todos: list })
  session.append('turn/end', { turn: 1, reason: { kind: 'completed' } })
  expect((await bench.tailProjections())?.values.todos).toEqual(list) // 现阶段即为「保留」
})
即当前实现与测试都明确：turn/end 保留清单，只有下一次 turn/start 才置 null。若认可本 issue，需要新增期望行为（提醒/标注），而不是修改这条断言。
Current behavior

投影规则（packages/todo/tool-todo/src/index.ts:124-135）：

todo/write → 整体替换列表；
turn/start → null（清空）；
turn/end → 保持，源码注释为 turn/end keeps the finished checklist visible。


宿主无收尾逻辑：turn/end 路径不会检查是否仍有 pending / in_progress，也不会要求模型补一次 todo_write。
系统提示无 todo 要求：默认 standard preset 的 persona 与 system prompt 中检索不到 todo 相关指导，清单维护完全依赖工具 description。
UI 只读投影（packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/TodoPanel.tsx:107）：useProjection('todos')，按投影原样渲染；in_progress 映射为 ongoing 状态点（TodoPanel.tsx:30-38），头部计数为 1 进行中 · 8 待处理（TodoPanel.tsx:52-63）。
排除丢更新：%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\storages\session_projcache\sessions\session-<id>.json 中 todos 的 val 与该快照逐字一致（asOfSeq 为末尾 seq），说明 host 投影、持久化缓存、客户端三处一致，纯属「最后快照本来就是这样」。

用户可见症状：会话结束、产物已交付、模型回复已给出结论，但计划面板仍停在「1 进行中」；打开历史会话时该误导性状态会长期保留（只有下一轮对话开始才会消失）。
Expected behavior
建议在以下方案中选择（不应由宿主静默改写模型提交的状态）：

回合收尾提醒（推荐）：turn/end 前若清单仍有 pending / in_progress，向模型注入一次轻量提醒（例如 "Your todo list still has N unfinished items; update it before finishing"），由模型自己决定重写清单还是说明原因。这样既保留"模型拥有清单"的语义，又给用户一个自洽的终态。
UI 终态标注（补充）：会话已结束（最后一条 turn/end）时，面板头部标注「清单为最后一次更新 / 未自动收尾」，或把 in_progress 的状态点改为中性色，避免"进行中"被读成"正在执行"。
不建议：在 turn/end 自动把未完成项置 completed——那等于伪造模型没有提交过的状态，会污染回放与投影缓存。

期望的验收行为（任一方案落地后）：

一个模型只在回合开头写过 todo_write、之后不再更新的会话，结束后不应再向用户呈现"仍在进行中"；
投影仍保持"最后快照"语义，回放结果不变；
turn/start 清空清单的现有行为不变。

Environment

DSH 0.2.2-alpha.2（@deepseek-ai/dsh-root / @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo 同为该版本）
Windows 11（-Command 调用 pwsh），Node v24.21.0
Web GUI（conversation.input.dock 的 todo dock）
会话格式 v4（session.v4.jsonl.zstd，多帧 zstd）
模型 deepseek-flash（reasoningEffort: high），standard agent preset
该会话 3 轮共 311 步；问题轮为 turn 3（111 步）

Additional context
相关源码

packages/todo/tool-todo/src/index.ts:124-135 —— todos 投影：todo/write 覆盖、turn/start 清空、turn/end 保留
packages/todo/tool-todo/src/index.ts:193-211 —— todo_write 执行体：由模型主动调用才会产生 todo/write 事件
packages/todo/tool-todo/tests/projection.spec.ts:87-100 —— 现有测试即断言「turn/end 保留」
packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/TodoPanel.tsx:52-63,107 —— 计数文案与投影读取
packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/locales.ts —— todo.progress.active = {active} 进行中、todo.progress.pending = {pending} 待处理

脱敏后的会话证据（节选）
# 唯一一次清单写入
seq 1220  2026-10-30T00:35:57Z  todo/write  turn=3 step=5
  [ {探测运行环境…, in_progress}, {编写 _.dsh 管线…, pending}, … 共 9 项，1 in_progress + 8 pending ]

# 回合结束，此后无 todo/write、无新的 turn/start
seq 1887  2026-10-30T00:53:29Z  turn/end  { turn: 3, reason: { kind: 'completed' } }
seq 1890  2026-10-30T02:15:57Z  session/end-seed

该轮工具调用统计（同一份日志）：pwsh 136、edit 106、write 44、read 24、subagent 3、present 3、todo_write 1。
影响面

用户侧：长任务的计划面板不可信，无法用于判断进度/交接；
一致性：会话已 completed，UI 仍显示 ongoing 状态点，两者语义冲突；
复现稳定性：只要模型在长回合中漏更新（长任务、被 compaction 打断、收尾步骤多时更易发生），就一定出现，与具体结果正确性无关。

可选复现脚本
如需在 CI 中固定该场景，可基于 packages/todo/tool-todo/tests/projection.spec.ts 的 harness，追加：写一次带 pending 的清单 → 追加 turn/end（completed）→ 断言投影仍含未完成项（当前实现），并按选定方案断言新的收尾行为。

threads.title: [Bug] ask_user_question renders TeX literally in the question title and option labels — only question.detail is wired to MarkdownText
threads.bodyText:
Summary
In the built-in ask_user_question card, four text fields come from the model, but only one of them is routed through the Markdown renderer.

question.detail is rendered with MarkdownText (GFM + KaTeX), and math displays correctly.
question.header, question.question, option.label and option.description are rendered as plain-text React children, so LaTeX source reaches the UI verbatim.

The result is that a question like "What are the eigenvalues of $A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 0 \ 0 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$?" is displayed as the literal character sequence $A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 \end{pmatrix}$ inside an h2, and an option reading "2 and 3, from $\det(A - \lambda I) = 0$" is displayed as literal source inside the option row.
The scope is narrow, but the timing is the worst possible one: whenever a model writes math into a question prompt or an option label — the natural thing to do for math, physics, engineering, statistics or any quantitative task — the card becomes unreadable at exactly the moment the user is required to choose. The same text in the conversation body renders perfectly, so the failure is inconsistent within a single turn: the assistant explains the problem with beautiful typeset math, then presents the question about that math as raw TeX.
Reproduction
Ask the agent to call ask_user_question with TeX in question.question and in option.label:
{
  "question": {
    "header": "Eigenvalues",
    "question": "What are the eigenvalues of $A = \\begin{pmatrix} 2 & 0 \\\\ 0 & 3 \\end{pmatrix}$?",
    "options": [
      { "label": "2 and 3, from $\\det(A - \\lambda I) = 0$" },
      { "label": "0 and 5" }
    ]
  }
}
Then read the card:

If question.detail is also provided, that field renders as typeset math.
question.question renders the raw TeX source.
The option label renders the raw TeX source.

No configuration, no third-party plugin, no non-default profile — this reproduces on a stock install of the desktop app with the bundled composer.
Current behavior
Call sites in @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions:



Field
Render path
Result




question.detail
jsx(MarkdownText, { text: question.detail, labels: markdownLabels })
GFM + KaTeX ✅


question.question

jsx("h2", { className: clsx(css.title, css.titlePreview), id: question-${pending.key}-${String(index)}, children: question.question })

literal text ❌


option.label
jsx("span", { className: css.optionLabel, children: display.label })
literal text ❌


option.description
plain-text child
literal text ❌



Verified on 0.2.1-rc.3, and unchanged in the newest published build, 0.2.2-alpha.2 (published 2026-10-27): the title and option call sites are identical to the older build; only detail is wired to MarkdownText. (dist-tags at the time of writing: latest = 0.0.1-rc.3, next = 0.2.1-rc.5, alpha = 0.2.2-alpha.2.)
Two secondary effects worth mentioning because they make the failure look like data corruption rather than missing rendering:

option.label is first passed through parseRecommendedLabel, which strips a trailing (recommended) / （推荐） suffix. So the string that finally gets rendered may already differ from what the model emitted, and then the remaining TeX is displayed verbatim on top of that.
The card's height is driven by the rendered text. A long question with several display equations inside h2 becomes a very tall, unbreakable block of source text, which is noticeably worse than in the conversation body where the same content wraps normally.

Expected behavior
The same text should render the same way everywhere in the card. Everything MarkdownText already supports for question.detail and for the conversation body — GFM plus inline $…$, display $$…$$, and also \(…\) / \[…\] if those are supported there — should apply to question.question and option.label as well, and ideally to option.description.
Two constraints need an explicit decision, because neither is an implementation detail:

Phrasing content. h2 and the option span may only contain phrasing content. MarkdownText emits block-level wrappers (div / p), and display math adds a .katex-display wrapper. Routing the raw output into the current elements would therefore produce invalid nesting. Either MarkdownText needs an inline rendering mode for these two hosts, or the host element has to change — for example h2 becoming a div that carries the heading role and is referenced by aria-labelledby, since the card already gives each question an id.
"Verbatim" appears to be intentional. The README states that question and option text "arrives from the model and renders verbatim", and a test asserts it ("The model's question text renders verbatim — no marker filtering"). The evident intent is do not strip or rewrite what the model wrote, which is fully compatible with parsing TeX for display. It would help to record the change as an intentional one so a later reader does not treat it as a regression.

Questions I would rather ask than assume

Is question.header meant to stay plain by design? It is a short label, so I can see an argument for that.
Are option.label / option.description kept verbatim deliberately for aria-label stability? If so, the minimal ask shrinks to question.question + option.label, which is where the math actually hurts.
Is there a preferred direction for the phrasing-content problem — an inline mode in MarkdownText, or a host-element change in the composer? I do not want to propose a specific patch before hearing which side of that boundary you would rather move.

Environment

DeepSeek Harness desktop, built-in @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions
reproduced on 0.2.1-rc.3; still present in 0.2.2-alpha.2
Windows 11, default profile, no third-party plugins installed
The model side is not involved: the tool payload contains the correct TeX; only the composer's rendering differs per field.

Additional context
The same call sites were reported for the desktop composer in anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop#1023, which documents the general case — markdown markers in question / option.description rendered as literals — together with its provenance (the README line and the test comment quoted above). That report does not mention KaTeX specifically; this post is the math instance of it, filed upstream because the durable fix belongs in the composer package rather than in a downstream shell.
A distinct but related report exists for the message body: anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop#1350, where two currency $ signs in prose are paired as a single inline math span, because parseGfmWithMath does not pass { singleDollarTextMath: false } to micromark-extension-math. The root cause is different, but it is directly relevant to how this one should be fixed: switching single-$ parsing on naively would give the card the same complaint. An inline rule that requires $ to be followed by a non-space, to be non-greedy, not to end on a space, and not to be followed by a digit keeps "priced at $5 and $10" out of math while still covering the real cases. Probably worth deciding together rather than inheriting the issue.
I am happy to test a candidate build against a set of math-in-question fixtures if that is useful.

threads.title: [Bug?] Phantom user messages reach model context with future timestamps (never persisted)
threads.bodyText:
What happens
Twice in one session, user messages appeared in the model's input that the user
never typed: duplicated up to ~12 times, some of them empty, with timestamps
~21 minutes ahead of wall clock. None of them was written to disk.

2026-10-29 00:16-00:17 (+11:00): ~12 copies of one short message plus several
empty payloads.
2026-10-30 23:15:18 / 23:15:26 / 23:15:33 (+11:00): 3 further messages, same
shape, different content.

Content is redacted (personal); both batches were ordinary short user messages
in Chinese.
Environment
dsh 0.2.1-rc.2, desktop app on Windows, desktop profile, web GUI on 127.0.0.1
(loopback), model deepseek-flash.
What I already ruled out

Session log: no event carries those timestamps; no future-dated event exists.
Projection cache, GUI localStorage / leveldb: the phrases are absent.
Full-store search: the text appears only inside assistant replies.
Server side: exactly 3 legitimate user submits per window, each rpcId once;
no error / retry / timeout / abort.
Host clock: accurate within 1-3s against three external sources; NTP running.

Code-level notes (review of the packaged dsh/ tree)

The inbox cannot deliver without committing. mutate() appends
agent/inbox/spliced (dsh-agent-loop L204) and claim() (L103-110) goes
through it; the frequent {"removedCount":1,"inserted":[]} splices are just
claim traces.
Model input != inbox. preStep() (L902-927) runs the agent/pre-step
waterfall (L909), where plugins may rewrite decision.messages - the only
path by which content reaches the model without a session event. This profile
has no third-party plugin installed.
Client time never reaches the model. beginSubmission() stores
Date.now() only in pendingSubmissions (local echo; snapshot L816);
prompt() (L186-192) sends {requestId, sessionId, mode, content, clientTimeZone} with no time field. Message time is written server-side.
So the earlier "uncommitted delivery" hypothesis does not hold.

Remaining possibilities
(a) the text reached the model through a non-inbox path, or (b) a local-echo
rendering was misread as a committed submission. These cannot be distinguished
from outside.
What I would like to know

Is there any path where agent/pre-step injection could duplicate user text?
Can a local-echo bubble (client clock) ever end up inside a turn's input?
Is there a supported way to log inbox / pre-step assembly without persisting
content?

Session id and untruncated evidence can be provided privately.

Session log becomes unreadable: compaction summary shadows the protected system head (0.2.1-rc.2, still on rc.5)
threads.bodyText:
中文标题：会话日志不可读——compaction 摘要折叠了「受保护的系统提示头」EN (short): On 0.2.1-rc.2 (still reproducible as of the latest tags, dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5 / dsh-v0.2.2-alpha.2), after a mid-session system-prompt update, compaction/summary events include the protected first system/message in shadowedSeqs. The persistence reader then rejects the whole log (compaction cannot shadow the protected system head), so the session becomes unreadable or silently disappears. Writer (dsh-compaction-basic) and reader (dsh-session-persistence-jsonl) use two different definitions of "head" — positional vs. identity. Decisive signal: a healthy session's first summary starts at shadowedRange.start = 9 while the protected head is seq = 8; a broken one starts at 8. Once broken, every subsequent compaction reproduces it (measured 100% over 33–126 compactions), so rewriting spans only restores readability until the next compaction.环境
项 | 值
-- | --
DSH | 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.2（nightly 通道，app.asar 2026-10-17）
关键包 | @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic@0.2.1-rc.2、@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl@0.2.1-rc.2、dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3 / v3-to-v4@0.2.1-rc.2
OS | Windows 11 x64
模型 | deepseek-flash（1M 上下文）
自定义插件 | 有若干第三方插件，但 compaction / persistence 均为官方原版，未打补丁
日志格式 | session.v4.jsonl.zstd（zstd 多帧）
修复后又继续对话的会话，逐段统计都是 100%（「新增压缩数 = 新增违规数」）：代码块备份A  52 摘要 / 52 违规
备份B  65 摘要 / 13 违规   ← 新增 13 次压缩，13 次违规
备份C 105 摘要 / 40 违规   ← 新增 40 次压缩，40 次违规
当前   133 摘要 / 33 违规   ← 新增 33 次压缩，33 次违规决定性证据：start = 9 vs start = 8同一台机器上，没有中招的会话与中招的会话，首个 compaction/summary 只差一位：代码块正常会话   protectedHead seq = 8   首个 summary: shadowedRange.start = 9   （头被正确排除）
中招会话   protectedHead seq = 8   首个 summary: shadowedRange.start = 8   （头被卷进 span）这说明写端在「surface[0] 是 system/message」时的 firstIdx = 1 判定，在系统提示被重写后失效， 退回 firstIdx = 0，于是 span 起点从 8 开始，正好压住被保护的头。 这是一个 1 位的偏差，复现面极小，也很容易做成单测。另外观察到：并非所有会话都会中招。只在会话中途改过工作区规则文件（AGENTS.md 等）、 导致宿主注入新的 system/message 的会话，才会从 9 掉到 8。复现步骤开一个长会话（足够触发自动压缩，>阈值）；在会话进行中修改工作区规则文件（如 AGENTS.md），使宿主注入系统提示更新 （日志里出现新的 system/message，带 Updated instructions from: …）；继续对话直到下一次自动压缩；重启 DSH / 重新打开该会话 → 报上述 SessionFormatError。实际：新写出的 compaction/summary 的 shadowedRange.start 等于最早那个 system/message 的 seq。 期望：任何 compaction 都不应折叠受保护的系统提示头，或读端应接受这种历史。源码分析（基于 0.2.1-rc.2）写端：@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.jsjsconst firstIdx = systemHead(session, surfaceNodes[0]) === void 0 ? 0 : 1;
...
return { start: surfaceNodes[firstIdx], end: surfaceNodes[keepFromIdx - 1] };systemHead() 只在「surface 第 0 个节点是 system/message」时返回该事件。也就是说写端认为 「surface 首位是 system/message → 跳过它」，其余情况从第 0 个节点开始压缩。读端：@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/worker.cjsjsfoldSurface(event) {
  ...
  if (event.type === "system/message" && this.surface.length === 0) this.protectedHead = event.seq;
  ...
}

// 校验 compaction/summary
if (this.protectedHead !== void 0 && seqs.includes(this.protectedHead))
  throw new SessionFormatError("compaction cannot shadow the protected system head");读端保护的是「最初开启 surface 的那个 system/message」，与它现在位于 surface 的第几位无关。分叉点两者只在「会话中途追加了新的 system/message」时产生分歧：写端按位置判断（第 0 位）， 读端按身份判断（最早那个）。一旦新头插入/替换，写端算出的 span 就会重新覆盖旧头，读端整份拒收。同一句错误文案还出现在 dsh-session-format-v2-to-v3 与 dsh-session-format-v3-to-v4 两个迁移包里， 说明该不变式在读取侧有三处实现——修复时三处需要一起看。已排除的其它因素不是阈值设置：曾把 thresholdRatio 设为 0.2 后移除（回到默认 0.8），移除后损坏继续发生； 阈值只改变压缩频率，不改变 span 计算。不是插件/本地补丁：四个关键包版本一致、app.asar 自安装日未变、compaction 与 persistence 无本地改动。不是日志写坏/截断：帧结构完整、逐帧可解、seq 连续；只有 span 语义非法。不是进程崩溃：系统 CrashDumps 无 DSH 转储；是读取端拒绝，不是进程退出。不是磁盘/内存故障：三块盘 SMART 均 Healthy。建议修法（首选）统一「头」的定义放在写端：selectCompactableRange 不要用「surface[0] 是否 system/message」 推断头，而应取持久化层认定的 protectedHead（或让 session 暴露该值），并保证 span 起点跳过所有 system/message 节点。（次选）替换头时同步语义：当会话中途追加新的 system/message 时，明确「哪个是要保护的头」， 写端与读端共用同一判定。（兜底，独立于上面）读端不要静默丢会话：listArtifacts 遇到该错误时至少把会话列出来并标记损坏， 现在静默 continue 会让人以为历史被删除。建议加一条单测：构造「session 中途追加 system/message」的 surface，断言首个 summary 的 shadowedRange.start 必须严格大于 protectedHead（当前实现在这里会得到 ==）。临时规避（供其他用户参考）需要改 AGENTS.md / 工作区规则时，先开新会话再改，避免在长会话中途触发系统提示重写；会话到 1 500 事件左右就换新会话；已损坏的日志可机械修复：把违规 compaction/summary 的 shadowedSeqs 中受保护头那一项移除， 并把 shadowedRange.start 改为下一个节点（span 仍连续，其余事件不动）。本机用脚本对多个会话 做了此修复，均通过 restoreReleasedV4Artifact 严格校验；但下一次压缩仍会再写坏， 所以这只是把历史救回可读，不是根治。
