Bug: 未捕获的 .kind 裸读导致 turn 以 UNKNOWN 失败（reason 可为 null/undefined）
threads.bodyText:
Bug report: turn/end 的 reason 为 undefined 时，多处监听器裸读 .kind 导致整轮失败
目标版本：@deepseek-ai/* 0.2.1-rc.5（DeepSeek Harness Desktop，macOS）
仓库：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
报告日期：2026-10-31
证据来源：本机 ~/.dsh/sessions/ 下 340 个会话日志（统计时共 1813 条 turn/end），
以及 /Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar 中经 sha256 校验的源码。

摘要
会话的某一轮结束后，界面只显示一行失败：
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')

code 为 UNKNOWN。这不是模型或网络问题：它是 turn/end 事件上 .kind 的裸解引用
（前面任何一段可能是 undefined），在进程内抛出的 TypeError 被 agent loop 捕获，
再以 {kind: "error", error: {message, code: "UNKNOWN"}} 记进日志。
本机历史上发生 10 次，涉及 5 个会话。一旦某个会话触发，后续轮次会持续失败：
session-f7217f05 从 turn 11 连续崩到 turn 14，四轮全挂。会话不会自我恢复。

复现到的部分
1. 代码扫描：6 个独立位置存在同样的裸读
判据：.kind 之前的一段路径可能是 undefined。



#
包
文件:行
代码




1
dsh-goal-round-driver
lib/index.js:274
if (event.data.reason.kind === "max-tokens") {


2
dsh-goal-round-driver
lib/index.js:278
if (event.data.reason.kind !== "aborted") return;


3
dsh-session-telemetry
lib/index.js:224
case "turn/end": return event.data.reason.kind === "error" ? "error" : "info";


4
dsh-subagent
lib/index.js:226
switch (end?.data.reason.kind) { ← ?. 只护了最外层


5
dsh-subagent
lib/index.js:2668
lastTurnCompleted: event.data.reason.kind === "completed"


6
dsh-agent
lib/index.js:63 与 lib/types/consumed-work.js:24
function accountsForClaim(reason) { switch (reason.kind) {



第 6 项在两份产物里各出现一次，是同一个缺陷。
复现命令（本机使用；gates/test_turn_reason_guard.py 是本地脚手架，不入本报告所属仓库）：
python3 gates/test_turn_reason_guard.py <上述 5 个文件>
→ REASON-GUARD-FAIL 7 处裸读 turn/end 的 reason

2. 机制：turn/end 的 reason 允许为空
dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js 的 turn 收尾：
let turnEnds = null;                                          // 951
...
} catch (error) {                                             // 1011
    turnEnds = { kind: "error", error: error instanceof LlmError ? error.failure : {
        message: errorChain(error), code: "UNKNOWN" } };      // 1020-1026
} finally {
    this.session.append("turn/end", { turn, reason: turnEnds });  // 1028-1032
}
step() 存在一条 return concluded ? { kind: "completed" } : null; —— concluded 为假时返回
null，随后被赋给 turnEnds。reason 因此可以为 null，而所有读 reason.kind
的地方都没有考虑这种情况。
已用最小复现确认：把 accountsForClaim / foldConsumedWork 原样抽出，喂入
turn/start → 认领(removedCount:1) → turn/end 缺 reason 的事件序列，得到与线上完全相同的
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')。
3. 真实失败分布



会话
崩溃轮次




session-1905fd5d-8797-4e39-b…
turn 1、2


session-567a0e1b-14e1-422d-8…
turn 1


session-1e2d2d0f-9ca3-4d58-a…
turn 6


session-63df0969-1efa-404a-a…
turn 24、25


session-f7217f05-141c-4b17-b…
turn 11、12、13、14



10 次失败的消息字面完全一致：Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')。

尚未定位的部分（如实说明）
具体是哪一处抛出，未能确定。
已经排除的候选，都附判据：

dsh-goal-round-driver：session/event 监听只在 turn/end 分支读 reason.kind；而崩溃轮的输入
来源是 user 与 tool-jobs，不是 goal 轮次，第 274 行在该路径上未被调用。
dsh-session-telemetry：captureEvent 包在 contain() 内，其实现是
try { step() } catch (e) { this.ctx.logger.warn(...) }，异常被吞掉，不会让整轮失败。
格式迁移 dsh-session-format-v0-to-v1：normalizeLegacyTurnEnd 先经
releasedV0Record() 校验，不匹配时抛 malformedLegacy，不是 TypeError。

一个尚未解释的矛盾：现场 10 次全部是 "undefined"，而按 turnEnds = null 的路径应报
"null"。两者不一致，说明 reason 是在到达监听器之前就被置空的，而不是本文件里
let turnEnds = null 这条赋值造成的。这一点是推断，未实跑。

建议的修复方向
任选其一，二者不冲突：

统一加可选链：把上述 6 处改为 event.data.reason?.kind、end?.data?.reason?.kind、
reason?.kind。这是最小改动，单独即可消除崩溃。
在源头拒绝空 reason：agent loop 的 finally 里，若 turnEnds == null 则回落为
{ kind: "error", error: { message: "turn ended without a recorded reason", code: "UNKNOWN" } }，
并在 turn/end 的类型定义里把 reason 标成不可空。这样任何新增的监听器都不会再踩到。

建议 1 和 2 一起做：脚本侧兜底，类型侧收口。

附加观察（同批会话，未合并进本问题）
同一批日志里还有两类 UNKNOWN 失败，与本 report 的 .kind 问题无关，单列备查：

next is not a function × 3（session-2d2c8398 等），发生在 workspace/changes 之后
cannot get property "workingDirectory" without inject × 2

出现位置提示是插件钩子链问题，需要单独排查。

threads.title: [Bug] dsh account: GET /auth-api/v0/users/current returns 403 (CloudFront WAF) for the official client's default User-Agent - profile reads fail silently
threads.bodyText:
Summary
Every account profile read from the official dsh client fails at the CDN edge with 403, and the plugin degrades silently ({status: 'failed'}) so the account panel never loads.

dsh version: 0.2.1-rc.2 (@deepseek-ai/dsh-deepseek-account-platform)
Verified NOT fixed upstream: protocol.js and index.js are byte-identical between 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.5
Log symptom (verbatim, non-secret): [deepseek-account] request failed { path: '/auth-api/v0/users/current', status: 403, errorCode: 'network' }
Local volume: 471 occurrences across 83 log files over 13 days (2026-10-18 -> 2026-10-30)

Reproduction (live probes, 2026-10-30, Node v24 fetch)



Request to https://platform.deepseek.com
Result




GET /auth-api/v0/users/current with no User-Agent (client default)
403 - CloudFront HTML "Request blocked", x-cache: Error from cloudfront


Same with user-agent: node or user-agent: undici
403


Same with Chrome 131 browser User-Agent
202 + x-amz-waf-action: challenge, empty body, no set-cookie (JS challenge cannot be solved outside a browser)


Same with full browser header set (sec-ch-ua, sec-fetch-*, referer, origin)
still 202 challenge, empty body


GET /api/v0/users/get_user_summary with default UA (same host)
200 (reaches origin) -> WAF rule appears scoped to /auth-api/* GETs


POST /auth-api/v0/dsh/auth_init and auth_exchange with default UA
422 (reaches origin, body validation) -> sign-in flow unaffected


GET https://api.deepseek.com/models with default UA
401 (normal auth) -> inference origin unaffected



Impact

Account panel (profile name/avatar) silently fails on every read: readAccountDetail maps the network error to {status: 'failed'}.
No impact on sign-in (POST endpoints pass the WAF) or on inference (api.deepseek.com unaffected).

Workaround tried
Adding a browser User-Agent via the plugin's requestHeaders config still receives the 202 JS challenge with an empty body, which fetch cannot solve (no cookie issued). So a config-only workaround is not sufficient.
Ask

Please send a browser-acceptable User-Agent from dsh-deepseek-account-platform by default, and/or
Exempt the official DSH client in the CloudFront/AWS WAF rule for /auth-api/* GETs.

Environment: Windows 10, Node.js v24, dsh 0.2.1-rc.2, reproduced independently of proxy/IP (PowerShell's browser-like UA also gets 202-challenge instead of 403, confirming User-Agent is the discriminator).

threads.title: [Bug][Desktop] 特定旧会话只能输出 Reasoning，Text 正文通道持续缺失
threads.bodyText:
1. 环境信息（Environment）应用： DeepSeek Harness Desktop (DSH)版本： 0.2.1-rc.3Electron： 44.7.0Node.js： v24.21.0操作系统： Windows 11Provider： deepseek-officialModel： deepseek-flashReasoning Effort： highWorkspace： default-workspace异常会话 ID： Available upon request（如开发者需要，可私下提供）。2. 问题描述（Description）一个已经持续使用较长时间的旧会话突然出现异常：Assistant 不再正常通过 Text 通道输出回复正文，而是将生成的内容全部或几乎全部输出到 Reasoning（思考）区域。目前确认：问题仅发生在特定旧会话中。相同 Provider、Model 和配置在新会话中可以正常输出 Text。在异常会话中，多次要求模型通过正常正文通道回复，问题仍然存在。偶尔可以成功输出极短的 Text 内容。例如，要求模型回复「在」时，曾成功通过 Text 通道输出「在」，但不稳定。故障发生前，该会话一直能够正常输出正文。因此，这似乎不是全局模型配置问题，而是与特定会话状态或处理流程有关。3. 故障时间线（Timeline）根据原始会话日志：Turn 536： 仍然存在正常 Text 输出。Turn 537： 首次发现只有 Reasoning、没有 Text 的情况。Turn 537 之后： 大部分回复只有 Reasoning。Turn 541： 短暂恢复，出现 Reasoning + Text。Turn 547、549、555： 用户主动测试正文通道时，模型曾成功通过 Text 输出单字「在」。Turn 558–563： 连续六轮只有 Reasoning，没有任何 Text 区块。这表明问题是在已有会话运行过程中出现的，并且偶尔会短暂恢复。4. 原始日志分析（Session Log Evidence）检查了原始会话文件及独立保存的故障现场备份：session.v4.jsonl.zstd在 Turn 558–563 中发现：assistant/message 的 content 数组只有 reasoning 类型区块。没有 text 类型区块。对应的 stream 记录中，chunk 同样只有 reasoning。流结束原因记录为 stop。step/end 和 turn/end 事件正常出现。Turn 结束状态为 completed。这意味着问题不只是 UI 将正常正文错误地显示在 Reasoning 区域。至少在 DSH 保存的流式事件和最终消息数据中，Text 区块本身就不存在。不过，目前无法确认是 DeepSeek 服务端没有返回 Text，还是 DSH 的 DeepSeek Adapter 在接收、解析或保存流式响应时丢失了 Text。5. 已完成的排查（Investigation）5.1 请求配置检查了故障发生前后的 request/header 事件：Provider 始终为 deepseek-official。Model 始终为 deepseek-flash。Reasoning Effort 始终为 high。Max Tokens 始终为 256000。没有发现相关配置变化。5.2 会话压缩（Compaction）第四次完整压缩发生在 Turn 523，但压缩后 Turn 524–536 仍然能够正常输出 Text。因此，目前没有证据证明这次压缩直接导致故障。5.3 Inbox 消息处理检查了故障时间段内的 agent/inbox/spliced 事件。消息插入和移除操作总体规律一致，暂时没有发现明显的队列异常。5.4 Delivery Accepted检查了 79 条 session-log-deepseek/delivery-accepted 事件：所有事件的 sessionFormatVersion 均为 4。每条事件的 throughSeq 均等于对应的 seq - 1。没有发现明显的序号断层。这些事件不包含原始模型响应或 Text/Reasoning 流式内容。5.5 故障时间段内的事件类型检查范围：seq 17300–17985
事件类型 | 数量
-- | --
session-log-deepseek/delivery-accepted | 79
user/message | 52
request/header | 2
assistant/message | 78
agent/inbox/spliced | 82
没有发现独立记录的 stream、adapter、response 或 llm 事件。5.6 DSH 诊断包另外检查了 DSH 导出的诊断 JSON。诊断包没有包含当前故障时刻的 DeepSeek 原始响应体或完整 Provider 流式响应，因此无法直接判断问题发生在服务端还是客户端。其中发现的一些旧错误发生在当前故障之前，目前没有证据证明它们与本次问题直接相关。6. 当前判断（Current Assessment）目前主要有两种可能：可能 A： DeepSeek 服务端或 API 返回的响应流本身缺少正常 Text 内容。可能 B： DSH 的 DeepSeek Adapter 在流式接收、解析、分块合并或消息保存过程中，没有正确处理 Text 区块。目前已经确认的是：DSH 保存的异常响应流和最终消息中都缺少 Text，但尚不能确定真正原因。考虑到相同 Provider、Model 和配置在新会话中工作正常，而旧会话出现异常，希望开发者特别关注：Session Resume 处理流程；长会话上下文处理；历史 Compaction 与会话恢复之间的交互；DeepSeek Adapter 的 Streaming 和 Reasoning/Text Block Parsing 逻辑。7. 希望开发者协助确认的问题（Questions）DeepSeek Adapter 是否可能在特定会话的 Resume 或长上下文场景下错误地丢弃 Text 区块？deepseek-messages 响应格式在 Reasoning 和 Text 区块的解析、合并过程中，是否可能出现异常？是否有办法在不修改原有会话历史的情况下，检查该会话实际收到的原始 Provider Response Stream？是否存在与特定会话状态、历史 Compaction 或 Streaming Recovery 有关的已知问题？8. 数据保护情况（Data Preservation）目前已经保留：原始异常会话文件；独立的故障现场备份；旧版会话备份；DSH 诊断 JSON。故障现场备份已经通过 SHA-256 校验，确认与原始文件一致。目前没有执行任何破坏性操作，包括删除会话历史、重置会话、重建会话、修改原始会话文件或清理历史记录。希望能够在不丢失、不修改现有会话历史的前提下，进一步定位并解决这个问题。如果开发者需要，我可以在确认隐私保护方式后提供相关诊断材料。

threads.title: [Bug] workspace.json with a non-array sessionIds breaks the whole workspace domain and cascades into unrelated services
threads.bodyText:
Environment

dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 (global install), Node v26.13.0
Windows 11, DSH_HOME redirected to C:\Users\<user>\Desktop\HarnessData
Web GUI: dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3088

Summary
A single malformed record in storages/workspace.json (sessionIds stored as a string instead of an array) makes the workspace domain throw on load. This cascades into sessionController, schedule, workspaceController and ui-deliverables staying pending, and the user only sees a misleading frontend error about directoryPickerController.
Steps to reproduce


Start DSH normally once so storages/workspace.json exists.


Edit storages/workspace.json and change any workspace's sessionIds from an array to a single string:
"sessionIds": "session-7f2c108b-…"


Restart dsh web.


Actual
Startup log:
dsh: warning: 5 entries did not activate
DomainError: domain 'workspace': stored record 'b7ac4724-…'
             in table 'workspaces' does not match its schema
ZodError: path: ["sessionIds"], message: "Invalid input: expected array, received string"

Frontend — clicking "select workspace directory" shows:
typert gateway: directoryPicker/list: active Service "directoryPickerController" is unavailable

The workspace list is empty and all conversations appear to be gone (they are still on disk).
Expected

The invalid record should be reported and skipped, while the valid workspaces still load.
At minimum, the startup warning should name the offending record and field, and the frontend error should mention the workspace domain rather than a downstream service.

Root cause analysis
Two independent layers contribute:

Data corruption (external) — the file was edited by a script outside DSH, and a single-element array was serialized as a string (a well-known PowerShell pitfall: pipeline output of one element collapses to a scalar). DSH had no chance to validate the write because the write did not go through DSH.
Missing isolation (DSH) — on read, the domain validates stored records with Zod and throws for the whole domain instead of per record, so one bad record takes down every dependent service.

Suggested fixes

Per-record tolerance — catch schema errors per stored record, skip the invalid ones, log {domain, recordId, field, expected} and continue mounting the domain with the remaining records.
Self-healing at boot — before mounting, validate storages/*.json; on failure rename the file to <name>.bad-<timestamp>, rebuild a minimal valid structure, and surface a one-line warning in the UI.
Root-cause propagation — make gateway errors carry the originating service + record + field, so directoryPickerController is unavailable becomes workspace registry failed to load (record b7ac4724-…, field sessionIds).

Logs
11:07:52.564  default data dir not writable: C:\Users\<user>\.dsh\profiles\web
11:07:52.564  falling back to: C:\Users\<user>\Desktop\HarnessData
11:08:02.278  > dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3088/?token=...
[after the corrupted file was introduced]
dsh: warning: 5 entries did not activate
DomainError: domain 'workspace': stored record 'b7ac4724-…' in table 'workspaces' does not match its schema

Notes

No data loss: fixing sessionIds back to ["…"] and restarting restored everything.
The .dsh → HarnessData fallback (unwritable default home on Windows) seems unrelated to the corruption itself, but it does mean storages/ can end up inside a user-visible directory where external edits are likely.

threads.title: [Desktop] 0.2.1-rc.5 startup fails with "desktop welcome: Web authentication failed" after restart
threads.bodyText:
Disclosure: This report was prepared and submitted by the user's DSH assistant on the user's behalf. The user does not write code; the assistant helped summarize the issue and run the checks below.
Environment

Windows x64
DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5
Electron 44.7.0
Node 24.21.0
locale: en

Symptom
After closing and reopening DSH Desktop, startup fails with:
DeepSeek Harness is unavailable
The application could not start or stopped unexpectedly.
desktop welcome: Web authentication failed

Clicking Restart repeats the same dialog; the desktop UI cannot be reached.

Diagnostic report
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
    at connectDesktopWelcome (file:///<DSH install>/resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:8886:31)
    at async Object.start (file:///<DSH install>/resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:12195:22)
    at async file:///<DSH install>/resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:7162:5
    at async file:///<DSH install>/resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:12313:4

Background
While doing some unrelated local plugin UI work, I had temporarily changed some global UI CSS, then rolled it back. One previous restart showed a similar popup once, and clicking Restart brought DSH up. The current failure happened later, after closing and reopening, and persists across Restart.
What was checked

Restarted the desktop app: same Web authentication failed.
Temporarily reduced the desktop profile to only @deepseek-ai/dsh-base and @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app, with no third-party dependencies, to rule out plugins. It still failed.
Checked the desktop host port behavior: it starts the host with --port 0 (random port), so the local web fallback on port 3080 is not a port conflict.
Backed up and cleared the desktop Electron auth cookies at %APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\Cookies; after that, desktop started normally.
Restored the normal profile and it still started.

Suspected cause
A stale/invalid desktop authentication cookie or login state, after which connectDesktopWelcome treats the first non-2xx response as fatal. The crash log does not include the request URL or HTTP status, so the exact response cannot be confirmed from the report.
Workaround that worked
Close DSH Desktop, back up and remove %APPDATA%\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\Cookies, then start again.
Expected

Detect stale auth state and clear/refresh it automatically;
Or open a re-login screen instead of a fatal "unavailable" dialog;
Include the request URL (redacted) and HTTP status in the crash diagnostic.

Request
Please check whether stale desktop auth cookies can be recovered automatically. The redacted screenshot and the diagnostic steps above are included.

threads.title: 桌面端反复重启后必定启动失败：dsh-auth cookie 随随机端口无限堆积，撑爆 16KB 请求头上限导致 431
threads.bodyText:
环境

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.5（0.2.1-rc.3 同样存在）
Windows 11 x64 / Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0
崩溃日志：%APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*.log


摘要
桌面端每次启动都会写入一个新的 dsh-auth-<44位哈希> 会话 cookie。
哈希值包含当次启动的随机端口，而 cookie 按域名（127.0.0.1）存储、
不区分端口，因此旧 cookie 永远不会被同名覆盖，只会无限累积。
累积到约 70 条时，Cookie 请求头超过 Node 默认的 max-http-header-size
（16384 字节），Host 返回 431，桌面端将其判为认证失败并中止启动。

现象
启动即弹窗 "The application could not start or stopped unexpectedly."，详情为：
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
at connectDesktopWelcome (.../app.asar/lib/main.js)
at async Object.start (.../app.asar/lib/main.js)
日志中 phase: startup。
弹窗建议"重装或禁用第三方插件"，这两条都是死路，与插件无关。

复现步骤

正常使用桌面端，反复启动/退出约 70 次（正常使用约 10～14 天）
再次启动，必现上述错误
关闭应用，删除 %APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\Cookies
重新启动，恢复正常


实测证据
从 cookie 库 Network/Cookies 中统计，故障时 127.0.0.1 下共有
71 条 dsh-auth-* cookie，无其他任何 cookie。
单条 cookie 形态（实测 Set-Cookie）：
dsh-auth-xve1cdvif713tCh-zvXXZ2XqUnAtUVDatWsduYXhYok=v1.eyJ2ZXJzaW9uIjoxLCJhdXRob3JpdHkiOiIxMjcuMC4wLjE6NDk0OTQifQ.rnymiz...
Max-Age=2592000; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict

name 52 字符、value 173 字符，单条约 228 字节
value 解码后含 "authority":"127.0.0.1:49494"，确认哈希与端口绑定
两次不同端口启动（49448 / 49494）产生两个不同的 cookie 名

针对真实 Host 扫描条数临界点（仅构造 Cookie 头，其余请求头最小化）：
Cookie 条数    Cookie 头字节    响应

71             16,194           200
72             16,422           431
实际请求还会带上 Host、User-Agent、Accept、Sec-Fetch-* 等约 300 字节，
因此真实阈值落在 71 条，与用户实际故障点完全吻合。

根因分析
app.asar/lib/main.js 中的启动流程：
const ready = await host.start();
hostCookie = await authenticateWebHost(ready.url);   // ① 通过
hostUrl = ready.url;
welcomeBackend = await connectDesktopWelcome(
ready.url, (input, init) => net.fetch(input, init), ...
);                                                    // ② 失败
① authenticateWebHost() 使用 Node 全局 fetch，请求不带任何 cookie，
因此能正常拿到 303 + Set-Cookie，看起来一切正常。
② connectDesktopWelcome() 使用 Chromium 的 net.fetch 且 credentials: "include"，
会把该域下全部 71 条 cookie 一并发出，请求头超限 → Host 返回 431：
const authenticated = await send(authenticatedUrl, { credentials: "include" });
if (!authenticated.ok) throw new Error("desktop welcome: Web authentication failed");
431 被统一归入 !ok，真实状态码被吞掉，日志中只剩"认证失败"，极难定位。

为什么 Web 版不会遇到
三个条件在 Web 版被默认用法消掉了：

dsh web 默认使用配置中的固定 host + port，哈希稳定 → 同名覆盖，永远只有 1 条
cookie 存在用户自己的浏览器里，可随手清理
万一触发，浏览器直接显示 431 页面，不会变成"应用无法启动"

桌面端则相反：端口必须每次随机（无法假设某个端口空闲）、cookie 存在
应用内置 profile 里无人清理、失败被包装成误导性的启动崩溃弹窗。

建议修复（按优先级）

cookie 名去掉端口因素，改为固定名（如 dsh-auth），让新 cookie 覆盖旧 cookie；
authority 信息已包含在 value 内，无需体现在名字里
或者在写入前，先删除该 host 下所有 dsh-auth-* 旧 cookie
容错：connectDesktopWelcome 收到 431 时，清理陈旧 dsh-auth-* 后重试一次
把状态码写进错误信息，例如
desktop welcome: Web authentication failed (HTTP 431)，
并在致命弹窗中区分该场景，提示"清理会话 cookie"而非"重装"


临时规避
关闭应用（含托盘）后删除：
%APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\Cookies
%APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\Network\Cookies-journal
该库仅包含上述 localhost dsh-auth cookie，不影响账号登录态
（凭据存于 ~/.dsh）。
清理后大约可再用 70 次启动，之后复发。

补充
如果你也遇到同样的报错，可以核对一下 cookie 库里的条数。
只要 127.0.0.1 下的 dsh-auth-* 接近 70 条，基本就是这个原因，
清掉即可恢复，无需重装。

threads.title: bug(subprocess-local): an active-empty Linux scope unit is never released without a termination request — leaks one unit plus a 5s systemctl polling loop per completed command
threads.bodyText:
Problem
SystemdScopeOwner.emptyRange() requires terminationRequested before it releases a leftover active-empty scope unit. That flag is only set by signal()/terminate(). A command that completes on its own never issues a termination request, so:

The transient systemd scope unit stays active with TasksCurrent=0 forever — systemd ends a scope only on the populated→empty transition, and a payload that never populated the cgroup leaves the unit active indefinitely (the class doc comment already documents this).
The waitForExit() observation loop keeps spawning systemctl --user show for that unit every 5 s — forever.
The handle stays in the subprocess service's live set, retaining memory.

Under sustained multi-agent usage (hundreds of tool calls) this accumulates. Observed on a long-running dsh web host: 900+ leaked dsh-subprocess-* scope units, ~500 concurrent systemctl children at peak (spawn storm), 60% of one core burned inside child_process.spawn, and heap growth from the retained handles. Clearing the stale units collapsed the storm instantly and CPU returned to idle.
Fix
Drop the terminationRequested gate. The remaining predicate already proves the range is conclusively finished — the class's own doc comment argues exactly this: "a departed client cannot add another payload; a consumed request proves the payload already entered the scope." Either the direct client has departed (it forked every process it will ever fork) or the launch request was consumed (the payload entered the scope), and with TasksCurrent=0 the managed range holds nothing. Termination signaling is orthogonal to settlement.
aaa02a3970 introduced emptyRange/releaseEmptyRange but gated them on terminationRequested, which covers only the kill/terminate path; normal completion and launch failures leak.
Verification

New regression test: releases an active empty scope once its client has completed without a termination request — completes a scope with no signal and asserts the leftover unit is released (systemctl stop issued) and the observation settles.
Renamed keeps waiting for an active empty scope no termination has requested to ... while its client is still alive — the wait invariant is client liveness, not absence of termination.
Full subprocess-local suite: 382 passed, 0 failed (also covers terminal scopes, spawn, windows-job suites).


Posted per the contributing guide (bug reports go to Discussions; external PRs are not accepted). Context: observed on a long-running dsh web host driving an external agent team (0.2.1-rc.3 through current master ce7073d5 — the gate is still present there). A fix is the one-line gate removal in emptyRange() plus dropping the now write-only field; I can share the exact patch in this thread if useful.

threads.title: typert: generated remote-client artifacts fail to bundle in third-party browser faces — /remote-info resolves to the declaration file
threads.bodyText:
Context
@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-generator emits remote-client artifacts that import the wire helpers through the subpath (emitter.ts, both the js and dts emitters):
import { createTypertRemoteInfo } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol/remote-info'
When a third-party bundle builds its browser face with tsdown/rolldown (oxc-resolver) and the bundler reads the bundle's TypeScript config — whose paths conventionally map specifiers to the type-layer .d.ts facades — resolution of this specifier lands on lib/types/remote-info.d.ts instead of lib/types/remote-info.js, failing the build:
[MISSING_EXPORT] "createTypertRemoteInfo" is not exported by ".../lib/types/remote-info.d.ts".

The published package itself is self-consistent: the rc.3 tarball ships lib/types/remote-info.js, and Node runtime resolution of the subpath works. The failure only appears when the specifier is resolved through a type-layer alias/conditions where the types entry wins over default.
Reproduction sketch

Third-party bundle declares a preset row whose client face bundles its generated typert.remote-client.js (any bundle that ships a Typed Remote per docs/architecture/client-and-remote).
Bundle tsconfig extends the type-layer tsconfig (paths → .d.ts facades); tsdown reads that tsconfig.
tsdown client pass fails with MISSING_EXPORT on remote-info.d.ts.

Workaround used in production
Pin the specifier to the runtime artifact with a resolver plugin — the same resolveId technique the team bundle already uses for @wowyuarm/dsh-agent-team/remote:
resolveId(source) {
  if (source === '@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol/remote-info') {
    return require.resolve('@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol/lib/types/remote-info.js')
  }
  return null
}
Possible upstream directions

Have the emitter import the helpers from the package root — @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol re-exports createTypertRemoteInfo since rc.3. Root imports already bundle cleanly in observed browser faces. (One-line change in both emitters + the generator test assertion at remote-metadata.spec.ts:230.)
Or document the resolver pin as part of the third-party browser-face recipe.


If maintainers prefer a code change for direction 1, I can share the exact emitter diff in this thread.

threads.title: inspector: cordis/tree 的尺寸校验与快照上限不一致，导致 host 进程 fatal 退出
threads.bodyText:
Summary
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector 通过 publishCordisTree 把 Cordis 树快照作为 cordis/tree state 发布。collector 与 buffer 用同一个 128 KB 帧上限校验，但量的是不同对象：collector 量裸快照，buffer 量包装后的 record {monotonicMs, topic, payload}。两者相差约 61 字节，形成一段 collector 放行、buffer 必拒的区间。
该拒绝发生在 queueMicrotask 内，调用链上没有 try/catch，最终以 dsh: fatal uncaught exception 结束整个 host 进程。桌面端表现为整程序退出，用户丢失当前会话。
影响范围是 Cordis 树接近 128 KB 的 profile：插件装载、MCP 上下线、会话切换都会触发发布，也就都可能触发退出。
Reproduction
A. 现场复现（0.2.1-rc.2 桌面版）

profile 启用 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector-profile，另挂若干第三方 bundle，inspector 使用默认配置。
在 host 进程内取到根 Cordis 上下文（root fiber uid = 0，当时 654 个活 fiber），持续调用 ctx.plugin({ name, apply() {} }) 挂空插件，每 20 ms 25 个。
挂到第 150 个之后，host 退出，crash-*-host.log 出现本文的栈。

654 个 fiber 时距上限只差约 150 个节点（约 19 KB），说明该 profile 一直贴着上限。
B. 最小单元复现（确定性）
collector 的接受上限是 maxSourceFrameBytes - 4096 = 126,976：
const buffer = new InspectorSourceBuffer({
  topics: ['*'], maxQueuedRecords: 2048, maxQueuedBytes: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
  maxRecordsPerFrame: 64, maxFrameBytes: 128 * 1024,
})
buffer.setState('cordis/tree', payloadOfSize(126976), 123456.789)
// Error: inspector: source state exceeds the source-frame byte limit
实测边界：126,976 被拒，126,915 通过，死区 61 字节。把时间戳换成 16 位再测，边界挪到 126,909，死区 67 字节——宽度随 monotonicMs 位数变化，不是常量。
C. 独立验证（Linux 容器，npm 发布产物）
node:24-bookworm 容器内 npm i @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector@0.2.1-rc.2，用 startInspector() 返回的真实 source 调 setState('cordis/tree', <126,976 字节的 payload>)：
Error: inspector: source state exceeds the source-frame byte limit
    at InspectorSourceBuffer.setState  (…/lib/index.js:996:10)
    at HostBridgePublisher.setState    (…/lib/index.js:1109:16)
    at HostInspectorSource.setState    (…/lib/index.js:836:18)
exit=1

同一环境下扫边界：126,915 接受，126,916 拒绝，死区 61 字节，与 B 一致。平台从 macOS 换成 Linux、代码从源码换成发布产物，结果不变。
Current behavior
两天内崩溃四次，栈完全一致：
dsh: fatal uncaught exception: Error: inspector: source state exceeds the source-frame byte limit
    at InspectorSourceBuffer.setState      (…/dsh-experimental-inspector/lib/index.js:996:10)
    at HostBridgePublisher.setState        (…/dsh-experimental-inspector/lib/index.js:1109:16)
    at HostInspectorSource.setState        (…/dsh-experimental-inspector/lib/index.js:836:18)
    at …                                   (…/dsh-experimental-inspector/lib/index.js:2322:13)
    at publish                             (…/dsh-experimental-inspector/lib/index.js:2294:3)
    at process.processTicksAndRejections   (node:internal/process/task_queues:104:5)

setState 在抛出前已把 state 回滚（buffer.ts:64-68），所以不是状态损坏，纯粹是一个没人接的异常。
Expected behavior
单帧观测超限应当被丢弃并记录，下一次 internal/plugin 或 internal/status 事件重试。inspector 的观测失败不应该终结 host 进程。
根因
collector 建出来时预留了 4096 字节帧开销（host/plugin.ts:80-83）：
publishCordisTree(ctx, handle.source, {
  maxNodes: spec.maxCordisNodes,
  maxBytes: spec.maxSourceFrameBytes - 4_096,
})
collector 据此裁剪，保证返回的裸快照满足 jsonByteLength(snapshot) <= maxBytes（collector.ts:104-110）。
但 buffer 校验的是状态的 JSON 编码（buffer.ts:157-160），而 state 里存的是 record() 构造的 {monotonicMs, topic, payload}（buffer.ts:134-146）：
private stateFits(): boolean {
  return jsonByteLength([...this.state.values()]) + SOURCE_FRAME_OVERHEAD_BYTES
    <= this.options.maxFrameBytes
}
于是快照要同时满足两个宽度不同的条件：
collector:  snapshot                              <= maxFrameBytes - 4096
buffer:     snapshot + 信封 + 2（数组括号） + 4096  <= maxFrameBytes

信封固定为 49 + String(monotonicMs).length 字节，这就是死区的来源。
另有一处同样致命但本次未触发：collector.ts:111 的 Cordis root exceeds the source-frame byte limit 从同一个微任务抛出，只修 buffer 不足以覆盖。
版本比对：0.1.7-rc.2、0.2.0-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.2、0.2.1-rc.5、0.2.2-alpha.2 的上述代码一致，不是回归，升级到目前最新版也不能解决。
Environment

DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2，Electron 44.7.0，Node 24.21.0，macOS arm64
@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector 0.2.1-rc.2
profile：默认桌面 profile，启用 @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-inspector-profile 及若干第三方 bundle
inspector 默认配置，未覆盖 maxSourceFrameBytes 或 maxCordisNodes

threads.title: [Bug] 升级至 0.2.1-rc.5 后，因第三方插件冲突导致启动崩溃 (1 required plugin did not activate)
threads.bodyText:
运行环境 (Environment)

OS: Windows 10 (10.0.19045.6466)
App Version: @deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.5
Electron: 44.7.0
Node.js: 24.21.0
安装方式: 桌面端自动更新（从旧版本更新至此版本）

问题描述 (Description)
更新至最新版本 0.2.1-rc.5 后，应用无法启动，直接闪退并弹出 "The application could not start or stopped unexpectedly" 报错。
通过查看崩溃日志发现，启动时因第三方插件（疑似之前安装的 @linxin666/dsh-web-all 等）与核心服务版本不兼容，导致核心服务 sessionProjections 注册失败。这引发了连锁反应，导致必须的核心插件 agent-loop 无法激活，最终导致 33 个依赖该服务的插件集体挂起，应用启动彻底失败。
崩溃日志 (Crash Log)
DesktopHostFatalError: dsh: startup failed: 1 required plugin did not activate

Plugins waiting for services (33):
  Plugin                     Missing services
  agent-loop (required)      sessionProjections
  session-title              sessionProjections
  session-title-llm          sessionTitle
  ... (以下省略)
"完整崩溃日志见附件：crash-2026-10-31T15-44-26-802Z-host.log"

###复现步骤 (Steps to Reproduce)
在旧版本中安装过第三方插件（如 @linxin666/dsh-web-all、dsh-better-sidebar 等）。
通过桌面端更新机制，升级到 0.2.1-rc.5 版本。
重启应用，直接报错闪退。

###临时解决办法 (Workaround)
目前通过“清空环境”恢复了运行。具体操作为：
彻底关闭应用及后台残留进程。
进入 .dsh\profiles\desktop 目录，将 package.json 中的 dependencies 清空为 {}。
删除 node_modules 文件夹。
重新执行 pnpm install，仅安装官方基础包。
应用可以成功启动，但代价是之前安装的所有第三方插件都被清空。

建议与诉求 (Suggestion)
理解第三方插件可能存在不兼容的情况，但目前这种“一个插件出错导致整个应用无法启动且没有 GUI 修复入口”的体验非常影响用户。
希望能：
在启动前加入插件兼容性校验，或者提供类似“安全模式/恢复模式”的启动选项（绕过用户插件）。
对于非 core 插件的异常，希望能做到“优雅降级”（如日志中出现的 plugin degraded），而不是直接阻断整个宿主程序的启动。
在更新提示中增加对第三方插件兼容性的警告。

感谢团队的辛勤付出！

threads.title: profile 清单被写入 UTF-8 BOM 后加载器解析即崩，且恢复流程会再次写坏，无法自救
threads.bodyText:
DSH 0.2.1-rc.3（Windows x64，Electron 44.7.0）在某些写入路径下会给 profiles/<name>/package.json 加上 UTF-8 BOM（EF BB BF）；加载器 readProfileManifest 直接 JSON.parse、不剥离 BOM，启动即抛 Unexpected token '﻿' 崩掉；崩溃弹窗的「恢复重启」又会走同一条坏路径，形成无法自救的崩溃循环（实测连续 9 次，16:09–16:31 UTC）。
证据四条：

0:13 的备份（950 字节）首三字节就是 efbbbf；更早的历史备份（466/344 字节）全是 7b0a20 —— BOM 是后来某次写入才引入的。
0:26 生成了 cordis.patch.yml.bak-1793378185239（正是「back up profile patch」的痕迹），0:27 立刻复崩 —— 恢复动作确实执行过，且没校验就重启。
已排除第三方插件与外部工具：profile 下所有已装插件没有 Set-Content/Out-File/utf8-sig 这类写法；PowerShell Operational 日志（enabled）在崩溃窗口内检索 package.json 命中 0 条。
对照组：今天 12:41 应用自己重写清单（1108 字节）首三字节为 7b0a20，此后 21 小时零崩溃 —— 不是「写清单一律加 BOM」，是某条特定路径（失败/恢复流程）才加。
按 RFC 8259 §8.1：写入方 MUST NOT 加 BOM，解析方 MAY 忽略 BOM。这里是写侧违规、读侧又把可选容错做成了致命失败。
建议修复（按优先级）：
读侧止血（P0）：配置读取收口到统一函数，解析前剥离 BOM，兼容 UTF-16 BOM。
恢复侧兜底（P0）：坏文件先隔离为 .bad-<ts> → 从 last-known-good 恢复 → 用同一加载器校验能 parse 再启动；加崩溃循环检测与安全模式。
写侧根因（P1）：定位并改掉带 BOM 的写入路径，改原子写（临时文件 + rename），写完回读校验。
另附一条：插件安装子进程未继承用户级 PATH，pnpm 解析 GitHub 依赖时报 'git' 不是内部或外部命令（git 实际已安装可用）。建议 spawn 时继承完整 PATH，或允许配置 git 路径。
本问题由用户在日常使用中发现，证据按时间线整理；已知此前有若干同类报告（#11182、#10883、#10159、#8837），本条补充的是「恢复流程会再次写坏、形成无法自救的崩溃循环」这一段。
证据2-插件安装失败日志.log
证据1-BOM坏掉的配置文件.json

threads.title: [Desktop] 双击启动必定失败：desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
threads.bodyText:
环境

@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop 0.2.1-rc.3
Electron 44.7.0 / Node 24.21.0 / win32 x64
Profile: desktop

现象
双击桌面端可执行文件启动，每次都在启动阶段失败，必现。恢复界面显示：
desktop welcome: Web authentication failed

崩溃日志（%APPDATA%@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop\logs\crash-*-host.log）：
Error: desktop welcome: Web authentication failed
    at connectDesktopWelcome (file:///H:/qin/resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:8886:31)
    at async Object.start (file:///H:/qin/resources/app.asar/lib/main.js:12195:22)

重启、禁用所有第三方插件、清理 profile patch 均无效，每次启动都会复现。
失败位置
main.js:12189-12195 连续执行以下步骤：
const ready = await host.start();
hostCookie = await authenticateWebHost(ready.url);   // (1) Node fetch，要求 303 + set-cookie
hostUrl = ready.url;
if (ready.injections === void 0) throw ...
injections = ready.injections;
welcomeBackend = await connectDesktopWelcome(
  ready.url,
  (input, init) => net.fetch(input, init),           // (2) Electron net.fetch
  ...);

第 (1) 步是成功的——否则报的会是另一条错误 "Desktop Host authentication failed"。
第 (2) 步对同一个 ready.url 再发一次 GET，返回 401，于是 8886 行抛出异常。
Host 侧判定规则（dsh-client-connection 的 authorizeIndex）：

带 ?token= 时：只有 token 完全匹配才返回 303，否则 401
不带 token 时：只要带有效的签名 cookie 就直接放行

直接探测同一个 Host，证明 Host 本身是健康的：
GET /                          -> 401
GET / 带有效 cookie            -> 200
GET /?token=<有效 token>       -> 200

可见 Host、启动 token、凭据存储都正常。
问题在于第 (2) 次请求既没有带上正确的 token，也没有带上第 (1) 步拿到的 cookie——
Node 侧的 fetch 和 Electron 的 net.fetch 之间没有共享鉴权状态。
预期
启动完成并进入工作区。
实际
启动每次都卡在 welcome 鉴权这一步失败。
规避方案（可稳定使用）
直接以纯 Node 方式启动 Host 完全正常（本机实测）：
set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1
"H:\qin\DeepSeek Harness.exe" --expose-internals ^
  "H:\qin\resources\app.asar\dsh\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-desktop-host\lib\index.js" ^
  "H:\qin\resources\app.asar\dsh" ^
  "H:\dsh-home\profiles\desktop" ^
  "H:\qin\resources\runtime\primary-runtime" ^
  "H:\qin\resources\runtime\primary-runtime\dependencies\pnpm\bin\pnpm.mjs" ^
  "H:\qin\resources\runtime\bin"

它会打印 dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:PORT/?token=...，在浏览器打开该 URL 即可正常进入工作区。
也就是说，只有桌面壳的 welcome 路径坏了。
可能的修复方向
让第 (2) 步复用第 (1) 步取得的鉴权——例如发送不带过期 token 的 ready.url 并同时携带
hostCookie，或在调用 connectDesktopWelcome 之前，先把 authenticateWebHost
返回的 set-cookie 写入 Electron 的 cookie jar。

threads.title: [Bug] settings/describe crashes on Standard Schema Config with toJSON
mcp-client: streamable-http transport is rejected with HTTP 403 by WAF-fronted MCP servers (version-negotiation probe)
threads.bodyText:
mcp-client: streamable-http transport is rejected with HTTP 403 by WAF-fronted MCP servers (version-negotiation probe)
Environment

DSH 0.2.1-rc.5, desktop profile, Windows 11 (PowerShell 7)
@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client with bundled @modelcontextprotocol/client@2.2.0
Remote server: Tavily MCP — https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/?tavilyApiKey=…, serverInfo: tavily-mcp 4.1.4

Expected
A bundle entry with
- id: tavily-mcp
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: tavily
    transport: streamable-http
    url: https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/?tavilyApiKey=…
    failOnStartupError: true
connects, lists tools and registers them on ctx.tools.
Actual
tavily-mcp (@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client): Error: mcp-client(tavily): initial connection or tool synchronization failed
SdkHttpError: Version negotiation failed: the server denied access (HTTP 403)

It is the client, not the server or the key
Same URL, same machine, same moment:
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST "$URL" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" \
  --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"probe","version":"1.0"}}}'
# 200, SSE body with a valid initialize result

DSH streamable-http → 403 (HTML body from the WAF, not a JSON-RPC error).
mcp-remote (MCP SDK 1.x proxy, stdio → http) with the identical URL → works: tools/list returns 5 tools, tavily_search returns results.
DSH stdio + mcp-remote → works and has been stable for repeated calls.

So the failing part is the request(s) the v2 client issues around initialize — the version-negotiation probe — and the WAF rejects that shape.
Additional data points

Accept header matters on this endpoint: Accept: application/json alone (without text/event-stream) returns 406.
A burst of ~20 probe requests in a couple of minutes got the IP rate-limited: during that window everything returned an HTML 403 — including the plain REST API https://api.tavily.com/search. After ~5 minutes the block cleared and curl was 200 again, while the DSH client still returned 403. So the client-side failure is not explained by the temporary block.

Suggested fix

Treat a 4xx/5xx response to the negotiation probe as "negotiation unsupported" and fall back to a plain initialize with the spec-default protocol version, instead of failing the whole connection.
Or expose it as config: negotiateProtocolVersion: false.
Optionally allow extra headers on the probe (browser-like User-Agent / Accept-Language) — many WAF-fronted MCP endpoints appear to expect them.

Workaround for users
Use the stdio bridge, e.g.
transport: stdio
command: node
args:
  - <path>/node_modules/mcp-remote/dist/proxy.js
  - https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp/?tavilyApiKey=…
This is what I am running now; everything works, but it costs an extra process and is a separate failure point (the bridge has already dropped with SdkError: Connection closed on its own once).

threads.title: dsh-superagent 原型在 Windows 上的六处不适配（附补丁与端到端验证）
threads.bodyText:
在 Windows 11 上把 deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype v0.1.0（DSH 0.2.1-rc.5、Node 24、GitHub CLI 2.103.3）跑起来了。原型本身是一套很干净的设计，但代码里有四处 POSIX 假设，各自卡在不同阶段，全修完才走通「Issue → 评估 → 工单 → 自动开 PR」。记录在这里，给同样在 Windows 上试的人省点时间，也给作者留个档。

原型仓的 Issues / Discussions / PR 都是关的（GET /pulls 返回 404），所以发在这里。不是求合并，只是把踩到的坑和改法说清楚；需要的话我可以把它拆成 PR 或按你们的风格重写。

六处不适配



位置
症状
原因




src/deployment.ts stateDir
插件完全不激活：$.stateDir expect string to match regexp /^\//
校验要求以 / 开头，Windows 盘符路径必然不满足


src/deployment.ts workerProbe
setup 读不到账号：spawn env ENOENT
argv 前缀是 env PATH=…，Windows 没有 env 这个程序


src/app/sessions.ts orchestrator preset
编排不挂载，/orchestrator/api/* 一律 404 且没有别的报错
preset 把工具限制为 bash；Windows profile 里是 pwsh，tools.restrict() 拒绝未知名字，整个挂载被中断


src/executor/dsh.ts prepare
每个工单立刻失败：The prepare command failed: spawn sh ENOENT
prepare 命令写死 sh -c


src/policy.ts executor.directory
填盘符根目录报 Invalid settings: directory
用「以 / 开头」代替「是绝对路径」


docs/006-deployment.md
按文档装完就会遇到上面四条
没有 Windows 说明：agent CLI 不能是 .cmd，prepare shell 也不可配



第三条最阴：它不报错、不崩溃，只是编排那一块静默消失，表现是面板 404，很难从现象倒推回去。
改法

stateDir 接受 POSIX / 盘符 / UNC 三种绝对路径。
workerProbe 在 POSIX 保留 env PATH=… 前缀；win32 直接传 argv —— 那个前缀本来是为了把 worker shim 排除出 PATH，而 Windows 上配置的是绝对路径，不需要它。
编排的受限工具表按平台取 shell 名（bash / pwsh），跟 bundle 里已有的 !!js process.platform === 'win32' 写法一致。
prepare shell 从平台分支改成设置项 prepareShell（默认 sh -c）：POSIX 行为零变化，Windows 填 cmd.exe /d /s /c 或 bash -lc。之所以不写死平台分支，是因为这样行为显式、可测，也不需要为「Windows 上用什么 shell」做猜测。
executor.directory 改用 path.isAbsolute()。
文档补一节 Windows：agent CLI 必须是可执行文件（Node 不能直接 spawn .cmd，所以 CLI 填 gh.exe，把身份放进服务进程的 GH_CONFIG_DIR）、prepareShell 怎么填、两种 shell 的语法差异（$VAR vs %VAR%）。

补丁：Ersith/dsh-superagent-prototype 分支 windows-compat，commit 6c53839，5 个文件 +39/−8，pnpm build 通过。
比较链接：Ersith/dsh-superagent-prototype@main...windows-compat
验证
Windows 11 + DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 + GitHub CLI 2.103.3，端到端走了一遍：

setup 解析出仓库与 agent 账号；
允许名单里的账号开一个 Issue，来源收到并交给模型评估；
命中 Policy 规则 → eval.mode=auto → 建工单；
prepare 把仓库 clone 进工单目录，worker session 改一处措辞、提交、推分支；
agent 自动开出 PR，正文自带「This is by an automated agent, not a human.」、改动前后对照和自检说明。

最后交付的 PR 是单行 diff（README.md 两行文件里的一行措辞）。
测试说明（如实）
仓库的测试直接断言 POSIX 行为——spawn argv 以 env / sh 开头、工具名 bash。这些断言在 Windows 上本来就有 39 个失败；打了补丁后变 131 个，多出来的都是那些断言在新平台分支下看到的差异。
我没有在 POSIX 主机上跑过全套，所以不能替你们保证 CI 绿。但代码上，POSIX 的每个判断都还是原来的值（同样的 env PATH=… 前缀、同样的 sh -c argv、同样的工具名、path.isAbsolute 对 POSIX 路径的结果不变）。如果希望测试覆盖两个平台，我可以把 shell argv 和工具名抽成常量让 spec 读取，而不是硬编码。
另外两处没动

scripts/dsh-superagent（Python + fcntl + tmux）和 src/app/migration.ts 里对 tmux 的假设仍然是 POSIX 的。前者只是控制脚本，后者是迁移路径；这次改的是「产品本身能不能跑」，没碰它们。Windows 上我另外写了个 start/stop/status 的 PowerShell 启动器替代 tmux 那层。
sessions.ts 里 worker preset 已经在用平台判断，说明 Windows 不是明确不支持，只是没适配全 —— 所以这几处大概属于「补完」而不是「新增支持」。


顺带一个非 Windows 的发现，可以单独开一条：线程 id 是 github:<编号>，不含仓库名（源码注释也写了 "of any repository"）。在面板里更换 Source 的 repository 时，会跟旧仓同号 Issue 撞线程——我实测换仓后，新仓 #2 的标题被覆盖，但时间戳和裁决理由还是旧仓的，received 也不增加。迁移路径可能需要处理这个。

threads.title: /compact cannot succeed once history exceeds the summarizer request limit (death spiral, 101/101 attempts failed)
threads.bodyText:
Summary
/compact cannot succeed on a session whose history has grown past the summarizer route's own request limit. Every attempt fails, nothing is pruned, the context only grows, and each subsequent turn re-triggers the same doomed request — a monotonic death spiral with no user-visible way out.
Reproduced on a real session (session.v4.jsonl.zstd, 9,519 events, 7 concatenated zstd frames, 13 MB decompressed, preset cordis):

101 compaction/start / 101 compaction/end, 0 compaction/summary, 0 compaction/prune — no attempt ever committed.
All 101 compaction/end events carried an error:

94 × HTTP 413 Request Entity Too Large (raw nginx HTML page)
3 × HTTP 400 context_length_exceeded — "Context far exceeds the limit for this pack: estimated ~655,944 / ~656,498 / ~699,975 tokens (limit 524,000). It can no longer be summarized in a single request — start a new session, or manually trim the conversation below 524,000 tokens."
2 × HTTP 401, 1 × HTTP 402, 1 × pi-ai detected context overflow


Surface pressure at the last attempt: 563,299 tokens against a 524,000-token window — already over the limit before compaction started.
The log itself is healthy: 0 JSON parse failures, 0 duplicate seqs, 0 gaps, and every compaction/start matched exactly one compaction/end, so the durable compaction lock is not leaked and the session remains readable.

The final /compact returned "Compaction could not produce a useful summary. The attempt is recorded in the session log."
Root cause
dsh-compaction-basic summarizes by replaying the selected span into one request. Three properties combine into the trap:

compactNow uses retainTokens = 0 (dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js:992 in the shipped build; src/index.ts in source). The manual path therefore shadows essentially the entire surface and replays all of it.
The manual path never invokes the tool-result pruner. Only compactIfNeeded does (src/index.ts:926-945), so the model-free "trim first, maybe skip the summary entirely" fallback documented in the README is unavailable to /compact.
The summarizer route's request limit is independent of, and can be smaller than, the conversation's routed window. Here the conversation was routed to a model advertising a 524,000-token window while the gateway in front of it enforced a much smaller effective body limit — so the replay was rejected as a 413 before the provider ever evaluated the model's window.

Because the attempt never shrank anything, nothing was ever pruned, so the surface only grew and every later turn re-triggered the same doomed replay.
A second classification bug
The harness maps any leading HTTP 413 to CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED (pi-ai's overflow patterns match the bare status). An nginx error page is therefore reported as a context overflow even though nothing about the model's window was ever evaluated. That mislabel sends the failure down the overflow-recovery path, which replays the same oversized request and dies identically — burning a retry per turn. This is the same class of bug as the existing fix/pi-ai-413-gateway-body-limit branch, but reached from the compaction side.
Measured provider matrix (against this session's own credentials)



route
result




commandcode minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash
HTTP 200 — accepted a 2.54 MB / 654,767-token replay and produced a valid checkpoint


aethera
HTTP 413 (nginx body cap)


oao claude-opus-5.5
HTTP 400 context_length_exceeded (524,000)


whatstoken
HTTP 402 (account out of credit)



I rebuilt the exact compaction request from the failing session (3,133 surface messages, the real 47-tool schema, the real 8,065-char system prompt, the verbatim COMPACTION_INSTRUCTION) and confirmed commandcode answers it successfully, so the session's content is summarizable — only the route was wrong.
Fix
https://github.com/akshaytp1571/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/compact-over-budget-route
Commit 2179c355e2 — fix(compaction-basic): condense in slices when the replay exceeds the summarizer limit.
Classify the failure. New classifySummarizationFailure() (packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/failure-class.ts) narrows a thrown summarizer failure to over-budget or other. Over-budget is a payload-size problem: a provider-confirmed context overflow, a gateway body-limit rejection of the replay, or a framed summary not smaller than its source. Auth, quota, transport, and empty output stay terminal. isGatewayBodyLimitError() distinguishes a proxy's HTML page or bare status line from a provider's structured overflow body.
Shrink and retry inside the same bracket. compactSurfaceRegion now retries on over-budget failures, re-selecting the oldest balanced prefix that fits and keeping the surface unchanged otherwise. The span keeps its start edge and only its tail boundary walks toward the start, so every intermediate cut stays tool-pairing balanced and the retained recent nodes stay verbatim. The durable contract is preserved exactly: one compaction/start, at most overBudgetRetries + 1 summary attempts, exactly one closing compaction/end — no lock leak, no orphan, no reader-visible shape change. Cancellation, surface change, and commit-stage failures are never retried.
New setting. overBudgetRetries (default 3), validated and merged through the existing per-model policy path, documented in the READMEs and the generated config catalog.
Tests. 14 new cases (183 total in the package pass, plus tsc -b and oxlint clean): 413 HTML page, bare status line, and structured provider overflow all classify as over-budget; auth, quota, and "summary is not smaller than the shadowed content" stay terminal; the bracket holds exactly one start/end pair across all retries; each retry replays a strictly smaller prefix; a non-over-budget failure is never retried.
What this does not fix

No pre-flight guard. The backend still does not check whether the selected span fits the summarizer's window before making the request, so the first attempt of an over-budget session still fails once and only then shrinks. A pre-flight estimate would avoid that wasted request entirely.
The manual path still never prunes. /compact cannot benefit from the tool-result pruner's model-free trim.
The threshold/ceiling mismatch. The compaction trigger derives from the routed model's advertised contextWindow, while the summarization ceiling is the gateway's effective limit. When those disagree the trigger fires far too late for the first attempt to succeed. Sharing one source of truth for both would remove the trap at its root.
This is a mitigation, not a recovery. A session already stuck in the death spiral still needs a restart to pick up the new code, and overBudgetRetries halves the span each attempt, so extremely oversized histories need several compactions rather than one.

Repro notes for maintainers
session.v4.jsonl.zstd is a concatenation of independently checksummed zstd frames, not a single frame. Node's zstdDecompressSync() and createZstdDecompress() both silently return only the first frame (314 bytes here). DSH's own dsh-session-persistence-jsonl ships a proper multi-frame decoder, so the harness reads these files correctly — but any external analysis tooling needs to split on frame magic 28 B5 2F FD and decode each frame.
I am posting this as a discussion rather than opening a PR against deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness because I do not have push access to the official repository. The branch above carries the full change and the reproducer's measured numbers.

threads.title: [Bug] 复制消息正文时行内代码前后被插入换行符（display:inline-flex 布局导致）
threads.bodyText:
环境

DSH：@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.2.1-rc.5，Web GUI（127.0.0.1:3080）
系统：Windows 11（build 26100），Chromium 内核浏览器
已排除本机插件因素（逐个查过样式注入，没有改写 markdown / code 的选择器）

现象
在助手消息里从段落开头拖选到结尾（选区中含行内 code），Ctrl+C 后粘贴到任意纯文本框（例如 DSH 底部输入框），结果是：每一段行内 code 前后各多出一个换行符，code 之外的文字留在原来那一行，行尾空格也还在。视觉上完全正常，只有复制出来的纯文本坏掉。块级 ``` 代码栅栏不受影响（它自带复制按钮）。
原文形如：
把 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml 第 257-258 行的 searchProvider: ddg 改成别的

粘贴出来变成：
把 
~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml 
第 
257-258 
行的 
searchProvider: ddg 
改成别的

这不是多打了换行，是剪贴板里的真字符
粘贴后手工删掉这些换行，显示立刻恢复正常；换行数量与粘贴进来的一致。DevTools 里 getSelection().toString() 也能直接看到这些 \n。所以是"复制那一刻"写进去的，不是渲染折行。
根因
packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/MarkdownText.module.css:163-174
.markdown :not(pre) > code {
  display: inline-flex;   /* :164 */
  align-items: center;    /* :165 */
  ...
  padding: 0 5px;         /* :173 */
}
Chromium 把选区序列化为纯文本时，会在"非 inline 的块级布局对象"前后各插一个 \n：
third_party/blink/renderer/core/editing/iterators/text_iterator.cc:662 ShouldEmitNewlinesBeforeAndAfterNode()
→ :709 return !r->IsInline() && r->IsLayoutBlock() && !r->IsFloatingOrOutOfFlowPositioned() && !r->IsBody();
display:inline-flex 生成的布局对象是 LayoutFlexibleBox（继承 LayoutBlock，IsInline() 为 false），前后各命中一次 ⇒ 行内代码被复制成一整行。（inline-block 同理；只有 display:inline 的 LayoutInline 不会触发。）
对照同一组件的 compact 变体，同文件 :384-392：
.compact :not(pre) > code {
  display: inline;
  ...
  box-decoration-break: clone;   /* :391 */
}
compact 路径复制时不断行 —— 看上去更像主路径漏了这两条声明，而不是有意设计。
当前 0.2.1-rc.5 的构建产物里规则仍在：
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-frontend/dist/assets/index-BNyAYEM7.css:1
._markdown_1ypvv_5 :not(pre)>code{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;...}
复现

让助手回复里出现行内 code（路径/命令即可）
从段首拖选到段尾，Ctrl+C
粘到任意纯文本框：每段行内 code 前后各多一个换行

建议修法
主路径向 compact 变体对齐：
.markdown :not(pre) > code {
  display: inline;
  box-decoration-break: clone;
  -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone;
  ...
}
代价只是胶囊的垂直居中退回基线对齐（水平 padding、圆角、背景色都保留）。
相关

#7384 —— 同一条规则，症状是"段落中的长行内代码让该行正文不可见"
#1216 —— 也是复制多出换行，但那是复制按钮取 content 文本的路径，根因不同

如果这个胶囊视觉是有意为之，也请说明一下，我就只在本地覆盖。

threads.title: Is one host with multiple frontends (Web + IM bot) a supported architecture?
threads.bodyText:
Question
Is one dsh host with multiple frontends (e.g. the Web UI and an IM bot) a supported architecture, or is the intended shape one host per frontend?
I am not asking for a feature commitment — a clear "one host per frontend is the contract" is a useful answer. I would like to know which way the architecture is pointing before investing further in a fork.
Why I am asking
I use the Web UI daily and also want Feishu (via the @dsh-feishu/dsh-feishu bundle). The documented pattern runs the Feishu bundle in its own profile, i.e. a second host with its own session store. That works, but the two hosts cannot see each other's sessions: a conversation started in Feishu is invisible in the Web UI, cross-frontend /resume does not exist, and approvals/questions are pending only on the side that raised them.
For a personal assistant, "same conversation from either frontend" is the whole point, so I built a local fork of the Feishu plugin that mounts into the web profile and shares the host. It works (shared session map, broadcast approvals with first-answer-wins, external-turn mirroring, tool scoping, log de-duplication), but every one of those behaviours is a guess about a contract that I could not find documented.
What a contract would need to define
If N frontends per host is supported (or planned), these are the questions a frontend plugin has to answer, and today each plugin answers them differently:

Session ownership — one store per host, so any frontend can create/resume; how are id collisions handled when a frontend resumes a session that already exists on another frontend?
Event fan-out — does every mounted frontend observe every session event, or only sessions it created/bound? Is there a subscription seam, or is it "whatever the plugin can reach on ctx"?
Interactions — approvals/user-questions are single-answer. Is "broadcast to all frontends, first answer wins, cancel the rest" a host responsibility, or does each frontend have to implement it?
Tool scoping — host-wide registries (tools, commands, exporters) leak into every session. Is there a supported way for a frontend to scope a tool to the sessions it owns (we use tools.restrict on agents not bound to a chat)?
Lifecycle — is mounting a frontend plugin into an already-running host (hot mount / profile reload) a supported path with defined disposal semantics?
Isolation — a co-hosted frontend shares the process: is the blast radius (one plugin bug takes down the Web UI) considered acceptable, or is process isolation the intended safety boundary?

Trade-offs I can see

One host per frontend is simpler, isolates failures, and keeps each frontend's assumptions local — at the cost of duplicated state and no cross-frontend continuity.
N frontends per host gives continuity and a single registry — at the cost of shared failure domains, ambiguous interaction semantics, and a larger surface for every frontend plugin to get right.

Note on terminology
By "frontend" I mean the thing a plugin like @dsh-feishu/dsh-feishu is: the UI binding for a conversation (Web page, IM bot). I am aware surface already has a different, specific meaning in the session subsystem (the ordered projection over the event log), so I am avoiding that word here.
What I will do with the answer

If N-per-host is supported/planned: I would rather upstream the co-hosting behaviour (or a minimal version of it) than maintain a fork, and I can open a design note / incremental PRs against @dsh-feishu/dsh-feishu.
If one-host-per-frontend is the contract: I will keep the fork, document it as unsupported, and stop proposing it.

threads.title: Windows 上 AI 执行命令时屏幕闪现控制台窗口（子进程未带 CREATE_NO_WINDOW）
threads.bodyText:
环境：Windows 11 x64，DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 0.2.1-rc.3（Electron 44）
版本频道：nightly

现象
AI 每执行一条 PowerShell 命令，屏幕上会闪出一个黑色控制台窗口，标题是 cmd / powershell 的完整路径（例如 C:\WINDOWS\system32\cmd.exe）；偶尔是蓝色的 Windows PowerShell 窗口。窗口会盖在其它全屏/娱乐程序上面，一闪即没。
只在这个 AI 干活时出现，正常聊天、浏览时不出现。
成因（读包后定位）
真正起子进程的那几处调用 CreateProcessW / CreateProcessAsUserW，creationFlags 里没有带 CREATE_NO_WINDOW（0x08000000）。
STARTUPINFO 那边虽然设了 STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW + wShowWindow = SW_HIDE，但对控制台子系统程序来说，SW_HIDE 只能让窗口"先建出来再藏起来"，创建时那一帧挡不住，所以屏幕上仍然会闪。
建议修复：在上述进程创建处的 creationFlags 补上 0x08000000。这些目标的 stdio 全部走管道，不需要控制台，加上不会影响功能。
复现与验收
用 SetWinEventHook 监听 EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW，过滤类名为 ConsoleWindowClass 的窗口，统计次数：

修复前：每执行一次命令会产生数次 ConsoleWindowClass 的 SHOW 事件
建议把「一次命令执行期间不产生任何 ConsoleWindowClass SHOW 事件」作为 Windows 端的启动冒烟断言

这条断言不需要用户肉眼盯着屏幕，可以直接进 CI。
附带一条（同一个问题域）
这台机器没有安装 PowerShell 7，pwsh-local 会静默回落到 Windows PowerShell 5.1（C:\WINDOWS\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe）。用户看到的"蓝底窗口"就是它。而 5.1 默认按 OEM 代码页输出。
建议：检测不到 PowerShell 7 时给出可见提示，或优先引导安装 PS7，而不是无声回落。

threads.title: subagent-codex pins @openai/codex 0.153.4, so current models fail with model_not_found
threads.bodyText:
Bilingual report — English first, 中文在下半部分。
双语报告 —— 上半部分英文，下半部分中文。

Symptom
With a ChatGPT (not API-key) login, every subagent_codex delegation opens fine but dies at the turn stage (product-error, no closing message). Running the payload the plugin ships reproduces it outside DSH entirely:
$ node ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/@openai/codex/bin/codex.js \
    exec --model gpt-6.1-sol --skip-git-repo-check "Reply with exactly: OK"
ERROR: {"type":"error","status":400,"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error",
  "message":"The 'gpt-6.1-sol' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account.",
  "code":"model_not_found"}}

Root cause
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex pins @openai/codex at 0.153.4 — both 0.2.1-rc.5 and the newer 0.2.2-alpha.2. That CLI's app-server serves a legacy model catalog, so the current models are rejected by the backend:



payload
model/list




0.153.4 (pinned)
gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna


0.166.0 (current)
gpt-6.1-sol (default), gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-terra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-*



Same account, same ~/.codex, same binary path — only the CLI version differs. With 0.166.0 a plain turn with gpt-6.1-sol returns normally.
Environment

DSH 0.2.1-rc.5, @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex 0.2.1-rc.5 (0.2.2-alpha.2 has the same pin)
macOS arm64; Codex login is a ChatGPT account; ~/.codex/config.toml sets model = "gpt-6.1-sol"
Codex Desktop on the same machine runs 0.166.0-alpha.5.1 and uses gpt-6.1-sol without problems

Suggested fix
Bump the @openai/codex dependency to the current stable (0.166.0 as of this report) and re-verify the app-server handshake. The delegate path used by the provider (initialize → thread/start → turn/start) worked unchanged after swapping only the payload.
Workaround
An overrides entry for @openai/codex@0.153.4 in the desktop profile's pnpm-workspace.yaml, plus a local payload swap for existing installs. subagent_codex then works end to end, including tool calls inside the child workspace.

中文版
现象
用 ChatGPT 账号（不是 API key）登录时，每次 subagent_codex 委派都能连上，但在 turn 阶段失败（product-error，没有收尾消息）。用插件自带的那份 payload 在 DSH 之外就能复现同一个错误：
$ node ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/@openai/codex/bin/codex.js \
    exec --model gpt-6.1-sol --skip-git-repo-check "Reply with exactly: OK"
ERROR: {"type":"error","status":400,"error":{"type":"invalid_request_error",
  "message":"The 'gpt-6.1-sol' model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account.",
  "code":"model_not_found"}}

根因
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex 把 @openai/codex 钉死在 0.153.4——0.2.1-rc.5 和更新的 0.2.2-alpha.2 都是这个版本。该版本 CLI 的 app-server 提供的是旧的模型目录，导致当前这一代模型被后端拒绝：



payload 版本
model/list 返回




0.153.4（当前 pin）
gpt-6-astra、gpt-5.6-sol、gpt-5.6-terra、gpt-5.6-luna


0.166.0（当前稳定版）
gpt-6.1-sol（默认）、gpt-6-astra、gpt-6.1-terra、gpt-6-sol、gpt-6-luna、gpt-5.6-*



同一个账号、同一份 ~/.codex、同一个二进制路径，只有 CLI 版本不同。换成 0.166.0 后，用 gpt-6.1-sol 跑普通 turn 能正常返回。
环境

DSH 0.2.1-rc.5，@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex 0.2.1-rc.5（0.2.2-alpha.2 的 pin 相同）
macOS arm64；Codex 登录的是 ChatGPT 账号；~/.codex/config.toml 里 model = "gpt-6.1-sol"
同一台机器上的 Codex 桌面端跑的是 0.166.0-alpha.5.1，用 gpt-6.1-sol 没有任何问题

建议修法
把 @openai/codex 依赖升到当前稳定版（写这份报告时是 0.166.0），再复验一次 app-server 握手。提供方用的委派链路（initialize → thread/start → turn/start）在只换 payload 的情况下没有改动就正常工作。
临时方案
在桌面 profile 的 pnpm-workspace.yaml 里给 @openai/codex@0.153.4 加一条 overrides；对已经装好的环境再本地替换一次 payload。这样 subagent_codex 就能端到端跑通，包括在子工作区里调用工具。

threads.title: Seeded (forked) session: first request re-uploads the entire inherited log — 7.5 MB body, and a shifted system prompt
threads.bodyText:
Seeded (forked) session: first request re-uploads the entire inherited log — 7.5 MB body, and a shifted system prompt
Environment: DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (web), Windows 11, provider deepseek-official / deepseek-flash.
Related: #9927 (session-log upload keyed to provider, not endpoint), and the proxy-side counterpart I filed at ranxianglei/billion-context#5519.
What I measured
I forked a long-running session (parent session-da4469c3, 113 messages, already folded by the proxy) and sent a single "1" in the fork. Both requests were captured as outgoing bodies (proxy-side diagnostics.dumpBody).



Field
Parent, normal turn
Fork, first turn




Total body
583,455 B
8,071,802 B


dsh_session_log
10,856 B
7,504,595 B


system
27,011 chars
26,384 chars


messages
113 (0.41 MB)
109 (0.41 MB)


tools
106 (115 KB)
identical



So the 14× body inflation is entirely dsh_session_log: on the fork's first turn the uploader appears to send the whole inherited transcript, then falls back to the usual ~10 KB tail on subsequent turns.
Two questions


Is the full re-upload intended? For a seeded session the log uploader has no prior state for the new session id, so it starts from zero. That is defensible for fidelity, but it costs 7.5 MB per fork on the wire. Would an incremental/opt-in mode be acceptable (e.g. only upload when the endpoint is the official one and the session is not a fork, or send a compact manifest)?


System prompt differs between parent and fork (667 chars). The parent carries a state note in the system prompt (Generation boundary: this conversation's message-ref ledger was reset mid-conversation …); the fork, whose refs legitimately start at m00001, does not. Content-wise that is correct, but it means the wire prefix of a fork can never hash-match its parent, which is exactly the condition a prompt-cache-aware proxy needs. Would you consider keeping state-dependent notes out of the system prompt (tail attachment / separate field), or is "fork = new prefix" the intended contract?


Why it matters here
The proxy prices a fork at full input the first turn (0.4% cache hit) before recovering to ~90% on later turns. Part of that is the proxy's own breakpoint inheritance (filed separately as #5519); part is this upstream prefix drift. Worth documenting either way: if forks are meant to be prefix-compatible, one of the two layers needs to change.
Repro

diagnostics.dumpBody: true on the proxy (or any request-logging gateway).
Fork a folded session, send one short message.
Diff dsh_session_log size and system between the parent's last turn and the fork's first turn.

threads.title: 账号模型接入启动失败
Bash tool requires description, and a model that omits it loops on the rejected call
threads.bodyText:
Bash tool rejects calls that omit description, and the agent retries the same call
Environment

DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 (web profile), Node 24.
Model served over an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint (local 24B model, openai-completions protocol).
Default standard preset, 31 tools.

Symptom
Every bash call from this model is rejected:
Error: invalid arguments: missing required property "description"

The model then sends the same call again, unchanged. In one turn that produced 23 rejected bash calls across 31 steps, with the same command repeated 9 times, and the turn never answered. Nothing surfaces in the UI beyond the normal busy state; the session log is the only place the error appears.
This is on a model that behaves correctly against the same endpoint with a single tool, so it is not a broken endpoint.
What the model actually emits
Measured against the same server, same tool schema (required: ["description", "command"]):



request
tool-call arguments




one tool, no system message
{"description":"List files in /home/user/notes","command":"ls -la /home/user/notes"}


one tool + any system message
{"command":"ls -la /home/user/notes"}


31 tools + system message
{"command":"ls -la /home/user/notes"}


parameter renamed description → label
{"command": …} (so it is not the name)


strict: true, additionalProperties: false
{"command": …}


system prompt adds "always include every required argument"
works with one tool, fails with 31



So the trigger is the presence of a system message, and the model treats a UI-label-shaped field as optional metadata. A two-argument tool whose fields are both data (file_path + content) is filled correctly in every case, which is why this shows up on bash specifically.
Why it compounds
The failure is model-visible as a tool result, but the model does not adapt: it repeats the identical call until the step budget is spent. There is no repeated-identical-call guard, so one schema mismatch turns into a stalled turn rather than one failed step.
Suggested changes

Treat description as optional. It is a UI label; command is the only thing execution needs. Deriving a label from the command's first line when it is absent keeps the terminal card useful. This removes the failure mode for every model that treats the field as metadata, not just this one.
If it stays required, contain the loop. A repeated-identical-call breaker (same tool + same arguments twice or three times consecutively) would turn a 30-step stall into one clear error. That is worth having independently of this issue.

Workaround
A tools/pre-execute handler can fill a missing description from command before the tool body validates its arguments:
export const name = 'bash-argument-fallback'
export const inject = ['tools']

export function apply(ctx) {
  ctx.on('tools/pre-execute', async (exec, next) => {
    if (exec?.name === 'bash') {
      const args = exec.arguments
      if (args && typeof args === 'object' && (typeof args.description !== 'string' || args.description.trim() === '')) {
        const line = String(args.command ?? '').trim().split('\n').find(part => part.trim().length > 0) ?? 'Run command'
        exec.arguments = { ...args, description: line.slice(0, 80) }
      }
    }
    return next()
  })
}
That restores execution, though the recorded call still lacks the field; relaxing the schema as in suggestion 1 is what makes the presentation path correct too.
Happy to provide the fuller version (with tests) if it is useful.

threads.title: Tutorial chapter 7 composition is missing the tool executor — TOOL_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE
threads.bodyText:
Following docs/cordis-tutorial/07-into-the-harness as written, the chapter's example crashes:
ToolExecutorUnavailableError: The selected tool executor is unavailable.
code: 'TOOL_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE'
Repro:​ run the chapter 7 composition exactly as documented (@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt + @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools + local plugins), call ctx.tools.execute(...) from greet-tool.ts.
Root cause:​ ctx.tools.execute now delegates to a replaceable executor registered via ctx.tools.setExecutor(...) (provided by @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-executor-native), but the tutorial composition was never updated to load one.
Fix:​ add - name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-executor-native' to the chapter 7 composition in both the English and Chinese tutorials, and mention that a composition without an executor throws TOOL_EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE. I have a working patch in my fork: richuff@ca9e8f348a — happy to have it merged upstream, or feel free to apply it directly since PRs are currently disabled for this repo.

threads.title: [Bug] 每轮「改动文件」卡片会静默丢失，且同一工作区并发会话会互相串入对方的改动
threads.bodyText:
[Bug] 每轮「改动文件」卡片会静默丢失，且同一工作区并发会话会互相串入对方的改动
摘要
@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes + @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables 这套「改动文件卡片」机制有两个可复现的缺陷：

静默丢失：某轮明明有写文件操作，但卡片不出现，且用户侧没有任何错误提示。
跨会话串台：同一工作目录下并发运行的另一个会话，其改动会出现在当前会话的卡片里。

两者都不是偶发，我在一个真实使用环境（约 810 个会话的历史日志）里做了量化：会话级零卡片率 15.9%（主会话）、轮次级缺失率 6.2%~23.3%、会话最后一轮缺失率 54.5%；原生事件中 24.7% 的轮窗口内混入了其他会话的写入。
经完整代码走查与第三方插件排除，判定这是框架层问题，不是任何第三方插件造成的（排除过程见文末）。

环境

DSH Host：Desktop（Electron 打包，checkout 为单文件 app.asar）
OS：macOS（Apple Silicon）
git：2.50.1，xcode-select -p 已正确配置（排除 A7 退化路径）
developerTools: true（即 showCodeDiff 总开关为开启状态）
相关包版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace-changes 0.2.1-rc.5、@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables、@deepseek-ai/dsh-session
所涉工作区均为 git 仓库（git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree = true）


复现步骤
缺陷 A：并发会话串台（必现，不需要特殊条件）

打开同一个 git 工作区的两个会话（本文称 A、B）。
让 A 进入一轮并中途写文件（例如修改 lib/foo.dart）。
在 A 的轮窗口（turn/start 到 turn/end）之内，让 B 开始一轮并在 A 写完之前结束；B 自己一个文件都不改。
观察 B 这一轮的「改动文件」卡片。

实际行为：B 的卡片里出现了 lib/foo.dart，甚至出现 B 从未访问过的目录下的文件（例如 A 持续写入 31 个文件，B 的卡片就把这 31 个都列上）。
期望行为：B 的卡片应为空或只包含 B 自己写过的文件。
本机统计（原生事件 974 条，按精确的 turn/start.time → turn/end.time 窗口判定）：**241 条（24.7%）**窗口内存在别的会话写入、且那些路径本会话全生命周期从未写过；其中 23 轮本会话在该轮一次都没写过文件——即完全纯混入。
缺陷 B：卡片静默丢失

跑一轮并写文件，确认卡片正常出现。
重启 Host，或让该会话从 live store 移除（关闭会话 / 引用释放）。
回到历史会话查看该轮。

实际行为：卡片消失；前端向 /api/changes.summary 请求得到 404 "Change summary unavailable."，不显示任何内容。
期望行为：历史轮次的改动摘要应当可以重新拉取，或在 UI 上明确区分「已不可用」与「本轮无改动」。
另一条丢失路径（无需重启）：工作区快照耗时接近但未超时的边界场景下，整轮被丢弃且无任何提示——见下文 A4/A5。

根因分析
一、串台：归属判据根本不存在
采集器每轮做两次整棵 git 工作树快照，再求差：

lib/types/git.js snapshotTree()：mkdtemp 临时 index → 复制仓库 .git/index → git add --all --ignore-errors → git write-tree
轮末 record() 再拍一次，diffTrees(before, after) 用 git diff-tree -r -M -z --numstat 求差
快照的 cwd 固定为 workspace.root（由 git rev-parse --show-toplevel 得出）

关键在于 diff 的对象是整个工作树，而不是本会话触碰过的路径。recorder.js 里唯一的归属相关逻辑是 capture()（挂 fs/write-intent / fs/edit-intent），但它只在 git 未覆盖某文件时补位，无法把别人的改动排除掉。
也就是说，归属完全由「时间窗」决定：谁的轮窗口盖住了该文件的变化时刻，就记到谁头上。项目 README 里也写明了这个语义：

"Edits the user makes during a turn are attributed to that turn."

在单人单会话时这是可接受的近似；一旦同 cwd 并发（本机是常态），就必然串台。本机统计：同 cwd 且轮窗口重叠的会话对 760，其中交集区间内双方都实际写了文件的 532 对，涉及 240 个会话、8 个工作区。
二、丢失：三条独立且全部静默的路径
A4 — 基线快照失败即整轮放弃，且无任何用户可见提示
lib/types/recorder.js start(turn) 里基线快照 catch 后：
state.baseline = "failed";
throw error;   // 注释：A repository whose snapshot failed must not be summarized as if it had none
随后 record() 第一步就早退：
if (paths === undefined || baseline === "failed" || state.lastToolResultSeq < 0) return;
这意味着连 capture() 已经收集到的文件工具调用记录也一起丢弃——明明知道改了哪些文件，却因为一个快照失败而整轮不报。失败本身只经 warnUnlessDisposed 打一行 logger 警告，不写事件、不进 UI、不重试。
A5 — 失败标记先于实际工作置位，导致永不重试
record() 中 state.attemptedAfterSeq = state.lastToolResultSeq; 写在快照之前。于是本轮一旦抛错，turn/end 的补记判断
if (turn !== state.turn || state.attemptedAfterSeq >= state.lastToolResultSeq) return;
永远成立，该轮永久丢失，没有第二次机会。把置位挪到成功之后即可修复。
B1/B2/B3 — 摘要只活在 Host 进程内存


事件里只存 { turn }，不含 files：'workspace/changes': { turn: number }，本机 1240 条事件中 data 的键集合 100% 只有 ('turn',)，含 files 的 0 条。


摘要存于 byId Map（index.js 的 ctx.provide("workspaceChanges", { summary: (id, seq) => byId.get(id)?.summary(seq) })），由路由 dsh-client-ui-deliverables/lib/index.js 的 handleChangesSummary 读取：
const summary = ctx.workspaceChanges.summary(id, seq);
if (summary === void 0) return new Response("Change summary unavailable.", { status: 404 });


ctx.on("session/disposed", session => forget(session)) → forget() 执行 recorders.delete(session); byId.delete(session.id); recorder?.dispose()，而 dispose() 里 records.clear()。records.clear() 甚至是同步执行的，发生在 await 之前。


客户端拿到 404 后：const changes = ... typeof summary === "object" && summary.files.length > 0 ? {...} : null; → 字符串 "missing" 不是 object → 无卡片。且 ChangesSummaryStore.retryable: () => false，只有 connection/reset 才会清缓存 → 永久不重试。


代码注释本身就承认了这个设计：

"serving one announced change summary while its Session lives"
"A summary the Host no longer serves leaves no card."

对照证据：同一框架里的 deliverables/presented 事件把 files[] 写进事件，重启后照样能渲染（本机 85 个会话有此事件）。这证明「事件自带文件列表」在本框架里是完全可行的，workspace/changes 只是没这么做。
三、性能边界会放大上述问题
snapshotTree 的成本是整个工作树，且临时 index 从不写回仓库，所以每次都是冷启动全量 hash。我在一个未提交、无 .gitignore、含 5 个 embedded repo 的工作区上实测：

单次 git add --all --ignore-errors：15.5s，写入 548MB 对象
每轮跑两次（turn/start + agent/turn-stopping）→ ≈31s/轮
而 timeoutMs 默认 30000（AbortSignal.timeout 是每条 git 命令 30s，不是整轮）

余量只有 1.9x。我实测 3 个并发快照各 18.1s（只慢 17%），所以不是必然超时，但机器繁忙/磁盘抖动时很容易踩线，一旦踩线就落入 A4/A5 的「整轮静默丢失」。
另外 agent/turn-stopping 的处理是 await recorders.get(agent.session)?.stopping(turn) —— 快照会阻塞轮末，这也解释了为什么这类工作区里轮次收尾明显变慢。

影响面（脱敏后的实测数据）
会话日志全库 810 个会话 / 1240 条 workspace/changes 事件。统计口径：某轮有 write/edit 调用且 file_path 落在 cwd 内，但日志中没有对应 data.turn 的 workspace/changes 事件。



分组

缺失率

注意 workspace-b / workspace-c 都是健康的、有 .gitignore 的小仓库，缺失率反而更高——说明这不是「仓库太大导致超时」的单一问题，A4/A5/B 系列才是主因。
整场 0 卡的样本（v4 主会话）：27 个 turn/start/turn/end 完整配对、498 次工具调用、10 个写轮共 63 次 write/edit，而 3519 条事件里 workspace/changes = 0，但同会话 deliverables/presented = 2。事件通道和前端都正常，唯独缺这一路。
逐轮失效的样本也能定位到具体轮次（例如 7 个写轮缺 4 个、27 个写轮只缺 1 个且该轮有 18 次写入），说明不是「整个会话被跳过」，而是特定轮的快照/记录失败。

已做的第三方插件排除
该环境装有多个第三方 DSH 插件（Host 侧与 Client 侧均有），已逐一排查：

全量 grep 采集链路的关键钩子：tools/pre-execute 0 命中、fs/write-intent 0 命中、fs/edit-intent 0 命中 → 插件根本没有接入采集链路。
对 workspace/changes / workspaceChanges / changes.summary 做全量 grep，在插件目录中零命中，生产者与消费者只有上述两个 @deepseek-ai 包。
会写 session.append 的插件只有两处（均为往自己的会话补一条消息）；挂 agent/turn-stopping 的只有一处且是 fire-and-forget。
客户端侧：无插件注册 uiConversation / conversation.chat.turnTail / tool.call.toolview，无法隐藏卡片；各插件的 slot 用 key:id 唯一注册，不占用 changes-review 位。
其余插件均为只读旁路，且都带 session?.id !== sessionId 之类的守卫。

因此这两个现象与第三方插件无关。

附：验证用的最小命令
# 1. 观察事件里是否带 files（当前应为只有 turn）
zstd -dc ~/.dsh/sessions/<slug>/<sid>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd \
  | grep -o '"type":"workspace/changes"[^}]*}' | head

# 2. 复现串台：同 cwd 两会话，B 的卡片应包含 A 的改动
# 3. 复现 404：改文件 → 重启 Host → 回看历史会话
